local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
while not LocalPlayer do
    LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players:GetPlayers()[1]
    task.wait()
end

if _G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP then
    pcall(_G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP)
    _G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP = nil
end

local _MODULES = {}
local _CACHE = {}

local function _resolveRel(baseParts, rel)
    local p = {}
    for _, seg in ipairs(baseParts) do
        table.insert(p, seg)
    end
    for seg in rel:gmatch("[^/]+") do
        if seg == "." then

        elseif seg == ".." then
            if #p > 0 then
                table.remove(p)
            end
        else
            table.insert(p, seg)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(p, "/")
end

local function _resolve(callerPath, req)
    if req:sub(1, 6) == "@game/" then
        return req:sub(7)
    end

    local parts = {}
    for seg in callerPath:gmatch("[^/]+") do
        table.insert(parts, seg)
    end

    local parentParts = {}
    for i = 1, #parts - 1 do
        table.insert(parentParts, parts[i])
    end

    if req:sub(1, 6) == "@self/" then
        local sub = req:sub(7)
        local candA = callerPath .. "/" .. sub
        if _MODULES[candA] then return candA end
        local candB = table.concat(parentParts, "/") .. "/" .. sub
        if _MODULES[candB] then return candB end
        return candA
    end

    if req:sub(1, 2) == "./" or req:sub(1, 3) == "../" then
        local candA = _resolveRel(parentParts, req)
        if _MODULES[candA] then return candA end
        local candB = _resolveRel(parts, req)
        if _MODULES[candB] then return candB end
        return candA
    end

    local candA = table.concat(parentParts, "/") .. "/" .. req
    if _MODULES[candA] then return candA end
    local candB = callerPath .. "/" .. req
    if _MODULES[candB] then return candB end

    return req
end

local _RESOLVE_CACHE = {}
local _LOADING = {}

local function _virtualRequire(callerPath, reqPath)
    local cacheKey = callerPath .. "\0" .. reqPath
    local target = _RESOLVE_CACHE[cacheKey]
    if not target then
        target = _resolve(callerPath, reqPath)
        _RESOLVE_CACHE[cacheKey] = target
    end

    if _CACHE[target] ~= nil then
        return _CACHE[target]
    end

    if _LOADING[target] then
        error(string.format("[Minecraft Virtual Require] Dependência circular detectada: %s (chamado de %s)", tostring(target), tostring(callerPath)))
    end

    local modFn = _MODULES[target]
    if not modFn then
        error(string.format("[Minecraft Virtual Require] Módulo não encontrado: %s (resolvido como: %s) de %s", tostring(reqPath), tostring(target), tostring(callerPath)))
    end

    _LOADING[target] = true

    local function req(subReq)
        return _virtualRequire(target, subReq)
    end

    local res = modFn(req)
    _CACHE[target] = res
    _LOADING[target] = nil
    return res
end

local _ServerReceiveHandler = nil
local _ClientReceiveHandler = nil
local _SharedProtocol = nil
local _ServerToClientQueue = {}
local _ClientToServerQueue = {}

local function _getProtocol()
    if not _SharedProtocol then
        local Minecraft = _virtualRequire("ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft", "@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
        _SharedProtocol = Minecraft.Protocol
    end
    return _SharedProtocol
end

local function _ProcessServerToClient(msg)
    if not _ClientReceiveHandler then return end
    local Protocol = _getProtocol()
    local Reader = Protocol.CreateReader(msg)
    while Protocol.HasMore(Reader) do
        local pid = Protocol.ReadU8(Reader)
        _ClientReceiveHandler(pid, Reader)
    end
end

local function _DeliverServerToClient(msg)
    if _ClientReceiveHandler then
        _ProcessServerToClient(msg)
    else
        table.insert(_ServerToClientQueue, msg)
    end
end

local function _ProcessClientToServer(msg)
    if not _ServerReceiveHandler then return end
    local Protocol = _getProtocol()
    local Reader = Protocol.CreateReader(msg)
    while Protocol.HasMore(Reader) do
        local pid = Protocol.ReadU8(Reader)
        _ServerReceiveHandler(LocalPlayer, pid, Reader)
    end
end

local function _DeliverClientToServer(msg)
    if _ServerReceiveHandler then
        _ProcessClientToServer(msg)
    else
        table.insert(_ClientToServerQueue, msg)
    end
end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft"] = function(require)

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
const UserGameSettings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")

const Minecraft = require("../Shared/Minecraft")
const Avatars = require("@self/Avatars")
const Camera = require("@self/Camera")
const Chat = require("@self/Chat")
const Connection = require("@self/Connection")
const Containers = require("@self/Containers")
const FirstPerson = require("@self/FirstPerson")
const Gui = require("@self/Gui")
const Input = require("@self/Input")
const Level = require("@self/Level")
const Interaction = require("@self/Interaction")
const ItemActivation = require("@self/ItemActivation")
const ItemEntities = require("@self/ItemEntities")
const Particles = require("@self/Particles")
const Players = require("@self/Players")
const Projectiles = require("@self/Projectiles")
const Rendering = require("@self/Rendering")
const Screens = require("@self/Screens")
const Shadows = require("@self/Shadows")
const Sounds = require("@self/Sounds")
const Textures = require("@self/Textures")

const TickSeconds = 0.05
const MaximumTicksPerFrame = 10
const MouseSensitivity = 1

local Elapsed = 0

const RemovedIds: { number } = {}

const function Bounds(EntityId: number): (vector?, number, number)
	const Player = Players.Entities[EntityId]

	if Player then
		return Player.Position, Player.Width, Player.Height
	end

	const ProjectilePosition, ProjectileWidth, ProjectileHeight = Projectiles.Bounds(EntityId)

	if ProjectilePosition then
		return ProjectilePosition, ProjectileWidth, ProjectileHeight
	end

	const ItemPosition, ItemWidth, ItemHeight = ItemEntities.Bounds(EntityId)

	if ItemPosition then
		return ItemPosition, ItemWidth, ItemHeight
	end

	return Interaction.HumanoidBounds(EntityId)
end

const function Locate(EntityId: number): vector?
	return (Bounds(EntityId))
end

const function Frame(DeltaTime: number)
	Elapsed += DeltaTime

	local Ticks = Elapsed // TickSeconds

	Elapsed -= Ticks * TickSeconds
	Ticks = math.min(Ticks, MaximumTicksPerFrame)

	for _ = 1, Ticks do
		const Ticking = Players.GetLocal()

		if Ticking then
			Containers.Tick()
			Gui.Tick(Ticking)
			Screens.Tick(Ticking)
			Input.Tick()
			Textures.Tick()
		end

		Chat.SetMinecraft(Ticking ~= nil)
		Players.SetKeysEnabled(not Screens.IsOpen())
		Players.Tick(Interaction.TouchesLiving)
		Projectiles.Tick()
		ItemEntities.Tick()
		Particles.SetScopingEye(if Ticking and Camera.IsFirstPerson() and Players.IsScoping(Ticking) then Ticking.Position + vector.create(0, Ticking.EyeHeight, 0) else nil)
		Particles.Tick(Bounds)

		const Local = Players.GetLocal()

		if Local then
			FirstPerson.Tick(Local)
			Level.Tick()
			Camera.Tick(Players.CameraEntity() or Local)
		end

		Connection.Flush()
	end

	const Local = Players.GetLocal()
	const Partial = Elapsed / TickSeconds

	if Local then
		const RobloxScale = UserGameSettings.MouseSensitivity * UserInputService.MouseDeltaSensitivity
		const MouseDelta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta() / RobloxScale

		if not Screens.IsOpen() then
			Players.Turn(MouseDelta.X * MouseSensitivity, MouseDelta.Y * MouseSensitivity)
		end

		Camera.Render(Players.CameraEntity() or Local, Partial, Screens.IsOpen())
		Rendering.UpdateLightmap(Local.Effects, Local.TickCount, Partial, Players.WaterVision(Local))
	end

	Sounds.Update(Locate)
	Shadows.Begin()
	Avatars.Draw(Partial, if Camera.IsFirstPerson() then Players.CameraEntity() else nil)
	Projectiles.Draw(Partial)
	ItemEntities.Draw(Partial)
	Shadows.Finish()
	Particles.Draw(Partial)
	Gui.DrawFireOverlay(Local ~= nil and Local.OnFire and Camera.IsFirstPerson() and Local.GameMode ~= "spectator", Camera.HudFieldOfView())

	if Local then
		FirstPerson.Draw(Local, Partial, Camera.IsFirstPerson() and not Gui.IsHidden() and Local.GameMode ~= "spectator")
		ItemActivation.Draw(Local, Partial, not Gui.IsHidden())
	end

	if Local then
		const Width, Height, Scale = Gui.BeginFrame(Local.Cooldowns, Partial)

		if Camera.IsFirstPerson() and Local.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			Gui.DrawScreenEffects(Width, Height, Camera.HudFieldOfView(), Local.Fluid.EyeInWater, Local.YRot, Local.XRot)
		end

		Gui.DrawHud(Local, Width, Height, Partial, Camera.IsFirstPerson(), Players.AttackStrengthScale(Local, 0), Interaction.ShowsMaxAttackIndicator(Local), Screens.ShowsActiveEffects())
		Screens.Draw(Width, Height, Scale, Partial)
		Gui.DrawToasts(Width)
		Gui.EndFrame()
	end
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	if PacketId == Minecraft.Protocol.Clientbound.RemoveEntities then
		for Index = 1, Minecraft.Protocol.ReadRemoveEntities(Reader, RemovedIds) do
			Players.Remove(RemovedIds[Index])
			Projectiles.Remove(RemovedIds[Index])
			ItemEntities.Remove(RemovedIds[Index])
		end

		return
	end

	if not Sounds.Receive(PacketId, Reader, Locate)
		and not Particles.Receive(PacketId, Reader, Bounds)
		and not Projectiles.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not ItemEntities.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Players.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Containers.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Level.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Screens.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Chat.Receive(PacketId, Reader)
		and not Gui.Receive(PacketId, Reader) then
		error(`Unknown clientbound packet {PacketId}`)
	end
end

const function Start()
	Connection.Start(Receive)
	Chat.Start()
	Input.Start()
	Interaction.Start()

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("Minecraft", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, Frame)
end

return Start

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Textures"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")

const AtlasSources = {
	blocks = require("@self/BlocksAtlas"),
	items = require("@self/ItemsAtlas"),
	gui = require("@self/GuiAtlas"),
	particles = require("@self/ParticlesAtlas"),
}

const StandaloneTextures = require("@self/StandaloneTextures")

export type AtlasName = "blocks" | "items" | "gui" | "particles"

export type Scaling = {
	Type: "tile" | "nine_slice",
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Border: { Left: number, Top: number, Right: number, Bottom: number }?,
	StretchInner: boolean?,
}

export type Sprite = {
	Size: Vector2,
	Frames: { Vector2 },
	Sequence: { { Frame: number, Time: number } }?,
	Interpolate: boolean?,
	Scaling: Scaling?,
}

export type Atlas = {
	Size: Vector2,
	Content: Content?,
	Pixels: buffer,
	Sprites: { [string]: Sprite },
}

export type Texture = {
	Size: Vector2,
	Pixels: buffer,
}

const MissingSprite = "minecraft:missingno"

const LoadedAtlases: { [AtlasName]: Atlas } = {}
const LoadedTextures: { [string]: Texture } = {}
const LoadedContents: { [string]: Content } = {}
local StandalonePixels: buffer? = nil
local AnimationTicks = 0

const function Decode(Encoded: string): buffer
	return EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Encoded)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
end

const function Atlas(Name: AtlasName): Atlas
	const Existing = LoadedAtlases[Name]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Source = AtlasSources[Name]
	const Loaded: Atlas = {
		Size = Source.Size,
		Content = nil,
		Pixels = Decode(Source.Pixels),
		Sprites = Source.Sprites,
	}

	LoadedAtlases[Name] = Loaded

	return Loaded
end

const function AtlasContent(Source: Atlas): Content
	const Existing = Source.Content

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Image = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Source.Size })

	Image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Source.Size, Source.Pixels)

	const Created = Content.fromObject(Image)

	Source.Content = Created

	return Created
end

const function Sprite(Source: Atlas, Id: string): Sprite
	return Source.Sprites[Id] or Source.Sprites[MissingSprite]
end

const function Tick()
	AnimationTicks += 1
end

const function FrameIndex(Sprite: Sprite): number
	const Sequence = Sprite.Sequence

	if not Sequence then
		return 1
	end

	local Total = 0

	for _, Step in Sequence do
		Total += Step.Time
	end

	local Remaining = AnimationTicks % Total

	for _, Step in Sequence do
		if Remaining < Step.Time then
			return Step.Frame
		end

		Remaining -= Step.Time
	end

	return Sequence[1].Frame
end

const function Frame(Sprite: Sprite): Vector2
	return Sprite.Frames[FrameIndex(Sprite)]
end

const function Texture(Id: string): Texture
	const Existing = LoadedTextures[Id]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Source = StandaloneTextures.Textures[Id]
	const Length = Source.Size.X * Source.Size.Y * 4
	const Pixels = buffer.create(Length)

	if not StandalonePixels then
		StandalonePixels = Decode(StandaloneTextures.Pixels)
	end

	buffer.copy(Pixels, 0, StandalonePixels :: buffer, Source.Offset, Length)

	const Loaded = { Size = Source.Size, Pixels = Pixels }

	LoadedTextures[Id] = Loaded

	return Loaded
end

const function BasePalette(Id: string): string?
	return StandaloneTextures.Textures[Id].BasePalette
end

const function HasTexture(Id: string): boolean
	return StandaloneTextures.Textures[Id] ~= nil
end

const function TextureContent(Id: string): Content
	const Existing = LoadedContents[Id]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Loaded = Texture(Id)
	const Image = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Loaded.Size })

	Image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Loaded.Size, Loaded.Pixels)

	const Created = Content.fromObject(Image)

	LoadedContents[Id] = Created

	return Created
end

return {
	Atlas = Atlas,
	AtlasContent = AtlasContent,
	TextureContent = TextureContent,
	Sprite = Sprite,
	Tick = Tick,
	Frame = Frame,
	FrameIndex = FrameIndex,
	Texture = Texture,
	HasTexture = HasTexture,
	BasePalette = BasePalette,
}

end

		["minecraft:palettes/trim/netherite_darker"] = { Size = Vector2.new(8, 1), Offset = 4169088 },
		["minecraft:palettes/trim/quartz"] = { Size = Vector2.new(8, 1), Offset = 4169120 },
		["minecraft:palettes/trim/redstone"] = { Size = Vector2.new(8, 1), Offset = 4169152 },
		["minecraft:palettes/trim/resin"] = { Size = Vector2.new(8, 1), Offset = 4169184 },
		["minecraft:palettes/trim_base"] = { Size = Vector2.new(8, 1), Offset = 4169216 },
		["minecraft:gui/container/inventory"] = { Size = Vector2.new(256, 256), Offset = 4169248 },
		["minecraft:gui/container/creative_inventory/tab_items"] = { Size = Vector2.new(256, 256), Offset = 4431392 },
		["minecraft:gui/container/creative_inventory/tab_item_search"] = { Size = Vector2.new(256, 256), Offset = 4693536 },
		["minecraft:gui/container/creative_inventory/tab_inventory"] = { Size = Vector2.new(256, 256), Offset = 4955680 },
	},
}

const Equipment = require("@self/Equipment")

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/ModelPart"] = function(require)

export type Vertex = {
	Position: vector,
	U: number,
	V: number,
}

export type Polygon = {
	Vertices: { Vertex },
	Normal: vector,
	Cube: number,
}

export type Pose = {
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Z: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRot: number,
	ZRot: number,
}

export type Part = {
	Name: string,
	Parent: Part?,
	Polygons: { Polygon },
	Initial: Pose,
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Z: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRot: number,
	ZRot: number,
	Visible: boolean,
}

const Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
const Up = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
const North = vector.create(0, 0, -1)
const South = vector.create(0, 0, 1)
const West = vector.create(-1, 0, 0)
const East = vector.create(1, 0, 0)

local CubeCount = 0

const function Polygon(Corners: { vector }, U0: number, V0: number, U1: number, V1: number, Mirror: boolean, Facing: vector, Cube: number): Polygon
	const Vertices = {
		{ Position = Corners[1], U = U1, V = V0 },
		{ Position = Corners[2], U = U0, V = V0 },
		{ Position = Corners[3], U = U0, V = V1 },
		{ Position = Corners[4], U = U1, V = V1 },
	}

	if Mirror then
		Vertices[1], Vertices[4] = Vertices[4], Vertices[1]
		Vertices[2], Vertices[3] = Vertices[3], Vertices[2]
	end

	return { Vertices = Vertices, Normal = if Mirror and Facing.Y == 0 and Facing.Z == 0 then -Facing else Facing, Cube = Cube }
end

const function Cube(TexU: number, TexV: number, MinX: number, MinY: number, MinZ: number, Width: number, Height: number, Depth: number, Grow: number, Mirror: boolean): { Polygon }
	local MaxX = MinX + Width + Grow
	local LowX = MinX - Grow

	const LowY = MinY - Grow
	const LowZ = MinZ - Grow
	const MaxY = MinY + Height + Grow
	const MaxZ = MinZ + Depth + Grow

	if Mirror then
		LowX, MaxX = MaxX, LowX
	end

	const T0 = vector.create(LowX, LowY, LowZ)
	const T1 = vector.create(MaxX, LowY, LowZ)
	const T2 = vector.create(MaxX, MaxY, LowZ)
	const T3 = vector.create(LowX, MaxY, LowZ)
	const L0 = vector.create(LowX, LowY, MaxZ)
	const L1 = vector.create(MaxX, LowY, MaxZ)
	const L2 = vector.create(MaxX, MaxY, MaxZ)
	const L3 = vector.create(LowX, MaxY, MaxZ)

	const U0 = TexU
	const U1 = TexU + Depth
	const U2 = TexU + Depth + Width
	const U22 = TexU + Depth + Width + Width
	const U3 = TexU + Depth + Width + Depth
	const U4 = TexU + Depth + Width + Depth + Width
	const V0 = TexV
	const V1 = TexV + Depth
	const V2 = TexV + Depth + Height

	CubeCount += 1

	const Id = CubeCount

	return {
		Polygon({ L1, L0, T0, T1 }, U1, V0, U2, V1, Mirror, Down, Id),
		Polygon({ T2, T3, L3, L2 }, U2, V1, U22, V0, Mirror, Up, Id),
		Polygon({ T0, L0, L3, T3 }, U0, V1, U1, V2, Mirror, West, Id),
		Polygon({ T1, T0, T3, T2 }, U1, V1, U2, V2, Mirror, North, Id),
		Polygon({ L1, T1, T2, L2 }, U2, V1, U3, V2, Mirror, East, Id),
		Polygon({ L0, L1, L2, L3 }, U3, V1, U4, V2, Mirror, South, Id),
	}
end

const function Create(Name: string, Parent: Part?, Polygons: { Polygon }, X: number, Y: number, Z: number): Part
	return {
		Name = Name,
		Parent = Parent,
		Polygons = Polygons,
		Initial = { X = X, Y = Y, Z = Z, XRot = 0, YRot = 0, ZRot = 0 },
		X = X,
		Y = Y,
		Z = Z,
		XRot = 0,
		YRot = 0,
		ZRot = 0,
		Visible = true,
	}
end

const function ResetPose(Part: Part)
	const Initial = Part.Initial

	Part.X = Initial.X
	Part.Y = Initial.Y
	Part.Z = Initial.Z
	Part.XRot = Initial.XRot
	Part.YRot = Initial.YRot
	Part.ZRot = Initial.ZRot
end

return {
	Cube = Cube,
	Create = Create,
	ResetPose = ResetPose,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/PlayerModel"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const ModelPart = require("./ModelPart")
const SpearAnimations = require("./SpearAnimations")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const OverlayGrow = 0.25
const FlightThreshold = Minecraft.Mth.Float(1.0E-5)
const HatGrow = 0.5

export type Arm = "Left" | "Right"

export type ArmPose = "Empty" | "Item" | "Block" | "BowAndArrow" | "ThrowTrident" | "CrossbowCharge" | "CrossbowHold" | "Spyglass" | "TootHorn" | "Brush" | "Spear"

export type AvatarRenderState = {
	AgeInTicks: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRot: number,
	WalkAnimationPos: number,
	WalkAnimationSpeed: number,
	SpeedValue: number,
	SwimAmount: number,
	IsInWater: boolean,
	IsVisuallySwimming: boolean,
	AgeScale: number,
	IsCrouching: boolean,
	IsFallFlying: boolean,
	IsPassenger: boolean,
	IsSpectator: boolean,
	IsUsingItem: boolean,
	MainArm: Arm,
	UseItemArm: Arm,
	RightArmPose: ArmPose,
	LeftArmPose: ArmPose,
	MaxCrossbowChargeDuration: number,
	TicksUsingItem: number,
	SwingAnimation: number,
	SwingArm: Arm?,
	SwingType: SwingType,
	RightKinetic: SpearAnimations.Kinetic?,
	LeftKinetic: SpearAnimations.Kinetic?,
	ElytraRotX: number,
	ElytraRotY: number,
	ElytraRotZ: number,
	FallFlyingScale: number,
	FlyingYRot: number,
}

export type SwingType = "None" | "Whack" | "Stab"

export type PlayerModel = {
	Slim: boolean,
	Head: ModelPart.Part,
	Body: ModelPart.Part,
	RightArm: ModelPart.Part,
	LeftArm: ModelPart.Part,
	RightLeg: ModelPart.Part,
	LeftLeg: ModelPart.Part,
	Parts: { ModelPart.Part },
}

const TwoHandedPoses = { BowAndArrow = true, CrossbowCharge = true, CrossbowHold = true }
const OffhandAffectingPoses = { BowAndArrow = true, ThrowTrident = true, CrossbowCharge = true, CrossbowHold = true }

const function Combine(First: { ModelPart.Polygon }, Second: { ModelPart.Polygon }): { ModelPart.Polygon }
	const Combined = table.clone(First)

	table.move(Second, 1, #Second, #Combined + 1, Combined)

	return Combined
end

const function QuadraticArmUpdate(Value: number): number
	return -65 * Value + Value * Value
end

const function BobModelPart(Part: ModelPart.Part, AgeInTicks: number, Scale: number)
	Part.ZRot += Scale * (Mth.Cos(AgeInTicks * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05)
	Part.XRot += Scale * (Mth.Sin(AgeInTicks * 0.067) * 0.05)
end

const function AnimateCrossbowHold(Model: PlayerModel, HoldingInRightArm: boolean)
	const HoldingArm = if HoldingInRightArm then Model.RightArm else Model.LeftArm
	const ShootingArm = if HoldingInRightArm then Model.LeftArm else Model.RightArm

	HoldingArm.YRot = (if HoldingInRightArm then -0.3 else 0.3) + Model.Head.YRot
	ShootingArm.YRot = (if HoldingInRightArm then 0.6 else -0.6) + Model.Head.YRot
	HoldingArm.XRot = -math.pi / 2 + Model.Head.XRot + 0.1
	ShootingArm.XRot = -1.5 + Model.Head.XRot
end

const function AnimateCrossbowCharge(Model: PlayerModel, MaxChargeDuration: number, TicksUsingItem: number, HoldingInRightArm: boolean)
	const HoldingArm = if HoldingInRightArm then Model.RightArm else Model.LeftArm
	const PullingArm = if HoldingInRightArm then Model.LeftArm else Model.RightArm

	HoldingArm.YRot = if HoldingInRightArm then -0.8 else 0.8
	HoldingArm.XRot = -0.97079635
	PullingArm.XRot = HoldingArm.XRot

	const LerpAlpha = Mth.Clamp(TicksUsingItem, 0, MaxChargeDuration) / MaxChargeDuration

	PullingArm.YRot = Mth.Lerp(LerpAlpha, 0.4, 0.85) * (if HoldingInRightArm then 1 else -1)
	PullingArm.XRot = Mth.Lerp(LerpAlpha, PullingArm.XRot, -math.pi / 2)
end

const function PoseBlockingArm(Model: PlayerModel, Arm: ModelPart.Part, Right: boolean)
	Arm.XRot = Arm.XRot * 0.5 - 0.9424779 + Mth.Clamp(Model.Head.XRot, -math.pi * 4 / 9, 0.43633232)
	Arm.YRot = (if Right then -30 else 30) * DegreesToRadians + Mth.Clamp(Model.Head.YRot, -math.pi / 6, math.pi / 6)
end

const function PoseArm(Model: PlayerModel, State: AvatarRenderState, Right: boolean)
	const Pose = if Right then State.RightArmPose else State.LeftArmPose
	const Arm = if Right then Model.RightArm else Model.LeftArm
	const Head = Model.Head
	const Side = if Right then -1 else 1

	if Pose == "Empty" then
		Arm.YRot = 0
	elseif Pose == "Item" then
		Arm.XRot = Arm.XRot * 0.5 - math.pi / 10
		Arm.YRot = 0
	elseif Pose == "Block" then
		PoseBlockingArm(Model, Arm, Right)
	elseif Pose == "BowAndArrow" then
		Model.RightArm.YRot = -0.1 + Head.YRot - (if Right then 0 else 0.4)
		Model.LeftArm.YRot = 0.1 + Head.YRot + (if Right then 0.4 else 0)
		Model.RightArm.XRot = -math.pi / 2 + Head.XRot
		Model.LeftArm.XRot = -math.pi / 2 + Head.XRot
	elseif Pose == "ThrowTrident" then
		Arm.XRot = Arm.XRot * 0.5 - math.pi
		Arm.YRot = 0
	elseif Pose == "CrossbowCharge" then
		AnimateCrossbowCharge(Model, State.MaxCrossbowChargeDuration, State.TicksUsingItem, Right)
	elseif Pose == "CrossbowHold" then
		AnimateCrossbowHold(Model, Right)
	elseif Pose == "Spyglass" then
		Arm.XRot = Mth.Clamp(Head.XRot - 1.9198622 - (if State.IsCrouching then math.pi / 12 else 0), -2.4, 3.3)
		Arm.YRot = Head.YRot + Side * math.pi / 12
	elseif Pose == "TootHorn" then
		Arm.XRot = Mth.Clamp(Head.XRot, -1.2, 1.2) - 1.4835298
		Arm.YRot = Head.YRot + Side * math.pi / 6
	elseif Pose == "Brush" then
		Arm.XRot = Arm.XRot * 0.5 - math.pi / 5
		Arm.YRot = 0
	elseif Pose == "Spear" then
		const ArmName: Arm = if Right then "Right" else "Left"
		const TicksUsingItem = if State.IsUsingItem and State.UseItemArm == ArmName then State.TicksUsingItem else 0

		SpearAnimations.ThirdPersonHandUse(
			Arm,
			Head,
			Right,
			if Right then State.RightKinetic else State.LeftKinetic,
			State.IsFallFlying or State.SwimAmount > 0,
			TicksUsingItem
		)
	end
end

const function SetupAttackAnimation(Model: PlayerModel, State: AvatarRenderState)
	const SwingAnimation = State.SwingAnimation
	const SwingArm = State.SwingArm

	if SwingAnimation <= 0 or not SwingArm then
		return
	end

	const Body = Model.Body
	const RightArm = Model.RightArm
	const LeftArm = Model.LeftArm

	Body.YRot = Mth.Sin(math.sqrt(SwingAnimation) * math.tau) * 0.2

	if SwingArm == "Left" then
		Body.YRot *= -1
	end

	RightArm.Z = Mth.Sin(Body.YRot) * 5 * State.AgeScale
	RightArm.X = -Mth.Cos(Body.YRot) * 5 * State.AgeScale
	LeftArm.Z = -Mth.Sin(Body.YRot) * 5 * State.AgeScale
	LeftArm.X = Mth.Cos(Body.YRot) * 5 * State.AgeScale
	RightArm.YRot += Body.YRot
	LeftArm.YRot += Body.YRot
	LeftArm.XRot += Body.YRot

	const AttackArm = if SwingArm == "Left" then LeftArm else RightArm

	if State.SwingType == "Whack" then
		const Eased = Mth.Sin(Mth.OutQuart(SwingAnimation) * math.pi)
		const Lift = Mth.Sin(SwingAnimation * math.pi) * -(Model.Head.XRot - 0.7) * 0.75

		AttackArm.XRot -= Eased * 1.2 + Lift
		AttackArm.YRot += Body.YRot * 2
		AttackArm.ZRot += Mth.Sin(SwingAnimation * math.pi) * -0.4
	elseif State.SwingType == "Stab" then
		RightArm.YRot -= Body.YRot
		LeftArm.YRot -= Body.YRot
		LeftArm.XRot -= Body.YRot
		AttackArm.XRot += SpearAnimations.ThirdPersonAttackArm(SwingAnimation)
	end
end

const function SetupSwimAnimation(Model: PlayerModel, State: AvatarRenderState, AnimationPos: number, SwimAmount: number)
	const RightArm = Model.RightArm
	const LeftArm = Model.LeftArm

	if not State.IsFallFlying then
		Model.Head.XRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(SwimAmount, Model.Head.XRot, -math.pi / 4)
	end

	const SwimPos = math.fmod(AnimationPos, 26)
	const RightArmSwimAmount = if State.RightArmPose ~= "Spear" and State.SwingArm ~= "Right" then SwimAmount else 0
	const LeftArmSwimAmount = if State.LeftArmPose ~= "Spear" and State.SwingArm ~= "Left" then SwimAmount else 0

	if not State.IsUsingItem then
		if SwimPos < 14 then
			const Stroke = 1.8707964 * QuadraticArmUpdate(SwimPos) / QuadraticArmUpdate(14)

			LeftArm.XRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.XRot, 0)
			RightArm.XRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.XRot, 0)
			LeftArm.YRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.YRot, math.pi)
			RightArm.YRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.YRot, math.pi)
			LeftArm.ZRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.ZRot, math.pi + Stroke)
			RightArm.ZRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.ZRot, math.pi - Stroke)
		elseif SwimPos < 22 then
			const Internal = (SwimPos - 14) / 8

			LeftArm.XRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.XRot, math.pi / 2 * Internal)
			RightArm.XRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.XRot, math.pi / 2 * Internal)
			LeftArm.YRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.YRot, math.pi)
			RightArm.YRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.YRot, math.pi)
			LeftArm.ZRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.ZRot, 5.012389 - 1.8707964 * Internal)
			RightArm.ZRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.ZRot, 1.2707963 + 1.8707964 * Internal)
		elseif SwimPos < 26 then
			const Internal = (SwimPos - 22) / 4

			LeftArm.XRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.XRot, math.pi / 2 - math.pi / 2 * Internal)
			RightArm.XRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.XRot, math.pi / 2 - math.pi / 2 * Internal)
			LeftArm.YRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.YRot, math.pi)
			RightArm.YRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.YRot, math.pi)
			LeftArm.ZRot = Mth.RotLerpRad(LeftArmSwimAmount, LeftArm.ZRot, math.pi)
			RightArm.ZRot = Mth.Lerp(RightArmSwimAmount, RightArm.ZRot, math.pi)
		end
	end

	Model.LeftLeg.XRot = Mth.Lerp(SwimAmount, Model.LeftLeg.XRot, 0.3 * Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.33333334 + math.pi))
	Model.RightLeg.XRot = Mth.Lerp(SwimAmount, Model.RightLeg.XRot, 0.3 * Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.33333334))
end

const function Create(Slim: boolean): PlayerModel
	const ArmWidth = if Slim then 3 else 4
	const RightArmMinX = if Slim then -2 else -3
	const Cube = ModelPart.Cube

	const Head = ModelPart.Create("head", nil, Combine(Cube(0, 0, -4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8, 0, false), Cube(32, 0, -4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8, HatGrow, false)), 0, 0, 0)
	const Body = ModelPart.Create("body", nil, Combine(Cube(16, 16, -4, 0, -2, 8, 12, 4, 0, false), Cube(16, 32, -4, 0, -2, 8, 12, 4, OverlayGrow, false)), 0, 0, 0)
	const RightArm = ModelPart.Create("right_arm", nil, Combine(Cube(40, 16, RightArmMinX, -2, -2, ArmWidth, 12, 4, 0, false), Cube(40, 32, RightArmMinX, -2, -2, ArmWidth, 12, 4, OverlayGrow, false)), -5, 2, 0)
	const LeftArm = ModelPart.Create("left_arm", nil, Combine(Cube(32, 48, -1, -2, -2, ArmWidth, 12, 4, 0, false), Cube(48, 48, -1, -2, -2, ArmWidth, 12, 4, OverlayGrow, false)), 5, 2, 0)
	const RightLeg = ModelPart.Create("right_leg", nil, Combine(Cube(0, 16, -2, 0, -2, 4, 12, 4, 0, false), Cube(0, 32, -2, 0, -2, 4, 12, 4, OverlayGrow, false)), -1.9, 12, 0)
	const LeftLeg = ModelPart.Create("left_leg", nil, Combine(Cube(16, 48, -2, 0, -2, 4, 12, 4, 0, false), Cube(0, 48, -2, 0, -2, 4, 12, 4, OverlayGrow, false)), 1.9, 12, 0)

	return {
		Slim = Slim,
		Head = Head,
		Body = Body,
		RightArm = RightArm,
		LeftArm = LeftArm,
		RightLeg = RightLeg,
		LeftLeg = LeftLeg,
		Parts = { Head, Body, RightArm, LeftArm, RightLeg, LeftLeg },
	}
end

const function FlyingYRot(Movement: vector, XRot: number, YRot: number): number
	const Look = Minecraft.Projectile.ViewDirection(XRot, YRot, 0)
	const MovementLength = Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z
	const LookLength = Look.x * Look.x + Look.z * Look.z

	if MovementLength <= FlightThreshold or LookLength <= FlightThreshold then
		return 0
	end

	const Dot = (Movement.x * Look.x + Movement.z * Look.z) / math.sqrt(MovementLength * LookLength)
	const Sign = Movement.x * Look.z - Movement.z * Look.x

	return math.sign(Sign) * math.acos(math.min(1, math.abs(Dot)))
end

const function SetupAnim(Model: PlayerModel, State: AvatarRenderState)
	const Head = Model.Head
	const Body = Model.Body
	const RightArm = Model.RightArm
	const LeftArm = Model.LeftArm
	const RightLeg = Model.RightLeg
	const LeftLeg = Model.LeftLeg

	for _, Part in Model.Parts do
		ModelPart.ResetPose(Part)
	end

	const ShowBody = not State.IsSpectator

	Body.Visible = ShowBody
	RightArm.Visible = ShowBody
	LeftArm.Visible = ShowBody
	RightLeg.Visible = ShowBody
	LeftLeg.Visible = ShowBody

	Head.XRot = State.XRot * DegreesToRadians
	Head.YRot = State.YRot * DegreesToRadians

	if State.IsFallFlying then
		Head.XRot = -math.pi / 4
	end

	const AnimationPos = State.WalkAnimationPos
	const AnimationSpeed = State.WalkAnimationSpeed
	const SpeedValue = State.SpeedValue

	RightArm.XRot = Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 2 * AnimationSpeed * 0.5 / SpeedValue
	LeftArm.XRot = Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.6662) * 2 * AnimationSpeed * 0.5 / SpeedValue
	RightLeg.XRot = Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * AnimationSpeed / SpeedValue
	LeftLeg.XRot = Mth.Cos(AnimationPos * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 1.4 * AnimationSpeed / SpeedValue
	RightLeg.YRot = 0.005
	LeftLeg.YRot = -0.005
	RightLeg.ZRot = 0.005
	LeftLeg.ZRot = -0.005

	if State.IsPassenger then
		RightArm.XRot += -math.pi / 5
		LeftArm.XRot += -math.pi / 5
		RightLeg.XRot = -1.4137167
		RightLeg.YRot = math.pi / 10
		RightLeg.ZRot = 0.07853982
		LeftLeg.XRot = -1.4137167
		LeftLeg.YRot = -math.pi / 10
		LeftLeg.ZRot = -0.07853982
	end

	local PrioritizeArm: Arm = State.UseItemArm

	if not State.IsUsingItem then
		const OffhandArm = if State.MainArm == "Right" then "Left" else "Right"
		const OffhandPose = if OffhandArm == "Right" then State.RightArmPose else State.LeftArmPose

		PrioritizeArm = if TwoHandedPoses[OffhandPose] then State.MainArm else OffhandArm
	end

	if PrioritizeArm == "Right" then
		PoseArm(Model, State, true)

		if not OffhandAffectingPoses[State.RightArmPose] then
			PoseArm(Model, State, false)
		end
	else
		PoseArm(Model, State, false)

		if not OffhandAffectingPoses[State.LeftArmPose] then
			PoseArm(Model, State, true)
		end
	end

	SetupAttackAnimation(Model, State)

	if State.IsCrouching then
		Body.XRot = 0.5
		RightArm.XRot += 0.4
		LeftArm.XRot += 0.4
		RightLeg.Z += 4
		LeftLeg.Z += 4
		Head.Y += 4.2
		Body.Y += 3.2
		LeftArm.Y += 3.2
		RightArm.Y += 3.2
	end

	if State.RightArmPose ~= "Spyglass" then
		BobModelPart(RightArm, State.AgeInTicks, 1)
	end

	if State.LeftArmPose ~= "Spyglass" then
		BobModelPart(LeftArm, State.AgeInTicks, -1)
	end

	if State.SwimAmount > 0 then
		SetupSwimAnimation(Model, State, AnimationPos, State.SwimAmount)
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	SetupAnim = SetupAnim,
	FlyingYRot = FlyingYRot,
}

end
