_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/Equipment"] = function(require)

const Affine = require("../Affine")
const Layers = require("./Layers")
const ModelPart = require("./ModelPart")
const PlayerModel = require("./PlayerModel")

const PixelsPerBlock = 16

const CrouchingWingDrop = 3

export type ArmorSlot = "head" | "chest" | "legs" | "feet"

export type ArmorModel = {
	Parts: { Layers.LayerPart },
	Animated: { Layers.LayerPart },
}

export type ElytraModel = {
	Parts: { Layers.LayerPart },
	LeftWing: Layers.LayerPart,
	RightWing: Layers.LayerPart,
}

const ArmorLayers: { [ArmorSlot]: string } = {
	head = "minecraft:player#helmet",
	chest = "minecraft:player#chestplate",
	legs = "minecraft:player#leggings",
	feet = "minecraft:player#boots",
}

const AnimatedNames = { "head", "body", "right_arm", "left_arm", "right_leg", "left_leg" }

const function CreateArmor(Slot: ArmorSlot, TextureSize: Vector2): ArmorModel
	const Layer = Layers.Create(ArmorLayers[Slot])
	const Animated: { Layers.LayerPart } = {}

	for _, Name in AnimatedNames do
		table.insert(Animated, Layer.Root.Children[Name])
	end

	return { Parts = Layers.Parts(Layer, TextureSize), Animated = Animated }
end

const function PoseArmor(Armor: ArmorModel, Player: PlayerModel.PlayerModel)
	for Index, Source in Player.Parts do
		const Target = Armor.Animated[Index]

		Target.X, Target.Y, Target.Z = Source.X, Source.Y, Source.Z
		Target.XRot, Target.YRot, Target.ZRot = Source.XRot, Source.YRot, Source.ZRot
		Target.Visible = Source.Visible
	end
end

const function ArmorPolygons(Armor: ArmorModel, Player: PlayerModel.PlayerModel): { [ModelPart.Part]: { Layers.Polygon } }
	const PixelPose = Affine.Create()
	const Out: { [ModelPart.Part]: { Layers.Polygon } } = {}

	Affine.Scale(PixelPose, PixelsPerBlock, PixelsPerBlock, PixelsPerBlock)

	for Index, Bone in Armor.Animated do
		const Polygons = table.clone(Bone.Polygons)

		for _, Child in Bone.Children do
			Layers.Flatten(Child, PixelPose, 1, 1, Polygons)
		end

		if #Polygons > 0 then
			Out[Player.Parts[Index]] = Polygons
		end
	end

	return Out
end

const function CreateElytra(TextureSize: Vector2): ElytraModel
	const Layer = Layers.Create("minecraft:elytra#main")

	return { Parts = Layers.Parts(Layer, TextureSize), LeftWing = Layer.Root.Children.left_wing, RightWing = Layer.Root.Children.right_wing }
end

const function PoseElytra(Elytra: ElytraModel, State: PlayerModel.AvatarRenderState)
	const Left = Elytra.LeftWing
	const Right = Elytra.RightWing

	Left.Y = if State.IsCrouching then CrouchingWingDrop else 0
	Left.XRot = State.ElytraRotX
	Left.ZRot = State.ElytraRotZ
	Left.YRot = State.ElytraRotY
	Right.YRot = -Left.YRot
	Right.Y = Left.Y
	Right.XRot = Left.XRot
	Right.ZRot = -Left.ZRot
end

return {
	ArmorPolygons = ArmorPolygons,
	CreateArmor = CreateArmor,
	PoseArmor = PoseArmor,
	CreateElytra = CreateElytra,
	PoseElytra = PoseElytra,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/Layers"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Affine = require("../Affine")
const Data = require("./Data")

const PixelsPerBlock = 16

type SourcePart = {
	Pose: { number },
	Cubes: { { { number } } },
	Children: { [string]: SourcePart },
}

type SourceLayer = {
	TextureWidth: number,
	TextureHeight: number,
	Root: SourcePart,
}

export type Vertex = {
	Position: vector,
	U: number,
	V: number,
}

export type Polygon = {
	Vertices: { Vertex },
	Normal: vector,
	Tint: number?,
	Cube: number?,
}

export type LayerPart = {
	Name: string,
	Parent: LayerPart?,
	Initial: { number },
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Z: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRot: number,
	ZRot: number,
	XScale: number,
	YScale: number,
	ZScale: number,
	Visible: boolean,
	Polygons: { Polygon },
	Children: { [string]: LayerPart },
}

export type Layer = {
	TextureWidth: number,
	TextureHeight: number,
	Root: LayerPart,
}

local Sources: { [string]: SourceLayer }? = nil
local CubeCount = 0

const function Decode(): { [string]: SourceLayer }
	if not Sources then
		const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)

		Sources = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: { [string]: SourceLayer }
	end

	return Sources :: { [string]: SourceLayer }
end

const function ResetPart(Part: LayerPart)
	const Initial = Part.Initial

	Part.X, Part.Y, Part.Z = Initial[1], Initial[2], Initial[3]
	Part.XRot, Part.YRot, Part.ZRot = Initial[4], Initial[5], Initial[6]
	Part.XScale, Part.YScale, Part.ZScale = Initial[7], Initial[8], Initial[9]
	Part.Visible = true

	for _, Child in Part.Children do
		ResetPart(Child)
	end
end

const function BuildPart(Name: string, Source: SourcePart): LayerPart
	const Polygons: { Polygon } = {}
	const Children: { [string]: LayerPart } = {}

	for _, Cube in Source.Cubes do
		CubeCount += 1

		for _, Values in Cube do
			const Vertices: { Vertex } = {}

			for Offset = 0, 15, 5 do
				table.insert(Vertices, { Position = vector.create(Values[Offset + 1], Values[Offset + 2], Values[Offset + 3]), U = Values[Offset + 4], V = Values[Offset + 5] })
			end

			table.insert(Polygons, { Vertices = Vertices, Normal = vector.create(Values[21], Values[22], Values[23]), Cube = -CubeCount })
		end
	end

	const Part: LayerPart = {
		Name = Name,
		Parent = nil,
		Initial = Source.Pose,
		X = 0,
		Y = 0,
		Z = 0,
		XRot = 0,
		YRot = 0,
		ZRot = 0,
		XScale = 1,
		YScale = 1,
		ZScale = 1,
		Visible = true,
		Polygons = Polygons,
		Children = Children,
	}

	for ChildName, Child in Source.Children do
		const Built = BuildPart(ChildName, Child)

		Built.Parent = Part
		Children[ChildName] = Built
	end

	ResetPart(Part)

	return Part
end

const function Create(Name: string): Layer
	const Source = Decode()[Name]

	return { TextureWidth = Source.TextureWidth, TextureHeight = Source.TextureHeight, Root = BuildPart("root", Source.Root) }
end

const function Reset(Layer: Layer)
	ResetPart(Layer.Root)
end

const function Flatten(Part: LayerPart, Pose: Affine.Matrix, UScale: number, VScale: number, Out: { Polygon })
	if not Part.Visible then
		return
	end

	const Matrix = table.clone(Pose)

	Affine.Translate(Matrix, Part.X / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Y / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Z / PixelsPerBlock)

	if Part.XRot ~= 0 or Part.YRot ~= 0 or Part.ZRot ~= 0 then
		Affine.RotateZ(Matrix, Part.ZRot)
		Affine.RotateY(Matrix, Part.YRot)
		Affine.RotateX(Matrix, Part.XRot)
	end

	if Part.XScale ~= 1 or Part.YScale ~= 1 or Part.ZScale ~= 1 then
		Affine.Scale(Matrix, Part.XScale, Part.YScale, Part.ZScale)
	end

	for _, Polygon in Part.Polygons do
		const Vertices: { Vertex } = {}

		for _, Vertex in Polygon.Vertices do
			table.insert(Vertices, { Position = Affine.Point(Matrix, Vertex.Position / PixelsPerBlock), U = Vertex.U * UScale, V = Vertex.V * VScale })
		end

		table.insert(Out, { Vertices = Vertices, Normal = Affine.Normal(Matrix, Polygon.Normal) })
	end

	for _, Child in Part.Children do
		Flatten(Child, Matrix, UScale, VScale, Out)
	end
end

const function CollectParts(Part: LayerPart, UScale: number, VScale: number, Out: { LayerPart })
	table.insert(Out, Part)

	if UScale ~= 1 or VScale ~= 1 then
		for _, Polygon in Part.Polygons do
			for _, Vertex in Polygon.Vertices do
				Vertex.U *= UScale
				Vertex.V *= VScale
			end
		end
	end

	for _, Child in Part.Children do
		CollectParts(Child, UScale, VScale, Out)
	end
end

const function Parts(Layer: Layer, TextureSize: Vector2): { LayerPart }
	const Out: { LayerPart } = {}

	CollectParts(Layer.Root, TextureSize.X / Layer.TextureWidth, TextureSize.Y / Layer.TextureHeight, Out)

	return Out
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Parts = Parts,
	Reset = Reset,
	Flatten = Flatten,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/Skull"] = function(require)

const Layers = require("./Layers")

const SkullLayers: { [string]: string } = {
	skeleton = "minecraft:skeleton_skull#main",
	wither_skeleton = "minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull#main",
	player = "minecraft:player_head#main",
	zombie = "minecraft:zombie_head#main",
	creeper = "minecraft:creeper_head#main",
	dragon = "minecraft:dragon_skull#main",
	piglin = "minecraft:piglin_head#main",
}

const function LayerName(Kind: string): string
	return SkullLayers[Kind]
end

const function Pose(Layer: Layers.Layer, Kind: string, Animation: number)
	const Head = Layer.Root.Children.head

	Head.YRot = 0
	Head.XRot = 0

	if Kind == "dragon" then
		Head.Children.jaw.XRot = (math.sin(Animation * math.pi * 0.2) + 1) * 0.2
	elseif Kind == "piglin" then
		Head.Children.left_ear.ZRot = -(math.cos(Animation * math.pi * 0.2 * 1.2) + 2.5) * 0.2
		Head.Children.right_ear.ZRot = (math.cos(Animation * math.pi * 0.2) + 2.5) * 0.2
	end
end

return {
	LayerName = LayerName,
	Pose = Pose,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Models/SpearAnimations"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const ModelPart = require("./ModelPart")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const FallFlyingArmDrop = 0.9599311
const ItemInHandDepth = 0.125

type Condition = { max_duration_ticks: number }

export type Kinetic = {
	delay_ticks: number?,
	forward_movement: number?,
	dismount_conditions: Condition?,
	knockback_conditions: Condition?,
	damage_conditions: Condition?,
}

local RaiseProgress = 0
local RaiseProgressStart = 0
local RaiseProgressMiddle = 0
local RaiseProgressEnd = 0
local SwayProgress = 0
local LowerProgress = 0
local RaiseBackProgress = 0
local SwayIntensity = 0
local SwayScaleSlow = 0
local SwayScaleFast = 0

const function Progress(Time: number, Start: number, Finish: number): number
	return Mth.Clamp(Mth.InverseLerp(Time, Start, Finish), 0, 1)
end

const function ConditionTicks(Condition: Condition?): number
	return if Condition then Condition.max_duration_ticks else 0
end

const function ComputeUseParams(Kinetic: Kinetic, Time: number)
	const FinishRaising = Kinetic.delay_ticks or 0
	const FinishSwaying = ConditionTicks(Kinetic.dismount_conditions) + FinishRaising
	const FinishLowering = ConditionTicks(Kinetic.knockback_conditions) + FinishRaising
	const FinishRaisingBack = ConditionTicks(Kinetic.damage_conditions) + FinishRaising

	RaiseProgress = Progress(Time, 0, FinishRaising)
	RaiseProgressStart = Progress(RaiseProgress, 0, 0.5)
	RaiseProgressMiddle = Progress(RaiseProgress, 0.5, 0.8)
	RaiseProgressEnd = Progress(RaiseProgress, 0.8, 1)
	SwayProgress = Progress(Time, FinishSwaying - 20, FinishSwaying)
	LowerProgress = Mth.OutCubic(Mth.InOutElastic(Progress(Time - 20, FinishLowering - 40, FinishLowering)))
	RaiseBackProgress = Progress(Time, FinishRaisingBack - 5, FinishRaisingBack)
	SwayIntensity = 2 * Mth.OutCirc(SwayProgress) - 2 * Mth.InCirc(RaiseBackProgress)
	SwayScaleSlow = Mth.Sin(Time * 19 * DegreesToRadians) * SwayIntensity
	SwayScaleFast = Mth.Sin(Time * 30 * DegreesToRadians) * SwayIntensity
end

const function HitFeedbackAmount(TicksSinceFeedback: number): number
	return 0.4 * (Mth.OutQuart(Progress(TicksSinceFeedback, 1, 3)) - Mth.InOutSine(Progress(TicksSinceFeedback, 3, 10)))
end

const function Around(Rotation: CFrame, X: number, Y: number, Z: number, Scale: number): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(X * Scale, Y * Scale, Z * Scale) * Rotation * CFrame.new(-X * Scale, -Y * Scale, -Z * Scale)
end

const function ThirdPersonHandUse(Arm: ModelPart.Part, Head: ModelPart.Part, Right: boolean, Kinetic: Kinetic?, FlyingOrSwimming: boolean, TicksUsingItem: number)
	const Invert = if Right then 1 else -1

	Arm.YRot = -0.1 * Invert + Head.YRot
	Arm.XRot = -math.pi / 2 + Head.XRot + 0.8

	if FlyingOrSwimming then
		Arm.XRot -= FallFlyingArmDrop
	end

	Arm.YRot = DegreesToRadians * math.clamp(Arm.YRot / DegreesToRadians, -60, 60)
	Arm.XRot = DegreesToRadians * math.clamp(Arm.XRot / DegreesToRadians, -120, 30)

	if TicksUsingItem > 0 and Kinetic then
		ComputeUseParams(Kinetic, TicksUsingItem)
		Arm.YRot += -Invert * SwayScaleFast * DegreesToRadians * SwayIntensity
		Arm.ZRot += -Invert * SwayScaleSlow * DegreesToRadians * SwayIntensity * 0.5
		Arm.XRot += DegreesToRadians
			* (
				-40 * RaiseProgressStart
				+ 30 * RaiseProgressMiddle
				- 20 * RaiseProgressEnd
				+ 20 * LowerProgress
				+ 10 * RaiseBackProgress
				+ 0.6 * SwayScaleSlow * SwayIntensity
			)
	end
end

const function ThirdPersonUseItem(Kinetic: Kinetic?, TimeHeld: number, Right: boolean, SwingAnimation: number, TicksSinceHit: number, Scale: number): CFrame
	if not Kinetic or TimeHeld == 0 then
		return CFrame.identity
	end

	const Attack = Mth.InQuad(Progress(SwingAnimation, 0.05, 0.2))
	const Retract = Mth.InOutExpo(Progress(SwingAnimation, 0.4, 1))

	ComputeUseParams(Kinetic, TimeHeld)

	const Invert = if Right then 1 else -1
	const RaiseModified = 1 - Mth.OutBack(1 - RaiseProgress)
	const HitFeedback = HitFeedbackAmount(TicksSinceHit)
	const Forward = Kinetic.forward_movement or 0
	const Tilt = 70 * (RaiseProgress - RaiseBackProgress) - 40 * (Attack - Retract)
	const Turn = Invert * 90 * (RaiseProgress - SwayProgress + 3 * Retract + Attack)

	return CFrame.new(0, -HitFeedback * 0.4 * Scale, (-Forward * (RaiseModified - RaiseBackProgress) + HitFeedback) * Scale)
		* Around(CFrame.Angles(-Tilt * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0), 0, -0.03125, ItemInHandDepth, Scale)
		* Around(CFrame.Angles(0, Turn * DegreesToRadians, 0), 0, 0, ItemInHandDepth, Scale)
end

const function ThirdPersonAttackArm(Animation: number): number
	const Prepare = Mth.InOutSine(Progress(Animation, 0, 0.05))
	const Attack = Mth.InQuad(Progress(Animation, 0.05, 0.2))
	const Retract = Mth.InOutExpo(Progress(Animation, 0.4, 1))

	return (90 * Prepare - 120 * Attack + 30 * Retract) * DegreesToRadians
end

const function ThirdPersonAttackItem(Animation: number, Forward: number, Scale: number): CFrame
	if Animation <= 0 then
		return CFrame.identity
	end

	const Attack = Mth.InQuad(Progress(Animation, 0.05, 0.2))
	const Retract = Mth.InOutExpo(Progress(Animation, 0.4, 1))

	return Around(CFrame.Angles(-70 * (Attack - Retract) * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0), 0, -ItemInHandDepth, ItemInHandDepth, Scale)
		* CFrame.new(0, Forward * (Attack - Retract) * Scale, 0)
end

const function FirstPersonUse(TicksSinceHit: number, TimeHeld: number, Right: boolean, Kinetic: Kinetic?, Scale: number): CFrame
	if not Kinetic then
		return CFrame.identity
	end

	ComputeUseParams(Kinetic, TimeHeld)

	const Invert = if Right then 1 else -1
	const X = Invert * (RaiseProgress * 0.15 + RaiseProgressEnd * -0.05 + SwayProgress * -0.1 + SwayScaleSlow * 0.005)
	const Y = RaiseProgress * -0.075 + RaiseProgressMiddle * 0.075 + SwayScaleFast * 0.01
	const Z = RaiseProgressStart * 0.05 + RaiseProgressEnd * -0.05 + SwayScaleSlow * 0.005
	const Tilt = -65 * Mth.InOutBack(RaiseProgress) - 35 * LowerProgress + 100 * RaiseBackProgress - 0.5 * SwayScaleFast
	const Turn = Invert * (-90 * Progress(RaiseProgress, 0.5, 0.55) + 90 * SwayProgress + 2 * SwayScaleSlow)

	return CFrame.new(X * Scale, Y * Scale, Z * Scale)
		* Around(CFrame.Angles(Tilt * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0), 0, 0.1, 0, Scale)
		* Around(CFrame.Angles(0, -Turn * DegreesToRadians, 0), Invert * 0.15, 0, 0, Scale)
		* CFrame.new(0, -HitFeedbackAmount(TicksSinceHit) * Scale, 0)
end

const function FirstPersonAttack(Attack: number, Invert: number, Scale: number): CFrame
	const Starting = Mth.InOutSine(Progress(Attack, 0, 0.05))
	const Middle = Mth.OutBack(Progress(Attack, 0.05, 0.2))
	const Ending = Mth.InOutExpo(Progress(Attack, 0.4, 1))

	return CFrame.new(Invert * 0.1 * (Starting - Middle) * Scale, -0.075 * (Starting - Ending) * Scale, 0.65 * (Starting - Middle) * Scale)
		* CFrame.Angles(-70 * (Starting - Ending) * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0)
		* CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.25 * (Ending - Middle) * Scale)
end

return {
	ThirdPersonHandUse = ThirdPersonHandUse,
	ThirdPersonUseItem = ThirdPersonUseItem,
	ThirdPersonAttackArm = ThirdPersonAttackArm,
	ThirdPersonAttackItem = ThirdPersonAttackItem,
	FirstPersonUse = FirstPersonUse,
	FirstPersonAttack = FirstPersonAttack,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Correct = require("@self/ColorCorrection")
const EditableBudget = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Features/Rendering/EditableBudget")
const ItemLights = require("@self/ItemLights")
const Lightmap = require("@self/Lightmap")
const QuadBatch = require("@self/QuadBatch")

const LightPower = 0.6
const AmbientLight = 0.4
const AlphaCutout = 26
const UvSnap = 4096
const NormalPrecision = 10000
const MaximumTriangles = 20000
const Light0 = vector.normalize(vector.create(0.2, 1, -0.7))
const Light1 = vector.normalize(vector.create(-0.2, 1, 0.7))

export type QuadCell = QuadBatch.Cell
export type Batch = QuadBatch.Batch

export type Material = "Cutout" | "CutoutCull" | "Solid"

export type Lights = {
	Light0: vector,
	Light1: vector,
	Lightmap: vector,
}

export type Polygon = {
	Vertices: { { Position: vector, U: number, V: number } },
	Normal: vector,
	Tint: number?,
}

export type Part = {
	Name: string,
	Parent: Part?,
	Polygons: { Polygon },
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Z: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRot: number,
	ZRot: number,
	XScale: number?,
	YScale: number?,
	ZScale: number?,
	Visible: boolean,
}

export type Texture = {
	Size: Vector2,
	Pixels: buffer,
}

export type Layer = {
	Texture: Texture,
	Material: Material,
	Overlay: boolean,
	Polygons: { [Part]: { Polygon } }?,
}

type Quad = {
	Corners: { vector },
	Color: vector,
	Key: number,
}

type Group = {
	Normal: vector,
	Layer: number,
	Quads: { Quad },
}

type Shading = {
	Normal: vector,
	ColorIds: { number },
	Texels: { vector },
	Overlay: boolean,
	Level: number,
	Hurt: boolean,
	Lightmap: vector,
	Tint: vector,
}

type PartMesh = {
	ModelPart: Part,
	Offset: CFrame,
	Mesh: EditableMesh,
	Instances: { MeshPart },
	Shadings: { Shading },
	VertexIds: { number },
	Positions: { vector },
	VertexLayers: { number },
	LayersShown: { boolean },
	Base: { vector },
	Squashed: { vector },
	IsSquashed: boolean,
	Shown: boolean,
}

export type Rig = {
	Visible: boolean,
	LayersShown: { boolean },
	Parts: { Part },
	Scale: number,
	Copies: { CFrame },
	Meshes: { PartMesh },
	PartFrames: { [Part]: CFrame },
	PartScales: { [Part]: vector },
	Instances: { BasePart },
	Frames: { CFrame },
}

type Cells = {
	Low: { number },
	High: { number },
	Texel: { number },
}

const function GroupFor(Groups: { [string]: Group }, Normal: vector, Layer: number): Group
	const Key = `{Layer}|{math.round(Normal.x * NormalPrecision) + 0},{math.round(Normal.y * NormalPrecision) + 0},{math.round(Normal.z * NormalPrecision) + 0}`
	local Found = Groups[Key]

	if not Found then
		Found = { Normal = Normal, Layer = Layer, Quads = {} }
		Groups[Key] = Found
	end

	return Found :: Group
end

const function Snap(Value: number): number
	return math.round(Value * UvSnap) / UvSnap
end

const function SplitAxis(Start: number, Finish: number, Limit: number): Cells
	const Cells: Cells = { Low = {}, High = {}, Texel = {} }

	if Start == Finish then
		table.insert(Cells.Low, 0)
		table.insert(Cells.High, 1)
		table.insert(Cells.Texel, math.clamp(Start // 1, 0, Limit - 1))

		return Cells
	end

	const Low = math.min(Start, Finish)
	const High = math.max(Start, Finish)

	for Texel = Low // 1, math.ceil(High) - 1 do
		const From = (math.max(Texel, Low) - Start) / (Finish - Start)
		const To = (math.min(Texel + 1, High) - Start) / (Finish - Start)

		table.insert(Cells.Low, math.min(From, To))
		table.insert(Cells.High, math.max(From, To))
		table.insert(Cells.Texel, math.clamp(Texel, 0, Limit - 1))
	end

	return Cells
end

const function MeshPolygon(Polygon: Polygon, Texture: Texture, Material: Material, Groups: { [string]: Group }, Layer: number, PartScale: vector)
	const Vertices = Polygon.Vertices
	const Origin = Vertices[1].Position * PartScale
	const AlongS = Vertices[2].Position * PartScale - Origin
	const AlongT = Vertices[4].Position * PartScale - Origin
	const U1, V1 = Snap(Vertices[1].U), Snap(Vertices[1].V)
	const U2, V2 = Snap(Vertices[2].U), Snap(Vertices[2].V)
	const U4, V4 = Snap(Vertices[4].U), Snap(Vertices[4].V)
	const TextureWidth = Texture.Size.X
	const TextureHeight = Texture.Size.Y
	local SAlongU = true

	if V2 == V1 and U4 == U1 then
		SAlongU = true
	elseif U2 == U1 and V4 == V1 then
		SAlongU = false
	else
		error("Polygon UVs do not span an axis-aligned rectangle")
	end

	const SCells = if SAlongU then SplitAxis(U1, U2, TextureWidth) else SplitAxis(V1, V2, TextureHeight)
	const TCells = if SAlongU then SplitAxis(V1, V4, TextureHeight) else SplitAxis(U1, U4, TextureWidth)
	const Columns = #SCells.Texel
	const Rows = #TCells.Texel
	const Pixels = Texture.Pixels
	const Tint = Polygon.Tint
	const TintColor = if Tint then vector.create(bit32.extract(Tint, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Tint, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Tint, 0, 8)) / 255 else vector.one
	const TintKey = if Tint then bit32.band(Tint, 0xFFFFFF) + 1 else 0
	const Claimed: { boolean } = table.create(Columns * Rows, false)
	const Normal = Polygon.Normal
	const Facing = if Material == "Cutout" then Normal else vector.cross(AlongS, AlongT)
	const Front = GroupFor(Groups, Normal, Layer)
	const Back = if Material == "Cutout" then GroupFor(Groups, -Normal, Layer) else nil

	const function TexelAt(Column: number, Row: number): number
		const U = if SAlongU then SCells.Texel[Column] else TCells.Texel[Row]
		const V = if SAlongU then TCells.Texel[Row] else SCells.Texel[Column]

		return buffer.readu32(Pixels, (V * TextureWidth + U) * 4)
	end

	const function IsOpen(Column: number, Row: number, Texel: number): boolean
		return not Claimed[(Row - 1) * Columns + Column] and TexelAt(Column, Row) == Texel
	end

	const function Point(S: number, T: number): vector
		return Origin + AlongS * S + AlongT * T
	end

	for Row = 1, Rows do
		for Column = 1, Columns do
			const Texel = TexelAt(Column, Row)

			if Claimed[(Row - 1) * Columns + Column] or (Material ~= "Solid" and bit32.rshift(Texel, 24) < AlphaCutout) then
				continue
			end

			local RunWidth = 1
			local RunHeight = 1

			while Column + RunWidth <= Columns and IsOpen(Column + RunWidth, Row, Texel) do
				RunWidth += 1
			end

			while Row + RunHeight <= Rows do
				local RowMatches = true

				for Offset = 0, RunWidth - 1 do
					if not IsOpen(Column + Offset, Row + RunHeight, Texel) then
						RowMatches = false
						break
					end
				end

				if not RowMatches then
					break
				end

				RunHeight += 1
			end

			for ClaimRow = Row, Row + RunHeight - 1 do
				for ClaimColumn = Column, Column + RunWidth - 1 do
					Claimed[(ClaimRow - 1) * Columns + ClaimColumn] = true
				end
			end

			const LastColumn = Column + RunWidth - 1
			const LastRow = Row + RunHeight - 1
			const S0 = math.min(SCells.Low[Column], SCells.Low[LastColumn])
			const S1 = math.max(SCells.High[Column], SCells.High[LastColumn])
			const T0 = math.min(TCells.Low[Row], TCells.Low[LastRow])
			const T1 = math.max(TCells.High[Row], TCells.High[LastRow])
			const Color = vector.create(bit32.extract(Texel, 0, 8), bit32.extract(Texel, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Texel, 16, 8)) / 255 * TintColor
			const Key = bit32.band(Texel, 0xFFFFFF) + TintKey * 0x1000000
			local Corners = { Point(S0, T0), Point(S1, T0), Point(S1, T1), Point(S0, T1) }

			if vector.dot(vector.cross(Corners[2] - Corners[1], Corners[3] - Corners[1]), Facing) < 0 then
				Corners = { Corners[1], Corners[4], Corners[3], Corners[2] }
			end

			table.insert(Front.Quads, { Corners = Corners, Color = Color, Key = Key })

			if Back then
				table.insert(Back.Quads, { Corners = { Corners[1], Corners[4], Corners[3], Corners[2] }, Color = Color, Key = Key })
			end
		end
	end
end

const function DestroyMesh(Built: PartMesh)
	for _, Instance in Built.Instances do
		Instance:Destroy()
	end

	Built.Mesh:Destroy()
end

const function BuildMesh(Part: Part, Groups: { Group }, Layers: { Layer }, Scale: number, Parent: Instance, CopyCount: number): PartMesh?
	local Minimum = Groups[1].Quads[1].Corners[1]
	local Maximum = Minimum
	local Triangles = 0

	for _, Group in Groups do
		for _, Quad in Group.Quads do
			for _, Corner in Quad.Corners do
				Minimum = vector.min(Minimum, Corner)
				Maximum = vector.max(Maximum, Corner)
			end
		end

		Triangles += #Group.Quads * 2
	end

	if Triangles > MaximumTriangles then
		error(`Part {Part.Name} needs {Triangles} triangles, more than an EditableMesh holds`)
	end

	const Center = (Minimum + Maximum) / 2
	const Mesh = EditableBudget.CreateMesh()
	const Shadings: { Shading } = {}
	const LayerOfVertex: { [number]: number } = {}

	if not Mesh then
		return nil
	end

	for _, Group in Groups do
		const ColorIds: { number } = {}
		const Texels: { vector } = {}
		const ColorIdByKey: { [number]: number } = {}

		for _, Quad in Group.Quads do
			local ColorId = ColorIdByKey[Quad.Key]

			if not ColorId then
				ColorId = Mesh:AddColor(Color3.new(Quad.Color.x, Quad.Color.y, Quad.Color.z), 1)
				ColorIdByKey[Quad.Key] = ColorId
				table.insert(ColorIds, ColorId)
				table.insert(Texels, Quad.Color)
			end

			const Corners = Quad.Corners
			const First = Mesh:AddVertex((Corners[1] - Center) * Scale)
			const Second = Mesh:AddVertex((Corners[2] - Center) * Scale)
			const Third = Mesh:AddVertex((Corners[3] - Center) * Scale)
			const Fourth = Mesh:AddVertex((Corners[4] - Center) * Scale)
			const FaceColors = { ColorId, ColorId, ColorId }

			LayerOfVertex[First], LayerOfVertex[Second], LayerOfVertex[Third], LayerOfVertex[Fourth] = Group.Layer, Group.Layer, Group.Layer, Group.Layer

			Mesh:SetFaceColors(Mesh:AddTriangle(First, Second, Third), FaceColors)
			Mesh:SetFaceColors(Mesh:AddTriangle(First, Third, Fourth), FaceColors)
		end

		table.insert(Shadings, {
			Normal = Group.Normal,
			ColorIds = ColorIds,
			Texels = Texels,
			Overlay = Layers[Group.Layer].Overlay,
			Level = -1,
			Hurt = false,
			Lightmap = vector.zero,
			Tint = vector.one,
		})
	end

	const FixedMesh = EditableBudget.CreateFixedMesh(Mesh)

	Mesh:Destroy()

	if not FixedMesh then
		return nil
	end

	const VertexIds = FixedMesh:GetVertices()
	const Positions = FixedMesh:BatchGetValues(VertexIds) :: { vector }
	const VertexLayers: { number } = {}

	for Index, Id in VertexIds do
		VertexLayers[Index] = LayerOfVertex[Id]
	end
	const MeshContent = Content.fromObject(FixedMesh)
	const Instances: { MeshPart } = {}

	for _ = 1, CopyCount do
		const Created, Instance = pcall(AssetService.CreateMeshPartAsync, AssetService, MeshContent)

		if not Created then
			for _, Existing in Instances do
				Existing:Destroy()
			end

			FixedMesh:Destroy()

			return nil
		end

		Instance.Name = Part.Name
		Instance.Anchored = true
		Instance.CanCollide = false
		Instance.CanTouch = false
		Instance.CanQuery = false
		Instance.CastShadow = false
		Instance.DoubleSided = false
		Instance.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		Instance.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		Instance.Parent = Parent
		table.insert(Instances, Instance)
	end

	return {
		ModelPart = Part,
		Offset = CFrame.new(Center * Scale),
		Mesh = FixedMesh,
		Instances = Instances,
		Shadings = Shadings,
		VertexIds = VertexIds,
		Positions = Positions,
		VertexLayers = VertexLayers,
		LayersShown = table.create(#Layers, true),
		Base = table.clone(Positions),
		Squashed = table.clone(Positions),
		IsSquashed = false,
		Shown = true,
	}
end

const function CreateRig(Parts: { Part }, Layers: { Layer }, Scale: number, Parent: Instance, Offsets: { vector }?): Rig?
	const Meshes: { PartMesh } = {}
	const Instances: { BasePart } = {}
	const Frames: { CFrame } = {}
	const PartFrames: { [Part]: CFrame } = {}
	const PartScales: { [Part]: vector } = {}
	const Copies: { CFrame } = {}

	if not EditableBudget.Allowed() then
		return nil
	end

	for _, Offset in Offsets or { vector.zero } do
		table.insert(Copies, CFrame.new(Offset * Scale))
	end

	for _, Part in Parts do
		const Groups: { [string]: Group } = {}
		const Filled: { Group } = {}
		const PartScale = (if Part.Parent then PartScales[Part.Parent] or vector.one else vector.one)
			* vector.create(Part.XScale or 1, Part.YScale or 1, Part.ZScale or 1)

		PartScales[Part] = PartScale

		for LayerIndex, Layer in Layers do
			const Polygons = if Layer.Polygons then Layer.Polygons[Part] else Part.Polygons

			for _, Polygon in Polygons or {} do
				MeshPolygon(Polygon, Layer.Texture, Layer.Material, Groups, LayerIndex, PartScale)
			end
		end

		for _, Group in Groups do
			if #Group.Quads > 0 then
				table.insert(Filled, Group)
			end
		end

		if #Filled > 0 then
			const Built = BuildMesh(Part, Filled, Layers, Scale, Parent, #Copies)

			if not Built then
				for _, Existing in Meshes do
					DestroyMesh(Existing)
				end

				return nil
			end

			table.insert(Meshes, Built)

			for _, Instance in Built.Instances do
				table.insert(Instances, Instance)
				table.insert(Frames, Instance.CFrame)
			end
		end

		PartFrames[Part] = CFrame.identity
	end

	return { Visible = true, LayersShown = table.create(#Layers, true), Parts = Parts, Scale = Scale, Copies = Copies, Meshes = Meshes, PartFrames = PartFrames, PartScales = PartScales, Instances = Instances, Frames = Frames }
end

const function PoseParts(Rig: Rig, Root: CFrame)
	const Scale = Rig.Scale
	const PartFrames = Rig.PartFrames

	for _, Part in Rig.Parts do
		const Parent = if Part.Parent then PartFrames[Part.Parent] else Root
		const Inherited = if Part.Parent then Rig.PartScales[Part.Parent] or vector.one else vector.one

		PartFrames[Part] = Parent
			* CFrame.new(Part.X * Scale * Inherited.x, Part.Y * Scale * Inherited.y, Part.Z * Scale * Inherited.z)
			* CFrame.fromEulerAngles(Part.XRot, Part.YRot, Part.ZRot, Enum.RotationOrder.ZYX)
	end
end

const function ShadeMesh(Built: PartMesh, Frame: CFrame, Shown: boolean, Hurt: boolean, LightmapColor: vector, Tint: vector, FirstLight: vector, SecondLight: vector)
	if Shown ~= Built.Shown then
		Built.Shown = Shown

		for _, Instance in Built.Instances do
			Instance.Transparency = if Shown then 0 else 1
		end
	end

	if not Shown then
		return
	end

	for _, Shading in Built.Shadings do
		const Rotated = Frame:VectorToWorldSpace(Shading.Normal)
		const WorldNormal = vector.create(Rotated.X, Rotated.Y, Rotated.Z)
		const Light = math.min(1, (math.max(0, vector.dot(WorldNormal, FirstLight)) + math.max(0, vector.dot(WorldNormal, SecondLight))) * LightPower + AmbientLight)
		const Level = math.round(Light * 255)

		const Overlaid = Hurt and Shading.Overlay

		if Level ~= Shading.Level or Overlaid ~= Shading.Hurt or LightmapColor ~= Shading.Lightmap or Tint ~= Shading.Tint then
			Shading.Level = Level
			Shading.Hurt = Overlaid
			Shading.Lightmap = LightmapColor
			Shading.Tint = Tint

			for ColorIndex, ColorId in Shading.ColorIds do
				Built.Mesh:SetColor(ColorId, Correct(Shading.Texels[ColorIndex] * Tint, Level / 255, Overlaid, LightmapColor))
			end
		end
	end
end

const function ShowLayers(Built: PartMesh, LayersShown: { boolean })
	local Changed = false

	for Index, Shown in LayersShown do
		if Built.LayersShown[Index] ~= Shown then
			Built.LayersShown[Index] = Shown
			Changed = true
		end
	end

	if not Changed then
		return
	end

	const Base = Built.Base

	for Index, Position in Built.Positions do
		Base[Index] = if Built.LayersShown[Built.VertexLayers[Index]] then Position else vector.zero
	end

	if not Built.IsSquashed then
		Built.Mesh:BatchSetValues(Built.VertexIds, Base)
	end
end

const function SquashMesh(Built: PartMesh, Frame: CFrame, Camera: CFrame, Squash: number, StretchFrame: CFrame, Stretch: number)
	if Squash == 1 and Stretch == 1 then
		if Built.IsSquashed then
			Built.IsSquashed = false
			Built.Mesh:BatchSetValues(Built.VertexIds, Built.Base)
		end

		return
	end

	const EyeFrame = Camera:ToObjectSpace(Frame)
	const StretchLocal = Frame:ToObjectSpace(StretchFrame)
	const Squashed = Built.Squashed

	Built.IsSquashed = true

	for Index, Position in Built.Base do
		local Point = Position

		if Stretch ~= 1 then
			const Local = StretchLocal:PointToObjectSpace(Point)

			Point = StretchLocal:PointToWorldSpace(vector.create(Local.X, Local.Y, Local.Z * Stretch))
		end

		const Eye = EyeFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Point)

		Squashed[Index] = EyeFrame:PointToObjectSpace(vector.create(Eye.X, Eye.Y, Eye.Z * Squash))
	end

	Built.Mesh:BatchSetValues(Built.VertexIds, Squashed)
end

const function PlaceCopies(Rig: Rig, Root: CFrame, Built: PartMesh, Frame: CFrame, First: number)
	const Frames = Rig.Frames
	const Copies = Rig.Copies

	if #Copies == 1 then
		Frames[First] = Frame * Built.Offset

		return
	end

	const Local = Root:ToObjectSpace(Frame * Built.Offset)

	for Copy, Offset in Copies do
		Frames[First + Copy - 1] = Root * Offset * Local
	end
end

const function DrawRig(Rig: Rig, Root: CFrame, Hurt: boolean, Tint: vector?)
	const PartFrames = Rig.PartFrames
	const CopyCount = #Rig.Copies
	const LightmapColor = vector.floor(Lightmap.Sample() * 255 + vector.one * 0.5) / 255

	PoseParts(Rig, Root)

	for Index, Built in Rig.Meshes do
		const Frame = PartFrames[Built.ModelPart]

		PlaceCopies(Rig, Root, Built, Frame, (Index - 1) * CopyCount + 1)
		ShowLayers(Built, Rig.LayersShown)
		ShadeMesh(Built, Frame, Built.ModelPart.Visible and Rig.Visible, Hurt, LightmapColor, Tint or vector.one, Light0, Light1)
	end

	workspace:BulkMoveTo(Rig.Instances, Rig.Frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

const function DrawRigSquashed(Rig: Rig, Root: CFrame, Camera: CFrame, Squash: number, StretchFrame: CFrame, Stretch: number, Lights: Lights?)
	const PartFrames = Rig.PartFrames
	const Frames = Rig.Frames
	const LightmapColor = vector.floor((if Lights then Lights.Lightmap else Lightmap.Sample()) * 255 + vector.one * 0.5) / 255
	const FirstLight = if Lights then Lights.Light0 else Light0
	const SecondLight = if Lights then Lights.Light1 else Light1

	PoseParts(Rig, Root)

	for Index, Built in Rig.Meshes do
		const Frame = PartFrames[Built.ModelPart]
		const Shown = Built.ModelPart.Visible and Rig.Visible

		Frames[Index] = Frame * Built.Offset
		ShowLayers(Built, Rig.LayersShown)
		ShadeMesh(Built, Frame, Shown, false, LightmapColor, vector.one, FirstLight, SecondLight)

		if Shown then
			SquashMesh(Built, Frames[Index], Camera, Squash, StretchFrame, Stretch)
		end
	end

	workspace:BulkMoveTo(Rig.Instances, Frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

const function DestroyRig(Rig: Rig)
	for _, Built in Rig.Meshes do
		DestroyMesh(Built)
	end
end

return {
	CreateEditableMesh = EditableBudget.CreateMesh,
	SampleLightmap = Lightmap.Sample,
	SampleFullBrightLightmap = Lightmap.SampleFullBright,
	ItemLights = ItemLights,
	BuildQuadLayout = QuadBatch.BuildLayout,
	ShadeQuads = QuadBatch.Shade,
	CreateQuadBatch = QuadBatch.Create,
	BeginQuads = QuadBatch.Begin,
	DrawQuad = QuadBatch.Draw,
	FinishQuads = QuadBatch.Finish,
	UpdateLightmap = Lightmap.Update,
	MaxLocalRawBrightness = Lightmap.MaxLocalRawBrightness,
	Brightness = Lightmap.Brightness,
	SunAngle = Lightmap.SunAngle,
	CanCreateRigs = EditableBudget.Allowed,
	CreateRig = CreateRig,
	DrawRig = DrawRig,
	DrawRigSquashed = DrawRigSquashed,
	DestroyRig = DestroyRig,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering/ColorCorrection"] = function(require)

const Neon = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Features/Rendering/Neon")
const Settings = require("../Settings")

const OverlayAlpha = 0xB3 / 255

const function Correct(Texel: vector, Light: number, Hurt: boolean, Lightmap: vector): Color3
	local Color = Texel * Light

	if Hurt then
		Color = vector.create(1 - OverlayAlpha, 0, 0) + Color * OverlayAlpha
	end

	return Neon(Color * Lightmap * Settings.Exposure)
end

return Correct

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering/DayLight"] = function(require)

return {
	PeriodTicks = 24000,
	AmbientLightColor = { 0.0392156862745098, 0.0392156862745098, 0.0392156862745098 },
	SkyLightFactor = { { Ticks = 730, Value = 1 }, { Ticks = 11270, Value = 1 }, { Ticks = 13140, Value = 0.24 }, { Ticks = 22860, Value = 0.24 } },
	SkyLightColor = { { Ticks = 730, Value = { 1, 1, 1 } }, { Ticks = 11270, Value = { 1, 1, 1 } }, { Ticks = 13140, Value = { 0.47843137254901963, 0.47843137254901963, 1 } }, { Ticks = 22860, Value = { 0.47843137254901963, 0.47843137254901963, 1 } } },
	SkyLightLevel = { { Ticks = 133, Value = 1 }, { Ticks = 11867, Value = 1 }, { Ticks = 13670, Value = 0.26666668 }, { Ticks = 22330, Value = 0.26666668 } },
	SunAngle = { Ease = { 0.362, 0.241, 0.638, 0.759 }, Keyframes = { { Ticks = 6000, Value = 360 }, { Ticks = 6000, Value = 0 } } },
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering/Lightmap"] = function(require)

const Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const DayLight = require("./DayLight")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const TicksPerHour = 1000
const DayStartHour = 6
const GammaOption = 0.5
const MaxSkyLight = 15
const BezierNewtonIterations = 4
const BezierTolerance = 1.0E-5
const BezierMaxStep = 0.25

const Ambient = vector.create(DayLight.AmbientLightColor[1], DayLight.AmbientLightColor[2], DayLight.AmbientLightColor[3])
const NightVisionColor = vector.one * (0x99 / 255)
const NightVisionPulseTicks = 200
const DarknessStrength = 0.45
const FullBlockLight = 1.4

local Cached = vector.one
local CachedFullBright = vector.one

const function FindSegment(Keyframes: { { Ticks: number } }, Ticks: number): (number, number, number)
	const Period = DayLight.PeriodTicks
	const Count = #Keyframes

	if Ticks < Keyframes[1].Ticks then
		const FromTicks = Keyframes[Count].Ticks - Period

		return Count, 1, (Ticks - FromTicks) / (Keyframes[1].Ticks - FromTicks)
	end

	for Index = 1, Count - 1 do
		const ToTicks = Keyframes[Index + 1].Ticks

		if Ticks < ToTicks then
			const FromTicks = Keyframes[Index].Ticks

			return Index, Index + 1, (Ticks - FromTicks) / (ToTicks - FromTicks)
		end
	end

	const FromTicks = Keyframes[Count].Ticks

	return Count, 1, (Ticks - FromTicks) / (Keyframes[1].Ticks + Period - FromTicks)
end

const function NotGamma(Color: vector): vector
	const MaxComponent = math.max(Color.x, Color.y, Color.z)

	if MaxComponent == 0 then
		return Color
	end

	const Inverted = 1 - MaxComponent
	const Scaled = 1 - Inverted * Inverted * Inverted * Inverted

	return Color * (Scaled / MaxComponent)
end

const function DayTicks(): number
	return ((Lighting.ClockTime - DayStartHour) % 24) * TicksPerHour
end

const function Update(Effects: Minecraft.Effects?, TickCount: number, Partial: number, WaterVision: number)
	const Ticks = DayTicks()
	const FactorFrom, FactorTo, FactorAlpha = FindSegment(DayLight.SkyLightFactor, Ticks)
	const ColorFrom, ColorTo, ColorAlpha = FindSegment(DayLight.SkyLightColor, Ticks)
	const FromFactor = DayLight.SkyLightFactor[FactorFrom].Value
	const SkyFactor = FromFactor + (DayLight.SkyLightFactor[FactorTo].Value - FromFactor) * FactorAlpha
	const FromColor = DayLight.SkyLightColor[ColorFrom].Value
	const ToColor = DayLight.SkyLightColor[ColorTo].Value
	const FromVector = vector.create(FromColor[1], FromColor[2], FromColor[3])
	const SkyColor = FromVector + (vector.create(ToColor[1], ToColor[2], ToColor[3]) - FromVector) * ColorAlpha
	local NightVision = 0
	local Darkness = 0

	if Effects then
		const Vision = Effects["minecraft:night_vision"]
		const Dark = Effects["minecraft:darkness"]

		if Vision then
			NightVision = if not Minecraft.Effects.EndsWithin(Vision, NightVisionPulseTicks) then 1 else 0.7 + Mth.Sin((Vision.Duration - Partial) * math.pi * 0.2) * 0.3
		elseif WaterVision > 0 and Effects["minecraft:conduit_power"] then
			NightVision = WaterVision
		end

		if Dark then
			Darkness = Minecraft.Effects.BlendFactor(Dark, Partial)
		end
	end

	const DarknessScale = math.max(0, Mth.Cos((TickCount - Partial) * math.pi * 0.025) * DarknessStrength * Darkness)
	const Base = vector.max(Ambient, NightVisionColor * NightVision)
	const Color = vector.clamp(Base + SkyColor * SkyFactor - vector.one * DarknessScale, vector.zero, vector.one)

	const Bright = vector.clamp(Base + SkyColor * SkyFactor + vector.one * (FullBlockLight - DarknessScale), vector.zero, vector.one)

	Cached = Color + (NotGamma(Color) - Color) * math.max(0, GammaOption - Darkness)
	CachedFullBright = Bright + (NotGamma(Bright) - Bright) * math.max(0, GammaOption - Darkness)
end

const function Sample(): vector
	return Cached
end

const function SampleFullBright(): vector
	return CachedFullBright
end

const function MaxLocalRawBrightness(): number
	const From, To, Alpha = FindSegment(DayLight.SkyLightLevel, DayTicks())
	const FromLevel = DayLight.SkyLightLevel[From].Value
	const SkyLightLevel = Mth.Float(MaxSkyLight * (FromLevel + (DayLight.SkyLightLevel[To].Value - FromLevel) * Alpha))
	const SkyDarken = math.modf(MaxSkyLight - SkyLightLevel)

	return MaxSkyLight - SkyDarken
end

const function Brightness(Level: number): number
	const Value = Mth.Float(Level / MaxSkyLight)

	return Mth.Float(Value / (4 - 3 * Value))
end

const function CubicSample(A: number, B: number, C: number, T: number): number
	return ((A * T + B) * T + C) * T
end

const function CubicBezier(Controls: { number }, X: number): number
	const XA = 3 * Controls[1] - 3 * Controls[3] + 1
	const XB = -6 * Controls[1] + 3 * Controls[3]
	const XC = 3 * Controls[1]
	local T = X

	for _ = 1, BezierNewtonIterations do
		const Error = CubicSample(XA, XB, XC, T) - X

		if math.abs(Error) < BezierTolerance then
			return CubicSample(3 * Controls[2] - 3 * Controls[4] + 1, -6 * Controls[2] + 3 * Controls[4], 3 * Controls[2], T)
		end

		const Gradient = (3 * XA * T + 2 * XB) * T + XC

		if Gradient < BezierTolerance then
			break
		end

		T -= math.clamp(Error / Gradient, -BezierMaxStep, BezierMaxStep)
	end

	local Low = 0
	local High = 1

	while Low < High do
		const Error = CubicSample(XA, XB, XC, T) - X

		if math.abs(Error) < BezierTolerance then
			break
		end

		if Error < 0 then
			Low = T
		else
			High = T
		end

		T = (High + Low) / 2
	end

	return CubicSample(3 * Controls[2] - 3 * Controls[4] + 1, -6 * Controls[2] + 3 * Controls[4], 3 * Controls[2], T)
end

const function SunAngle(): number
	const Track = DayLight.SunAngle
	const From, To, Alpha = FindSegment(Track.Keyframes, DayTicks())
	const FromValue = Track.Keyframes[From].Value

	return FromValue + (Track.Keyframes[To].Value - FromValue) * CubicBezier(Track.Ease, Alpha)
end

Update(nil, 0, 0, 0)

return {
	Update = Update,
	Sample = Sample,
	SampleFullBright = SampleFullBright,
	SunAngle = SunAngle,
	MaxLocalRawBrightness = MaxLocalRawBrightness,
	Brightness = Brightness,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering/QuadBatch"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Correct = require("./ColorCorrection")
const EditableBudget = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Features/Rendering/EditableBudget")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const Extent = 4
const PartTransparency = 0.02
const AlphaScale = 1 / (1 - PartTransparency)

export type Cell = {
	X0: number,
	Y0: number,
	X1: number,
	Y1: number,
	Texel: vector,
	Alpha: number,
}

type Page = {
	Mesh: EditableMesh,
	Instance: MeshPart,
	VertexIds: { number },
	ColorIds: { number },
	Colors: { Color3 },
	Alphas: { number },
}

export type Batch = {
	Folder: Folder,
	Capacity: number,
	Page: Page?,
	Building: boolean,
	Used: number,
	Count: number,
	Origin: vector,
}

type Run = {
	First: number,
	Last: number,
	Key: number,
	Cell: Cell,
}

const Columns: { number } = {}
const Rows: { number } = {}
const Open: { Run } = {}
const Next: { Run } = {}
const Keys: { number } = {}
const Texels: { vector } = {}
const TexelAlphas: { number } = {}
const White = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

const function Boundaries(Start: number, Finish: number, Out: { number }): number
	table.clear(Out)

	const Low = math.min(Start, Finish)
	const High = math.max(Start, Finish)

	table.insert(Out, Low)

	for Edge = Low // 1 + 1, math.ceil(High) - 1 do
		table.insert(Out, Edge)
	end

	table.insert(Out, High)

	return #Out - 1
end

const function BuildLayout(AtlasName: Textures.AtlasName, SpriteId: string, U0: number, U1: number, V0: number, V1: number): { Cell }
	const Atlas = Textures.Atlas(AtlasName)
	const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Atlas, SpriteId)
	const Frame = Textures.Frame(Sprite)
	const Size = Sprite.Size
	const PixelU0 = U0 * Size.X
	const PixelU1 = U1 * Size.X
	const PixelV0 = V0 * Size.Y
	const PixelV1 = V1 * Size.Y
	const ColumnCount = Boundaries(PixelU0, PixelU1, Columns)
	const RowCount = Boundaries(PixelV0, PixelV1, Rows)
	const Cells: { Cell } = {}

	table.clear(Open)

	for Row = 1, RowCount + 1 do
		table.clear(Next)

		if Row <= RowCount then
			const PixelY = math.clamp((Rows[Row] + Rows[Row + 1]) / 2 // 1, 0, Size.Y - 1)
			const Top = 1 - 2 * (Rows[Row] - PixelV0) / (PixelV1 - PixelV0)
			const Bottom = 1 - 2 * (Rows[Row + 1] - PixelV0) / (PixelV1 - PixelV0)

			for Column = 1, ColumnCount do
				const PixelX = math.clamp((Columns[Column] + Columns[Column + 1]) / 2 // 1, 0, Size.X - 1)
				const Offset = ((Frame.Y + PixelY) * Atlas.Size.X + Frame.X + PixelX) * 4
				const Alpha = buffer.readu8(Atlas.Pixels, Offset + 3)

				Keys[Column] = if Alpha > 0 then buffer.readu32(Atlas.Pixels, Offset) else -1
				Texels[Column] = vector.create(buffer.readu8(Atlas.Pixels, Offset), buffer.readu8(Atlas.Pixels, Offset + 1), buffer.readu8(Atlas.Pixels, Offset + 2)) / 255
				TexelAlphas[Column] = Alpha / 255
			end

			local Column = 1

			while Column <= ColumnCount do
				const Key = Keys[Column]
				local Last = Column

				while Last < ColumnCount and Keys[Last + 1] == Key do
					Last += 1
				end

				if Key ~= -1 then
					const Left = -1 + 2 * (Columns[Column] - PixelU0) / (PixelU1 - PixelU0)
					const Right = -1 + 2 * (Columns[Last + 1] - PixelU0) / (PixelU1 - PixelU0)
					local Continued: Run? = nil

					for _, Candidate in Open do
						if Candidate.First == Column and Candidate.Last == Last and Candidate.Key == Key then
							Continued = Candidate
						end
					end

					if Continued then
						const Cell = Continued.Cell

						Cell.Y0 = math.min(Cell.Y0, Bottom)
						Cell.Y1 = math.max(Cell.Y1, Top)
						table.insert(Next, Continued)
					else
						const Cell: Cell = {
							X0 = math.min(Left, Right),
							X1 = math.max(Left, Right),
							Y0 = math.min(Top, Bottom),
							Y1 = math.max(Top, Bottom),
							Texel = Texels[Column],
							Alpha = TexelAlphas[Column],
						}

						table.insert(Cells, Cell)
						table.insert(Next, { First = Column, Last = Last, Key = Key, Cell = Cell })
					end
				end

				Column = Last + 1
			end
		end

		table.clear(Open)

		for Index, Continued in Next do
			Open[Index] = Continued
		end
	end

	return Cells
end

const function Shade(Cells: { Cell }, Color: vector, Alpha: number, Light: vector, Colors: { Color3 }, Alphas: { number })
	table.clear(Colors)
	table.clear(Alphas)

	for Index, Cell in Cells do
		Colors[Index] = Correct(Cell.Texel * Color, 1, false, Light)
		Alphas[Index] = math.min(Cell.Alpha * Alpha * AlphaScale, 1)
	end
end

const function CreatePage(Batch: Batch): Page?
	const Mesh = EditableBudget.CreateMesh()

	if not Mesh then
		return nil
	end

	const Bound = Extent * StudsPerBlock
	const VertexIds: { number } = {}
	const ColorIds: { number } = {}
	const Colors: { Color3 } = {}
	const Alphas: { number } = {}

	for Quad = 1, Batch.Capacity do
		const Corner = if Quad == 1 then -Bound elseif Quad == 2 then Bound else 0
		const ColorId = Mesh:AddColor(White, 1)
		const Ids: { number } = {}

		for Index = 1, 4 do
			Ids[Index] = Mesh:AddVertex(vector.one * Corner)
			table.insert(VertexIds, Ids[Index])
		end

		const First = Mesh:AddTriangle(Ids[1], Ids[2], Ids[3])
		const Second = Mesh:AddTriangle(Ids[1], Ids[3], Ids[4])

		Mesh:SetFaceColors(First, { ColorId, ColorId, ColorId })
		Mesh:SetFaceColors(Second, { ColorId, ColorId, ColorId })
		ColorIds[Quad] = ColorId
		Colors[Quad] = White
		Alphas[Quad] = 1
	end

	const Created, Part = pcall(AssetService.CreateMeshPartAsync, AssetService, Content.fromObject(Mesh))

	if not Created then
		Mesh:Destroy()

		return nil
	end

	Part.Name = "Quads"
	Part.Anchored = true
	Part.CanCollide = false
	Part.CanTouch = false
	Part.CanQuery = false
	Part.CastShadow = false
	Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	Part.Color = White
	Part.Transparency = PartTransparency
	Part.Parent = Batch.Folder

	for Index = 1, 8 do
		Mesh:SetPosition(VertexIds[Index], vector.zero)
	end

	return {
		Mesh = Mesh,
		Instance = Part,
		VertexIds = VertexIds,
		ColorIds = ColorIds,
		Colors = Colors,
		Alphas = Alphas,
	}
end

const function Build(Batch: Batch)
	Batch.Page = CreatePage(Batch)
	Batch.Building = false
end

const function Create(Name: string, Capacity: number): Batch
	const Folder = Instance.new("Folder")

	Folder.Name = Name
	Folder.Parent = workspace

	return { Folder = Folder, Capacity = Capacity, Page = nil, Building = false, Used = 0, Count = 0, Origin = vector.zero }
end

const function Begin(Batch: Batch)
	const CameraFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame

	Batch.Origin = vector.create(CameraFrame.X, CameraFrame.Y, CameraFrame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
	Batch.Count = 0
end

const function Draw(Batch: Batch, Center: vector, Right: vector, Up: vector, Cells: { Cell }, Colors: { Color3 }, Alphas: { number })
	const Local = Center - Batch.Origin

	if not Batch.Page and not Batch.Building then
		Batch.Building = true
		task.spawn(Build, Batch)
	end

	const Page = Batch.Page

	if not Page or math.abs(Local.x) > Extent or math.abs(Local.y) > Extent or math.abs(Local.z) > Extent then
		return
	end

	const Mesh = Page.Mesh
	const VertexIds = Page.VertexIds
	const Base = Local * StudsPerBlock
	const RightStuds = Right * StudsPerBlock
	const UpStuds = Up * StudsPerBlock
	local Quad = Batch.Count

	for CellIndex, Cell in Cells do
		if Quad >= Batch.Capacity then
			break
		end

		const First = Quad * 4
		const Left = RightStuds * Cell.X0
		const RightEdge = RightStuds * Cell.X1
		const Bottom = UpStuds * Cell.Y0
		const Top = UpStuds * Cell.Y1
		const Shown = Colors[CellIndex]
		const ShownAlpha = Alphas[CellIndex]

		Quad += 1
		Mesh:SetPosition(VertexIds[First + 1], Base + Left + Bottom)
		Mesh:SetPosition(VertexIds[First + 2], Base + RightEdge + Bottom)
		Mesh:SetPosition(VertexIds[First + 3], Base + RightEdge + Top)
		Mesh:SetPosition(VertexIds[First + 4], Base + Left + Top)

		if Page.Colors[Quad] ~= Shown then
			Page.Colors[Quad] = Shown
			Mesh:SetColor(Page.ColorIds[Quad], Shown)
		end

		if Page.Alphas[Quad] ~= ShownAlpha then
			Page.Alphas[Quad] = ShownAlpha
			Mesh:SetColorAlpha(Page.ColorIds[Quad], ShownAlpha)
		end
	end

	Batch.Count = Quad
end

const function Finish(Batch: Batch)
	const Page = Batch.Page

	if not Page then
		return
	end

	for Quad = Batch.Count, Batch.Used - 1 do
		for Corner = 1, 4 do
			Page.Mesh:SetPosition(Page.VertexIds[Quad * 4 + Corner], vector.zero)
		end
	end

	Batch.Used = Batch.Count
	Page.Instance.CFrame = CFrame.new(Batch.Origin * StudsPerBlock)
end

return {
	BuildLayout = BuildLayout,
	Shade = Shade,
	Create = Create,
	Begin = Begin,
	Draw = Draw,
	Finish = Finish,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Rendering/ItemLights"] = function(require)

const Affine = require("../Affine")

const DiffuseLight0 = vector.normalize(vector.create(0.2, 1, -0.7))
const DiffuseLight1 = vector.normalize(vector.create(-0.2, 1, 0.7))

const function LightDirections(Rotations: { number }, FlipY: boolean): (vector, vector)
	const Matrix = Affine.Create()

	if FlipY then
		Affine.Scale(Matrix, 1, -1, 1)
	end

	for Index = 1, #Rotations, 2 do
		Affine.RotateY(Matrix, Rotations[Index])
		Affine.RotateX(Matrix, Rotations[Index + 1])
	end

	return Affine.Point(Matrix, DiffuseLight0), Affine.Point(Matrix, DiffuseLight1)
end

const Flat0, Flat1 = LightDirections({ -math.pi / 8, math.pi * 3 / 4 }, false)
const Block0, Block1 = LightDirections({ 1.0821041, 3.2375858, -math.pi / 8, math.pi * 3 / 4 }, true)

return {
	Flat0 = Flat0,
	Flat1 = Flat1,
	Block0 = Block0,
	Block1 = Block1,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Avatars"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Equipment = require("./Equipment")
const HeldItems = require("./HeldItems")
const ItemModels = require("./ItemModels")
const Models = require("./Models")
const Players = require("./Players")

const Shadows = require("./Shadows")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Behaviors = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors
const Spear = Models.Spear
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const RenderScale = 0.9375
const ModelYOffset = -1.501
const CrouchOffset = -2 / 16
const DeathFlipDegrees = 90
const ModelStudsPerBlock = RenderScale * StudsPerBlock
const StudsPerModelPixel = ModelStudsPerBlock / 16
const ModelFlip = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi)
const ModelOffset = CFrame.new(0, ModelYOffset * ModelStudsPerBlock, 0)
const HandTurn = CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
const ShadowRadius = 0.5
const SlimHandOffset = 0.5
const RightHandOffset = CFrame.new(1 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock, 2 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock, -10 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock)
const LeftHandOffset = CFrame.new(-1 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock, 2 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock, -10 / 16 * ModelStudsPerBlock)
const ThirdPersonLeftOrdinal = 1
const ThirdPersonRightOrdinal = 2
const HeadOrdinal = 5
const HeldToEyeSwing = 1.0E-5
const EyeScale = 0.625 * ModelStudsPerBlock
const EyeHeadMinimumXRot = -math.pi / 6
const EyeHeadMaximumXRot = math.pi / 2
const HeadOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.25 * ModelStudsPerBlock, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0)
const RightEyeOffset = CFrame.new(2.5 / 16 * EyeScale, -0.0625 * EyeScale, 0)
const LeftEyeOffset = CFrame.new(-2.5 / 16 * EyeScale, -0.0625 * EyeScale, 0)
const WingsOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.125 * ModelStudsPerBlock)
const SkullScale = 1.1875
const FallFlyingSpeedScale = 0.2
const OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

const ArmorSlots: { Models.ArmorSlot } = { "chest", "legs", "feet", "head" }
const ArmorLayerTypes: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Equipment.LayerType } = {
	chest = "humanoid",
	legs = "humanoid_leggings",
	feet = "humanoid",
	head = "humanoid",
}

const TwoHandedPoses = { BowAndArrow = true, CrossbowCharge = true, CrossbowHold = true }
const UsePoses: { [string]: Models.ArmPose } = {
	block = "Block",
	bow = "BowAndArrow",
	trident = "ThrowTrident",
	crossbow = "CrossbowCharge",
	spyglass = "Spyglass",
	toot_horn = "TootHorn",
	brush = "Brush",
	spear = "Spear",
}
const SwingTypes: { [string]: Models.SwingType } = { none = "None", whack = "Whack", stab = "Stab" }

type LayerRig = {
	Parts: { Models.LayerPart },
	Scale: number,
	Texture: Textures.Texture?,
	Rig: Rendering.Rig?,
	Building: boolean,
}

type Avatar = {
	Instance: Model,
	Model: Models.PlayerModel,
	Skin: Skins.Skin,
	Rig: Rendering.Rig?,
	Building: boolean,
	State: Models.AvatarRenderState,
	RightHand: HeldItems.Holder,
	LeftHand: HeldItems.Holder,
	EyeItem: HeldItems.Holder,
	HeadItem: HeldItems.Holder,
	ArmorPolygons: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: { [Models.Part]: { Models.LayerPolygon } } },
	RigArmor: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture },
	WantedArmor: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture },
	Elytra: Models.ElytraModel,
	Wings: LayerRig,
	SkullKind: string?,
	SkullSize: Vector2?,
	SkullLayer: Models.Layer?,
	Skull: LayerRig?,
	Highlight: Highlight?,
	Destroyed: boolean,
}

const Avatars: { [Players.PlayerEntity]: Avatar } = {}
const ItemState = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const ItemContext: ItemModels.Context = { DisplayContext = "none", Holder = nil, Seed = 0 }
const Container = Instance.new("Folder")
const EquipmentTextureSize = Vector2.new(64, 32)

Container.Name = "MinecraftAvatars"
Container.Parent = workspace

const function CreateRenderState(): Models.AvatarRenderState
	return {
		AgeInTicks = 0,
		XRot = 0,
		YRot = 0,
		WalkAnimationPos = 0,
		WalkAnimationSpeed = 0,
		SpeedValue = 1,
		SwimAmount = 0,
		IsInWater = false,
		IsVisuallySwimming = false,
		AgeScale = 1,
		IsCrouching = false,
		IsFallFlying = false,
		IsPassenger = false,
		IsSpectator = false,
		IsUsingItem = false,
		MainArm = "Right",
		UseItemArm = "Right",
		RightArmPose = "Empty",
		LeftArmPose = "Empty",
		MaxCrossbowChargeDuration = 0,
		TicksUsingItem = 0,
		SwingAnimation = 0,
		SwingArm = nil,
		SwingType = "None",
		RightKinetic = nil,
		LeftKinetic = nil,
		ElytraRotX = 0,
		ElytraRotY = 0,
		ElytraRotZ = 0,
		FallFlyingScale = 0,
		FlyingYRot = 0,
	}
end

const function IsChargedCrossbow(Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): boolean
	if not Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Stack), "CrossbowItem") then
		return false
	end

	const Projectiles = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:charged_projectiles") :: { unknown }?

	return Projectiles ~= nil and #Projectiles > 0
end

const function HandPose(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, OffHand: boolean): Models.ArmPose
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return "Empty"
	elseif not Entity.SwingActive and IsChargedCrossbow(Stack) then
		return "CrossbowHold"
	end

	if Entity.UsingOffHand == OffHand and Entity.UseItemRemaining > 0 then
		const Pose = UsePoses[Behaviors.UseAnimation(Stack)]

		if Pose then
			return Pose
		end
	end

	if
		Entity.SwingActive and Entity.SwingOffHand == OffHand and Entity.SwingType == "stab"
		or Minecraft.Registry.HasTag("minecraft:item", "minecraft:spears", Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id)
	then
		return "Spear"
	end

	return "Item"
end

const function KineticOf(Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): Models.Kinetic?
	return Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") :: Models.Kinetic?
end

const function BuildRig(Avatar: Avatar, Armor: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture })
	const Layers: { Rendering.Layer } = { { Texture = Textures.Texture(Avatar.Skin.Texture), Material = "Cutout", Overlay = true } }

	for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
		const Texture = Armor[Slot]

		if Texture then
			table.insert(Layers, { Texture = Texture, Material = "Cutout", Overlay = false, Polygons = Avatar.ArmorPolygons[Slot] })
		end
	end

	const Rig = Rendering.CreateRig(Avatar.Model.Parts, Layers, StudsPerModelPixel, Avatar.Instance)

	Avatar.Building = false

	if not Rig then
		return
	end

	if Avatar.Destroyed then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Rig)

		return
	end

	if Avatar.Rig then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Avatar.Rig)
	end

	Avatar.Rig = Rig
	Avatar.RigArmor = Armor
end

const function SameArmor(A: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture }, B: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture }): boolean
	for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
		if A[Slot] ~= B[Slot] then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function UpdateRig(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar)
	const Wanted = Avatar.WantedArmor

	table.clear(Wanted)

	for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
		const Stack = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, Slot)

		if Equipment.ShouldRender(Stack, Slot) then
			Wanted[Slot] = Equipment.Texture(Stack, ArmorLayerTypes[Slot])
		end
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if not Avatar.Building and (now - (Avatar.LastBuildAttempt or 0) > 3) and (not Avatar.Rig or not SameArmor(Wanted, Avatar.RigArmor)) then
		Avatar.Building = true
		Avatar.LastBuildAttempt = now
		task.spawn(BuildRig, Avatar, table.clone(Wanted))
	end
end

const function BuildLayerRig(Avatar: Avatar, Layer: LayerRig, Texture: Textures.Texture)
	const Rig = Rendering.CreateRig(Layer.Parts, { { Texture = Texture, Material = "Cutout", Overlay = false } }, Layer.Scale, Avatar.Instance)

	if Avatar.Destroyed or Layer.Texture ~= Texture then
		if Rig then
			Rendering.DestroyRig(Rig)
		end

		return
	end

	Layer.Building = false

	if Layer.Rig then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Layer.Rig)
	end

	Layer.Rig = Rig
end

const function StartLayerBuild(Avatar: Avatar, Layer: LayerRig, Texture: Textures.Texture)
	Layer.Building = true
	task.spawn(BuildLayerRig, Avatar, Layer, Texture)
end

const function SetLayerTexture(Avatar: Avatar, Layer: LayerRig, Texture: Textures.Texture?)
	if Texture == Layer.Texture then
		if Texture and not Layer.Rig and not Layer.Building then
			StartLayerBuild(Avatar, Layer, Texture)
		end

		return
	end

	Layer.Texture = Texture

	if Texture then
		StartLayerBuild(Avatar, Layer, Texture)
	elseif Layer.Rig then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Layer.Rig)
		Layer.Rig = nil
	end
end

const function DestroyLayerRig(Layer: LayerRig)
	Layer.Texture = nil

	if Layer.Rig then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Layer.Rig)
		Layer.Rig = nil
	end
end

const function DrawLayerRig(Layer: LayerRig, Root: CFrame, Visible: boolean)
	const Rig = Layer.Rig

	if Rig then
		Rig.Visible = Visible
		Rendering.DrawRig(Rig, Root, false)
	end
end

const function CreateAvatar(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity): Avatar
	const Skin = Skins.ForName(Entity.Name)

	local existingHolder = Container:FindFirstChild(Entity.Name)
	if existingHolder then
		pcall(function() existingHolder:Destroy() end)
	end

	const Holder = Instance.new("Model")
	Holder.Name = Entity.Name
	Holder.Parent = Container

	const Model = Models.Player.Create(Skin.Slim)
	const ArmorPolygons: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: { [Models.Part]: { Models.LayerPolygon } } } = {}

	for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
		ArmorPolygons[Slot] = Models.Equipment.ArmorPolygons(Models.Equipment.CreateArmor(Slot, EquipmentTextureSize), Model)
	end

	const Elytra = Models.Equipment.CreateElytra(EquipmentTextureSize)
	const Avatar: Avatar = {
		Instance = Holder,
		Model = Model,
		Skin = Skin,
		Rig = nil,
		Building = false,
		State = CreateRenderState(),
		RightHand = HeldItems.Create(Holder, ModelStudsPerBlock),
		LeftHand = HeldItems.Create(Holder, ModelStudsPerBlock),
		EyeItem = HeldItems.Create(Holder, EyeScale),
		HeadItem = HeldItems.Create(Holder, EyeScale),
		ArmorPolygons = ArmorPolygons,
		RigArmor = {},
		WantedArmor = {},
		Elytra = Elytra,
		Wings = { Parts = Elytra.Parts, Scale = StudsPerModelPixel, Texture = nil, Rig = nil, Building = false },
		SkullKind = nil,
		SkullSize = nil,
		SkullLayer = nil,
		Skull = nil,
		Highlight = nil,
		Destroyed = false,
	}

	Avatars[Entity] = Avatar

	return Avatar
end

const function DestroyAvatar(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar)
	Avatars[Entity] = nil
	Avatar.Destroyed = true

	if Avatar.Rig then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Avatar.Rig)
	end

	DestroyLayerRig(Avatar.Wings)

	if Avatar.Skull then
		DestroyLayerRig(Avatar.Skull)
	end

	HeldItems.Destroy(Avatar.RightHand)
	HeldItems.Destroy(Avatar.LeftHand)
	HeldItems.Destroy(Avatar.EyeItem)
	HeldItems.Destroy(Avatar.HeadItem)
	Avatar.Instance:Destroy()
end

const function ExtractRenderState(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Partial: number, State: Models.AvatarRenderState): number
	const BodyRot = Mth.RotLerp(Partial, Entity.YBodyRotO, Entity.YBodyRot)
	const HeadRot = Mth.RotLerp(Partial, Entity.YHeadRotO, Entity.YHeadRot)
	const MainHand = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "mainhand")
	const OffHand = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "offhand")
	const MainPose = HandPose(Entity, MainHand, false)
	local OffPose = HandPose(Entity, OffHand, true)
	const OffArm: Models.Arm = if Entity.MainArm == "Right" then "Left" else "Right"
	const FallFlying = Players.IsFallFlying(Entity)
	const FlightTicks = Entity.FallFlyTicks + Partial
	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement
	local SpeedValue = 1

	if TwoHandedPoses[MainPose] then
		OffPose = if Items.IsEmpty(OffHand) then "Empty" else "Item"
	end

	if FallFlying then
		const Ratio = vector.dot(Movement, Movement) / FallFlyingSpeedScale

		SpeedValue = math.max(1, Ratio * Ratio * Ratio)
	end

	State.AgeInTicks = Entity.TickCount + Partial
	State.XRot = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.XRotO, Entity.XRot)
	State.YRot = Mth.WrapDegrees(HeadRot - BodyRot)
	State.WalkAnimationPos = Entity.WalkPosition - Entity.WalkSpeed * (1 - Partial)
	State.WalkAnimationSpeed = math.min(Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.WalkSpeedOld, Entity.WalkSpeed), 1)
	State.SpeedValue = SpeedValue
	State.IsSpectator = Entity.GameMode == "spectator"
	State.SwimAmount = Players.SwimAmount(Entity, Partial)
	State.IsInWater = Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Entity)
	State.IsVisuallySwimming = Players.IsVisuallySwimming(Entity)
	State.IsCrouching = if Entity.IsLocal then Entity.Crouching else Entity.Pose == "Crouching"
	State.IsFallFlying = FallFlying
	State.FallFlyingScale = math.clamp(FlightTicks * FlightTicks / 100, 0, 1)
	State.FlyingYRot = Models.Player.FlyingYRot(Entity.DeltaMovementO + (Movement - Entity.DeltaMovementO) * Partial, Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.XRotO, Entity.XRot), HeadRot)
	State.ElytraRotX = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.ElytraRotXO, Entity.ElytraRotX)
	State.ElytraRotY = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.ElytraRotYO, Entity.ElytraRotY)
	State.ElytraRotZ = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.ElytraRotZO, Entity.ElytraRotZ)
	State.MainArm = Entity.MainArm
	State.RightArmPose = if Entity.MainArm == "Right" then MainPose else OffPose
	State.LeftArmPose = if Entity.MainArm == "Right" then OffPose else MainPose
	State.RightKinetic = KineticOf(if Entity.MainArm == "Right" then MainHand else OffHand)
	State.LeftKinetic = KineticOf(if Entity.MainArm == "Right" then OffHand else MainHand)
	State.IsUsingItem = Entity.UsingItem
	State.UseItemArm = if Entity.UsingOffHand then OffArm else Entity.MainArm
	State.MaxCrossbowChargeDuration = Behaviors.ChargeDuration(Entity.UseItem)
	State.TicksUsingItem = Players.TicksUsingItem(Entity, Partial)
	State.SwingAnimation = if Entity.SwingActive then Players.SwingProgress(Entity, Partial) else 0
	State.SwingArm = if not Entity.SwingActive then nil elseif Entity.SwingOffHand then OffArm else Entity.MainArm
	State.SwingType = if Entity.SwingActive then SwingTypes[Entity.SwingType] or "None" else "None"

	return BodyRot
end

const function HandFrame(Model: Models.PlayerModel, ModelRoot: CFrame, Right: boolean): CFrame
	const Arm = if Right then Model.RightArm else Model.LeftArm
	const SlimOffset = if Model.Slim then (if Right then SlimHandOffset else -SlimHandOffset) else 0
	const ArmFrame = ModelRoot
		* CFrame.new((Arm.X + SlimOffset) * StudsPerModelPixel, Arm.Y * StudsPerModelPixel, Arm.Z * StudsPerModelPixel)
		* CFrame.fromEulerAngles(Arm.XRot, Arm.YRot, Arm.ZRot, Enum.RotationOrder.ZYX)

	return ArmFrame * HandTurn * (if Right then RightHandOffset else LeftHandOffset)
end

const function HeadFrame(Model: Models.PlayerModel, ModelRoot: CFrame, XRot: number): CFrame
	const Head = Model.Head

	return ModelRoot
		* CFrame.new(Head.X * StudsPerModelPixel, Head.Y * StudsPerModelPixel, Head.Z * StudsPerModelPixel)
		* CFrame.fromEulerAngles(XRot, Head.YRot, Head.ZRot, Enum.RotationOrder.ZYX)
end

const function DrawHand(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar, ModelRoot: CFrame, Right: boolean, Visible: boolean, Partial: number): boolean
	const Holder = if Right then Avatar.RightHand else Avatar.LeftHand
	const State = Avatar.State
	const Arm: Models.Arm = if Right then "Right" else "Left"
	const UsesArm = State.IsUsingItem and State.UseItemArm == Arm
	const ToEye = UsesArm and State.SwingAnimation < HeldToEyeSwing and Players.IsScoping(Entity)
	local Frame = HandFrame(Avatar.Model, ModelRoot, Right)

	if State.SwingType == "Stab" and State.SwingArm == Arm then
		const MainKinetic = if State.MainArm == "Right" then State.RightKinetic else State.LeftKinetic
		const Forward = if MainKinetic then MainKinetic.forward_movement or 0 else 0

		Frame *= Spear.ThirdPersonAttackItem(State.SwingAnimation, Forward, ModelStudsPerBlock)
	end

	if UsesArm and State.TicksUsingItem ~= 0 and (if Right then State.RightArmPose else State.LeftArmPose) == "Spear" then
		Frame *= Spear.ThirdPersonUseItem(
			if Right then State.RightKinetic else State.LeftKinetic,
			State.TicksUsingItem,
			Right,
			State.SwingAnimation,
			Players.TicksSinceKineticHit(Entity, Partial),
			ModelStudsPerBlock
		)
	end

	ItemContext.DisplayContext = if Right then "thirdperson_righthand" else "thirdperson_lefthand"
	ItemContext.Holder = Entity
	ItemContext.Seed = Entity.Id + (if Right then ThirdPersonRightOrdinal else ThirdPersonLeftOrdinal)
	ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, if ToEye then Items.Empty else Players.ItemHeldByArm(Entity, Arm), ItemContext)
	HeldItems.Update(Holder, ItemState)
	HeldItems.Draw(Holder, Frame, Visible)

	return ToEye
end

const function DrawHeldToEye(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar, ModelRoot: CFrame, Arm: Models.Arm?, Visible: boolean)
	ItemContext.DisplayContext = "head"
	ItemContext.Holder = Entity
	ItemContext.Seed = Entity.Id + HeadOrdinal
	ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, if Arm then Players.ItemHeldByArm(Entity, Arm) else Items.Empty, ItemContext)
	HeldItems.Update(Avatar.EyeItem, ItemState)

	if not Arm then
		HeldItems.Draw(Avatar.EyeItem, ModelRoot, false)

		return
	end

	const Head = HeadFrame(Avatar.Model, ModelRoot, math.clamp(Avatar.Model.Head.XRot, EyeHeadMinimumXRot, EyeHeadMaximumXRot))

	HeldItems.Draw(Avatar.EyeItem, Head * HeadOffset * (if Arm == "Right" then RightEyeOffset else LeftEyeOffset), Visible)
end

const function DrawWings(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar, ModelRoot: CFrame, Visible: boolean)
	const Chest = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "chest")

	SetLayerTexture(Avatar, Avatar.Wings, if Equipment.ShouldRender(Chest, "chest") then Equipment.Texture(Chest, "wings") else nil)
	Models.Equipment.PoseElytra(Avatar.Elytra, Avatar.State)
	DrawLayerRig(Avatar.Wings, ModelRoot * WingsOffset, Visible)
end

const function SetSkull(Avatar: Avatar, Kind: string?, Size: Vector2?)
	if Kind == Avatar.SkullKind and Size == Avatar.SkullSize then
		return
	end

	Avatar.SkullKind = Kind
	Avatar.SkullSize = Size

	if Avatar.Skull then
		DestroyLayerRig(Avatar.Skull)
		Avatar.Skull = nil
		Avatar.SkullLayer = nil
	end

	if Kind and Size then
		const Layer = Models.Layer(Models.Skull.LayerName(Kind))

		Avatar.SkullLayer = Layer
		Avatar.Skull = { Parts = Models.LayerParts(Layer, Size), Scale = StudsPerModelPixel * SkullScale, Texture = nil, Rig = nil, Building = false }
	end
end

const function DrawHead(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar, ModelRoot: CFrame, Visible: boolean)
	const Stack = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "head")
	const Kind, Texture = ItemModels.WornSkull(Stack)
	const Head = HeadFrame(Avatar.Model, ModelRoot, Avatar.Model.Head.XRot)

	SetSkull(Avatar, Kind, if Texture then Texture.Size else nil)

	const Skull = Avatar.Skull
	const SkullLayer = Avatar.SkullLayer

	if Skull and SkullLayer and Kind then
		SetLayerTexture(Avatar, Skull, Texture)
		Models.Skull.Pose(SkullLayer, Kind, Avatar.State.WalkAnimationPos)
		DrawLayerRig(Skull, Head, Visible)
	end

	const ShowsItem = not Kind and not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and not Equipment.ShouldRender(Stack, "head")

	ItemContext.DisplayContext = "head"
	ItemContext.Holder = Entity
	ItemContext.Seed = Entity.Id + HeadOrdinal
	ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, if ShowsItem then Stack else Items.Empty, ItemContext)
	HeldItems.Update(Avatar.HeadItem, ItemState)
	HeldItems.Draw(Avatar.HeadItem, Head * HeadOffset, Visible and ShowsItem)
end

const function UpdateHighlight(Avatar: Avatar, Glowing: boolean)
	if Glowing and not Avatar.Highlight then
		const Created = Instance.new("Highlight")

		Created.FillTransparency = 1
		Created.OutlineTransparency = 0
		Created.OutlineColor = OutlineColor
		Created.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		Created.Adornee = Avatar.Instance
		Created.Parent = Avatar.Instance
		Avatar.Highlight = Created
	elseif not Glowing and Avatar.Highlight then
		Avatar.Highlight:Destroy()
		Avatar.Highlight = nil
	end
end

const function DrawEntity(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Avatar: Avatar, Rig: Rendering.Rig, Partial: number, Hidden: Players.PlayerEntity?)
	const State = Avatar.State
	const BodyRot = ExtractRenderState(Entity, Partial, State)

	Models.Player.SetupAnim(Avatar.Model, State)

	const Position = Entity.PositionO + (Entity.Position - Entity.PositionO) * Partial
	local Root = CFrame.new(Position * StudsPerBlock)

	if State.IsCrouching then
		Root *= CFrame.new(0, CrouchOffset * StudsPerBlock, 0)
	end

	Root *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180 - BodyRot), 0)

	if Entity.DeathTime > 0 then
		const Fall = math.min(1, math.sqrt((Entity.DeathTime + Partial - 1) / 20 * 1.6))

		Root *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(Fall * DeathFlipDegrees))
	end

	if State.IsFallFlying then
		if not Entity.SpinAttack then
			Root *= CFrame.Angles(State.FallFlyingScale * (-90 - State.XRot) * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0)
		end

		Root *= CFrame.Angles(0, State.FlyingYRot, 0)
	elseif State.SwimAmount > 0 then
		const TargetXRot = if State.IsInWater then -90 - State.XRot else -90

		Root *= CFrame.Angles(Mth.Lerp(State.SwimAmount, 0, TargetXRot) * DegreesToRadians, 0, 0)

		if State.IsVisuallySwimming then
			Root *= CFrame.new(0, -StudsPerBlock, 0.3 * StudsPerBlock)
		end
	end

	const ModelRoot = Root * ModelFlip * ModelOffset
	const Viewer = Players.GetLocal()
	const Shown = Entity ~= Hidden
	const LayersVisible = Shown and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator"
	const BodyVisible = Shown and not (Players.IsInvisible(Entity) and not (Viewer and Viewer.GameMode == "spectator"))

	const LayersShown = Rig.LayersShown

	Rig.Visible = BodyVisible or LayersVisible
	LayersShown[1] = BodyVisible

	for Index = 2, #LayersShown do
		LayersShown[Index] = LayersVisible
	end

	Rendering.DrawRig(Rig, ModelRoot, Entity.HurtTime > 0 or Entity.DeathTime > 0)
	DrawWings(Entity, Avatar, ModelRoot, LayersVisible)

	const RightToEye = DrawHand(Entity, Avatar, ModelRoot, true, LayersVisible, Partial)
	const LeftToEye = DrawHand(Entity, Avatar, ModelRoot, false, LayersVisible, Partial)

	DrawHead(Entity, Avatar, ModelRoot, LayersVisible)
	DrawHeldToEye(Entity, Avatar, ModelRoot, if RightToEye then "Right" elseif LeftToEye then "Left" else nil, LayersVisible)

	if Shown and not Players.IsInvisible(Entity) then
		Shadows.Draw(Position, ShadowRadius, 1)
	end

	UpdateHighlight(Avatar, Shown and bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Glowing))
end

const function Draw(Partial: number, Hidden: Players.PlayerEntity?)
	for Entity, Avatar in Avatars do
		if Players.Entities[Entity.Id] ~= Entity then
			DestroyAvatar(Entity, Avatar)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Players.Entities do
		const Avatar = Avatars[Entity] or CreateAvatar(Entity)

		UpdateRig(Entity, Avatar)

		if Avatar.Rig then
			DrawEntity(Entity, Avatar, Avatar.Rig, Partial, Hidden)
		end
	end
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
	CreateRenderState = CreateRenderState,
	ExtractRenderState = ExtractRenderState,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Connection"] = function(require)
    local Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
    local Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
    local Stream = Protocol.CreateStream()

    local function Start(Receive)
        _ClientReceiveHandler = Receive
        while #_ServerToClientQueue > 0 do
            local msg = table.remove(_ServerToClientQueue, 1)
            _ProcessServerToClient(msg)
        end
    end

    local function Flush()
        local Message = Protocol.Flush(Stream)
        if Message then
            _DeliverClientToServer(Message)
        end
    end

    return {
        Stream = Stream,
        Start = Start,
        Flush = Flush,
    }
end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Players"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Containers = require("./Containers")
const Particles = require("./Particles")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")
const LocalPlayer = require("@self/LocalPlayer")
const PlayerEntity = require("@self/PlayerEntity")
const RemotePlayer = require("@self/RemotePlayer")
const Skins = require("./Skins")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Clientbound = Protocol.Clientbound
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const HurtDuration = 10
const DropSwingDuration = 6
const ActivationLength = 40
const DamageCooldownTicks = 20
const DamageWalkSpeed = Minecraft.Mth.Float(1.5)
const TotemEmitterTicks = 30

export type PlayerEntity = PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity

export type PlayerInfo = {
	Name: string,
	GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode,
}

const Generator = Random.new()
const Entities: { [number]: PlayerEntity } = {}
const Info: { [number]: PlayerInfo } = {}
const PoseNames: { [number]: Minecraft.Pose } = {}
const Deltas: { vector } = {}
const Positions: { vector } = {}
const Ticks: { number } = {}
const EquipmentSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = {}
const EquipmentStacks: { Minecraft.ItemStack } = {}
const EffectParticles: { Minecraft.ParticleOptions } = {}
const PendingSounds: { Minecraft.InventorySound } = {}
const SoundRandom = Random.new()

const BreakSlots: { [number]: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = {
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakMainHand] = "mainhand",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakOffHand] = "offhand",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakHead] = "head",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakChest] = "chest",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakLegs] = "legs",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakFeet] = "feet",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakBody] = "body",
	[Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakSaddle] = "saddle",
}
local Local: PlayerEntity? = nil

for Name, Id in Minecraft.Poses do
	PoseNames[Id] = Name :: Minecraft.Pose
end

const function Remote(EntityId: number): PlayerEntity?
	const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

	return if Entity and not Entity.IsLocal then Entity else nil
end

const function Bounds(EntityId: number): (vector?, number, number)
	const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

	if not Entity then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end

	return Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height
end

const function VoicePitch(): number
	return (SoundRandom:NextNumber() - SoundRandom:NextNumber()) * 0.2 + 1
end

const function FindTotem(Entity: PlayerEntity): Minecraft.ItemStack
	for _, Slot in { "mainhand", "offhand" } :: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } do
		const Stack = PlayerEntity.ItemBySlot(Entity, Slot)

		if Minecraft.Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:death_protection") then
			return Stack
		end
	end

	return Minecraft.Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item("minecraft:totem_of_undying"), 1)
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId == Clientbound.Login then
		const EntityId = Protocol.ReadLogin(Reader)
		const Created = LocalPlayer.Create(EntityId, Players.LocalPlayer.Name, Containers.Owner.Inventory)

		Local = Created
		Entities[EntityId] = Created
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.PlayerPosition then
		const TeleportId, Position, YRot, XRot = Protocol.ReadPlayerPosition(Reader)

		if Local then
			LocalPlayer.Teleport(Local, Connection.Stream, TeleportId, Position, YRot, XRot)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.AddEntity then
		const EntityId, Name, Position, YRot, XRot, YHeadRot = Protocol.ReadAddEntity(Reader)

		if not Entities[EntityId] then
			const Created = RemotePlayer.Create(EntityId, Name, Position, YRot, XRot, YHeadRot)
			const Listed = Info[EntityId]

			if Listed then
				Created.GameMode = Listed.GameMode
			end

			Entities[EntityId] = Created
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPos or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPosRot or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityRot then
		const EntityId, StepCount, HasRotation, YRot, XRot, OnGround = Protocol.ReadMoveEntity(Reader, PacketId, Deltas, Ticks)
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		if Entity then
			if PacketId ~= Clientbound.MoveEntityRot then
				RemotePlayer.Move(Entity, StepCount, Deltas, Ticks, HasRotation, YRot, XRot)
			else
				RemotePlayer.Rotate(Entity, YRot, XRot)
			end

			Entity.OnGround = OnGround
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.EntityPositionSync then
