		const EntityId, StepCount, YRot, XRot, OnGround = Protocol.ReadEntityPositionSync(Reader, Positions, Ticks)
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		if Entity then
			RemotePlayer.Sync(Entity, StepCount, Positions, Ticks, YRot, XRot)
			Entity.OnGround = OnGround
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.RotateHead then
		const EntityId, YHeadRot = Protocol.ReadRotateHead(Reader)
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		if Entity then
			RemotePlayer.RotateHead(Entity, YHeadRot)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.GameEvent then
		const Event, Value = Protocol.ReadGameEvent(Reader)

		if Local and Event == Protocol.GameEvents.ArrowHitPlayer then
			Sounds.Play("entity.arrow.hit_player", Local.Position + vector.create(0, Local.EyeHeight, 0), 0.18, 0.45)
		elseif Local and Event == Protocol.GameEvents.ChangeGameMode then
			const GameMode = Protocol.GameModes[Value + 1] :: Minecraft.GameMode

			Local.GameMode = GameMode
			Minecraft.Abilities.ApplyGameMode(Local, GameMode)
			Containers.SetGameMode(GameMode, Local.Instabuild)

			if GameMode == "spectator" then
				Local.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Local.DeltaMovement.x, 0, Local.DeltaMovement.z)
			end
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.PlayerInfoAdd then
		const EntityId, Name, GameMode, Skin = Protocol.ReadPlayerInfoAdd(Reader)

		Skins.Assign(Name, Skin)

		const Listed = { Name = Name, GameMode = Protocol.GameModes[GameMode + 1] :: Minecraft.GameMode }
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		Info[EntityId] = Listed

		if Entity then
			Entity.GameMode = Listed.GameMode
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.PlayerInfoRemove then
		const EntityId = Protocol.ReadPlayerInfoRemove(Reader)
		const Listed = Info[EntityId]

		if Listed then
			Skins.Assign(Listed.Name, nil)
		end

		Info[EntityId] = nil
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.PlayerInfoGameMode then
		const EntityId, GameMode = Protocol.ReadPlayerInfoGameMode(Reader)
		const Listed = Info[EntityId]
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		if Listed then
			Listed.GameMode = Protocol.GameModes[GameMode + 1] :: Minecraft.GameMode
		end

		if Entity and Listed then
			Entity.GameMode = Listed.GameMode
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetCamera then
		const EntityId = Protocol.ReadSetCamera(Reader)

		if Local then
			Local.CameraId = if EntityId == Local.Id then nil else EntityId
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.PlayerAbilities then
		const Flags, FlyingSpeed, WalkingSpeed = Protocol.ReadPlayerAbilities(Reader)

		if Local then
			Minecraft.Abilities.ApplyFlags(Local, Flags)
			Local.FlyingSpeed = FlyingSpeed
			Local.WalkingSpeed = WalkingSpeed
			Containers.SetGameMode(Local.GameMode, Local.Instabuild)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetEquipment then
		const EntityId, Count = Protocol.ReadSetEquipment(Reader, EquipmentSlots, EquipmentStacks)
		const Entity = Remote(EntityId)

		if Entity then
			for Index = 1, Count do
				Entity.Equipment[EquipmentSlots[Index]] = EquipmentStacks[Index]
			end
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.EntityEvent then
		const EntityId, Event = Protocol.ReadEntityEvent(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if not Entity then
			return true
		end

		if Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.SwapHands and not Entity.IsLocal then
			const MainHand = PlayerEntity.ItemBySlot(Entity, "mainhand")

			Entity.Equipment.mainhand = PlayerEntity.ItemBySlot(Entity, "offhand")
			Entity.Equipment.offhand = MainHand
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.UseItemComplete and Entity.IsLocal then
			PlayerEntity.CompleteUsingItem(Entity)
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.KineticHit then
			PlayerEntity.KineticHit(Entity)
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.Death and Entity.IsLocal then
			Sounds.Play("entity.player.death", Entity.Position, 1, VoicePitch())
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.TotemOfUndying then
			Particles.Emit(EntityId, { Type = "totem_of_undying" }, TotemEmitterTicks, Bounds)
			Sounds.Play("item.totem.use", Entity.Position, 1, 1)

			if Entity.IsLocal then
				Entity.ActivationItem = Minecraft.Items.Copy(FindTotem(Entity))
				Entity.ActivationTicks = ActivationLength
				Entity.ActivationOffX = Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) * 2 - 1
				Entity.ActivationOffY = Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) * 2 - 1
			end
		elseif BreakSlots[Event] then
			PlayerEntity.BreakItem(Entity, BreakSlots[Event])
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.Poof then
			Particles.Poof(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height)
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.Drown then
			Particles.Drown(Entity.Position, Entity.DeltaMovement)
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.ChorusTeleport then
			Particles.ChorusTeleport(Entity.PositionO, Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetEntityData then
		const EntityId, SharedFlags, Pose, LivingFlags, Health, ArrowCount, AirSupply, EffectAmbience = Protocol.ReadSetEntityData(Reader, EffectParticles)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity and Entity.IsLocal then
			LocalPlayer.ApplyServerData(Entity, SharedFlags, LivingFlags, AirSupply, EffectParticles, EffectAmbience)
		elseif Entity then
			Entity.EffectParticles = table.clone(EffectParticles)
			Entity.EffectAmbience = EffectAmbience
			const Using = bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.UsingItem)
			const OffHand = bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.OffHand)

			Entity.SharedFlags = SharedFlags
			PlayerEntity.SetPose(Entity, PoseNames[Pose] or "Standing")
			Entity.Health = Health
			Entity.ArrowCount = ArrowCount
			Entity.AirSupply = AirSupply
			Entity.SpinAttack = bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.SpinAttack)
			Entity.OnFire = bit32.btest(SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.OnFire)

			if Using and not Entity.UsingItem then
				PlayerEntity.StartUsingItem(Entity, OffHand)
			elseif not Using and Entity.UsingItem then
				PlayerEntity.StopUsingItem(Entity)
			end
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetHealth then
		const Health, Food, Saturation, Absorption = Protocol.ReadSetHealth(Reader)

		if Local then
			LocalPlayer.HurtTo(Local, Health)
			Local.FoodLevel = Food
			Local.Saturation = Saturation
			Local.Absorption = Absorption
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetExperience then
		const Progress, Level = Protocol.ReadSetExperience(Reader)

		if Local then
			Local.ExperienceProgress = Progress
			Local.ExperienceLevel = Level
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.UpdateMobEffect then
		const EntityId, Effect, Amplifier, Duration, EffectFlags = Protocol.ReadUpdateMobEffect(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity then
			const Previous = Entity.Effects[Effect]
			const Created = Minecraft.Effects.Create(
				Effect,
				Duration,
				Amplifier,
				bit32.btest(EffectFlags, Protocol.EffectFlags.Ambient),
				bit32.btest(EffectFlags, Protocol.EffectFlags.Visible),
				bit32.btest(EffectFlags, Protocol.EffectFlags.ShowIcon)
			)

			if not bit32.btest(EffectFlags, Protocol.EffectFlags.Blend) then
				Minecraft.Effects.SkipBlending(Created)
			elseif Previous then
				Created.BlendFactor = Previous.BlendFactor
				Created.BlendFactorPrevious = Previous.BlendFactorPrevious
			end

			Entity.Effects[Effect] = Created
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.RemoveMobEffect then
		const EntityId, Effect = Protocol.ReadRemoveMobEffect(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity then
			Entity.Effects[Effect] = nil
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.DamageEvent then
		const EntityId, DamageType = Protocol.ReadDamageEvent(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity and Entity.IsLocal then
			Sounds.Play(Minecraft.Damage.PlayerHurtSound(DamageType), Entity.Position, 1, VoicePitch())
		end

		if Entity then
			Entity.WalkSpeed = DamageWalkSpeed
			Entity.DamageCooldownTime = DamageCooldownTicks
			Entity.HurtDuration = HurtDuration
			Entity.HurtTime = HurtDuration
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.HurtAnimation then
		const EntityId, Yaw = Protocol.ReadHurtAnimation(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity then
			Entity.HurtDuration = HurtDuration
			Entity.HurtTime = HurtDuration
			Entity.HurtDir = Yaw
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.Explode then
		const Center, Explosion, Sound, Knockback = Protocol.ReadExplode(Reader)

		Particles.Explode(Center, Explosion, Sound)

		if Local then
			Local.DeltaMovement += Knockback
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetEntityMotion then
		const EntityId, Motion = Protocol.ReadSetEntityMotion(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity then
			Entity.DeltaMovement = Motion
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SwingAnimation then
		const EntityId, OffHand, Type, Duration = Protocol.ReadSwingAnimation(Reader)
		const Entity = Entities[EntityId]

		if Entity then
			PlayerEntity.Swing(Entity, OffHand, Type, Duration)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.Cooldown then
		const Group, Duration = Protocol.ReadCooldown(Reader)

		if Local then
			if Duration == 0 then
				Local.Cooldowns.Groups[Group] = nil
			else
				Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.AddCooldown(Local.Cooldowns, Group, Duration)
			end
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.Respawn then
		if Local then
			LocalPlayer.Respawn(Local)
		end
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function Tick(TouchesLiving: LocalPlayer.LivingToucher)
	if Local then
		for _ = 1, Containers.TakeDropSwings() do
			PlayerEntity.Swing(Local, false, "whack", PlayerEntity.ModifiedSwingDuration(Local, DropSwingDuration))
		end

		for _, Sound in Containers.TakeSounds(PendingSounds) do
			Sounds.Play(Sound.Event, Local.Position, Sound.Volume, Sound.Pitch + SoundRandom:NextNumber() * Sound.PitchSpread)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Entities do
		if Entity.IsLocal then
			LocalPlayer.Tick(Entity, TouchesLiving)
		else
			RemotePlayer.Tick(Entity)
		end
	end

	if Local then
		LocalPlayer.SendChanges(Local, Connection.Stream)

		if Local.ActivationTicks > 0 then
			Local.ActivationTicks -= 1

			if Local.ActivationTicks == 0 then
				Local.ActivationItem = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Remove(EntityId: number)
	const Removed = Entities[EntityId]

	if Removed and not Removed.IsLocal then
		Entities[EntityId] = nil
	end
end

const function GetLocal(): PlayerEntity?
	return Local
end

const function CameraEntity(): PlayerEntity?
	if Local and Local.CameraId then
		return Entities[Local.CameraId] or Local
	end

	return Local
end

const function AdjustFlyingSpeed(Steps: number)
	if Local then
		LocalPlayer.AdjustFlyingSpeed(Local, Steps)
	end
end

const function Turn(MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	if Local then
		LocalPlayer.Turn(Local, MouseX, MouseY)
	end
end

return {
	Entities = Entities,
	Info = Info,
	CameraEntity = CameraEntity,
	Receive = Receive,
	Remove = Remove,
	Tick = Tick,
	GetLocal = GetLocal,
	Turn = Turn,
	AdjustFlyingSpeed = AdjustFlyingSpeed,
	SetKeysEnabled = LocalPlayer.SetKeysEnabled,
	FieldOfViewModifier = LocalPlayer.FieldOfViewModifier,
	AttackStrengthDelay = LocalPlayer.AttackStrengthDelay,
	AttackStrengthScale = LocalPlayer.AttackStrengthScale,
	ItemSwapScale = LocalPlayer.ItemSwapScale,
	ItemBySlot = PlayerEntity.ItemBySlot,
	Swing = PlayerEntity.Swing,
	ModifiedSwingDuration = PlayerEntity.ModifiedSwingDuration,
	SwingProgress = PlayerEntity.SwingProgress,
	StartUsingItem = PlayerEntity.StartUsingItem,
	StopUsingItem = PlayerEntity.StopUsingItem,
	ReleaseUsingItem = LocalPlayer.ReleaseUsingItem,
	WaterVision = LocalPlayer.WaterVision,
	IsSwimming = PlayerEntity.IsSwimming,
	IsVisuallySwimming = PlayerEntity.IsVisuallySwimming,
	SwimAmount = PlayerEntity.SwimAmount,
	TicksUsingItem = PlayerEntity.TicksUsingItem,
	IsDeadOrDying = PlayerEntity.IsDeadOrDying,
	IsInvisible = PlayerEntity.IsInvisible,
	IsFallFlying = PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying,
	IsScoping = PlayerEntity.IsScoping,
	TicksSinceKineticHit = PlayerEntity.TicksSinceKineticHit,
	ItemHeldByArm = PlayerEntity.ItemHeldByArm,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Players/Interpolation"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const CompactionThreshold = 64

export type State = {
	Steps: number,
	Position: vector,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	StepPositions: { vector },
	StepYRots: { number },
	StepXRots: { number },
	StepTicks: { number },
	Head: number,
	Count: number,
	LastStepPosition: vector,
	LastStepYRot: number,
	LastStepXRot: number,
	CurrentStepTicks: number,
	RemainingTicks: number,
	Speed: number,
}

type Mover = {
	Position: vector,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
}

const function Create(Steps: number): State
	return {
		Steps = Steps,
		Position = vector.zero,
		YRot = 0,
		XRot = 0,
		StepPositions = {},
		StepYRots = {},
		StepXRots = {},
		StepTicks = {},
		Head = 1,
		Count = 0,
		LastStepPosition = vector.zero,
		LastStepYRot = 0,
		LastStepXRot = 0,
		CurrentStepTicks = 0,
		RemainingTicks = 0,
		Speed = 1,
	}
end

const function IsActive(State: State): boolean
	return State.Count > 0
end

const function Cancel(State: State)
	State.Head = 1
	State.Count = 0
	State.RemainingTicks = 0
	State.Speed = 1
end

const function AddStep(State: State, Position: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number, Ticks: number)
	if State.Head > CompactionThreshold then
		const Last = State.Head + State.Count - 1

		table.move(State.StepPositions, State.Head, Last, 1)
		table.move(State.StepYRots, State.Head, Last, 1)
		table.move(State.StepXRots, State.Head, Last, 1)
		table.move(State.StepTicks, State.Head, Last, 1)
		State.Head = 1
	end

	const Slot = State.Head + State.Count

	State.StepPositions[Slot] = Position
	State.StepYRots[Slot] = YRot
	State.StepXRots[Slot] = XRot
	State.StepTicks[Slot] = Ticks
	State.Count += 1
	State.RemainingTicks += Ticks
end

const function InterpolateTo(State: State, Mover: Mover, StepCount: number, Positions: { vector }, Ticks: { number }, HasRotation: boolean, RequestedYRot: number, RequestedXRot: number)
	const Active = IsActive(State)
	const End = Positions[math.max(StepCount, 1)]
	const YRot = if HasRotation then RequestedYRot elseif Active then State.YRot else Mover.YRot
	const XRot = if HasRotation then RequestedXRot elseif Active then State.XRot else Mover.XRot

	if Active and State.Position == End and State.YRot == YRot and State.XRot == XRot then
		return
	end

	if not Active then
		State.LastStepPosition = Mover.Position
		State.LastStepYRot = Mover.YRot
		State.LastStepXRot = Mover.XRot
		State.CurrentStepTicks = 1
	end

	if End == State.Position or StepCount == 0 then
		AddStep(State, End, YRot, XRot, State.Steps)
	elseif YRot == State.YRot and XRot == State.XRot then
		for Index = 1, StepCount do
			AddStep(State, Positions[Index], YRot, XRot, Ticks[Index])
		end
	else
		local TotalTicks = 0

		for Index = 1, StepCount do
			TotalTicks += Ticks[Index]
		end

		local Offset = 0

		for Index = 1, StepCount do
			Offset += Ticks[Index]

			const Alpha = Offset / TotalTicks

			AddStep(State, Positions[Index], Mth.RotLerp(Alpha, State.YRot, YRot), Mth.Lerp(Alpha, State.XRot, XRot), Ticks[Index])
		end
	end

	State.Position = End
	State.YRot = YRot
	State.XRot = XRot
end

const function Advance(State: State)
	const TargetSpeed = math.max(State.RemainingTicks / State.Steps, 1)
	local Ticks = 1

	State.Speed = Mth.Lerp(1 / State.Steps, State.Speed, TargetSpeed)

	if Ticks * State.Speed < State.RemainingTicks then
		Ticks *= State.Speed
	else
		Ticks = State.RemainingTicks
		State.Speed = 1
	end

	State.CurrentStepTicks += Ticks
	State.RemainingTicks -= Ticks
end

const function Interpolate(State: State, Mover: Mover)
	if not IsActive(State) then
		Cancel(State)
		return
	end

	while State.Count > 0 do
		const Head = State.Head
		const Ticks = State.StepTicks[Head]

		if State.CurrentStepTicks < Ticks then
			const Alpha = State.CurrentStepTicks / Ticks

			Mover.Position = State.LastStepPosition + (State.StepPositions[Head] - State.LastStepPosition) * Alpha
			Mover.YRot = Mth.RotLerp(Alpha, State.LastStepYRot, State.StepYRots[Head])
			Mover.XRot = Mth.Lerp(Alpha, State.LastStepXRot, State.StepXRots[Head])
			Advance(State)
			return
		end

		State.CurrentStepTicks -= Ticks
		State.LastStepPosition = State.StepPositions[Head]
		State.LastStepYRot = State.StepYRots[Head]
		State.LastStepXRot = State.StepXRots[Head]
		State.Head += 1
		State.Count -= 1
	end

	Mover.Position = State.Position
	Mover.YRot = State.YRot
	Mover.XRot = State.XRot
	Advance(State)

	if State.Count == 0 then
		State.Head = 1
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	IsActive = IsActive,
	Cancel = Cancel,
	InterpolateTo = InterpolateTo,
	Interpolate = Interpolate,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Players/LocalPlayer"] = function(require)

const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Sounds = require("../Sounds")
const PlayerEntity = require("./PlayerEntity")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Flags = Protocol.InputFlags
const EntityPhysics = Minecraft.Entity

const InputScale = Mth.Float(0.98)
const SlowFallingGravity = 0.01
const LevitationSpeed = 0.05
const LevitationFactor = 0.2
const JumpBoostPerLevel = Mth.Float(0.1)
const BowZoomTicks = 20
const BowZoomScale = Mth.Float(0.15)
const ScopeFieldOfView = Mth.Float(0.1)
const SprintFoodLevel = 6
const HurtDurationTicks = 10
const HurtCooldownTicks = 20
const HealCooldownTicks = 10
const AirDrag = Mth.Float(1 - Mth.Float(1 - Mth.Float(0.91)))
const VerticalDrag = Mth.Float(1 - Mth.Float(1 - Mth.Float(0.98)))
const DefaultFriction = Mth.Float(0.6)
const FrictionSpeedScale = Mth.Float(0.21600002)
const AirSpeed = Mth.Float(0.02)
const SprintingAirSpeed = Mth.Float(0.025999999)
const SprintJumpBoost = 0.2
const FlightDamping = 0.6
const MinorCollisionAngle = Mth.Float(0.13962634)
const WalkDistanceScale = Mth.Float(0.6)
const MouseTurnScale = Mth.Float(0.15)
const ArmLagFactor = Mth.Float(0.5)
const MinimumInput = 1.0E-7
const MinimumImpulse = Mth.Float(1.0E-5)
const HorizontalRestThreshold = 9.0E-6
const VerticalRestThreshold = 0.003
const PoseDeflation = 1.0E-7
const MovementReminderTicks = 20
const MovementThresholdSquared = 2.0E-4 * 2.0E-4
const SprintWindow = 7
const JumpTriggerWindow = 7
const NoJumpDelayTicks = 10
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const GlideHorizontalDrag = Mth.Float(0.99)
const GlideVerticalDrag = Mth.Float(0.98)
const GlideFallDistanceCap = 1
const GlideFallSpeed = -0.5
const ServerOwnedFlags = bit32.bnot(bit32.bor(Minecraft.SharedFlags.Shift, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting))
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const MaxAirSupply = 300
const WaterSlowDown = Mth.Float(0.8)
const BigFallDamage = 4
const LegacyOnOffset = vector.create(0, 0.2, 0)
const SwimVolumeScale = 0.35
const SoundRandom = Random.new()
const SprintingWaterSlowDown = Mth.Float(0.9)
const DepthStriderSlowDown = Mth.Float(0.54600006)
const DolphinsGraceSlowDown = Mth.Float(0.96)
const FluidSpeed = Mth.Float(0.02)
const FluidVerticalDrag = Mth.Float(0.8)
const LavaDrag = 0.5
const FluidJumpImpulse = Mth.Float(0.04)
const FluidRestSpeed = 0.005
const FluidRestTolerance = 0.003
const FluidSinkFraction = 16
const FluidExitHeight = Mth.Float(0.6)
const FluidExitSpeed = Mth.Float(0.3)
const SwimDiveLook = -0.2
const SwimDiveFactor = 0.085
const SwimFactor = 0.06
const SwimSurfaceHeight = 1.0 - 0.1
const WaterVisionMax = 600
const WaterVisionFade = 10
const WaterVisionRise = 100
const RiptideThreshold = 10
const RiptideTicks = 20
const RiptideLift = Mth.Float(1.1999999)
const SpinBounce = -0.2

type PlayerEntity = PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity

export type LivingToucher = (Min: vector, Max: vector) -> boolean

local KeysEnabled = true
local FlashOnSetHealth = false

const function IsDown(Entity: PlayerEntity, Flag: number): boolean
	return bit32.btest(Entity.KeyPresses, Flag)
end

const function HasForwardImpulse(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.MoveY > MinimumImpulse
end

const function Impulse(Positive: boolean, Negative: boolean): number
	return if Positive == Negative then 0 elseif Positive then 1 else -1
end

const function PollInput(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	local Pressed = 0
	local mobileX = 0
	local mobileY = 0
	local mobileJump = false

	if KeysEnabled and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
			Pressed += Flags.Forward
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
			Pressed += Flags.Backward
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
			Pressed += Flags.Left
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
			Pressed += Flags.Right
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
			Pressed += Flags.Jump
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
			Pressed += Flags.Shift
		end

		local sprintPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
			or (sprintPlayer and sprintPlayer:GetAttribute("MinecraftMobileSprint") == true) then
			Pressed += Flags.Sprint
		end

		local moveVec = Vector3.zero
		local RobloxPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
		if RobloxPlayer then
			local pScripts = RobloxPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerScripts")
			if pScripts then
				local pMod = pScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
				if pMod then
					local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return require(pMod):GetControls() end)
					if ok and ctrl and ctrl.GetMoveVector then
						pcall(function() moveVec = ctrl:GetMoveVector() end)
					end
				end
			end
			if RobloxPlayer.Character then
				local hum = RobloxPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum then
					if hum.Jump then mobileJump = true end

					if moveVec.Magnitude < 0.05 then
						local worldMove = hum.MoveDirection
						local yaw = math.rad(Entity.YRot)
						local sine, cosine = math.sin(yaw), math.cos(yaw)
						moveVec = Vector3.new(
							worldMove.X * cosine + worldMove.Z * sine,
							0,
							-worldMove.X * sine + worldMove.Z * cosine
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if moveVec.Magnitude >= 0.05 then

			mobileX = moveVec.X
			mobileY = moveVec.Z
			if mobileY > 0.2 then Pressed += Flags.Forward end
			if mobileY < -0.2 then Pressed += Flags.Backward end
			if mobileX > 0.2 then Pressed += Flags.Left end
			if mobileX < -0.2 then Pressed += Flags.Right end
		end
		if mobileJump then
			Pressed += Flags.Jump
		end
	end

	Entity.KeyPresses = Pressed

	local Left = Impulse(IsDown(Entity, Flags.Left), IsDown(Entity, Flags.Right))
	local Forward = Impulse(IsDown(Entity, Flags.Forward), IsDown(Entity, Flags.Backward))
	if math.abs(mobileX) > 0.05 or math.abs(mobileY) > 0.05 then
		Left = mobileX
		Forward = mobileY
	end

	local Length = Mth.Float(math.sqrt(Left * Left + Forward * Forward))

	if Length < Mth.Float(1.0E-4) then
		Entity.MoveX = 0
		Entity.MoveY = 0
	elseif Length > 1 then
		Entity.MoveX = Mth.Float(Left / Length)
		Entity.MoveY = Mth.Float(Forward / Length)
	else
		Entity.MoveX = Mth.Float(Left)
		Entity.MoveY = Mth.Float(Forward)
	end
end

const function SetSprinting(Entity: PlayerEntity, Sprinting: boolean)
	if Sprinting then
		Entity.SharedFlags = bit32.bor(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting)
	else
		Entity.SharedFlags = bit32.band(Entity.SharedFlags, bit32.bnot(Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting))
	end
end

const function AttributeValue(Entity: PlayerEntity, Id: string): number
	return Minecraft.Attributes.Value(Id, Entity.Inventory, Entity.Effects)
end

const function MovementSpeed(Entity: PlayerEntity): number
	return Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.MovementSpeed(Entity.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory, Entity.Effects, PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity))
end

const function IsSlowDueToUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.UsingItem and not Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CanSprintWhileUsing(Entity.UseItem)
end

const function CanFit(Entity: PlayerEntity, Pose: Minecraft.Pose): boolean
	const Dimensions = EntityPhysics.PlayerDimensions[Pose]
	const Min, Max = EntityPhysics.BoxAt(Entity.Position, Dimensions.Width, Dimensions.Height)
	const Deflation = vector.one * PoseDeflation

	return Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min + Deflation, Max - Deflation)
end

const function IsMovingSlowly(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.Crouching or PlayerEntity.IsVisuallyCrawling(Entity)
end

const function IsInShallowWater(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity) and not PlayerEntity.IsUnderWater(Entity)
end

const function IsSprintingPossible(Entity: PlayerEntity, AllowedInShallowWater: boolean): boolean
	return not Entity.Effects["minecraft:blindness"] and (Entity.FoodLevel > SprintFoodLevel or Entity.MayFly) and (AllowedInShallowWater or not IsInShallowWater(Entity))
end

const function CanStartSprinting(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return not PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity)
		and HasForwardImpulse(Entity)
		and IsSprintingPossible(Entity, Entity.Flying)
		and not IsSlowDueToUsingItem(Entity)
		and (not PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying(Entity) or PlayerEntity.IsUnderWater(Entity))
		and (not IsMovingSlowly(Entity) or PlayerEntity.IsUnderWater(Entity))
end

const function CanGlide(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CanGlide(Entity.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory, Entity.OnGround, Entity.Flying, Entity.Effects["minecraft:levitation"] ~= nil)
end

const function TryToStartFallFlying(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	if PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying(Entity) or not CanGlide(Entity) or EntityPhysics.IsInLiquid(Entity) then
		return false
	end

	Entity.SharedFlags = bit32.bor(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying)

	return true
end

const function ShouldStopRunSprinting(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return not IsSprintingPossible(Entity, Entity.Flying) or not HasForwardImpulse(Entity) or Entity.HorizontalCollision and not Entity.MinorHorizontalCollision
end

const function ShouldStopSwimSprinting(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return not IsSprintingPossible(Entity, true)
		or not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity)
		or not HasForwardImpulse(Entity) and not Entity.OnGround and not IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift)
end

const function ModifyInput(Entity: PlayerEntity): (number, number)
	local X = Entity.MoveX
	local Y = Entity.MoveY

	if X * X + Y * Y == 0 then
		return 0, 0
	end

	X = Mth.Float(X * InputScale)
	Y = Mth.Float(Y * InputScale)

	if Entity.UsingItem then
		const UseSpeed = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.UseSpeedMultiplier(Entity.UseItem)

		X = Mth.Float(X * UseSpeed)
		Y = Mth.Float(Y * UseSpeed)
	end

	if IsMovingSlowly(Entity) then
		const SneakingSpeed = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:sneaking_speed"))

		X = Mth.Float(X * SneakingSpeed)
		Y = Mth.Float(Y * SneakingSpeed)
	end

	const Length = Mth.Float(math.sqrt(X * X + Y * Y))

	if Length <= 0 then
		return X, Y
	end

	const DirectionX = Mth.Float(X / Length)
	const DirectionY = Mth.Float(Y / Length)
	const AbsoluteX = math.abs(DirectionX)
	const AbsoluteY = math.abs(DirectionY)
	const Tangent = if AbsoluteY > AbsoluteX then AbsoluteX / AbsoluteY else AbsoluteY / AbsoluteX
	const DistanceToUnitSquare = Mth.Float(math.sqrt(1 + Tangent * Tangent))
	const ModifiedLength = math.min(Mth.Float(Length * DistanceToUnitSquare), 1)

	return Mth.Float(DirectionX * ModifiedLength), Mth.Float(DirectionY * ModifiedLength)
end

const function MoveRelative(Entity: PlayerEntity, Speed: number, Input: vector)
	const LengthSquared = vector.dot(Input, Input)

	if LengthSquared < MinimumInput then
		return
	end

	const Movement = (if LengthSquared > 1 then Mth.Normalize(Input) else Input) * Speed
	const Angle = Mth.Float(Entity.YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Sine = Mth.Sin(Angle)
	const Cosine = Mth.Cos(Angle)

	Entity.DeltaMovement += vector.create(Movement.x * Cosine - Movement.z * Sine, Movement.y, Movement.z * Cosine + Movement.x * Sine)
end

const function IsHorizontalCollisionMinor(Entity: PlayerEntity, Movement: vector): boolean
	const Angle = Mth.Float(Entity.YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Sine = Mth.Sin(Angle)
	const Cosine = Mth.Cos(Angle)
	const GlobalX = Entity.Xxa * Cosine - Entity.Zza * Sine
	const GlobalZ = Entity.Zza * Cosine + Entity.Xxa * Sine
	const InputLengthSquared = GlobalX * GlobalX + GlobalZ * GlobalZ
	const MovementLengthSquared = Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z

	if InputLengthSquared < MinimumImpulse or MovementLengthSquared < MinimumImpulse then
		return false
	end

	const Dot = GlobalX * Movement.x + GlobalZ * Movement.z

	return math.acos(math.clamp(Dot / math.sqrt(InputLengthSquared * MovementLengthSquared), -1, 1)) < MinorCollisionAngle
end

const function FallSounds(Entity: PlayerEntity, FallDistance: number)
	if Entity.MayFly then
		return
	end

	const Amount = ((FallDistance + 1.0E-6 - AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:safe_fall_distance")) * AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:fall_damage_multiplier")) // 1

	if Amount <= 0 then
		return
	end

	Sounds.Play(if Amount > BigFallDamage then "entity.player.big_fall" else "entity.player.small_fall", Entity.Position, 1, 1)

	const Landed = EntityPhysics.BlockAt(Entity.Position - LegacyOnOffset)

	if Landed then
		const Sound = Minecraft.BlockSounds[Landed.Id]

		Sounds.Play(Sound.Fall, Entity.Position, Sound.Volume * 0.5, Sound.Pitch * 0.75)
	end
end

const function StepSounds(Entity: PlayerEntity, Movement: vector)
	if Entity.NoPhysics or Entity.Flying or Entity.OnGround and IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift) then
		return
	end

	const Stepped, Swim = EntityPhysics.StepEmission(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Movement, Entity, Entity.OnGround, Entity.Pose == "Crouching", PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity), EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity))

	if Stepped then
		const Sound = Minecraft.BlockSounds[Stepped.Id]

		Sounds.Play(Sound.Step, Entity.Position, Sound.Volume * 0.15, Sound.Pitch)
	elseif Swim then
		const Motion = Entity.DeltaMovement
		const Speed = math.min(1, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x * 0.2 + Motion.y * Motion.y + Motion.z * Motion.z * 0.2) * SwimVolumeScale)

		Sounds.Play("entity.player.swim", Entity.Position, Speed, 1 + (SoundRandom:NextNumber() - SoundRandom:NextNumber()) * 0.4)
	end
end

const function Move(Entity: PlayerEntity, Delta: vector)
	const Previous = Entity.Position
	const FallDistance = Entity.FallDistance

	Entity.SteppingCarefully = not Entity.Flying and IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift)

	const Movement = EntityPhysics.Move(Entity, Delta, true)

	if Entity.OnGround and FallDistance > 0 then
		FallSounds(Entity, FallDistance)
	end

	StepSounds(Entity, Movement)

	Entity.MinorHorizontalCollision = Entity.HorizontalCollision and IsHorizontalCollisionMinor(Entity, Movement)

	const MovedX = Mth.Float(Entity.Position.x - Previous.x)
	const MovedZ = Mth.Float(Entity.Position.z - Previous.z)

	Entity.WalkDist += Mth.Float(Mth.Float(math.sqrt(MovedX * MovedX + MovedZ * MovedZ)) * WalkDistanceScale)
end

const function JumpFromGround(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Block = EntityPhysics.SupportingBlock(Entity)
	const JumpBoost = Entity.Effects["minecraft:jump_boost"]
	const BoostPower = if JumpBoost then Mth.Float(JumpBoostPerLevel * (JumpBoost.Amplifier + 1)) else 0
	const JumpPower = Mth.Float(Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:jump_strength")) * (if Block then Block.JumpFactor else 1) + BoostPower)

	if JumpPower <= MinimumImpulse then
		return
	end

	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement

	Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x, math.max(JumpPower, Movement.y), Movement.z)

	if PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then
		const Angle = Mth.Float(Entity.YRot * DegreesToRadians)

		Entity.DeltaMovement += vector.create(-Mth.Sin(Angle) * SprintJumpBoost, 0, Mth.Cos(Angle) * SprintJumpBoost)
	end
end

const function EffectiveGravity(Entity: PlayerEntity, MovementY: number): number
	const Gravity = AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:gravity")

	return if MovementY <= 0 and Entity.Effects["minecraft:slow_falling"] then math.min(Gravity, SlowFallingGravity) else Gravity
end

const function FallFlyingMovement(Entity: PlayerEntity, Movement: vector): vector
	const Look = Minecraft.Projectile.ViewDirection(Entity.XRot, Entity.YRot, 0)
	const Lean = Mth.Float(Entity.XRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const LookHorizontal = math.sqrt(Look.x * Look.x + Look.z * Look.z)
	const MoveHorizontal = math.sqrt(Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z)
	const Lift = math.cos(Lean) * math.cos(Lean)
	local X = Movement.x
	local Y = Movement.y + EffectiveGravity(Entity, Movement.y) * (-1 + Lift * 0.75)
	local Z = Movement.z

	if Y < 0 and LookHorizontal > 0 then
		const Convert = Y * -0.1 * Lift

		X += Look.x * Convert / LookHorizontal
		Y += Convert
		Z += Look.z * Convert / LookHorizontal
	end

	if Lean < 0 and LookHorizontal > 0 then
		const Convert = MoveHorizontal * -Mth.Sin(Lean) * 0.04

		X += -Look.x * Convert / LookHorizontal
		Y += Convert * 3.2
		Z += -Look.z * Convert / LookHorizontal
	end

	if LookHorizontal > 0 then
		X += (Look.x / LookHorizontal * MoveHorizontal - X) * 0.1
		Z += (Look.z / LookHorizontal * MoveHorizontal - Z) * 0.1
	end

	return vector.create(X * GlideHorizontalDrag, Y * GlideVerticalDrag, Z * GlideHorizontalDrag)
end

const function TravelFallFlying(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.DeltaMovement = FallFlyingMovement(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement)
	Move(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement)
end

const function TravelInAir(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector)
	local BlockFriction = 1

	if Entity.OnGround then
		const Block = EntityPhysics.SupportingBlock(Entity)
		const Friction = if Block then Block.Friction else DefaultFriction

		BlockFriction = Mth.Float(1 - Mth.Float(1 - Friction))
	end

	local Speed: number

	if not Entity.OnGround then
		Speed = if Entity.Flying
			then (if PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then Mth.Float(Entity.FlyingSpeed * 2) else Entity.FlyingSpeed)
			elseif PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then SprintingAirSpeed
			else AirSpeed
	elseif BlockFriction > DefaultFriction then
		Speed = Mth.Float(MovementSpeed(Entity) * Mth.Float(FrictionSpeedScale / Mth.Float(BlockFriction * BlockFriction * BlockFriction)))
	else
		Speed = MovementSpeed(Entity)
	end

	MoveRelative(Entity, Speed, Input)
	Move(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement)

	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement
	const Friction = Mth.Float(BlockFriction * AirDrag)
	const Levitation = Entity.Effects["minecraft:levitation"]
	local MovementY = Movement.y

	if Levitation then
		MovementY += (LevitationSpeed * (Levitation.Amplifier + 1) - Movement.y) * LevitationFactor
	else
		MovementY -= EffectiveGravity(Entity, Movement.y)
	end

	Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x * Friction, MovementY * VerticalDrag, Movement.z * Friction)
end

const function FluidFallingAdjustedMovement(Entity: PlayerEntity, Gravity: number, Falling: boolean, Movement: vector): vector
	if Gravity == 0 or PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then
		return Movement
	end

	const Resting = Falling and math.abs(Movement.y - FluidRestSpeed) >= FluidRestTolerance and math.abs(Movement.y - Gravity / FluidSinkFraction) < FluidRestTolerance

	return vector.create(Movement.x, if Resting then -FluidRestTolerance else Movement.y - Gravity / FluidSinkFraction, Movement.z)
end

const function JumpOutOfFluid(Entity: PlayerEntity, OldY: number)
	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement

	if Entity.HorizontalCollision and EntityPhysics.IsFree(Entity, vector.create(Movement.x, Movement.y + FluidExitHeight - Entity.Position.y + OldY, Movement.z)) then
		Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x, FluidExitSpeed, Movement.z)
	end
end

const function TravelInWater(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector, Gravity: number, Falling: boolean, OldY: number)
	local SlowDown = if PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then SprintingWaterSlowDown else WaterSlowDown
	local Speed = FluidSpeed
	local WaterWalker = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:water_movement_efficiency"))

	if not Entity.OnGround then
		WaterWalker = Mth.Float(WaterWalker * 0.5)
	end

	if WaterWalker > 0 then
		SlowDown = Mth.Float(SlowDown + (DepthStriderSlowDown - SlowDown) * WaterWalker)
		Speed = Mth.Float(Speed + (Mth.Float(MovementSpeed(Entity)) - Speed) * WaterWalker)
	end

	if Entity.Effects["minecraft:dolphins_grace"] then
		SlowDown = DolphinsGraceSlowDown
	end

	MoveRelative(Entity, Speed, Input)
	Move(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement)
	Entity.DeltaMovement = FluidFallingAdjustedMovement(Entity, Gravity, Falling, Entity.DeltaMovement * vector.create(SlowDown, FluidVerticalDrag, SlowDown))
	JumpOutOfFluid(Entity, OldY)
end

const function TravelInLava(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector, Gravity: number, Falling: boolean, OldY: number)
	MoveRelative(Entity, FluidSpeed, Input)
	Move(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement)

	if Entity.Fluid.LavaHeight <= EntityPhysics.FluidJumpThreshold(Entity) then
		Entity.DeltaMovement = FluidFallingAdjustedMovement(Entity, Gravity, Falling, Entity.DeltaMovement * vector.create(LavaDrag, FluidVerticalDrag, LavaDrag))
	else
		Entity.DeltaMovement *= LavaDrag
	end

	if Gravity ~= 0 then
		Entity.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Gravity / 4, 0)
	end

	JumpOutOfFluid(Entity, OldY)
end

const function TravelInFluid(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector)
	const Falling = Entity.DeltaMovement.y <= 0
	const OldY = Entity.Position.y
	const Gravity = EffectiveGravity(Entity, Entity.DeltaMovement.y)

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity) then
		TravelInWater(Entity, Input, Gravity, Falling, OldY)
	else
		TravelInLava(Entity, Input, Gravity, Falling, OldY)
	end
end

const function LivingTravel(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector)
	if EntityPhysics.IsInLiquid(Entity) and not Entity.Flying then
		TravelInFluid(Entity, Input)
	elseif PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying(Entity) then
		TravelFallFlying(Entity)
	else
		TravelInAir(Entity, Input)
	end
end

const function Travel(Entity: PlayerEntity, Input: vector)
	if PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity) then
		const LookY = Minecraft.Projectile.ViewDirection(Entity.XRot, Entity.YRot, 0).y
		const Factor = if LookY < SwimDiveLook then SwimDiveFactor else SwimFactor
		const Position = Entity.Position

		if LookY <= 0 or Entity.Jumping or EntityPhysics.FluidAt(vector.create(Position.x, Position.y + SwimSurfaceHeight, Position.z)) then
			const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement

			Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x, Movement.y + (LookY - Movement.y) * Factor, Movement.z)
		end
	end

	if Entity.Flying then
		const OriginalY = Entity.DeltaMovement.y

		LivingTravel(Entity, Input)
		Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Entity.DeltaMovement.x, OriginalY * FlightDamping, Entity.DeltaMovement.z)
	else
		LivingTravel(Entity, Input)
	end
end

const function CheckAutoSpinAttack(Entity: PlayerEntity, OldMin: vector, OldMax: vector, TouchesLiving: LivingToucher)
	const Min, Max = EntityPhysics.Box(Entity)

	if TouchesLiving(vector.min(OldMin, Min), vector.max(OldMax, Max)) then
		Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
		Entity.DeltaMovement *= SpinBounce
	elseif Entity.HorizontalCollision then
		Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
	end
end

const function LivingAiStep(Entity: PlayerEntity, TouchesLiving: LivingToucher)
	if Entity.NoJumpDelay > 0 then
		Entity.NoJumpDelay -= 1
	end

	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement
	local RestX = Movement.x
	local RestY = Movement.y
	local RestZ = Movement.z

	if Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z < HorizontalRestThreshold then
		RestX = 0
		RestZ = 0
	end

	if math.abs(Movement.y) < VerticalRestThreshold then
		RestY = 0
	end

	Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(RestX, RestY, RestZ)
	Minecraft.Inventory.TickEquipment(Entity.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory)
	if Entity.CameraId == nil then
		Entity.Xxa, Entity.Zza = ModifyInput(Entity)
		Entity.Jumping = IsDown(Entity, Flags.Jump)
	else
		Entity.Xxa = Mth.Float(Entity.Xxa * InputScale)
		Entity.Zza = Mth.Float(Entity.Zza * InputScale)
	end

	if PlayerEntity.IsDeadOrDying(Entity) then
		Entity.Jumping = false
		Entity.Xxa = 0
		Entity.Zza = 0
	end
	Entity.YBobO = Entity.YBob
	Entity.XBobO = Entity.XBob
	Entity.XBob = Mth.Float(Entity.XBob + (Entity.XRot - Entity.XBob) * ArmLagFactor)
	Entity.YBob = Mth.Float(Entity.YBob + (Entity.YRot - Entity.YBob) * ArmLagFactor)

	if Entity.Jumping and not Entity.Flying then
		const InLava = EntityPhysics.IsInLava(Entity)
		const FluidHeight = if InLava then Entity.Fluid.LavaHeight else Entity.Fluid.WaterHeight
		const InWaterWithHeight = EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity) and FluidHeight > 0
		const Threshold = EntityPhysics.FluidJumpThreshold(Entity)

		if InWaterWithHeight and not (Entity.OnGround and FluidHeight <= Threshold) then
			Entity.DeltaMovement += vector.create(0, FluidJumpImpulse, 0)
		elseif InLava and not (Entity.OnGround and Entity.Fluid.LavaHeight <= Threshold) then
			Entity.DeltaMovement += vector.create(0, FluidJumpImpulse, 0)
		elseif (Entity.OnGround or InWaterWithHeight and FluidHeight <= Threshold) and Entity.NoJumpDelay == 0 then
			JumpFromGround(Entity)
			Entity.NoJumpDelay = NoJumpDelayTicks
		end
	else
		Entity.NoJumpDelay = 0
	end

	if PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying(Entity) and Entity.DeltaMovement.y > GlideFallSpeed and Entity.FallDistance > GlideFallDistanceCap then
		Entity.FallDistance = GlideFallDistanceCap
	end

	if Entity.Effects["minecraft:slow_falling"] or Entity.Effects["minecraft:levitation"] then
		Entity.FallDistance = 0
	end

	const OldMin, OldMax = EntityPhysics.Box(Entity)

	Travel(Entity, vector.create(Entity.Xxa, 0, Entity.Zza))

	if Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks > 0 then
		Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks -= 1
		CheckAutoSpinAttack(Entity, OldMin, OldMax, TouchesLiving)
	end

	PlayerEntity.UpdateWalkAnimation(Entity)
end

const function AiStep(Entity: PlayerEntity, TouchesLiving: LivingToucher)
	if Entity.SprintTriggerTime > 0 then
		Entity.SprintTriggerTime -= 1
	end

	const WasJumping = IsDown(Entity, Flags.Jump)
	const WasShiftKeyDown = IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift)
	const HadForwardImpulse = HasForwardImpulse(Entity)

	Entity.Crouching = not Entity.Flying and not PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity) and CanFit(Entity, "Crouching") and (WasShiftKeyDown or not CanFit(Entity, "Standing"))
	PollInput(Entity)

	if WasShiftKeyDown or IsDown(Entity, Flags.Backward) then
		Entity.SprintTriggerTime = 0
	end

	if CanStartSprinting(Entity) then
		if not HadForwardImpulse then
			if Entity.SprintTriggerTime > 0 then
				SetSprinting(Entity, true)
			else
				Entity.SprintTriggerTime = SprintWindow
			end
		end

		if IsDown(Entity, Flags.Sprint) then
			SetSprinting(Entity, true)
		end
	end

	if PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) then
		if PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity) then
			if ShouldStopSwimSprinting(Entity) then
				SetSprinting(Entity, false)
			end
		elseif ShouldStopRunSprinting(Entity) then
			SetSprinting(Entity, false)
		end
	end

	local JustToggledCreativeFlight = false

	if Entity.MayFly and Entity.GameMode == "spectator" then
		if not Entity.Flying then
			Entity.Flying = true
			Entity.AbilitiesChanged = true
			JustToggledCreativeFlight = true
		end
	elseif Entity.MayFly and not WasJumping and IsDown(Entity, Flags.Jump) then
		if Entity.JumpTriggerTime == 0 then
			Entity.JumpTriggerTime = JumpTriggerWindow
		elseif not PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity) then
			Entity.Flying = not Entity.Flying
			Entity.AbilitiesChanged = true

			if Entity.Flying and Entity.OnGround then
				JumpFromGround(Entity)
			end

			JustToggledCreativeFlight = true
			Entity.JumpTriggerTime = 0
		end
	end

	if IsDown(Entity, Flags.Jump) and not JustToggledCreativeFlight and not WasJumping and TryToStartFallFlying(Entity) then
		Entity.FallFlyingRequested = true
	end

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity) and IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift) and not Entity.Flying then
		Entity.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, FluidJumpImpulse, 0)
	end

	if Entity.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		Entity.WaterVisionTime = math.clamp(Entity.WaterVisionTime + (if Entity.GameMode == "spectator" then WaterVisionFade else 1), 0, WaterVisionMax)
	elseif Entity.WaterVisionTime > 0 then
		Entity.WaterVisionTime = math.clamp(Entity.WaterVisionTime - WaterVisionFade, 0, WaterVisionMax)
	end

	if Entity.Flying and Entity.CameraId == nil then
		const Vertical = (if IsDown(Entity, Flags.Jump) then 1 else 0) - (if IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift) then 1 else 0)

		if Vertical ~= 0 then
			Entity.DeltaMovement += vector.create(0, Vertical * Mth.Float(Entity.FlyingSpeed * 3), 0)
		end
	end

	PlayerEntity.UpdateBob(Entity)

	if Entity.JumpTriggerTime > 0 then
		Entity.JumpTriggerTime -= 1
	end

	Minecraft.Inventory.Tick(Entity.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory)

	if Entity.Flying then
		Entity.FallDistance = 0
	end

	LivingAiStep(Entity, TouchesLiving)
	Entity.YHeadRot = Entity.YRot

	if Entity.OnGround and Entity.Flying and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		Entity.Flying = false
		Entity.AbilitiesChanged = true
	end
end

const function UpdatePose(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if not CanFit(Entity, "Swimming") then
		return
	end

	const Desired: Minecraft.Pose = if PlayerEntity.IsSwimming(Entity)
		then "Swimming"
		elseif PlayerEntity.IsFallFlying(Entity) then "FallFlying"
		elseif Entity.SpinAttack then "SpinAttack"
		elseif IsDown(Entity, Flags.Shift) and not Entity.Flying then "Crouching"
		else "Standing"
	const Actual: Minecraft.Pose = if CanFit(Entity, Desired) then Desired elseif CanFit(Entity, "Crouching") then "Crouching" else "Swimming"

	if Actual ~= Entity.Pose then
		PlayerEntity.SetPose(Entity, Actual)
	end
end

const function TickAttackStrength(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const MainHand = Minecraft.Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Entity.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory)

	Entity.AttackStrengthTicker += 1
	Entity.ItemSwapTicker += 1

	if not Minecraft.Items.Matches(Entity.LastItemInMainHand, MainHand) then
		if not Minecraft.Items.IsSameItem(Entity.LastItemInMainHand, MainHand) then
			Entity.AttackStrengthTicker = 0
			Entity.ItemSwapTicker = 0
		end

		Entity.LastItemInMainHand = Minecraft.Items.Copy(MainHand)
	end
end

const function AttackStrengthDelay(Entity: PlayerEntity): number
	return Mth.Float(1 / AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:attack_speed") * TicksPerSecond)
end

const function AttackStrengthScale(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	return Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float((Entity.AttackStrengthTicker + Partial) / AttackStrengthDelay(Entity)), 0, 1)
end

const function ItemSwapScale(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	return Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float((Entity.ItemSwapTicker + Partial) / AttackStrengthDelay(Entity)), 0, 1)
end

const function Create(Id: number, Name: string, Inventory: Minecraft.Inventory): PlayerEntity
	const Created = PlayerEntity.Create(Id, Name, true, vector.zero, 0, 0)

	Created.Inventory = Inventory

	return Created
end

const function Tick(Entity: PlayerEntity, TouchesLiving: LivingToucher)
	PlayerEntity.SaveOldState(Entity)
	Entity.NoPhysics = Entity.GameMode == "spectator"

	if Entity.NoPhysics then
		Entity.OnGround = false
	end
	PlayerEntity.TickSwing(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.BaseTick(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickDeath(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickEffects(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickUsingItem(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickSwimAmount(Entity)
	Entity.MaxUpStep = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Entity, "minecraft:step_height"))
	AiStep(Entity, TouchesLiving)
	PlayerEntity.TurnBody(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickFallFlying(Entity)
	TickAttackStrength(Entity)
	Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.TickCooldowns(Entity.Cooldowns)
	UpdatePose(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickElytraSound(Entity)
end

const function ReleaseUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Stack = Entity.UseItem
	const Behaviors = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors

	if Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Minecraft.Items.ItemOf(Stack), "SpyglassItem") then
		Sounds.Play("item.spyglass.stop_using", Entity.Position, 1, 1)
	end

	if not Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Minecraft.Items.ItemOf(Stack), "TridentItem") then
		return
	end

	const Strength = Behaviors.TridentSpinStrength(Stack)

	if PlayerEntity.TicksUsingItem(Entity, 0) < RiptideThreshold or Strength <= 0 or not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Entity) or Behaviors.NextDamageWillBreak(Stack) then
		return
	end

	Entity.DeltaMovement += Behaviors.RiptidePush(Entity.XRot, Entity.YRot, Strength)
	Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks = RiptideTicks

	if Entity.OnGround then
		Move(Entity, vector.create(0, RiptideLift, 0))
	end
end

const function WaterVision(Entity: PlayerEntity): number
	if not Entity.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		return 0
	end

	if Entity.WaterVisionTime >= WaterVisionMax then
		return 1
	end

	const Rising = math.clamp(Entity.WaterVisionTime / WaterVisionRise, 0, 1)
	const Settling = if Entity.WaterVisionTime < WaterVisionRise then 0 else math.clamp((Entity.WaterVisionTime - WaterVisionRise) / (WaterVisionMax - WaterVisionRise), 0, 1)

	return Mth.Float(Mth.Float(Rising * Mth.Float(0.6)) + Mth.Float(Settling * Mth.Float(0.39999998)))
end

const function Turn(Entity: PlayerEntity, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const DeltaXRot = Mth.Float(MouseY * MouseTurnScale)
	const DeltaYRot = Mth.Float(MouseX * MouseTurnScale)

	Entity.XRot = Mth.Clamp(Entity.XRot + DeltaXRot, -90, 90)
	Entity.YRot += DeltaYRot
	Entity.XRotO = Mth.Clamp(Entity.XRotO + DeltaXRot, -90, 90)
	Entity.YRotO += DeltaYRot
end

const function Teleport(Entity: PlayerEntity, Stream: Minecraft.Stream, TeleportId: number, Position: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	Entity.Position = Position
	Entity.PositionO = Position
	Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
	Entity.YRot = YRot
	Entity.YRotO = YRot
	Entity.XRot = XRot
	Entity.XRotO = XRot
	Entity.YHeadRot = YRot
	Entity.YBodyRot = YRot
	Entity.YBodyRotO = YRot
	Protocol.WriteAcceptTeleportation(Stream, TeleportId)
	Protocol.WriteMovePlayer(Stream, Position, YRot, XRot, false, false)
end

const function SendChanges(Entity: PlayerEntity, Stream: Minecraft.Stream)
	if Entity.AbilitiesChanged then
		Protocol.WriteServerboundAbilities(Stream, Entity.Flying)
		Entity.AbilitiesChanged = false
	end

	if Entity.KeyPresses ~= Entity.LastSentInput then
		Protocol.WritePlayerInput(Stream, Entity.KeyPresses)
		Entity.LastSentInput = Entity.KeyPresses
	end

	const Sprinting = PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity)

	if Sprinting ~= Entity.WasSprinting then
		Protocol.WritePlayerCommand(Stream, if Sprinting then Protocol.PlayerCommands.StartSprinting else Protocol.PlayerCommands.StopSprinting)
		Entity.WasSprinting = Sprinting
	end

	if Entity.FallFlyingRequested then
		Protocol.WritePlayerCommand(Stream, Protocol.PlayerCommands.StartFallFlying)
		Entity.FallFlyingRequested = false
	end

	if Entity.CameraId ~= nil then
		return
	end

	const Delta = Entity.Position - Entity.LastSentPosition

	Entity.PositionReminder += 1

	const Moved = vector.dot(Delta, Delta) > MovementThresholdSquared or Entity.PositionReminder >= MovementReminderTicks
	const Rotated = Entity.YRot ~= Entity.LastSentYRot or Entity.XRot ~= Entity.LastSentXRot

	if Moved and Rotated then
		Protocol.WriteMovePlayer(Stream, Entity.Position, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot, Entity.OnGround, Entity.HorizontalCollision)
	elseif Moved then
		Protocol.WriteMovePlayer(Stream, Entity.Position, nil, nil, Entity.OnGround, Entity.HorizontalCollision)
	elseif Rotated then
		Protocol.WriteMovePlayer(Stream, nil, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot, Entity.OnGround, Entity.HorizontalCollision)
	elseif Entity.LastOnGround ~= Entity.OnGround or Entity.LastHorizontalCollision ~= Entity.HorizontalCollision then
		Protocol.WriteMovePlayer(Stream, nil, nil, nil, Entity.OnGround, Entity.HorizontalCollision)
	end

	if Moved then
		Entity.LastSentPosition = Entity.Position
		Entity.PositionReminder = 0
	end

	if Rotated then
		Entity.LastSentYRot = Entity.YRot
		Entity.LastSentXRot = Entity.XRot
	end

	Entity.LastOnGround = Entity.OnGround
	Entity.LastHorizontalCollision = Entity.HorizontalCollision
end

const function FieldOfViewModifier(Entity: PlayerEntity, FirstPerson: boolean): number
	local Modifier = 1

	if Entity.Flying then
		Modifier *= Mth.Float(1.1)
	end

	if Entity.WalkingSpeed ~= 0 then
		Modifier *= (MovementSpeed(Entity) / Entity.WalkingSpeed + 1) / 2
	end

	if Entity.UsingItem then
		if Minecraft.Items.Is(Entity.UseItem, "minecraft:bow") then
			const Scale = math.min(PlayerEntity.TicksUsingItem(Entity, 0) / BowZoomTicks, 1)

			Modifier *= 1 - Scale * Scale * BowZoomScale
		elseif FirstPerson and Minecraft.Items.Is(Entity.UseItem, "minecraft:spyglass") then
			return ScopeFieldOfView
		end
	end

	return Modifier
end

const function HurtTo(Entity: PlayerEntity, Health: number)
	if not FlashOnSetHealth then
		Entity.Health = Health
		FlashOnSetHealth = true

		return
	end

	const Damage = Entity.Health - Health

	if Damage <= 0 then
		Entity.Health = Health

		if Damage < 0 then
			Entity.DamageCooldownTime = HealCooldownTicks
		end
	else
		Entity.DamageCooldownTime = HurtCooldownTicks
		Entity.Health = Health
		Entity.HurtDuration = HurtDurationTicks
		Entity.HurtTime = HurtDurationTicks
	end
end

const function ApplyServerData(Entity: PlayerEntity, SharedFlags: number, LivingFlags: number, AirSupply: number, EffectParticles: { Minecraft.ParticleOptions }, EffectAmbience: boolean)
	Entity.EffectParticles = table.clone(EffectParticles)
	Entity.EffectAmbience = EffectAmbience

	if PlayerEntity.IsSprinting(Entity) and not bit32.btest(SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting) then
		SetSprinting(Entity, false)
	end

	Entity.SharedFlags = bit32.bor(bit32.band(Entity.SharedFlags, bit32.bnot(ServerOwnedFlags)), bit32.band(SharedFlags, ServerOwnedFlags))
	Entity.SpinAttack = bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.SpinAttack)
	Entity.OnFire = bit32.btest(SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.OnFire)
	Entity.AirSupply = AirSupply

	const Using = bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.UsingItem)

	if Using and not Entity.UsingItem then
		PlayerEntity.StartUsingItem(Entity, bit32.btest(LivingFlags, Protocol.LivingFlags.OffHand))
	elseif not Using and Entity.UsingItem then
		PlayerEntity.StopUsingItem(Entity)
	end
end

const function Respawn(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	FlashOnSetHealth = false
	Entity.Health = Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:max_health", Entity.Inventory, nil)
	Entity.DeathTime = 0
	Entity.HurtTime = 0
	Entity.DamageCooldownTime = 0
	Entity.Effects = {}
	Entity.Cooldowns = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CreateCooldowns()
	Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
	Entity.FallDistance = 0
	Entity.AirSupply = MaxAirSupply
	Entity.Fluid = EntityPhysics.CreateFluidState()
	Entity.SwimAmount = 0
	Entity.SwimAmountO = 0
	Entity.WasUnderwater = false
	Entity.WaterVisionTime = 0
	Entity.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
	Entity.SpinAttack = false
	Entity.CameraId = nil
	Entity.AttackStrengthTicker = 0
	Entity.ItemSwapTicker = 0
	Entity.SwingActive = false
	Entity.SwingAnimation = 0
	Entity.SwingAnimationO = 0
	PlayerEntity.StopUsingItem(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.SetPose(Entity, "Standing")
	SetSprinting(Entity, false)
end

const function AdjustFlyingSpeed(Entity: PlayerEntity, Steps: number)
	Entity.FlyingSpeed = math.clamp(Mth.Float(Entity.FlyingSpeed + Mth.Float(Steps * Mth.Float(0.005))), 0, Mth.Float(0.2))
end

const function SetKeysEnabled(Enabled: boolean)
	KeysEnabled = Enabled
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	SetKeysEnabled = SetKeysEnabled,
	HurtTo = HurtTo,
	ApplyServerData = ApplyServerData,
	Respawn = Respawn,
	AdjustFlyingSpeed = AdjustFlyingSpeed,
	ReleaseUsingItem = ReleaseUsingItem,
	WaterVision = WaterVision,
	Tick = Tick,
	Turn = Turn,
	Teleport = Teleport,
	SendChanges = SendChanges,
	FieldOfViewModifier = FieldOfViewModifier,
	AttackStrengthDelay = AttackStrengthDelay,
	AttackStrengthScale = AttackStrengthScale,
	ItemSwapScale = ItemSwapScale,
}

end

const function ItemBySlot(Entity: PlayerEntity, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot): Minecraft.ItemStack
	const Inventory = Entity.Inventory

	if Inventory then
		return Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Inventory, Slot)
	end

	return Entity.Equipment[Slot] or Minecraft.Items.Empty
end

const function ItemHeldByArm(Entity: PlayerEntity, Arm: "Right" | "Left"): Minecraft.ItemStack
	return ItemBySlot(Entity, if Arm == Entity.MainArm then "mainhand" else "offhand")
end

const function IsDeadOrDying(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.Health <= 0
end

const function Swing(Entity: PlayerEntity, OffHand: boolean, Type: string, Duration: number)
	if Entity.SwingActive and Entity.SwingTicks <= Entity.SwingDuration // 2 and Entity.SwingTicks > 0 then
		return
	end

	if not (Entity.SwingActive and Entity.SwingOffHand == OffHand and Entity.SwingType == Type and Entity.SwingDuration == Duration) then
		Entity.SwingAnimationO = 0
		Entity.SwingAnimation = 0
	end

	Entity.SwingActive = true
	Entity.SwingOffHand = OffHand
	Entity.SwingType = Type
	Entity.SwingDuration = Duration
	Entity.SwingTicks = 0
end

const function ModifiedSwingDuration(Entity: PlayerEntity, Duration: number): number
	const Effects = Entity.Effects
	const Haste = Effects["minecraft:haste"]
	const Conduit = Effects["minecraft:conduit_power"]
	const Fatigue = Effects["minecraft:mining_fatigue"]

	if Haste or Conduit then
		return Duration - (1 + math.max(if Haste then Haste.Amplifier else 0, if Conduit then Conduit.Amplifier else 0))
	elseif Fatigue then
		return Duration + (1 + Fatigue.Amplifier) * 2
	end

	return Duration
end

const function TickSwing(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.SwingAnimationO = Entity.SwingAnimation

	if not Entity.SwingActive then
		Entity.SwingAnimation = 0

		return
	end

	if Entity.SwingDuration > 0 then
		Entity.SwingAnimation = math.min(Mth.Float(Entity.SwingTicks / Entity.SwingDuration), 1)
	end

	Entity.SwingTicks += 1

	if Entity.SwingTicks > Entity.SwingDuration + 1 then
		Entity.SwingActive = false
		Entity.SwingAnimation = 0
	end
end

const function SwingProgress(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	if Entity.SwingAnimation >= Entity.SwingAnimationO then
		return Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.SwingAnimationO, Entity.SwingAnimation)
	end

	return Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.SwingAnimationO, Entity.SwingAnimation + 1)
end

const function StartUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity, OffHand: boolean)
	const Stack = ItemBySlot(Entity, if OffHand then "offhand" else "mainhand")

	if Minecraft.Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Entity.UsingItem then
		return
	end

	Entity.UseItem = Stack
	Entity.UseItemRemaining = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.UseDuration(Stack)
	Entity.UsingItem = true
	Entity.UsingOffHand = OffHand
end

const function StopUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.UsingItem = false
	Entity.UseItem = Minecraft.Items.Empty
	Entity.UseItemRemaining = 0
end

const function Triangle(Mode: number, Deviation: number): number
	return Mode + Deviation * (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function PlayOwnSound(Entity: PlayerEntity, Event: string, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	if Entity.IsLocal then
		Sounds.Play(Event, Entity.Position, Volume, Pitch)
	end
end

const function ViewVector(Entity: PlayerEntity): vector
	const Pitch = Entity.XRot * DegreesToRadians
	const Yaw = Entity.YRot * DegreesToRadians

	return vector.create(-math.sin(Yaw) * math.cos(Pitch), -math.sin(Pitch), math.cos(Yaw) * math.cos(Pitch))
end

const function BlockReach(Entity: PlayerEntity): number
	const Inventory = Entity.Inventory

	if Inventory then
		return Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.InteractionRange(Inventory, Entity.Effects, Entity.GameMode == "creative", "minecraft:block_interaction_range")
	end

	const Attribute = Minecraft.Registry.Attribute("minecraft:block_interaction_range")

	return Attribute.player or Attribute.default
end

const function ConsumeEffects(Entity: PlayerEntity, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Count: number)
	const Event, Volume, Pitch, HasParticles = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.ConsumeSound(Stack, Generator)

	if HasParticles then
		Particles.ItemParticles(Stack, Count, Entity.Position, Entity.EyeHeight, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot)
	end

	PlayOwnSound(Entity, Event, Volume, Pitch)
end

const function BrushDust(Entity: PlayerEntity, Hit: vector, Normal: vector, Block: string, Tint: vector?)
	const Look = ViewVector(Entity)
	const Flip = if Entity.UsingOffHand then -1 else 1
	local DeltaX = 0.1
	local DeltaZ = 1

	if Normal.y ~= 0 then
		DeltaX, DeltaZ = Look.z, -Look.x
	elseif Normal.z < 0 then
		DeltaX, DeltaZ = 1, -0.1
	elseif Normal.z > 0 then
		DeltaX, DeltaZ = -1, 0.1
	elseif Normal.x < 0 then
		DeltaX, DeltaZ = -0.1, -1
	end

	const Point = Hit - vector.create(if Normal.x < 0 then 1.0E-6 else 0, 0, if Normal.z < 0 then 1.0E-6 else 0)

	for _ = 1, Generator:NextInteger(7, 11) do
		Particles.Add({ Type = "block", Block = Block, Color = Tint }, Point, vector.create(DeltaX * Flip * BrushDustSpeed * Generator:NextNumber(), 0, DeltaZ * Flip * BrushDustSpeed * Generator:NextNumber()))
	end
end

const function TickBrush(Entity: PlayerEntity, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Remaining: number)
	const Eye = Entity.Position + vector.create(0, Entity.EyeHeight, 0)
	const Hit, Normal = Minecraft.Collision.RaycastNormal(Eye, ViewVector(Entity) * BlockReach(Entity))

	if Remaining < 0 or not Hit then
		StopUsingItem(Entity)

		return
	end

	if (Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Remaining + 1) % BrushStroke ~= BrushSoundTick then
		return
	end

	const Block, Tint = Minecraft.Entity.BlockAt(Hit - Normal * BrushHitInset)

	if Block then
		BrushDust(Entity, Hit, Normal, Block.Id, Tint)
	end

	PlayOwnSound(Entity, "item.brush.brushing.generic", 1, 1)
end

const function UseTickEffects(Entity: PlayerEntity, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Remaining: number)
	if Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.ShouldEmitConsumeEffects(Stack, Remaining) then
		ConsumeEffects(Entity, Stack, UseParticles)
	end

	if Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Minecraft.Items.ItemOf(Stack), "BrushItem") then
		TickBrush(Entity, Stack, Remaining)
	end
end

const function CompleteUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Stack = Entity.UseItem

	if Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.ConsumableOf(Stack) then
		ConsumeEffects(Entity, Stack, CompletedUseParticles)
	elseif Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Minecraft.Items.ItemOf(Stack), "SpyglassItem") then
		PlayOwnSound(Entity, "item.spyglass.stop_using", 1, 1)
	end

	StopUsingItem(Entity)
end

const function BreakItem(Entity: PlayerEntity, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot)
	const Stack = ItemBySlot(Entity, Slot)

	if Minecraft.Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	const Sound = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Minecraft.Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:break_sound"))

	if Sound then
		Sounds.Play(Sound, Entity.Position, 0.8, 0.8 + Generator:NextNumber() * 0.4)
	end

	Particles.ItemParticles(Stack, UseParticles, Entity.Position, Entity.EyeHeight, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot)
end

const function KineticHit(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.KineticHitTime = Entity.TickCount

	if Entity.TickCount - Entity.LastKineticHitFeedback <= KineticFeedbackTicks then
		return
	end

	Entity.LastKineticHitFeedback = Entity.TickCount

	const Kinetic = Minecraft.Items.Get(Entity.UseItem, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") :: { hit_sound: unknown? }?
	const Sound = if Kinetic then Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Kinetic.hit_sound) else nil

	if Sound then
		Sounds.Play(Sound, Entity.Position, 1, 1)
	end
end

const function TickUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if not Entity.UsingItem then
		return
	end

	const InHand = ItemBySlot(Entity, if Entity.UsingOffHand then "offhand" else "mainhand")

	if Minecraft.Items.IsSameItem(InHand, Entity.UseItem) then
		Entity.UseItem = InHand
		UseTickEffects(Entity, InHand, Entity.UseItemRemaining)

		if Entity.UsingItem then
			Entity.UseItemRemaining -= 1
		end
	else
		StopUsingItem(Entity)
	end
end

const function TicksUsingItem(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	if not Entity.UsingItem then
		return 0
	end

	return Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.UseDuration(Entity.UseItem) - Entity.UseItemRemaining + Partial
end

const function TickDeath(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if IsDeadOrDying(Entity) then
		Entity.DeathTime += 1
	else
		Entity.DeathTime = 0
	end
end

const function TickEffects(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	for _, Effect in Entity.Effects do
		Minecraft.Effects.TickClient(Effect)
	end

	Particles.EffectSwirl(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height, Entity.EffectParticles, Entity.EffectAmbience, bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Invisible))
end

const function IsInvisible(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Invisible)
end

const function IsScoping(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.UsingItem and Minecraft.Items.Is(Entity.UseItem, "minecraft:spyglass")
end

const function TicksSinceKineticHit(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	return if Entity.KineticHitTime < 0 then 0 else Entity.TickCount - Entity.KineticHitTime + Partial
end

const function IsFallFlying(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying)
end

const function TickFallFlying(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if IsFallFlying(Entity) then
		Entity.FallFlyTicks += 1
	else
		Entity.FallFlyTicks = 0
	end

	Entity.ElytraRotXO = Entity.ElytraRotX
	Entity.ElytraRotYO = Entity.ElytraRotY
	Entity.ElytraRotZO = Entity.ElytraRotZ

	local TargetX = ElytraRestX
	local TargetY = 0
	local TargetZ = ElytraRestZ

	if IsFallFlying(Entity) then
		local Ratio = 1
		const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement

		if Movement.y < 0 then
			Ratio = 1 - (-Mth.Normalize(Movement).y) ^ 1.5
		end

		TargetX = Mth.Lerp(Ratio, ElytraRestX, ElytraGlideX)
		TargetZ = Mth.Lerp(Ratio, ElytraRestZ, ElytraGlideZ)
	elseif Entity.Pose == "Crouching" then
		TargetX = ElytraCrouchX
		TargetZ = ElytraCrouchZ
		TargetY = ElytraCrouchY
	end

	Entity.ElytraRotX += (TargetX - Entity.ElytraRotX) * ElytraEasing
	Entity.ElytraRotY += (TargetY - Entity.ElytraRotY) * ElytraEasing
	Entity.ElytraRotZ += (TargetZ - Entity.ElytraRotZ) * ElytraEasing
end

const function IsSprinting(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting)
end

const function SaveOldState(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.PositionO = Entity.Position
	Entity.DeltaMovementO = Entity.DeltaMovement
	Entity.YRotO = Entity.YRot
	Entity.XRotO = Entity.XRot
	Entity.TickCount += 1
	Entity.WalkDistO = Entity.WalkDist
end

const function IsSwimming(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return not Entity.Flying and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator" and bit32.btest(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Swimming)
end

const function IsUnderWater(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return if Entity.IsLocal then Entity.WasUnderwater else Minecraft.Entity.IsUnderWater(Entity)
end

const function IsVisuallySwimming(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.Pose == "Swimming" or not IsFallFlying(Entity) and Entity.Pose == "FallFlying"
end

const function IsVisuallyCrawling(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return Entity.Pose == "Swimming" and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Entity)
end

const function SetSwimming(Entity: PlayerEntity, Swimming: boolean)
	Entity.SharedFlags = if Swimming
		then bit32.bor(Entity.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Swimming)
		else bit32.band(Entity.SharedFlags, bit32.bnot(Minecraft.SharedFlags.Swimming))
end

const function UpdateSwimming(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if Entity.Flying then
		SetSwimming(Entity, false)
	elseif IsSwimming(Entity) then
		SetSwimming(Entity, IsSprinting(Entity) and Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Entity))
	else
		SetSwimming(Entity, IsSprinting(Entity) and IsUnderWater(Entity) and Minecraft.Entity.FluidAt(Entity.Position) == "Water")
	end
end

const function TickSwimAmount(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	Entity.SwimAmountO = Entity.SwimAmount
	Entity.SwimAmount = if IsVisuallySwimming(Entity) then math.min(1, Entity.SwimAmount + SwimAmountStep) else math.max(0, Entity.SwimAmount - SwimAmountStep)
end

const function SwimAmount(Entity: PlayerEntity, Partial: number): number
	return Mth.Lerp(Partial, Entity.SwimAmountO, Entity.SwimAmount)
end

const function DoWaterSplashEffect(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Motion = Entity.DeltaMovement
	const Speed = math.min(1, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x * 0.2 + Motion.y * Motion.y + Motion.z * Motion.z * 0.2) * SplashVolumeScale)

	PlayOwnSound(Entity, if Speed < HighSpeedSplash then "entity.player.splash" else "entity.player.splash.high_speed", Speed, Triangle(1, 0.4))
	Particles.Splash(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Motion)
end

const function CanSpawnSprintParticle(Entity: PlayerEntity): boolean
	return IsSprinting(Entity)
		and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Entity)
		and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator"
		and Entity.Pose ~= "Crouching"
		and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Entity)
		and not IsDeadOrDying(Entity)
end

const function SpawnSprintParticle(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Block, Tint = Minecraft.Entity.BlockAt(Entity.Position - LegacyOnOffset)

	if Block then
		Particles.Sprint(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.DeltaMovement, Block.Id, Tint)
	end
end

const function TickElytraSound(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	if not Entity.ElytraSoundActive then
		if IsFallFlying(Entity) then
			Entity.ElytraSoundActive = true
			Entity.ElytraSoundTime = 0
			Entity.ElytraSound = Sounds.Start("item.elytra.flying", Entity.Position, ElytraStartVolume, 1)
		end

		return
	end

	Entity.ElytraSoundTime += 1

	const Handle = Entity.ElytraSound

	if Entity.ElytraSoundTime > ElytraSoundDelay and not IsFallFlying(Entity) then
		if Handle then
			Sounds.Stop(Handle)
		end

		Entity.ElytraSound = nil
		Entity.ElytraSoundActive = false

		return
	end

	const Speed = vector.dot(Entity.DeltaMovement, Entity.DeltaMovement)
	local Volume = if Speed >= 1.0E-7 then math.clamp(Speed / 4, 0, 1) else 0

	if Entity.ElytraSoundTime < ElytraSoundDelay then
		Volume = 0
	elseif Entity.ElytraSoundTime < ElytraSoundDelay + ElytraFadeTicks then
		Volume *= (Entity.ElytraSoundTime - ElytraSoundDelay) / ElytraFadeTicks
	end

	if Handle then
		Sounds.Set(Handle, Entity.Position, Volume, if Volume > ElytraLoudPitch then 1 + (Volume - ElytraLoudPitch) else 1)
	end
end

const function BaseTick(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const WasTouchingWater = Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater
	const FirstTick = Entity.Fluid.FirstTick

	Entity.WasUnderwater = Entity.Fluid.EyeInWater
	Entity.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Entity.Fluid.EyeInWater
	Minecraft.Entity.UpdateFluidInteraction(Entity)
	UpdateSwimming(Entity)

	if Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Entity) and not WasTouchingWater and not FirstTick and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		DoWaterSplashEffect(Entity)
	end

	if CanSpawnSprintParticle(Entity) then
		SpawnSprintParticle(Entity)
	end

	if Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Entity) then
		Entity.FallDistance *= LavaFallScale
	end

	Entity.Fluid.FirstTick = false

	if Entity.HurtTime > 0 then
		Entity.HurtTime -= 1
	end

	if Entity.DamageCooldownTime > 0 then
		Entity.DamageCooldownTime -= 1
	end

	Entity.YHeadRotO = Entity.YHeadRot
	Entity.YBodyRotO = Entity.YBodyRot
end

const function UpdateBob(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const Movement = Entity.DeltaMovement
	const TargetBob = if Entity.OnGround and Entity.DeathTime == 0 and not IsSwimming(Entity) then math.min(MaxBob, math.sqrt(Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z)) else 0

	Entity.BobO = Entity.Bob
	Entity.Bob += (TargetBob - Entity.Bob) * BobFactor
end

const function TurnBody(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const DeltaX = Entity.Position.x - Entity.PositionO.x
	const DeltaZ = Entity.Position.z - Entity.PositionO.z
	const SideDistance = Mth.Float(DeltaX * DeltaX + DeltaZ * DeltaZ)
	local Target = Entity.YBodyRot

	if SideDistance > BodyTurnSpeedSquared then
		const WalkDirection = Mth.Float(math.atan2(DeltaZ, DeltaX)) * (180 / math.pi) - 90
		const Difference = math.abs(Mth.WrapDegrees(Entity.YRot) - WalkDirection)

		Target = if 95 < Difference and Difference < 265 then WalkDirection - 180 else WalkDirection
	end

	if Entity.SwingAnimation > 0 then
		Target = Entity.YRot
	end

	Entity.YBodyRot += Mth.WrapDegrees(Target - Entity.YBodyRot) * BodyFollowFactor

	const HeadDifference = Mth.WrapDegrees(Entity.YRot - Entity.YBodyRot)

	if math.abs(HeadDifference) > MaxHeadRotation then
		Entity.YBodyRot += HeadDifference - math.sign(HeadDifference) * MaxHeadRotation
	end

	while Entity.YRot - Entity.YRotO < -180 do
		Entity.YRotO -= 360
	end

	while Entity.YRot - Entity.YRotO >= 180 do
		Entity.YRotO += 360
	end

	while Entity.YBodyRot - Entity.YBodyRotO < -180 do
		Entity.YBodyRotO -= 360
	end

	while Entity.YBodyRot - Entity.YBodyRotO >= 180 do
		Entity.YBodyRotO += 360
	end

	while Entity.XRot - Entity.XRotO < -180 do
		Entity.XRotO -= 360
	end

	while Entity.XRot - Entity.XRotO >= 180 do
		Entity.XRotO += 360
	end

	while Entity.YHeadRot - Entity.YHeadRotO < -180 do
		Entity.YHeadRotO -= 360
	end

	while Entity.YHeadRot - Entity.YHeadRotO >= 180 do
		Entity.YHeadRotO += 360
	end
end

const function UpdateWalkAnimation(Entity: PlayerEntity)
	const DeltaX = Entity.Position.x - Entity.PositionO.x
	const DeltaZ = Entity.Position.z - Entity.PositionO.z
	const Distance = Mth.Float(math.sqrt(DeltaX * DeltaX + DeltaZ * DeltaZ))

	if Entity.DeathTime > 0 then
		Entity.WalkSpeedOld = 0
		Entity.WalkSpeed = 0
		Entity.WalkPosition = 0
		return
	end

	Entity.WalkSpeedOld = Entity.WalkSpeed
	Entity.WalkSpeed += (math.min(Distance * 4, 1) - Entity.WalkSpeed) * WalkFactor
	Entity.WalkPosition += Entity.WalkSpeed
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	SetPose = SetPose,
	ItemBySlot = ItemBySlot,
	ItemHeldByArm = ItemHeldByArm,
	IsSprinting = IsSprinting,
	IsFallFlying = IsFallFlying,
	TickFallFlying = TickFallFlying,
	IsInvisible = IsInvisible,
	IsScoping = IsScoping,
	TicksSinceKineticHit = TicksSinceKineticHit,
	IsDeadOrDying = IsDeadOrDying,
	Swing = Swing,
	ModifiedSwingDuration = ModifiedSwingDuration,
	TickSwing = TickSwing,
	SwingProgress = SwingProgress,
	StartUsingItem = StartUsingItem,
	StopUsingItem = StopUsingItem,
	CompleteUsingItem = CompleteUsingItem,
	BreakItem = BreakItem,
	KineticHit = KineticHit,
	TickElytraSound = TickElytraSound,
	TickUsingItem = TickUsingItem,
	TicksUsingItem = TicksUsingItem,
	TickDeath = TickDeath,
	TickEffects = TickEffects,
	SaveOldState = SaveOldState,
	BaseTick = BaseTick,
	IsSwimming = IsSwimming,
	IsUnderWater = IsUnderWater,
	IsVisuallySwimming = IsVisuallySwimming,
	IsVisuallyCrawling = IsVisuallyCrawling,
	TickSwimAmount = TickSwimAmount,
	SwimAmount = SwimAmount,
	UpdateBob = UpdateBob,
	TurnBody = TurnBody,
	UpdateWalkAnimation = UpdateWalkAnimation,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Players/RemotePlayer"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Interpolation = require("./Interpolation")
const PlayerEntity = require("./PlayerEntity")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const UpdateInterval = 2
const HeadLerpSteps = 3

const DecodedPositions: { vector } = {}
const RotationTarget: { vector } = { vector.zero }
const NoTicks: { number } = {}

const function Create(Id: number, Name: string, Position: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number, YHeadRot: number): PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity
	const Entity = PlayerEntity.Create(Id, Name, false, Position, YRot, XRot)

	Entity.YHeadRot = YHeadRot
	Entity.YHeadRotO = YHeadRot
	Entity.YBodyRot = YHeadRot
	Entity.YBodyRotO = YHeadRot
	Entity.LerpYHeadRot = YHeadRot
	Entity.Interpolation = Interpolation.Create(UpdateInterval)

	return Entity
end

const function DecodeAxis(Base: number, Delta: number): number
	return if Delta == 0 then Base else Protocol.DecodeCoordinate(Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Base) + Delta)
end

const function Move(Entity: PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity, StepCount: number, Deltas: { vector }, Ticks: { number }, HasRotation: boolean, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	local Base = Entity.PositionBase

	for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
		const Delta = Deltas[Index]
		const Decoded = if Delta == vector.zero then Base else vector.create(DecodeAxis(Base.x, Delta.x), DecodeAxis(Base.y, Delta.y), DecodeAxis(Base.z, Delta.z))

		DecodedPositions[Index] = Decoded

		if StepCount > 0 then
			Base = Decoded
		end
	end

	Entity.PositionBase = DecodedPositions[math.max(StepCount, 1)]
	Interpolation.InterpolateTo(Entity.Interpolation :: Interpolation.State, Entity, StepCount, DecodedPositions, Ticks, HasRotation, YRot, XRot)
end

const function Rotate(Entity: PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	const State = Entity.Interpolation :: Interpolation.State

	RotationTarget[1] = if Interpolation.IsActive(State) then State.Position else Entity.Position
	Interpolation.InterpolateTo(State, Entity, 0, RotationTarget, NoTicks, true, YRot, XRot)
end

const function Sync(Entity: PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity, StepCount: number, Positions: { vector }, Ticks: { number }, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	const End = Positions[math.max(StepCount, 1)]

	Entity.PositionBase = End

	if vector.magnitude(Entity.Position - End) > 64 then
		Interpolation.Cancel(Entity.Interpolation :: Interpolation.State)
		Entity.Position = End
		Entity.PositionO = End
		Entity.YRot = YRot
		Entity.XRot = XRot
		return
	end

	Interpolation.InterpolateTo(Entity.Interpolation :: Interpolation.State, Entity, StepCount, Positions, Ticks, true, YRot, XRot)
end

const function RotateHead(Entity: PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity, YHeadRot: number)
	Entity.LerpYHeadRot = YHeadRot
	Entity.LerpHeadSteps = HeadLerpSteps
end

const function Tick(Entity: PlayerEntity.PlayerEntity)
	Entity.PositionO = Entity.Position
	Entity.DeltaMovementO = Entity.DeltaMovement
	Entity.YRotO = Entity.YRot
	Entity.XRotO = Entity.XRot
	Interpolation.Interpolate(Entity.Interpolation :: Interpolation.State, Entity)
	Entity.TickCount += 1
	Entity.WalkDistO = Entity.WalkDist
	PlayerEntity.TickSwing(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.BaseTick(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickDeath(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickEffects(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickUsingItem(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickSwimAmount(Entity)

	if Entity.LerpHeadSteps > 0 then
		Entity.YHeadRot = Mth.RotLerp(1 / Entity.LerpHeadSteps, Entity.YHeadRot, Entity.LerpYHeadRot)
		Entity.LerpHeadSteps -= 1
	end

	PlayerEntity.UpdateBob(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TurnBody(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.UpdateWalkAnimation(Entity)
	PlayerEntity.TickFallFlying(Entity)
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Move = Move,
	Rotate = Rotate,
	Sync = Sync,
	RotateHead = RotateHead,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Camera"] = function(require)

const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const MinecraftPlayers = require("./Players")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const BaseFieldOfView = 70
const CameraDistance = 4
const ZoomJitter = 0.1
const EyeFollowFactor = Mth.Float(0.5)
const FovFollowFactor = Mth.Float(0.5)
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const HurtTiltDegrees = 14
const DeathRollTicks = 20
const DeathRollBase = 40
const DeathRollScale = 8000
const DeathRollOffset = 200
const DeathFovTicks = 20
const DeathFovOffset = 500
const FluidFovScale = Mth.Float(0.85714287)
const NearPlaneDistance = Mth.Float(0.05)

export type Perspective = "FirstPerson" | "ThirdPersonBack" | "ThirdPersonFront"

local Perspective: Perspective = "FirstPerson"
local EyeHeight = 0
local EyeHeightOld = 0
local FovModifier = 1
local OldFovModifier = 1
local Following: MinecraftPlayers.PlayerEntity? = nil
local BobbedFrame = CFrame.identity
local UnbobbedFrame = CFrame.identity
local HurtFrame = CFrame.identity
local LastPartial = 0
local HudFov = BaseFieldOfView

const function Rotation(YRot: number, XRot: number): CFrame
	return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(-XRot * DegreesToRadians, math.pi - YRot * DegreesToRadians, 0)
end

const function MaxZoom(Eye: vector, Forward: vector, Distance: number): number
	local Allowed = Distance

	for Index = 0, 7 do
		const Offset = vector.create(bit32.band(Index, 1) * 2 - 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(Index, 1), 1) * 2 - 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(Index, 2), 1) * 2 - 1) * ZoomJitter
		const Hit = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Eye + Offset, -Forward * Allowed)

		if Hit then
