		const Id, Stack = Protocol.ReadSetItemEntityData(Reader)

		ItemEntities[Id].Stack = Stack
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.TakeItemEntity then
		const Id, Collector, Amount = Protocol.ReadTakeItemEntity(Reader)

		Take(ItemEntities[Id], Collector, Amount)
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if ReceiveAddressed(PacketId, Reader) then
		return true
	elseif PacketId == Protocol.Clientbound.AddItemEntity then
		const Id, Position, Motion, Stack = Protocol.ReadAddItemEntity(Reader)

		Add(Id, Position, Motion, Stack)

		return true
	elseif PacketId == Protocol.Clientbound.TakeItemEntity then
		Protocol.ReadTakeItemEntity(Reader)

		return true
	elseif PacketId == Protocol.Clientbound.SetItemEntityData then
		Protocol.ReadSetItemEntityData(Reader)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function Remove(Id: number)
	const Item = ItemEntities[Id]

	if Item then
		Destroy(Item)
	end
end

const function DrawItem(Item: ItemEntity, Position: vector, Age: number)
	ItemContext.Seed = Item.Id
	ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, Item.Stack, ItemContext)
	UpdateCluster(Item, ItemState)
	HeldItems.Update(Item.Holder, ItemState, Item.Cluster)

	const Bob = Mth.Sin(Age / 10 + Item.BobOffset) * 0.1 + 0.1
	const Spin = Age / 20 + Item.BobOffset
	const Root = CFrame.new((Position + vector.create(0, Bob + Item.LiftY, 0)) * StudsPerBlock) * CFrame.Angles(0, Spin, 0)

	HeldItems.Draw(Item.Holder, Root, true)
end

const function Draw(Partial: number)
	const CameraFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	const CameraPosition = vector.create(CameraFrame.X, CameraFrame.Y, CameraFrame.Z) / StudsPerBlock

	for _, Item in ItemEntities do
		const ToCamera = Item.Position - CameraPosition

		if vector.dot(ToCamera, ToCamera) >= RenderDistanceSquared then
			HeldItems.Hide(Item.Holder)

			continue
		end

		const Position = Item.PositionO + (Item.Position - Item.PositionO) * Partial

		DrawItem(Item, Position, Item.TickCount + Partial)
		Shadows.Draw(Position, ShadowRadius, ShadowStrength)
	end

	for Particle in Particles do
		const Collector = if Particle.Collector then Players.Entities[Particle.Collector] else nil
		local Position = Particle.Position

		if Collector then
			const Target = Collector.PositionO + (Collector.Position - Collector.PositionO) * Partial + vector.create(0, Collector.EyeHeight / 2, 0)
			const Time = (Particle.Life + Partial) / PickupLife

			Position = Particle.Position + (Target - Particle.Position) * (Time * Time)
		end

		DrawItem(Particle, Position, Particle.FrozenAge)
	end
end

const function Bounds(Id: number): (vector?, number, number)
	const Item = ItemEntities[Id]

	if not Item then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end

	return Item.Position, Item.Width, Item.Height
end

return {
	Receive = Receive,
	Remove = Remove,
	Tick = Tick,
	Draw = Draw,
	Bounds = Bounds,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Level"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const Dimension = "minecraft:overworld"

local GameTime = 0
local SpawnPosition: vector? = nil

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId ~= Protocol.Clientbound.SetDefaultSpawnPosition then
		return false
	end

	SpawnPosition = Protocol.ReadSetDefaultSpawnPosition(Reader)

	return true
end

const function Tick()
	GameTime += 1
end

const function GetGameTime(): number
	return GameTime
end

const function GetSpawnPosition(): vector?
	return SpawnPosition
end

return {
	Dimension = Dimension,
	Receive = Receive,
	Tick = Tick,
	GetGameTime = GetGameTime,
	GetSpawnPosition = GetSpawnPosition,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Projectiles"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const HeldItems = require("./HeldItems")
const ItemModels = require("./ItemModels")
const Models = require("./Models")
const Particles = require("./Particles")
const Players = require("./Players")
const Rendering = require("./Rendering")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")
const Textures = require("./Textures")
const Affine = require("./Affine")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Flight = Minecraft.Projectile
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const EntityPhysics = Minecraft.Entity
const Flags = Protocol.ProjectileFlags
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const ShakeTicks = 7
const PickupTicks = 3
const OrbGravity = 0.03
const OrbDrag = Mth.Float(0.98)
const OrbWaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.99)
const OrbFluidRise = Mth.Float(5.0E-4)
const OrbFluidRiseLimit = Mth.Float(0.06)
const OrbLavaHop = Mth.Float(0.2)
const OrbFollowDistance = 8
const OrbSize = 0.5
const OrbEyeHeight = Mth.Float(OrbSize * Mth.Float(0.85))
const OrbScale = 0.3
const OrbLift = 0.1
const OrbIcons = 11
const ReturnRiseScale = 0.015
const ReturnAcceleration = 0.05
const RocketBoost = 1.5
const RocketBoostPull = 0.1
const WindSpinDegrees = 16
const WindRestTurn = math.pi / 4
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const HalfTurn = math.pi

const OrbThresholds = { 2477, 1237, 617, 307, 149, 73, 37, 17, 7, 3 }
const MaximumPooled = 8
const ArrowTextures: { [string]: string } = {
	Arrow = "minecraft:entity/projectiles/arrow",
	TippedArrow = "minecraft:entity/projectiles/arrow_tipped",
	SpectralArrow = "minecraft:entity/projectiles/arrow_spectral",
}

type RigKey = "Arrow" | "TippedArrow" | "SpectralArrow" | "Trident" | "Wind" | "WindCore" | string

type Projectile = {
	Id: number,
	Type: string,
	Position: vector,
	PositionO: vector,
	PositionBase: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	YRotO: number,
	XRotO: number,
	Owner: number,
	Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack,
	Data: number,
	Flags: number,
	Value: number,
	ShakeTime: number,
	InGroundTime: number,
	Waiting: boolean,
	Age: number,
	Collector: number?,
	Following: Players.PlayerEntity?,
	PickupAge: number,
	PickupStart: vector,

	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnGroundNoBlocks: boolean,
	HorizontalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollisionBelow: boolean,
	FallDistance: number,
	MaxUpStep: number,
	NoPhysics: boolean,
	SteppingCarefully: boolean,
	SupportingPart: BasePart?,

	Rigs: { [number]: Rendering.Rig },
	RigKeys: { [number]: RigKey },
	Holder: HeldItems.Holder?,
	Folder: Folder,
}

const Projectiles: { [number]: Projectile } = {}
const Pools: { [RigKey]: { Rendering.Rig } } = {}
const Building: { [RigKey]: number } = {}
const ItemState = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const ItemContext: ItemModels.Context = { DisplayContext = "ground", Holder = nil, Seed = 0 }
const Container = Instance.new("Folder")
const Stash = Instance.new("Folder")
const Positions: { vector } = {}
const Deltas: { vector } = {}
const Ticks: { number } = {}
const Generator = Random.new()

Container.Name = "MinecraftProjectiles"
Container.Parent = workspace
Stash.Name = "Pooled"

const TypeNames: { [number]: Minecraft.ProjectileType } = {}
const CritOptions: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "crit" }
const MinimumRenderAge = 2
const MinimumCameraDistanceSquared = 12.25
const BubbleOptions: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "bubble" }
const PortalOptions: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "portal" }
const SparkOptions: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "firework" }
const DefaultCloudOptions: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "entity_effect", Color = vector.one, Alpha = 1 }

for Name, Id in Protocol.ProjectileTypes do
	TypeNames[Id] = Name :: Minecraft.ProjectileType
end

const function LayerPolygons(LayerName: string, ChildName: string?, Texture: Rendering.Texture): { Rendering.Polygon }
	const Layer = Models.Layer(LayerName)
	const Root = if ChildName then Layer.Root.Children.bone.Children[ChildName] else Layer.Root
	const Out: { Models.LayerPolygon } = {}

	Models.FlattenLayer(Root, Affine.Create(),Texture.Size.X / Layer.TextureWidth, Texture.Size.Y / Layer.TextureHeight, Out)

	return Out :: { Rendering.Polygon }
end

const function OrbPolygons(Icon: number): { Rendering.Polygon }
	const U0 = Icon % 4 * 16
	const V0 = Icon // 4 * 16

	return {
		{
			Vertices = {
				{ Position = vector.create(-0.5, -0.25, 0), U = U0, V = V0 + 16 },
				{ Position = vector.create(0.5, -0.25, 0), U = U0 + 16, V = V0 + 16 },
				{ Position = vector.create(0.5, 0.75, 0), U = U0 + 16, V = V0 },
				{ Position = vector.create(-0.5, 0.75, 0), U = U0, V = V0 },
			},
			Normal = vector.create(0, 1, 0),
		},
	}
end

const function BuildRig(Key: RigKey): Rendering.Rig?
	local Texture: Rendering.Texture
	local Polygons: { Rendering.Polygon }
	local Material: Rendering.Material = "Cutout"
	local Scale = StudsPerBlock

	if Key == "Arrow" or Key == "TippedArrow" or Key == "SpectralArrow" then
		Texture = Textures.Texture(ArrowTextures[Key])
		Polygons = LayerPolygons("minecraft:arrow#main", nil, Texture)
		Material = "CutoutCull"
	elseif Key == "Trident" then
		Texture = Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/trident/trident")
		Polygons = LayerPolygons("minecraft:trident#main", nil, Texture)
		Material = "Solid"
	elseif Key == "Wind" or Key == "WindCore" then
		Texture = Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/projectiles/wind_charge")
		Polygons = LayerPolygons("minecraft:wind_charge#main", if Key == "Wind" then "wind" else "wind_charge", Texture)
	else
		Texture = Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/experience/experience_orb")
		Polygons = OrbPolygons(tonumber(string.sub(Key, 4)) :: number)
		Scale = StudsPerBlock * OrbScale
	end

	const Part: Rendering.Part = { Name = Key, Parent = nil, Polygons = Polygons, X = 0, Y = 0, Z = 0, XRot = 0, YRot = 0, ZRot = 0, Visible = true }

	return Rendering.CreateRig({ Part }, { { Texture = Texture, Material = Material, Overlay = false } }, Scale, Stash)
end

const function FillPool(Key: RigKey)
	const Created = BuildRig(Key)

	if Created then
		table.insert(Pools[Key], Created)
	end

	Building[Key] -= 1
end

const function TakeRig(Key: RigKey): Rendering.Rig?
	local Pool = Pools[Key]

	if not Pool then
		Pool = {}
		Pools[Key] = Pool
		Building[Key] = 0
	end

	const Taken = table.remove(Pool :: { Rendering.Rig })

	if not Taken and Building[Key] == 0 and Rendering.CanCreateRigs() then
		Building[Key] += 1
		task.spawn(FillPool, Key)
	end

	return Taken
end

const function ReturnRig(Key: RigKey, Rig: Rendering.Rig)
	const Pool = Pools[Key]

	if #Pool >= MaximumPooled then
		Rendering.DestroyRig(Rig)

		return
	end

	Rig.Visible = false

	for _, Instance in Rig.Instances do
		Instance.Parent = Stash
	end

	table.insert(Pool, Rig)
end

const function OrbIcon(Value: number): number
	for Index, Threshold in OrbThresholds do
		if Value >= Threshold then
			return OrbIcons - Index
		end
	end

	return 0
end

const function WantedRigs(Projectile: Projectile, Out: { RigKey })
	const Type = Projectile.Type

	table.clear(Out)

	if Type == "Arrow" and Projectile.Data > 0 then
		table.insert(Out, "TippedArrow")
	elseif Type == "Arrow" or Type == "SpectralArrow" or Type == "Trident" then
		table.insert(Out, Type)
	elseif Type == "WindCharge" then
		table.insert(Out, "Wind")
		table.insert(Out, "WindCore")
	elseif Type == "ExperienceOrb" then
		table.insert(Out, `Orb{OrbIcon(Projectile.Value)}`)
	end
end

const function Create(Id: number, Type: string, Position: vector, Motion: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number, Owner: number, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Data: number): Projectile
	const Properties = if Type == "ExperienceOrb" or Type == "AreaEffectCloud" then nil else Flight.Of(Type :: Minecraft.ProjectileType)
	const Folder = Instance.new("Folder")

	Folder.Name = Type
	Folder.Parent = Container

	const Created: Projectile = {
		Id = Id,
		Type = Type,
		Position = Position,
		PositionO = Position,
		PositionBase = Position,
		DeltaMovement = Motion,
		YRot = YRot,
		XRot = XRot,
		YRotO = YRot,
		XRotO = XRot,
		Owner = Owner,
		Stack = Stack,
		Data = Data,
		Flags = 0,
		Value = Data,
		ShakeTime = 0,
		InGroundTime = 0,
		Waiting = false,
		Age = 0,
		Collector = nil,
		Following = nil,
		PickupAge = 0,
		PickupStart = Position,
		Width = if Properties then Properties.Width else OrbSize,
		Height = if Properties then Properties.Height else OrbSize,
		EyeHeight = if Properties then Properties.EyeHeight else OrbEyeHeight,
		Fluid = EntityPhysics.CreateFluidState(),
		OnGround = false,
		OnGroundNoBlocks = false,
		HorizontalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollisionBelow = false,
		FallDistance = 0,
		MaxUpStep = 0,
		NoPhysics = false,
		SteppingCarefully = false,
		SupportingPart = nil,
		Rigs = {},
		RigKeys = {},
		Holder = nil,
		Folder = Folder,
	}

	if Type ~= "Arrow" and Type ~= "SpectralArrow" and Type ~= "Trident" and Type ~= "WindCharge" and Type ~= "ExperienceOrb" and Type ~= "AreaEffectCloud" then
		Created.Holder = HeldItems.Create(Folder, StudsPerBlock)
	end

	Projectiles[Id] = Created

	return Created
end

const function Destroy(Projectile: Projectile)
	Projectiles[Projectile.Id] = nil

	for Index, Rig in Projectile.Rigs do
		ReturnRig(Projectile.RigKeys[Index], Rig)
	end

	if Projectile.Holder then
		HeldItems.Destroy(Projectile.Holder)
	end

	Projectile.Folder:Destroy()
end

const function HasFlag(Projectile: Projectile, Flag: number): boolean
	return bit32.btest(Projectile.Flags, Flag)
end

const function SetFlag(Projectile: Projectile, Flag: number, Enabled: boolean)
	Projectile.Flags = if Enabled then bit32.bor(Projectile.Flags, Flag) else bit32.band(Projectile.Flags, bit32.bnot(Flag))
end

const function UpdateFluids(Projectile: Projectile)
	Projectile.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Projectile.Fluid.EyeInWater
	EntityPhysics.UpdateFluidInteraction(Projectile)
	Projectile.Fluid.FirstTick = false
end

const function Rgb(Color: number): vector
	return vector.create(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8)) / 255
end

const function RandomPoint(Projectile: Projectile): vector
	return Projectile.Position + vector.create(
		Projectile.Width * ((2 * Generator:NextNumber() - 1) * 0.5),
		Projectile.Height * Generator:NextNumber(),
		Projectile.Width * ((2 * Generator:NextNumber() - 1) * 0.5)
	)
end

const function TippedParticles(Projectile: Projectile, Count: number)
	if Projectile.Type ~= "Arrow" or Projectile.Data == -1 then
		return
	end

	const Options: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "entity_effect", Color = Rgb(Projectile.Data), Alpha = 1 }

	for _ = 1, Count do
		Particles.Add(Options, RandomPoint(Projectile), vector.zero)
	end
end

const function Bubbles(Origin: vector, Motion: vector)
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		Particles.Add(BubbleOptions, Origin - Motion * 0.25, Motion)
	end
end

const function CloudParticles(Cloud: Projectile)
	if Cloud.Waiting and Generator:NextInteger(0, 1) == 1 then
		return
	end

	const Radius = Cloud.Width / 2
	const Options: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "entity_effect", Color = Rgb(Cloud.Data), Alpha = 1 }
	const Count = if Cloud.Waiting then 2 else math.ceil(math.pi * Radius * Radius)
	const Spread = if Cloud.Waiting then 0.2 else Radius

	for _ = 1, Count do
		const Angle = Generator:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
		const Distance = math.sqrt(Generator:NextNumber()) * Spread
		const Point = Cloud.Position + vector.create(math.cos(Angle) * Distance, 0, math.sin(Angle) * Distance)

		Particles.Add(if Cloud.Waiting and Generator:NextInteger(0, 1) == 1 then DefaultCloudOptions else Options, Point, vector.zero)
	end
end

const function TickArrow(Projectile: Projectile)
	const Gravity = Flight.Of(Projectile.Type :: Minecraft.ProjectileType).Gravity
	const NoPhysics = HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.NoPhysics)

	if Projectile.ShakeTime > 0 then
		Projectile.ShakeTime -= 1
	end

	if Projectile.Type == "Trident" and Projectile.Data > 0 and NoPhysics then
		const Owner = Players.Entities[Projectile.Owner]

		if Owner then
			const Toward = Owner.Position + vector.create(0, Owner.EyeHeight, 0) - Projectile.Position

			Projectile.Position += vector.create(0, Toward.y * ReturnRiseScale * Projectile.Data, 0)
			Projectile.DeltaMovement = Projectile.DeltaMovement * 0.95 + Mth.Normalize(Toward) * (ReturnAcceleration * Projectile.Data)
		end
	end

	if HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround) and not NoPhysics then
		Projectile.InGroundTime += 1

		return
	end

	Projectile.InGroundTime = 0

	const Motion = Projectile.DeltaMovement
	const TargetYRot = if NoPhysics then math.deg(math.atan2(-Motion.x, -Motion.z)) else math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.x, Motion.z))
	const TargetXRot = math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.y, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x + Motion.z * Motion.z)))

	Projectile.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.XRot, Mth.Float(TargetXRot))
	Projectile.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.YRot, Mth.Float(TargetYRot))

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Projectile) then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement *= Flight.Of(Projectile.Type :: Minecraft.ProjectileType).WaterInertia
		Bubbles(Projectile.Position, Projectile.DeltaMovement)
	end

	if HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.Critical) then
		for Index = 0, 3 do
			Particles.Add(CritOptions, Projectile.Position + Motion * Index / 4, vector.create(-Motion.x, -Motion.y + 0.2, -Motion.z))
		end
	end

	if NoPhysics then
		Projectile.Position += Motion
	else
		const Hit = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Projectile.Position, Motion)

		if Hit then
			Projectile.Position = Hit - vector.create(math.sign(Motion.x), math.sign(Motion.y), math.sign(Motion.z)) * 0.05
			Projectile.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
			Projectile.ShakeTime = ShakeTicks
			SetFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround, true)
			SetFlag(Projectile, Flags.Critical, false)

			return
		end

		Projectile.Position += Motion
	end

	if not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Projectile) then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement *= Flight.Of(Projectile.Type :: Minecraft.ProjectileType).Drag
	end

	if not NoPhysics then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Gravity, 0)
	end

	UpdateFluids(Projectile)
end

const function TickThrown(Projectile: Projectile)
	const Properties = Flight.Of(Projectile.Type :: Minecraft.ProjectileType)

	Projectile.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Properties.Gravity, 0)

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Projectile) then
		Bubbles(Projectile.Position, Projectile.DeltaMovement)
	end

	Projectile.DeltaMovement *= if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Projectile) then Properties.WaterInertia else Properties.Drag

	const Hit = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Projectile.Position, Projectile.DeltaMovement)

	Projectile.Position = Hit or Projectile.Position + Projectile.DeltaMovement

	if Hit and Projectile.Type == "EnderPearl" then
		for _ = 1, 32 do
			Particles.Add(PortalOptions, Hit + vector.create(0, Generator:NextNumber() * 2, 0), vector.create(Particles.NextGaussian(), 0, Particles.NextGaussian()))
		end
	end

	const YRot, XRot = Flight.FacingOf(Projectile.DeltaMovement)

	Projectile.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.XRot, XRot)
	Projectile.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.YRot, YRot)
	UpdateFluids(Projectile)
end

const function TickWindCharge(Projectile: Projectile)
	const Hit = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Projectile.Position, Projectile.DeltaMovement)

	Projectile.Position = Hit or Projectile.Position + Projectile.DeltaMovement
end

const function TickRocket(Projectile: Projectile)
	if Projectile.Data > 0 then
		const Attached = Players.Entities[Projectile.Data]

		if not Attached then
			return
		end

		local HandAngle = vector.zero

		if Players.IsFallFlying(Attached) then
			const Look = Flight.ViewDirection(Attached.XRot, Attached.YRot, 0)
			const Motion = Attached.DeltaMovement

			Attached.DeltaMovement = Motion + Look * RocketBoostPull + (Look * RocketBoost - Motion) * 0.5
			HandAngle = Flight.RocketHandAngle(Players.ItemBySlot(Attached, "mainhand"), Players.ItemBySlot(Attached, "offhand"), Attached.YRot)
		end

		Projectile.Position = Attached.Position + HandAngle
		Projectile.DeltaMovement = Attached.DeltaMovement

		return
	end

	if not HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.ShotAtAngle) then
		const Acceleration = if Projectile.HorizontalCollision then 1 else 1.15

		Projectile.DeltaMovement = Projectile.DeltaMovement * vector.create(Acceleration, 1, Acceleration) + vector.create(0, 0.04, 0)
	end

	const Motion = Projectile.DeltaMovement

	EntityPhysics.Move(Projectile, Motion, false)
	Projectile.DeltaMovement = Motion

	const YRot, XRot = Flight.FacingOf(Motion)

	Projectile.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.XRot, XRot)
	Projectile.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Projectile.YRot, YRot)
end

const function NearestPlayer(Position: vector): Players.PlayerEntity?
	local Nearest: Players.PlayerEntity? = nil
	local NearestDistance = OrbFollowDistance * OrbFollowDistance

	for _, Entity in Players.Entities do
		const Offset = Entity.Position - Position
		const Distance = vector.dot(Offset, Offset)

		if Distance < NearestDistance and Entity.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			Nearest = Entity
			NearestDistance = Distance
		end
	end

	return if Nearest and Nearest.Health > 0 then Nearest else nil
end

const function TickOrb(Projectile: Projectile)
	const Min, Max = EntityPhysics.BoxAt(Projectile.Position, OrbSize, OrbSize)

	UpdateFluids(Projectile)

	if Projectile.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		const Movement = Projectile.DeltaMovement

		Projectile.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x * OrbWaterInertia, math.min(Movement.y + OrbFluidRise, OrbFluidRiseLimit), Movement.z * OrbWaterInertia)
	elseif Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min, Max) then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, OrbGravity, 0)
	end

	if EntityPhysics.FluidAt(Projectile.Position) == "Lava" then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement = vector.create((Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) - Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber())) * OrbLavaHop, OrbLavaHop, (Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) - Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber())) * OrbLavaHop)
	end

	local Target = Projectile.Following

	if not Target or Players.Entities[Target.Id] ~= Target or Target.GameMode == "spectator" or vector.dot(Target.Position - Projectile.Position, Target.Position - Projectile.Position) > OrbFollowDistance * OrbFollowDistance then
		Target = NearestPlayer(Projectile.Position)
		Projectile.Following = Target
	end

	if Target then
		const Delta = Target.Position + vector.create(0, Target.EyeHeight / 2, 0) - Projectile.Position
		const Power = 1 - vector.magnitude(Delta) / OrbFollowDistance

		Projectile.DeltaMovement += Mth.Normalize(Delta) * (Power * Power * 0.1)
	end

	const FallSpeed = Projectile.DeltaMovement.y

	EntityPhysics.Move(Projectile, Projectile.DeltaMovement, false)

	local Friction = OrbDrag

	if Projectile.OnGround then
		const Block = EntityPhysics.SupportingBlock(Projectile)

		Friction = Mth.Float(Friction * (if Block then Block.Friction else Mth.Float(0.6)))
	end

	Projectile.DeltaMovement *= Friction

	if Projectile.VerticalCollisionBelow and FallSpeed < -OrbGravity then
		Projectile.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Projectile.DeltaMovement.x, -FallSpeed * 0.4, Projectile.DeltaMovement.z)
	end
end

const function Tick()
	for Id, Projectile in Projectiles do
		Projectile.PositionO = Projectile.Position
		Projectile.YRotO = Projectile.YRot
		Projectile.XRotO = Projectile.XRot
		Projectile.Age += 1

		if Projectile.Collector then
			Projectile.PickupAge += 1

			if Projectile.PickupAge >= PickupTicks then
				Destroy(Projectile)
			end

			continue
		end

		const Type = Projectile.Type

		if Type == "Arrow" or Type == "SpectralArrow" or Type == "Trident" then
			TickArrow(Projectile)

			if not HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround) then
				TippedParticles(Projectile, 2)
			elseif Projectile.InGroundTime % 5 == 0 then
				TippedParticles(Projectile, 1)
			end
		elseif Type == "WindCharge" then
			TickWindCharge(Projectile)
		elseif Type == "FireworkRocket" then
			TickRocket(Projectile)
			Particles.Add(SparkOptions, Projectile.Position, vector.create(Particles.NextGaussian() * 0.05, -Projectile.DeltaMovement.y * 0.5, Particles.NextGaussian() * 0.05))
		elseif Type == "ExperienceOrb" then
			if Projectile.Age > 1 then
				TickOrb(Projectile)
			end
		elseif Type == "AreaEffectCloud" then
			CloudParticles(Projectile)
		else
			TickThrown(Projectile)
		end
	end
end

const function DecodeAxis(Base: number, Delta: number): number
	return if Delta == 0 then Base else Protocol.DecodeCoordinate(Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Base) + Delta)
end

const function Move(Id: number, StepCount: number, Deltas: { vector }, HasPosition: boolean, HasRotation: boolean, YRot: number, XRot: number, OnGround: boolean)
	const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

	if not Projectile then
		return
	end

	if HasPosition then
		local Base = Projectile.PositionBase

		for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
			const Delta = Deltas[Index]

			Base = vector.create(DecodeAxis(Base.x, Delta.x), DecodeAxis(Base.y, Delta.y), DecodeAxis(Base.z, Delta.z))
		end

		Projectile.PositionBase = Base
		Projectile.Position = Base
	end

	if HasRotation then
		Projectile.YRot = YRot
		Projectile.XRot = XRot
	end

	Projectile.OnGround = OnGround
end

const function Sync(Id: number, Position: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number, OnGround: boolean)
	const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

	if Projectile then
		Projectile.PositionBase = Position
		Projectile.Position = Position
		Projectile.YRot = YRot
		Projectile.XRot = XRot
		Projectile.OnGround = OnGround
	end
end

const function SetMotion(Id: number, Motion: vector)
	const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

	if not Projectile then
		return
	end

	Projectile.DeltaMovement = Motion

	if HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround) and vector.dot(Motion, Motion) > 0 then
		SetFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround, false)
	end
end

const function Remove(Id: number)
	const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

	if Projectile and not Projectile.Collector then
		Destroy(Projectile)
	end
end

const function ReceiveAddressed(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	const Clientbound = Protocol.Clientbound
	const Addressed = Protocol.PeekEntityId(Reader, PacketId)

	if not Addressed or not Projectiles[Addressed] then
		return false
	end

	if PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPos or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPosRot or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityRot then
		const Id, StepCount, HasRotation, YRot, XRot, OnGround = Protocol.ReadMoveEntity(Reader, PacketId, Deltas, Ticks)

		Move(Id, StepCount, Deltas, PacketId ~= Clientbound.MoveEntityRot, HasRotation, YRot, XRot, OnGround)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.EntityPositionSync then
		const Id, StepCount, YRot, XRot, OnGround = Protocol.ReadEntityPositionSync(Reader, Positions, Ticks)

		Sync(Id, Positions[math.max(StepCount, 1)], YRot, XRot, OnGround)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetEntityMotion then
		const Id, Motion = Protocol.ReadSetEntityMotion(Reader)

		SetMotion(Id, Motion)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.EntityEvent then
		const Id, Event = Protocol.ReadEntityEvent(Reader)
		const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

		if Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.ThrownHit and (Projectile.Type == "Snowball" or Projectile.Type == "Egg") then
			const Options: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = if Minecraft.Items.IsEmpty(Projectile.Stack) then { Type = "item_snowball" } else { Type = "item", Item = Projectile.Stack }

			for _ = 1, 8 do
				const Speed = if Projectile.Type == "Egg" then vector.create(Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5, Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5, Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 0.08 else vector.zero

				Particles.Add(Options, Projectile.Position, Speed)
			end
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.FireworkExplode and Projectile.Type == "FireworkRocket" then
			const Fireworks = Minecraft.Items.Get(Projectile.Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { explosions: { { [string]: unknown } }? }?

			Particles.CreateFireworks(Projectile.Position, Projectile.DeltaMovement, if Fireworks then Fireworks.explosions or {} else {}, true)
		elseif Event == Protocol.EntityEvents.TippedArrowParticles then
			TippedParticles(Projectile, 20)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.TakeItemEntity then
		const CollectedId, CollectorId = Protocol.ReadTakeItemEntity(Reader)
		const Projectile = Projectiles[CollectedId]

		if Projectile.Type == "ExperienceOrb" then
			Sounds.Play("entity.experience_orb.pickup", Projectile.Position, 0.1, (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber()) * 0.35 + 0.9)
		else
			Sounds.Play("entity.item.pickup", Projectile.Position, 0.2, (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber()) * 1.4 + 2)
		end

		if not Projectile.Collector then
			Projectile.Collector = CollectorId
			Projectile.PickupAge = 0
			Projectile.PickupStart = Projectile.Position
		end
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	const Clientbound = Protocol.Clientbound

	if ReceiveAddressed(PacketId, Reader) then
		return true
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.AddProjectile then
		const Id, Type, Position, Motion, YRot, XRot, Owner, Stack, Data = Protocol.ReadAddProjectile(Reader)

		Remove(Id)
		Create(Id, TypeNames[Type] or "Snowball", Position, Motion, YRot, XRot, Owner, Stack, Data)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.AddExperienceOrb then
		const Id, Position, Value = Protocol.ReadAddExperienceOrb(Reader)

		Remove(Id)
		Create(Id, "ExperienceOrb", Position, vector.zero, 0, 0, 0, Minecraft.Items.Empty, Value)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.AddAreaEffectCloud then
		const Id, Position, Radius, Color = Protocol.ReadAddAreaEffectCloud(Reader)

		Remove(Id)

		const Cloud = Create(Id, "AreaEffectCloud", Position, vector.zero, 0, 0, 0, Minecraft.Items.Empty, Color)

		Cloud.Width = Radius * 2
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetCloudData then
		const Id, Radius, Waiting = Protocol.ReadSetCloudData(Reader)
		const Cloud = Projectiles[Id]

		if Cloud then
			Cloud.Width = Radius * 2
			Cloud.Waiting = Waiting
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetProjectileData then
		const Id, FlagsValue, Data = Protocol.ReadSetProjectileData(Reader)
		const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

		if Projectile then
			const WasInGround = HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround)

			Projectile.Flags = FlagsValue
			Projectile.Data = Data

			if not WasInGround and HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.InGround) and Projectile.ShakeTime <= 0 and Projectile.Age > 1 then
				Projectile.ShakeTime = ShakeTicks
			end
		end
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function ArrowFrame(Projectile: Projectile, Position: vector, Partial: number): CFrame
	const YRot = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Projectile.YRotO, Projectile.YRot)
	const XRot = Mth.Lerp(Partial, Projectile.XRotO, Projectile.XRot)
	local Shake = 0
	const Remaining = Projectile.ShakeTime - Partial

	if Projectile.Type ~= "Trident" and Remaining > 0 then
		Shake = -Mth.Sin(Remaining * 3) * Remaining * DegreesToRadians
	end

	const Base = CFrame.new(Position * StudsPerBlock) * CFrame.Angles(0, (YRot - 90) * DegreesToRadians, 0)

	if Projectile.Type == "Trident" then
		return Base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, (XRot + 90) * DegreesToRadians)
	end

	return Base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, XRot * DegreesToRadians) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, Shake)
end

const function DrawRigs(Projectile: Projectile, Wanted: { RigKey }): boolean
	for Index, Key in Wanted do
		if Projectile.RigKeys[Index] ~= Key then
			if Projectile.Rigs[Index] then
				ReturnRig(Projectile.RigKeys[Index], Projectile.Rigs[Index])
				Projectile.Rigs[Index] = nil
			end

			const Taken = TakeRig(Key)

			if not Taken then
				return false
			end

			Projectile.Rigs[Index] = Taken
			Projectile.RigKeys[Index] = Key

			for _, Instance in Taken.Instances do
				Instance.Parent = Projectile.Folder
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

const WantedKeys: { RigKey } = {}

const function HiddenNearCamera(Projectile: Projectile, CameraAt: vector): boolean
	const Type = Projectile.Type

	if Projectile.Age >= MinimumRenderAge or Type == "Arrow" or Type == "SpectralArrow" or Type == "Trident" or Type == "FireworkRocket" or Type == "ExperienceOrb" or Type == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		return false
	end

	const Offset = Projectile.Position - CameraAt

	return vector.dot(Offset, Offset) < MinimumCameraDistanceSquared
end

const function DrawProjectile(Projectile: Projectile, Partial: number, CameraRotation: CFrame, CameraAt: vector)
	local Position = Projectile.PositionO + (Projectile.Position - Projectile.PositionO) * Partial

	if Projectile.Collector then
		const Collector = Players.Entities[Projectile.Collector]

		if Collector then
			const Target = Collector.PositionO + (Collector.Position - Collector.PositionO) * Partial + vector.create(0, Collector.EyeHeight / 2, 0)
			const Progress = math.min((Projectile.PickupAge + Partial) / PickupTicks, 1)

			Position = Projectile.PickupStart + (Target - Projectile.PickupStart) * (Progress * Progress)
		end
	end

	const Type = Projectile.Type
	const Holder = Projectile.Holder

	if Holder and Type == "FireworkRocket" and Projectile.Data > 0 then
		HeldItems.Hide(Holder)

		return
	end

	if HiddenNearCamera(Projectile, CameraAt) then
		if Holder then
			HeldItems.Hide(Holder)
		end

		for _, Rig in Projectile.Rigs do
			Rig.Visible = false
			Rendering.DrawRig(Rig, CFrame.new(Position * StudsPerBlock), false)
		end

		return
	end

	if Holder then
		ItemContext.Seed = Projectile.Id
		ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, Projectile.Stack, ItemContext)
		HeldItems.Update(Holder, ItemState)

		local Root = CFrame.new(Position * StudsPerBlock) * CameraRotation

		if Type == "FireworkRocket" and HasFlag(Projectile, Flags.ShotAtAngle) then
			Root *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, HalfTurn) * CFrame.Angles(0, HalfTurn, 0) * CFrame.Angles(HalfTurn / 2, 0, 0)
		end

		HeldItems.Draw(Holder, Root, true)

		return
	end

	WantedRigs(Projectile, WantedKeys)

	if #WantedKeys == 0 or not DrawRigs(Projectile, WantedKeys) then
		return
	end

	if Type == "WindCharge" then
		const Age = Projectile.Age + Partial
		const Root = CFrame.new(Position * StudsPerBlock)
		const Wind = Projectile.Rigs[1]
		const Core = Projectile.Rigs[2]

		Wind.Visible = true
		Core.Visible = true
		Rendering.DrawRig(Wind, Root * CFrame.Angles(0, Age * WindSpinDegrees * DegreesToRadians + WindRestTurn, 0), false)
		Rendering.DrawRig(Core, Root * CFrame.Angles(0, -Age * WindSpinDegrees * DegreesToRadians, 0), false)
	elseif Type == "ExperienceOrb" then
		const Rig = Projectile.Rigs[1]
		const Phase = (Projectile.Age + Partial) / 2
		const Red = (((Mth.Sin(Phase) + 1) * 0.5 * 255) // 1) / 255
		const Blue = (((Mth.Sin(Phase + math.pi * 4 / 3) + 1) * 0.1 * 255) // 1) / 255

		Rig.Visible = true
		Rendering.DrawRig(Rig, CFrame.new((Position + vector.create(0, OrbLift, 0)) * StudsPerBlock) * CameraRotation, false, vector.create(Red, 1, Blue))
	else
		const Rig = Projectile.Rigs[1]

		Rig.Visible = true
		Rendering.DrawRig(Rig, ArrowFrame(Projectile, Position, Partial), false)
	end
end

const function Draw(Partial: number)
	const CameraFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	const CameraAt = vector.create(CameraFrame.X, CameraFrame.Y, CameraFrame.Z) / StudsPerBlock

	for _, Projectile in Projectiles do
		DrawProjectile(Projectile, Partial, CameraFrame.Rotation, CameraAt)
	end
end

const function Bounds(Id: number): (vector?, number, number)
	const Projectile = Projectiles[Id]

	if not Projectile then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end

	return Projectile.Position, Projectile.Width, Projectile.Height
end

return {
	Receive = Receive,
	Remove = Remove,
	Tick = Tick,
	Draw = Draw,
	Bounds = Bounds,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Shadows"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Rendering = require("./Rendering")
const Textures = require("./Textures")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Collision = Minecraft.Collision
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const InitialPieces = 256
const MaximumPieces = 10000
const PartTransparency = 0.02
const AlphaScale = 1 / (1 - PartTransparency)
const LiftStuds = 0.01
const MaxDistanceSquared = 256
const PoolExtent = 18
const MinimumBrightness = 3
const TopTolerance = 1.0E-3

type Pool = {
	Mesh: EditableMesh,
	Instance: MeshPart,
	VertexIds: { number },
	UVIds: { number },
	ColorIds: { number },
	Capacity: number,
	Used: number,
}

const ShadowTexture = Textures.Texture("minecraft:misc/shadow")
const ShadowImage = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = ShadowTexture.Size })
const Container = Instance.new("Folder")

local Current: Pool? = nil
local Growing = false
local Origin = vector.zero
local CameraPosition = vector.zero
local Pieces = 0
local Wanted = 0

ShadowImage:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, ShadowTexture.Size, ShadowTexture.Pixels)
Container.Name = "MinecraftShadows"
Container.Parent = workspace

const function SetQuad(Pool: Pool, Piece: number, Base: vector, X0: number, X1: number, Y: number, Z0: number, Z1: number, Radius: number, Alpha: number, Slope: vector, CenterX: number, CenterZ: number)
	const Mesh = Pool.Mesh
	const First = (Piece - 1) * 4
	const U0 = -X0 / 2 / Radius + 0.5
	const U1 = -X1 / 2 / Radius + 0.5
	const V0 = -Z0 / 2 / Radius + 0.5
	const V1 = -Z1 / 2 / Radius + 0.5
	const Rise0 = Slope.x * (X0 - CenterX)
	const Rise1 = Slope.x * (X1 - CenterX)
	const Run0 = Slope.z * (Z0 - CenterZ)
	const Run1 = Slope.z * (Z1 - CenterZ)
	const Left = (Base.x + X0) * StudsPerBlock
	const Right = (Base.x + X1) * StudsPerBlock
	const Near = (Base.z + Z0) * StudsPerBlock
	const Far = (Base.z + Z1) * StudsPerBlock
	const Height = (Base.y + Y) * StudsPerBlock + LiftStuds

	Mesh:SetPosition(Pool.VertexIds[First + 1], vector.create(Left, Height + (Rise0 + Run0) * StudsPerBlock, Near))
	Mesh:SetPosition(Pool.VertexIds[First + 2], vector.create(Left, Height + (Rise0 + Run1) * StudsPerBlock, Far))
	Mesh:SetPosition(Pool.VertexIds[First + 3], vector.create(Right, Height + (Rise1 + Run1) * StudsPerBlock, Far))
	Mesh:SetPosition(Pool.VertexIds[First + 4], vector.create(Right, Height + (Rise1 + Run0) * StudsPerBlock, Near))
	Mesh:SetUV(Pool.UVIds[First + 1], Vector2.new(U0, V0))
	Mesh:SetUV(Pool.UVIds[First + 2], Vector2.new(U0, V1))
	Mesh:SetUV(Pool.UVIds[First + 3], Vector2.new(U1, V1))
	Mesh:SetUV(Pool.UVIds[First + 4], Vector2.new(U1, V0))
	Mesh:SetColorAlpha(Pool.ColorIds[Piece], math.min(Alpha * AlphaScale, 1))
end

const function Collapse(Pool: Pool, Keep: number)
	for Piece = Keep + 1, Pool.Used do
		const First = (Piece - 1) * 4

		for Corner = 1, 4 do
			Pool.Mesh:SetPosition(Pool.VertexIds[First + Corner], vector.zero)
		end
	end

	Pool.Used = Keep
end

const function Grow(Capacity: number)
	const Mesh = Rendering.CreateEditableMesh()
	const VertexIds: { number } = {}
	const UVIds: { number } = {}
	const ColorIds: { number } = {}
	const Bound = PoolExtent * StudsPerBlock

	if not Mesh then
		Growing = false

		return
	end

	for Piece = 1, Capacity do
		const Corner = if Piece == 1 then -Bound elseif Piece == 2 then Bound else 0
		const ColorId = Mesh:AddColor(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
		const Ids: { number } = {}
		const UVs: { number } = {}

		for Index = 1, 4 do
			Ids[Index] = Mesh:AddVertex(vector.one * Corner)
			UVs[Index] = Mesh:AddUV(Vector2.zero)
			table.insert(VertexIds, Ids[Index])
			table.insert(UVIds, UVs[Index])
		end

		const First = Mesh:AddTriangle(Ids[1], Ids[2], Ids[3])
		const Second = Mesh:AddTriangle(Ids[1], Ids[3], Ids[4])

		Mesh:SetFaceUVs(First, { UVs[1], UVs[2], UVs[3] })
		Mesh:SetFaceUVs(Second, { UVs[1], UVs[3], UVs[4] })
		Mesh:SetFaceColors(First, { ColorId, ColorId, ColorId })
		Mesh:SetFaceColors(Second, { ColorId, ColorId, ColorId })
		table.insert(ColorIds, ColorId)
	end

	const Made, Instance = pcall(AssetService.CreateMeshPartAsync, AssetService, Content.fromObject(Mesh))

	if not Made then
		Mesh:Destroy()
		Growing = false

		return
	end

	Instance.Name = "Shadows"
	Instance.Anchored = true
	Instance.CanCollide = false
	Instance.CanTouch = false
	Instance.CanQuery = false
	Instance.CastShadow = false
	Instance.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	Instance.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Instance.Transparency = PartTransparency
	Instance.TextureContent = Content.fromObject(ShadowImage)
	Instance.Parent = Container

	const Created: Pool = {
		Mesh = Mesh,
		Instance = Instance,
		VertexIds = VertexIds,
		UVIds = UVIds,
		ColorIds = ColorIds,
		Capacity = Capacity,
		Used = 2,
	}

	Collapse(Created, 0)

	if Current then
		Current.Instance:Destroy()
		Current.Mesh:Destroy()
	end

	Current = Created
	Growing = false
end

const function Begin()
	const CameraFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame

	CameraPosition = vector.create(CameraFrame.X, CameraFrame.Y, CameraFrame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
	Origin = vector.floor(CameraPosition)
	Pieces = 0
	Wanted = 0
end

const function Draw(Position: vector, Radius: number, Strength: number)
	const Pool = Current
	const ToCamera = Position - CameraPosition
	const Power = Mth.Float((1 - vector.dot(ToCamera, ToCamera) / MaxDistanceSquared) * Strength)
	const RawBrightness = Rendering.MaxLocalRawBrightness()

	if not Pool or Power <= 0 or RawBrightness <= MinimumBrightness then
		return
	end

	const Base = Position - Origin
	const Depth = math.min(Mth.Float(Power / 0.5 - 1), Radius)
	const LowestTop = (Position.y - Depth) // 1
	const LightBrightness = Rendering.Brightness(RawBrightness)
	const Count = Collision.Gather(vector.create(Position.x - Radius, LowestTop, Position.z - Radius), vector.create(Position.x + Radius, Position.y + TopTolerance, Position.z + Radius))

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const Min = Collision.Mins[Index]
		const Max = Collision.Maxs[Index]
		const Top = Max.y
		const X0 = math.max(Min.x, Position.x - Radius) - Position.x
		const X1 = math.min(Max.x, Position.x + Radius) - Position.x
		const Z0 = math.max(Min.z, Position.z - Radius) - Position.z
		const Z1 = math.min(Max.z, Position.z + Radius) - Position.z

		if Top < LowestTop or Top > Position.y + TopTolerance or X0 >= X1 or Z0 >= Z1 then
			continue
		end

		const PowerAtDepth = Power - Mth.Float(Position.y - Top) * 0.5
		const Alpha = Mth.Clamp(PowerAtDepth * 0.5 * LightBrightness, 0, 1)

		if Alpha <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		Wanted += 1

		if Pieces < Pool.Capacity then
			Pieces += 1
			SetQuad(Pool, Pieces, Base, X0, X1, Top - Position.y, Z0, Z1, Radius, Alpha, Collision.Slopes[Index], (Min.x + Max.x) / 2 - Position.x, (Min.z + Max.z) / 2 - Position.z)
		end
	end
end

const function Finish()
	const Pool = Current

	if not Pool then
		return
	end

	if Pieces > Pool.Used then
		Pool.Used = Pieces
	end

	Collapse(Pool, Pieces)
	Pool.Instance.CFrame = CFrame.new(Origin * StudsPerBlock)

	if Wanted > Pool.Capacity and Pool.Capacity < MaximumPieces and not Growing then
		Growing = true
		task.spawn(Grow, math.min(Wanted * 2, MaximumPieces))
	end
end

Growing = true
task.spawn(Grow, InitialPieces)

return {
	Begin = Begin,
	Draw = Draw,
	Finish = Finish,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Skins"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")

export type Skin = Minecraft.Skin

const Assigned: { [string]: Skin } = {}

const DefaultSkins: { Skin } = {
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/alex", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/ari", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/efe", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/kai", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/makena", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/noor", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/steve", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/sunny", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/slim/zuri", Slim = true },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/alex", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/ari", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/efe", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/kai", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/makena", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/noor", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/steve", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/sunny", Slim = false },
	{ Texture = "minecraft:entity/player/wide/zuri", Slim = false },
}

const DefaultSkinIndex = 7

const function ForHash(Hash: number): Skin
	const Signed = if Hash >= 0x80000000 then Hash - 0x100000000 else Hash

	return DefaultSkins[Signed % #DefaultSkins + 1]
end

const function OfflineHash(Name: string): number
	const Digest = Minecraft.Uuid.Offline(Name)

	return bit32.bxor(
		bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(Digest, 0)),
		bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(Digest, 4)),
		bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(Digest, 8)),
		bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(Digest, 12))
	)
end

const function UuidHash(Id: unknown): number
	if type(Id) == "table" then
		const Words = Id :: { number }

		return bit32.bxor(Words[1] % 0x100000000, Words[2] % 0x100000000, Words[3] % 0x100000000, Words[4] % 0x100000000)
	end

	const Hex = (string.gsub(Id :: string, "-", ""))

	return bit32.bxor(tonumber(string.sub(Hex, 1, 8), 16) :: number, tonumber(string.sub(Hex, 9, 16), 16) :: number, tonumber(string.sub(Hex, 17, 24), 16) :: number, tonumber(string.sub(Hex, 25, 32), 16) :: number)
end

const function Assign(Name: string, Skin: Skin?)
	Assigned[Name] = Skin
end

const function ForName(Name: string): Skin
	return Assigned[Name] or ForHash(OfflineHash(Name))
end

const function ForProfile(Profile: unknown, IsAvailable: (string) -> boolean): string
	if type(Profile) == "string" then
		return ForName(Profile).Texture
	end

	const Fields = Profile :: { name: string?, id: unknown?, texture: string? }
	const Override = Fields.texture

	if Override and IsAvailable(Override) then
		return Override
	end

	if Fields.id ~= nil then
		return ForHash(UuidHash(Fields.id)).Texture
	elseif Fields.name then
		return ForName(Fields.name).Texture
	end

	return ForHash(0).Texture
end

return {
	Default = DefaultSkins[DefaultSkinIndex],
	Assign = Assign,
	ForName = ForName,
	ForProfile = ForProfile,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Equipment"] = function(require)

const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Assets = require("@self/Assets")
const Textures = require("./Textures")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

export type LayerType = "humanoid" | "humanoid_leggings" | "wings"

type Layer = {
	texture: string,
	dyeable: { color_when_undyed: number? }?,
	use_player_texture: boolean?,
}

type TrimOverride = {
	when: { material: string },
	palette: string?,
	texture: string?,
}

type Equippable = {
	slot: string,
	asset_id: string?,
	camera_overlay: string?,
}

const AlphaCutout = 26
const Opaque = 0xFF000000
const White = -1

const TrimPrefixes: { [LayerType]: string? } = {
	humanoid = "trims/entity/humanoid",
	humanoid_leggings = "trims/entity/humanoid_leggings",
}

const Merged: { [string]: Textures.Texture | false } = {}
const Palettes: { [string]: { [number]: number } } = {}

const function Path(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, ":(.*)$") or Id) :: string
end

const function Namespace(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, "^(.-):") or "minecraft") :: string
end

const function EquippableOf(Stack: ItemStack): Equippable?
	return Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: Equippable?
end

const function ShouldRender(Stack: ItemStack, Slot: string): boolean
	const Equippable = EquippableOf(Stack)

	return Equippable ~= nil and Equippable.asset_id ~= nil and Equippable.slot == Slot
end

const function CameraOverlay(Stack: ItemStack, Slot: string): string?
	const Equippable = EquippableOf(Stack)

	if not Equippable or Equippable.slot ~= Slot or not Equippable.camera_overlay then
		return nil
	end

	const Overlay = Equippable.camera_overlay :: string

	return `{Namespace(Overlay)}:{Path(Overlay)}`
end

const function LayerColor(Layer: Layer, Dye: number): number
	const Dyeable = Layer.dyeable

	if not Dyeable then
		return White
	elseif Dye ~= 0 then
		return Dye
	end

	const Undyed = Dyeable.color_when_undyed

	return if Undyed then bit32.bor(Undyed, Opaque) else 0
end

const function PaletteMap(Base: string, Target: string): { [number]: number }
	const Key = `{Base}>{Target}`
	const Existing = Palettes[Key]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const BaseTexture = Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Base)}:palettes/{Path(Base)}`)
	const TargetTexture = Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Target)}:palettes/{Path(Target)}`)
	const Map: { [number]: number } = {}

	for Offset = 0, buffer.len(BaseTexture.Pixels) - 4, 4 do
		const Color = buffer.readu32(BaseTexture.Pixels, Offset)

		if bit32.rshift(Color, 24) ~= 0 then
			Map[bit32.bor(Color, Opaque)] = buffer.readu32(TargetTexture.Pixels, Offset)
		end
	end

	Palettes[Key] = Map

	return Map
end

const function Paint(Out: buffer, Source: Textures.Texture, Color: number, Palette: { [number]: number }?)
	const Red = bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8) / 255
	const Green = bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8) / 255
	const Blue = bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8) / 255
	const Pixels = Source.Pixels

	for Offset = 0, buffer.len(Pixels) - 4, 4 do
		local Texel = buffer.readu32(Pixels, Offset)
		local Alpha = bit32.rshift(Texel, 24)

		if Palette and Alpha ~= 0 then
			const Mapped = Palette[bit32.bor(Texel, Opaque)]

			if Mapped then
				Alpha = Alpha * bit32.rshift(Mapped, 24) // 255
				Texel = bit32.bor(bit32.band(Mapped, 0xFFFFFF), bit32.lshift(Alpha, 24))
			end
		end

		if Alpha >= AlphaCutout then
			buffer.writeu8(Out, Offset, math.round(bit32.extract(Texel, 0, 8) * Red))
			buffer.writeu8(Out, Offset + 1, math.round(bit32.extract(Texel, 8, 8) * Green))
			buffer.writeu8(Out, Offset + 2, math.round(bit32.extract(Texel, 16, 8) * Blue))
			buffer.writeu8(Out, Offset + 3, 255)
		end
	end
end

const function MaterialId(Material: unknown): string?
	return if type(Material) == "string" then Material else nil
end

const function TrimTexture(Trim: { material: unknown, pattern: unknown }, LayerType: LayerType, Asset: { TrimOverrides: { TrimOverride }? }): (string?, string?)
	const Prefix = TrimPrefixes[LayerType]
	const MaterialName = MaterialId(Trim.material)
	const Material = if type(Trim.material) == "table" then Trim.material :: { [string]: unknown } else (MaterialName and Registry.DatapackEntry("minecraft:trim_material", MaterialName))
	const Pattern = if type(Trim.pattern) == "table" then Trim.pattern :: { [string]: unknown } else Registry.DatapackEntry("minecraft:trim_pattern", Trim.pattern :: string)

	if not Prefix or not Material or not Pattern then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local TextureId = Pattern.asset_id :: string
	local PaletteId: string? = Material.palette_id :: string

	for _, Override in Asset.TrimOverrides or {} do
		if Override.when.material == MaterialName then
			TextureId = Override.texture or TextureId
			PaletteId = Override.palette
			break
		end
	end

	return `{Namespace(TextureId)}:{Prefix}/{Path(TextureId)}`, PaletteId
end

const function ValueKey(Value: unknown): string
	return if type(Value) == "string" then Value else HttpService:JSONEncode(Value)
end

const function Merge(Asset: { Layers: unknown, TrimOverrides: unknown? }, Layers: { Layer }, LayerType: LayerType, Dye: number, Trim: { material: unknown, pattern: unknown }?): Textures.Texture?
	const Passes: { { Texture: string, Color: number } } = {}

	for _, Layer in Layers do
		const Color = LayerColor(Layer, Dye)

		if Color ~= 0 then
			table.insert(Passes, { Texture = `{Namespace(Layer.texture)}:entity/equipment/{LayerType}/{Path(Layer.texture)}`, Color = Color })
		end
	end

	local TrimId: string? = nil
	local TrimPalette: string? = nil

	if Trim then
		TrimId, TrimPalette = TrimTexture(Trim, LayerType, Asset :: { TrimOverrides: { TrimOverride }? })
	end

	if #Passes == 0 and not TrimId then
		return nil
	end

	const Size = Textures.Texture(Passes[1] and Passes[1].Texture or TrimId :: string).Size
	const Pixels = buffer.create(Size.X * Size.Y * 4)

	for _, Pass in Passes do
		Paint(Pixels, Textures.Texture(Pass.Texture), Pass.Color, nil)
	end

	if TrimId then
		const BasePalette = Textures.BasePalette(TrimId)

		Paint(Pixels, Textures.Texture(TrimId), White, if BasePalette and TrimPalette then PaletteMap(BasePalette, TrimPalette) else nil)
	end

	return { Size = Size, Pixels = Pixels }
end

const function Texture(Stack: ItemStack, LayerType: LayerType): Textures.Texture?
	const Equippable = EquippableOf(Stack)
	const AssetId = Equippable and Equippable.asset_id
	const Asset = AssetId and Assets[AssetId]
	const Layers = Asset and (Asset.Layers :: { [string]: { Layer } })[LayerType]

	if not Asset or not Layers or #Layers == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const Dyed = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:dyed_color") :: number?
	const Dye = if Dyed then bit32.bor(Dyed, Opaque) else 0
	const Trim = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:trim") :: { material: unknown, pattern: unknown }?
	const Key = if Trim then `{AssetId}|{LayerType}|{Dye}|{ValueKey(Trim.material)}|{ValueKey(Trim.pattern)}` else `{AssetId}|{LayerType}|{Dye}`
	local Existing = Merged[Key]

	if Existing == nil then
		Existing = Merge(Asset, Layers, LayerType, Dye, Trim) or false
		Merged[Key] = Existing
	end

	return if Existing then Existing else nil
end

return {
	ShouldRender = ShouldRender,
	CameraOverlay = CameraOverlay,
	Texture = Texture,
}

end
