_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("@self/Canvas")
const ChatComponent = require("@self/ChatComponent")
const Hud = require("@self/Hud")
const ItemRenderer = require("@self/ItemRenderer")
const ScreenEffects = require("@self/ScreenEffects")
const SpectatorMenu = require("@self/SpectatorMenu")
const Toasts = require("@self/Toasts")

const MinimumWidth = 320
const MinimumHeight = 240

local Screen: ScreenGui? = nil

const function ScreenGui(): ScreenGui
	if Screen then
		return Screen
	end

	const Created = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	const Container = Instance.new("Frame")

	Created.Name = "Minecraft"
	Created.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	Created.ResetOnSpawn = false
	Created.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None
	Created.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	Container.Name = "Canvas"
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	Container.Parent = Created
	Canvas.Attach(Container)
	Created.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	Screen = Created

	return Created
end

const function GuiScale(Width: number, Height: number): number
	local Scale = 1

	while Scale < Width and Scale < Height and Width // (Scale + 1) >= MinimumWidth and Height // (Scale + 1) >= MinimumHeight do
		Scale += 1
	end

	return Scale
end

const function Tick(Player: Hud.Player)
	Hud.Tick(Player)
	ChatComponent.Tick()
end

const function BeginFrame(Cooldowns: Minecraft.Cooldowns?, Partial: number): (number, number, number)
	const Size = ScreenGui().AbsoluteSize
	const Scale = GuiScale(Size.X, Size.Y)

	Canvas.BeginFrame(Scale)
	ItemRenderer.BeginFrame(Cooldowns, Partial)

	return math.ceil(Size.X / Scale), math.ceil(Size.Y / Scale), Scale
end

const function DrawHud(Player: Hud.Player, Width: number, Height: number, Partial: number, FirstPerson: boolean, AttackStrength: number, MaxAttackIndicator: boolean, ScreenShowsEffects: boolean)
	Hud.Draw(Player, Width, Height, Partial, FirstPerson, AttackStrength, MaxAttackIndicator, ScreenShowsEffects)
end

const function DrawToasts(Width: number)
	Toasts.Update()

	if not Hud.IsHidden() then
		Toasts.Draw(Width)
	end
end

const function EndFrame()
	Canvas.EndFrame()
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId ~= Minecraft.Protocol.Clientbound.AwardAdvancement then
		return false
	end

	Toasts.AddAdvancement(Minecraft.Protocol.ReadAwardAdvancement(Reader))

	return true
end

return {
	ScreenGui = ScreenGui,
	Tick = Tick,
	BeginFrame = BeginFrame,
	DrawScreenEffects = ScreenEffects.Draw,
	DrawFireOverlay = ScreenEffects.DrawFire,
	DrawHud = DrawHud,
	DrawToasts = DrawToasts,
	EndFrame = EndFrame,
	Receive = Receive,
	ToggleHidden = Hud.ToggleHidden,
	IsHidden = Hud.IsHidden,
	SetOverlayMessage = Hud.SetOverlayMessage,
	SpectatorHotbarSelected = SpectatorMenu.HotbarSelected,
	SpectatorActionKeyPressed = SpectatorMenu.ActionKeyPressed,
	SpectatorMenuActive = SpectatorMenu.IsActive,
	SpectatorScrolled = SpectatorMenu.Scrolled,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Canvas"] = function(require)

const Textures = require("../Textures")

type Sprite = Textures.Sprite

type Element = {
	Label: ImageLabel,
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	U: number,
	V: number,
	UWidth: number,
	VHeight: number,
	Color: number,
	ZIndex: number,
	Gradient: UIGradient?,
	GradientTop: number,
	GradientBottom: number,
	Visible: boolean,
}

type Pool = {
	Elements: { Element },
	Used: number,
}

const FillKey = "Fill"
const GradientKey = "Gradient"

const Pools: { [unknown]: Pool } = {}
const ScissorStack: { number } = {}
local Container: Frame? = nil
local Scale = 1
local PoseScale = 1
local Drawn = 0
local GuiAtlas: Textures.Atlas? = nil

const function Atlas(): Textures.Atlas
	if not GuiAtlas then
		GuiAtlas = Textures.Atlas("gui")
	end

	return GuiAtlas :: Textures.Atlas
end

const function Attach(Parent: Frame)
	Container = Parent
end

const function NextElement(Key: unknown, Source: Content?): Element
	local Found = Pools[Key]

	if not Found then
		Found = { Elements = {}, Used = 0 }
		Pools[Key] = Found
	end

	const Target = Found :: Pool

	Target.Used += 1
	Drawn += 1

	local Element = Target.Elements[Target.Used]

	if not Element then
		const Label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

		Label.BorderSizePixel = 0
		Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		Label.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
		Label.Visible = false

		if Source then
			Label.ImageContent = Source
		else
			Label.ImageTransparency = 1
		end

		Label.Parent = Container

		Element = {
			Label = Label,
			X = math.huge,
			Y = math.huge,
			Width = -1,
			Height = -1,
			U = -1,
			V = -1,
			UWidth = -1,
			VHeight = -1,
			Color = -1,
			ZIndex = -1,
			Gradient = nil,
			GradientTop = -1,
			GradientBottom = -1,
			Visible = false,
		}

		Target.Elements[Target.Used] = Element
	end

	const Acquired = Element :: Element

	if Acquired.ZIndex ~= Drawn then
		Acquired.ZIndex = Drawn
		Acquired.Label.ZIndex = Drawn
	end

	return Acquired
end

const function EnsureGradient(Element: Element): UIGradient
	if not Element.Gradient then
		const Created = Instance.new("UIGradient")

		Created.Rotation = 90
		Created.Parent = Element.Label
		Element.Gradient = Created
	end

	return Element.Gradient :: UIGradient
end

const function ApplyColor(Element: Element, Fill: boolean, Color: number)
	if Element.Color == Color then
		return
	end

	const Alpha = bit32.extract(Color, 24, 8)
	const Tint = Color3.fromRGB(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8))

	Element.Color = Color

	if Fill then
		Element.Label.BackgroundColor3 = Tint
		Element.Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - Alpha / 255
	else
		Element.Label.ImageColor3 = Tint
		Element.Label.ImageTransparency = 1 - Alpha / 255
	end
end

const function Place(Element: Element, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number)
	const Factor = Scale * PoseScale
	const X = X0 * Factor
	const Y = Y0 * Factor
	const Width = (X1 - X0) * Factor
	const Height = (Y1 - Y0) * Factor

	if Element.X ~= X or Element.Y ~= Y then
		Element.X = X
		Element.Y = Y
		Element.Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(X, Y)
	end

	if Element.Width ~= Width or Element.Height ~= Height then
		Element.Width = Width
		Element.Height = Height
		Element.Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Width, Height)
	end

	if not Element.Visible then
		Element.Visible = true
		Element.Label.Visible = true
	end
end

const function Release(Source: Content)
	const Found = Pools[Source]

	if not Found then
		return
	end

	for _, Element in Found.Elements do
		Element.Label:Destroy()
	end

	Pools[Source] = nil
end

const function Clip(X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number): (number, number, number, number)
	const Depth = #ScissorStack

	if Depth == 0 then
		return X0, Y0, X1, Y1
	end

	return math.max(X0, ScissorStack[Depth - 3]), math.max(Y0, ScissorStack[Depth - 2]), math.min(X1, ScissorStack[Depth - 1]), math.min(Y1, ScissorStack[Depth])
end

const function Blit(Source: Content, U0: number, V0: number, U1: number, V1: number, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, Color: number)
	const ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1 = Clip(X0, Y0, X1, Y1)

	if ClippedX1 <= ClippedX0 or ClippedY1 <= ClippedY0 or bit32.extract(Color, 24, 8) == 0 then
		return
	end

	const UScale = (U1 - U0) / (X1 - X0)
	const VScale = (V1 - V0) / (Y1 - Y0)
	const U = U0 + (ClippedX0 - X0) * UScale
	const V = V0 + (ClippedY0 - Y0) * VScale
	const UWidth = (ClippedX1 - ClippedX0) * UScale
	const VHeight = (ClippedY1 - ClippedY0) * VScale
	const Element = NextElement(Source, Source)
	const Label = Element.Label

	if Element.U ~= U or Element.V ~= V then
		Element.U = U
		Element.V = V
		Label.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(U, V)
	end

	if Element.UWidth ~= UWidth or Element.VHeight ~= VHeight then
		Element.UWidth = UWidth
		Element.VHeight = VHeight
		Label.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(UWidth, VHeight)
	end

	ApplyColor(Element, false, Color)
	Place(Element, ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1)
end

const function Fill(X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, Color: number)
	const Left = math.min(X0, X1)
	const Right = math.max(X0, X1)
	const Top = math.min(Y0, Y1)
	const Bottom = math.max(Y0, Y1)
	const ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1 = Clip(Left, Top, Right, Bottom)

	if ClippedX1 <= ClippedX0 or ClippedY1 <= ClippedY0 or bit32.extract(Color, 24, 8) == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Element = NextElement(FillKey, nil)

	ApplyColor(Element, true, Color)
	Place(Element, ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1)
end

const function LerpColor(Delta: number, From: number, To: number): number
	const Alpha = math.round(bit32.extract(From, 24, 8) + (bit32.extract(To, 24, 8) - bit32.extract(From, 24, 8)) * Delta)
	const Red = math.round(bit32.extract(From, 16, 8) + (bit32.extract(To, 16, 8) - bit32.extract(From, 16, 8)) * Delta)
	const Green = math.round(bit32.extract(From, 8, 8) + (bit32.extract(To, 8, 8) - bit32.extract(From, 8, 8)) * Delta)
	const Blue = math.round(bit32.extract(From, 0, 8) + (bit32.extract(To, 0, 8) - bit32.extract(From, 0, 8)) * Delta)

	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(Alpha, 24), bit32.lshift(Red, 16), bit32.lshift(Green, 8), Blue)
end

const function FillGradient(X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, TopColor: number, BottomColor: number)
	const ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1 = Clip(X0, Y0, X1, Y1)

	if ClippedX1 <= ClippedX0 or ClippedY1 <= ClippedY0 then
		return
	end

	const Top = LerpColor((ClippedY0 - Y0) / (Y1 - Y0), TopColor, BottomColor)
	const Bottom = LerpColor((ClippedY1 - Y0) / (Y1 - Y0), TopColor, BottomColor)
	const Element = NextElement(GradientKey, nil)
	const Gradient = EnsureGradient(Element)

	ApplyColor(Element, true, 0xFFFFFFFF)

	if Element.GradientTop ~= Top or Element.GradientBottom ~= Bottom then
		Element.GradientTop = Top
		Element.GradientBottom = Bottom
		Gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
			Color3.fromRGB(bit32.extract(Top, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Top, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Top, 0, 8)),
			Color3.fromRGB(bit32.extract(Bottom, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Bottom, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Bottom, 0, 8))
		)
		Gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - bit32.extract(Top, 24, 8) / 255, 1 - bit32.extract(Bottom, 24, 8) / 255)
	end

	Place(Element, ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1)
end

const function Sprite(Id: string): Sprite
	return Textures.Sprite(Atlas(), Id)
end

const function BlitSpritePart(Sprite: Sprite, SpriteWidth: number, SpriteHeight: number, TextureX: number, TextureY: number, TextureWidth: number, TextureHeight: number, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, Color: number)
	const Frame = Textures.Frame(Sprite)
	const PixelsX = Sprite.Size.X / SpriteWidth
	const PixelsY = Sprite.Size.Y / SpriteHeight

	Blit(Textures.AtlasContent(Atlas()), Frame.X + TextureX * PixelsX, Frame.Y + TextureY * PixelsY, Frame.X + (TextureX + TextureWidth) * PixelsX, Frame.Y + (TextureY + TextureHeight) * PixelsY, X0, Y0, X1, Y1, Color)
end

const function BlitTiled(Sprite: Sprite, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, TextureX: number, TextureY: number, TileWidth: number, TileHeight: number, SpriteWidth: number, SpriteHeight: number, Color: number)
	if Width <= 0 or Height <= 0 then
		return
	end

	for TileY = Y, Y + Height - 1, TileHeight do
		const PartHeight = math.min(TileHeight, Y + Height - TileY)

		for TileX = X, X + Width - 1, TileWidth do
			const PartWidth = math.min(TileWidth, X + Width - TileX)

			BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SpriteWidth, SpriteHeight, TextureX, TextureY, PartWidth, PartHeight, TileX, TileY, TileX + PartWidth, TileY + PartHeight, Color)
		end
	end
end

const function BlitInnerSegment(Sprite: Sprite, Scaling: Textures.Scaling, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, TextureX: number, TextureY: number, TextureWidth: number, TextureHeight: number, Color: number)
	if Width <= 0 or Height <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if Scaling.StretchInner then
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, Scaling.Width, Scaling.Height, TextureX, TextureY, TextureWidth, TextureHeight, X, Y, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	else
		BlitTiled(Sprite, X, Y, Width, Height, TextureX, TextureY, TextureWidth, TextureHeight, Scaling.Width, Scaling.Height, Color)
	end
end

const function BlitNineSliced(Sprite: Sprite, Scaling: Textures.Scaling, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, Color: number)
	const Border = Scaling.Border :: { Left: number, Top: number, Right: number, Bottom: number }
	const SliceWidth = Scaling.Width
	const SliceHeight = Scaling.Height
	const Left = math.min(Border.Left, Width // 2)
	const Right = math.min(Border.Right, Width // 2)
	const Top = math.min(Border.Top, Height // 2)
	const Bottom = math.min(Border.Bottom, Height // 2)

	if Width == SliceWidth and Height == SliceHeight then
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, 0, Width, Height, X, Y, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	elseif Height == SliceHeight then
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, 0, Left, Height, X, Y, X + Left, Y + Height, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X + Left, Y, Width - Right - Left, Height, Left, 0, SliceWidth - Right - Left, SliceHeight, Color)
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, SliceWidth - Right, 0, Right, Height, X + Width - Right, Y, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	elseif Width == SliceWidth then
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, 0, Width, Top, X, Y, X + Width, Y + Top, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X, Y + Top, Width, Height - Bottom - Top, 0, Top, SliceWidth, SliceHeight - Bottom - Top, Color)
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, SliceHeight - Bottom, Width, Bottom, X, Y + Height - Bottom, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	else
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, 0, Left, Top, X, Y, X + Left, Y + Top, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X + Left, Y, Width - Right - Left, Top, Left, 0, SliceWidth - Right - Left, Top, Color)
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, SliceWidth - Right, 0, Right, Top, X + Width - Right, Y, X + Width, Y + Top, Color)
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, 0, SliceHeight - Bottom, Left, Bottom, X, Y + Height - Bottom, X + Left, Y + Height, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X + Left, Y + Height - Bottom, Width - Right - Left, Bottom, Left, SliceHeight - Bottom, SliceWidth - Right - Left, Bottom, Color)
		BlitSpritePart(Sprite, SliceWidth, SliceHeight, SliceWidth - Right, SliceHeight - Bottom, Right, Bottom, X + Width - Right, Y + Height - Bottom, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X, Y + Top, Left, Height - Bottom - Top, 0, Top, Left, SliceHeight - Bottom - Top, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X + Left, Y + Top, Width - Right - Left, Height - Bottom - Top, Left, Top, SliceWidth - Right - Left, SliceHeight - Bottom - Top, Color)
		BlitInnerSegment(Sprite, Scaling, X + Width - Right, Y + Top, Right, Height - Bottom - Top, SliceWidth - Right, Top, Right, SliceHeight - Bottom - Top, Color)
	end
end

const function BlitSprite(Id: string, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, Color: number)
	if Width == 0 or Height == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Found = Sprite(Id)
	const Scaling = Found.Scaling

	if not Scaling then
		BlitSpritePart(Found, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, X, Y, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	elseif Scaling.Type == "tile" then
		BlitTiled(Found, X, Y, Width, Height, 0, 0, Scaling.Width, Scaling.Height, Scaling.Width, Scaling.Height, Color)
	else
		BlitNineSliced(Found, Scaling, X, Y, Width, Height, Color)
	end
end

const function EnableScissor(X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number)
	const ClippedX0, ClippedY0, ClippedX1, ClippedY1 = Clip(X0, Y0, X1, Y1)

	table.insert(ScissorStack, ClippedX0)
	table.insert(ScissorStack, ClippedY0)
	table.insert(ScissorStack, ClippedX1)
	table.insert(ScissorStack, ClippedY1)
end

const function DisableScissor()
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		table.remove(ScissorStack)
	end
end

const function BlitSpriteRegion(Id: string, SpriteWidth: number, SpriteHeight: number, TextureX: number, TextureY: number, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, Color: number)
	if Width == 0 or Height == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Found = Sprite(Id)

	if not Found.Scaling then
		BlitSpritePart(Found, SpriteWidth, SpriteHeight, TextureX, TextureY, Width, Height, X, Y, X + Width, Y + Height, Color)
	else
		EnableScissor(X, Y, X + Width, Y + Height)
		BlitSprite(Id, X - TextureX, Y - TextureY, SpriteWidth, SpriteHeight, Color)
		DisableScissor()
	end
end

const function SetPoseScale(Factor: number)
	PoseScale = Factor
end

const function BeginFrame(GuiScale: number)
	Scale = GuiScale
	PoseScale = 1
	Drawn = 0
	table.clear(ScissorStack)

	for _, Target in Pools do
		Target.Used = 0
	end
end

const function GuiScale(): number
	return Scale
end

const function EndFrame()
	for _, Target in Pools do
		for Index = Target.Used + 1, #Target.Elements do
			const Element = Target.Elements[Index]

			if Element.Visible then
				Element.Visible = false
				Element.Label.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end

return {
	Attach = Attach,
	BeginFrame = BeginFrame,
	EndFrame = EndFrame,
	GuiScale = GuiScale,
	SetPoseScale = SetPoseScale,
	Blit = Blit,
	Release = Release,
	Fill = Fill,
	FillGradient = FillGradient,
	BlitSprite = BlitSprite,
	BlitSpriteRegion = BlitSpriteRegion,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/EditBox"] = function(require)

const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")

export type EditBox = {
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	MaxLength: number,
	Value: { number },
	CursorPos: number,
	HighlightPos: number,
	DisplayPos: number,
	Visible: boolean,
	Focused: boolean,
	CanLoseFocus: boolean,
	FocusedTime: number,
	TextColor: number,
	HighlightColor: number,
	SelectedColor: number,
	SelectedShadowColor: number,
	Formats: { Font.Style },
	Suggestion: string?,
	Run: Font.Formatted,
}

const SectionSign = 167
const Space = 32
const Delete = 127
const Underscore = 95
const SuggestionColor = 0xFF808080
const LineHeight = 9
const BlinkMilliseconds = 300
const ShadowScale = 0.25
const Blue = 0xFF0000FF
const Inserted: { number } = {}

const function Millis(): number
	return os.clock() * 1000 // 1
end

const function SelectedColor(Color: number, Invert: boolean): number
	const Red = bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8)
	const Green = bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8)

	return bit32.bor(Blue, bit32.lshift(if Invert then 255 - Red else Red, 16), bit32.lshift(if Invert then 255 - Green else Green, 8))
end

const function ShadowColor(Color: number): number
	return bit32.bor(
		bit32.band(Color, 0xFF000000),
		bit32.lshift(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8) * ShadowScale // 1, 16),
		bit32.lshift(bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8) * ShadowScale // 1, 8),
		bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8) * ShadowScale // 1
	)
end

const function Create(X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, MaxLength: number, TextColor: number, HighlightColor: number, InvertText: boolean): EditBox
	return {
		X = X,
		Y = Y,
		Width = Width,
		Height = Height,
		MaxLength = MaxLength,
		Value = {},
		CursorPos = 0,
		HighlightPos = 0,
		DisplayPos = 0,
		Visible = true,
		Focused = false,
		CanLoseFocus = true,
		FocusedTime = Millis(),
		TextColor = TextColor,
		HighlightColor = HighlightColor,
		SelectedColor = SelectedColor(TextColor, InvertText),
		SelectedShadowColor = SelectedColor(ShadowColor(TextColor), InvertText),
		Formats = {},
		Suggestion = nil,
		Run = { Codepoints = {}, Styles = {}, Count = 0 },
	}
end

const function IsAllowed(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Codepoint ~= SectionSign and Codepoint >= Space and Codepoint ~= Delete
end

const function FillRun(Box: EditBox, First: number, Last: number): Font.Formatted
	const Run = Box.Run
	local Count = 0

	for Index = First, Last do
		Count += 1
		Run.Codepoints[Count] = Box.Value[Index]
		Run.Styles[Count] = Box.Formats[Index] or Font.PlainStyle
	end

	Run.Count = Count

	return Run
end

const function HeadLength(Box: EditBox, From: number, MaxWidth: number): number
	local Remaining = MaxWidth
	local Length = 0

	for Index = From + 1, #Box.Value do
		Remaining -= Font.FormattedWidth(FillRun(Box, Index, Index))

		if Remaining < 0 then
			break
		end

		Length += 1
	end

	return Length
end

const function TailLength(Box: EditBox, MaxWidth: number): number
	local Remaining = MaxWidth
	local Length = 0

	for Index = #Box.Value, 1, -1 do
		Remaining -= Font.FormattedWidth(FillRun(Box, Index, Index))

		if Remaining < 0 then
			break
		end

		Length += 1
	end

	return Length
end

const function ScrollTo(Box: EditBox, Position: number)
	Box.DisplayPos = math.min(Box.DisplayPos, #Box.Value)

	const LastPos = HeadLength(Box, Box.DisplayPos, Box.Width) + Box.DisplayPos

	if Position == Box.DisplayPos then
		Box.DisplayPos -= TailLength(Box, Box.Width)
	end

	if Position > LastPos then
		Box.DisplayPos += Position - LastPos
	elseif Position <= Box.DisplayPos then
		Box.DisplayPos -= Box.DisplayPos - Position
	end

	Box.DisplayPos = math.clamp(Box.DisplayPos, 0, #Box.Value)
end

const function SetCursorPosition(Box: EditBox, Position: number)
	Box.CursorPos = math.clamp(Position, 0, #Box.Value)
	ScrollTo(Box, Box.CursorPos)
end

const function SetHighlightPos(Box: EditBox, Position: number)
	Box.HighlightPos = math.clamp(Position, 0, #Box.Value)
	ScrollTo(Box, Box.HighlightPos)
end

const function MoveCursorTo(Box: EditBox, Position: number, ExtendSelection: boolean)
	SetCursorPosition(Box, Position)

	if not ExtendSelection then
		SetHighlightPos(Box, Box.CursorPos)
	end
end

const function MoveCursorToEnd(Box: EditBox, ExtendSelection: boolean)
	MoveCursorTo(Box, #Box.Value, ExtendSelection)
end

const function ValueString(Box: EditBox): string
	return if #Box.Value == 0 then "" else utf8.char(table.unpack(Box.Value))
end

const function SetValue(Box: EditBox, Value: string)
	table.clear(Box.Value)

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Value) do
		if #Box.Value < Box.MaxLength then
			table.insert(Box.Value, Codepoint)
		end
	end

	MoveCursorToEnd(Box, false)
	SetHighlightPos(Box, Box.CursorPos)
end

const function InsertText(Box: EditBox, Text: string): boolean
	const Start = math.min(Box.CursorPos, Box.HighlightPos)
	const Finish = math.max(Box.CursorPos, Box.HighlightPos)
	const MaxInsertion = Box.MaxLength - #Box.Value - (Start - Finish)

	if MaxInsertion <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	table.clear(Inserted)

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Text) do
		if IsAllowed(Codepoint) and #Inserted < MaxInsertion then
			table.insert(Inserted, Codepoint)
		end
	end

	for _ = Start + 1, Finish do
		table.remove(Box.Value, Start + 1)
	end

	for Offset, Codepoint in Inserted do
		table.insert(Box.Value, Start + Offset, Codepoint)
	end

	SetCursorPosition(Box, Start + #Inserted)
	SetHighlightPos(Box, Box.CursorPos)

	return true
end

const function WordPosition(Box: EditBox, Direction: number, From: number): number
	local Result = From
	const Value = Box.Value

	if Direction > 0 then
		while Result < #Value and Value[Result + 1] ~= Space do
			Result += 1
		end

		while Result < #Value and Value[Result + 1] == Space do
			Result += 1
		end
	else
		while Result > 0 and Value[Result] == Space do
			Result -= 1
		end

		while Result > 0 and Value[Result] ~= Space do
			Result -= 1
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function DeleteCharsToPos(Box: EditBox, Position: number): boolean
	if #Box.Value == 0 then
		return false
	end

	if Box.HighlightPos ~= Box.CursorPos then
		return InsertText(Box, "")
	end

	const Start = math.min(Position, Box.CursorPos)
	const Finish = math.max(Position, Box.CursorPos)

	if Start == Finish then
		return false
	end

	for _ = Start + 1, Finish do
		table.remove(Box.Value, Start + 1)
	end

	SetCursorPosition(Box, Start)
	MoveCursorTo(Box, Start, false)

	return true
end

const function DeleteText(Box: EditBox, Direction: number, WholeWord: boolean): boolean
	if WholeWord then
		if #Box.Value == 0 then
			return false
		elseif Box.HighlightPos ~= Box.CursorPos then
			return InsertText(Box, "")
		end

		return DeleteCharsToPos(Box, WordPosition(Box, Direction, Box.CursorPos))
	end

	return DeleteCharsToPos(Box, math.clamp(Box.CursorPos + Direction, 0, #Box.Value))
end

const function KeyPressed(Box: EditBox, Key: Enum.KeyCode, Shift: boolean, Control: boolean): (boolean, boolean)
	if not Box.Visible or not Box.Focused then
		return false, false
	end

	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
		return true, DeleteText(Box, -1, Control)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
		return true, DeleteText(Box, 1, Control)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Home then
		MoveCursorTo(Box, 0, Shift)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.End then
		MoveCursorToEnd(Box, Shift)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
		MoveCursorTo(Box, if Control then WordPosition(Box, 1, Box.CursorPos) else Box.CursorPos + 1, Shift)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
		MoveCursorTo(Box, if Control then WordPosition(Box, -1, Box.CursorPos) else Box.CursorPos - 1, Shift)
	elseif Control and Key == Enum.KeyCode.A then
		MoveCursorToEnd(Box, false)
		SetHighlightPos(Box, 0)
	elseif Control and Key == Enum.KeyCode.C then
		return true, false
	elseif Control and Key == Enum.KeyCode.V then
		return true, false
	elseif Control and Key == Enum.KeyCode.X then
		return true, InsertText(Box, "")
	else
		return false, false
	end

	return true, false
end

const function IsMouseOver(Box: EditBox, MouseX: number, MouseY: number): boolean
	return Box.Visible and MouseX >= Box.X and MouseY >= Box.Y and MouseX < Box.X + Box.Width and MouseY < Box.Y + Box.Height
end

const function ClickedPosition(Box: EditBox, MouseX: number): number
	const PositionInText = math.min(MouseX // 1 - Box.X, Box.Width)

	return Box.DisplayPos + HeadLength(Box, Box.DisplayPos, PositionInText)
end

const function Click(Box: EditBox, MouseX: number, Shift: boolean, DoubleClick: boolean)
	const Position = ClickedPosition(Box, MouseX)

	if DoubleClick then
		MoveCursorTo(Box, WordPosition(Box, -1, Position), false)
		MoveCursorTo(Box, WordPosition(Box, 1, Position), true)
	else
		MoveCursorTo(Box, Position, Shift)
	end
end

const function Drag(Box: EditBox, MouseX: number)
	MoveCursorTo(Box, ClickedPosition(Box, MouseX), true)
end

const function GetScreenX(Box: EditBox, Index: number): number
	if Index > #Box.Value then
		return Box.X
	end

	const Run = Box.Run

	for Position = 1, Index do
		Run.Codepoints[Position] = Box.Value[Position]
		Run.Styles[Position] = Font.PlainStyle
	end

	Run.Count = Index

	return Box.X + Font.FormattedWidth(Run)
end

const function SetFocused(Box: EditBox, Focused: boolean)
	if Box.CanLoseFocus or Focused then
		Box.Focused = Focused

		if Focused then
			Box.FocusedTime = Millis()
		end
	end
end

const function DrawSelected(Box: EditBox, Run: Font.Formatted, X: number)
	Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X + 1, Box.Y + 1, Box.SelectedShadowColor, false)
	Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X, Box.Y, Box.SelectedColor, false)
end

const function DrawSelection(Box: EditBox, Cursor: number, Highlight: number, Split: number, SecondX: number)
	const Start = Box.DisplayPos
	const Low = math.min(Cursor, Highlight)
	const High = math.max(Cursor, Highlight)

	if Low < Split then
		const X = Box.X + Font.FormattedWidth(FillRun(Box, Start + 1, Start + Low))

		DrawSelected(Box, FillRun(Box, Start + Low + 1, Start + math.min(High, Split)), X)
	end

	if High > Split then
		const First = math.max(Low, Split)
		const X = SecondX + Font.FormattedWidth(FillRun(Box, Start + Split + 1, Start + First))

		DrawSelected(Box, FillRun(Box, Start + First + 1, Start + High), X)
	end
end

const function Draw(Box: EditBox)
	if not Box.Visible then
		return
	end

	const Color = Box.TextColor
	const RelativeCursor = Box.CursorPos - Box.DisplayPos
	const DisplayedLength = HeadLength(Box, Box.DisplayPos, Box.Width)
	const CursorOnScreen = RelativeCursor >= 0 and RelativeCursor <= DisplayedLength
	const ShowCursor = Box.Focused and ((Millis() - Box.FocusedTime) // BlinkMilliseconds) % 2 == 0 and CursorOnScreen
	const RelativeHighlight = math.clamp(Box.HighlightPos - Box.DisplayPos, 0, DisplayedLength)
	local DrawX = Box.X

	if DisplayedLength > 0 then
		const HalfLength = if CursorOnScreen then RelativeCursor else DisplayedLength
		const Half = FillRun(Box, Box.DisplayPos + 1, Box.DisplayPos + HalfLength)

		Font.DrawFormatted(Half, DrawX, Box.Y, Color, true)
		DrawX += Font.FormattedWidth(Half) + 1
	end

	const Insert = Box.CursorPos < #Box.Value or #Box.Value >= Box.MaxLength
	local CursorX = DrawX

	if not CursorOnScreen then
		CursorX = if RelativeCursor > 0 then Box.X + Box.Width else Box.X
	elseif Insert then
		CursorX -= 1
		DrawX -= 1
	end

	const SecondX = DrawX

	if DisplayedLength > 0 and CursorOnScreen and RelativeCursor < DisplayedLength then
		Font.DrawFormatted(FillRun(Box, Box.CursorPos + 1, Box.DisplayPos + DisplayedLength), DrawX, Box.Y, Color, true)
	end

	if not Insert and Box.Suggestion then
		Font.Draw(Box.Suggestion, CursorX - 1, Box.Y, SuggestionColor, true)
	end

	if RelativeHighlight ~= RelativeCursor then
		const HighlightX = Box.X + Font.FormattedWidth(FillRun(Box, Box.DisplayPos + 1, Box.DisplayPos + RelativeHighlight))

		Canvas.Fill(math.min(CursorX, Box.X + Box.Width), Box.Y - 1, math.min(HighlightX - 1, Box.X + Box.Width), Box.Y + 1 + LineHeight, Box.HighlightColor)
		DrawSelection(Box, math.clamp(RelativeCursor, 0, DisplayedLength), RelativeHighlight, if CursorOnScreen then RelativeCursor else DisplayedLength, SecondX)
	end

	if ShowCursor then
		if Insert then
			Canvas.Fill(CursorX, Box.Y - 1, CursorX + 1, Box.Y + LineHeight + 1, Color)
		else
			const Run = Box.Run

			Run.Codepoints[1] = Underscore
			Run.Styles[1] = Font.PlainStyle
			Run.Count = 1
			Font.DrawFormatted(Run, CursorX, Box.Y, Color, true)
		end
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	ValueString = ValueString,
	SetValue = SetValue,
	InsertText = InsertText,
	GetScreenX = GetScreenX,
	SetCursorPosition = SetCursorPosition,
	KeyPressed = KeyPressed,
	IsMouseOver = IsMouseOver,
	Click = Click,
	Drag = Drag,
	SetFocused = SetFocused,
	MoveCursorToEnd = MoveCursorToEnd,
	SetHighlightPos = SetHighlightPos,
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/EntityPicture"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Affine = require("../Affine")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const Models = require("../Models")
const Raster = require("./Raster")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

type Visibility = {
	Faces: { [unknown]: number },
	OpaqueCubes: { [number]: boolean },
	Classified: { [unknown]: true },
}

type HandItem = {
	State: ItemModels.RenderState,
	Draws: { ItemModels.Draw },
}

export type Worn = {
	Armor: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Textures.Texture? },
	Wings: Textures.Texture?,
	SkullKind: string?,
	SkullTexture: Textures.Texture?,
	HeadItem: ItemModels.RenderState,
	Invisible: boolean,
}

const RenderScale = 0.9375
const ModelYOffset = -1.501
const CrouchOffset = -2 / 16
const PixelsPerBlock = 16
const PictureOffsetY = 0.0625
const FollowDivisor = 40
const FollowDegrees = 20
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const AlphaCutout = 26
const SlimHandOffset = 0.5
const White = -1
const EmptyFace = 0
const PartialFace = 1
const OpaqueFace = 2
const Light0 = vector.normalize(vector.create(0.2, -1, 1))
const Light1 = vector.normalize(vector.create(-0.2, -1, 0))
const SkullScale = 1.1875
const HeadItemScale = 0.625
const WingsDepth = 0.125
const ArmorSlots: { Models.ArmorSlot } = { "chest", "legs", "feet", "head" }
const EquipmentTextureSize = Vector2.new(64, 32)

const Root = Affine.Create()
const HandPose = Affine.Create()
const PartMatrices: { [Models.Part]: Affine.Matrix } = {}
const PolygonMatrices: { [Models.Part]: Affine.Matrix } = {}
const Visibilities: { [Textures.Texture]: Visibility } = {}
const ItemDraws: { [string]: { ItemModels.Draw } } = {}
const Signature: { number } = {}
const Inputs: { number } = {}
const RightHand: HandItem = { State = ItemModels.CreateRenderState(), Draws = {} }
const LeftHand: HandItem = { State = ItemModels.CreateRenderState(), Draws = {} }
const HeadItem: HandItem = { State = ItemModels.CreateRenderState(), Draws = {} }
const LayerMatrices: { [Models.LayerPart]: Affine.Matrix } = {}
const LayerPolygonMatrices: { [Models.LayerPart]: Affine.Matrix } = {}
const ArmorModels: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Models.ArmorModel } = {}
const Elytra = Models.Equipment.CreateElytra(EquipmentTextureSize)
const WornTextures: { Textures.Texture | false } = {}
const LastWornTextures: { Textures.Texture | false } = {}
const LayerPose = Affine.Create()

for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
	ArmorModels[Slot] = Models.Equipment.CreateArmor(Slot, EquipmentTextureSize)
end

local SkullKind: string? = nil
local SkullSize: Vector2? = nil
local SkullLayer: Models.Layer? = nil
local SkullParts: { Models.LayerPart } = {}

local Image: EditableImage? = nil
local Source: Content? = nil
local Target = Raster.Create(0, 0)
local LastTexture: Textures.Texture? = nil

const function EnsureImage(PixelWidth: number, PixelHeight: number)
	if Image and Target.Width == PixelWidth and Target.Height == PixelHeight then
		return
	end

	if Image and Source then
		Canvas.Release(Source)
		Image:Destroy()
	end

	const Created = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(PixelWidth, PixelHeight) })

	Image = Created
	Source = Content.fromObject(Created)
	Target = Raster.Create(PixelWidth, PixelHeight)
	table.clear(Signature)
end

const function ClassifyFace(Texture: Textures.Texture, Polygon: Models.LayerPolygon): number
	local MinU = math.huge
	local MaxU = -math.huge
	local MinV = math.huge
	local MaxV = -math.huge

	for _, Vertex in Polygon.Vertices do
		MinU = math.min(MinU, Vertex.U)
		MaxU = math.max(MaxU, Vertex.U)
		MinV = math.min(MinV, Vertex.V)
		MaxV = math.max(MaxV, Vertex.V)
	end

	const TextureWidth = Texture.Size.X
	local Opaque = 0
	local Total = 0

	for V = math.max(MinV // 1, 0), math.min(math.ceil(MaxV) - 1, Texture.Size.Y - 1) do
		for U = math.max(MinU // 1, 0), math.min(math.ceil(MaxU) - 1, TextureWidth - 1) do
			Total += 1

			if buffer.readu8(Texture.Pixels, (V * TextureWidth + U) * 4 + 3) >= AlphaCutout then
				Opaque += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return if Opaque == 0 then EmptyFace elseif Opaque == Total then OpaqueFace else PartialFace
end

const function VisibilityOf(Parts: { { Polygons: { Models.LayerPolygon } } }, Texture: Textures.Texture): Visibility
	local Found = Visibilities[Texture]

	if not Found then
		Found = { Faces = {}, OpaqueCubes = {}, Classified = {} }
		Visibilities[Texture] = Found
	end

	const Created = Found :: Visibility

	if Created.Classified[Parts] then
		return Created
	end

	Created.Classified[Parts] = true

	for _, Part in Parts do
		for _, Polygon in Part.Polygons do
			const Class = ClassifyFace(Texture, Polygon)
			const Cube = Polygon.Cube

			Created.Faces[Polygon] = Class

			if Cube then
				Created.OpaqueCubes[Cube] = Created.OpaqueCubes[Cube] ~= false and Class == OpaqueFace
			end
		end
	end

	return Created
end

const function HandChanged(Hand: HandItem, State: ItemModels.RenderState): boolean
	if ItemModels.SameState(State, Hand.State) then
		return false
	end

	ItemModels.CopyState(Hand.State, State)

	if State.Count == 0 then
		Hand.Draws = {}

		return true
	end

	const Key = ItemModels.Key(State)
	local Found = ItemDraws[Key]

	if not Found then
		Found = ItemModels.Draws(State)
		ItemDraws[Key] = Found
	end

	Hand.Draws = Found :: { ItemModels.Draw }

	return true
end

const function InputsChanged(Model: Models.PlayerModel, Texture: Textures.Texture, Hurt: boolean, Values: { number }): boolean
	local Count = #Values

	for _, Part in Model.Parts do
		Values[Count + 1] = Part.X
		Values[Count + 2] = Part.Y
		Values[Count + 3] = Part.Z
		Values[Count + 4] = Part.XRot
		Values[Count + 5] = Part.YRot
		Values[Count + 6] = Part.ZRot
		Values[Count + 7] = if Part.Visible then 1 else 0
		Count += 7
	end

	Values[Count + 1] = if Hurt then 1 else 0
	Count += 1

	local Changed = LastTexture ~= Texture or #Signature ~= Count

	for Index = 1, Count do
		if Signature[Index] ~= Values[Index] then
			Signature[Index] = Values[Index]
			Changed = true
		end
	end

	LastTexture = Texture

	return Changed
end

const function EnsureSkull(Kind: string?, Size: Vector2?)
	if Kind == SkullKind and Size == SkullSize then
		return
	end

	SkullKind = Kind
	SkullSize = Size
	SkullLayer = nil
	SkullParts = {}

	if Kind and Size then
		const Layer = Models.Layer(Models.Skull.LayerName(Kind))

		SkullLayer = Layer
		SkullParts = Models.LayerParts(Layer, Size)
	end
end

const function WornChanged(Worn: Worn): boolean
	WornTextures[1] = Worn.Armor.chest or false
	WornTextures[2] = Worn.Armor.legs or false
	WornTextures[3] = Worn.Armor.feet or false
	WornTextures[4] = Worn.Armor.head or false
	WornTextures[5] = Worn.Wings or false
	WornTextures[6] = Worn.SkullTexture or false

	local Changed = false

	for Index = 1, 6 do
		if LastWornTextures[Index] ~= WornTextures[Index] then
			LastWornTextures[Index] = WornTextures[Index]
			Changed = true
		end
	end

	return Changed
end

const function DrawLayerParts(Parts: { Models.LayerPart }, Base: Affine.Matrix, Texture: Textures.Texture)
	const Visibility = VisibilityOf(Parts, Texture)

	for _, Part in Parts do
		local Matrix = LayerMatrices[Part]

		if not Matrix then
			Matrix = Affine.Create()
			LayerMatrices[Part] = Matrix
			LayerPolygonMatrices[Part] = Affine.Create()
		end

		const PartMatrix = Matrix :: Affine.Matrix
		const PolygonMatrix = LayerPolygonMatrices[Part]
		const Parent = Part.Parent

		Affine.Set(PartMatrix, if Parent then LayerMatrices[Parent] else Base)
		Affine.Translate(PartMatrix, Part.X / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Y / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Z / PixelsPerBlock)
		Affine.RotateZ(PartMatrix, Part.ZRot)
		Affine.RotateY(PartMatrix, Part.YRot)
		Affine.RotateX(PartMatrix, Part.XRot)

		if Part.XScale ~= 1 or Part.YScale ~= 1 or Part.ZScale ~= 1 then
			Affine.Scale(PartMatrix, Part.XScale, Part.YScale, Part.ZScale)
		end

		Affine.Set(PolygonMatrix, PartMatrix)
		Affine.Scale(PolygonMatrix, 1 / PixelsPerBlock, 1 / PixelsPerBlock, 1 / PixelsPerBlock)

		if Part.Visible and (not Parent or Parent.Visible) then
			for _, Polygon in Part.Polygons do
				if Visibility.Faces[Polygon] ~= EmptyFace then
					Raster.DrawPolygon(Target, Polygon, PolygonMatrix, Texture, "Cutout", Light0, Light1, false, Visibility.OpaqueCubes[Polygon.Cube or 0] == true)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function HeadPose(Model: Models.PlayerModel, Out: Affine.Matrix)
	const Head = Model.Head

	Affine.Set(Out, Root)
	Affine.Translate(Out, Head.X / PixelsPerBlock, Head.Y / PixelsPerBlock, Head.Z / PixelsPerBlock)
	Affine.RotateZ(Out, Head.ZRot)
	Affine.RotateY(Out, Head.YRot)
	Affine.RotateX(Out, Head.XRot)
end

const function DrawWorn(Model: Models.PlayerModel, State: Models.AvatarRenderState, Worn: Worn)
	for _, Slot in ArmorSlots do
		const Texture = Worn.Armor[Slot]

		if Texture then
			Models.Equipment.PoseArmor(ArmorModels[Slot], Model)
			DrawLayerParts(ArmorModels[Slot].Parts, Root, Texture)
		end
	end

	if Worn.Wings then
		Models.Equipment.PoseElytra(Elytra, State)
		Affine.Set(LayerPose, Root)
		Affine.Translate(LayerPose, 0, 0, WingsDepth)
		DrawLayerParts(Elytra.Parts, LayerPose, Worn.Wings)
	end

	if SkullLayer and SkullKind and Worn.SkullTexture then
		Models.Skull.Pose(SkullLayer, SkullKind, State.WalkAnimationPos)
		HeadPose(Model, LayerPose)
		Affine.Scale(LayerPose, SkullScale, SkullScale, SkullScale)
		DrawLayerParts(SkullParts, LayerPose, Worn.SkullTexture)
	end

	if #HeadItem.Draws > 0 then
		HeadPose(Model, HandPose)
		Affine.Translate(HandPose, 0, -0.25, 0)
		Affine.RotateY(HandPose, math.pi)
		Affine.Scale(HandPose, HeadItemScale, -HeadItemScale, -HeadItemScale)

		for _, Draw in HeadItem.Draws do
			for _, Polygon in Draw.Polygons do
				Raster.DrawPolygon(Target, Polygon, HandPose, Draw.Texture, Draw.Material, Light0, Light1, false, false)
			end
		end
	end
end

const function DrawHand(Model: Models.PlayerModel, Hand: HandItem, Right: boolean)
	if #Hand.Draws == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Arm = if Right then Model.RightArm else Model.LeftArm
	const SlimOffset = if Model.Slim then (if Right then SlimHandOffset else -SlimHandOffset) else 0

	Affine.Set(HandPose, Root)
	Affine.Translate(HandPose, (Arm.X + SlimOffset) / PixelsPerBlock, Arm.Y / PixelsPerBlock, Arm.Z / PixelsPerBlock)
	Affine.RotateZ(HandPose, Arm.ZRot)
	Affine.RotateY(HandPose, Arm.YRot)
	Affine.RotateX(HandPose, Arm.XRot)
	Affine.RotateX(HandPose, -math.pi / 2)
	Affine.RotateY(HandPose, math.pi)
	Affine.Translate(HandPose, (if Right then 1 else -1) / 16, 2 / 16, -10 / 16)

	for _, Draw in Hand.Draws do
		for _, Polygon in Draw.Polygons do
			Raster.DrawPolygon(Target, Polygon, HandPose, Draw.Texture, Draw.Material, Light0, Light1, false, false)
		end
	end
end

const function Draw(
	Model: Models.PlayerModel,
	State: Models.AvatarRenderState,
	Texture: Textures.Texture,
	Hurt: boolean,
	BoundingBoxHeight: number,
	RightItem: ItemModels.RenderState,
	LeftItem: ItemModels.RenderState,
	Worn: Worn,
	X0: number,
	Y0: number,
	X1: number,
	Y1: number,
	Size: number,
	MouseX: number,
	MouseY: number,
	GuiScale: number
)
	const CenterX = (X0 + X1) / 2
	const CenterY = (Y0 + Y1) / 2
	const XAngle = math.atan((CenterX - MouseX) / FollowDivisor)
	const YAngle = math.atan((CenterY - MouseY) / FollowDivisor)
	const BodyRot = 180 + XAngle * FollowDegrees

	State.YRot = XAngle * FollowDegrees
	State.XRot = if State.IsFallFlying then 0 else -YAngle * FollowDegrees
	Models.Player.SetupAnim(Model, State)
	EnsureImage((X1 - X0) * GuiScale, (Y1 - Y0) * GuiScale)

	table.clear(Inputs)
	Inputs[1] = Size
	Inputs[2] = MouseX - X0
	Inputs[3] = MouseY - Y0
	Inputs[4] = BoundingBoxHeight
	Inputs[5] = if State.IsCrouching then 1 else 0
	Inputs[6] = if Worn.Invisible then 1 else 0
	Inputs[7] = if State.IsFallFlying then State.FallFlyingScale else 0
	Inputs[8] = if State.IsFallFlying then State.FlyingYRot else 0
	Inputs[9] = if Worn.Wings then State.ElytraRotX else 0
	Inputs[10] = if Worn.Wings then State.ElytraRotY else 0
	Inputs[11] = if Worn.Wings then State.ElytraRotZ else 0
	Inputs[12] = if Worn.SkullKind then State.WalkAnimationPos else 0
	Inputs[13] = if State.IsFallFlying then 0 else State.SwimAmount
	Inputs[14] = if State.IsInWater then State.XRot else 0
	Inputs[15] = if State.IsVisuallySwimming then 1 else 0

	EnsureSkull(Worn.SkullKind, if Worn.SkullTexture then Worn.SkullTexture.Size else nil)

	const RightChanged = HandChanged(RightHand, RightItem)
	const LeftChanged = HandChanged(LeftHand, LeftItem)
	const HeadChanged = HandChanged(HeadItem, Worn.HeadItem)
	const EquipmentChanged = WornChanged(Worn)

	if InputsChanged(Model, Texture, Hurt, Inputs) or RightChanged or LeftChanged or HeadChanged or EquipmentChanged then
		const Visibility = VisibilityOf(Model.Parts, Texture)
		const PictureScale = GuiScale * Size

		Raster.Clear(Target)
		Affine.Identity(Root)
		Affine.Translate(Root, Target.Width / 2, Target.Height / 2, 0)
		Affine.Scale(Root, PictureScale, PictureScale, -PictureScale)
		Affine.Translate(Root, 0, BoundingBoxHeight / 2 + PictureOffsetY, 0)
		Affine.RotateZ(Root, math.pi)
		Affine.RotateX(Root, YAngle * FollowDegrees * DegreesToRadians)

		if State.IsCrouching then
			Affine.Translate(Root, 0, CrouchOffset, 0)
		end

		Affine.RotateY(Root, (180 - BodyRot) * DegreesToRadians)

		if State.IsFallFlying then
			Affine.RotateX(Root, State.FallFlyingScale * (-90 - State.XRot) * DegreesToRadians)
			Affine.RotateY(Root, State.FlyingYRot)
		elseif State.SwimAmount > 0 then
			const TargetXRot = if State.IsInWater then -90 - State.XRot else -90

			Affine.RotateX(Root, math.lerp(0, TargetXRot, State.SwimAmount) * DegreesToRadians)

			if State.IsVisuallySwimming then
				Affine.Translate(Root, 0, -1, 0.3)
			end
		end

		Affine.Scale(Root, -RenderScale, -RenderScale, RenderScale)
		Affine.Translate(Root, 0, ModelYOffset, 0)

		for _, Part in Model.Parts do
			local Matrix = PartMatrices[Part]

			if not Matrix then
				Matrix = Affine.Create()
				PartMatrices[Part] = Matrix
				PolygonMatrices[Part] = Affine.Create()
			end

			const PartMatrix = Matrix :: Affine.Matrix
			const PolygonMatrix = PolygonMatrices[Part]

			Affine.Set(PartMatrix, if Part.Parent then PartMatrices[Part.Parent] else Root)
			Affine.Translate(PartMatrix, Part.X / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Y / PixelsPerBlock, Part.Z / PixelsPerBlock)
			Affine.RotateZ(PartMatrix, Part.ZRot)
			Affine.RotateY(PartMatrix, Part.YRot)
			Affine.RotateX(PartMatrix, Part.XRot)
			Affine.Set(PolygonMatrix, PartMatrix)
			Affine.Scale(PolygonMatrix, 1 / PixelsPerBlock, 1 / PixelsPerBlock, 1 / PixelsPerBlock)

			if Part.Visible and not Worn.Invisible then
				for _, Polygon in Part.Polygons do
					if Visibility.Faces[Polygon] ~= EmptyFace then
						Raster.DrawPolygon(Target, Polygon, PolygonMatrix, Texture, "Cutout", Light0, Light1, Hurt, Visibility.OpaqueCubes[Polygon.Cube] == true)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		DrawWorn(Model, State, Worn)
		DrawHand(Model, RightHand, true)
		DrawHand(Model, LeftHand, false)

		const Picture = Image :: EditableImage

		Picture:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Picture.Size, Target.Pixels)
	end

	Canvas.Blit(Source :: Content, 0, 0, Target.Width, Target.Height, X0, Y0, X1, Y1, White)
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Font"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Data = require("@self/Data")

const Argb = Minecraft.Argb

const RecordSize = 12
const ShadowScale = 0.25
const ShadowOffset = 1
const BoldOffset = 1
const BoldThickness = 0.1
const ItalicShearPerPixel = 0.25
const ItalicShearBase = 1
const SpaceCodepoint = 32
const NewlineCodepoint = 10
const MissingAdvance = 6
const MissingWidth = 5
const MissingHeight = 8
const StrikethroughTop = 3.5
const UnderlineTop = 8
const EffectThickness = 1

export type Style = {
	Color: number?,
	Bold: boolean,
	Italic: boolean,
	Underlined: boolean,
	Strikethrough: boolean,
	Obfuscated: boolean,
}

export type Formatted = {
	Codepoints: { number },
	Styles: { Style },
	Count: number,
}

type Glyph = {
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Advance: number,
	Top: number,
}

const PlainStyle: Style = {
	Color = nil,
	Bold = false,
	Italic = false,
	Underlined = false,
	Strikethrough = false,
	Obfuscated = false,
}

const Glyphs: { [number]: Glyph } = {}
const GlyphsByAdvance: { [number]: { Glyph } } = {}
const PlainRun: Formatted = { Codepoints = {}, Styles = {}, Count = 0 }
const Missing: Glyph = {
	X = Data.Missing.X,
	Y = Data.Missing.Y,
	Width = MissingWidth,
	Height = MissingHeight,
	Advance = MissingAdvance,
	Top = 0,
}

const function Decode(Encoded: string): buffer
	return EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Encoded)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
end

const Records = Decode(Data.Glyphs)
const Image = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Data.Size })
const Source = Content.fromObject(Image)

Image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Data.Size, Decode(Data.Pixels))

for Offset = 0, buffer.len(Records) - 1, RecordSize do
	const Glyph = {
		X = buffer.readu16(Records, Offset + 4),
		Y = buffer.readu16(Records, Offset + 6),
		Width = buffer.readu8(Records, Offset + 8),
		Height = buffer.readu8(Records, Offset + 9),
		Advance = buffer.readu8(Records, Offset + 10),
		Top = buffer.readi8(Records, Offset + 11),
	}

	Glyphs[buffer.readu32(Records, Offset)] = Glyph

	if Glyph.Width > 0 then
		const SameAdvance = GlyphsByAdvance[Glyph.Advance] or {}

		table.insert(SameAdvance, Glyph)
		GlyphsByAdvance[Glyph.Advance] = SameAdvance
	end
end

const function GlyphOf(Codepoint: number): Glyph
	return Glyphs[Codepoint] or Missing
end

const function Advance(Glyph: Glyph, Style: Style): number
	return Glyph.Advance + (if Style.Bold then BoldOffset else 0)
end

const function Plain(Text: string): Formatted
	local Count = 0

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Text) do
		Count += 1
		PlainRun.Codepoints[Count] = Codepoint
		PlainRun.Styles[Count] = PlainStyle
	end

	PlainRun.Count = Count

	return PlainRun
end

const function FormattedWidth(Run: Formatted): number
	local Width = 0

	for Index = 1, Run.Count do
		Width += Advance(GlyphOf(Run.Codepoints[Index]), Run.Styles[Index])
	end

	return math.ceil(Width)
end

const function Width(Text: string): number
	return FormattedWidth(Plain(Text))
end

const function Slice(Run: Formatted, First: number, Last: number): Formatted
	const Line: Formatted = { Codepoints = {}, Styles = {}, Count = Last - First + 1 }

	table.move(Run.Codepoints, First, Last, 1, Line.Codepoints)
	table.move(Run.Styles, First, Last, 1, Line.Styles)

	return Line
end

const function Head(Run: Formatted, MaxWidth: number): Formatted
	local Remaining = MaxWidth
	local Count = 0

	for Index = 1, Run.Count do
		Remaining -= Advance(GlyphOf(Run.Codepoints[Index]), Run.Styles[Index])

		if Remaining < 0 then
			break
		end

		Count = Index
	end

	return Slice(Run, 1, Count)
end

const function Split(Run: Formatted, MaxWidth: number): ({ Formatted }, { boolean })
	const Lines: { Formatted } = {}
	const Wrapped: { boolean } = {}
	local IsWrapped = false
	const Limit = math.max(MaxWidth, 1)
	local Start = 1
	local ForceNewLine = false

	while true do
		local Width = 0
		local HadVisible = false
		local LastSpace: number? = nil
		local Break: number? = nil

		for Index = Start, Run.Count do
			const Codepoint = Run.Codepoints[Index]

			if Codepoint == NewlineCodepoint then
				Break = Index

				break
			end

			if Codepoint == SpaceCodepoint then
				LastSpace = Index
			end

			const CharWidth = Advance(GlyphOf(Codepoint), Run.Styles[Index])

			Width += CharWidth

			if HadVisible and Width > Limit then
				Break = LastSpace or Index

				break
			end

			HadVisible = HadVisible or CharWidth ~= 0
		end

		if not Break then
			break
		end

		const Tail = Run.Codepoints[Break]
		const Skip = Tail == NewlineCodepoint or Tail == SpaceCodepoint

		ForceNewLine = Tail == NewlineCodepoint
		table.insert(Lines, Slice(Run, Start, Break - 1))
		table.insert(Wrapped, IsWrapped)
		IsWrapped = not ForceNewLine
		Start = if Skip then Break + 1 else Break
	end

	if Start <= Run.Count then
		table.insert(Lines, Slice(Run, Start, Run.Count))
		table.insert(Wrapped, IsWrapped)
	elseif ForceNewLine then
		table.insert(Lines, Slice(Run, Start, Start - 1))
		table.insert(Wrapped, false)
	end

	return Lines, Wrapped
end

const function TextColor(Style: Style, BaseColor: number): number
	return if Style.Color then bit32.bor(bit32.band(BaseColor, 0xFF000000), bit32.band(Style.Color, 0xFFFFFF)) else BaseColor
end

const function DrawQuad(Glyph: Glyph, X: number, Y: number, Italic: boolean, Thickness: number, Color: number)
	const Top = Y + Glyph.Top

	if not Italic then
		Canvas.Blit(Source, Glyph.X, Glyph.Y, Glyph.X + Glyph.Width, Glyph.Y + Glyph.Height, X - Thickness, Top - Thickness, X + Glyph.Width + Thickness, Top + Glyph.Height + Thickness, Color)

		return
	end

	for Row = 0, Glyph.Height - 1 do
		const Shear = ItalicShearBase - ItalicShearPerPixel * (Glyph.Top + Row + 0.5)
		const RowTop = if Row == 0 then Top - Thickness else Top + Row
		const RowBottom = if Row == Glyph.Height - 1 then Top + Glyph.Height + Thickness else Top + Row + 1

		Canvas.Blit(Source, Glyph.X, Glyph.Y + Row, Glyph.X + Glyph.Width, Glyph.Y + Row + 1, X + Shear - Thickness, RowTop, X + Shear + Glyph.Width + Thickness, RowBottom, Color)
	end
end

const function DrawGlyphs(Run: Formatted, X: number, Y: number, BaseColor: number, Shadow: boolean)
	local CursorX = X

	for Index = 1, Run.Count do
		const Codepoint = Run.Codepoints[Index]
		const Style = Run.Styles[Index]
		local Glyph = GlyphOf(Codepoint)
		const GlyphAdvance = Advance(Glyph, Style)
		const Color = TextColor(Style, BaseColor)
		const DrawColor = if Shadow then Argb.ScaleRgb(Color, ShadowScale) else Color
		const Offset = if Shadow then ShadowOffset else 0

		if Style.Obfuscated and Codepoint ~= SpaceCodepoint then
			const Candidates = GlyphsByAdvance[math.ceil(Glyph.Advance)]

			if Candidates then
				Glyph = Candidates[math.random(1, #Candidates)]
			end
		end

		if Glyph.Width > 0 then
			const Thickness = if Style.Bold then BoldThickness else 0

			DrawQuad(Glyph, CursorX + Offset, Y + Offset, Style.Italic, Thickness, DrawColor)

			if Style.Bold then
				DrawQuad(Glyph, CursorX + BoldOffset + Offset, Y + Offset, Style.Italic, Thickness, DrawColor)
			end
		end

		CursorX += GlyphAdvance
	end
end

const function DrawEffects(Run: Formatted, X: number, Y: number, BaseColor: number, Shadow: boolean)
	local CursorX = X

	for Index = 1, Run.Count do
		const Style = Run.Styles[Index]
		const GlyphAdvance = Advance(GlyphOf(Run.Codepoints[Index]), Style)
		const EffectX = if Index == 1 then CursorX - 1 else CursorX

		if Style.Strikethrough or Style.Underlined then
			const Color = TextColor(Style, BaseColor)
			const ShadowColor = Argb.ScaleRgb(Color, ShadowScale)

			for Line = 1, 2 do
				const Top = Y + (if Line == 1 then StrikethroughTop else UnderlineTop)

				if (Line == 1 and Style.Strikethrough) or (Line == 2 and Style.Underlined) then
					if Shadow then
						Canvas.Fill(EffectX + ShadowOffset, Top + ShadowOffset, CursorX + GlyphAdvance + ShadowOffset, Top + EffectThickness + ShadowOffset, ShadowColor)
					end

					Canvas.Fill(EffectX, Top, CursorX + GlyphAdvance, Top + EffectThickness, Color)
				end
			end
		end

		CursorX += GlyphAdvance
	end
end

const function DrawFormatted(Run: Formatted, X: number, Y: number, Color: number, Shadow: boolean)
	if Argb.Alpha(Color) == 0 then
		return
	end

	if Shadow then
		DrawGlyphs(Run, X, Y, Color, true)
	end

	DrawGlyphs(Run, X, Y, Color, false)
	DrawEffects(Run, X, Y, Color, Shadow)
end

const function Draw(Text: string, X: number, Y: number, Color: number, Shadow: boolean)
	DrawFormatted(Plain(Text), X, Y, Color, Shadow)
end

return {
	PlainStyle = PlainStyle,
	Width = Width,
	FormattedWidth = FormattedWidth,
	Split = Split,
	Head = Head,
	Draw = Draw,
	DrawFormatted = DrawFormatted,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Hud"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const ChatComponent = require("./ChatComponent")
const Font = require("./Font")
const ItemRenderer = require("./ItemRenderer")
const SpectatorMenu = require("./SpectatorMenu")
const Text = require("./Text")
const Rendering = require("../Rendering")
const Textures = require("../Textures")
const Equipment = require("../Equipment")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Inventory = Minecraft.Inventory
const Argb = Minecraft.Argb
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const JavaRandom = Minecraft.JavaRandom

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack
type Formatted = Font.Formatted

export type Player = {
	Position: vector,
	YBodyRot: number,
	Inventory: Minecraft.Inventory?,
	GameMode: "survival" | "creative" | "adventure" | "spectator",
	Hardcore: boolean,
	Health: number,
	Absorption: number,
	AirSupply: number,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FoodLevel: number,
	Saturation: number,
	ExperienceLevel: number,
	ExperienceProgress: number,
	DamageCooldownTime: number,
	TicksFrozen: number,
	Effects: Minecraft.Effects,
	UseItem: ItemStack,
	UseItemRemaining: number,
	UsingItem: boolean,
}

const White = -1
const Black = 0xFF000000
const ExperienceLevelColor = -8323296
const HeartSeedMultiplier = 312871
const HotbarWidth = 182
const HalfHotbar = 91
const HeartSize = 9
const HeartSpacing = 8
const MaxAirSupply = 300
const TicksRequiredToFreeze = 140
const NotificationTicks = 40
const OverlayMessageTicks = 60
const OverlayFadeTicks = 20
const OverlayMessageBottom = 68
const VignetteRate = 0.01
const CrosshairSize = 15
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const ScopeStartScale = 0.5
const ScopeTargetScale = 1.125
const SpyglassScope = "minecraft:misc/spyglass_scope"
const SpyglassItem = "minecraft:spyglass"
const EffectStride = 25
const EffectRowHeight = 26
const EffectBoxSize = 24
const EffectIconSize = 18
const EffectFadeTicks = 200
const LineHeight = 10

const RarityColors: { [string]: number } = {
	common = 0xFFFFFF,
	uncommon = 0xFFFF55,
	rare = 0x55FFFF,
	epic = 0xFF55FF,
}

const HeartSprites: { [string]: { string } } = {}

for _, Type in { "container", "normal", "poisoned", "withered", "absorbing", "frozen" } do
	const Prefix = if Type == "normal" then "" else `{Type}_`
	const Sprites: { string } = {}

	for Index = 0, 7 do
		const Hardcore = Index >= 4
		const Half = Index % 4 >= 2
		const Blinking = Index % 2 == 1

		if Type == "container" then
			Sprites[Index + 1] = `minecraft:hud/heart/container{if Hardcore then "_hardcore" else ""}{if Blinking then "_blinking" else ""}`
		else
			Sprites[Index + 1] = `minecraft:hud/heart/{Prefix}{if Hardcore then "hardcore_" else ""}{if Half then "half" else "full"}{if Blinking then "_blinking" else ""}`
		end
	end

	HeartSprites[Type] = Sprites
end

const Random = JavaRandom.Create(0)
local TickCount = 0
local Hidden = false
local VignetteBrightness = 1
local ScopeScale = ScopeStartScale
const SortedEffects: { Minecraft.EffectInstance } = {}
local LastScopeClock = 0
local ToolHighlightTimer = 0
local LastToolHighlight: ItemStack = Items.Empty
local HighlightSource: ItemStack = Items.Empty
local HighlightText: Formatted? = nil
local LevelShown = -1
local LevelText: Formatted? = nil
local LastHealth = 0
local DisplayHealth = 0
local LastHealthTime = 0
local HealthBlinkTime = 0
local OverlayMessage: Formatted? = nil
local OverlayMessageTime = 0
local VignetteContent: Content? = nil
local VignetteSize = Vector2.zero

const function Millis(): number
	return os.clock() * 1000 // 1
end

const function HasEffect(Player: Player, Id: string): boolean
	return Player.Effects[Id] ~= nil
end

const function HeartSprite(Type: string, Hardcore: boolean, Half: boolean, Blinking: boolean): string
	return HeartSprites[Type][(if Hardcore then 4 else 0) + (if Half then 2 else 0) + (if Blinking then 1 else 0) + 1]
end

const function PlayerHeartType(Player: Player): string
	if HasEffect(Player, "minecraft:poison") then
		return "poisoned"
	elseif HasEffect(Player, "minecraft:wither") then
		return "withered"
	elseif Player.TicksFrozen >= TicksRequiredToFreeze then
		return "frozen"
	end

	return "normal"
end

const function CanHurtPlayer(Player: Player): boolean
	return Player.GameMode == "survival" or Player.GameMode == "adventure"
end

const function XpNeededForNextLevel(Level: number): number
	if Level >= 30 then
		return 112 + (Level - 30) * 9
	elseif Level >= 15 then
		return 37 + (Level - 15) * 5
	end

	return 7 + Level * 2
end

const function HighlightRun(Stack: ItemStack): Formatted
	const Color = RarityColors[Items.Rarity(Stack)] or RarityColors.common

	return Text.Flatten(Items.GetHoverName(Stack), Text.Style(Color, Items.GetCustomName(Stack) ~= nil))
end

const function Tick(Player: Player)
	TickCount += 1

	if OverlayMessageTime > 0 then
		OverlayMessageTime -= 1
	end

	const Target = Mth.Clamp(1 - Rendering.Brightness(Rendering.MaxLocalRawBrightness()), 0, 1)

	VignetteBrightness += (Target - VignetteBrightness) * VignetteRate

	const Selected = Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Selected) then
		ToolHighlightTimer = 0
	elseif Items.IsEmpty(LastToolHighlight) or not Items.IsSameItem(Selected, LastToolHighlight) or (not Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Selected, LastToolHighlight) and not Items.Equal(Items.GetHoverName(Selected), Items.GetHoverName(LastToolHighlight))) then
		ToolHighlightTimer = NotificationTicks
	elseif ToolHighlightTimer > 0 then
		ToolHighlightTimer -= 1
	end

	LastToolHighlight = Selected

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Selected) and not Items.Matches(HighlightSource, Selected) then
		HighlightSource = Items.Copy(Selected)
		HighlightText = HighlightRun(Selected)
	end
end

const function VignetteMask(): (Content, Vector2)
	if not VignetteContent then
		const Vignette = Textures.Texture("minecraft:misc/vignette")
		const Pixels = buffer.create(buffer.len(Vignette.Pixels))

		for Offset = 0, buffer.len(Pixels) - 1, 4 do
			buffer.writeu8(Pixels, Offset + 3, buffer.readu8(Vignette.Pixels, Offset))
		end

		const Image = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vignette.Size })

		Image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vignette.Size, Pixels)
		VignetteContent = Content.fromObject(Image)
		VignetteSize = Vignette.Size
	end

	return VignetteContent :: Content, VignetteSize
end

const function DrawVignette(Width: number, Height: number)
	const Brightness = Mth.Clamp(VignetteBrightness, 0, 1)
	const Mask, Size = VignetteMask()

	Canvas.Blit(Mask, 0, 0, Size.X, Size.Y, 0, 0, Width, Height, Argb.Color(Argb.As8BitChannel(Brightness), 0, 0, 0))
end

const function DrawSpyglass(Width: number, Height: number)
	const Side = math.min(Width, Height)
	const Size = (Side * math.min(Width / Side, Height / Side) * ScopeScale) // 1
	const Left = (Width - Size) // 2
	const Top = (Height - Size) // 2
	const Right = Left + Size
	const Bottom = Top + Size
	const Scope = Textures.Texture(SpyglassScope)

	Canvas.Blit(Textures.TextureContent(SpyglassScope), 0, 0, Scope.Size.X, Scope.Size.Y, Left, Top, Right, Bottom, White)
	Canvas.Fill(0, Bottom, Width, Height, Black)
	Canvas.Fill(0, 0, Width, Top, Black)
	Canvas.Fill(0, Top, Left, Bottom, Black)
	Canvas.Fill(Right, Top, Width, Bottom, Black)
end

const function DrawCrosshair(Width: number, Height: number, AttackStrength: number, MaxAttackIndicator: boolean)
	Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/crosshair", (Width - CrosshairSize) // 2, (Height - CrosshairSize) // 2, CrosshairSize, CrosshairSize, White)

	const X = Width // 2 - 8
	const Y = Height // 2 - 7 + 16

	if MaxAttackIndicator then
		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_full", X, Y, 16, 16, White)
	elseif AttackStrength < 1 then
		const Progress = math.modf(AttackStrength * 17)

		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_background", X, Y, 16, 4, White)
		Canvas.BlitSpriteRegion("minecraft:hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_progress", 16, 4, 0, 0, X, Y, Progress, 4, White)
	end
end

const function DrawSlot(Player: Player, Stack: ItemStack, X: number, Y: number, Seed: number, Partial: number)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	ItemRenderer.DrawItem(Stack, X, Y, Seed, Player, Partial)
	ItemRenderer.DrawDecorations(Stack, X, Y)
end

const function DrawHotbar(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number, Partial: number)
	const PlayerInventory = Player.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory
	const Offhand = Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "offhand")
	const Center = Width // 2

	Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/hotbar", Center - HalfHotbar, Height - 22, HotbarWidth, 22, White)
	Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/hotbar_selection", Center - HalfHotbar - 1 + PlayerInventory.Selected * 20, Height - 22 - 1, 24, 23, White)

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Offhand) then
		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/hotbar_offhand_left", Center - HalfHotbar - 29, Height - 23, 29, 24, White)
	end

	for Index = 0, Inventory.SelectionSize - 1 do
		DrawSlot(Player, Inventory.GetItem(PlayerInventory, Index), Center - 90 + Index * 20 + 2, Height - 16 - 3, Index + 1, Partial)
	end

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Offhand) then
		DrawSlot(Player, Offhand, Center - HalfHotbar - 26, Height - 16 - 3, Inventory.SelectionSize + 1, Partial)
	end
end

const function DrawArmor(Armor: number, YBase: number, Rows: number, RowHeight: number, Left: number)
	if Armor <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Y = YBase - (Rows - 1) * RowHeight - LineHeight

	for Index = 0, 9 do
		const X = Left + Index * HeartSpacing

		if Index * 2 + 1 < Armor then
			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/armor_full", X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end

		if Index * 2 + 1 == Armor then
			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/armor_half", X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end

		if Index * 2 + 1 > Armor then
			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/armor_empty", X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end
	end
end

const function DrawHearts(Player: Player, Left: number, YBase: number, RowHeight: number, OffsetIndex: number, MaxHealth: number, Current: number, Old: number, Absorption: number, Blink: boolean)
	const Type = PlayerHeartType(Player)
	const HealthContainers = math.ceil(MaxHealth / 2)
	const AbsorptionContainers = math.ceil(Absorption / 2)
	const MaxHealthHalves = HealthContainers * 2

	for Container = HealthContainers + AbsorptionContainers - 1, 0, -1 do
		const X = Left + (Container % 10) * HeartSpacing
		local Y = YBase - (Container // 10) * RowHeight

		if Current + Absorption <= 4 then
			Y += JavaRandom.NextInt(Random, 2)
		end

		if Container < HealthContainers and Container == OffsetIndex then
			Y -= 2
		end

		Canvas.BlitSprite(HeartSprite("container", Player.Hardcore, false, Blink), X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)

		const Halves = Container * 2

		if Container >= HealthContainers then
			const AbsorptionHalves = Halves - MaxHealthHalves

			if AbsorptionHalves < Absorption then
				Canvas.BlitSprite(HeartSprite(if Type == "withered" then Type else "absorbing", Player.Hardcore, AbsorptionHalves + 1 == Absorption, false), X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
			end
		end

		if Blink and Halves < Old then
			Canvas.BlitSprite(HeartSprite(Type, Player.Hardcore, Halves + 1 == Old, true), X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end

		if Halves < Current then
			Canvas.BlitSprite(HeartSprite(Type, Player.Hardcore, Halves + 1 == Current, false), X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end
	end
end

const function DrawFood(Player: Player, YBase: number, Right: number)
	const Food = Player.FoodLevel
	const Hunger = HasEffect(Player, "minecraft:hunger")
	const Empty = if Hunger then "minecraft:hud/food_empty_hunger" else "minecraft:hud/food_empty"
	const Half = if Hunger then "minecraft:hud/food_half_hunger" else "minecraft:hud/food_half"
	const Full = if Hunger then "minecraft:hud/food_full_hunger" else "minecraft:hud/food_full"

	for Index = 0, 9 do
		local Y = YBase

		if Player.Saturation <= 0 and TickCount % (Food * 3 + 1) == 0 then
			Y += JavaRandom.NextInt(Random, 3) - 1
		end

		const X = Right - Index * HeartSpacing - HeartSize

		Canvas.BlitSprite(Empty, X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)

		if Index * 2 + 1 < Food then
			Canvas.BlitSprite(Full, X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end

		if Index * 2 + 1 == Food then
			Canvas.BlitSprite(Half, X, Y, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end
	end
end

const function AirBubble(Current: number, Maximum: number, Offset: number): number
	return math.ceil(Mth.Float((Current + Offset) * 10 / Maximum))
end

const function DrawAir(Player: Player, YAir: number, Right: number)
	const Current = math.clamp(Player.AirSupply, 0, MaxAirSupply)
	const UnderWater = Player.Fluid.EyeInWater

	if not UnderWater and Current >= MaxAirSupply then
		return
	end

	const Full = AirBubble(Current, MaxAirSupply, -2)
	const Popping = AirBubble(Current, MaxAirSupply, 0)
	const Empty = 10 - AirBubble(Current, MaxAirSupply, if Current ~= 0 and UnderWater then 1 else 0)

	for Bubble = 1, 10 do
		const X = Right - (Bubble - 1) * HeartSpacing - HeartSize

		if Bubble <= Full then
			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/air", X, YAir, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		elseif Full ~= Popping and Bubble == Popping and UnderWater then
			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/air_bursting", X, YAir, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		elseif Bubble > 10 - Empty then
			const Wobble = if Empty == 10 and TickCount % 2 == 0 then JavaRandom.NextInt(Random, 2) else 0

			Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/air_empty", X, YAir + Wobble, HeartSize, HeartSize, White)
		end
	end
end

const function DrawPlayerHealth(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number)
	const Current = math.ceil(Player.Health)
	const Blink = HealthBlinkTime > TickCount and ((HealthBlinkTime - TickCount) // 3) % 2 == 1
	const Now = Millis()

	if Current < LastHealth and Player.DamageCooldownTime > 0 then
		LastHealthTime = Now
		HealthBlinkTime = TickCount + 20
	elseif Current > LastHealth and Player.DamageCooldownTime > 0 then
		LastHealthTime = Now
		HealthBlinkTime = TickCount + 10
	end

	if Now - LastHealthTime > 1000 then
		DisplayHealth = Current
		LastHealthTime = Now
	end

	LastHealth = Current

	const Old = DisplayHealth

	JavaRandom.SetSeedInt(Random, TickCount * HeartSeedMultiplier)

	const PlayerInventory = Player.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory
	const Left = Width // 2 - HalfHotbar
	const Right = Width // 2 + HalfHotbar
	const YBase = Height - 39
	const MaxHealth = math.max(Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:max_health", PlayerInventory, Player.Effects), math.max(Old, Current))
	const Absorption = math.ceil(Player.Absorption)
	const Rows = math.ceil(Mth.Float((MaxHealth + Absorption) / 2 / 10))
	const RowHeight = math.max(10 - (Rows - 2), 3)
	const OffsetIndex = if HasEffect(Player, "minecraft:regeneration") then TickCount % math.ceil(MaxHealth + 5) else -1
	const Armor = math.modf(Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:armor", PlayerInventory, Player.Effects))

	DrawArmor(Armor, YBase, Rows, RowHeight, Left)
	DrawHearts(Player, Left, YBase, RowHeight, OffsetIndex, MaxHealth, Current, Old, Absorption, Blink)
	DrawFood(Player, YBase, Right)
	DrawAir(Player, YBase - LineHeight, Right)
end

const function DrawExperience(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number)
	const Left = (Width - HotbarWidth) // 2
	const Top = Height - 24 - 5

	if XpNeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel) > 0 then
		const Progress = math.modf(Player.ExperienceProgress * 183)

		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/experience_bar_background", Left, Top, HotbarWidth, 5, White)

		if Progress > 0 then
			Canvas.BlitSpriteRegion("minecraft:hud/experience_bar_progress", HotbarWidth, 5, 0, 0, Left, Top, Progress, 5, White)
		end
	end

	if Player.ExperienceLevel > 0 then
		if LevelShown ~= Player.ExperienceLevel then
			LevelShown = Player.ExperienceLevel
			LevelText = Text.Flatten({ translate = "gui.experience.level", with = { LevelShown } }, Font.PlainStyle)
		end

		const Run = LevelText :: Formatted
		const X = (Width - Font.FormattedWidth(Run)) // 2
		const Y = Height - 24 - 9 - 2

		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X + 1, Y, Black, false)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X - 1, Y, Black, false)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X, Y + 1, Black, false)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X, Y - 1, Black, false)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X, Y, ExperienceLevelColor, false)
	end
end

const function DrawSelectedItemName(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number)
	if ToolHighlightTimer <= 0 or Items.IsEmpty(LastToolHighlight) or not HighlightText then
		return
	end

	const Run = HighlightText :: Formatted
	const TextWidth = Font.FormattedWidth(Run)
	const Y = Height - 59 + (if CanHurtPlayer(Player) then 0 else 14)
	const Fade = math.modf(ToolHighlightTimer * 256 / 10)
	const Alpha = math.min(Fade, 255)

	if Alpha > 0 then
		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, (Width - TextWidth) // 2, Y, Argb.White(Alpha), true)
	end
end

const function DrawOverlayMessage(Width: number, Height: number, Partial: number)
	if not OverlayMessage or OverlayMessageTime <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Run = OverlayMessage :: Formatted
	const Fade = math.modf((OverlayMessageTime - Partial) * 255 / OverlayFadeTicks)
	const Alpha = math.min(Fade, 255)

	if Alpha > 0 then
		const TextWidth = Font.FormattedWidth(Run)

		Font.DrawFormatted(Run, Width // 2 - TextWidth // 2, Height - OverlayMessageBottom - 4, Argb.White(Alpha), true)
	end
end

const function SetOverlayMessage(Message: unknown)
	OverlayMessage = Text.Flatten(Message, Font.PlainStyle)
	OverlayMessageTime = OverlayMessageTicks
end

const function Path(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, ":(.*)$") or Id) :: string
end

const function DrawCameraOverlays(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number)
	const PlayerInventory = Player.Inventory :: Minecraft.Inventory

	for _, Slot in Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Overlay = Equipment.CameraOverlay(Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot), Slot)

		if Overlay then
			const Size = Textures.Texture(Overlay).Size

			Canvas.Blit(Textures.TextureContent(Overlay), 0, 0, Size.X, Size.Y, 0, 0, Width, Height, White)
		end
	end
end

const function DrawEffects(Player: Player, Width: number)
	table.clear(SortedEffects)

	for _, Effect in Player.Effects do
		table.insert(SortedEffects, Effect)
	end

	table.sort(SortedEffects, Minecraft.Effects.Precedes)

	local Beneficial = 0
	local Harmful = 0

	for Index = #SortedEffects, 1, -1 do
		const Effect = SortedEffects[Index]

		if Effect.ShowIcon then
			const Definition = Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)
			local X = Width
			local Y = 1

			if Definition and Definition.category == "beneficial" then
				Beneficial += 1
				X -= EffectStride * Beneficial
			else
				Harmful += 1
				X -= EffectStride * Harmful
				Y += EffectRowHeight
			end

			local Alpha = 1

			if Effect.Ambient then
				Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/effect_background_ambient", X, Y, EffectBoxSize, EffectBoxSize, White)
			else
				Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/effect_background", X, Y, EffectBoxSize, EffectBoxSize, White)

				if Minecraft.Effects.EndsWithin(Effect, EffectFadeTicks) then
					const Remaining = Effect.Duration
					const UsedSeconds = 10 - Remaining // 20

					Alpha = Mth.Clamp(Remaining / 10 / 5 * 0.5, 0, 0.5) + Mth.Cos(Remaining * math.pi / 5) * Mth.Clamp(UsedSeconds / 10 * 0.25, 0, 0.25)
					Alpha = Mth.Clamp(Alpha, 0, 1)
				end
			end

			Canvas.BlitSprite(`minecraft:mob_effect/{Path(Effect.Id)}`, X + 3, Y + 3, EffectIconSize, EffectIconSize, Argb.Color(Argb.As8BitChannel(Alpha), 255, 255, 255))
		end
	end
end

const function Draw(Player: Player, Width: number, Height: number, Partial: number, FirstPerson: boolean, AttackStrength: number, MaxAttackIndicator: boolean, ScreenShowsEffects: boolean)
	const Now = os.clock()
	const DeltaTicks = (Now - LastScopeClock) * TicksPerSecond

	LastScopeClock = Now

	if Hidden then
		return
	end

	DrawVignette(Width, Height)
	ScopeScale = Mth.Lerp(0.5 * DeltaTicks, ScopeScale, ScopeTargetScale)

	if FirstPerson then
		if Player.UsingItem and Items.Is(Player.UseItem, SpyglassItem) then
			DrawSpyglass(Width, Height)
		else
			ScopeScale = ScopeStartScale
			DrawCameraOverlays(Player, Width, Height)
		end
	end

	if FirstPerson and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		DrawCrosshair(Width, Height, AttackStrength, MaxAttackIndicator)
	end

	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		DrawHotbar(Player, Width, Height, Partial)
	else
		SpectatorMenu.DrawHotbar(Width, Height)
	end

	if CanHurtPlayer(Player) then
		DrawPlayerHealth(Player, Width, Height)
	end

	if CanHurtPlayer(Player) then
		DrawExperience(Player, Width, Height)
	end

	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		DrawSelectedItemName(Player, Width, Height)
	else
		SpectatorMenu.DrawAction(Width, Height)
	end

	if not ScreenShowsEffects then
		DrawEffects(Player, Width)
	end

	DrawOverlayMessage(Width, Height, Partial)

	if not ChatComponent.IsFocused() then
		ChatComponent.Draw(Width, Height, 0, 0)
	end
end

const function ToggleHidden()
	Hidden = not Hidden
end

const function IsHidden(): boolean
	return Hidden
end

return {
	Tick = Tick,
	Draw = Draw,
	ToggleHidden = ToggleHidden,
	IsHidden = IsHidden,
	SetOverlayMessage = SetOverlayMessage,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/ItemAtlas"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Affine = require("../Affine")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const Raster = require("./Raster")
const Rendering = require("../Rendering")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

type Slot = {
	Index: number,
	Key: string,
	LastFrame: number,
}

type Remembered = {
	State: ItemModels.RenderState,
	Key: string,
	LastFrame: number,
}

const AtlasSize = 1024
const SlotPixels = 16
const ForgetFrames = 60
const RenderBudget = 0.003
const AlphaCutout = 26

const Slots: { [string]: Slot } = {}
const SlotList: { Slot } = {}
const RememberedStacks: { [ItemStack]: Remembered } = {}
const Pose = Affine.Create()

local Image: EditableImage? = nil
local Source: Content? = nil
local Target: Raster.Target? = nil
local SlotSize = 0
local Columns = 0
local Capacity = 0
local Frame = 0
local Spent = 0

const ItemLights = Rendering.ItemLights
const FlatFrontLight = math.min(1, (math.max(0, ItemLights.Flat0.z) + math.max(0, ItemLights.Flat1.z)) * 0.6 + 0.4)

const function Prepare(GuiScale: number)
	const Size = SlotPixels * GuiScale

	if Image and SlotSize == Size then
		return
	end

	if not Image then
		const Created = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(AtlasSize, AtlasSize) })

		Image = Created
		Source = Content.fromObject(Created)
	end

	SlotSize = Size
	Columns = AtlasSize // Size
	Capacity = Columns * Columns
	Target = Raster.Create(Size, Size)
	table.clear(Slots)
	table.clear(SlotList)
end

const function IsFlat(State: ItemModels.RenderState): boolean
	for Index = 1, State.Count do
		const Layer = State.Layers[Index]

		if Layer.Node.type == "minecraft:special" or Layer.Model.Kind ~= "generated" or Layer.Model.Transforms.gui ~= nil or Layer.Node.transform ~= nil then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function RenderFlat(State: ItemModels.RenderState, Canvas: Raster.Target)
	const Pixels = Canvas.Pixels

	for Index = 1, State.Count do
		const Layer = State.Layers[Index]

		for LayerIndex, Source in Layer.Model.Layers :: { { string } } do
			const Atlas = Textures.Atlas(Source[1] :: Textures.AtlasName)
			const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Atlas, Source[2])
			const Frame = Textures.Frame(Sprite)
			const Tint = if LayerIndex <= Layer.TintCount then Layer.Tints[LayerIndex] else -1
			const Red = bit32.extract(Tint, 16, 8) / 255 * FlatFrontLight
			const Green = bit32.extract(Tint, 8, 8) / 255 * FlatFrontLight
			const Blue = bit32.extract(Tint, 0, 8) / 255 * FlatFrontLight
			const AtlasPixels = Atlas.Pixels
			const AtlasWidth = Atlas.Size.X
			const Width = Sprite.Size.X
			const Height = Sprite.Size.Y

			for Y = 0, SlotSize - 1 do
				const Row = (Frame.Y + ((Y + 0.5) * Height / SlotSize) // 1) * AtlasWidth + Frame.X

				for X = 0, SlotSize - 1 do
					const Texel = (Row + ((X + 0.5) * Width / SlotSize) // 1) * 4

					const Alpha = buffer.readu8(AtlasPixels, Texel + 3)

					if Alpha >= AlphaCutout then
						Raster.Blend(
							Pixels,
							(Y * SlotSize + X) * 4,
							math.round(buffer.readu8(AtlasPixels, Texel) * Red),
							math.round(buffer.readu8(AtlasPixels, Texel + 1) * Green),
							math.round(buffer.readu8(AtlasPixels, Texel + 2) * Blue),
							Alpha
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Render(State: ItemModels.RenderState, Index: number)
	const Canvas = Target :: Raster.Target

	Raster.Clear(Canvas)

	if IsFlat(State) then
		RenderFlat(State, Canvas)
	else
		const BlockLit = ItemModels.UsesBlockLight(State)
		const Light0, Light1 = if BlockLit then ItemLights.Block0 else ItemLights.Flat0, if BlockLit then ItemLights.Block1 else ItemLights.Flat1

		Affine.Identity(Pose)
		Affine.Translate(Pose, SlotSize / 2, SlotSize / 2, 0)
