		Affine.Scale(Pose, SlotSize, -SlotSize, SlotSize)

		for _, Draw in ItemModels.Draws(State) do
			for _, Polygon in Draw.Polygons do
				Raster.DrawPolygon(Canvas, Polygon, Pose, Draw.Texture, Draw.Material, Light0, Light1, false, false)
			end
		end
	end

	const Atlas = Image :: EditableImage

	Atlas:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.new((Index - 1) % Columns * SlotSize, (Index - 1) // Columns * SlotSize), Vector2.new(SlotSize, SlotSize), Canvas.Pixels)
end

const function Claim(Key: string): Slot?
	if #SlotList < Capacity then
		const Created = { Index = #SlotList + 1, Key = Key, LastFrame = Frame }

		table.insert(SlotList, Created)

		return Created
	end

	local Oldest: Slot? = nil

	for _, Candidate in SlotList do
		if Candidate.LastFrame < Frame and (not Oldest or Candidate.LastFrame < (Oldest :: Slot).LastFrame) then
			Oldest = Candidate
		end
	end

	if Oldest then
		Slots[Oldest.Key] = nil
		Oldest.Key = Key
	end

	return Oldest
end

const function KeyFor(Stack: ItemStack, State: ItemModels.RenderState): string
	local Entry = RememberedStacks[Stack]

	if not Entry then
		Entry = { State = ItemModels.CreateRenderState(), Key = "", LastFrame = Frame }
		RememberedStacks[Stack] = Entry
		ItemModels.CopyState(Entry.State, State)
		Entry.Key = ItemModels.Key(State)
	elseif not ItemModels.SameState(State, Entry.State) then
		ItemModels.CopyState(Entry.State, State)
		Entry.Key = ItemModels.Key(State)
	end

	const Found = Entry :: Remembered

	Found.LastFrame = Frame

	return Found.Key
end

const function BeginFrame()
	Frame += 1
	Spent = 0

	if Frame % ForgetFrames == 0 then
		for Stack, Entry in RememberedStacks do
			if Frame - Entry.LastFrame > ForgetFrames then
				RememberedStacks[Stack] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

const function SlotOf(Stack: ItemStack, State: ItemModels.RenderState, GuiScale: number): (Content?, number, number, number)
	Prepare(GuiScale)

	if State.Count == 0 then
		return nil, 0, 0, 0
	end

	const Key = KeyFor(Stack, State)
	local Found = Slots[Key]

	if not Found then
		if Spent >= RenderBudget then
			return nil, 0, 0, 0
		end

		Found = Claim(Key)

		if not Found then
			return nil, 0, 0, 0
		end

		const Started = os.clock()

		Slots[Key] = Found
		Render(State, (Found :: Slot).Index)
		Spent += os.clock() - Started
	end

	const Slot = Found :: Slot

	Slot.LastFrame = Frame

	return Source, (Slot.Index - 1) % Columns * SlotSize, (Slot.Index - 1) // Columns * SlotSize, SlotSize
end

return {
	BeginFrame = BeginFrame,
	SlotOf = SlotOf,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/ItemRenderer"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")
const ItemAtlas = require("./ItemAtlas")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")

const Items = Minecraft.Items

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

const SlotSize = 16
const White = -1
const BarLeft = 2
const BarTop = 13
const BarWidth = 13
const BarHeight = 2
const BarBackground = 0xFF000000
const CountRight = 17
const CountTop = 9
const CooldownColor = 0x7FFFFFFF

local FrameCooldowns: Minecraft.Cooldowns? = nil
local FramePartial = 0

const State = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const Context: ItemModels.Context = {
	DisplayContext = "gui",
	Holder = nil,
	Seed = 0,
}

const function BeginFrame(Cooldowns: Minecraft.Cooldowns?, Partial: number)
	ItemAtlas.BeginFrame()
	FrameCooldowns = Cooldowns
	FramePartial = Partial
end

const function DrawItem(Stack: ItemStack, X: number, Y: number, Seed: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	Context.Holder = Holder
	Context.Seed = Seed
	ItemModels.Resolve(State, Stack, Context)

	const Source, U, V, Size = ItemAtlas.SlotOf(Stack, State, Canvas.GuiScale())

	if not Source then
		return
	end

	const Pop = Stack.PopTime - Partial

	if Pop > 0 then
		const Squeeze = 1 + Pop / 5
		const Width = SlotSize / Squeeze
		const Height = SlotSize * (Squeeze + 1) / 2
		const PivotX = X + 8
		const PivotY = Y + 12

		Canvas.Blit(Source, U, V, U + Size, V + Size, PivotX - Width / 2, PivotY - Height * 12 / SlotSize, PivotX + Width / 2, PivotY + Height * 4 / SlotSize, White)
	else
		Canvas.Blit(Source, U, V, U + Size, V + Size, X, Y, X + SlotSize, Y + SlotSize, White)
	end
end

const function DrawDecorations(Stack: ItemStack, X: number, Y: number, CountText: Font.Formatted?)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	if Items.Bar.IsVisible(Stack) then
		Canvas.Fill(X + BarLeft, Y + BarTop, X + BarLeft + BarWidth, Y + BarTop + BarHeight, BarBackground)
		Canvas.Fill(X + BarLeft, Y + BarTop, X + BarLeft + Items.Bar.Width(Stack), Y + BarTop + 1, Minecraft.Argb.Opaque(Items.Bar.Color(Stack)))
	end

	const Cooldown = if FrameCooldowns then Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CooldownPercent(FrameCooldowns, Stack, FramePartial) else 0

	if Cooldown > 0 then
		const Top = Y + (SlotSize * (1 - Cooldown)) // 1

		Canvas.Fill(X, Top, X + SlotSize, Top + math.ceil(SlotSize * Cooldown), CooldownColor)
	end

	const Count = Items.GetCount(Stack)

	if CountText then
		Font.DrawFormatted(CountText, X + CountRight - Font.FormattedWidth(CountText), Y + CountTop, White, true)
	elseif Count ~= 1 then
		const Text = tostring(Count)

		Font.Draw(Text, X + CountRight - Font.Width(Text), Y + CountTop, White, true)
	end
end

return {
	BeginFrame = BeginFrame,
	DrawItem = DrawItem,
	DrawDecorations = DrawDecorations,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/ItemTooltip"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack
type Component = unknown
type Fields = { [string]: unknown }
type Add = (Component) -> ()

export type Options = {
	Advanced: boolean,
	Creative: boolean,
	HasPlayer: boolean,
}

const RarityColors: { [string]: string } = {
	common = "white",
	uncommon = "yellow",
	rare = "aqua",
	epic = "light_purple",
}

const StyleKeys = { "color", "shadow_color", "font", "bold", "italic", "underlined", "strikethrough", "obfuscated", "click_event", "hover_event", "insertion" }
const SlotGroups = { "any", "mainhand", "offhand", "hand", "feet", "legs", "chest", "head", "armor", "body", "saddle" }
const PotSides = { "front", "left", "right", "back" }
const SignSides = { "front", "back" }
const OperationIds: { [string]: number } = { add_value = 0, add_multiplied_base = 1, add_multiplied_total = 2 }
const DyeNames = { "white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple", "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black" }
const FireworkColors = { 15790320, 15435844, 12801229, 6719955, 14602026, 4312372, 14188952, 4408131, 11250603, 2651799, 8073150, 2437522, 5320730, 3887386, 11743532, 1973019 }
const TropicalFishVariants = {
	{ "stripey", "orange", "gray" },
	{ "flopper", "gray", "gray" },
	{ "flopper", "gray", "blue" },
	{ "clayfish", "white", "gray" },
	{ "sunstreak", "blue", "gray" },
	{ "kob", "orange", "white" },
	{ "spotty", "pink", "light_blue" },
	{ "blockfish", "purple", "yellow" },
	{ "clayfish", "white", "red" },
	{ "spotty", "white", "yellow" },
	{ "glitter", "white", "gray" },
	{ "clayfish", "white", "orange" },
	{ "dasher", "cyan", "pink" },
	{ "brinely", "lime", "light_blue" },
	{ "betty", "red", "white" },
	{ "snooper", "gray", "red" },
	{ "blockfish", "red", "white" },
	{ "flopper", "white", "yellow" },
	{ "kob", "red", "white" },
	{ "sunstreak", "gray", "white" },
	{ "dasher", "cyan", "yellow" },
	{ "flopper", "yellow", "yellow" },
}

const DefaultFishColor = "white"
const BaseAttackDamageId = "minecraft:base_attack_damage"
const BaseAttackSpeedId = "minecraft:base_attack_speed"
const KnockbackResistance = "minecraft:knockback_resistance"
const OminousDuration = 120000
const StewDuration = 160
const InfiniteDuration = -1
const DurationShownAbove = 20
const MaxBannerLines = 6
const MaxContainerLines = 5
const MaxBees = 3
const MaxHoneyLevel = 5
const TickRate = 20
const Empty = ""
const Space = " "
const Indent = "  "
const ProjectileOptions: Options = { Advanced = false, Creative = false, HasPlayer = false }

const EnchantmentModifiers: { Minecraft.EnchantmentModifier } = {}

const function Translatable(Key: string, With: { unknown }?, Color: string?, Italic: boolean?): Fields
	return { translate = Key, with = With, color = Color, italic = Italic }
end

const function Copy(Value: Component): Fields
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		return { text = Value }
	end

	const List = Value :: { unknown }

	if #List > 0 then
		const First = Copy(List[1])
		const Extra = table.clone((First.extra or {}) :: { unknown })

		table.move(List, 2, #List, #Extra + 1, Extra)
		First.extra = Extra

		return First
	end

	return table.clone(Value :: Fields)
end

const function MergeStyles(Value: Component, Color: string): Fields
	const Merged = Copy(Value)

	if Merged.color == nil then
		Merged.color = Color
	end

	return Merged
end

const function WithStyle(Value: Component, Source: Component): Fields
	const Styled = Copy(Value)

	if type(Source) == "table" then
		const Style = Copy(Source)

		for _, Key in StyleKeys do
			if Style[Key] ~= nil then
				Styled[Key] = Style[Key]
			end
		end
	end

	return Styled
end

const function PlainCopy(Value: Component): Fields
	const Plain = Copy(Value)

	Plain.extra = nil

	for _, Key in StyleKeys do
		Plain[Key] = nil
	end

	return Plain
end

const function Prefixed(Prefix: string, Inner: Component, Color: string?): Fields
	return { text = Prefix, extra = { Inner }, color = Color }
end

const function IsEmptyText(Value: Component): boolean
	if Value == Empty then
		return true
	end

	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	const Text = Value :: Fields

	return Text.text == Empty and next(Text, "text") == nil and next(Text) == "text"
end

const function FormatNumber(Value: number): string
	const Text = string.format("%.2f", Value)

	return (string.gsub(string.gsub(Text, "0+$", ""), "%.$", ""))
end

const function FormatTicks(Ticks: number): string
	const TotalSeconds = Ticks // TickRate
	const Seconds = TotalSeconds % 60
	const Minutes = (TotalSeconds // 60) % 60
	const Hours = TotalSeconds // 3600

	return if Hours > 0 then string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", Hours, Minutes, Seconds) else string.format("%02d:%02d", Minutes, Seconds)
end

const function Shows(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string): boolean
	const Display = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tooltip_display") :: { hidden_components: { string }? }?
	const Hidden = Display and Display.hidden_components

	return not Hidden or table.find(Hidden, Type) == nil
end

const function Shown(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string): unknown?
	const Value = Items.Get(Stack, Type)

	return if Value ~= nil and Shows(Stack, Type) then Value else nil
end

const function Entry(RegistryName: string, Value: unknown): Fields?
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		return Registry.DatapackEntry(RegistryName, Value)
	end

	return Value :: Fields?
end

const function Namespaced(Id: string): string
	return if string.find(Id, ":", 1, true) then Id else `minecraft:{Id}`
end

const function HoverName(Stack: ItemStack): Fields
	const Name: Fields = { text = Empty, extra = { Items.GetHoverName(Stack) } }

	if Items.GetCustomName(Stack) ~= nil then
		Name.italic = true
	end

	return Name
end

const function StyledHoverName(Stack: ItemStack): Fields
	const Name = HoverName(Stack)

	Name.color = RarityColors[Items.Rarity(Stack)]

	return Name
end

const function DisplayName(Stack: ItemStack): Fields
	return Translatable("chat.square_brackets", { HoverName(Stack) }, RarityColors[Items.Rarity(Stack)])
end

const function PotionLines(Effects: { Fields }, DurationScale: number, Add: Add)
	const Modifiers: { Fields } = {}

	for _, Effect in Effects do
		const Definition = Registry.MobEffect(Effect.id :: string)
		const Amplifier = (Effect.amplifier or 0) :: number
		const Duration = (Effect.duration or 0) :: number

		if Definition then
			for _, Modifier in Definition.modifiers do
				table.insert(Modifiers, { Attribute = Modifier.attribute, Amount = Modifier.amount * (Amplifier + 1), Operation = Modifier.operation })
			end

			local Line = Translatable(Definition.descriptionId)

			if Amplifier > 0 then
				Line = Translatable("potion.withAmplifier", { Line, Translatable(`potion.potency.{Amplifier}`) })
			end

			if Duration == InfiniteDuration then
				Line = Translatable("potion.withDuration", { Line, Translatable("effect.duration.infinite") })
			elseif Duration > DurationShownAbove then
				Line = Translatable("potion.withDuration", { Line, FormatTicks((Duration * DurationScale) // 1) })
			end

			Line.color = if Definition.category == "harmful" then "red" else "blue"
			Add(Line)
		end
	end

	if #Effects == 0 then
		Add(Translatable("effect.none", nil, "gray"))
	end

	if #Modifiers > 0 then
		Add(Empty)
		Add(Translatable("potion.whenDrank", nil, "dark_purple"))

		for _, Modifier in Modifiers do
			const Amount = Modifier.Amount :: number
			const Operation = Modifier.Operation :: string
			const Name = Translatable(Registry.Attribute(Modifier.Attribute :: string).descriptionId)
			const Display = if Operation == "add_value" then Amount else Amount * 100

			if Amount > 0 then
				Add(Translatable(`attribute.modifier.plus.{OperationIds[Operation]}`, { FormatNumber(Display), Name }, "blue"))
			elseif Amount < 0 then
				Add(Translatable(`attribute.modifier.take.{OperationIds[Operation]}`, { FormatNumber(-Display), Name }, "red"))
			end
		end
	end
end

const function PotionEffects(Contents: unknown): { Fields }
	const Effects: { Fields } = {}
	const Full = if type(Contents) == "table" then Contents :: { potion: string?, custom_effects: { Fields }? } else nil
	const PotionId = if Full then Full.potion else Contents :: string
	const Potion = if PotionId then Registry.Potion(PotionId) else nil

	if Potion then
		for _, Effect in Potion.effects do
			table.insert(Effects, { id = Effect.id, amplifier = Effect.amplifier, duration = Effect.duration })
		end
	end

	if Full and Full.custom_effects then
		for _, Effect in Full.custom_effects do
			table.insert(Effects, Effect)
		end
	end

	return Effects
end

const function EnchantmentName(Id: string, Level: number): Fields
	const Definition = Registry.Enchantment(Id) :: Fields
	const Name = MergeStyles(Definition.description, if Registry.HasTag("minecraft:enchantment", "minecraft:curse", Id) then "red" else "gray")

	if Level ~= 1 or Definition.max_level ~= 1 then
		const Extra = table.clone((Name.extra or {}) :: { unknown })

		table.insert(Extra, Space)
		table.insert(Extra, Translatable(`enchantment.level.{Level}`))
		Name.extra = Extra
	end

	return Name
end

const function EnchantmentLines(Enchantments: { [string]: number }, Add: Add)
	const Order = Registry.TagMembers("minecraft:enchantment", "minecraft:tooltip_order")

	for _, Id in Order do
		const Level = Enchantments[Id]

		if Level and Level > 0 then
			Add(EnchantmentName(Id, Level))
		end
	end

	for Id, Level in Enchantments do
		if table.find(Order, Id) == nil then
			Add(EnchantmentName(Id, Level))
		end
	end
end

const function ShapeName(Explosion: Fields): Fields
	return Translatable(`item.minecraft.firework_star.shape.{Explosion.shape}`)
end

const function AppendColors(Builder: Fields, Colors: { number }): Fields
	const Extra: { unknown } = (Builder.extra or {}) :: { unknown }

	for Index, Color in Colors do
		if Index > 1 then
			table.insert(Extra, ", ")
		end

		const Dye = table.find(FireworkColors, Color)

		table.insert(Extra, if Dye then Translatable(`item.minecraft.firework_star.{DyeNames[Dye]}`) else Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_star.custom_color"))
	end

	Builder.extra = Extra

	return Builder
end

const function ExplosionDetails(Explosion: Fields, Add: Add)
	const Colors = Explosion.colors :: { number }?
	const Fades = Explosion.fade_colors :: { number }?

	if Colors and #Colors > 0 then
		Add(AppendColors({ text = Empty, color = "gray" }, Colors))
	end

	if Fades and #Fades > 0 then
		Add(AppendColors({ translate = "item.minecraft.firework_star.fade_to", extra = { Space }, color = "gray" }, Fades))
	end

	if Explosion.has_trail then
		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_star.trail", nil, "gray"))
	end

	if Explosion.has_twinkle then
		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_star.flicker", nil, "gray"))
	end
end

const function ExplosionGroup(Explosion: Fields, Count: number, Add: Add)
	if Count == 1 then
		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_rocket.single_star", { ShapeName(Explosion) }, "gray"))
	else
		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_rocket.multiple_stars", { Count, ShapeName(Explosion) }, "gray"))
	end

	ExplosionDetails(Explosion, function(Line: Component)
		Add(Prefixed(Indent, Line))
	end)
end

const function FireworkLines(Fireworks: { flight_duration: number?, explosions: { Fields }? }, Add: Add)
	if (Fireworks.flight_duration or 0) > 0 then
		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.firework_rocket.flight_duration", { Fireworks.flight_duration }, "gray"))
	end

	const Explosions = Fireworks.explosions or {}
	local Current: Fields? = nil
	local Count = 0

	for _, Explosion in Explosions do
		if Current and Items.Equal(Current, Explosion) then
			Count += 1
		else
			if Current then
				ExplosionGroup(Current, Count, Add)
			end

			Current = Explosion
			Count = 1
		end
	end

	if Current then
		ExplosionGroup(Current, Count, Add)
	end
end

const function ModifierLine(Attribute: string, Id: string, Amount: number, Operation: string, Options: Options, Add: Add)
	const Definition = Registry.Attribute(Attribute)
	local Value = Amount
	local WithBase = false

	if Options.HasPlayer then
		if Id == BaseAttackDamageId then
			Value += Registry.Attribute("minecraft:attack_damage").player or 0
			WithBase = true
		elseif Id == BaseAttackSpeedId then
			Value += Registry.Attribute("minecraft:attack_speed").player or 0
			WithBase = true
		end
	end

	const Display = if Operation ~= "add_value" then Value * 100 elseif Attribute == KnockbackResistance then Value * 10 else Value
	const Name = Translatable(Definition.descriptionId)

	if WithBase then
		Add(Prefixed(Space, Translatable(`attribute.modifier.equals.{OperationIds[Operation]}`, { FormatNumber(Display), Name }), "dark_green"))
	elseif Value > 0 then
		const Color = if Definition.sentiment == "positive" then "blue" elseif Definition.sentiment == "negative" then "red" else "gray"

		Add(Translatable(`attribute.modifier.plus.{OperationIds[Operation]}`, { FormatNumber(Display), Name }, Color))
	elseif Value < 0 then
		const Color = if Definition.sentiment == "positive" then "red" elseif Definition.sentiment == "negative" then "blue" else "gray"

		Add(Translatable(`attribute.modifier.take.{OperationIds[Operation]}`, { FormatNumber(-Display), Name }, Color))
	end
end

const function AttributeLines(Stack: ItemStack, Options: Options, Add: Add)
	if not Shows(Stack, "minecraft:attribute_modifiers") then
		return
	end

	const Modifiers = (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:attribute_modifiers") or {}) :: { Fields }

	for _, Group in SlotGroups do
		local First = true

		for _, Modifier in Modifiers do
			const Display = Modifier.display :: { type: string, value: Component? }?

			if (Modifier.slot or "any") == Group and not (Display and Display.type == "hidden") then
				if First then
					Add(Empty)
					Add(Translatable(`item.modifiers.{Group}`, nil, "gray"))
					First = false
				end

				if Display and Display.type == "override" then
					Add(Display.value)
				else
					ModifierLine(Modifier.type :: string, Modifier.id :: string, Modifier.amount :: number, Modifier.operation :: string, Options, Add)
				end
			end
		end

		for Index = 1, Items.Enchantments.Modifiers(Stack, Group, true, EnchantmentModifiers) do
			const Enchanted = EnchantmentModifiers[Index]

			if First then
				Add(Empty)
				Add(Translatable(`item.modifiers.{Group}`, nil, "gray"))
				First = false
			end

			ModifierLine(Enchanted.Attribute, Enchanted.Id, Enchanted.Amount, Enchanted.Operation, Options, Add)
		end
	end
end

const function PredicateBlocks(Blocks: unknown): { string }
	if type(Blocks) == "table" then
		return Blocks :: { string }
	end

	const Id = Blocks :: string

	return if string.sub(Id, 1, 1) == "#" then Registry.TagMembers("minecraft:block", Namespaced(string.sub(Id, 2))) else { Id }
end

const function AdventureLines(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string, Header: string, Add: Add)
	const Value = Shown(Stack, Type)

	if Value == nil then
		return
	end

	const Predicates = if #(Value :: { unknown }) > 0 then Value :: { Fields } else { Value :: Fields }

	Add(Empty)
	Add(Translatable(Header, nil, "gray"))

	for _, Predicate in Predicates do
		if Predicate.blocks == nil then
			Add(Translatable("item.canUse.unknown", nil, "gray"))

			return
		end
	end

	const Seen: { [string]: true } = {}

	for _, Predicate in Predicates do
		for _, Block in PredicateBlocks(Predicate.blocks) do
			const Id = Namespaced(Block)

			if not Seen[Id] then
				Seen[Id] = true
				Add(Translatable(Registry.BlockDescriptionId(Id), nil, "dark_gray"))
			end
		end
	end
end

const function ItemHoverText(Stack: ItemStack, Options: Options, Add: Add)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Item.HoverText then
		for _, Line in Item.HoverText do
			Add(Line)
		end
	elseif Item.Id == "minecraft:painting" and Shows(Stack, "minecraft:painting_variant") then
		const Variant = Entry("minecraft:painting_variant", Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:painting_variant"))

		if Variant then
			if Variant.title ~= nil then
				Add(Variant.title)
			end

			if Variant.author ~= nil then
				Add(Variant.author)
			end

			Add(Translatable("painting.dimensions", { Variant.width, Variant.height }))
		elseif Options.Creative then
			Add(Translatable("painting.random", nil, "gray"))
		end
	end
end

const function FishLines(Stack: ItemStack, Pattern: string, Add: Add)
	const Base = (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tropical_fish/base_color") or DefaultFishColor) :: string
	const PatternColor = (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tropical_fish/pattern_color") or DefaultFishColor) :: string

	for Index, Variant in TropicalFishVariants do
		if Variant[1] == Pattern and Variant[2] == Base and Variant[3] == PatternColor then
			Add(Translatable(`entity.minecraft.tropical_fish.predefined.{Index - 1}`, nil, "gray", true))

			return
		end
	end

	Add(Translatable(`entity.minecraft.tropical_fish.type.{Pattern}`, nil, "gray", true))

	const Colors = Translatable(`color.minecraft.{Base}`, nil, "gray", true)

	if Base ~= PatternColor then
		Colors.extra = { ", ", Translatable(`color.minecraft.{PatternColor}`) }
	end

	Add(Colors)
end

const function SlotOrder(A: { slot: number, item: unknown }, B: { slot: number, item: unknown }): boolean
	return A.slot < B.slot
end

const function ContainerLines(Slots: { { slot: number, item: unknown } }, Add: Add)
	const Ordered = table.clone(Slots)
	local Lines = 0
	local Total = 0

	table.sort(Ordered, SlotOrder)

	for _, Slot in Ordered do
		const Item = Items.FromTemplate(Slot.item)

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Item) then
			Total += 1

			if Lines < MaxContainerLines then
				Lines += 1
				Add(Translatable("item.container.item_count", { Items.GetCount(Item), Items.GetHoverName(Item) }))
			end
		end
	end

	if Total > Lines then
		Add(Translatable("item.container.more_items", { Total - Lines }, nil, true))
	end
end

const function LeadingLines(Stack: ItemStack, Add: Add)
	const Pattern = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:tropical_fish/pattern") :: string?

	if Pattern then
		FishLines(Stack, Pattern, Add)
	end

	const Instrument = Entry("minecraft:instrument", Shown(Stack, "minecraft:instrument"))

	if Instrument then
		Add(MergeStyles(Instrument.description, "gray"))
	end

	if Shown(Stack, "minecraft:map_id") ~= nil then
		Add(Translatable("filled_map.unknown", nil, "gray"))
	end

	const Bees = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:bees") :: { unknown }?

	if Bees then
		Add(Translatable("container.beehive.bees", { #Bees, MaxBees }, "gray"))
	end

	if Shown(Stack, "minecraft:container_loot") ~= nil then
		Add(Translatable("item.container.loot_table.unknown"))
	end

	const Container = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:container") :: { { slot: number, item: unknown } }?

	if Container then
		ContainerLines(Container, Add)
	end

	const Banner = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:banner_patterns") :: { { pattern: unknown, color: string } }?

	if Banner then
		for Index = 1, math.min(#Banner, MaxBannerLines) do
			const Layer = Banner[Index]
			const BannerPattern = Entry("minecraft:banner_pattern", Layer.pattern) :: Fields

			Add(Translatable(`{BannerPattern.translation_key}.{Layer.color}`, nil, "gray"))
		end
	end

	const Pot = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:pot_decorations") :: { [string]: unknown }?

	if Pot and next(Pot) ~= nil then
		Add(Empty)

		for _, Side in PotSides do
			if Pot[Side] ~= nil then
				const Name = PlainCopy(Items.GetHoverName(Items.FromTemplate(Pot[Side])))

				Name.color = "gray"
				Add(Name)
			end
		end
	end

	const Book = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:written_book_content") :: { author: string?, generation: number? }?

	if Book then
		if Book.author and string.find(Book.author, "%S") then
			Add(Translatable("book.byAuthor", { Book.author }, "gray"))
		end

		Add(Translatable(`book.generation.{Book.generation or 0}`, nil, "gray"))
	end
end

const function TrailingLines(Stack: ItemStack, Options: Options, Add: Add)
	const Fireworks = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { flight_duration: number?, explosions: { Fields }? }?

	if Fireworks then
		FireworkLines(Fireworks, Add)
	end

	const Explosion = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:firework_explosion") :: Fields?

	if Explosion then
		const Shape = ShapeName(Explosion)

		Shape.color = "gray"
		Add(Shape)
		ExplosionDetails(Explosion, Add)
	end

	const Potion = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

	if Potion ~= nil then
		PotionLines(PotionEffects(Potion), (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_duration_scale") or 1) :: number, Add)
	end

	const Song = Entry("minecraft:jukebox_song", Shown(Stack, "minecraft:jukebox_playable"))

	if Song then
		Add(MergeStyles(Song.description, "gray"))
	end

	const Trim = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:trim") :: { material: unknown, pattern: unknown }?

	if Trim then
		const Material = Entry("minecraft:trim_material", Trim.material) :: Fields
		const TrimPattern = Entry("minecraft:trim_pattern", Trim.pattern) :: Fields

		Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.smithing_template.upgrade", nil, "gray"))
		Add(Prefixed(Space, WithStyle(TrimPattern.description, Material.description)))
		Add(Prefixed(Space, Material.description))
	end

	const Stored = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:stored_enchantments") :: { [string]: number }?

	if Stored then
		EnchantmentLines(Stored, Add)
	end

	const Enchantments = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:enchantments") :: { [string]: number }?

	if Enchantments then
		EnchantmentLines(Enchantments, Add)
	end

	const Dyed = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:dyed_color") :: number?

	if Dyed then
		if Options.Advanced then
			Add(Translatable("item.color", { string.format("#%06X", Dyed) }, "gray"))
		else
			Add(Translatable("item.dyed", nil, "gray", true))
		end
	end

	const Profile = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:profile")

	if Profile ~= nil then
		const Partial = if type(Profile) == "table" then Profile :: { id: unknown?, name: string?, properties: { unknown }? } else nil
		const Dynamic = if Partial then (Partial.properties == nil or next(Partial.properties) == nil) and (Partial.id ~= nil) ~= (Partial.name ~= nil) else true

		if Dynamic then
			Add(Translatable("component.profile.dynamic", nil, "gray"))
		end
	end

	const Lore = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:lore") :: { Component }?

	if Lore then
		for _, Line in Lore do
			const Styled = MergeStyles(Line, "dark_purple")

			if Styled.italic == nil then
				Styled.italic = true
			end

			Add(Styled)
		end
	end

	const Sulfur = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:sulfur_cube_content")

	if Sulfur ~= nil then
		Add(Translatable("entity.minecraft.sulfur_cube.content", { Items.GetHoverName(Items.FromTemplate(Sulfur)) }, "gray", true))
	end
end

const function SignLines(Stack: ItemStack, Side: string, Add: Add)
	const Type = `minecraft:sign_text_{Side}`
	const Sign = Shown(Stack, Type) :: { messages: { Component }, filtered_messages: { Component }?, color: string?, has_glowing_text: boolean? }?

	if not Sign then
		return
	end

	local IsEmpty = (Sign.color or "black") == "black" and not Sign.has_glowing_text

	for Index, Message in Sign.messages do
		if not IsEmptyText(Message) or (Sign.filtered_messages and not IsEmptyText(Sign.filtered_messages[Index])) then
			IsEmpty = false
		end
	end

	if IsEmpty then
		return
	end

	Add(Translatable(`sign.{Side}_text`, nil, "gray"))

	for _, Message in Sign.messages do
		Add(Prefixed(Indent, Message))
	end
end

const function SpawnerLines(Stack: ItemStack, Add: Add)
	const Data = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:block_entity_data") :: Fields?
	const SpawnData = if Data then Data.SpawnData :: { entity: { id: string? }? }? else nil
	const EntityId = if SpawnData and SpawnData.entity then SpawnData.entity.id else nil

	if EntityId then
		const DescriptionId = string.gsub(Namespaced(EntityId), ":", ".")

		Add(Translatable(`entity.{DescriptionId}`, nil, "gray"))
	else
		Add(Empty)
		Add(Translatable("block.minecraft.spawner.desc1", nil, "gray"))
		Add(Prefixed(Space, Translatable("block.minecraft.spawner.desc2", nil, "blue")))
	end
end

const function AdvancedLines(Stack: ItemStack, Add: Add)
	if Items.IsDamaged(Stack) and Shows(Stack, "minecraft:damage") then
		Add(Translatable("item.durability", { Items.MaxDamage(Stack) - Items.DamageValue(Stack), Items.MaxDamage(Stack) }))
	end

	Add({ text = Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id, color = "dark_gray" })

	const Prototype = Stack.Item.Components
	local Count = 0

	for _ in Prototype do
		Count += 1
	end

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value == Items.Removed then
			Count -= 1
		elseif Prototype[Type] == nil then
			Count += 1
		end
	end

	if Count > 0 then
		Add(Translatable("item.components", { Count }, "dark_gray"))
	end
end

const function Details(Stack: ItemStack, Options: Options, Add: Add)
	ItemHoverText(Stack, Options, Add)
	LeadingLines(Stack, Add)

	const Projectiles = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:charged_projectiles") :: { unknown }?

	if Projectiles then
		const function Indented(Line: Component)
			Add(Prefixed(Indent, Line, "gray"))
		end

		local Current: ItemStack? = nil
		local Count = 0

		for Index = 1, #Projectiles + 1 do
			const Projectile = if Index <= #Projectiles then Items.FromTemplate(Projectiles[Index]) else nil

			if Current and Projectile and Items.Matches(Current, Projectile) then
				Count += 1
			else
				if Current then
					if Count == 1 then
						Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.crossbow.projectile.single", { DisplayName(Current) }))
					else
						Add(Translatable("item.minecraft.crossbow.projectile.multiple", { Count, Items.GetHoverName(Current) }))
					end

					Details(Current, ProjectileOptions, Indented)
				end

				Current = Projectile
				Count = 1
			end
		end
	end

	TrailingLines(Stack, Options, Add)
	AttributeLines(Stack, Options, Add)

	if Shown(Stack, "minecraft:intangible_projectile") ~= nil then
		Add(Translatable("item.intangible", nil, "gray"))
	end

	if Shown(Stack, "minecraft:unbreakable") ~= nil then
		Add(Translatable("item.unbreakable", nil, "blue"))
	end

	for _, Side in SignSides do
		SignLines(Stack, Side, Add)
	end

	const Amplifier = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:ominous_bottle_amplifier") :: number?

	if Amplifier then
		PotionLines({ { id = "minecraft:bad_omen", amplifier = Amplifier, duration = OminousDuration } }, 1, Add)
	end

	const Stew = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:suspicious_stew_effects") :: { { id: string, duration: number? } }?

	if Stew and Options.Creative then
		const Effects: { Fields } = {}

		for _, Effect in Stew do
			table.insert(Effects, { id = Effect.id, duration = Effect.duration or StewDuration })
		end

		PotionLines(Effects, 1, Add)
	end

	const State = Shown(Stack, "minecraft:block_state") :: { honey_level: string? }?
	const HoneyLevel = if State and State.honey_level then tonumber(State.honey_level) else nil

	if HoneyLevel then
		Add(Translatable("container.beehive.honey", { HoneyLevel, MaxHoneyLevel }, "gray"))
	end

	if (Items.Is(Stack, "minecraft:spawner") or Items.Is(Stack, "minecraft:trial_spawner")) and Shows(Stack, "minecraft:block_entity_data") then
		SpawnerLines(Stack, Add)
	end

	AdventureLines(Stack, "minecraft:can_break", "item.canBreak", Add)
	AdventureLines(Stack, "minecraft:can_place_on", "item.canPlace", Add)

	if Options.Advanced then
		AdvancedLines(Stack, Add)
	end
end

const function Lines(Stack: ItemStack, Options: Options): { Component }
	const Result: { Component } = {}
	const Display = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tooltip_display") :: { hide_tooltip: boolean? }?

	if not Options.Creative and Display and Display.hide_tooltip then
		return Result
	end

	table.insert(Result, StyledHoverName(Stack))
	Details(Stack, Options, function(Line: Component)
		table.insert(Result, Line)
	end)

	return Result
end

return {
	Lines = Lines,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Raster"] = function(require)

const Affine = require("../Affine")

const AlphaCutout = 26
const LightPower = 0.6
const AmbientLight = 0.4
const OverlayAlpha = 0xB3 / 255
const OverlayRed = 255 * (1 - OverlayAlpha)
const OpaqueAlpha = 0xFF000000
const DepthBias = 100000

export type Target = {
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Pixels: buffer,
	Depth: buffer,
}

export type Texture = {
	Size: Vector2,
	Pixels: buffer,
}

export type Polygon = {
	Vertices: { { Position: vector, U: number, V: number } },
	Normal: vector,
	Tint: number?,
}

export type Material = "Cutout" | "CutoutCull" | "Solid"

const ScreenX = table.create(4, 0)
const ScreenY = table.create(4, 0)
const ScreenZ = table.create(4, 0)

const function Create(Width: number, Height: number): Target
	return { Width = Width, Height = Height, Pixels = buffer.create(Width * Height * 4), Depth = buffer.create(Width * Height * 4) }
end

const function Clear(Target: Target)
	buffer.fill(Target.Pixels, 0, 0)
	buffer.fill(Target.Depth, 0, 0)
end

const function Blend(Pixels: buffer, Index: number, Red: number, Green: number, Blue: number, Alpha: number)
	const Existing = buffer.readu32(Pixels, Index)
	const Source = Alpha / 255
	const Kept = bit32.extract(Existing, 24, 8) / 255 * (1 - Source)
	const Combined = Source + Kept

	buffer.writeu32(Pixels, Index, bit32.bor(
		bit32.lshift(math.round(Combined * 255), 24),
		math.round((Red * Source + bit32.extract(Existing, 0, 8) * Kept) / Combined),
		bit32.lshift(math.round((Green * Source + bit32.extract(Existing, 8, 8) * Kept) / Combined), 8),
		bit32.lshift(math.round((Blue * Source + bit32.extract(Existing, 16, 8) * Kept) / Combined), 16)
	))
end

const function Constrain(Weight: number, Slope: number, First: number, Last: number): (number, number)
	if Slope > 0 then
		return math.max(First, (-Weight / Slope) // 1), Last
	elseif Slope < 0 then
		return First, math.min(Last, math.ceil(-Weight / Slope))
	elseif Weight < 0 then
		return First, First - 1
	end

	return First, Last
end

const function Triangle(
	Target: Target,
	Texture: Texture,
	A: number,
	B: number,
	C: number,
	UA: number,
	VA: number,
	UB: number,
	VB: number,
	UC: number,
	VC: number,
	Shade: vector,
	Hurt: boolean,
	Cutout: boolean
)
	const AX, AY, AZ = ScreenX[A], ScreenY[A], ScreenZ[A]
	const BX, BY, BZ = ScreenX[B], ScreenY[B], ScreenZ[B]
	const CX, CY, CZ = ScreenX[C], ScreenY[C], ScreenZ[C]
	const Area = (BX - AX) * (CY - AY) - (BY - AY) * (CX - AX)
	const Width = Target.Width
	const Height = Target.Height

	if Area == 0 then
		return
	end

	const MinX = math.max(0, math.min(AX, BX, CX) // 1)
	const MaxX = math.min(Width - 1, math.ceil(math.max(AX, BX, CX)))
	const MinY = math.max(0, math.min(AY, BY, CY) // 1)
	const MaxY = math.min(Height - 1, math.ceil(math.max(AY, BY, CY)))

	if MinX > MaxX or MinY > MaxY then
		return
	end

	const Pixels = Target.Pixels
	const Depth = Target.Depth
	const TextureWidth = Texture.Size.X
	const LastU = TextureWidth - 1
	const LastV = Texture.Size.Y - 1
	const TexturePixels = Texture.Pixels
	const SlopeAX = (BY - CY) / Area
	const SlopeAY = (CX - BX) / Area
	const SlopeBX = (CY - AY) / Area
	const SlopeBY = (AX - CX) / Area
	const SlopeCX = -(SlopeAX + SlopeBX)
	const StartX = MinX + 0.5
	const StartY = MinY + 0.5
	const DeltaZA, DeltaZB = AZ - CZ, BZ - CZ
	const DeltaUA, DeltaUB = UA - UC, UB - UC
	const DeltaVA, DeltaVB = VA - VC, VB - VC
	const Scale = if Hurt then Shade * OverlayAlpha else Shade
	const RedOffset = if Hurt then OverlayRed else 0
	const ScaleRed, ScaleGreen, ScaleBlue = Scale.x, Scale.y, Scale.z
	local RowA = ((BX - StartX) * (CY - StartY) - (BY - StartY) * (CX - StartX)) / Area
	local RowB = ((CX - StartX) * (AY - StartY) - (CY - StartY) * (AX - StartX)) / Area
	local LastTexel = -1
	local Alpha = 0
	local Red = 0
	local Green = 0
	local Blue = 0
	local Packed = 0

	for PixelY = MinY, MaxY do
		local First, Last = 0, MaxX - MinX

		First, Last = Constrain(RowA, SlopeAX, First, Last)
		First, Last = Constrain(RowB, SlopeBX, First, Last)
		First, Last = Constrain(1 - RowA - RowB, SlopeCX, First, Last)

		const RowIndex = PixelY * Width + MinX

		for Offset = math.max(First, 0), math.min(Last, MaxX - MinX) do
			const WeightA = RowA + SlopeAX * Offset
			const WeightB = RowB + SlopeBX * Offset

			if WeightA >= 0 and WeightB >= 0 and 1 - WeightA - WeightB >= 0 then
				const Z = CZ + DeltaZA * WeightA + DeltaZB * WeightB + DepthBias
				const Index = (RowIndex + Offset) * 4

				if Z >= buffer.readf32(Depth, Index) then
					const U = math.clamp((UC + DeltaUA * WeightA + DeltaUB * WeightB) // 1, 0, LastU)
					const V = math.clamp((VC + DeltaVA * WeightA + DeltaVB * WeightB) // 1, 0, LastV)
					const Texel = (V * TextureWidth + U) * 4

					if Texel ~= LastTexel then
						LastTexel = Texel
						Alpha = buffer.readu8(TexturePixels, Texel + 3)
						Red = math.min(255, math.round(RedOffset + buffer.readu8(TexturePixels, Texel) * ScaleRed))
						Green = math.min(255, math.round(buffer.readu8(TexturePixels, Texel + 1) * ScaleGreen))
						Blue = math.min(255, math.round(buffer.readu8(TexturePixels, Texel + 2) * ScaleBlue))
						Packed = bit32.bor(OpaqueAlpha, Red, bit32.lshift(Green, 8), bit32.lshift(Blue, 16))
					end

					if not Cutout or Alpha >= AlphaCutout then
						buffer.writef32(Depth, Index, Z)

						if Cutout and Alpha < 255 then
							Blend(Pixels, Index, Red, Green, Blue, Alpha)
						else
							buffer.writeu32(Pixels, Index, Packed)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		RowA += SlopeAY
		RowB += SlopeBY
	end
end

const function FaceLight(Normal: vector, Light0: vector, Light1: vector): number
	return math.min(1, (math.max(0, vector.dot(Light0, Normal)) + math.max(0, vector.dot(Light1, Normal))) * LightPower + AmbientLight)
end

const function DrawPolygon(Target: Target, Polygon: Polygon, Pose: Affine.Matrix, Texture: Texture, Material: Material, Light0: vector, Light1: vector, Hurt: boolean, CullBack: boolean)
	const Vertices = Polygon.Vertices

	for Index, Vertex in Vertices do
		const Position = Affine.Point(Pose, Vertex.Position)

		ScreenX[Index] = Position.x
		ScreenY[Index] = Position.y
		ScreenZ[Index] = Position.z
	end

	const Front = (ScreenX[2] - ScreenX[1]) * (ScreenY[3] - ScreenY[1]) - (ScreenY[2] - ScreenY[1]) * (ScreenX[3] - ScreenX[1]) < 0

	if not Front and (Material ~= "Cutout" or CullBack) then
		return
	end

	const Normal = Affine.Normal(Pose, Polygon.Normal)
	const Tint = Polygon.Tint
	const TintColor = if Tint then vector.create(bit32.extract(Tint, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Tint, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Tint, 0, 8)) / 255 else vector.one
	const Shade = TintColor * FaceLight(if Front then Normal else -Normal, Light0, Light1)
	const Cutout = Material ~= "Solid"

	Triangle(Target, Texture, 1, 2, 3, Vertices[1].U, Vertices[1].V, Vertices[2].U, Vertices[2].V, Vertices[3].U, Vertices[3].V, Shade, Hurt, Cutout)
	Triangle(Target, Texture, 1, 3, 4, Vertices[1].U, Vertices[1].V, Vertices[3].U, Vertices[3].V, Vertices[4].U, Vertices[4].V, Shade, Hurt, Cutout)
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Clear = Clear,
	Blend = Blend,
	DrawPolygon = DrawPolygon,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Tooltip"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")
const ItemRenderer = require("./ItemRenderer")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const Text = require("./Text")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack
type Formatted = Font.Formatted

export type Tooltip = {
	Lines: { Formatted },
	Widths: { number },
	Bundle: Bundle?,
	Style: string?,
	ExtraSpace: boolean,
}

export type Bundle = {
	Items: { ItemStack },
	Count: number,
	HiddenText: Formatted,
	Selected: number,
	SelectedName: Tooltip?,
	Valid: boolean,
	WeightNumerator: number,
	WeightDenominator: number,
	Description: { Formatted },
}

const White = -1
const DescriptionColor = -5592406
const MouseOffset = 12
const FlipOffset = 24
const Padding = 3
const Margin = 9
const EdgeMargin = 4
const BottomMargin = 3
const LineHeight = 10
const FirstLineSpace = 2
const BundleWidth = 96
const SlotSize = 24
const SlotMargin = 4
const Columns = 4
const MaxSlots = 12
const ProgressHeight = 13
const ProgressFillMax = 94
const ProgressMargin = 4
const BundleFooter = 8
const DescriptionLineHeight = 9
const SelectedNameOffset = 15
const ContentsType = "minecraft:bundle_contents"
const DefaultBackground = "minecraft:tooltip/background"
const DefaultFrame = "minecraft:tooltip/frame"
const RarityColors: { [string]: string } = {
	common = "white",
	uncommon = "yellow",
	rare = "aqua",
	epic = "light_purple",
}

local FullText: Formatted? = nil
local EmptyText: Formatted? = nil

const function Prepare(Components: { unknown }, ExtraSpace: boolean, Style: string?): Tooltip
	const Lines: { Formatted } = {}
	const Widths: { number } = {}

	for Index, Component in Components do
		const Run = Text.Flatten(Component, Font.PlainStyle)

		Lines[Index] = Run
		Widths[Index] = Font.FormattedWidth(Run)
	end

	return { Lines = Lines, Widths = Widths, Bundle = nil, Style = Style, ExtraSpace = ExtraSpace }
end

const function PrepareWrapped(Component: unknown, MaxWidth: number): Tooltip
	const Lines = Font.Split(Text.Flatten(Component, Font.PlainStyle), MaxWidth)
	const Widths: { number } = {}

	for Index, Line in Lines do
		Widths[Index] = Font.FormattedWidth(Line)
	end

	return { Lines = Lines, Widths = Widths, Bundle = nil, Style = nil, ExtraSpace = false }
end

const function SelectedNameTooltip(Stack: ItemStack): Tooltip
	const Name: { [string]: unknown } = { text = "", extra = { Items.GetHoverName(Stack) }, color = RarityColors[Items.Rarity(Stack)] }

	if Items.GetCustomName(Stack) ~= nil then
		Name.italic = true
	end

	return Prepare({ Name }, false, Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tooltip_style") :: string?)
end

const function PrepareBundle(Stack: ItemStack): Bundle
	const Templates = Items.Get(Stack, ContentsType) :: { unknown }
	const Valid, Numerator, Denominator = Items.Bundle.ContentsWeight(Templates)
	const Shown = math.min(#Templates, Items.Bundle.NumberOfItemsToShow(Stack))
	const Selected = Items.Bundle.SelectedItemIndex(Stack)
	const Contents: { ItemStack } = {}
	local Hidden = 0

	for Index, Template in Templates do
		if Index <= Shown then
			Contents[Index] = Items.FromTemplate(Template)
		else
			Hidden += if type(Template) == "table" then (Template :: { count: number? }).count or 1 else 1
		end
	end

	return {
		Items = Contents,
		Count = #Templates,
		HiddenText = Text.Flatten(`+{Hidden}`, Font.PlainStyle),
		Selected = Selected,
		SelectedName = if Selected >= 0 and Selected < #Templates then SelectedNameTooltip(Items.FromTemplate(Templates[Selected + 1])) else nil,
		Valid = Valid,
		WeightNumerator = Numerator,
		WeightDenominator = Denominator,
		Description = if #Templates == 0 then Font.Split(Text.Flatten({ translate = "item.minecraft.bundle.empty.description" }, Font.PlainStyle), BundleWidth) else {},
	}
end

const function ForItem(Stack: ItemStack, Components: { unknown }): Tooltip
	const Prepared = Prepare(Components, true, Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tooltip_style") :: string?)
	const Display = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:tooltip_display") :: { hidden_components: { string }? }?
	const Hidden = Display and Display.hidden_components
	const ShowsContents = not Hidden or table.find(Hidden, ContentsType) == nil

	if Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Stack), "BundleItem") and Items.Has(Stack, ContentsType) and ShowsContents then
		Prepared.Bundle = PrepareBundle(Stack)
	end

	return Prepared
end

const function ShowsWithItemInHand(Prepared: Tooltip): boolean
	return Prepared.Bundle ~= nil
end

const function GridRows(Bundle: Bundle): number
	return (math.min(MaxSlots, Bundle.Count) + Columns - 1) // Columns
end

const function BundleHeight(Bundle: Bundle): number
	if Bundle.Count == 0 then
		return #Bundle.Description * DescriptionLineHeight + ProgressHeight + BundleFooter
	end

	return GridRows(Bundle) * SlotSize + ProgressHeight + BundleFooter
end

const function SpriteFor(Style: string?, Suffix: string, Default: string): string
	if not Style then
		return Default
	end

	const Namespace, Path = string.match(Style, "^([^:]*):(.*)$")

	return if Namespace then `{Namespace}:tooltip/{Path}_{Suffix}` else `minecraft:tooltip/{Style}_{Suffix}`
end

const function Place(Width: number, Height: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, GuiWidth: number, GuiHeight: number): (number, number)
	local X = MouseX + MouseOffset
	local Y = MouseY - MouseOffset

	if X + Width > GuiWidth then
		X = math.max(X - FlipOffset - Width, EdgeMargin)
	end

	if Y + Height + BottomMargin > GuiHeight then
		Y = GuiHeight - Height - BottomMargin
	end

	return X, Y
end

const function DrawBackground(Style: string?, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number)
	const BoxX = X - Padding - Margin
	const BoxY = Y - Padding - Margin
	const BoxWidth = Width + (Padding + Margin) * 2
	const BoxHeight = Height + (Padding + Margin) * 2

	Canvas.BlitSprite(SpriteFor(Style, "background", DefaultBackground), BoxX, BoxY, BoxWidth, BoxHeight, White)
	Canvas.BlitSprite(SpriteFor(Style, "frame", DefaultFrame), BoxX, BoxY, BoxWidth, BoxHeight, White)
end

const function DrawTextBox(Prepared: Tooltip, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, GuiWidth: number, GuiHeight: number)
	local Width = 0

	for _, LineWidth in Prepared.Widths do
		Width = math.max(Width, LineWidth)
	end

	const Height = #Prepared.Lines * LineHeight + (if Prepared.ExtraSpace and #Prepared.Lines ~= 1 then 0 else -2)
	const X, Y = Place(Width, Height, MouseX, MouseY, GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
	local LineY = Y

	DrawBackground(Prepared.Style, X, Y, Width, Height)

	for Index, Line in Prepared.Lines do
		Font.DrawFormatted(Line, X, LineY, White, true)
		LineY += LineHeight + (if Prepared.ExtraSpace and Index == 1 then FirstLineSpace else 0)
	end
end

const function DrawCenteredText(Run: Formatted, X: number, Y: number)
	Font.DrawFormatted(Run, X - Font.FormattedWidth(Run) // 2, Y, White, true)
end

const function DrawProgressbar(Bundle: Bundle, X: number, Y: number)
	const Numerator = Bundle.WeightNumerator
	const Denominator = Bundle.WeightDenominator
	const Full = Numerator >= Denominator
	const Fill = math.clamp(Numerator * ProgressFillMax // Denominator, 0, ProgressFillMax)

	Canvas.BlitSprite(if Full then "minecraft:container/bundle/bundle_progressbar_full" else "minecraft:container/bundle/bundle_progressbar_fill", X + 1, Y, Fill, ProgressHeight, White)
	Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:container/bundle/bundle_progressbar_border", X, Y, BundleWidth, ProgressHeight, White)

	if Numerator == 0 then
		if not EmptyText then
			EmptyText = Text.Flatten({ translate = "item.minecraft.bundle.empty" }, Font.PlainStyle)
		end

		DrawCenteredText(EmptyText :: Formatted, X + BundleWidth // 2, Y + 3)
	elseif Full then
		if not FullText then
			FullText = Text.Flatten({ translate = "item.minecraft.bundle.full" }, Font.PlainStyle)
		end

		DrawCenteredText(FullText :: Formatted, X + BundleWidth // 2, Y + 3)
	end
end

const function DrawBundle(Bundle: Bundle, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, GuiWidth: number, GuiHeight: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	if not Bundle.Valid then
		return
	end

	const Left = X + (Width - BundleWidth) // 2

	if Bundle.Count == 0 then
		for Index, Line in Bundle.Description do
			Font.DrawFormatted(Line, Left, Y + (Index - 1) * DescriptionLineHeight, DescriptionColor, true)
		end

		DrawProgressbar(Bundle, Left, Y + #Bundle.Description * DescriptionLineHeight + ProgressMargin)

		return
	end

	const Overflowing = Bundle.Count > MaxSlots
	const Shown = #Bundle.Items
	const Rows = GridRows(Bundle)
	const StartX = Left + BundleWidth
	const StartY = Y + Rows * SlotSize
	local SlotNumber = 1

	for Row = 1, Rows do
		for Column = 1, Columns do
			const DrawX = StartX - Column * SlotSize
			const DrawY = StartY - Row * SlotSize

			if Overflowing and Column * Row == 1 then
				DrawCenteredText(Bundle.HiddenText, DrawX + SlotSize // 2, DrawY + 10)
			elseif Shown >= SlotNumber then
				const VisualIndex = Shown - SlotNumber
				const Highlight = VisualIndex == Bundle.Selected
				const Item = Bundle.Items[VisualIndex + 1]

				Canvas.BlitSprite(if Highlight then "minecraft:container/bundle/slot_highlight_back" else "minecraft:container/bundle/slot_background", DrawX, DrawY, SlotSize, SlotSize, White)
				ItemRenderer.DrawItem(Item, DrawX + SlotMargin, DrawY + SlotMargin, SlotNumber, Holder, Partial)
				ItemRenderer.DrawDecorations(Item, DrawX + SlotMargin, DrawY + SlotMargin)

				if Highlight then
					Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:container/bundle/slot_highlight_front", DrawX, DrawY, SlotSize, SlotSize, White)
				end

				SlotNumber += 1
			end
		end
	end

	const SelectedName = Bundle.SelectedName

	if SelectedName then
		DrawTextBox(SelectedName, X + Width // 2 - 12 - SelectedName.Widths[1] // 2, Y - SelectedNameOffset, GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
	end

	DrawProgressbar(Bundle, Left, Y + Rows * SlotSize + ProgressMargin)
end

const function Draw(Prepared: Tooltip, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, GuiWidth: number, GuiHeight: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	const Bundle = Prepared.Bundle

	if not Bundle then
		if #Prepared.Lines > 0 then
			DrawTextBox(Prepared, MouseX, MouseY, GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
		end

		return
	end

	const Image = if #Prepared.Lines == 0 then 1 else 2
	const Count = #Prepared.Lines + 1
	local Width = BundleWidth
	local Height = (if Prepared.ExtraSpace and Count ~= 1 then 0 else -2) + BundleHeight(Bundle)

	for _, LineWidth in Prepared.Widths do
		Width = math.max(Width, LineWidth)
		Height += LineHeight
	end

	const X, Y = Place(Width, Height, MouseX, MouseY, GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
	local LineY = Y
	local ImageY = Y

	DrawBackground(Prepared.Style, X, Y, Width, Height)

	for Index = 1, Count do
		if Index == Image then
			ImageY = LineY
			LineY += BundleHeight(Bundle)
		else
			Font.DrawFormatted(Prepared.Lines[if Index > Image then Index - 1 else Index], X, LineY, White, true)
			LineY += LineHeight
		end

		if Prepared.ExtraSpace and Index == 1 then
			LineY += FirstLineSpace
		end
	end

	DrawBundle(Bundle, X, ImageY, Width, GuiWidth, GuiHeight, Holder, Partial)
end

return {
	Prepare = Prepare,
	PrepareWrapped = PrepareWrapped,
	ForItem = ForItem,
	ShowsWithItemInHand = ShowsWithItemInHand,
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/ScreenEffects"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Rendering = require("../Rendering")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const Argb = Minecraft.Argb

const UnderwaterTexture = "minecraft:misc/underwater"
const FireSprite = "minecraft:block/fire_1"
const EffectDepth = 0.5
const QuadExtent = 1
const UnderwaterRepeat = 4
const UnderwaterAlpha = 0.1
const ScrollScale = 64
const FireOffsetX = 0.24
const FireOffsetY = -0.3
const FireHalfSize = 0.5
const FireTurn = math.pi / 18
const FireAlpha = 229 / 255
const FireShrink = 0.2
const FireSides = { 1, -1 }
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

type Image = {
	Content: Content,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
}

local Underwater: Image? = nil
const FireSize = Textures.Sprite(Textures.Atlas("blocks"), FireSprite).Size
const FireBatch = Rendering.CreateQuadBatch("MinecraftScreenEffects", #FireSides * FireSize.X * FireSize.Y)
const FireLayouts: { [number]: { Rendering.QuadCell } } = {}
const FireColors: { Color3 } = {}
const FireAlphas: { number } = {}

const function MirroredImage(Source: buffer, SourceWidth: number, X: number, Y: number, Width: number, Height: number, Into: buffer, IntoY: number)
	for Row = 0, Height - 1 do
		for Column = 0, Width - 1 do
			const Texel = buffer.readu32(Source, ((Y + Row) * SourceWidth + X + Width - 1 - Column) * 4)

			buffer.writeu32(Into, ((IntoY + Row) * Width + Column) * 4, Texel)
		end
	end
end

const function CreateImage(Pixels: buffer, Width: number, Height: number): Image
	const Created = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(Width, Height) })

	Created:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Created.Size, Pixels)

	return { Content = Content.fromObject(Created), Width = Width, Height = Height }
end

const function UnderwaterImage(): Image
	if Underwater then
		return Underwater
	end

	const Texture = Textures.Texture(UnderwaterTexture)
	const Width = Texture.Size.X
	const Height = Texture.Size.Y
	const Pixels = buffer.create(Width * Height * 4)

	MirroredImage(Texture.Pixels, Width, 0, 0, Width, Height, Pixels, 0)

	const Created = CreateImage(Pixels, Width, Height)

	Underwater = Created

	return Created
end

const function DrawWrapped(Source: Image, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, U0: number, U1: number, V0: number, V1: number, Color: number)
	const Scale = Canvas.GuiScale()
	const Left = math.round(X0 * Scale)
	const Right = math.round(X1 * Scale)
	const Top = math.round(Y0 * Scale)
	const Bottom = math.round(Y1 * Scale)

	if Right <= Left or Bottom <= Top then
		return
	end

	const UPerPixel = (U1 - U0) / (Right - Left)
	const VPerPixel = (V1 - V0) / (Bottom - Top)
	local X = Left

	while X < Right do
		const TileU = (U0 + (X + 0.5 - Left) * UPerPixel) // 1
		const NextX = math.min(Right, math.round(Left + (TileU + 1 - U0) / UPerPixel))
		const StartU = math.clamp(U0 + (X - Left) * UPerPixel - TileU, 0, 1)
		const EndU = math.clamp(U0 + (NextX - Left) * UPerPixel - TileU, 0, 1)
		local Y = Top

		while Y < Bottom do
			const TileV = (V0 + (Y + 0.5 - Top) * VPerPixel) // 1
			const NextY = math.min(Bottom, math.round(Top + (TileV + 1 - V0) / VPerPixel))
			const StartV = math.clamp(V0 + (Y - Top) * VPerPixel - TileV, 0, 1)
			const EndV = math.clamp(V0 + (NextY - Top) * VPerPixel - TileV, 0, 1)

			Canvas.Blit(Source.Content, StartU * Source.Width, StartV * Source.Height, EndU * Source.Width, EndV * Source.Height, X / Scale, Y / Scale, NextX / Scale, NextY / Scale, Color)
			Y = NextY
		end

		X = NextX
	end
end

const function DrawUnderwater(Width: number, Height: number, Tangent: number, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	const HalfHeight = EffectDepth * Tangent
	const HalfWidth = HalfHeight * Width / Height
	const Left = math.max(-QuadExtent, -HalfWidth)
	const Right = math.min(QuadExtent, HalfWidth)
	const Bottom = math.max(-QuadExtent, -HalfHeight)
	const Top = math.min(QuadExtent, HalfHeight)
	const Scale = UnderwaterRepeat / (QuadExtent * 2)
	const UOffset = -YRot / ScrollScale
	const VOffset = XRot / ScrollScale
	const Brightness = Rendering.Brightness(Rendering.MaxLocalRawBrightness())
	const Shade = Argb.As8BitChannel(Brightness)
	const Color = Argb.Color(Argb.As8BitChannel(UnderwaterAlpha), Shade, Shade, Shade)

	DrawWrapped(
		UnderwaterImage(),
		(Left / HalfWidth + 1) / 2 * Width,
		(1 - Top / HalfHeight) / 2 * Height,
		(Right / HalfWidth + 1) / 2 * Width,
		(1 - Bottom / HalfHeight) / 2 * Height,
		(Left + QuadExtent) * Scale - UOffset - UnderwaterRepeat,
		(Right + QuadExtent) * Scale - UOffset - UnderwaterRepeat,
		VOffset + (QuadExtent - Top) * Scale,
		VOffset + (QuadExtent - Bottom) * Scale,
		Color
	)
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, HudFieldOfView: number, EyeInWater: boolean, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	if EyeInWater then
		DrawUnderwater(Width, Height, math.tan(HudFieldOfView * DegreesToRadians / 2), YRot, XRot)
	end
end

const function FireCells(): { Rendering.QuadCell }
	const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Textures.Atlas("blocks"), FireSprite)
	const Frame = Textures.FrameIndex(Sprite)
	const Existing = FireLayouts[Frame]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Built = Rendering.BuildQuadLayout("blocks", FireSprite, 1, 0, 0, 1)

	FireLayouts[Frame] = Built

	return Built
end

const function DrawFire(Burning: boolean, HudFieldOfView: number)
	Rendering.BeginQuads(FireBatch)

	if Burning then
		const Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		const Frame = Camera.CFrame
		const Eye = vector.create(Frame.X, Frame.Y, Frame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
		const Squash = math.tan(HudFieldOfView * DegreesToRadians / 2) / math.tan(Camera.FieldOfView * DegreesToRadians / 2)
		const Right = vector.create(Frame.RightVector.X, Frame.RightVector.Y, Frame.RightVector.Z) * FireShrink
		const Up = vector.create(Frame.UpVector.X, Frame.UpVector.Y, Frame.UpVector.Z) * FireShrink
		const Back = -vector.create(Frame.LookVector.X, Frame.LookVector.Y, Frame.LookVector.Z) * (FireShrink * Squash)
		const Cells = FireCells()

		Rendering.ShadeQuads(Cells, vector.one, FireAlpha, vector.one, FireColors, FireAlphas)

		for _, Side in FireSides do
			const Angle = -Side * FireTurn
			const Cosine = math.cos(Angle)
			const Sine = math.sin(Angle)
			const Center = Right * (Side * FireOffsetX - EffectDepth * Sine) + Up * FireOffsetY + Back * (-EffectDepth * Cosine)
			const QuadRight = Right * (FireHalfSize * Cosine) + Back * (-FireHalfSize * Sine)

			Rendering.DrawQuad(FireBatch, Eye + Center, QuadRight, Up * FireHalfSize, Cells, FireColors, FireAlphas)
		end
	end

	Rendering.FinishQuads(FireBatch)
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
	DrawFire = DrawFire,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/SpectatorMenu"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")
const Skins = require("../Skins")
const Text = require("./Text")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const Argb = Minecraft.Argb
const Uuid = Minecraft.Uuid

const FadeDelay = 5000
const FadeTime = 2000
const PageSize = 6
const ScrollLeftSlot = 0
const ScrollRightSlot = 7
const CloseSlot = 8
const HotbarWidth = 182
const HalfHotbar = 91
const DisabledBrightness = 0.25
const ActionBottom = 35

export type PlayerInfo = {
	Name: string,
	GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode,
}

type ItemKind = "Empty" | "Close" | "ScrollLeft" | "ScrollRight" | "TeleportCategory" | "TeamCategory" | "Player"

type Item = {
	Kind: ItemKind,
	Enabled: boolean,
	Name: unknown,
	PlayerId: number,
	PlayerName: string,
}

type Category = {
	Items: { Item },
	Prompt: unknown,
}

type Menu = {
	Category: Category,
	SelectedSlot: number,
	Page: number,
}

const Empty: Item = { Kind = "Empty", Enabled = false, Name = "", PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" }
const Close: Item = { Kind = "Close", Enabled = true, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.close" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" }
const ScrollLeft: Item = { Kind = "ScrollLeft", Enabled = true, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.previous_page" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" }
const ScrollRightEnabled: Item = { Kind = "ScrollRight", Enabled = true, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.next_page" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" }
const ScrollRightDisabled: Item = { Kind = "ScrollRight", Enabled = false, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.next_page" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" }
const Sprites: { [ItemKind]: string } = {
	Close = "minecraft:spectator/close",
	ScrollLeft = "minecraft:spectator/scroll_left",
	ScrollRight = "minecraft:spectator/scroll_right",
	TeleportCategory = "minecraft:spectator/teleport_to_player",
	TeamCategory = "minecraft:spectator/teleport_to_team",
}

local Current: Menu? = nil
local LastSelectionTime = 0

const function Millis(): number
	return os.clock() * 1000
end

const function TeleportCategory(Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): Category
	const Ids: { number } = {}
	const Items: { Item } = {}

	for Id, Info in Players do
		if Info.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			table.insert(Ids, Id)
		end
	end

	table.sort(Ids, function(First: number, Second: number): boolean
		return Uuid.Before(Uuid.Offline(Players[First].Name), Uuid.Offline(Players[Second].Name))
	end)

	for _, Id in Ids do
		const Name = Players[Id].Name

		table.insert(Items, { Kind = "Player", Enabled = true, Name = Name, PlayerId = Id, PlayerName = Name })
	end

	return { Items = Items, Prompt = { translate = "spectatorMenu.teleport.prompt" } }
end

const function RootCategory(Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): Category
	const Teleport = TeleportCategory(Players)

	return {
		Items = {
			{ Kind = "TeleportCategory", Enabled = #Teleport.Items > 0, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.teleport" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" },
			{ Kind = "TeamCategory", Enabled = false, Name = { translate = "spectatorMenu.team_teleport" }, PlayerId = 0, PlayerName = "" },
		},
		Prompt = { translate = "spectatorMenu.root.prompt" },
	}
end

const function ItemAt(Menu: Menu, Slot: number): Item
	const Index = Slot + Menu.Page * PageSize
	const Items = Menu.Category.Items

	if Menu.Page > 0 and Slot == ScrollLeftSlot then
		return ScrollLeft
	elseif Slot == ScrollRightSlot then
		return if Index < #Items then ScrollRightEnabled else ScrollRightDisabled
	elseif Slot == CloseSlot then
		return Close
	end

	return if Index >= 0 and Index < #Items then Items[Index + 1] else Empty
end

const function Exit()
	Current = nil
	LastSelectionTime = 0
end

const function Use(Menu: Menu, Item: Item, Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): number?
	if Item.Kind == "Close" then
		Exit()
	elseif Item.Kind == "ScrollLeft" then
		Menu.Page -= 1
	elseif Item.Kind == "ScrollRight" then
		Menu.Page += 1
	elseif Item.Kind == "TeleportCategory" then
		Menu.Category = TeleportCategory(Players)
		Menu.SelectedSlot = -1
		Menu.Page = 0
	elseif Item.Kind == "Player" then
		return Item.PlayerId
	end

	return nil
end

const function SelectSlot(Menu: Menu, Slot: number, Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): number?
	const Item = ItemAt(Menu, Slot)

	if Item == Empty then
		return nil
	end

	if Menu.SelectedSlot == Slot and Item.Enabled then
		return Use(Menu, Item, Players)
	end

	Menu.SelectedSlot = Slot

	return nil
end

const function Open(Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): Menu
	const Created: Menu = { Category = RootCategory(Players), SelectedSlot = -1, Page = 0 }

	Current = Created

	return Created
end

const function HotbarSelected(Slot: number, Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): number?
	LastSelectionTime = Millis()

	const Menu = Current

	if Menu then
		return SelectSlot(Menu, Slot, Players)
	end

	Open(Players)

	return nil
end

const function ActionKeyPressed(Players: { [number]: PlayerInfo }): number?
	LastSelectionTime = Millis()

	const Menu = Current

	if not Menu then
		Open(Players)

		return nil
	end

	if Menu.SelectedSlot ~= -1 then
		return SelectSlot(Menu, Menu.SelectedSlot, Players)
	end

	return nil
end

const function IsActive(): boolean
	return Current ~= nil
end

const function Scrolled(Wheel: number)
	const Menu = Current

	if not Menu then
		return
	end

	local Slot = Menu.SelectedSlot + Wheel

	while Slot >= 0 and Slot <= CloseSlot and (ItemAt(Menu, Slot) == Empty or not ItemAt(Menu, Slot).Enabled) do
		Slot += Wheel
	end

	if Slot >= 0 and Slot <= CloseSlot then
		Menu.SelectedSlot = Slot
		LastSelectionTime = Millis()
	end
end

const function Alpha(): number
	return math.clamp((LastSelectionTime - Millis() + FadeDelay) / FadeTime, 0, 1)
end

const function DrawIcon(Item: Item, X: number, Y: number, Brightness: number, Fade: number)
	if Item.Kind == "Player" then
		const Texture = Skins.ForName(Item.PlayerName).Texture
		const Source = Textures.TextureContent(Texture)
		const Color = Argb.White(Argb.As8BitChannel(Fade))

		Canvas.Blit(Source, 8, 8, 16, 16, X + 2, Y + 2, X + 14, Y + 14, Color)
		Canvas.Blit(Source, 40, 8, 48, 16, X + 2, Y + 2, X + 14, Y + 14, Color)

		return
	end

	const Shade = Argb.As8BitChannel(Brightness)

	Canvas.BlitSprite(Sprites[Item.Kind], X, Y, 16, 16, Argb.Color(Argb.As8BitChannel(Fade), Shade, Shade, Shade))
end

const function DrawHotbar(Width: number, Height: number)
	const Menu = Current

	if not Menu then
		return
	end

	const Fade = Alpha()

	if Fade <= 0 then
		Exit()

		return
	end

	const Center = Width // 2
	const Y = (Height - 22 * Fade) // 1
	const Color = Argb.White(Argb.As8BitChannel(Fade))

	Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/hotbar", Center - HalfHotbar, Y, HotbarWidth, 22, Color)

	if Menu.SelectedSlot >= 0 then
		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:hud/hotbar_selection", Center - HalfHotbar - 1 + Menu.SelectedSlot * 20, Y - 1, 24, 23, Color)
	end

	for Slot = 0, CloseSlot do
		const Item = ItemAt(Menu, Slot)
		const X = Width // 2 - 90 + Slot * 20 + 2

		if Item == Empty then
			continue
		end

		DrawIcon(Item, X, Y + 3, if Item.Enabled then 1 else DisabledBrightness, Fade)

		if Item.Enabled then
			const Key = tostring(Slot + 1)

			Font.Draw(Key, X + 19 - 2 - Font.Width(Key), Y + 3 + 6 + 3, Color, true)
		end
	end
end

const function DrawAction(Width: number, Height: number)
	const Menu = Current
	const Fade = Alpha()

	if not Menu or Fade <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Item = ItemAt(Menu, Menu.SelectedSlot)
	const Run = Text.Flatten(if Item == Empty then Menu.Category.Prompt else Item.Name, Font.PlainStyle)
	const TextWidth = Font.FormattedWidth(Run)

	Font.DrawFormatted(Run, (Width - TextWidth) // 2, Height - ActionBottom, Argb.White(Argb.As8BitChannel(Fade)), true)
end

return {
	HotbarSelected = HotbarSelected,
	ActionKeyPressed = ActionKeyPressed,
	IsActive = IsActive,
	Scrolled = Scrolled,
	DrawHotbar = DrawHotbar,
	DrawAction = DrawAction,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Text"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Font = require("./Font")

const Language = Minecraft.Language

type Style = Font.Style
type Formatted = Font.Formatted

type Component = {
	text: string?,
	translate: string?,
	fallback: string?,
	with: { unknown }?,
	extra: { unknown }?,
	color: string?,
	bold: boolean?,
	italic: boolean?,
	underlined: boolean?,
	strikethrough: boolean?,
	obfuscated: boolean?,
}

const SectionSign = 167
const NullArgument = "null"

const NamedColors: { [string]: number } = {
	black = 0x000000,
	dark_blue = 0x0000AA,
	dark_green = 0x00AA00,
	dark_aqua = 0x00AAAA,
	dark_red = 0xAA0000,
	dark_purple = 0xAA00AA,
	gold = 0xFFAA00,
	gray = 0xAAAAAA,
	dark_gray = 0x555555,
	blue = 0x5555FF,
	green = 0x55FF55,
	aqua = 0x55FFFF,
	red = 0xFF5555,
	light_purple = 0xFF55FF,
	yellow = 0xFFFF55,
	white = 0xFFFFFF,
}

const LegacyColorCodes = "0123456789abcdef"
const LegacyColorNames = { "black", "dark_blue", "dark_green", "dark_aqua", "dark_red", "dark_purple", "gold", "gray", "dark_gray", "blue", "green", "aqua", "red", "light_purple", "yellow", "white" }

const function CopyStyle(Base: Style): Style
	return {
		Color = Base.Color,
		Bold = Base.Bold,
		Italic = Base.Italic,
		Underlined = Base.Underlined,
		Strikethrough = Base.Strikethrough,
		Obfuscated = Base.Obfuscated,
	}
end

const function ParseColor(Name: string): number?
	if string.sub(Name, 1, 1) == "#" then
		return tonumber(string.sub(Name, 2), 16)
	end

	return NamedColors[Name]
end

const function ApplyStyle(Component: Component, Parent: Style): Style
	const Style = CopyStyle(Parent)
	const Color = Component.color and ParseColor(Component.color)

	if Color then
		Style.Color = Color
	end

	if Component.bold ~= nil then
		Style.Bold = Component.bold
	end

	if Component.italic ~= nil then
		Style.Italic = Component.italic
	end

	if Component.underlined ~= nil then
		Style.Underlined = Component.underlined
	end

	if Component.strikethrough ~= nil then
		Style.Strikethrough = Component.strikethrough
	end

	if Component.obfuscated ~= nil then
		Style.Obfuscated = Component.obfuscated
	end

	return Style
end

const function ApplyLegacyFormat(Base: Style, Code: string): Style?
	const Lower = string.lower(Code)
	const ColorIndex = string.find(LegacyColorCodes, Lower, 1, true)
	const Style = CopyStyle(Base)

	if ColorIndex then
		Style.Color = NamedColors[LegacyColorNames[ColorIndex]]
		Style.Bold = false
		Style.Italic = false
		Style.Underlined = false
		Style.Strikethrough = false
		Style.Obfuscated = false
	elseif Lower == "k" then
		Style.Obfuscated = true
	elseif Lower == "l" then
		Style.Bold = true
	elseif Lower == "m" then
		Style.Strikethrough = true
	elseif Lower == "n" then
		Style.Underlined = true
	elseif Lower == "o" then
		Style.Italic = true
	else
		return nil
	end

	return Style
end

const function AppendLiteral(Run: Formatted, Text: string, Style: Style)
	local Current = Style
	local PendingSection = false

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Text) do
		if PendingSection then
			PendingSection = false

			if utf8.char(Codepoint) == "r" or utf8.char(Codepoint) == "R" then
				Current = Style
			else
				Current = ApplyLegacyFormat(Current, utf8.char(Codepoint)) or Current
			end
		elseif Codepoint == SectionSign then
			PendingSection = true
		else
			Run.Count += 1
			Run.Codepoints[Run.Count] = Codepoint
			Run.Styles[Run.Count] = Current
		end
	end
end

const function Append(Run: Formatted, Value: unknown, Parent: Style)
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		AppendLiteral(Run, Value, Parent)

		return
	end

	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if #(Value :: { unknown }) > 0 then
		const List = Value :: { unknown }
		const First = List[1]
		const FirstStyle = if type(First) == "table" and #(First :: { unknown }) == 0 then ApplyStyle(First :: Component, Parent) else Parent

		Append(Run, First, Parent)

		for Index = 2, #List do
			Append(Run, List[Index], FirstStyle)
		end

		return
	end

	const Component = Value :: Component
	const Style = ApplyStyle(Component, Parent)

	if Component.text then
		AppendLiteral(Run, Component.text, Style)
	elseif Component.translate then
		const Template = Language.Translate(Component.translate) or Component.fallback or Component.translate
		const Arguments = Component.with or {}
		const Parts = Language.DecomposeTemplate(Template)
		local Valid = Parts ~= nil

		if Parts then
			for _, Part in Parts do
				if type(Part) == "number" and Arguments[Part] == nil and Part > #Arguments then
					Valid = false
				end
			end
		end

		if Valid and Parts then
			for _, Part in Parts do
				if type(Part) == "string" then
					AppendLiteral(Run, Part, Style)
				else
					const Argument = Arguments[Part]

					if type(Argument) == "table" then
						Append(Run, Argument, Style)
					else
						AppendLiteral(Run, if Argument == nil then NullArgument else Language.ArgumentText(Argument), Style)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			AppendLiteral(Run, Template, Style)
		end
	end

	if Component.extra then
		for _, Child in Component.extra do
			Append(Run, Child, Style)
		end
	end
end

const function Flatten(Component: unknown, Parent: Style): Formatted
	const Run: Formatted = { Codepoints = {}, Styles = {}, Count = 0 }

	Append(Run, Component, Parent)

	return Run
end

const function Style(Color: number?, Italic: boolean): Style
	const Created = CopyStyle(Font.PlainStyle)

	Created.Color = Color
	Created.Italic = Italic

	return Created
end

return {
	NamedColors = NamedColors,
	Translate = Language.Translate,
	Flatten = Flatten,
	Style = Style,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/ChatComponent"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")
const Text = require("./Text")
const Tooltip = require("./Tooltip")

const Argb = Minecraft.Argb

const MaximumHistory = 100
const ChatWidth = 320
const UnfocusedHeight = 90
const FocusedHeight = 180
const BottomMargin = 40
const EntryHeight = 9
const EntryBottomToMessageY = 8
const Indent = 4
const TextOpacity = 1
const BackgroundOpacity = 0.5
const VisibleTicks = 200
const FadeScale = 10
const MinimumAlpha = 1.0E-5
const TagWidth = 2
const TagIndicatorColor = 0xD0D0D0
const TooltipWidth = 210
const ScrollbarColor = 0x3333AA
const ScrollbarNewColor = 0xCC3333
const ScrollbarEdgeColor = 0xCCCCCC
const ScrolledAlpha = 170
const RestingAlpha = 96
const SpaceCodepoint = 32

export type Tag = "System" | "NotSecure"

type Line = {
	Run: Font.Formatted,
	AddedTime: number,
	Tag: Tag?,
	EndOfEntry: boolean,
}

const TagTexts: { [Tag]: unknown } = {
	System = { translate = "chat.tag.system_single_player" },
	NotSecure = { translate = "chat.tag.not_secure" },
}

const Lines: { Line } = {}

local TickCount = 0
local ScrollPos = 0
local NewMessageSinceScroll = false
local Focused = false

const function LinesPerPage(): number
	return (if Focused then FocusedHeight else UnfocusedHeight) // EntryHeight
end

const function Scroll(Direction: number)
	ScrollPos += Direction

	const Maximum = #Lines - LinesPerPage()

	if ScrollPos > Maximum then
		ScrollPos = Maximum
	end

	if ScrollPos <= 0 then
		ScrollPos = 0
		NewMessageSinceScroll = false
	end
end

const function ResetScroll()
	ScrollPos = 0
	NewMessageSinceScroll = false
end

const function SetFocused(IsFocused: boolean)
	Focused = IsFocused
end

const function IsFocused(): boolean
	return Focused
end

const function Tick()
	TickCount += 1
end

const function AddMessage(Component: unknown, Tag: Tag?)
	const Split, Wrapped = Font.Split(Text.Flatten(Component, Font.PlainStyle), ChatWidth)

	if #Split == 0 then
		table.insert(Split, { Codepoints = {}, Styles = {}, Count = 0 })
		table.insert(Wrapped, false)
	end

	for Index, Run in Split do
		if Focused and ScrollPos > 0 then
			NewMessageSinceScroll = true
			Scroll(1)
		end

		if Wrapped[Index] then
			table.insert(Run.Codepoints, 1, SpaceCodepoint)
			table.insert(Run.Styles, 1, Font.PlainStyle)
			Run.Count += 1
		end

		table.insert(Lines, 1, { Run = Run, AddedTime = TickCount, Tag = Tag, EndOfEntry = Index == #Split })
	end

	for Index = #Lines, MaximumHistory + 1, -1 do
		Lines[Index] = nil
	end
end

const function Alpha(Line: Line): number
	if Focused then
		return 1
	end

	const Fade = math.clamp((1 - (TickCount - Line.AddedTime) / VisibleTicks) * FadeScale, 0, 1)

	return Fade * Fade
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const Total = #Lines

	if Total == 0 then
		return
	end

	const ChatBottom = Height - BottomMargin
	const Visible = math.min(Total - ScrollPos, LinesPerPage())
	local Count = 0
	local HoveredTag: Tag? = nil

	for Index = Visible - 1, 0, -1 do
		const Line = Lines[Index + ScrollPos + 1]
		const Opacity = Alpha(Line)

		if Opacity > MinimumAlpha then
			const EntryBottom = ChatBottom - Index * EntryHeight

			Count += 1
			Canvas.Fill(0, EntryBottom - EntryHeight, ChatWidth + Indent * 3, EntryBottom, Argb.Color(Argb.As8BitChannel(Opacity * BackgroundOpacity), 0, 0, 0))
		end
	end

	for Index = Visible - 1, 0, -1 do
		const Line = Lines[Index + ScrollPos + 1]
		const Opacity = Alpha(Line)

		if Opacity > MinimumAlpha then
			const EntryBottom = ChatBottom - Index * EntryHeight
			const EntryTop = EntryBottom - EntryHeight
			const Channel = Argb.As8BitChannel(Opacity * TextOpacity)

			Font.DrawFormatted(Line.Run, Indent, EntryBottom - EntryBottomToMessageY, Argb.White(Channel), true)

			if Line.Tag then
				Canvas.Fill(0, EntryTop, TagWidth, EntryBottom, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(Channel, 24), TagIndicatorColor))

				if Focused and MouseX >= 0 and MouseX < TagWidth and MouseY >= EntryTop and MouseY < EntryBottom then
					HoveredTag = Line.Tag
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if Focused then
		const ChatHeight = Count * EntryHeight
		const VirtualHeight = Total * EntryHeight

		if VirtualHeight ~= ChatHeight then
			const Y = (ScrollPos * ChatHeight) // Total - ChatBottom
			const BarHeight = (ChatHeight * ChatHeight) // VirtualHeight
			const BarAlpha = if Y > 0 then ScrolledAlpha else RestingAlpha
			const BarColor = if NewMessageSinceScroll then ScrollbarNewColor else ScrollbarColor
			const X = ChatWidth + Indent * 2

			Canvas.Fill(X, -Y, X + 2, -Y - BarHeight, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(BarAlpha, 24), BarColor))
			Canvas.Fill(X + 2, -Y, X + 1, -Y - BarHeight, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(BarAlpha, 24), ScrollbarEdgeColor))
		end

		if HoveredTag then
			Tooltip.Draw(Tooltip.PrepareWrapped(TagTexts[HoveredTag], TooltipWidth), MouseX, MouseY, Width, Height, nil, 0)
		end
	end
end

return {
	Tick = Tick,
	AddMessage = AddMessage,
	Draw = Draw,
	Scroll = Scroll,
	ResetScroll = ResetScroll,
	LinesPerPage = LinesPerPage,
	SetFocused = SetFocused,
	IsFocused = IsFocused,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/NoobHead"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const Canvas = require("./Canvas")

const Size = 16
const PixelsPerUnit = 10
const HeadRadius = 0.5
const HeadHalfHeight = 0.5
const Rounding = 0.2
const Ground = -0.7
const HopHeight = 0.18
const HopSeconds = 0.5
const SquashReach = 0.3
const SquashAmount = 0.14
const StretchAmount = 0.1
const SpinSeconds = 2.4
const WhipSeconds = 0.6
const Sway = 0.45
const BlinkSeconds = 2.6
const BlinkLength = 0.15
const Tilt = math.rad(-12)
const MarchStart = -1.5
const MarchEnd = 1.5
const MarchSteps = 40
const HitDistance = 0.002
const NormalStep = 0.01
const FaceAngle = 1.3
const ShadowRow = Size - 1
const ShadowAlpha = 90
const White = -1
const Light = vector.normalize(vector.create(-0.45, 0.75, -0.5))
const Highlight = vector.normalize(Light + vector.create(0, 0, -1))

const Palette = {
	Dark = { 190, 132, 10 },
	Shade = { 224, 170, 22 },
	Base = { 247, 206, 46 },
	Light = { 255, 230, 100 },
	Shine = { 255, 248, 190 },
	Face = { 32, 30, 28 },
}

const Pixels = buffer.create(Size * Size * 4)
const Image = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(Size, Size) })
const Source = Content.fromObject(Image)

local SpinCos = 1
local SpinSin = 0
const TiltCos = math.cos(Tilt)
const TiltSin = math.sin(Tilt)
const ShownHalfHeight = HeadHalfHeight * TiltCos + HeadRadius * math.abs(TiltSin)
local CenterY = 0
local ScaleX = 1
local ScaleY = 1

const function Local(Point: vector): vector
	const Unscaled = vector.create(Point.x / ScaleX, (Point.y - CenterY) / ScaleY, Point.z / ScaleX)
	const Y = Unscaled.y * TiltCos + Unscaled.z * TiltSin
	const Z = -Unscaled.y * TiltSin + Unscaled.z * TiltCos

	return vector.create(Unscaled.x * SpinCos - Z * SpinSin, Y, Unscaled.x * SpinSin + Z * SpinCos)
end

const function Distance(Point: vector): number
	const Head = Local(Point)
	const Across = math.sqrt(Head.x * Head.x + Head.z * Head.z) - (HeadRadius - Rounding)
	const Along = math.abs(Head.y) - (HeadHalfHeight - Rounding)
	const Outside = math.sqrt(math.max(Across, 0) ^ 2 + math.max(Along, 0) ^ 2)

	return (math.min(math.max(Across, Along), 0) + Outside - Rounding) * math.min(ScaleX, ScaleY)
end

const function Normal(Point: vector): vector
	const X = vector.create(NormalStep, 0, 0)
	const Y = vector.create(0, NormalStep, 0)
	const Z = vector.create(0, 0, NormalStep)
