	return vector.normalize(vector.create(
		Distance(Point + X) - Distance(Point - X),
		Distance(Point + Y) - Distance(Point - Y),
		Distance(Point + Z) - Distance(Point - Z)
	))
end

const function OnFace(Head: vector, Blinking: boolean): boolean
	const Angle = math.atan2(Head.x, -Head.z)

	if math.abs(Angle) > FaceAngle then
		return false
	end

	const X = Angle * HeadRadius
	const Y = Head.y
	const EyeX = math.abs(X) - 0.13

	if Blinking then
		if math.abs(EyeX) < 0.075 and math.abs(Y - 0.18) < 0.05 then
			return true
		end
	elseif (EyeX / 0.065) ^ 2 + ((Y - 0.18) / 0.14) ^ 2 < 1 then
		return true
	end

	const FromMouth = math.sqrt(X * X + (Y - 0.02) ^ 2)

	return Y < -0.04 and math.abs(FromMouth - 0.25) < 0.05
end

const function Shade(Point: vector, Blinking: boolean): { number }
	if OnFace(Local(Point), Blinking) then
		return Palette.Face
	end

	const Surface = Normal(Point)
	const Lit = 0.35 + 0.65 * math.max(0, vector.dot(Surface, Light))

	if math.max(0, vector.dot(Surface, Highlight)) ^ 24 > 0.55 then
		return Palette.Shine
	elseif Lit < 0.5 then
		return Palette.Dark
	elseif Lit < 0.68 then
		return Palette.Shade
	elseif Lit < 0.88 then
		return Palette.Base
	end

	return Palette.Light
end

const function Cast(X: number, Y: number): vector?
	local Depth = MarchStart

	for _ = 1, MarchSteps do
		const Point = vector.create(X, Y, Depth)
		const Step = Distance(Point)

		if Step < HitDistance then
			return Point
		end

		Depth += Step

		if Depth > MarchEnd then
			return nil
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function Write(Column: number, Row: number, Color: { number }, Alpha: number)
	buffer.writeu32(Pixels, (Row * Size + Column) * 4, bit32.bor(Color[1], bit32.lshift(Color[2], 8), bit32.lshift(Color[3], 16), bit32.lshift(Alpha, 24)))
end

const function Render(Seconds: number)
	const Phase = Seconds / HopSeconds % 1
	const Height = 4 * Phase * (1 - Phase)
	const Contact = math.max(0, 1 - Height / SquashReach)
	const Rising = if Phase < 0.5 then 1 - Contact else 0
	const Cycle = Seconds % SpinSeconds
	const Spin = if Cycle < WhipSeconds
		then (1 - math.cos(Cycle / WhipSeconds * math.pi)) * math.pi
		else math.sin((Cycle - WhipSeconds) / (SpinSeconds - WhipSeconds) * math.pi * 2) * Sway
	const Blinking = Seconds % BlinkSeconds < BlinkLength
	const ShadowWidth = 4 - 2 * Height

	ScaleX = 1 + StretchAmount * Contact - 0.04 * Rising
	ScaleY = 1 - SquashAmount * Contact + 0.06 * Rising
	CenterY = Ground + ShownHalfHeight * ScaleY + HopHeight * Height
	SpinCos = math.cos(Spin)
	SpinSin = math.sin(Spin)

	for Row = 0, Size - 1 do
		for Column = 0, Size - 1 do
			const X = (Column + 0.5 - Size / 2) / PixelsPerUnit
			const Y = (Size / 2 - Row - 0.5) / PixelsPerUnit
			const Hit = Cast(X, Y)

			if Hit then
				Write(Column, Row, Shade(Hit, Blinking), 255)
			elseif Row == ShadowRow and math.abs(Column + 0.5 - Size / 2) < ShadowWidth then
				Write(Column, Row, Palette.Face, ShadowAlpha)
			else
				Write(Column, Row, Palette.Face, 0)
			end
		end
	end

	Image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Image.Size, Pixels)
end

const function Draw(X: number, Y: number, Seconds: number)
	Render(Seconds)
	Canvas.Blit(Source, 0, 0, Size, Size, X, Y, X + Size, Y + Size, White)
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Gui/Toasts"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("./Canvas")
const Font = require("./Font")
const NoobHead = require("./NoobHead")
const Sounds = require("../Sounds")
const Text = require("./Text")

const SlotCount = 5
const ToastWidth = 160
const ToastHeight = 32
const SlideMilliseconds = 600
const DisplayMilliseconds = 5000
const TitleWidth = 125
const UnlockTextMilliseconds = 1500
const UnlockFadeMilliseconds = 300
const LineHeight = 9
const ChallengeColor = 0xFFFF88FF
const TaskColor = 0xFFFFFF00
const White = 0xFFFFFFFF
const Background = "minecraft:toast/advancement"

type Visibility = "Show" | "Hide"

type Toast = {
	Advancement: Minecraft.Advancement,
	Header: Font.Formatted,
	Lines: { Font.Formatted },
	Slot: number,
	AnimationStart: number,
	BecameFullyVisibleAt: number,
	Visibility: Visibility,
	FullyVisibleFor: number,
	VisiblePortion: number,
	Finished: boolean,
}

const Queued: { Minecraft.Advancement } = {}
const Visible: { Toast } = {}
const Occupied: { boolean } = table.create(SlotCount, false)
const PlayedSounds: { [string]: true } = {}

const function Millis(): number
	return os.clock() * 1000
end

const function AddAdvancement(Id: string)
	const Advancement = Minecraft.Advancements.Get(Id)

	if Advancement then
		table.insert(Queued, Advancement)
	end
end

const function FreeSlot(): number?
	for Slot = 1, SlotCount do
		if not Occupied[Slot] then
			return Slot
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function CreateToast(Advancement: Minecraft.Advancement, Slot: number): Toast
	const Lines = Font.Split(Text.Flatten(Advancement.Title, Font.PlainStyle), TitleWidth)

	return {
		Advancement = Advancement,
		Header = Text.Flatten({ translate = `advancements.toast.{Advancement.Type}` }, Font.PlainStyle),
		Lines = Lines,
		Slot = Slot,
		AnimationStart = -1,
		BecameFullyVisibleAt = -1,
		Visibility = "Hide",
		FullyVisibleFor = 0,
		VisiblePortion = 0,
		Finished = false,
	}
end

const function UpdateToast(Toast: Toast, Now: number)
	if Toast.AnimationStart == -1 then
		Toast.AnimationStart = Now
		Toast.Visibility = "Show"
	end

	if Toast.Visibility == "Show" and Now - Toast.AnimationStart <= SlideMilliseconds then
		Toast.BecameFullyVisibleAt = Now
	end

	Toast.FullyVisibleFor = Now - Toast.BecameFullyVisibleAt

	const Progress = math.clamp((Now - Toast.AnimationStart) / SlideMilliseconds, 0, 1) ^ 2

	Toast.VisiblePortion = if Toast.Visibility == "Hide" then 1 - Progress else Progress

	const Wanted: Visibility = if Toast.FullyVisibleFor >= DisplayMilliseconds then "Hide" else "Show"

	if Wanted ~= Toast.Visibility then
		Toast.AnimationStart = Now - (1 - Toast.VisiblePortion) * SlideMilliseconds // 1
		Toast.Visibility = Wanted
	end

	Toast.Finished = Toast.Visibility == "Hide" and Now - Toast.AnimationStart > SlideMilliseconds
end

const function Update()
	const Now = Millis()
	local SoundPlayed = false
	local Index = 1

	while Index <= #Visible do
		const Toast = Visible[Index]
		const Previous = Toast.Visibility

		UpdateToast(Toast, Now)

		if Toast.Visibility ~= Previous and not SoundPlayed then
			SoundPlayed = true
			Sounds.Play(if Toast.Visibility == "Show" then "ui.toast.in" else "ui.toast.out", nil, 1, 1)
		end

		if Toast.Finished then
			Occupied[Toast.Slot] = false
			table.remove(Visible, Index)
		else
			Index += 1
		end
	end

	while #Queued > 0 do
		const Slot = FreeSlot()

		if not Slot then
			break
		end

		const Advancement = table.remove(Queued, 1) :: Minecraft.Advancement

		table.insert(Visible, CreateToast(Advancement, Slot))
		Occupied[Slot] = true

		if Advancement.Type == "challenge" and not PlayedSounds["ui.toast.challenge_complete"] then
			PlayedSounds["ui.toast.challenge_complete"] = true
			Sounds.Play("ui.toast.challenge_complete", nil, 1, 1)
		end
	end

	table.clear(PlayedSounds)
end

const function WithAlpha(Color: number, Alpha: number): number
	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(Alpha, 24), bit32.band(Color, 0xFFFFFF))
end

const function DrawToast(Toast: Toast, ScreenWidth: number)
	const X = ScreenWidth - ToastWidth * Toast.VisiblePortion
	const Y = (Toast.Slot - 1) * ToastHeight
	const Advancement = Toast.Advancement
	const HeaderColor = if Advancement.Type == "challenge" then ChallengeColor else TaskColor
	const Lines = Toast.Lines

	Canvas.BlitSprite(Background, X, Y, ToastWidth, ToastHeight, White)

	if #Lines == 1 then
		Font.DrawFormatted(Toast.Header, X + 30, Y + 7, HeaderColor, false)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Lines[1], X + 30, Y + 18, White, false)
	elseif Toast.FullyVisibleFor < UnlockTextMilliseconds then
		const Alpha = math.clamp((UnlockTextMilliseconds - Toast.FullyVisibleFor) / UnlockFadeMilliseconds, 0, 1) * 255 // 1

		Font.DrawFormatted(Toast.Header, X + 30, Y + 11, WithAlpha(HeaderColor, Alpha), false)
	else
		const Alpha = math.clamp((Toast.FullyVisibleFor - UnlockTextMilliseconds) / UnlockFadeMilliseconds, 0, 1) * 252 // 1
		local LineY = Y + ToastHeight // 2 - #Lines * LineHeight // 2

		for _, Line in Lines do
			Font.DrawFormatted(Line, X + 30, LineY, WithAlpha(White, Alpha), false)
			LineY += LineHeight
		end
	end

	if Advancement.Icon == "noob_head" then
		NoobHead.Draw(X + 8, Y + 8, Millis() / 1000)
	end
end

const function Draw(ScreenWidth: number)
	for _, Toast in Visible do
		DrawToast(Toast, ScreenWidth)
	end
end

return {
	AddAdvancement = AddAdvancement,
	Update = Update,
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/ItemModels"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Affine = require("./Affine")
const Level = require("./Level")
const Rendering = require("./Rendering")
const Data = require("@self/Data")
const Geometry = require("@self/Geometry")
const Specials = require("@self/Specials")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Behaviors = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors
const Argb = Minecraft.Argb
const JavaRandom = Minecraft.JavaRandom

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

export type Node = { [string]: unknown }

export type Holder = {
	Position: vector,
	YBodyRot: number,
	UseItem: ItemStack,
	UseItemRemaining: number,
}

export type Context = {
	DisplayContext: string,
	Holder: Holder?,
	Seed: number,
}

export type Model = {
	Kind: "generated" | "cuboid",
	UsesBlockLight: boolean,
	Transforms: { [string]: { number } },
	Layers: { { string } }?,
	Textures: { { string } }?,
	Quads: { number }?,
	Particle: { string },
}

export type Draw = Geometry.Draw

export type Layer = {
	Node: Node,
	Model: Model,
	Tints: { number },
	TintCount: number,
	First: unknown?,
	Second: unknown?,
	Frame: number,
}

export type RenderState = {
	Context: string,
	Layers: { Layer },
	Count: number,
}

type Wobbler = {
	Rotation: number,
	Delta: number,
	LastTick: number,
	Factor: number,
	Wobble: boolean,
}

const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
const Payload = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: {
	Items: { [string]: { model: Node, swap_animation_scale: number?, hand_animation_on_swap: boolean? } },
	Models: { [string]: Model },
}

const PotionDefault = -13083194
const FireworkDefault = -7697782
const CompassWobbleFactor = 0.8
const ClockWobbleFactor = 0.9
const WobbleStep = 0.1
const SpinHashMultiplier = 1327217883
const SpinHashScale = 2.1474836E9
const MinimumTargetDistanceSquared = 1.0E-5
const Tau = math.pi * 2
const TwoTo31 = 2147483648
const TwoTo32 = 4294967296

const LocalTimeInterval = 1
const MissingModel = "minecraft:builtin/missing"
const LeftHands = { thirdperson_lefthand = true, firstperson_lefthand = true }
const MissingNode: Node = { type = "minecraft:missing" }
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

const Needles: { [Node]: Wobbler } = {}
const SpinNeedles: { [Node]: Wobbler } = {}
const Randoms: { [Node]: Minecraft.JavaRandom } = {}
const LocalTimes: { [Node]: { Result: string, NextUpdate: number } } = {}
const NodeIds: { [Node]: number } = {}
const Arguments: { unknown } = {}
const BoundsCache: { [string]: { vector } } = {}
local NodeCount = 0

const function PositiveModulo(Value: number, Modulus: number): number
	return Value - (Value // Modulus) * Modulus
end

const function WobblerOf(Wobblers: { [Node]: Wobbler }, Node: Node, Factor: number): Wobbler
	local Wobbler = Wobblers[Node]

	if not Wobbler then
		Wobbler = { Rotation = 0, Delta = 0, LastTick = -1, Factor = Factor, Wobble = Node.wobble ~= false }
		Wobblers[Node] = Wobbler
	end

	return Wobbler :: Wobbler
end

const function RandomOf(Node: Node): Minecraft.JavaRandom
	local Random = Randoms[Node]

	if not Random then
		Random = JavaRandom.Create(math.random(0, TwoTo31 - 1))
		Randoms[Node] = Random
	end

	return Random :: Minecraft.JavaRandom
end

const function UpdateWobbler(Wobbler: Wobbler, Tick: number, Target: number): number
	if not Wobbler.Wobble then
		Wobbler.Rotation = Target

		return Target
	end

	if Wobbler.LastTick ~= Tick then
		Wobbler.LastTick = Tick
		Wobbler.Delta += (PositiveModulo(Target - Wobbler.Rotation + 0.5, 1) - 0.5) * WobbleStep
		Wobbler.Delta *= Wobbler.Factor
		Wobbler.Rotation = PositiveModulo(Wobbler.Rotation + Wobbler.Delta, 1)
	end

	return Wobbler.Rotation
end

const function UsedTicks(Stack: ItemStack, Holder: Holder): number
	return Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Holder.UseItemRemaining
end

const function IsUsing(Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): boolean
	const Holder = Context.Holder

	return Holder ~= nil and not Items.IsEmpty(Holder.UseItem) and Holder.UseItem == Stack
end

const function CompassTarget(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack): vector?
	const Target = Node.target

	if Target == "spawn" then
		return Level.GetSpawnPosition()
	elseif Target == "lodestone" then
		const Tracker = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:lodestone_tracker") :: { target: { dimension: string, pos: { number } }? }?
		const Position = Tracker and Tracker.target

		if Position and Position.dimension == Level.Dimension then
			return vector.create(Position.pos[1], Position.pos[2], Position.pos[3])
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function CompassAngle(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): number
	const Holder = Context.Holder

	if not Holder then
		return 0
	end

	const Target = CompassTarget(Node, Stack)
	const GameTime = Level.GetGameTime()
	const Center = if Target then Target + vector.one * 0.5 else vector.zero
	const Offset = Center - Holder.Position

	if not Target or vector.dot(Offset, Offset) < MinimumTargetDistanceSquared then
		const Spin = WobblerOf(SpinNeedles, Node, CompassWobbleFactor)
		const Rotation = UpdateWobbler(Spin, GameTime, JavaRandom.NextFloat(RandomOf(Node)))
		const Hash = (Context.Seed * SpinHashMultiplier + TwoTo31) % TwoTo32 - TwoTo31

		return PositiveModulo(Rotation + Hash / SpinHashScale, 1)
	end

	const AngleToTarget = math.atan2(Offset.z, Offset.x) / Tau
	const HolderRotation = PositiveModulo(Holder.YBodyRot / 360, 1)
	const Needle = WobblerOf(Needles, Node, CompassWobbleFactor)

	return PositiveModulo(AngleToTarget + UpdateWobbler(Needle, GameTime, 0.5 - (HolderRotation - 0.25)), 1)
end

const function TimeValue(Node: Node, Context: Context): number
	if not Context.Holder then
		return 0
	end

	const Source = Node.source
	const Target = if Source == "daytime" then Rendering.SunAngle() / 360 elseif Source == "random" then JavaRandom.NextFloat(RandomOf(Node)) else error(`Unsupported time source {Source}`)

	return UpdateWobbler(WobblerOf(Needles, Node, ClockWobbleFactor), Level.GetGameTime(), Target)
end

const function LocalTimeToken(Token: string): string
	if Token == "MM" then
		return os.date("%m")
	elseif Token == "dd" then
		return os.date("%d")
	elseif Token == "yyyy" then
		return os.date("%Y")
	elseif Token == "HH" then
		return os.date("%H")
	elseif Token == "mm" then
		return os.date("%M")
	elseif Token == "ss" then
		return os.date("%S")
	end

	error(`Unsupported local time pattern letter {Token}`)
end

const function LocalTime(Node: Node): string
	local Cached = LocalTimes[Node]
	const Now = os.clock()

	if not Cached then
		Cached = { Result = "", NextUpdate = -math.huge }
		LocalTimes[Node] = Cached
	end

	const Entry = Cached :: { Result: string, NextUpdate: number }

	if Now > Entry.NextUpdate then
		Entry.Result = (string.gsub(Node.pattern :: string, "%a+", LocalTimeToken))
		Entry.NextUpdate = Now + LocalTimeInterval
	end

	return Entry.Result
end

const function ConditionValue(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): boolean
	const Property = Node.property

	if Property == "minecraft:using_item" then
		return IsUsing(Stack, Context)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:bundle/has_selected_item" then
		return Stack.SelectedBundleItem ~= Items.NoSelectedItem
	elseif Property == "minecraft:has_component" then
		const Type = Node.component :: string

		return if Node.ignore_default then Stack.Patch[Type] ~= nil else Items.Has(Stack, Type)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:broken" then
		return Items.IsDamageableItem(Stack) and Items.DamageValue(Stack) >= Items.MaxDamage(Stack) - 1
	elseif Property == "minecraft:fishing_rod/cast" then
		return false
	end

	error(`Unsupported item model condition {Property}`)
end

const function SelectValue(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): string?
	const Property = Node.property

	if Property == "minecraft:display_context" then
		return Context.DisplayContext
	elseif Property == "minecraft:block_state" then
		const State = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:block_state") :: { [string]: string }?

		return State and State[Node.block_state_property :: string]
	elseif Property == "minecraft:trim_material" then
		const Trim = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:trim") :: { material: unknown }?
		const Material = Trim and Trim.material

		return if type(Material) == "string" then Material else nil
	elseif Property == "minecraft:local_time" then
		return LocalTime(Node)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:context_dimension" then
		return Level.Dimension
	elseif Property == "minecraft:charge_type" then
		const Projectiles = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:charged_projectiles") :: { unknown }?

		if not Projectiles or #Projectiles == 0 then
			return "none"
		end

		for _, Template in Projectiles do
			const Id = if type(Template) == "string" then Template else (Template :: { id: string }).id

			if Id == "minecraft:firework_rocket" then
				return "rocket"
			end
		end

		return "arrow"
	end

	error(`Unsupported item model select property {Property}`)
end

const function RangeValue(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): number
	const Property = Node.property

	if Property == "minecraft:use_duration" then
		if not IsUsing(Stack, Context) then
			return 0
		end

		const Holder = Context.Holder :: Holder

		return if Node.remaining then Holder.UseItemRemaining else UsedTicks(Stack, Holder)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:use_cycle" then
		if not IsUsing(Stack, Context) then
			return 0
		end

		return (Context.Holder :: Holder).UseItemRemaining % ((Node.period or 1) :: number)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:crossbow/pull" then
		const Holder = Context.Holder

		if not Holder or Behaviors.IsChargedCrossbow(Stack) then
			return 0
		end

		return UsedTicks(Stack, Holder) / Behaviors.ChargeDuration(Stack)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:time" then
		return TimeValue(Node, Context)
	elseif Property == "minecraft:compass" then
		return CompassAngle(Node, Stack, Context)
	end

	error(`Unsupported item model range property {Property}`)
end

const function SelectCase(Node: Node, Value: string?): Node?
	if Value ~= nil then
		for _, Case in Node.cases :: { { when: unknown, model: Node } } do
			const When = Case.when

			if When == Value or (type(When) == "table" and table.find(When :: { string }, Value)) then
				return Case.model
			end
		end
	end

	return Node.fallback :: Node?
end

const function CompareThresholds(Left: { threshold: number }, Right: { threshold: number }): boolean
	return Left.threshold < Right.threshold
end

const function SelectRange(Node: Node, Value: number): Node?
	const Entries = Node.entries :: { { threshold: number, model: Node } }

	if not Node.Sorted then
		table.sort(Entries, CompareThresholds)
		Node.Sorted = true
	end

	const Scaled = Value * ((Node.scale or 1) :: number)
	local Chosen: Node? = nil

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		if Entry.threshold > Scaled then
			break
		end

		Chosen = Entry.model
	end

	return Chosen or Node.fallback :: Node?
end

const function RootNode(Stack: ItemStack): Node?
	const Id = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:item_model") :: string?

	if not Id then
		return nil
	end

	const Definition = Payload.Items[Id]

	return if Definition then Definition.model else MissingNode
end

const function Select(Node: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context): Node?
	const Type = Node.type

	if Type == "minecraft:condition" then
		return (if ConditionValue(Node, Stack, Context) then Node.on_true else Node.on_false) :: Node?
	elseif Type == "minecraft:select" then
		return SelectCase(Node, SelectValue(Node, Stack, Context))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:range_dispatch" then
		return SelectRange(Node, RangeValue(Node, Stack, Context))
	end

	return Node
end

const function ModelOf(Id: string): Model
	return Payload.Models[if string.find(Id, ":", 1, true) then Id else `minecraft:{Id}`]
end

const function TintColor(Tint: Node, Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Type = Tint.type

	if Type == "minecraft:constant" then
		return Tint.value :: number
	elseif Type == "minecraft:dye" then
		const Dyed = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:dyed_color") :: number?

		return Argb.Opaque(Dyed or Tint.default :: number)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:grass" then
		return Tint.color :: number
	elseif Type == "minecraft:potion" then
		const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

		return if Contents ~= nil then Items.PotionContents.Color(Contents, (Tint.default or PotionDefault) :: number) else (Tint.default or PotionDefault) :: number
	elseif Type == "minecraft:firework" then
		const Explosion = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:firework_explosion") :: { colors: { number }? }?
		const Colors = Explosion and Explosion.colors

		if not Colors or #Colors == 0 then
			return (Tint.default or FireworkDefault) :: number
		elseif #Colors == 1 then
			return Argb.Opaque(Colors[1])
		end

		local Red = 0
		local Green = 0
		local Blue = 0

		for _, Color in Colors do
			Red += Argb.Red(Color)
			Green += Argb.Green(Color)
			Blue += Argb.Blue(Color)
		end

		return Argb.Color(255, Red // #Colors, Green // #Colors, Blue // #Colors)
	end

	error(`Unsupported item tint {Type}`)
end

const function NewLayer(State: RenderState, Node: Node, Model: Model): Layer
	State.Count += 1

	local Layer = State.Layers[State.Count]

	if not Layer then
		Layer = { Node = Node, Model = Model, Tints = {}, TintCount = 0, First = nil, Second = nil, Frame = 0 }
		State.Layers[State.Count] = Layer
	end

	const Created = Layer :: Layer

	Created.Node = Node
	Created.Model = Model
	Created.TintCount = 0
	Created.First = nil
	Created.Second = nil
	Created.Frame = 0

	return Created
end

const function AppendModel(State: RenderState, Node: Node, Model: Model, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Layer = NewLayer(State, Node, Model)
	const Tints = Node.tints :: { Node }?

	if Tints then
		for Index, Tint in Tints do
			Layer.Tints[Index] = TintColor(Tint, Stack)
		end

		Layer.TintCount = #Tints
	end

	Layer.Frame = Geometry.AnimationSignature((Model.Layers or Model.Textures) :: { { string } })
end

const function AppendNode(State: RenderState, Start: Node, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context)
	local Node = Start

	while true do
		const Selected = Select(Node, Stack, Context) :: Node

		if Selected == Node then
			break
		end

		Node = Selected
	end

	const Type = Node.type

	if Type == "minecraft:model" then
		AppendModel(State, Node, ModelOf(Node.model :: string), Stack)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:missing" then
		AppendModel(State, Node, ModelOf(MissingModel), Stack)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:special" then
		const Layer = NewLayer(State, Node, ModelOf(Node.base :: string))

		Specials.Arguments(Node.model :: Node, Stack, Arguments)
		Layer.First = Arguments[1]
		Layer.Second = Arguments[2]
	elseif Type == "minecraft:composite" then
		for _, Child in Node.models :: { Node } do
			AppendNode(State, Child, Stack, Context)
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:bundle/selected_item" then
		const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:bundle_contents") :: { unknown }?
		const Template = Contents and Contents[Stack.SelectedBundleItem + 1]

		if Template ~= nil then
			const Selected = Items.FromTemplate(Template)
			const Root = RootNode(Selected)

			if Root then
				AppendNode(State, Root, Selected, Context)
			end
		end
	end
end

const function CreateRenderState(): RenderState
	return { Context = "none", Layers = {}, Count = 0 }
end

const function Resolve(State: RenderState, Stack: ItemStack, Context: Context)
	State.Count = 0
	State.Context = Context.DisplayContext

	const Root = if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then nil else RootNode(Stack)

	if Root then
		AppendNode(State, Root, Stack, Context)
	end
end

const function ParticleSprite(State: RenderState, Generator: Random): { string }?
	if State.Count == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return State.Layers[Generator:NextInteger(1, State.Count)].Model.Particle
end

const function SameState(A: RenderState, B: RenderState): boolean
	if A.Count ~= B.Count or A.Context ~= B.Context then
		return false
	end

	for Index = 1, A.Count do
		const Left = A.Layers[Index]
		const Right = B.Layers[Index]

		if Left.Node ~= Right.Node or Left.TintCount ~= Right.TintCount or Left.First ~= Right.First or Left.Second ~= Right.Second or Left.Frame ~= Right.Frame then
			return false
		end

		for Tint = 1, Left.TintCount do
			if Left.Tints[Tint] ~= Right.Tints[Tint] then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function CopyState(Out: RenderState, Source: RenderState)
	Out.Context = Source.Context
	Out.Count = 0

	for Index = 1, Source.Count do
		const From = Source.Layers[Index]
		const To = NewLayer(Out, From.Node, From.Model)

		To.TintCount = From.TintCount
		To.First = From.First
		To.Second = From.Second
		To.Frame = From.Frame
		table.move(From.Tints, 1, From.TintCount, 1, To.Tints)
	end
end

const function NodeId(Node: Node): number
	local Id = NodeIds[Node]

	if not Id then
		NodeCount += 1
		Id = NodeCount
		NodeIds[Node] = NodeCount
	end

	return Id :: number
end

const function Key(State: RenderState): string
	const Parts = { State.Context }

	for Index = 1, State.Count do
		const Layer = State.Layers[Index]
		const Encoded = if Layer.First ~= nil or Layer.Second ~= nil then HttpService:JSONEncode({ Layer.First, Layer.Second }) else ""

		table.insert(Parts, `{NodeId(Layer.Node)}:{table.concat(Layer.Tints, ",", 1, Layer.TintCount)}:{Layer.Frame}:{Encoded}`)
	end

	return table.concat(Parts, "|")
end

const function UsesBlockLight(State: RenderState): boolean
	return State.Count > 0 and State.Layers[1].Model.UsesBlockLight
end

const function LayerPose(State: RenderState, Layer: Layer): Affine.Matrix
	const Pose = Affine.Create()
	const Transform = Layer.Model.Transforms[State.Context]
	const Local = Layer.Node.transform :: { number }?

	if Transform then
		const Mirror = if LeftHands[State.Context] then -1 else 1

		Affine.Translate(Pose, Transform[4] * Mirror, Transform[5], Transform[6])
		Affine.RotateX(Pose, Transform[1] * DegreesToRadians)
		Affine.RotateY(Pose, Transform[2] * Mirror * DegreesToRadians)
		Affine.RotateZ(Pose, Transform[3] * Mirror * DegreesToRadians)
		Affine.Scale(Pose, Transform[7], Transform[8], Transform[9])
	end

	Affine.Translate(Pose, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5)

	if Local then
		Affine.Multiply(Pose, Pose, Local)
	end

	return Pose
end

const function Draws(State: RenderState): { Draw }
	const Out: { Draw } = {}
	const Planes: Geometry.Planes = {}

	for Index = 1, State.Count do
		const Layer = State.Layers[Index]
		const Model = Layer.Model
		const Pose = LayerPose(State, Layer)

		if Layer.Node.type == "minecraft:special" then
			Specials.Draws(Layer.Node.model :: Node, Layer.First, Layer.Second, Pose, Out)
		elseif Model.Kind == "generated" then
			Geometry.Generated(Model.Layers :: { { string } }, Layer.Tints, Layer.TintCount, Pose, Planes, Out)
		else
			Geometry.Cuboid(Model.Textures :: { { string } }, Model.Quads :: { number }, Layer.Tints, Layer.TintCount, Pose, Planes, Out)
		end
	end

	return Out
end

const function SwapAnimationScale(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Id = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:item_model") :: string?
	const Definition = Id and Payload.Items[Id]

	return if Definition then Definition.swap_animation_scale or 1 else 1
end

const function Bounds(State: RenderState): (vector, vector)
	const StateKey = Key(State)
	const Existing = BoundsCache[StateKey]

	if Existing then
		return Existing[1], Existing[2]
	end

	local Min = vector.one * math.huge
	local Max = -Min

	for _, Draw in Draws(State) do
		for _, Polygon in Draw.Polygons do
			for _, Vertex in Polygon.Vertices do
				Min = vector.min(Min, Vertex.Position)
				Max = vector.max(Max, Vertex.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	if Min.x > Max.x then
		Min = vector.zero
		Max = vector.zero
	end

	BoundsCache[StateKey] = { Min, Max }

	return Min, Max
end

const function WornSkull(Stack: ItemStack): (string?, Rendering.Texture?)
	const Root = RootNode(Stack)

	if not Root or Root.type ~= "minecraft:special" then
		return nil, nil
	end

	const Spec = Root.model :: Node
	const Kind = Specials.SkullKind(Spec)

	if not Kind then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return Kind, Specials.SkullTexture(Spec, Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:profile"))
end

const function ShouldPlaySwapAnimation(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	const Id = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:item_model") :: string?
	const Definition = Id and Payload.Items[Id]

	return not Definition or Definition.hand_animation_on_swap ~= false
end

return {
	CreateRenderState = CreateRenderState,
	Resolve = Resolve,
	SameState = SameState,
	CopyState = CopyState,
	Key = Key,
	UsesBlockLight = UsesBlockLight,
	Draws = Draws,
	SwapAnimationScale = SwapAnimationScale,
	ShouldPlaySwapAnimation = ShouldPlaySwapAnimation,
	WornSkull = WornSkull,
	Bounds = Bounds,
	ParticleSprite = ParticleSprite,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/ItemModels/Geometry"] = function(require)

const Affine = require("../Affine")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const Nudge = 1 / 256
const SideShrink = 0.1
const PixelsPerBlock = 16
const PlanePrecision = 4096
const OverlapTolerance = 1.0E-6

const Directions = {
	vector.create(0, -1, 0),
	vector.create(0, 1, 0),
	vector.create(0, 0, -1),
	vector.create(0, 0, 1),
	vector.create(-1, 0, 0),
	vector.create(1, 0, 0),
}

const Down = 1
const Up = 2
const North = 3
const South = 4
const West = 5
const East = 6

const FaceCorners = {
	{ 4, 0, 1, 5 },
	{ 2, 6, 7, 3 },
	{ 3, 1, 0, 2 },
	{ 6, 4, 5, 7 },
	{ 2, 0, 4, 6 },
	{ 7, 5, 1, 3 },
}

export type Vertex = {
	Position: vector,
	U: number,
	V: number,
}

export type Polygon = {
	Vertices: { Vertex },
	Normal: vector,
	Tint: number?,
}

export type Draw = {
	Polygons: { Polygon },
	Texture: Textures.Texture,
	Material: "Cutout" | "CutoutCull" | "Solid",
}

type PlaneQuad = {
	Minimum: vector,
	Maximum: vector,
	Level: number,
}

export type Planes = { [string]: { PlaneQuad } }

type Quad = {
	Positions: { vector },
	Us: { number },
	Vs: { number },
	Direction: number,
}

const function Corner(Mask: number, From: vector, To: vector): vector
	return vector.create(
		if bit32.btest(Mask, 1) then To.x else From.x,
		if bit32.btest(Mask, 2) then To.y else From.y,
		if bit32.btest(Mask, 4) then To.z else From.z
	)
end

const function ClosestDirection(Positions: { vector }): number?
	const Normal = vector.cross(Positions[2] - Positions[1], Positions[3] - Positions[1])
	const Length = vector.magnitude(Normal)

	if Length == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local Best: number? = nil
	local Closest = 0

	for Index, Direction in Directions do
		const Product = vector.dot(Normal, Direction) / Length

		if Product >= 0 and Product > Closest then
			Closest = Product
			Best = Index
		end
	end

	return Best
end

const function RecalculateWinding(Quad: Quad)
	const Positions = Quad.Positions
	local Minimum = Positions[1]
	local Maximum = Positions[1]

	for Index = 2, 4 do
		Minimum = vector.min(Minimum, Positions[Index])
		Maximum = vector.max(Maximum, Positions[Index])
	end

	for Vertex, Mask in FaceCorners[Quad.Direction] do
		const Target = Corner(Mask, Minimum, Maximum)

		for Index = Vertex, 4 do
			if Positions[Index] == Target then
				Positions[Vertex], Positions[Index] = Positions[Index], Positions[Vertex]
				Quad.Us[Vertex], Quad.Us[Index] = Quad.Us[Index], Quad.Us[Vertex]
				Quad.Vs[Vertex], Quad.Vs[Index] = Quad.Vs[Index], Quad.Vs[Vertex]
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

const function BakeQuad(From: vector, To: vector, MinU: number, MinV: number, MaxU: number, MaxV: number, Facing: number): Quad
	const Positions: { vector } = {}
	const Us: { number } = {}
	const Vs: { number } = {}

	for Index, Mask in FaceCorners[Facing] do
		Positions[Index] = Corner(Mask, From, To) / PixelsPerBlock
		Us[Index] = (if Index <= 2 then MinU else MaxU) / PixelsPerBlock
		Vs[Index] = (if Index == 1 or Index == 4 then MinV else MaxV) / PixelsPerBlock
	end

	const Quad = { Positions = Positions, Us = Us, Vs = Vs, Direction = Facing }
	const Direction = ClosestDirection(Positions)

	Quad.Direction = Direction or Up

	if Direction then
		RecalculateWinding(Quad)
	end

	return Quad
end

const function IsTransparent(Atlas: Textures.Atlas, Frame: Vector2, Size: Vector2, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	if X < 0 or Y < 0 or X >= Size.X or Y >= Size.Y then
		return true
	end

	return buffer.readu8(Atlas.Pixels, ((Frame.Y + Y) * Atlas.Size.X + Frame.X + X) * 4 + 3) == 0
end

const function SideQuads(Atlas: Textures.Atlas, Sprite: Textures.Sprite, Out: { Quad })
	const Size = Sprite.Size
	const Width = Size.X
	const Height = Size.Y
	const XScale = PixelsPerBlock / Width
	const YScale = PixelsPerBlock / Height
	const Seen: { [number]: boolean } = {}

	for _, Frame in Sprite.Frames do
		for Y = 0, Height - 1 do
			for X = 0, Width - 1 do
				if IsTransparent(Atlas, Frame, Size, X, Y) then
					continue
				end

				for Side = 1, 4 do
					const Neighbor = if Side == 1 then IsTransparent(Atlas, Frame, Size, X, Y - 1)
						elseif Side == 2 then IsTransparent(Atlas, Frame, Size, X, Y + 1)
						elseif Side == 3 then IsTransparent(Atlas, Frame, Size, X - 1, Y)
						else IsTransparent(Atlas, Frame, Size, X + 1, Y)
					const Key = (Y * Width + X) * 4 + Side

					if not Neighbor or Seen[Key] then
						continue
					end

					Seen[Key] = true

					const Horizontal = Side <= 2
					const U0 = X + SideShrink
					const U1 = X + 1 - SideShrink
					const V0 = if Horizontal then Y + SideShrink else Y + 1 - SideShrink
					const V1 = if Horizontal then Y + 1 - SideShrink else Y + SideShrink
					local StartX, StartY, EndX, EndY = X, Y, X, Y

					if Side == 1 then
						EndX += 1
					elseif Side == 2 then
						EndX += 1
						StartY += 1
						EndY += 1
					elseif Side == 3 then
						EndY += 1
					else
						StartX += 1
						EndX += 1
						EndY += 1
					end

					StartX *= XScale
					EndX *= XScale
					StartY = PixelsPerBlock - StartY * YScale
					EndY = PixelsPerBlock - EndY * YScale

					local From = vector.zero
					local To = vector.zero
					local Facing = Up

					if Side == 1 then
						From, To, Facing = vector.create(StartX, StartY, 7.5), vector.create(EndX, StartY, 8.5), Up
					elseif Side == 2 then
						From, To, Facing = vector.create(StartX, EndY, 7.5), vector.create(EndX, EndY, 8.5), Down
					elseif Side == 3 then
						From, To, Facing = vector.create(StartX, StartY, 7.5), vector.create(StartX, EndY, 8.5), East
					else
						From, To, Facing = vector.create(EndX, StartY, 7.5), vector.create(EndX, EndY, 8.5), West
					end

					table.insert(Out, BakeQuad(From, To, U0 * XScale, V0 * YScale, U1 * XScale, V1 * YScale, Facing))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function DrawFor(Draws: { Draw }, Texture: Textures.Texture): Draw
	for _, Existing in Draws do
		if Existing.Texture == Texture and Existing.Material == "CutoutCull" then
			return Existing
		end
	end

	const Created: Draw = { Polygons = {}, Texture = Texture, Material = "CutoutCull" }

	table.insert(Draws, Created)

	return Created
end

const function AddQuad(Draw: Draw, Quad: Quad, Atlas: Textures.Atlas, Sprite: Textures.Sprite, Tint: number?, Pose: Affine.Matrix, Lift: number, Planes: Planes)
	const Direction = Directions[Quad.Direction]
	const PlaneKey = `{Quad.Direction}:{math.round(vector.dot(Quad.Positions[1], Direction) * PlanePrecision)}`
	const Minimum = vector.min(vector.min(Quad.Positions[1], Quad.Positions[2]), vector.min(Quad.Positions[3], Quad.Positions[4]))
	const Maximum = vector.max(vector.max(Quad.Positions[1], Quad.Positions[2]), vector.max(Quad.Positions[3], Quad.Positions[4]))
	const InPlane = vector.one - vector.abs(Direction)
	local Plane = Planes[PlaneKey]
	local Level = 0

	if not Plane then
		Plane = {}
		Planes[PlaneKey] = Plane
	end

	for _, Earlier in Plane :: { PlaneQuad } do
		const Overlap = vector.min(Maximum, Earlier.Maximum) - vector.max(Minimum, Earlier.Minimum)
		const Clear = vector.max(Overlap * InPlane, vector.zero)

		if vector.dot(InPlane, vector.create(if Clear.x > OverlapTolerance then 1 else 0, if Clear.y > OverlapTolerance then 1 else 0, if Clear.z > OverlapTolerance then 1 else 0)) == 2 then
			Level = math.max(Level, Earlier.Level + 1)
		end
	end

	table.insert(Plane :: { PlaneQuad }, { Minimum = Minimum, Maximum = Maximum, Level = Level })

	const Offset = Direction * (Level * Lift)
	const Frame = Textures.Frame(Sprite)
	const Vertices: { Vertex } = {}

	for Index = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(Vertices, {
			Position = Affine.Point(Pose, Quad.Positions[Index] + Offset),
			U = Frame.X + Quad.Us[Index] * Sprite.Size.X,
			V = Frame.Y + Quad.Vs[Index] * Sprite.Size.Y,
		})
	end

	table.insert(Draw.Polygons, { Vertices = Vertices, Normal = Affine.Normal(Pose, Direction), Tint = Tint })
end

const function Lift(Pose: Affine.Matrix): number
	return if Affine.Determinant(Pose) < 0 then -Nudge else Nudge
end

const function TintOf(Tints: { number }, TintCount: number, Index: number): number?
	return if Index >= 0 and Index < TintCount then Tints[Index + 1] else nil
end

const function Generated(Layers: { { string } }, Tints: { number }, TintCount: number, Pose: Affine.Matrix, Planes: Planes, Draws: { Draw })
	const Lifted = Lift(Pose)

	for Index, Layer in Layers do
		const Atlas = Textures.Atlas(Layer[1] :: Textures.AtlasName)
		const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Atlas, Layer[2])
		const Draw = DrawFor(Draws, Atlas)
		const Tint = TintOf(Tints, TintCount, Index - 1)
		const Quads: { Quad } = {
			BakeQuad(vector.create(0, 0, 7.5), vector.create(16, 16, 8.5), 0, 0, 16, 16, South),
			BakeQuad(vector.create(0, 0, 7.5), vector.create(16, 16, 8.5), 16, 0, 0, 16, North),
		}

		SideQuads(Atlas, Sprite, Quads)

		for _, Quad in Quads do
			AddQuad(Draw, Quad, Atlas, Sprite, Tint, Pose, Lifted, Planes)
		end
	end
end

const function Cuboid(TextureSprites: { { string } }, Values: { number }, Tints: { number }, TintCount: number, Pose: Affine.Matrix, Planes: Planes, Draws: { Draw })
	const Lifted = Lift(Pose)

	for Offset = 0, #Values - 1, 23 do
		const Source = TextureSprites[Values[Offset + 23] + 1]
		const Atlas = Textures.Atlas(Source[1] :: Textures.AtlasName)
		const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Atlas, Source[2])
		const Quad = {
			Positions = {
				vector.create(Values[Offset + 1], Values[Offset + 2], Values[Offset + 3]),
				vector.create(Values[Offset + 4], Values[Offset + 5], Values[Offset + 6]),
				vector.create(Values[Offset + 7], Values[Offset + 8], Values[Offset + 9]),
				vector.create(Values[Offset + 10], Values[Offset + 11], Values[Offset + 12]),
			},
			Us = { Values[Offset + 13], Values[Offset + 15], Values[Offset + 17], Values[Offset + 19] },
			Vs = { Values[Offset + 14], Values[Offset + 16], Values[Offset + 18], Values[Offset + 20] },
			Direction = Values[Offset + 21] + 1,
		}

		AddQuad(DrawFor(Draws, Atlas), Quad, Atlas, Sprite, TintOf(Tints, TintCount, Values[Offset + 22]), Pose, Lifted, Planes)
	end
end

const function AnimationSignature(Sprites: { { string } }): number
	local Signature = 0

	for _, Source in Sprites do
		const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Textures.Atlas(Source[1] :: Textures.AtlasName), Source[2])

		if Sprite.Sequence then
			Signature = Signature * 64 + Textures.FrameIndex(Sprite)
		end
	end

	return Signature
end

return {
	Generated = Generated,
	Cuboid = Cuboid,
	AnimationSignature = AnimationSignature,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/ItemModels/Specials"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Affine = require("../Affine")
const Geometry = require("./Geometry")
const Models = require("../Models")
const Skins = require("../Skins")
const SpecialsData = require("./SpecialsData")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Argb = Minecraft.Argb

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack
type Draw = Geometry.Draw

const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(SpecialsData)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
const Data = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: {
	DyeColors: { [string]: number },
	SkullTextures: { [string]: string },
	BannerPatterns: { [string]: string },
	PotPatterns: { [string]: string },
}

const MaxPatterns = 16
const FlagPhase = 0

const StatueLayers = {
	standing = "minecraft:copper_golem#main",
	sitting = "minecraft:copper_golem_sitting#main",
	running = "minecraft:copper_golem_running#main",
	star = "minecraft:copper_golem_star#main",
}

const Layers: { [string]: Models.Layer } = {}
const Composites: { [string]: Textures.Texture } = {}

const function Layer(Name: string): Models.Layer
	local Found = Layers[Name]

	if not Found then
		Found = Models.Layer(Name)
		Layers[Name] = Found
	end

	const Instance = Found :: Models.Layer

	Models.ResetLayer(Instance)

	return Instance
end

const function Path(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, ":(.*)$") or Id) :: string
end

const function Namespace(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, "^(.-):") or "minecraft") :: string
end

const function Append(Draws: { Draw }, Part: Models.LayerPart, Layer: Models.Layer, Texture: Textures.Texture, Material: "Cutout" | "CutoutCull" | "Solid", Pose: Affine.Matrix)
	const Draw: Draw = { Polygons = {}, Texture = Texture, Material = Material }

	Models.FlattenLayer(Part, Pose, Texture.Size.X / Layer.TextureWidth, Texture.Size.Y / Layer.TextureHeight, Draw.Polygons)
	table.insert(Draws, Draw)
end

const function PatternAsset(Pattern: unknown): string
	if type(Pattern) == "table" then
		return (Pattern :: { asset_id: string }).asset_id
	end

	return Data.BannerPatterns[Pattern :: string]
end

const function Composite(Base: string, PatternFolder: string, BaseColor: string, Patterns: unknown?): Textures.Texture
	const Layered: { { Texture: string, Color: number } } = { { Texture = `minecraft:entity/{PatternFolder}/base`, Color = Data.DyeColors[BaseColor] } }

	for Index, Entry in (Patterns or {}) :: { { pattern: unknown, color: string } } do
		if Index > MaxPatterns then
			break
		end

		const Asset = PatternAsset(Entry.pattern)

		table.insert(Layered, { Texture = `{Namespace(Asset)}:entity/{PatternFolder}/{Path(Asset)}`, Color = Data.DyeColors[Entry.color] })
	end

	const Key = HttpService:JSONEncode({ Base, Layered })
	const Existing = Composites[Key]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Source = Textures.Texture(Base)
	const Pixels = buffer.create(buffer.len(Source.Pixels))
	const Width = Source.Size.X
	const Height = Source.Size.Y

	buffer.copy(Pixels, 0, Source.Pixels)

	for _, Entry in Layered do
		const Pattern = Textures.Texture(Entry.Texture)
		const Red = Argb.Red(Entry.Color) / 255
		const Green = Argb.Green(Entry.Color) / 255
		const Blue = Argb.Blue(Entry.Color) / 255
		const PatternWidth = Pattern.Size.X

		for Y = 0, Height - 1 do
			for X = 0, Width - 1 do
				const From = ((Y * Pattern.Size.Y // Height) * PatternWidth + X * PatternWidth // Width) * 4
				const Alpha = buffer.readu8(Pattern.Pixels, From + 3) / 255

				if Alpha > 0 then
					const To = (Y * Width + X) * 4

					buffer.writeu8(Pixels, To, math.round(buffer.readu8(Pattern.Pixels, From) * Red * Alpha + buffer.readu8(Pixels, To) * (1 - Alpha)))
					buffer.writeu8(Pixels, To + 1, math.round(buffer.readu8(Pattern.Pixels, From + 1) * Green * Alpha + buffer.readu8(Pixels, To + 1) * (1 - Alpha)))
					buffer.writeu8(Pixels, To + 2, math.round(buffer.readu8(Pattern.Pixels, From + 2) * Blue * Alpha + buffer.readu8(Pixels, To + 2) * (1 - Alpha)))
				end
			end
		end
	end

	const Created = { Size = Source.Size, Pixels = Pixels }

	Composites[Key] = Created

	return Created
end

const function PotSide(Decoration: unknown?): Textures.Texture
	if Decoration ~= nil then
		const Pattern = Items.Get(Items.FromTemplate(Decoration), "minecraft:provides_pottery_pattern") :: string?
		const Asset = Pattern and Data.PotPatterns[Pattern]

		if Asset then
			return Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Asset)}:entity/decorated_pot/{Path(Asset)}`)
		end
	end

	return Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/decorated_pot/decorated_pot_side")
end

const function SkullKind(Spec: { [string]: unknown }): string?
	if Spec.type == "minecraft:head" then
		return Spec.kind :: string
	elseif Spec.type == "minecraft:player_head" then
		return "player"
	end

	return nil
end

const function SkullTexture(Spec: { [string]: unknown }, Profile: unknown?): Textures.Texture
	if Spec.type == "minecraft:player_head" then
		return Textures.Texture(if Profile ~= nil then Skins.ForProfile(Profile, Textures.HasTexture) else Skins.Default.Texture)
	end

	const Override = Spec.texture :: string?

	return Textures.Texture(if Override then `{Namespace(Override)}:entity/{Path(Override)}` else Data.SkullTextures[Spec.kind :: string])
end

const function Arguments(Spec: { [string]: unknown }, Stack: ItemStack, Out: { unknown })
	const Type = Spec.type

	Out[1] = nil
	Out[2] = nil

	if Type == "minecraft:shield" then
		Out[1] = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:banner_patterns")
		Out[2] = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:base_color")
	elseif Type == "minecraft:banner" then
		Out[1] = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:banner_patterns")
	elseif Type == "minecraft:decorated_pot" then
		Out[1] = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:pot_decorations")
	elseif Type == "minecraft:player_head" then
		Out[1] = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:profile")
	end
end

const function Draws(Spec: { [string]: unknown }, First: unknown?, Second: unknown?, Pose: Affine.Matrix, Out: { Draw })
	const Type = Spec.type

	if Type == "minecraft:shield" then
		const Model = Layer("minecraft:shield#main")
		const Patterns = First :: { unknown }?
		const HasPatterns = (Patterns ~= nil and #Patterns > 0) or Second ~= nil
		const Texture = if HasPatterns
			then Composite("minecraft:entity/shield/shield_base", "shield", (Second or "white") :: string, Patterns)
			else Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/shield/shield_base_nopattern")

		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Texture, "Solid", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:trident" then
		const Model = Layer("minecraft:trident#main")

		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/trident/trident"), "Solid", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:chest" then
		if Spec.chest_type ~= nil and Spec.chest_type ~= "single" then
			error(`Unsupported chest type {Spec.chest_type}`)
		end

		const Model = Layer("minecraft:chest#main")
		const Lid = Model.Root.Children.lid
		const Texture = Spec.texture :: string

		Lid.XRot = -(((Spec.openness or 0) :: number) * math.pi / 2)
		Model.Root.Children.lock.XRot = Lid.XRot
		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Texture)}:entity/chest/{Path(Texture)}`), "CutoutCull", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:shulker_box" then
		const Model = Layer("minecraft:shulker_box#main")
		const Lid = Model.Root.Children.lid
		const Openness = (Spec.openness or 0) :: number
		const Texture = (Spec.texture or "minecraft:shulker") :: string

		Lid.X, Lid.Y, Lid.Z = 0, 24 - Openness * 0.5 * 16, 0
		Lid.YRot = 270 * Openness * math.pi / 180
		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Texture)}:entity/shulker/{Path(Texture)}`), "Cutout", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:head" then
		const Kind = Spec.kind :: string
		const Model = Layer(Models.Skull.LayerName(Kind))

		Models.Skull.Pose(Model, Kind, (Spec.animation or 0) :: number)
		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, SkullTexture(Spec, First), "Cutout", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:player_head" then
		const Model = Layer(Models.Skull.LayerName("player"))

		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, SkullTexture(Spec, First), "Cutout", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:banner" then
		const Wall = Spec.attachment == "wall"
		const Model = Layer(if Wall then "minecraft:wall_banner#main" else "minecraft:standing_banner#main")
		const Flag = Layer(if Wall then "minecraft:wall_banner#flag" else "minecraft:standing_banner#flag")

		Flag.Root.Children.flag.XRot = (-0.0125 + 0.01 * math.cos(math.pi * 2 * FlagPhase)) * math.pi
		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/banner/banner_base"), "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Flag.Root, Flag, Composite("minecraft:entity/banner/banner_base", "banner", Spec.color :: string, First), "Solid", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:decorated_pot" then
		const Base = Layer("minecraft:decorated_pot_base#main")
		const Sides = Layer("minecraft:decorated_pot_sides#main")
		const BaseTexture = Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/decorated_pot/decorated_pot_base")
		const Decorations = (First or {}) :: { back: unknown?, left: unknown?, right: unknown?, front: unknown? }

		Append(Out, Base.Root.Children.neck, Base, BaseTexture, "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Base.Root.Children.top, Base, BaseTexture, "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Base.Root.Children.bottom, Base, BaseTexture, "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Sides.Root.Children.front, Sides, PotSide(Decorations.front), "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Sides.Root.Children.back, Sides, PotSide(Decorations.back), "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Sides.Root.Children.left, Sides, PotSide(Decorations.left), "Solid", Pose)
		Append(Out, Sides.Root.Children.right, Sides, PotSide(Decorations.right), "Solid", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:conduit" then
		const Model = Layer("minecraft:conduit#shell")

		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture("minecraft:entity/conduit/base"), "Solid", Pose)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:copper_golem_statue" then
		const Model = Layer(StatueLayers[Spec.pose :: string])
		const Texture = Spec.texture :: string
		const Stripped = string.gsub(Path(Texture), "^textures/", "")
		const Location = string.gsub(Stripped, "%.png$", "")

		Model.Root.Y = 0
		Model.Root.ZRot = math.pi
		Append(Out, Model.Root, Model, Textures.Texture(`{Namespace(Texture)}:{Location}`), "Cutout", Pose)
	else
		error(`Unsupported special item model {Type}`)
	end
end

return {
	SkullKind = SkullKind,
	SkullTexture = SkullTexture,
	Arguments = Arguments,
	Draws = Draws,
}

end
