_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens"] = function(require)

const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

const Containers = require("./Containers")
const ChatScreen = require("@self/ChatScreen")
const ContainerScreen = require("@self/ContainerScreen")
const CreativeScreen = require("@self/CreativeScreen")
const DeathScreen = require("@self/DeathScreen")
const InventoryScreen = require("@self/InventoryScreen")
const Canvas = require("./Gui/Canvas")
const Gui = require("./Gui")
const Players = require("./Players")
const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")

export type Kind = "Inventory" | "Creative" | "Death" | "Chat"

const DoubleClickMilliseconds = 250
const RepeatedKeySeconds = 0.1
const BackgroundTop = -1072689136
const BackgroundBottom = -804253680

local Current: Kind? = nil
local ScreenToken = 0
local GuiWidth = 0
local GuiHeight = 0
local GuiScale = 1
local MouseX = 0
local MouseY = 0
local ActiveButton: number? = nil
local LastClickTime = -math.huge
local LastClickButton = 0
local LastClickToken = -1
local AdvancedTooltips = false
local TextInput: TextBox? = nil

const KeyTimes: { [Enum.KeyCode]: number } = {}

const function Millis(): number
	return os.clock() * 1000
end

const function IsOpen(): boolean
	return Current ~= nil
end

const function ShowsActiveEffects(): boolean
	if Current == "Inventory" then
		return InventoryScreen.ShowsActiveEffects(GuiWidth)
	elseif Current == "Creative" then
		return CreativeScreen.ShowsActiveEffects(GuiWidth)
	end

	return false
end

const function UpdateMouse()
	const Location = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	const Size = Gui.ScreenGui().AbsoluteSize

	MouseX = if Size.X > 0 then Location.X * GuiWidth / Size.X else 0
	MouseY = if Size.Y > 0 then Location.Y * GuiHeight / Size.Y else 0
end

const function Show(Next: Kind)
	Current = Next
	ScreenToken += 1
	ActiveButton = nil

	if Next == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.Open(GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
	else
		InventoryScreen.Open(GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
	end
end

const function Removed()
	if Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.Removed()
	elseif Current == "Chat" then
		ChatScreen.Removed()
	end
end

const function OpenInventory()
	if Current then
		return
	end

	Show(if Containers.Owner.InfiniteMaterials then "Creative" else "Inventory")
end

const function OpenChat(Method: ChatScreen.Method)
	if Current then
		return
	end

	Current = "Chat"
	ScreenToken += 1
	ActiveButton = nil
	ChatScreen.Open(Method, GuiWidth, GuiHeight)
end

const function Close()
	if Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.Close()
	elseif Current == "Inventory" then
		InventoryScreen.Close()
	elseif Current == "Chat" then
		ChatScreen.Removed()
	end

	Current = nil
	ActiveButton = nil
end

const function Tick(Player: Players.PlayerEntity)
	if not Current then
		return
	end

	if Current == "Death" then
		DeathScreen.Tick()

		if Player.Health > 0 then
			Current = nil
		end

		return
	elseif Current == "Chat" then
		return
	end

	if Player.Health <= 0 then
		Close()

		return
	end

	const InfiniteMaterials = Containers.Owner.InfiniteMaterials

	if Current == "Inventory" and InfiniteMaterials then
		Show("Creative")
	elseif Current == "Creative" and not InfiniteMaterials then
		Removed()
		Show("Inventory")
	end
end

const function MouseButton(Button: number, Pressed: boolean, Shift: boolean)
	if not Current then
		return
	end

	UpdateMouse()

	if Pressed then
		const Now = Millis()
		const DoubleClick = Now - LastClickTime < DoubleClickMilliseconds and LastClickToken == ScreenToken and LastClickButton == Button

		ActiveButton = Button

		if Current == "Death" then
			DeathScreen.MouseClicked(GuiWidth, GuiHeight, MouseX, MouseY, Button)
		elseif Current == "Chat" then
			ChatScreen.MouseClicked(MouseX, MouseY, Shift, DoubleClick)
		elseif Current == "Creative" then
			CreativeScreen.MouseClicked(MouseX, MouseY, Button, Shift, DoubleClick)
		else
			InventoryScreen.MouseClicked(MouseX, MouseY, Button, Shift, DoubleClick)
		end

		LastClickTime = Now
		LastClickToken = ScreenToken
		LastClickButton = Button
	else
		ActiveButton = nil

		if Current == "Creative" then
			CreativeScreen.MouseReleased(MouseX, MouseY, Button, Shift)
		elseif Current == "Inventory" then
			InventoryScreen.MouseReleased(MouseX, MouseY, Button, Shift)
		end
	end
end

const function Scrolled(Amount: number, Shift: boolean)
	if Current == "Chat" then
		UpdateMouse()
		ChatScreen.MouseScrolled(MouseX, MouseY, Amount, Shift)
	elseif Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.MouseScrolled(0, Amount)
	elseif Current == "Inventory" then
		InventoryScreen.MouseScrolled(0, Amount)
	end
end

const function KeyPressed(Key: Enum.KeyCode, Shift: boolean, Control: boolean)
	if not Current or Current == "Death" then
		return
	end

	KeyTimes[Key] = os.clock()

	if Current == "Chat" then
		if ChatScreen.KeyPressed(Key, Shift, Control) then
			Close()
		end

		return
	end

	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
		Close()

		return
	end

	const Closing = if Current == "Creative" then CreativeScreen.KeyPressed(Key, Shift, Control) else InventoryScreen.KeyPressed(Key, Control)

	if Closing then
		Close()
	end
end

const function KeyReleased()
	if Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.KeyReleased()
	end
end

const function ToggleAdvancedTooltips()
	AdvancedTooltips = not AdvancedTooltips
end

const function TextTyped(Typed: string)
	if Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.CharTyped(Typed)
	elseif Current == "Chat" then
		ChatScreen.CharTyped(Typed)
	end
end

const function CreateTextInput(): TextBox
	const Created = Instance.new("TextBox")

	Created.Name = "TextInput"
	Created.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Created.TextTransparency = 1
	Created.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	Created.Text = ""
	Created.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
	Created.Parent = Gui.ScreenGui()

	Created.FocusLost:Connect(function(EnterPressed: boolean, Cause: InputObject?)
		const Key = if EnterPressed then Enum.KeyCode.Return elseif Cause and Cause.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then Enum.KeyCode.Escape else nil

		if Key and os.clock() - (KeyTimes[Key] or -math.huge) > RepeatedKeySeconds then
			KeyPressed(Key, false, false)
		end
	end)

	Created:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		const Typed = Created.Text

		if Typed ~= "" then
			Created.Text = ""
			TextTyped(Typed)
		end
	end)

	return Created
end

const function UpdateTextInput()
	const WantsInput = (Current == "Creative" and CreativeScreen.WantsTextInput()) or (Current == "Chat" and ChatScreen.WantsTextInput())

	if not TextInput then
		if not WantsInput then
			return
		end

		TextInput = CreateTextInput()
	end

	const Input = TextInput :: TextBox

	if WantsInput and not Input:IsFocused() then
		Input:CaptureFocus()
	elseif not WantsInput and Input:IsFocused() then
		Input:ReleaseFocus()
	end
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, Scale: number, Partial: number)
	GuiWidth = Width
	GuiHeight = Height
	GuiScale = Scale
	UpdateTextInput()

	if not Current then
		return
	end

	const PreviousX = MouseX
	const PreviousY = MouseY

	UpdateMouse()

	const DrawX = MouseX // 1
	const DrawY = MouseY // 1

	if Current == "Death" then
		DeathScreen.Draw(Width, Height, DrawX, DrawY)

		return
	end

	if Current == "Chat" then
		if ActiveButton and (MouseX ~= PreviousX or MouseY ~= PreviousY) then
			ChatScreen.MouseDragged(MouseX)
		end

		ChatScreen.Draw(Width, Height, DrawX, DrawY)

		return
	end

	if ActiveButton and (MouseX ~= PreviousX or MouseY ~= PreviousY) then
		if Current == "Creative" then
			CreativeScreen.MouseDragged(MouseX, MouseY, ActiveButton)
		else
			InventoryScreen.MouseDragged(MouseX, MouseY)
		end
	end

	const Player = Players.GetLocal() :: Players.PlayerEntity

	Canvas.FillGradient(0, 0, Width, Height, BackgroundTop, BackgroundBottom)

	if Current == "Creative" then
		CreativeScreen.Draw(Width, Height, GuiScale, DrawX, DrawY, AdvancedTooltips, Partial)
	else
		InventoryScreen.Draw(Width, Height, GuiScale, DrawX, DrawY, AdvancedTooltips, Partial)
	end

	ContainerScreen.DrawDeferredTooltip(Width, Height, Player, Partial)
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId == Minecraft.Protocol.Clientbound.CommandSuggestions then
		const Info = Minecraft.Protocol.ReadCommandSuggestions(Reader)

		if Current == "Chat" then
			ChatScreen.Receive(Info)
		end

		return true
	elseif PacketId ~= Minecraft.Protocol.Clientbound.PlayerCombatKill then
		return false
	end

	const Message, Score = Minecraft.Protocol.ReadPlayerCombatKill(Reader)

	Close()
	DeathScreen.Open(Message, Score)
	Current = "Death"
	ScreenToken += 1
	ActiveButton = nil

	return true
end

return {
	Receive = Receive,
	IsOpen = IsOpen,
	ShowsActiveEffects = ShowsActiveEffects,
	OpenInventory = OpenInventory,
	OpenChat = OpenChat,
	Close = Close,
	Tick = Tick,
	MouseButton = MouseButton,
	Scrolled = Scrolled,
	KeyPressed = KeyPressed,
	KeyReleased = KeyReleased,
	ToggleAdvancedTooltips = ToggleAdvancedTooltips,
	HandleHotbarLoadOrSave = CreativeScreen.HandleHotbarLoadOrSave,
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/ContainerScreen"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Containers = require("../Containers")
const Canvas = require("../Gui/Canvas")
const Font = require("../Gui/Font")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const ItemRenderer = require("../Gui/ItemRenderer")
const Text = require("../Gui/Text")
const Tooltip = require("../Gui/Tooltip")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry
const Menu = Minecraft.Inventory.Menu
const Inputs = Menu.Inputs

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack
type Slot = Minecraft.Slot
type Owner = Minecraft.Owner

export type Screen = {
	Menu: Minecraft.Menu,
	ImageWidth: number,
	ImageHeight: number,
	LeftPos: number,
	TopPos: number,
	HoveredSlot: Slot?,
	LastClickSlot: Slot?,
	QuickCraftSlots: { Slot },
	IsQuickCrafting: boolean,
	QuickCraftingType: number,
	QuickCraftingButton: number,
	SkipNextRelease: boolean,
	QuickCraftingRemainder: number,
	DoubleClick: boolean,
	LastQuickMoved: ItemStack,
	ScrollX: number,
	ScrollY: number,
	Previews: { [Slot]: ItemStack },
	CarriedPreview: ItemStack,
	TooltipStack: ItemStack?,
	TooltipItem: Minecraft.Item?,
	TooltipCount: number,
	TooltipSelected: number,
	TooltipContext: number,
	TooltipPatch: { [string]: unknown },
	Tooltip: Tooltip.Tooltip?,
}

export type Click = (Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot?, SlotId: number, Button: number, Input: number) -> ()
export type Outside = (Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number) -> boolean
export type Lines = (Screen: Screen, Stack: ItemStack) -> { unknown }

const LeftButton = 1
const MiddleButton = 2
const RightButton = 3
const OffhandButton = 40
const SlotSize = 16
const HighlightSize = 24
const HighlightOffset = 4
const CarriedOffset = 8
const DragPreviewColor = -2130706433
const White = -1
const BundlesTag = "minecraft:bundles"
const HotbarKeys = {
	Enum.KeyCode.One,
	Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	Enum.KeyCode.Three,
	Enum.KeyCode.Four,
	Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	Enum.KeyCode.Six,
	Enum.KeyCode.Seven,
	Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	Enum.KeyCode.Nine,
}

const CappedCounts: { [number]: Font.Formatted } = {}
local PendingTooltip: Tooltip.Tooltip? = nil
local PendingX = 0
local PendingY = 0

const function Create(ScreenMenu: Minecraft.Menu, ImageWidth: number, ImageHeight: number): Screen
	return {
		Menu = ScreenMenu,
		ImageWidth = ImageWidth,
		ImageHeight = ImageHeight,
		LeftPos = 0,
		TopPos = 0,
		HoveredSlot = nil,
		LastClickSlot = nil,
		QuickCraftSlots = {},
		IsQuickCrafting = false,
		QuickCraftingType = 0,
		QuickCraftingButton = 0,
		SkipNextRelease = true,
		QuickCraftingRemainder = 0,
		DoubleClick = false,
		LastQuickMoved = Items.Empty,
		ScrollX = 0,
		ScrollY = 0,
		Previews = {},
		CarriedPreview = Items.Empty,
		TooltipStack = nil,
		TooltipItem = nil,
		TooltipCount = 0,
		TooltipSelected = 0,
		TooltipContext = 0,
		TooltipPatch = {},
		Tooltip = nil,
	}
end

const function Layout(Screen: Screen, Width: number, Height: number)
	Screen.LeftPos = (Width - Screen.ImageWidth) // 2
	Screen.TopPos = (Height - Screen.ImageHeight) // 2
end

const function Open(Screen: Screen, Width: number, Height: number)
	Screen.HoveredSlot = nil
	Screen.LastClickSlot = nil
	table.clear(Screen.QuickCraftSlots)
	Screen.IsQuickCrafting = false
	Screen.SkipNextRelease = true
	Screen.DoubleClick = false
	Screen.LastQuickMoved = Items.Empty
	table.clear(Screen.Previews)
	Layout(Screen, Width, Height)
end

const function Carried(Screen: Screen): ItemStack
	return Menu.CarriedOf(Screen.Menu).Carried
end

const function IsHovering(Screen: Screen, Left: number, Top: number, Width: number, Height: number, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	const RelativeX = X - Screen.LeftPos
	const RelativeY = Y - Screen.TopPos

	return RelativeX >= Left - 1 and RelativeX < Left + Width + 1 and RelativeY >= Top - 1 and RelativeY < Top + Height + 1
end

const function SlotAt(Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number): Slot?
	for _, Slot in Screen.Menu.Slots do
		if IsHovering(Screen, Slot.X, Slot.Y, SlotSize, SlotSize, X, Y) then
			return Slot
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function ClickButton(Button: number): number
	return if Button == LeftButton then 0 elseif Button == RightButton then 1 else Button
end

const function OutsideImage(Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	return X < Screen.LeftPos or Y < Screen.TopPos or X >= Screen.LeftPos + Screen.ImageWidth or Y >= Screen.TopPos + Screen.ImageHeight
end

const function IsBundle(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Registry.HasTag("minecraft:item", BundlesTag, Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id)
end

const function ToggleSelectedBundleItem(Stack: ItemStack, SlotIndex: number, SelectedItem: number)
	if SelectedItem < Items.Bundle.NumberOfItemsToShow(Stack) then
		Items.Bundle.ToggleSelectedItemOf(Stack, SelectedItem)
		Containers.SelectBundleItem(SlotIndex, SelectedItem)
	end
end

const function UnselectBundleItem(Stack: ItemStack, SlotIndex: number)
	ToggleSelectedBundleItem(Stack, SlotIndex, Items.NoSelectedItem)
end

const function OnMouseClickAction(Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot?, Input: number)
	if Slot and Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Slot) then
		const Stack = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)

		if IsBundle(Stack) and (Input == Inputs.QuickMove or Input == Inputs.Swap) then
			UnselectBundleItem(Stack, Slot.Index)
		end
	end
end

const function OnStopHovering(Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot)
	if Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Slot) then
		const Stack = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)

		if IsBundle(Stack) then
			UnselectBundleItem(Stack, Slot.Index)
		end
	end
end

const function ScrollWheel(Screen: Screen, ScrollX: number, ScrollY: number): (number, number)
	if Screen.ScrollX ~= 0 and math.sign(ScrollX) ~= math.sign(Screen.ScrollX) then
		Screen.ScrollX = 0
	end

	if Screen.ScrollY ~= 0 and math.sign(ScrollY) ~= math.sign(Screen.ScrollY) then
		Screen.ScrollY = 0
	end

	Screen.ScrollX += ScrollX
	Screen.ScrollY += ScrollY

	const WheelX = math.modf(Screen.ScrollX)
	const WheelY = math.modf(Screen.ScrollY)

	Screen.ScrollX -= WheelX
	Screen.ScrollY -= WheelY

	return WheelX, WheelY
end

const function MouseScrolled(Screen: Screen, ScrollX: number, ScrollY: number): boolean
	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot

	if not Hovered or not Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Hovered) then
		return false
	end

	const Stack = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Hovered)

	if not IsBundle(Stack) then
		return false
	end

	const Shown = Items.Bundle.NumberOfItemsToShow(Stack)

	if Shown == 0 then
		return false
	end

	const WheelX, WheelY = ScrollWheel(Screen, ScrollX, ScrollY)
	const Wheel = if WheelY == 0 then -WheelX else WheelY

	if Wheel ~= 0 then
		const Selected = Items.Bundle.SelectedItemIndex(Stack)
		local Updated = math.max(-1, Selected - math.sign(Wheel))

		while Updated < 0 do
			Updated += Shown
		end

		while Updated >= Shown do
			Updated -= Shown
		end

		if Selected ~= Updated then
			ToggleSelectedBundleItem(Stack, Hovered.Index, Updated)
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function RecalculateQuickCraftRemaining(Screen: Screen)
	const Stack = Carried(Screen)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or not Screen.IsQuickCrafting then
		return
	end

	if Screen.QuickCraftingType == Menu.QuickcraftTypes.Clone then
		Screen.QuickCraftingRemainder = Items.MaxStackSize(Stack)

		return
	end

	Screen.QuickCraftingRemainder = Items.GetCount(Stack)

	for _, Slot in Screen.QuickCraftSlots do
		const SlotStack = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)
		const Carry = if Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack) then 0 else Items.GetCount(SlotStack)
		const MaxSize = math.min(Items.MaxStackSize(Stack), Menu.SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Stack))
		const NewCount = math.min(Menu.QuickCraftPlaceCount(#Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Screen.QuickCraftingType, Stack) + Carry, MaxSize)

		Screen.QuickCraftingRemainder -= NewCount - Carry
	end
end

const function ShouldAddSlotToQuickCraft(Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Screen.IsQuickCrafting
		and not Items.IsEmpty(Stack)
		and (Items.GetCount(Stack) > #Screen.QuickCraftSlots or Screen.QuickCraftingType == Menu.QuickcraftTypes.Clone)
		and Menu.CanItemQuickReplace(Screen.Menu, Slot, Stack, true)
		and Menu.MayPlace(Slot, Stack)
		and Menu.CanDragTo(Screen.Menu, Slot)
end

const function QuickCraftToSlots(Screen: Screen, Click: Click)
	const Type = Screen.QuickCraftingType

	Click(Screen, nil, Menu.SlotClickedOutside, Menu.QuickcraftMask(Menu.QuickcraftHeaders.Start, Type), Inputs.QuickCraft)

	for _, Slot in Screen.QuickCraftSlots do
		Click(Screen, Slot, Slot.Index, Menu.QuickcraftMask(Menu.QuickcraftHeaders.Continue, Type), Inputs.QuickCraft)
	end

	Click(Screen, nil, Menu.SlotClickedOutside, Menu.QuickcraftMask(Menu.QuickcraftHeaders.End, Type), Inputs.QuickCraft)
end

const function MouseClicked(Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number, Button: number, Shift: boolean, DoubleClick: boolean, Owner: Owner, Click: Click, Outside: Outside)
	const Cloning = Button == MiddleButton and Owner.InfiniteMaterials
	const Slot = SlotAt(Screen, X, Y)

	Screen.DoubleClick = Screen.LastClickSlot == Slot and DoubleClick
	Screen.SkipNextRelease = false

	if Button == LeftButton or Button == RightButton or Cloning then
		local SlotId = if Slot then Slot.Index else -1

		if Outside(Screen, X, Y) then
			SlotId = Menu.SlotClickedOutside
		end

		if SlotId ~= -1 and not Screen.IsQuickCrafting then
			if Items.IsEmpty(Carried(Screen)) then
				if Cloning then
					Click(Screen, Slot, SlotId, ClickButton(Button), Inputs.Clone)
				else
					local Input = Inputs.Pickup

					if SlotId ~= Menu.SlotClickedOutside and Shift then
						Screen.LastQuickMoved = if Slot and Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Slot) then Items.Copy(Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)) else Items.Empty
						Input = Inputs.QuickMove
					elseif SlotId == Menu.SlotClickedOutside then
						Input = Inputs.Throw
					end

					Click(Screen, Slot, SlotId, ClickButton(Button), Input)
				end

				Screen.SkipNextRelease = true
			else
				Screen.IsQuickCrafting = true
				Screen.QuickCraftingButton = Button
				table.clear(Screen.QuickCraftSlots)

				if Button == LeftButton then
					Screen.QuickCraftingType = Menu.QuickcraftTypes.Charitable
				elseif Button == RightButton then
					Screen.QuickCraftingType = Menu.QuickcraftTypes.Greedy
				elseif Cloning then
					Screen.QuickCraftingType = Menu.QuickcraftTypes.Clone
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Screen.LastClickSlot = Slot
end

const function MouseDragged(Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	const Slot = SlotAt(Screen, X, Y)
	const Stack = Carried(Screen)

	if Slot and ShouldAddSlotToQuickCraft(Screen, Slot, Stack) and not table.find(Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Slot) then
		table.insert(Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Slot)
		RecalculateQuickCraftRemaining(Screen)

		return true
	end

	return not (Slot == nil and Items.IsEmpty(Stack))
end

const function MouseReleased(Screen: Screen, X: number, Y: number, Button: number, Shift: boolean, Owner: Owner, Click: Click, Outside: Outside)
	const Slot = SlotAt(Screen, X, Y)
	local SlotId = if Slot then Slot.Index else -1

	if Outside(Screen, X, Y) then
		SlotId = Menu.SlotClickedOutside
	end

	if Screen.DoubleClick and Slot and Button == LeftButton and Menu.CanTakeItemForPickAll(Screen.Menu, Slot) then
		if Shift then
			const Moved = Screen.LastQuickMoved

			if not Items.IsEmpty(Moved) then
				for _, Target in Screen.Menu.Slots do
					if
						Menu.MayPickup(Screen.Menu, Owner, Target)
						and Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Target)
						and Menu.ContainerOf(Target) == Menu.ContainerOf(Slot)
						and Menu.CanItemQuickReplace(Screen.Menu, Target, Moved, true)
					then
						Click(Screen, Target, Target.Index, ClickButton(Button), Inputs.QuickMove)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			Click(Screen, Slot, SlotId, ClickButton(Button), Inputs.PickupAll)
		end

		Screen.DoubleClick = false
	else
		if Screen.IsQuickCrafting and Screen.QuickCraftingButton ~= Button then
			Screen.IsQuickCrafting = false
			table.clear(Screen.QuickCraftSlots)
			Screen.SkipNextRelease = true

			return
		end

		if Screen.SkipNextRelease then
			Screen.SkipNextRelease = false

			return
		end

		if Screen.IsQuickCrafting and #Screen.QuickCraftSlots > 0 then
			QuickCraftToSlots(Screen, Click)
		elseif not Items.IsEmpty(Carried(Screen)) then
			if Button == MiddleButton then
				Click(Screen, Slot, SlotId, ClickButton(Button), Inputs.Clone)
			else
				const QuickKey = SlotId ~= Menu.SlotClickedOutside and Shift

				if QuickKey then
					Screen.LastQuickMoved = if Slot and Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Slot) then Items.Copy(Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)) else Items.Empty
				end

				Click(Screen, Slot, SlotId, ClickButton(Button), if QuickKey then Inputs.QuickMove else Inputs.Pickup)
			end
		end
	end

	Screen.IsQuickCrafting = false
end

const function HotbarKeyPressed(Screen: Screen, Key: Enum.KeyCode, Click: Click): boolean
	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Carried(Screen)) or not Hovered then
		return false
	end

	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		Click(Screen, Hovered, Hovered.Index, OffhandButton, Inputs.Swap)

		return true
	end

	const Index = table.find(HotbarKeys, Key)

	if Index then
		Click(Screen, Hovered, Hovered.Index, Index - 1, Inputs.Swap)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function IsHotbarKey(Key: Enum.KeyCode): boolean
	return table.find(HotbarKeys, Key) ~= nil
end

const function KeyPressed(Screen: Screen, Key: Enum.KeyCode, Control: boolean, Click: Click): boolean
	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		return true
	end

	HotbarKeyPressed(Screen, Key, Click)

	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot

	if Hovered and Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Hovered) and Key == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
		Click(Screen, Hovered, Hovered.Index, if Control then 1 else 0, Inputs.Throw)
	end

	return false
end

const function Close(Screen: Screen)
	Containers.Close()

	if Screen.HoveredSlot then
		OnStopHovering(Screen, Screen.HoveredSlot)
	end
end

const function CappedCount(Count: number): Font.Formatted
	local Run = CappedCounts[Count]

	if not Run then
		Run = Text.Flatten(`§e{Count}`, Font.PlainStyle)
		CappedCounts[Count] = Run
	end

	return Run :: Font.Formatted
end

const function Preview(Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack, Count: number): ItemStack
	const Existing = Screen.Previews[Slot]

	if Existing and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Existing, Stack) then
		Items.SetCount(Existing, Count)

		return Existing
	end

	const Created = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, Count)

	Screen.Previews[Slot] = Created

	return Created
end

const function DrawSlot(Screen: Screen, Slot: Slot, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	const X = Screen.LeftPos + Slot.X
	const Y = Screen.TopPos + Slot.Y
	const Stack = Carried(Screen)
	local Shown = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Slot)
	local QuickCraftStack = false
	local CountText: Font.Formatted? = nil

	if Screen.IsQuickCrafting and table.find(Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Slot) and not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		if #Screen.QuickCraftSlots == 1 then
			return
		end

		if Menu.CanItemQuickReplace(Screen.Menu, Slot, Stack, true) and Menu.CanDragTo(Screen.Menu, Slot) then
			QuickCraftStack = true

			const MaxSize = math.min(Items.MaxStackSize(Stack), Menu.SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Stack))
			const Carry = if Items.IsEmpty(Shown) then 0 else Items.GetCount(Shown)
			local NewCount = Menu.QuickCraftPlaceCount(#Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Screen.QuickCraftingType, Stack) + Carry

			if NewCount > MaxSize then
				NewCount = MaxSize
				CountText = CappedCount(MaxSize)
			end

			Shown = Preview(Screen, Slot, Stack, NewCount)
		else
			table.remove(Screen.QuickCraftSlots, table.find(Screen.QuickCraftSlots, Slot) :: number)
			RecalculateQuickCraftRemaining(Screen)
		end
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(Shown) and Slot.NoItemIcon then
		Canvas.BlitSprite(Slot.NoItemIcon, X, Y, SlotSize, SlotSize, White)

		return
	end

	if QuickCraftStack then
		Canvas.Fill(X, Y, X + SlotSize, Y + SlotSize, DragPreviewColor)
	end

	ItemRenderer.DrawItem(Shown, X, Y, Slot.X + Slot.Y * Screen.ImageWidth, Holder, Partial)
	ItemRenderer.DrawDecorations(Shown, X, Y, CountText)
end

const function DrawSlots(Screen: Screen, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	const Previous = Screen.HoveredSlot
	const Hovered = SlotAt(Screen, MouseX, MouseY)

	Screen.HoveredSlot = Hovered

	if Hovered then
		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:container/slot_highlight_back", Screen.LeftPos + Hovered.X - HighlightOffset, Screen.TopPos + Hovered.Y - HighlightOffset, HighlightSize, HighlightSize, White)
	end

	for _, Slot in Screen.Menu.Slots do
		DrawSlot(Screen, Slot, Holder, Partial)
	end

	if Hovered then
		Canvas.BlitSprite("minecraft:container/slot_highlight_front", Screen.LeftPos + Hovered.X - HighlightOffset, Screen.TopPos + Hovered.Y - HighlightOffset, HighlightSize, HighlightSize, White)
	end

	if Previous and Previous ~= Hovered then
		OnStopHovering(Screen, Previous)
	end
end

const function DrawCarried(Screen: Screen, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	local Stack = Carried(Screen)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	if Screen.IsQuickCrafting and #Screen.QuickCraftSlots > 1 then
		const Existing = Screen.CarriedPreview

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Existing) and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Existing, Stack) then
			Items.SetCount(Existing, Screen.QuickCraftingRemainder)
			Stack = Existing
		else
			Stack = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, Screen.QuickCraftingRemainder)
			Screen.CarriedPreview = Stack
		end
	end

	ItemRenderer.DrawItem(Stack, MouseX - CarriedOffset, MouseY - CarriedOffset, 0, Holder, Partial)
	ItemRenderer.DrawDecorations(Stack, MouseX - CarriedOffset, MouseY - CarriedOffset)
end

const function PatchUnchanged(Stack: ItemStack, Snapshot: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	local Remaining = 0

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Snapshot[Type] ~= Value then
			return false
		end

		Remaining += 1
	end

	for _ in Snapshot do
		Remaining -= 1
	end

	return Remaining == 0
end

const function ItemTooltip(Screen: Screen, Stack: ItemStack, Context: number, Lines: Lines): Tooltip.Tooltip
	const Cached = Screen.Tooltip

	if
		Cached
		and Screen.TooltipStack == Stack
		and Screen.TooltipItem == Stack.Item
		and Screen.TooltipCount == Stack.Count
		and Screen.TooltipSelected == Stack.SelectedBundleItem
		and Screen.TooltipContext == Context
		and PatchUnchanged(Stack, Screen.TooltipPatch)
	then
		return Cached
	end

	const Built = Tooltip.ForItem(Stack, Lines(Screen, Stack))

	Screen.Tooltip = Built
	Screen.TooltipStack = Stack
	Screen.TooltipItem = Stack.Item
	Screen.TooltipCount = Stack.Count
	Screen.TooltipSelected = Stack.SelectedBundleItem
	Screen.TooltipContext = Context
	Screen.TooltipPatch = table.clone(Stack.Patch)

	return Built
end

const function SetTooltip(Prepared: Tooltip.Tooltip, X: number, Y: number)
	if not PendingTooltip then
		PendingTooltip = Prepared
		PendingX = X
		PendingY = Y
	end
end

const function RequestSlotTooltip(Screen: Screen, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Context: number, Lines: Lines)
	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot

	if not Hovered or not Menu.HasItem(Screen.Menu, Hovered) then
		return
	end

	const Stack = Menu.GetItem(Screen.Menu, Hovered)
	const Prepared = ItemTooltip(Screen, Stack, Context, Lines)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Carried(Screen)) or Tooltip.ShowsWithItemInHand(Prepared) then
		SetTooltip(Prepared, MouseX, MouseY)
	end
end

const function DrawDeferredTooltip(Width: number, Height: number, Holder: ItemModels.Holder?, Partial: number)
	const Prepared = PendingTooltip

	PendingTooltip = nil

	if Prepared then
		Tooltip.Draw(Prepared, PendingX, PendingY, Width, Height, Holder, Partial)
	end
end

return {
	LeftButton = LeftButton,
	Create = Create,
	Layout = Layout,
	Open = Open,
	Carried = Carried,
	IsHovering = IsHovering,
	OutsideImage = OutsideImage,
	OnMouseClickAction = OnMouseClickAction,
	MouseScrolled = MouseScrolled,
	MouseClicked = MouseClicked,
	MouseDragged = MouseDragged,
	MouseReleased = MouseReleased,
	HotbarKeyPressed = HotbarKeyPressed,
	IsHotbarKey = IsHotbarKey,
	KeyPressed = KeyPressed,
	Close = Close,
	DrawSlots = DrawSlots,
	DrawCarried = DrawCarried,
	SetTooltip = SetTooltip,
	RequestSlotTooltip = RequestSlotTooltip,
	DrawDeferredTooltip = DrawDeferredTooltip,
}

end

	return SelectedTab :: Tab
end

const function Box(): EditBox.EditBox
	if not SearchBox then
		const Texture = Textures.Texture(SearchTexture)
		const Pixel = ((SearchY + 1) * Texture.Size.X + SearchX + 1) * 4
		const HighlightColor = bit32.bor(0xFF0000FF, bit32.lshift(buffer.readu8(Texture.Pixels, Pixel), 16), bit32.lshift(buffer.readu8(Texture.Pixels, Pixel + 1), 8))
		const Created = EditBox.Create(0, 0, SearchWidth, SearchHeight, SearchMaxLength, White, HighlightColor, false)

		Created.Visible = false
		SearchBox = Created
	end

	return SearchBox :: EditBox.EditBox
end

const function RowCount(): number
	return (#PickerItems + Columns - 1) // Columns - Rows
end

const function RowIndexForScroll(Offset: number): number
	const Row = math.modf(Offset * RowCount() + 0.5)

	return math.max(Row, 0)
end

const function ScrollTo(Offset: number)
	const Row = RowIndexForScroll(Offset)

	for Y = 0, Rows - 1 do
		for X = 0, Columns - 1 do
			Picker.Creative[X + Y * Columns + 1] = PickerItems[X + (Y + Row) * Columns + 1] or Items.Empty
		end
	end
end

const function PickerCanScroll(): boolean
	return #PickerItems > Rows * Columns
end

const function CanScroll(): boolean
	return Selected().CanScroll and PickerCanScroll()
end

const function TabX(Tab: Tab): number
	return if Tab.AlignedRight then ImageWidth - TabSpacing * (RightTabs - Tab.Column) + 1 else TabSpacing * Tab.Column
end

const function TabY(Tab: Tab): number
	return if Tab.Top then -TabHeight else ImageHeight
end

const function TabClicked(Tab: Tab, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	const Left = TabX(Tab)
	const Top = TabY(Tab)

	return X >= Left and X <= Left + TabWidth and Y >= Top and Y <= Top + TabHeight
end

const function UpdateVisibleTags(Query: string)
	const Colon = string.find(Query, ":", 1, true)
	const Namespace = if Colon then string.match(string.sub(Query, 1, Colon - 1), "^%s*(.-)%s*$") :: string else nil
	const Path = if Colon then string.match(string.sub(Query, Colon + 1), "^%s*(.-)%s*$") :: string else Query

	for _, Tag in Registry.TagNames("minecraft:item") do
		const TagNamespace, TagPath = string.match(Tag, "^([^:]*):(.*)$")

		if string.find(TagPath :: string, Path, 1, true) and (not Namespace or string.find(TagNamespace :: string, Namespace, 1, true)) then
			table.insert(VisibleTags, Tag)
		end
	end
end

const function RefreshSearchResults()
	table.clear(PickerItems)
	table.clear(VisibleTags)
	SearchGeneration += 1

	local Query = EditBox.ValueString(Box())

	if Query == "" then
		table.move(Selected().Items, 1, #Selected().Items, 1, PickerItems)
	else
		local Results: { ItemStack } = {}

		if string.sub(Query, 1, 1) == "#" then
			Query = string.sub(Query, 2)
			Results = CreativeSearch.SearchTags(string.lower(Query))
			UpdateVisibleTags(Query)
		else
			Results = CreativeSearch.SearchNames(string.lower(Query))
		end

		table.move(Results, 1, #Results, 1, PickerItems)
	end

	ScrollOffs = 0
	ScrollTo(0)
end

const function HotbarPlaceholder(Index: number): ItemStack
	const Placeholder = Items.Create(Registry.Item("minecraft:paper"), 1)

	Items.Set(Placeholder, "minecraft:creative_slot_lock", {})
	Items.Set(Placeholder, "minecraft:item_name", { translate = "inventory.hotbarInfo", with = { SaveActivatorName, HotbarKeyNames[Index + 1] } })

	return Placeholder
end

const function SelectTab(Tab: Tab)
	const OldTab = Selected()
	const Search = Box()

	SelectedTab = Tab
	table.clear(Screen.QuickCraftSlots)
	table.clear(Screen.Previews)
	table.clear(PickerItems)

	if Tab.Type == "hotbar" then
		for HotbarIndex = 0, Hotbars.Count - 1 do
			if Hotbars.IsEmpty(HotbarIndex) then
				for Slot = 0, Inventory.SelectionSize - 1 do
					table.insert(PickerItems, if Slot == HotbarIndex then HotbarPlaceholder(HotbarIndex) else Items.Empty)
				end
			else
				for _, Stack in Hotbars.Load(HotbarIndex) do
					table.insert(PickerItems, Stack)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif Tab.Type == "category" then
		table.move(Tab.Items, 1, #Tab.Items, 1, PickerItems)
	end

	if Tab.Type == "inventory" then
		Menu.ShowPickerInventory(Picker, InventoryMenu)
	elseif OldTab.Type == "inventory" then
		Menu.ShowPickerItems(Picker)
	end

	if Tab.Type == "search" then
		Search.Visible = true
		Search.CanLoseFocus = false
		EditBox.SetFocused(Search, true)

		if OldTab ~= Tab then
			EditBox.SetValue(Search, "")
		end

		RefreshSearchResults()
	else
		Search.Visible = false
		Search.CanLoseFocus = true
		EditBox.SetFocused(Search, false)
		EditBox.SetValue(Search, "")
	end

	ScrollOffs = 0
	ScrollTo(0)
end

const function TrashSlot(): Slot?
	if Selected().Type ~= "inventory" then
		return nil
	end

	return Picker.Slots[#Picker.Slots]
end

const function Drop(Stack: ItemStack)
	Containers.HandleCreativeModeItemDrop(Stack)
end

const function ClickCreativeSlot(Slot: Slot, Button: number, Input: number, QuickKey: boolean)
	const CarriedMenu = Menu.CarriedOf(Picker)
	const Carried = CarriedMenu.Carried
	const Clicked = Menu.GetItem(Picker, Slot)

	if Input == Inputs.Swap then
		if not Items.IsEmpty(Clicked) then
			Inventory.SetItem(Picker.Inventory, Button, Items.CopyWithCount(Clicked, Items.MaxStackSize(Clicked)))
			Containers.BroadcastChanges()
		end

		return
	end

	if Input == Inputs.Clone then
		if Items.IsEmpty(Carried) and Menu.HasItem(Picker, Slot) then
			CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.CopyWithCount(Clicked, Items.MaxStackSize(Clicked))
		end

		return
	end

	if Input == Inputs.Throw then
		if not Items.IsEmpty(Clicked) then
			Drop(Items.CopyWithCount(Clicked, if Button == 0 then 1 else Items.MaxStackSize(Clicked)))
		end

		return
	end

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Carried) and not Items.IsEmpty(Clicked) and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Carried, Clicked) then
		if Button == 0 then
			if QuickKey then
				Items.SetCount(Carried, Items.MaxStackSize(Carried))
			elseif Items.GetCount(Carried) < Items.MaxStackSize(Carried) then
				Items.Grow(Carried, 1)
			end
		else
			Items.Shrink(Carried, 1)
		end
	elseif not Items.IsEmpty(Clicked) and Items.IsEmpty(Carried) then
		CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.CopyWithCount(Clicked, if QuickKey then Items.MaxStackSize(Clicked) else Items.GetCount(Clicked))
	elseif Button == 0 then
		CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	elseif not Items.IsEmpty(CarriedMenu.Carried) then
		Items.Shrink(CarriedMenu.Carried, 1)
	end
end

const function ClickInventoryTab(Slot: Slot?, SlotId: number, Button: number, Input: number)
	const CarriedMenu = Menu.CarriedOf(Picker)

	if Slot and Slot == TrashSlot() then
		CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	elseif Input == Inputs.Throw and Slot and Menu.HasItem(Picker, Slot) then
		const ToDrop = Menu.Remove(Picker, Slot, if Button == 0 then 1 else Items.MaxStackSize(Menu.GetItem(Picker, Slot)))

		Drop(ToDrop)
		Containers.HandleCreativeModeItemAdd(Menu.GetItem(Picker, Slot), Slot.Index)
	elseif Input == Inputs.Throw and SlotId == Menu.SlotClickedOutside and not Items.IsEmpty(CarriedMenu.Carried) then
		Drop(CarriedMenu.Carried)
		CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	else
		Menu.Clicked(InventoryMenu, Containers.Owner, if Slot then Slot.Index else SlotId, Button, Input)
		Containers.BroadcastChanges()
	end
end

const function ClickPicker(Slot: Slot?, SlotId: number, Button: number, Input: number)
	const Old = if Slot then Menu.GetItem(Picker, Slot) else Items.Empty

	Menu.Clicked(Picker, Containers.Owner, if Slot then Slot.Index else SlotId, Button, Input)
	Containers.SendCreativeDrops()

	if Input == Inputs.QuickCraft and bit32.band(Button, 3) == QuickCraftEnd then
		for Index = 0, Inventory.SelectionSize - 1 do
			Containers.HandleCreativeModeItemAdd(Menu.SlotItem(Picker, HotbarMenuStart + Index), HotbarInventoryStart + Index)
		end
	elseif Slot and Inventory.IsHotbarSlot(Slot.ContainerSlot) and Selected().Type ~= "inventory" then
		const Carried = Menu.CarriedOf(Picker).Carried

		if Input == Inputs.Throw and not Items.IsEmpty(Old) and not Items.IsEmpty(Carried) then
			const Count = if Button == 0 then 1 else Items.GetCount(Old)
			const ToDrop = Items.CopyWithCount(Old, Count)

			Items.Shrink(Old, Count)
			Drop(ToDrop)
		end

		Containers.BroadcastChanges()
	end
end

const function Click(Target: ContainerScreen.Screen, Slot: Slot?, SlotId: number, Button: number, Input: number)
	const Search = Box()

	if Slot and Menu.IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then
		EditBox.MoveCursorToEnd(Search, false)
		EditBox.SetHighlightPos(Search, 0)
	end

	const QuickKey = Input == Inputs.QuickMove
	const Effective = if SlotId == Menu.SlotClickedOutside and Input == Inputs.Pickup then Inputs.Throw else Input

	if Effective == Inputs.Throw and not Containers.CanDropItems() then
		return
	end

	ContainerScreen.OnMouseClickAction(Target, Slot, Effective)

	const Tab = Selected()

	if not Slot and Tab.Type ~= "inventory" and Effective ~= Inputs.QuickCraft then
		const CarriedMenu = Menu.CarriedOf(Picker)

		if not Items.IsEmpty(CarriedMenu.Carried) and HasClickedOutside then
			if not Containers.CanDropItems() then
				return
			end

			if Button == 0 then
				Drop(CarriedMenu.Carried)
				CarriedMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
			end

			if Button == 1 then
				Drop(Items.Split(CarriedMenu.Carried, 1))
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if Slot and not Menu.MayPickup(Picker, Containers.Owner, Slot) then
		return
	end

	if Slot and Slot == TrashSlot() and QuickKey then
		for Index, InventorySlot in InventoryMenu.Slots do
			Menu.Set(InventoryMenu, InventorySlot, Items.Empty)
			Containers.HandleCreativeModeItemAdd(Items.Empty, Index - 1)
		end
	elseif Tab.Type == "inventory" then
		ClickInventoryTab(Slot, SlotId, Button, Effective)
	elseif Effective ~= Inputs.QuickCraft and Slot and Menu.IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then
		ClickCreativeSlot(Slot, Button, Effective, QuickKey)
	else
		ClickPicker(Slot, SlotId, Button, Effective)
	end
end

const function Outside(Target: ContainerScreen.Screen, X: number, Y: number): boolean
	HasClickedOutside = ContainerScreen.OutsideImage(Target, X, Y) and not TabClicked(Selected(), X, Y)

	return HasClickedOutside
end

const function TabTitle(Tab: Tab): Font.Formatted
	local Run = TitleRuns[Tab]

	if not Run then
		Run = Text.Flatten(Tab.Title, Font.PlainStyle)
		TitleRuns[Tab] = Run
	end

	return Run :: Font.Formatted
end

const function Lines(Target: ContainerScreen.Screen, Stack: ItemStack): { unknown }
	const Hovered = Target.HoveredSlot
	const CreativeSlot = Hovered ~= nil and Hovered.Kind == "Creative"
	const Tab = Selected()
	const Original = ItemTooltip.Lines(Stack, { Advanced = Advanced, Creative = CreativeSlot, HasPlayer = true })

	if #Original == 0 or (Tab.Type == "category" and CreativeSlot) then
		return Original
	end

	if Tab.Type == "search" and CreativeSlot then
		for _, Tag in VisibleTags do
			if Registry.HasTag("minecraft:item", Tag, Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id) then
				table.insert(Original, 2, { text = `#{Tag}`, color = "dark_purple" })
			end
		end
	end

	local Position = 2

	for _, Other in CreativeTabs.Displayed() do
		if Other.Type ~= "search" and CreativeTabs.Contains(Other, Stack) then
			table.insert(Original, Position, { text = "", extra = { Other.Title }, color = "blue" })
			Position += 1
		end
	end

	return Original
end

const function TabTooltip(Tab: Tab): Tooltip.Tooltip
	local Prepared = TabTitles[Tab]

	if not Prepared then
		Prepared = Tooltip.Prepare({ Tab.Title }, false, nil)
		TabTitles[Tab] = Prepared
	end

	return Prepared :: Tooltip.Tooltip
end

const function DrawTabButton(Tab: Tab, Player: Players.PlayerEntity, Partial: number)
	const IsSelected = Tab == Selected()
	const X = Screen.LeftPos + TabX(Tab)
	const Y = Screen.TopPos - (if Tab.Top then 28 else -(ImageHeight - 4))
	const Sprites = if Tab.Top then (if IsSelected then TopSelected else TopUnselected) else (if IsSelected then BottomSelected else BottomUnselected)

	Canvas.BlitSprite(Sprites[math.clamp(Tab.Column, 0, #Sprites) + 1], X, Y, TabWidth, TabHeight, White)
	ItemRenderer.DrawItem(Tab.Icon, X + 13 - 8, Y + 16 - 8 + (if Tab.Top then 1 else -1), 0, Player, Partial)
end

const function Open(Width: number, Height: number)
	ContainerScreen.Open(Screen, Width, Height)

	const Tab = Selected()

	SelectedTab = CreativeTabs.DefaultTab()
	SelectTab(Tab)
	Containers.SetCreativeListener(true)

	if not Selected().Display then
		SelectTab(CreativeTabs.DefaultTab())
	end
end

const function Removed()
	Containers.SetCreativeListener(false)
end

const function Close()
	ContainerScreen.Close(Screen)
	Removed()
end

const function WantsTextInput(): boolean
	const Search = Box()

	return Search.Visible and Search.Focused
end

const function CharTyped(Typed: string)
	if IgnoreTextInput or Selected().Type ~= "search" then
		return
	end

	const Search = Box()
	const Before = EditBox.ValueString(Search)

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Typed) do
		EditBox.InsertText(Search, utf8.char(Codepoint))
	end

	if EditBox.ValueString(Search) ~= Before then
		RefreshSearchResults()
	end
end

const function KeyPressed(Key: Enum.KeyCode, Shift: boolean, Control: boolean): boolean
	IgnoreTextInput = false

	if Selected().Type ~= "search" then
		if Key == Enum.KeyCode.T then
			IgnoreTextInput = true
			SelectTab(CreativeTabs.SearchTab())

			return false
		end

		return ContainerScreen.KeyPressed(Screen, Key, Control, Click)
	end

	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot
	const DoQuickSwap = not (Hovered and Menu.IsCreativeContainer(Hovered)) or Menu.HasItem(Picker, Hovered :: Slot)

	if DoQuickSwap and ContainerScreen.IsHotbarKey(Key) and ContainerScreen.HotbarKeyPressed(Screen, Key, Click) then
		IgnoreTextInput = true

		return false
	end

	const Search = Box()
	const Before = EditBox.ValueString(Search)
	const Handled = EditBox.KeyPressed(Search, Key, Shift, Control)

	if Handled then
		if EditBox.ValueString(Search) ~= Before then
			RefreshSearchResults()
		end

		return false
	end

	return false
end

const function KeyReleased()
	IgnoreTextInput = false
end

const function MouseClicked(X: number, Y: number, Button: number, Shift: boolean, DoubleClick: boolean)
	if Button == ContainerScreen.LeftButton then
		for _, Tab in CreativeTabs.Displayed() do
			if TabClicked(Tab, X - Screen.LeftPos, Y - Screen.TopPos) then
				return
			end
		end

		if Selected().Type ~= "inventory" and X >= Screen.LeftPos + ScrollerX and Y >= Screen.TopPos + ScrollerY and X < Screen.LeftPos + ScrollerX + ScrollbarWidth and Y < Screen.TopPos + ScrollerY + ScrollbarHeight and Selected().CanScroll then
			Scrolling = CanScroll()

			return
		end

		const Search = Box()

		if EditBox.IsMouseOver(Search, X, Y) then
			EditBox.Click(Search, X, Shift, DoubleClick)
			EditBox.SetFocused(Search, true)
			DraggingSearch = true

			return
		end
	end

	ContainerScreen.MouseClicked(Screen, X, Y, Button, Shift, DoubleClick, Containers.Owner, Click, Outside)
end

const function MouseDragged(X: number, Y: number, Button: number)
	if Scrolling then
		const Top = Screen.TopPos + ScrollerY

		ScrollOffs = math.clamp((Y - Top - 7.5) / (ScrollbarHeight - 15), 0, 1)
		ScrollTo(ScrollOffs)

		return
	end

	if not ContainerScreen.MouseDragged(Screen, X, Y) and Button == ContainerScreen.LeftButton then
		const Search = Box()

		if DraggingSearch and Search.Focused then
			EditBox.Drag(Search, X)
		end
	end
end

const function MouseReleased(X: number, Y: number, Button: number, Shift: boolean)
	if Button == ContainerScreen.LeftButton then
		Scrolling = false
		DraggingSearch = false

		for _, Tab in CreativeTabs.Displayed() do
			if TabClicked(Tab, X - Screen.LeftPos, Y - Screen.TopPos) then
				SelectTab(Tab)

				return
			end
		end
	end

	ContainerScreen.MouseReleased(Screen, X, Y, Button, Shift, Containers.Owner, Click, Outside)
end

const function MouseScrolled(ScrollX: number, ScrollY: number)
	if ContainerScreen.MouseScrolled(Screen, ScrollX, ScrollY) or not CanScroll() then
		return
	end

	ScrollOffs = math.clamp(ScrollOffs - ScrollY / RowCount(), 0, 1)
	ScrollTo(ScrollOffs)
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, GuiScale: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, AdvancedTooltips: boolean, Partial: number)
	ContainerScreen.Layout(Screen, Width, Height)

	const Player = Players.GetLocal() :: Players.PlayerEntity
	const Left = Screen.LeftPos
	const Top = Screen.TopPos
	const Tab = Selected()
	const Search = Box()

	Advanced = AdvancedTooltips
	EffectsPanel.Draw(Screen, Width, Player, MouseX, MouseY)
	Search.X = Left + SearchX
	Search.Y = Top + SearchY

	for _, Other in CreativeTabs.Displayed() do
		if Other ~= Tab then
			DrawTabButton(Other, Player, Partial)
		end
	end

	Canvas.Blit(Textures.TextureContent(Tab.Background), 0, 0, ImageWidth, ImageHeight, Left, Top, Left + ImageWidth, Top + ImageHeight, White)
	EditBox.Draw(Search)

	if Tab.CanScroll then
		Canvas.BlitSprite(
			if CanScroll() then "minecraft:container/creative_inventory/scroller" else "minecraft:container/creative_inventory/scroller_disabled",
			Left + ScrollerX,
			Top + ScrollerY + math.modf((ScrollbarHeight - 17) * ScrollOffs),
			ScrollerWidth,
			ScrollerHeight,
			White
		)
	end

	DrawTabButton(Tab, Player, Partial)

	if Tab.Type == "inventory" then
		PlayerPreview.Draw(Player, Left + PreviewLeft, Top + PreviewTop, Left + PreviewRight, Top + PreviewBottom, PreviewSize, MouseX, MouseY, GuiScale)
	end

	if Tab.ShowTitle then
		Font.DrawFormatted(TabTitle(Tab), Left + TitleX, Top + TitleY, LabelColor, false)
	end

	ContainerScreen.DrawSlots(Screen, MouseX, MouseY, Player, Partial)
	ContainerScreen.DrawCarried(Screen, MouseX, MouseY, Player, Partial)

	const Hovered = Screen.HoveredSlot
	const Context = (if Advanced then 1 else 0) + (if Hovered and Hovered.Kind == "Creative" then 2 else 0) + Tab.Index * 4 + SearchGeneration * 64

	ContainerScreen.RequestSlotTooltip(Screen, MouseX, MouseY, Context, Lines)

	for _, Other in CreativeTabs.Displayed() do
		if ContainerScreen.IsHovering(Screen, TabX(Other) + 3, TabY(Other) + 3, 21, 27, MouseX, MouseY) then
			ContainerScreen.SetTooltip(TabTooltip(Other), MouseX, MouseY)

			break
		end
	end

	const Trash = TrashSlot()

	if Trash and ContainerScreen.IsHovering(Screen, Trash.X, Trash.Y, 16, 16, MouseX, MouseY) then
		if not TrashTooltip then
			TrashTooltip = Tooltip.Prepare({ { translate = "inventory.binSlot" } }, false, nil)
		end

		ContainerScreen.SetTooltip(TrashTooltip :: Tooltip.Tooltip, MouseX, MouseY)
	end
end

const function HandleHotbarLoadOrSave(Index: number, Load: boolean, Save: boolean)
	const PlayerInventory = Containers.Owner.Inventory

	if Load then
		const Loaded = Hotbars.Load(Index)

		for Slot = 0, Inventory.SelectionSize - 1 do
			const Stack = Loaded[Slot + 1]

			Inventory.SetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot, Stack)
			Containers.HandleCreativeModeItemAdd(Stack, HotbarInventoryStart + Slot)
		end

		Containers.BroadcastChanges()
	elseif Save then
		Hotbars.Store(Index, PlayerInventory)
		Gui.SetOverlayMessage({ translate = "inventory.hotbarSaved", with = { LoadActivatorName, HotbarKeyNames[Index + 1] } })
	end
end

const function ShowsActiveEffects(Width: number): boolean
	return EffectsPanel.CanSee(Screen, Width)
end

return {
	ShowsActiveEffects = ShowsActiveEffects,
	Open = Open,
	Removed = Removed,
	Close = Close,
	WantsTextInput = WantsTextInput,
	CharTyped = CharTyped,
	KeyPressed = KeyPressed,
	KeyReleased = KeyReleased,
	MouseClicked = MouseClicked,
	MouseDragged = MouseDragged,
	MouseReleased = MouseReleased,
	MouseScrolled = MouseScrolled,
	Draw = Draw,
	HandleHotbarLoadOrSave = HandleHotbarLoadOrSave,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/CreativeSearch"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const CreativeTabs = require("./CreativeTabs")
const Font = require("../Gui/Font")
const ItemTooltip = require("../Gui/ItemTooltip")
const Text = require("../Gui/Text")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

type Entry = {
	Stack: ItemStack,
	Names: { string },
	Namespace: string,
	Path: string,
	TagNamespaces: { string },
	TagPaths: { string },
}

const TooltipOptions: ItemTooltip.Options = { Advanced = false, Creative = true, HasPlayer = false }

const Entries: { Entry } = {}

const function PlainString(Component: unknown): string
	const Run = Text.Flatten(Component, Font.PlainStyle)

	return if Run.Count == 0 then "" else utf8.char(table.unpack(Run.Codepoints, 1, Run.Count))
end

const function Trim(Value: string): string
	return string.match(Value, "^[%z\1- ]*(.-)[%z\1- ]*$") :: string
end

const function Split(Id: string): (string, string)
	const Namespace, Path = string.match(Id, "^([^:]*):(.*)$")

	return string.lower(Namespace :: string), string.lower(Path :: string)
end

const function Build()
	if #Entries > 0 then
		return
	end

	for _, Stack in CreativeTabs.SearchTab().Items do
		const Names: { string } = {}

		for _, Line in ItemTooltip.Lines(Stack, TooltipOptions) do
			const Name = Trim(PlainString(Line))

			if Name ~= "" then
				table.insert(Names, string.lower(Name))
			end
		end

		const Id = Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id
		const Namespace, Path = Split(Id)
		const TagNamespaces: { string } = {}
		const TagPaths: { string } = {}

		for _, Tag in Registry.TagsOf("minecraft:item", Id) do
			const TagNamespace, TagPath = Split(Tag)

			table.insert(TagNamespaces, TagNamespace)
			table.insert(TagPaths, TagPath)
		end

		table.insert(Entries, { Stack = Stack, Names = Names, Namespace = Namespace, Path = Path, TagNamespaces = TagNamespaces, TagPaths = TagPaths })
	end
end

const function AnyContains(Values: { string }, Query: string): boolean
	for _, Value in Values do
		if string.find(Value, Query, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function SplitQuery(Query: string): (string?, string)
	const Colon = string.find(Query, ":", 1, true)

	if not Colon then
		return nil, Query
	end

	return Trim(string.sub(Query, 1, Colon - 1)), Trim(string.sub(Query, Colon + 1))
end

const function SearchNames(Query: string): { ItemStack }
	Build()

	const Namespace, Path = SplitQuery(Query)
	const Results: { ItemStack } = {}

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		const Matches = if Namespace
			then string.find(Entry.Namespace, Namespace, 1, true) ~= nil and (string.find(Entry.Path, Path, 1, true) ~= nil or AnyContains(Entry.Names, Path))
			else AnyContains(Entry.Names, Path)

		if Matches then
			table.insert(Results, Entry.Stack)
		end
	end

	return Results
end

const function SearchTags(Query: string): { ItemStack }
	Build()

	const Namespace, Path = SplitQuery(Query)
	const Results: { ItemStack } = {}

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		const Matches = if Namespace then AnyContains(Entry.TagNamespaces, Namespace) and AnyContains(Entry.TagPaths, Path) else AnyContains(Entry.TagPaths, Path)

		if Matches then
			table.insert(Results, Entry.Stack)
		end
	end

	return Results
end

return {
	SearchNames = SearchNames,
	SearchTags = SearchTags,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/CreativeTabs"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Data = require("@self/Data")

const Items = Minecraft.Items

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

export type TabType = "category" | "hotbar" | "search" | "inventory"

export type Tab = {
	Index: number,
	Id: string,
	Type: TabType,
	Top: boolean,
	Column: number,
	AlignedRight: boolean,
	ShowTitle: boolean,
	CanScroll: boolean,
	Display: boolean,
	Background: string,
	Title: unknown,
	Icon: ItemStack,
	Items: { ItemStack },
	SearchItems: { ItemStack },
}

type Source = {
	Id: string,
	Type: TabType,
	Row: "top" | "bottom",
	Column: number,
	AlignedRight: boolean,
	ShowTitle: boolean,
	CanScroll: boolean,
	Display: boolean,
	Background: string,
	Title: unknown,
	Icon: unknown,
	Items: { unknown },
	SearchItems: { unknown },
}

const DefaultTabId = "minecraft:building_blocks"
const SearchTabId = "minecraft:search"

const Tabs: { Tab } = {}
const Shown: { Tab } = {}

const function Stacks(Templates: { unknown }): { ItemStack }
	const Converted: { ItemStack } = {}

	for Index, Template in Templates do
		Converted[Index] = Items.FromTemplate(Template)
	end

	return Converted
end

const function Load()
	if #Tabs > 0 then
		return
	end

	const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)

	for Index, Source in HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: { Source } do
		const Created: Tab = {
			Index = Index,
			Id = Source.Id,
			Type = Source.Type,
			Top = Source.Row == "top",
			Column = Source.Column,
			AlignedRight = Source.AlignedRight,
			ShowTitle = Source.ShowTitle,
			CanScroll = Source.CanScroll,
			Display = Source.Display,
			Background = Source.Background,
			Title = Source.Title,
			Icon = Items.FromTemplate(Source.Icon),
			Items = Stacks(Source.Items),
			SearchItems = Stacks(Source.SearchItems),
		}

		table.insert(Tabs, Created)

		if Created.Display then
			table.insert(Shown, Created)
		end
	end
end

const function All(): { Tab }
	Load()

	return Tabs
end

const function Displayed(): { Tab }
	Load()

	return Shown
end

const function Find(Id: string): Tab
	for _, Tab in All() do
		if Tab.Id == Id then
			return Tab
		end
	end

	error(`Unknown creative tab {Id}`)
end

const function DefaultTab(): Tab
	return Find(DefaultTabId)
end

const function SearchTab(): Tab
	return Find(SearchTabId)
end

const function Contains(Tab: Tab, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	for _, Candidate in Tab.SearchItems do
		if Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Candidate, Stack) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	All = All,
	Displayed = Displayed,
	DefaultTab = DefaultTab,
	SearchTab = SearchTab,
	Contains = Contains,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/DeathScreen"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("../Connection")
const Sounds = require("../Sounds")
const Canvas = require("../Gui/Canvas")
const Font = require("../Gui/Font")
const Text = require("../Gui/Text")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const ButtonWidth = 200
const ButtonHeight = 20
const ButtonDelay = 20
const ClickVolume = 0.25
const BackgroundTop = 1615855616
const BackgroundBottom = -1602211792
const White = -1
const InactiveColor = -6250336
const TitleScale = 2

const Title = Text.Flatten({ translate = "deathScreen.title" }, Font.PlainStyle)
const RespawnLabel = Text.Flatten({ translate = "deathScreen.respawn" }, Font.PlainStyle)
const TitleScreenLabel = Text.Flatten({ translate = "deathScreen.titleScreen" }, Font.PlainStyle)

local Cause: Font.Formatted? = nil
local Score: Font.Formatted = Text.Flatten({ text = "" }, Font.PlainStyle)
local DelayTicker = 0
local RespawnActive = false

const function Open(Message: unknown, ScoreValue: number)
	Cause = if Message == nil then nil else Text.Flatten(Message, Font.PlainStyle)
	Score = Text.Flatten({ translate = "deathScreen.score.value", with = { { text = tostring(ScoreValue), color = "yellow" } } }, Font.PlainStyle)
	DelayTicker = 0
	RespawnActive = false
end

const function Tick()
	DelayTicker += 1

	if DelayTicker == ButtonDelay then
		RespawnActive = true
	end
end

const function IsOver(X: number, Y: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number): boolean
	return MouseX >= X and MouseY >= Y and MouseX < X + ButtonWidth and MouseY < Y + ButtonHeight
end

const function DrawButton(Label: Font.Formatted, X: number, Y: number, Active: boolean, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const Sprite = if not Active then "minecraft:widget/button_disabled" elseif IsOver(X, Y, MouseX, MouseY) then "minecraft:widget/button_highlighted" else "minecraft:widget/button"
	const TextWidth = Font.FormattedWidth(Label)

	Canvas.BlitSprite(Sprite, X, Y, ButtonWidth, ButtonHeight, White)
	Font.DrawFormatted(Label, X + (ButtonWidth - TextWidth) // 2, Y + (ButtonHeight - 9) // 2 + 1, if Active then White else InactiveColor, true)
end

const function DrawCentered(Run: Font.Formatted, CenterX: number, Y: number)
	Font.DrawFormatted(Run, CenterX - Font.FormattedWidth(Run) // 2, Y, White, true)
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const Middle = Width // 2

	Canvas.FillGradient(0, 0, Width, Height, BackgroundTop, BackgroundBottom)
	Canvas.SetPoseScale(TitleScale)
	DrawCentered(Title, Middle // 2, 30)
	Canvas.SetPoseScale(1)

	if Cause then
		DrawCentered(Cause, Middle, 85)
	end

	DrawCentered(Score, Middle, 100)
	DrawButton(RespawnLabel, Middle - ButtonWidth // 2, Height // 4 + 72, RespawnActive, MouseX, MouseY)
	DrawButton(TitleScreenLabel, Middle - ButtonWidth // 2, Height // 4 + 96, false, MouseX, MouseY)
end

const function MouseClicked(Width: number, Height: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Button: number)
	if Button == 1 and RespawnActive and IsOver(Width // 2 - ButtonWidth // 2, Height // 4 + 72, MouseX, MouseY) then
		RespawnActive = false
		Sounds.Play("ui.button.click", nil, ClickVolume, 1)
		Protocol.WriteClientCommand(Connection.Stream, Protocol.ClientCommands.PerformRespawn)
	end
end

return {
	Open = Open,
	Tick = Tick,
	Draw = Draw,
	MouseClicked = MouseClicked,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/EffectsPanel"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("../Gui/Canvas")
const ContainerScreen = require("./ContainerScreen")
const Font = require("../Gui/Font")
const Players = require("../Players")
const Text = require("../Gui/Text")
const Tooltip = require("../Gui/Tooltip")

const Effects = Minecraft.Effects

const Gap = 2
const MinimumWidth = 32
const WideWidth = 120
const Spacing = 7
const BoxHeight = 32
const TextOffset = 32
const IconOffset = 7
const IconSize = 18
const DefaultStep = 33
const CrowdedSpan = 132
const CrowdedCount = 5
const LineHeight = 9
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const White = -1
const DurationColor = -8355712
const Ellipsis = "..."

const Sorted: { Minecraft.EffectInstance } = {}
const Names: { [string]: Font.Formatted } = {}
const Clipped: { [string]: Font.Formatted } = {}
const InfiniteDuration = Text.Flatten({ translate = "effect.duration.infinite" }, Font.PlainStyle)

local TooltipKey = ""
local PreparedTooltip: Tooltip.Tooltip? = nil

const function Path(Id: string): string
	return (string.match(Id, ":(.*)$") or Id) :: string
end

const function NameComponent(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): unknown
	const Definition = Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)
	const Name = if Definition then Definition.descriptionId else Effect.Id

	if Effect.Amplifier >= 1 and Effect.Amplifier <= 9 then
		return { translate = Name, extra = { " ", { translate = `enchantment.level.{Effect.Amplifier + 1}` } } }
	end

	return { translate = Name }
end

const function NameOf(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): Font.Formatted
	const Key = `{Effect.Id}|{Effect.Amplifier}`
	local Name = Names[Key]

	if not Name then
		Name = Text.Flatten(NameComponent(Effect), Font.PlainStyle)
		Names[Key] = Name
	end

	return Name :: Font.Formatted
end

const function ClippedName(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, Name: Font.Formatted, MaxWidth: number): Font.Formatted
	const Key = `{Effect.Id}|{Effect.Amplifier}|{MaxWidth}`
	local Result = Clipped[Key]

	if not Result then
		const Head = Font.Head(Name, MaxWidth - Font.Width(Ellipsis))
		const Combined = Text.Flatten({ text = Ellipsis }, Font.PlainStyle)
		const Run: Font.Formatted = { Codepoints = table.clone(Head.Codepoints), Styles = table.clone(Head.Styles), Count = Head.Count + Combined.Count }

		table.move(Combined.Codepoints, 1, Combined.Count, Head.Count + 1, Run.Codepoints)
		table.move(Combined.Styles, 1, Combined.Count, Head.Count + 1, Run.Styles)
		Result = Run
		Clipped[Key] = Run
	end

	return Result :: Font.Formatted
end

const function DurationText(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): string
	const Seconds = Effect.Duration // TicksPerSecond
	const Minutes = Seconds // 60
	const Hours = Minutes // 60

	return if Hours > 0 then string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", Hours, Minutes % 60, Seconds % 60) else string.format("%02d:%02d", Minutes % 60, Seconds % 60)
end

const function DurationWidth(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): number
	return if Effects.IsInfinite(Effect) then Font.FormattedWidth(InfiniteDuration) else Font.Width(DurationText(Effect))
end

const function DrawDuration(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, X: number, Y: number)
	if Effects.IsInfinite(Effect) then
		Font.DrawFormatted(InfiniteDuration, X, Y, DurationColor, true)
	else
		Font.Draw(DurationText(Effect), X, Y, DurationColor, true)
	end
end

const function RequestTooltip(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const Duration = if Effects.IsInfinite(Effect) then "" else DurationText(Effect)
	const Key = `{Effect.Id}|{Effect.Amplifier}|{Duration}`

	if Key ~= TooltipKey or not PreparedTooltip then
		TooltipKey = Key
		PreparedTooltip = Tooltip.Prepare({ NameComponent(Effect), if Effects.IsInfinite(Effect) then { translate = "effect.duration.infinite" } else { text = Duration } }, false, nil)
	end

	ContainerScreen.SetTooltip(PreparedTooltip :: Tooltip.Tooltip, MouseX, MouseY)
end

const function CanSee(Screen: ContainerScreen.Screen, Width: number): boolean
	return Width - (Screen.LeftPos + Screen.ImageWidth + Gap) >= MinimumWidth
end

const function Draw(Screen: ContainerScreen.Screen, Width: number, Player: Players.PlayerEntity, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const X0 = Screen.LeftPos + Screen.ImageWidth + Gap
	const Available = Width - X0

	table.clear(Sorted)

	for _, Effect in Player.Effects do
		table.insert(Sorted, Effect)
	end

	if #Sorted == 0 or Available < MinimumWidth then
		return
	end

	table.sort(Sorted, Effects.Precedes)

	const MaxWidth = if Available >= WideWidth then Available - Spacing else MinimumWidth
	const Step = if #Sorted > CrowdedCount then CrowdedSpan // (#Sorted - 1) else DefaultStep
	local Y0 = Screen.TopPos

	for _, Effect in Sorted do
		const Name = NameOf(Effect)
		const NameWidth = Font.FormattedWidth(Name)
		const BoxWidth = math.min(MaxWidth, math.max(TextOffset + NameWidth + Spacing, TextOffset + DurationWidth(Effect) + Spacing))
		const MaxTextWidth = BoxWidth - TextOffset - Spacing
		local Compact = true

		Canvas.BlitSprite(if Effect.Ambient then "minecraft:container/inventory/effect_background_ambient" else "minecraft:container/inventory/effect_background", X0, Y0, BoxWidth, BoxHeight, White)

		if MaxTextWidth > 0 then
			const ShouldClip = NameWidth > MaxTextWidth

			Font.DrawFormatted(if ShouldClip then ClippedName(Effect, Name, MaxTextWidth) else Name, X0 + TextOffset, Y0 + Spacing, White, true)
			DrawDuration(Effect, X0 + TextOffset, Y0 + Spacing + LineHeight)
			Compact = ShouldClip
		end

		if Compact and MouseX >= X0 and MouseX <= X0 + BoxWidth and MouseY >= Y0 and MouseY <= Y0 + Step then
			RequestTooltip(Effect, MouseX, MouseY)
		end

		Canvas.BlitSprite(`minecraft:mob_effect/{Path(Effect.Id)}`, X0 + IconOffset, Y0 + IconOffset, IconSize, IconSize, White)
		Y0 += Step
	end
end

return {
	CanSee = CanSee,
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/InventoryScreen"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Containers = require("../Containers")
const ContainerScreen = require("./ContainerScreen")
const EffectsPanel = require("./EffectsPanel")
const PlayerPreview = require("./PlayerPreview")
