_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/PlayerPreview"] = function(require)

const Avatars = require("../Avatars")
const Equipment = require("../Equipment")
const EntityPicture = require("../Gui/EntityPicture")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Models = require("../Models")
const Players = require("../Players")
const Skins = require("../Skins")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const RenderPartial = 1
const ThirdPersonLeftOrdinal = 1
const ThirdPersonRightOrdinal = 2
const HeadOrdinal = 5

local SkinName: string? = nil
local Model: Models.PlayerModel? = nil
local Texture: Textures.Texture? = nil
const State = Avatars.CreateRenderState()
const RightItem = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const LeftItem = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const ItemContext: ItemModels.Context = { DisplayContext = "none", Holder = nil, Seed = 0 }
const Worn: EntityPicture.Worn = {
	Armor = {},
	Wings = nil,
	SkullKind = nil,
	SkullTexture = nil,
	HeadItem = ItemModels.CreateRenderState(),
	Invisible = false,
}

const ArmorLayerTypes: { [Models.ArmorSlot]: Equipment.LayerType } = {
	chest = "humanoid",
	legs = "humanoid_leggings",
	feet = "humanoid",
	head = "humanoid",
}

const function ResolveWorn(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity)
	for Slot, LayerType in ArmorLayerTypes do
		const Stack = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, Slot)

		Worn.Armor[Slot] = if Equipment.ShouldRender(Stack, Slot) then Equipment.Texture(Stack, LayerType) else nil
	end

	const Chest = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "chest")
	const Head = Players.ItemBySlot(Entity, "head")
	const Kind, Texture = ItemModels.WornSkull(Head)
	const ShowsItem = not Kind and not Equipment.ShouldRender(Head, "head")

	Worn.Wings = if Equipment.ShouldRender(Chest, "chest") then Equipment.Texture(Chest, "wings") else nil
	Worn.SkullKind = Kind
	Worn.SkullTexture = Texture
	Worn.Invisible = Players.IsInvisible(Entity)
	ItemContext.DisplayContext = "head"
	ItemContext.Holder = Entity
	ItemContext.Seed = Entity.Id + HeadOrdinal
	ItemModels.Resolve(Worn.HeadItem, if ShowsItem then Head else Minecraft.Items.Empty, ItemContext)
end

const function ResolveHand(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, Out: ItemModels.RenderState, Right: boolean)
	ItemContext.DisplayContext = if Right then "thirdperson_righthand" else "thirdperson_lefthand"
	ItemContext.Holder = Entity
	ItemContext.Seed = Entity.Id + (if Right then ThirdPersonRightOrdinal else ThirdPersonLeftOrdinal)
	ItemModels.Resolve(Out, Players.ItemHeldByArm(Entity, if Right then "Right" else "Left"), ItemContext)
end

const function Draw(Entity: Players.PlayerEntity, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number, Size: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number, GuiScale: number)
	if SkinName ~= Entity.Name then
		const Skin = Skins.ForName(Entity.Name)

		SkinName = Entity.Name
		Model = Models.Player.Create(Skin.Slim)
		Texture = Textures.Texture(Skin.Texture)
	end

	Avatars.ExtractRenderState(Entity, RenderPartial, State)
	ResolveHand(Entity, RightItem, true)
	ResolveHand(Entity, LeftItem, false)
	ResolveWorn(Entity)
	EntityPicture.Draw(
		Model :: Models.PlayerModel,
		State,
		Texture :: Textures.Texture,
		Entity.HurtTime > 0 or Entity.DeathTime > 0,
		Entity.Height,
		RightItem,
		LeftItem,
		Worn,
		X0,
		Y0,
		X1,
		Y1,
		Size,
		MouseX,
		MouseY,
		GuiScale
	)
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Screens/ChatScreen"] = function(require)

const TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Canvas = require("../Gui/Canvas")
const ChatComponent = require("../Gui/ChatComponent")
const Connection = require("../Connection")
const EditBox = require("../Gui/EditBox")
const Font = require("../Gui/Font")
const Interaction = require("../Interaction")
const Players = require("../Players")
const Text = require("../Gui/Text")
const Tooltip = require("../Gui/Tooltip")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const MaxLength = 256
const HistorySize = 100
const LineHeight = 12
const UsageOffsetFromBottom = 27
const SuggestionLineLimit = 10
const LineStartOffset = 1
const BackgroundColor = 0x80000000
const FillColor = 0xD0000000
const TextColor = 0xFFE0E0E0
const HighlightColor = 0xFFBFBFFF
const UsageColor = 0xFFFFFFFF
const UnselectedColor = 0xFFAAAAAA
const SelectedColor = 0xFFFFFF00
const DottedColor = 0xFFFFFFFF
const Slash = 47
const Space = 32

export type Method = "Message" | "Command"

type ExitReason = "Intentional" | "Interrupted" | "Done"

type Suggestion = Minecraft.CommandSuggestion

type Pending = {
	Start: number,
	End: number,
	List: { Suggestion },
}

type SuggestionsList = {
	X: number,
	Y: number,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	OriginalContents: string,
	List: { Suggestion },
	Start: number,
	End: number,
	Offset: number,
	Current: number,
	LastMouseX: number,
	LastMouseY: number,
	TabCycles: boolean,
}

const RecentChat: { string } = {}

local Draft: { Text: string, Method: Method }? = nil
local Input: EditBox.EditBox? = nil
local Initial = ""
local IsDraft = false
local Exit: ExitReason = "Interrupted"
local HistoryBuffer = ""
local HistoryPos = 0
local ScreenWidth = 0
local ScreenHeight = 0
local AllowSuggestions = false
local KeepSuggestions = false
local ParsedText: string? = nil
local Ranges: { { Start: number, End: number } } = {}
local UnparsedStart = -1
local UnparsedLength = 0
local RequestId = 0
local KeepingRequest = false
local PendingSuggestions: Pending? = nil
local List: SuggestionsList? = nil
const Usage: { Font.Formatted } = {}
local UsagePosition = 0
local UsageWidth = 0

const ArgumentStyles = {
	Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.aqua, false),
	Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.yellow, false),
	Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.green, false),
	Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.light_purple, false),
	Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.gold, false),
}

const LiteralStyle = Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.gray, false)
const UnparsedStyle = Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.red, false)
const DraftStyle = Text.Style(Text.NamedColors.gray, true)

const function Box(): EditBox.EditBox
	return Input :: EditBox.EditBox
end

const function Codepoints(Value: string): { number }
	const Result: { number } = {}

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Value) do
		table.insert(Result, Codepoint)
	end

	return Result
end

const function Substring(Value: string, From: number, To: number?): string
	const Points = Codepoints(Value)
	const Last = math.min(To or #Points, #Points)

	return if Last > From then utf8.char(table.unpack(Points, From + 1, Last)) else ""
end

const function Length(Value: string): number
	return utf8.len(Value) or #Value
end

const function StartsWith(Value: string, Prefix: string): boolean
	return string.sub(Value, 1, #Prefix) == Prefix
end

const function LastWordIndex(Value: string): number
	local Result = 0
	const Points = Codepoints(Value)

	for Index, Codepoint in Points do
		if Codepoint == Space or Codepoint == 9 or Codepoint == 10 or Codepoint == 13 then
			Result = Index
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function UpdateFormats()
	const Input = Box()
	const Formats = Input.Formats
	const Count = #Input.Value

	table.clear(Formats)

	if IsDraft then
		for Index = 1, Count do
			Formats[Index] = DraftStyle
		end

		return
	end

	if ParsedText == nil or ParsedText ~= EditBox.ValueString(Input) then
		return
	end

	for Index = 1, Count do
		Formats[Index] = LiteralStyle
	end

	for Index, Range in Ranges do
		const Style = ArgumentStyles[(Index - 1) % #ArgumentStyles + 1]

		if Range.Start >= Count then
			break
		end

		for Position = Range.Start + 1, math.min(Range.End, Count) do
			Formats[Position] = Style
		end
	end

	if UnparsedStart >= 0 and UnparsedStart < Count then
		for Position = UnparsedStart + 1, math.min(UnparsedStart + UnparsedLength, Count) do
			Formats[Position] = UnparsedStyle
		end
	end
end

const function SetUsage(Lines: { unknown })
	table.clear(Usage)
	UsageWidth = 0

	for _, Line in Lines do
		const Run = Text.Flatten(Line, Font.PlainStyle)

		table.insert(Usage, Run)
		UsageWidth = math.max(UsageWidth, Font.FormattedWidth(Run))
	end
end

const function SortSuggestions(Pending: Pending): { Suggestion }
	const Input = Box()
	const Partial = Substring(EditBox.ValueString(Input), 0, Input.CursorPos)
	const LastWord = string.lower(Substring(Partial, LastWordIndex(Partial)))
	const Leading: { Suggestion } = {}
	const Rest: { Suggestion } = {}

	for _, Entry in Pending.List do
		if StartsWith(Entry.Text, LastWord) or StartsWith(Entry.Text, `minecraft:{LastWord}`) then
			table.insert(Leading, Entry)
		else
			table.insert(Rest, Entry)
		end
	end

	for _, Entry in Rest do
		table.insert(Leading, Entry)
	end

	return Leading
end

const function Apply(Entry: { Start: number, End: number }, Suggestion: Suggestion, Contents: string): string
	if Entry.Start == 0 and Entry.End == Length(Contents) then
		return Suggestion.Text
	end

	return `{Substring(Contents, 0, Entry.Start)}{Suggestion.Text}{Substring(Contents, Entry.End)}`
end

const function Select(Shown: SuggestionsList, Index: number)
	local Current = Index

	if Current < 1 then
		Current += #Shown.List
	end

	if Current > #Shown.List then
		Current -= #Shown.List
	end

	Shown.Current = Current

	const Input = Box()
	const Value = EditBox.ValueString(Input)
	const Completed = Apply(Shown, Shown.List[Current], Shown.OriginalContents)

	Input.Suggestion = if StartsWith(Completed, Value) then string.sub(Completed, #Value + 1) else nil
end

const function SuggestNames(Partial: string, Start: number): Pending
	const Remaining = string.lower(Substring(Partial, Start))
	const Found: { Suggestion } = {}

	for _, Info in Players.Info do
		const Name = Info.Name
		const Lower = string.lower(Name)
		local Index = 1
		local Matches = false

		while true do
			if string.sub(Lower, Index, Index + #Remaining - 1) == Remaining then
				Matches = true

				break
			end

			const Splitter = string.find(Lower, "[%._/]", Index)

			if not Splitter then
				break
			end

			Index = Splitter + 1
		end

		if Matches and Name ~= Substring(Partial, Start) then
			table.insert(Found, { Text = Name, Tooltip = nil })
		end
	end

	table.sort(Found, function(First: Suggestion, Second: Suggestion): boolean
		return string.lower(First.Text) < string.lower(Second.Text)
	end)

	return { Start = Start, End = Length(Partial), List = Found }
end

const function UpdateCommandInfo()
	const Input = Box()
	const Command = EditBox.ValueString(Input)

	if ParsedText ~= nil and ParsedText ~= Command then
		ParsedText = nil
	end

	if not KeepSuggestions then
		Input.Suggestion = nil
		List = nil
	end

	SetUsage({})

	const StartsWithSlash = #Input.Value > 0 and Input.Value[1] == Slash
	const Cursor = Input.CursorPos

	if StartsWithSlash then
		RequestId += 1
		KeepingRequest = KeepSuggestions and List ~= nil
		Protocol.WriteCommandSuggestion(Connection.Stream, RequestId, Command, Cursor, Interaction.TargetEntity())
	elseif string.find(Command, "%S") then
		RequestId += 1

		const Partial = Substring(Command, 0, Cursor)

		PendingSuggestions = SuggestNames(Partial, LastWordIndex(Partial))
		UsagePosition = 0
	else
		RequestId += 1
		PendingSuggestions = nil
	end

	UpdateFormats()
end

const function OnEdited()
	AllowSuggestions = true
	UpdateCommandInfo()
	IsDraft = false
	UpdateFormats()
end

const function ShowSuggestions()
	const Pending = PendingSuggestions

	if not Pending or #Pending.List == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Input = Box()
	local MaxWidth = 0

	for _, Entry in Pending.List do
		MaxWidth = math.max(MaxWidth, Font.Width(Entry.Text))
	end

	const X = math.clamp(EditBox.GetScreenX(Input, Pending.Start), 0, math.max(0, EditBox.GetScreenX(Input, 0) + Input.Width - MaxWidth))
	const Y = ScreenHeight - LineHeight
	const Sorted = SortSuggestions(Pending)
	const Shown = math.min(#Sorted, SuggestionLineLimit)
	const Created: SuggestionsList = {
		X = X - 1,
		Y = Y - 3 - Shown * LineHeight,
		Width = MaxWidth + 1,
		Height = Shown * LineHeight,
		OriginalContents = EditBox.ValueString(Input),
		List = Sorted,
		Start = Pending.Start,
		End = Pending.End,
		Offset = 0,
		Current = 1,
		LastMouseX = 0,
		LastMouseY = 0,
		TabCycles = false,
	}

	List = Created
	Select(Created, 1)
end

const function UseSuggestion(Shown: SuggestionsList)
	const Suggestion = Shown.List[Shown.Current]
	const Input = Box()
	const Finish = Shown.Start + Length(Suggestion.Text)

	KeepSuggestions = true
	EditBox.SetValue(Input, Apply(Shown, Suggestion, Shown.OriginalContents))
	OnEdited()
	EditBox.SetCursorPosition(Input, Finish)
	EditBox.SetHighlightPos(Input, Finish)
	Select(Shown, Shown.Current)
	KeepSuggestions = false
	Shown.TabCycles = true
end

const function Cycle(Shown: SuggestionsList, Direction: number)
	Select(Shown, Shown.Current + Direction)

	const Current = Shown.Current - 1
	const First = Shown.Offset
	const Last = Shown.Offset + SuggestionLineLimit - 1
	const MaximumOffset = math.max(#Shown.List - SuggestionLineLimit, 0)

	if Current < First then
		Shown.Offset = math.clamp(Current, 0, MaximumOffset)
	elseif Current > Last then
		Shown.Offset = math.clamp(Current + LineStartOffset - SuggestionLineLimit, 0, MaximumOffset)
	end
end

const function SetAllowSuggestions(Allowed: boolean)
	AllowSuggestions = Allowed

	if not Allowed then
		List = nil
	end
end

const function Init(Width: number, Height: number)
	ScreenWidth = Width
	ScreenHeight = Height
	HistoryPos = #RecentChat

	const Created = EditBox.Create(4, Height - 12, Width - 4, 12, MaxLength, TextColor, HighlightColor, true)

	Created.CanLoseFocus = false
	Input = Created
	EditBox.SetValue(Created, Initial)
	EditBox.SetFocused(Created, true)
	SetAllowSuggestions(false)
	ParsedText = nil
	UpdateCommandInfo()
end

const function Open(Method: Method, Width: number, Height: number)
	const Saved = Draft

	if Saved and (Method == "Message" or Saved.Method == Method) then
		Initial = Saved.Text
		IsDraft = true
	else
		Initial = if Method == "Command" then "/" else ""
		IsDraft = false
	end

	Exit = "Interrupted"
	ChatComponent.SetFocused(true)
	Init(Width, Height)
end

const function Removed()
	ChatComponent.ResetScroll()
	ChatComponent.SetFocused(false)
	Initial = EditBox.ValueString(Box())

	if Exit ~= "Interrupted" or not string.find(Initial, "%S") then
		Draft = nil
	elseif not IsDraft then
		Draft = { Text = Initial, Method = if StartsWith(Initial, "/") then "Command" else "Message" }
	end

	Input = nil
	List = nil
	PendingSuggestions = nil
	ParsedText = nil
	RequestId += 1
end

const function Receive(Info: Minecraft.CommandInfo)
	if not Input or Info.Id ~= RequestId then
		return
	end

	ParsedText = EditBox.ValueString(Box())
	Ranges = Info.Ranges
	UnparsedStart = Info.UnparsedStart
	UnparsedLength = Info.UnparsedLength
	UpdateFormats()

	if KeepingRequest then
		return
	end

	const Input = Box()

	SetUsage(Info.Usage)
	UsagePosition = if #Usage > 0 then math.clamp(EditBox.GetScreenX(Input, Info.UsageStart), 0, math.max(0, EditBox.GetScreenX(Input, 0) + Input.Width - UsageWidth)) else 0
	PendingSuggestions = { Start = Info.SuggestionStart, End = Info.SuggestionEnd, List = Info.Suggestions }
	List = nil

	if AllowSuggestions then
		ShowSuggestions()
	end
end

const function Normalize(Message: string): string
	const Collapsed = string.gsub(string.gsub(Message, "^%s+", ""), "%s+$", "")
	const Spaced = string.gsub(Collapsed, "%s+", " ")

	return Substring(Spaced, 0, MaxLength)
end

const function SendMessage(Message: string)
	const Channel = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels"):WaitForChild("RBXGeneral") :: TextChannel

	Channel:SendAsync(Message)
end

const function HandleChatInput(Raw: string)
	const Message = Normalize(Raw)

	if Message == "" then
		return
	end

	if RecentChat[#RecentChat] ~= Message then
		if #RecentChat >= HistorySize then
			table.remove(RecentChat, 1)
		end

		table.insert(RecentChat, Message)
	end

	if StartsWith(Message, "/") then
		Protocol.WriteChatCommand(Connection.Stream, string.sub(Message, 2))
	else
		task.spawn(SendMessage, Message)
	end
end

const function MoveInHistory(Direction: number)
	const Input = Box()
	const Maximum = #RecentChat
	const Position = math.clamp(HistoryPos + Direction, 0, Maximum)

	if Position == HistoryPos then
		return
	end

	if Position == Maximum then
		HistoryPos = Maximum
		EditBox.SetValue(Input, HistoryBuffer)
		OnEdited()

		return
	end

	if HistoryPos == Maximum then
		HistoryBuffer = EditBox.ValueString(Input)
	end

	EditBox.SetValue(Input, RecentChat[Position + 1])
	OnEdited()
	SetAllowSuggestions(false)
	HistoryPos = Position
end

const function SuggestionsKeyPressed(Key: Enum.KeyCode, Shift: boolean): boolean
	const Shown = List

	if Shown then
		if Key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			Cycle(Shown, -1)
			Shown.TabCycles = false

			return true
		elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			Cycle(Shown, 1)
			Shown.TabCycles = false

			return true
		elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			if Shown.TabCycles then
				Cycle(Shown, if Shift then -1 else 1)
			end

			UseSuggestion(Shown)

			return true
		elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			List = nil
			Box().Suggestion = nil

			return true
		end
	end

	if Key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
		return false
	end

	ShowSuggestions()

	return true
end

const function KeyPressed(Key: Enum.KeyCode, Shift: boolean, Control: boolean): boolean
	const Input = Box()

	if SuggestionsKeyPressed(Key, Shift) then
		return false
	end

	if IsDraft and Key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
		EditBox.SetValue(Input, "")
		OnEdited()

		return false
	end

	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
		Exit = "Intentional"

		return true
	end

	const Handled, Changed = EditBox.KeyPressed(Input, Key, Shift, Control)

	if Changed then
		OnEdited()
	elseif Handled then
		UpdateFormats()
	end

	if Handled then
		return false
	end

	if Key == Enum.KeyCode.Return or Key == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then
		HandleChatInput(EditBox.ValueString(Input))
		Exit = "Done"

		return true
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
		MoveInHistory(-1)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
		MoveInHistory(1)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.PageUp then
		ChatComponent.Scroll(ChatComponent.LinesPerPage() - 1)
	elseif Key == Enum.KeyCode.PageDown then
		ChatComponent.Scroll(-ChatComponent.LinesPerPage() + 1)
	end

	return false
end

const function CharTyped(Typed: string)
	if EditBox.InsertText(Box(), Typed) then
		OnEdited()
	end
end

const function Hovered(Shown: SuggestionsList, MouseX: number, MouseY: number): boolean
	return MouseX >= Shown.X and MouseX < Shown.X + Shown.Width and MouseY >= Shown.Y and MouseY < Shown.Y + Shown.Height
end

const function MouseClicked(MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Shift: boolean, DoubleClick: boolean)
	const Shown = List

	if Shown and Hovered(Shown, MouseX // 1, MouseY // 1) then
		const Line = (MouseY // 1 - Shown.Y) // LineHeight + Shown.Offset

		if Line >= 0 and Line < #Shown.List then
			Select(Shown, Line + 1)
			UseSuggestion(Shown)
		end

		return
	end

	const Input = Box()

	if EditBox.IsMouseOver(Input, MouseX, MouseY) then
		EditBox.Click(Input, MouseX, Shift, DoubleClick)
	end
end

const function MouseDragged(MouseX: number)
	EditBox.Drag(Box(), MouseX)
end

const function MouseScrolled(MouseX: number, MouseY: number, Amount: number, Shift: boolean)
	const Shown = List
	const Clamped = math.clamp(Amount, -1, 1)

	if Shown and Hovered(Shown, MouseX // 1, MouseY // 1) then
		const Scrolled = math.modf(Shown.Offset - Clamped)

		Shown.Offset = math.clamp(Scrolled, 0, math.max(#Shown.List - SuggestionLineLimit, 0))

		return
	end

	ChatComponent.Scroll(math.modf(if Shift then Clamped else Clamped * 7))
end

const function DrawList(Shown: SuggestionsList, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	const Limit = math.min(#Shown.List, SuggestionLineLimit)
	const HasPrevious = Shown.Offset > 0
	const HasNext = #Shown.List > Shown.Offset + Limit
	const Moved = Shown.LastMouseX ~= MouseX or Shown.LastMouseY ~= MouseY
	const X = Shown.X
	const Y = Shown.Y
	local HoveredIndex: number? = nil

	if Moved then
		Shown.LastMouseX = MouseX
		Shown.LastMouseY = MouseY
	end

	if HasPrevious or HasNext then
		Canvas.Fill(X, Y - 1, X + Shown.Width, Y, FillColor)
		Canvas.Fill(X, Y + Shown.Height, X + Shown.Width, Y + Shown.Height + 1, FillColor)

		for Column = 0, Shown.Width - 1, 2 do
			if HasPrevious then
				Canvas.Fill(X + Column, Y - 1, X + Column + 1, Y, DottedColor)
			end

			if HasNext then
				Canvas.Fill(X + Column, Y + Shown.Height, X + Column + 1, Y + Shown.Height + 1, DottedColor)
			end
		end
	end

	for Line = 0, Limit - 1 do
		const Index = Line + Shown.Offset + 1
		const Top = Y + LineHeight * Line

		Canvas.Fill(X, Top, X + Shown.Width, Top + LineHeight, FillColor)

		if MouseX > X and MouseX < X + Shown.Width and MouseY > Top and MouseY < Top + LineHeight then
			if Moved then
				Select(Shown, Index)
			end

			HoveredIndex = Index
		end

		Font.Draw(Shown.List[Index].Text, X + 1, Top + 2, if Index == Shown.Current then SelectedColor else UnselectedColor, true)
	end

	const Tip = if HoveredIndex then Shown.List[Shown.Current].Tooltip else nil

	if Tip ~= nil then
		Tooltip.Draw(Tooltip.Prepare({ Tip }, false, nil), MouseX, MouseY, ScreenWidth, ScreenHeight, nil, 0)
	end
end

const function DrawUsage()
	for Index, Line in Usage do
		const Y = ScreenHeight - UsageOffsetFromBottom - LineHeight * (Index - 1)

		Canvas.Fill(UsagePosition - 1, Y, UsagePosition + UsageWidth + 1, Y + LineHeight, FillColor)
		Font.DrawFormatted(Line, UsagePosition, Y + 2, UsageColor, true)
	end
end

const function Draw(Width: number, Height: number, MouseX: number, MouseY: number)
	if Width ~= ScreenWidth or Height ~= ScreenHeight then
		Initial = EditBox.ValueString(Box())
		Init(Width, Height)
	end

	Canvas.Fill(2, Height - 14, Width - 2, Height - 2, BackgroundColor)
	ChatComponent.Draw(Width, Height, MouseX, MouseY)
	EditBox.Draw(Box())

	const Shown = List

	if Shown then
		DrawList(Shown, MouseX, MouseY)
	else
		DrawUsage()
	end
end

const function WantsTextInput(): boolean
	return Input ~= nil
end

return {
	Open = Open,
	Removed = Removed,
	Receive = Receive,
	KeyPressed = KeyPressed,
	CharTyped = CharTyped,
	MouseClicked = MouseClicked,
	MouseDragged = MouseDragged,
	MouseScrolled = MouseScrolled,
	Draw = Draw,
	WantsTextInput = WantsTextInput,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Chat"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const ChatComponent = require("./Gui/ChatComponent")
const Font = require("./Gui/Font")
const Text = require("./Gui/Text")

const DefaultColor = 0xFFFFFF
const Escapes = { ["&"] = "&amp;", ["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ['"'] = "&quot;", ["'"] = "&apos;" }
const Unescapes = { ["&amp;"] = "&", ["&lt;"] = "<", ["&gt;"] = ">", ["&quot;"] = '"', ["&apos;"] = "'" }
const GeneralChannel = "RBXGeneral"

local IsMinecraft = false

type Style = Font.Style

const function SameStyle(A: Style, B: Style): boolean
	return A.Color == B.Color and A.Bold == B.Bold and A.Italic == B.Italic and A.Underlined == B.Underlined and A.Strikethrough == B.Strikethrough
end

const function Wrap(Content: string, Style: Style): string
	local Result = (string.gsub(Content, "[&<>\"']", Escapes))

	if Style.Strikethrough then
		Result = `<s>{Result}</s>`
	end

	if Style.Underlined then
		Result = `<u>{Result}</u>`
	end

	if Style.Italic then
		Result = `<i>{Result}</i>`
	end

	if Style.Bold then
		Result = `<b>{Result}</b>`
	end

	return `<font color="#{string.format("%06X", Style.Color or DefaultColor)}">{Result}</font>`
end

const function RichText(Component: unknown): string
	const Run = Text.Flatten(Component, Font.PlainStyle)
	const Parts: { string } = {}
	local Start = 1

	for Index = 2, Run.Count + 1 do
		if Index > Run.Count or not SameStyle(Run.Styles[Index], Run.Styles[Start]) then
			table.insert(Parts, Wrap(utf8.char(table.unpack(Run.Codepoints, Start, Index - 1)), Run.Styles[Start]))
			Start = Index
		end
	end

	return table.concat(Parts)
end

const function Display(Message: string)
	const Channel = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels"):WaitForChild("RBXSystem") :: TextChannel

	Channel:DisplaySystemMessage(Message)
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId ~= Minecraft.Protocol.Clientbound.SystemChat then
		return false
	end

	const Message = Minecraft.Protocol.ReadSystemChat(Reader)

	if IsMinecraft then
		ChatComponent.AddMessage(Message, "System")
	else
		task.spawn(Display, RichText(Message))
	end

	return true
end

const function MessageReceived(Message: TextChatMessage)
	const Source = Message.TextSource
	const Channel = Message.TextChannel

	if not IsMinecraft or not Source or not Channel or Channel.Name ~= GeneralChannel or Message.Status ~= Enum.TextChatMessageStatus.Success then
		return
	end

	const Sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Source.UserId)
	const Name = if Sender then Sender.Name else Source.Name
	const Content = (string.gsub(Message.Text, "&%a+;", Unescapes))
	const Own = Sender == Players.LocalPlayer

	ChatComponent.AddMessage({ translate = "chat.type.text", with = { { text = Name }, { text = Content } } }, if Own then nil else "NotSecure")
end

const function Hide(Configuration: ChatInputBarConfiguration | ChatWindowConfiguration | nil, Hidden: boolean)
	if Configuration and Configuration.Enabled == Hidden then
		Configuration.Enabled = not Hidden
	end
end

const function SetMinecraft(Enabled: boolean)
	IsMinecraft = Enabled
	Hide(TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration"), Enabled)
	Hide(TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration"), Enabled)
end

const function Start()
	TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(MessageReceived)
end

return {
	Receive = Receive,
	SetMinecraft = SetMinecraft,
	Start = Start,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/ItemActivation"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Camera = require("./Camera")
const HeldItems = require("./HeldItems")
const ItemModels = require("./ItemModels")
const Players = require("./Players")
const Rendering = require("./Rendering")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const Shrink = 1 / 18
const Unit = Shrink * Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
const ItemSize = Mth.Float(0.8)
const AnimationLength = 40
const OffsetScale = Mth.Float(0.3)
const FarDepth = 10
const DepthSwing = 9
const SpinDegrees = 900
const WobbleDegrees = 6
const WobbleRate = 8
const SquashTolerance = 1.0E-4

const Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
const Holder = HeldItems.Create(Folder, ItemSize * Unit)
const ItemState = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const ItemContext: ItemModels.Context = { DisplayContext = "fixed", Holder = nil, Seed = 0 }
const Lights: Rendering.Lights = { Light0 = vector.zero, Light1 = vector.zero, Lightmap = vector.one }

Folder.Name = "MinecraftItemActivation"

const function Draw(Player: Players.PlayerEntity, Partial: number, Visible: boolean)
	const Item = Player.ActivationItem
	const Shown = Visible and Item ~= nil and Player.ActivationTicks > 0
	const Parent = if Shown then workspace else nil

	if Folder.Parent ~= Parent then
		Folder.Parent = Parent
	end

	if not Shown or not Item then
		return
	end

	const Viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	const Progress = Mth.Float((AnimationLength - Player.ActivationTicks + Partial) / AnimationLength)
	const Square = Progress * Progress
	const Cube = Progress * Square
	const Smooth = Mth.Float(10.25 * Cube * Square - 24.95 * Square * Square + 25.5 * Cube - 13.8 * Square + 4 * Progress)
	const Angle = Smooth * math.pi
	const Drift = math.abs(Mth.Sin(Angle * 2))
	const OffX = Player.ActivationOffX * OffsetScale * (Viewport.X / Viewport.Y)
	const OffY = Player.ActivationOffY * OffsetScale
	const Wobble = math.rad(WobbleDegrees * Mth.Cos(Progress * WobbleRate))
	const CameraFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	const Ratio = math.tan(math.rad(Camera.HudFieldOfView() / 2)) / math.tan(math.rad(workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView / 2))
	const Squash = if math.abs(Ratio - 1) < SquashTolerance then 1 else Ratio
	const Root = Camera.EyeFrame()
		* CFrame.new(OffX * Drift * Unit, OffY * Drift * Unit, (-FarDepth + DepthSwing * Mth.Sin(Angle)) * Unit)
		* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(SpinDegrees * math.abs(Mth.Sin(Angle))), 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(Wobble, 0, 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, Wobble)

	const Light0 = CameraFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Rendering.ItemLights.Block0)
	const Light1 = CameraFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Rendering.ItemLights.Block1)

	Lights.Light0 = vector.create(Light0.X, Light0.Y, Light0.Z)
	Lights.Light1 = vector.create(Light1.X, Light1.Y, Light1.Z)
	Lights.Lightmap = Rendering.SampleFullBrightLightmap()
	ItemModels.Resolve(ItemState, Item, ItemContext)
	HeldItems.Update(Holder, ItemState)
	HeldItems.DrawSquashed(Holder, Root, CameraFrame, Squash, Root, 1, true, Lights)
end

return {
	Draw = Draw,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Settings"] = function(require)

const SoundBank = "rbxtemp://204"

const Exposure = 1.25

return {
	SoundBank = SoundBank,
	Exposure = Exposure,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Sounds"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
const SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Data = require("@self/Data")
const Settings = require("./Settings")

const JavaRandom = Minecraft.JavaRandom
const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const MinimumPitch = 0.5
const MaximumPitch = 2
const SeedRange = 2 ^ 31
const InteractionGroup = "Minecraft"
const EndGrace = 5

type Entry = {
	Clip: number?,
	Event: string?,
	Volume: number,
	Pitch: number,
	Weight: number?,
	Attenuation: number?,
}

type Clip = {
	Start: number,
	Length: number,
}

type Payload = {
	Events: { [string]: { Entry } },
	Clips: { Clip },
}

type Voice = {
	Player: AudioPlayer,
	Attachment: Attachment,
	Emitter: AudioEmitter,
	Wire: Wire,
	Token: number,
	Active: boolean,
	Owner: Handle?,
}

export type Handle = {
	Voice: Voice,
	Token: number,
	EntityId: number?,
	Volume: number,
	Pitch: number,
	Attenuation: number,
}

const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
const Index = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: Payload
const Bound: { [Handle]: true } = {}
const Idle: { Voice } = {}
const Generator = Random.new()
const Output = Instance.new("AudioDeviceOutput")
const Listener = Instance.new("AudioListener")
const ListenerWire = Instance.new("Wire")

Output.Name = "MinecraftSounds"
Output.Parent = SoundService
Listener.Name = "MinecraftListener"
Listener.AudioInteractionGroup = InteractionGroup
Listener.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
ListenerWire.SourceInstance = Listener
ListenerWire.TargetInstance = Output
ListenerWire.Parent = Listener

workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
	Listener.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
end)

const function Weight(Event: string): number
	local Total = 0

	for _, Entry in Index.Events[Event] or {} do
		Total += if Entry.Event then Weight(Entry.Event) else Entry.Weight :: number
	end

	return Total
end

const function Choose(Event: string, Picker: Minecraft.JavaRandom): (Clip?, number, number, number)
	const Total = Weight(Event)

	if Total == 0 then
		return nil, 0, 0, 0
	end

	local Remaining = JavaRandom.NextInt(Picker, Total)

	for _, Entry in Index.Events[Event] do
		Remaining -= if Entry.Event then Weight(Entry.Event) else Entry.Weight :: number

		if Remaining < 0 then
			if Entry.Event then
				const Chosen, Volume, Pitch, Attenuation = Choose(Entry.Event, Picker)

				return Chosen, Volume * Entry.Volume, Pitch * Entry.Pitch, Attenuation
			end

			return Index.Clips[(Entry.Clip :: number) + 1], Entry.Volume, Entry.Pitch, Entry.Attenuation :: number
		end
	end

	return nil, 0, 0, 0
end

const function Release(Voice: Voice)
	if not Voice.Active then
		return
	end

	if Voice.Owner then
		Bound[Voice.Owner] = nil
		Voice.Owner = nil
	end

	Voice.Active = false
	Voice.Token += 1
	Voice.Player:Stop()
	table.insert(Idle, Voice)
end

const function Expire(Voice: Voice, Token: number)
	if Voice.Token == Token then
		Release(Voice)
	end
end

const function CreateVoice(): Voice
	const Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	const Emitter = Instance.new("AudioEmitter")
	const Player = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
	const Wire = Instance.new("Wire")

	Attachment.Name = "MinecraftSound"
	Attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	Emitter.AudioInteractionGroup = InteractionGroup
	Emitter.Parent = Attachment
	Player.Parent = Attachment
	Wire.SourceInstance = Player
	Wire.TargetInstance = Emitter
	Wire.Parent = Player

	const Created: Voice = { Player = Player, Attachment = Attachment, Emitter = Emitter, Wire = Wire, Token = 0, Active = false, Owner = nil }

	Player.Ended:Connect(function()
		if not Player.Looping and not Player.IsPlaying then
			Release(Created)
		end
	end)

	return Created
end

const function Attenuate(Voice: Voice, Distance: number)
	Voice.Emitter:SetDistanceAttenuation({ [0] = 1, [Distance] = 0 })
end

const function Current(Handle: Handle): Voice?
	const Voice = Handle.Voice

	return if Voice.Active and Voice.Token == Handle.Token then Voice else nil
end

const function Create(Event: string, Position: vector?, Volume: number, Pitch: number, Seed: number?, Looping: boolean): Handle?
	if Settings.SoundBank == "" or not Index.Events[Event] then
		return nil
	end

	const Clip, SoundVolume, SoundPitch, Attenuation = Choose(Event, JavaRandom.Create(Seed or Generator:NextInteger(0, SeedRange)))
	const InstanceVolume = Volume * SoundVolume
	const Gain = math.clamp(InstanceVolume, 0, 1)

	if not Clip or (Gain == 0 and not Looping) then
		return nil
	end

	const Voice = table.remove(Idle) or CreateVoice()
	const Player = Voice.Player
	const Region = NumberRange.new(Clip.Start, Clip.Start + Clip.Length)
	const Speed = math.clamp(Pitch * SoundPitch, MinimumPitch, MaximumPitch)

	if Player.Asset ~= Settings.SoundBank then
		Player.Asset = Settings.SoundBank
	end

	Player.PlaybackRegion = Region
	Player.LoopRegion = Region
	Player.Looping = Looping
	Player.PlaybackSpeed = Speed
	Player.Volume = Gain
	Player.TimePosition = Clip.Start

	if Position then
		Voice.Attachment.WorldPosition = Position * StudsPerBlock
		Attenuate(Voice, math.max(InstanceVolume, 1) * Attenuation * StudsPerBlock)
		Voice.Wire.TargetInstance = Voice.Emitter
	else
		Voice.Wire.TargetInstance = Output
	end

	Voice.Active = true
	Voice.Token += 1

	const Handle: Handle = { Voice = Voice, Token = Voice.Token, EntityId = nil, Volume = SoundVolume, Pitch = SoundPitch, Attenuation = Attenuation }

	Voice.Owner = Handle
	Player:Play()

	if not Looping then
		task.delay(Clip.Length / Speed + EndGrace, Expire, Voice, Voice.Token)
	end

	return Handle
end

const function Play(Event: string, Position: vector?, Volume: number, Pitch: number, Seed: number?, EntityId: number?)
	const Handle = Create(Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, Seed, false)

	if Handle and EntityId then
		Handle.EntityId = EntityId
		Bound[Handle] = true
	end
end

const function Start(Event: string, Position: vector?, Volume: number, Pitch: number): Handle?
	return Create(Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, nil, true)
end

const function Set(Handle: Handle, Position: vector?, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	const Voice = Current(Handle)

	if not Voice then
		return
	end

	const InstanceVolume = Volume * Handle.Volume

	Voice.Player.Volume = math.clamp(InstanceVolume, 0, 1)
	Voice.Player.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(Pitch * Handle.Pitch, MinimumPitch, MaximumPitch)

	if Position and Voice.Wire.TargetInstance == Voice.Emitter then
		Voice.Attachment.WorldPosition = Position * StudsPerBlock
		Attenuate(Voice, math.max(InstanceVolume, 1) * Handle.Attenuation * StudsPerBlock)
	end
end

const function Stop(Handle: Handle)
	const Voice = Current(Handle)

	if Voice then
		Release(Voice)
	end
end

export type Locator = (EntityId: number) -> vector?

const function Update(Locate: Locator)
	for Handle in Bound do
		const Voice = Current(Handle)
		const Position = Locate(Handle.EntityId :: number)

		if Voice and Position then
			Voice.Attachment.WorldPosition = Position * StudsPerBlock
		elseif Voice then
			Release(Voice)
		else
			Bound[Handle] = nil
		end
	end
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader, Locate: Locator): boolean
	if PacketId == Protocol.Clientbound.Sound then
		const Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, Seed = Protocol.ReadSound(Reader)

		Play(Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, Seed)
	elseif PacketId == Protocol.Clientbound.SoundEntity then
		const Event, EntityId, Volume, Pitch, Seed = Protocol.ReadSoundEntity(Reader)
		const Position = Locate(EntityId)

		if Position then
			Play(Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, Seed, EntityId)
		end
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

return {
	Play = Play,
	Start = Start,
	Set = Set,
	Stop = Stop,
	Update = Update,
	Receive = Receive,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Rendering = require("./Rendering")
const Settings = require("./Settings")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")
const Billboards = require("@self/Billboards")
const Fireworks = require("@self/Fireworks")
const Particle = require("@self/Particle")
const Providers = require("@self/Providers")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Clientbound = Protocol.Clientbound
const LevelEvents = Protocol.LevelEvents
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
const NextFloat = Particle.NextFloat
const NextGaussian = Particle.NextGaussian

const MaximumParticles = 16384
const CullDistanceSquared = 1024
const EmitterTries = 16
const DefaultEmitterLifetime = 3
const Diagonal = math.sqrt(2)
const SplashPotionItem = "minecraft:splash_potion"

type Particle = Particle.Particle
type ParticleOptions = Minecraft.ParticleOptions

export type Locator = (EntityId: number) -> (vector?, number, number)

type Emitter = {
	EntityId: number,
	Options: ParticleOptions,
	Life: number,
	Lifetime: number,
}

const Live: { Particle } = {}
const Queued: { Particle } = {}
const Emitters: { Emitter } = {}
const Survivors: { Particle } = {}
const SplashPotion = Minecraft.Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item(SplashPotionItem), 1)

const function CameraPosition(): vector
	const Frame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame

	return vector.create(Frame.X, Frame.Y, Frame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
end

const function AddParticle(Created: Particle)
	table.insert(Queued, Created)
end

const function Create(Options: ParticleOptions, Position: vector, Aux: vector)
	const Created = Providers.Create(Options, Position, Aux)

	if Created then
		AddParticle(Created)
	end
end

const function Add(Options: ParticleOptions, Position: vector, Aux: vector)
	const Offset = Position - CameraPosition()

	if vector.dot(Offset, Offset) > CullDistanceSquared then
		return
	end

	Create(Options, Position, Aux)
end

const function TickEmitter(Emitter: Emitter, Locate: Locator): boolean
	const Position, Width, Height = Locate(Emitter.EntityId)

	if not Position then
		return false
	end

	for _ = 1, EmitterTries do
		const X = NextFloat() * 2 - 1
		const Y = NextFloat() * 2 - 1
		const Z = NextFloat() * 2 - 1

		if X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z <= 1 then
			const Point = Position + vector.create(Width * (X / 4), Height * (0.5 + Y / 4), Width * (Z / 4))

			Add(Emitter.Options, Point, vector.create(X, Y + 0.2, Z))
		end
	end

	Emitter.Life += 1

	return Emitter.Life < Emitter.Lifetime
end

const function Emit(EntityId: number, Options: ParticleOptions, Lifetime: number?, Locate: Locator)
	const Emitter: Emitter = { EntityId = EntityId, Options = Options, Life = 0, Lifetime = Lifetime or DefaultEmitterLifetime }

	if TickEmitter(Emitter, Locate) then
		table.insert(Emitters, Emitter)
	end
end

const function Tick(Locate: Locator)
	table.clear(Survivors)

	for _, Ticking in Live do
		if Ticking.Kind == "Starter" then
			Fireworks.Tick(Ticking, AddParticle)
		else
			Providers.Tick(Ticking, Create, AddParticle)
		end

		if not Ticking.Removed then
			table.insert(Survivors, Ticking)
		end
	end

	table.clear(Live)

	for Index, Kept in Survivors do
		Live[Index] = Kept
	end

	local Index = 1

	while Index <= #Emitters do
		if TickEmitter(Emitters[Index], Locate) then
			Index += 1
		else
			table.remove(Emitters, Index)
		end
	end

	for _, Joining in Queued do
		if #Live >= MaximumParticles then
			table.remove(Live, 1)
		end

		table.insert(Live, Joining)
	end

	table.clear(Queued)
end

const function Draw(Partial: number)
	const Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	const Frame = Camera.CFrame
	const CameraAt = vector.create(Frame.X, Frame.Y, Frame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
	const Look = vector.create(Frame.LookVector.X, Frame.LookVector.Y, Frame.LookVector.Z)
	const Right = vector.create(Frame.RightVector.X, Frame.RightVector.Y, Frame.RightVector.Z)
	const Up = vector.create(Frame.UpVector.X, Frame.UpVector.Y, Frame.UpVector.Z)
	const Viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
	const VerticalTangent = math.tan(math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2))
	const HorizontalTangent = VerticalTangent * Viewport.X / math.max(Viewport.Y, 1)
	const Sky = vector.floor(Rendering.SampleLightmap() * 255 + vector.one * 0.5) / 255

	Billboards.Begin()

	for _, Drawn in Live do
		if not Drawn.Renders or not Providers.Visible(Drawn) then
			continue
		end

		const Center = Drawn.PositionO + (Drawn.Position - Drawn.PositionO) * Partial
		const Size = Providers.QuadSize(Drawn, Partial)
		const Offset = Center - CameraAt
		const Depth = vector.dot(Offset, Look)
		const Reach = Size * Diagonal

		if Depth < -Reach or math.abs(vector.dot(Offset, Right)) > Depth * HorizontalTangent + Reach or math.abs(vector.dot(Offset, Up)) > Depth * VerticalTangent + Reach then
			continue
		end

		const Roll = Drawn.RollO + (Drawn.Roll - Drawn.RollO) * Partial
		const Light = if Drawn.FullBright then vector.one else Sky

		Billboards.Draw(Drawn.Atlas, Drawn.Sprite, Drawn.U0, Drawn.U1, Drawn.V0, Drawn.V1, Center, Size, Roll, Drawn.Color * Light * Settings.Exposure, Providers.AlphaAt(Drawn, Partial))
	end

	Billboards.Finish()
end

const function RandomX(Position: vector, Width: number, Spread: number): number
	return Position.x + Width * ((2 * NextFloat() - 1) * Spread)
end

const function RandomZ(Position: vector, Width: number, Spread: number): number
	return Position.z + Width * ((2 * NextFloat() - 1) * Spread)
end

const function RandomY(Position: vector, Height: number): number
	return Position.y + Height * NextFloat()
end

const function Triangle(Mode: number, Deviation: number): number
	return Mode + Deviation * (NextFloat() - NextFloat())
end

const function RotateX(Value: vector, Angle: number): vector
	const Cosine = math.cos(Angle)
	const Sine = math.sin(Angle)

	return vector.create(Value.x, Value.y * Cosine + Value.z * Sine, Value.z * Cosine - Value.y * Sine)
end

const function RotateY(Value: vector, Angle: number): vector
	const Cosine = math.cos(Angle)
	const Sine = math.sin(Angle)

	return vector.create(Value.x * Cosine + Value.z * Sine, Value.y, Value.z * Cosine - Value.x * Sine)
end

const function Poof(Position: vector, Width: number, Height: number)
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		const Speed = vector.create(NextGaussian() * 0.02, NextGaussian() * 0.02, NextGaussian() * 0.02)
		const Point = vector.create(RandomX(Position, Width, 1), RandomY(Position, Height), RandomZ(Position, Width, 1)) - Speed * 10

		Add({ Type = "poof" }, Point, Speed)
	end
end

const function Drown(Position: vector, Motion: vector)
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		Add({ Type = "bubble" }, Position + vector.create(Triangle(0, 1), Triangle(0, 1), Triangle(0, 1)), Motion)
	end
end

const function ItemParticles(Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Count: number, Position: vector, EyeHeight: number, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	if Minecraft.Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	const Options: ParticleOptions = { Type = "item", Item = Stack }
	const Pitch = math.rad(-XRot)
	const Yaw = math.rad(-YRot)

	for _ = 1, Count do
		const Direction = RotateY(RotateX(vector.create((NextFloat() - 0.5) * 0.1, NextFloat() * 0.1 + 0.1, 0), Pitch), Yaw)
		const Lower = -NextFloat() * 0.6 - 0.3
		const Offset = RotateY(RotateX(vector.create((NextFloat() - 0.5) * 0.3, Lower, 0.6), Pitch), Yaw)

		Add(Options, Position + Offset + vector.create(0, EyeHeight, 0), Direction + vector.create(0, 0.05, 0))
	end
end

const function Splash(Position: vector, Width: number, Motion: vector)
	const Surface = Position.y // 1 + 1

	for _ = 1, math.ceil(1 + Width * 20) do
		const Point = vector.create(Position.x + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * Width, Surface, Position.z + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * Width)

		Add({ Type = "bubble" }, Point, vector.create(Motion.x, Motion.y - NextFloat() * 0.2, Motion.z))
	end

	for _ = 1, math.ceil(1 + Width * 20) do
		const Point = vector.create(Position.x + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * Width, Surface, Position.z + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * Width)

		Add({ Type = "splash" }, Point, Motion)
	end
end

const function Sprint(Position: vector, Width: number, Motion: vector, Block: string, Tint: vector?)
	const Point = vector.create(Position.x + (NextFloat() - 0.5) * Width, Position.y + 0.1, Position.z + (NextFloat() - 0.5) * Width)

	Add({ Type = "block", Block = Block, Color = Tint }, Point, vector.create(Motion.x * -4, 1.5, Motion.z * -4))
end

const function EffectSwirl(Position: vector, Width: number, Height: number, Swirls: { ParticleOptions }, Ambient: boolean, Invisible: boolean)
	if #Swirls == 0 then
		return
	end

	const Bound = (if Invisible then 15 else 4) * (if Ambient then 5 else 1)

	if Particle.NextInt(Bound) == 0 then
		const Point = vector.create(RandomX(Position, Width, 0.5), RandomY(Position, Height), RandomZ(Position, Width, 0.5))

		Add(Swirls[Particle.NextInt(#Swirls) + 1], Point, vector.one)
	end
end

const function ChorusTeleport(From: vector, To: vector, Width: number, Height: number)
	for Index = 0, 127 do
		const Along = Index / 127
		const Speed = vector.create(NextFloat() - 0.5, NextFloat() - 0.5, NextFloat() - 0.5) * 0.2
		const Base = From + (To - From) * Along
		const Point = vector.create(Base.x + (NextFloat() - 0.5) * Width * 2, Base.y + NextFloat() * Height, Base.z + (NextFloat() - 0.5) * Width * 2)

		Add({ Type = "portal" }, Point, Speed)
	end
end

const function CreateFireworks(Position: vector, Motion: vector, Explosions: { { [string]: unknown } }, PlaySound: boolean)
	Fireworks.Create(Position, Motion, Explosions, PlaySound, AddParticle)
end

const function PotionSplash(Type: string, BlockPosition: vector, Color: number)
	const Point = BlockPosition + vector.create(0.5, 0, 0.5)
	const Rgb = vector.create(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8)) / 255

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		Add({ Type = "item", Item = SplashPotion }, Point, vector.create(NextGaussian() * 0.15, NextFloat() * 0.2, NextGaussian() * 0.15))
	end

	for _ = 1, 100 do
		const Distance = NextFloat() * 4
		const Angle = NextFloat() * math.pi * 2
		const Speed = vector.create(math.cos(Angle) * Distance, 0.01 + NextFloat() * 0.5, math.sin(Angle) * Distance)
		const Brightness = 0.75 + NextFloat() * 0.25

		Add({ Type = Type, Color = Rgb * Brightness, Power = Distance }, Point + vector.create(Speed.x * 0.1, 0.3, Speed.z * 0.1), Speed)
	end
end

const function SmashAttack(BlockPosition: vector, Count: number, Block: string, Tint: vector?)
	const Center = BlockPosition + vector.create(0.5, 1, 0.5)
	const Options: ParticleOptions = { Type = "dust_pillar", Block = Block, Color = Tint }
	local Index = 0

	while Index < Count / 3 do
		const Point = vector.create(Center.x + NextGaussian() / 2, Center.y, Center.z + NextGaussian() / 2)

		Add(Options, Point, vector.create(NextGaussian() * 0.2, NextGaussian() * 0.2, NextGaussian() * 0.2))
		Index += 1
	end

	Index = 0

	while Index < Count / 1.5 do
		const Point = vector.create(Center.x + 3.5 * math.cos(Index) + NextGaussian() / 2, Center.y, Center.z + 3.5 * math.sin(Index) + NextGaussian() / 2)

		Add(Options, Point, vector.create(NextGaussian() * 0.05, NextGaussian() * 0.05, NextGaussian() * 0.05))
		Index += 1
	end
end

const function ReceiveLevelEvent(Event: number, Position: vector, Data: number)
	if Event == LevelEvents.SplashPotionSound or Event == LevelEvents.InstantSplashPotionSound then
		Sounds.Play("entity.splash_potion.break", Position + vector.one * 0.5, 1, NextFloat() * 0.1 + 0.9)
	elseif Event == LevelEvents.PotionSplash then
		PotionSplash("effect", Position, Data)
	elseif Event == LevelEvents.InstantPotionSplash then
		PotionSplash("instant_effect", Position, Data)
	elseif Event == LevelEvents.SmashAttack then
		const Block, Tint = Minecraft.Entity.BlockInCell(Position)

		if Block then
			SmashAttack(Position, Data, Block.Id, Tint)
		end
	end
end

const function Explode(Center: vector, Explosion: Minecraft.ParticleOptions, Sound: string)
	Sounds.Play(Sound, Center, 4, (1 + (NextFloat() - NextFloat()) * 0.2) * 0.7)
	Add(Explosion, Center, vector.create(1, 0, 0))
end

const function Receive(PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader, Locate: Locator): boolean
	if PacketId == Clientbound.LevelParticles then
		const Options, Position, Distance, MaxSpeed, Count = Protocol.ReadLevelParticles(Reader)

		if Count == 0 then
			Add(Options, Position, Distance * MaxSpeed)
		else
			for _ = 1, Count do
				const Spread = vector.create(NextGaussian() * Distance.x, NextGaussian() * Distance.y, NextGaussian() * Distance.z)
				const Speed = vector.create(NextGaussian(), NextGaussian(), NextGaussian()) * MaxSpeed

				Add(Options, Position + Spread, Speed)
			end
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.Animate then
		const EntityId, Action = Protocol.ReadAnimate(Reader)

		if Action == Protocol.AnimateActions.CriticalHit then
			Emit(EntityId, { Type = "crit" }, nil, Locate)
		elseif Action == Protocol.AnimateActions.MagicCriticalHit then
			Emit(EntityId, { Type = "enchanted_hit" }, nil, Locate)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.LevelEvent then
		ReceiveLevelEvent(Protocol.ReadLevelEvent(Reader))
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

return {
	Add = Add,
	Emit = Emit,
	Tick = Tick,
	Draw = Draw,
	Receive = Receive,
	Explode = Explode,
	Poof = Poof,
	Drown = Drown,
	ItemParticles = ItemParticles,
	Splash = Splash,
	Sprint = Sprint,
	EffectSwirl = EffectSwirl,
	ChorusTeleport = ChorusTeleport,
	CreateFireworks = CreateFireworks,
	SetScopingEye = Providers.SetScopingEye,
	NextGaussian = NextGaussian,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles/Data"] = function(require)

return {
	Sprites = {
		crit = {
			"minecraft:critical_hit",
		},
		enchanted_hit = {
			"minecraft:enchanted_hit",
		},
		damage_indicator = {
			"minecraft:damage",
		},
		sweep_attack = {
			"minecraft:sweep_0",
			"minecraft:sweep_1",
			"minecraft:sweep_2",
			"minecraft:sweep_3",
			"minecraft:sweep_4",
			"minecraft:sweep_5",
			"minecraft:sweep_6",
			"minecraft:sweep_7",
		},
		effect = {
			"minecraft:effect_7",
			"minecraft:effect_6",
			"minecraft:effect_5",
			"minecraft:effect_4",
			"minecraft:effect_3",
			"minecraft:effect_2",
			"minecraft:effect_1",
			"minecraft:effect_0",
		},
		entity_effect = {
			"minecraft:effect_7",
			"minecraft:effect_6",
			"minecraft:effect_5",
			"minecraft:effect_4",
			"minecraft:effect_3",
