_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles/Fireworks"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Sounds = require("../Sounds")
const Particle = require("./Particle")
const Providers = require("./Providers")

const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
const NextFloat = Particle.NextFloat
const NextInt = Particle.NextInt
const NextGaussian = Particle.NextGaussian

const BlackFireworkColor = 1973019
const FarDistanceSquared = 256
const SoundSpeed = 40

const CreeperCoordinates = {
	{ 0, 0.2 }, { 0.2, 0.2 }, { 0.2, 0.6 }, { 0.6, 0.6 }, { 0.6, 0.2 }, { 0.2, 0.2 }, { 0.2, 0 }, { 0.4, 0 }, { 0.4, -0.6 }, { 0.2, -0.6 }, { 0.2, -0.4 }, { 0, -0.4 },
}

const StarCoordinates = {
	{ 0, 1 },
	{ 0.3455, 0.309 },
	{ 0.9511, 0.309 },
	{ 0.3795918367346939, -0.12653061224489795 },
	{ 0.6122448979591837, -0.8040816326530612 },
	{ 0, -0.35918367346938773 },
}

type Particle = Particle.Particle
type Explosion = { [string]: unknown }

export type Adder = (Created: Particle) -> ()

const function CameraPosition(): vector
	const Frame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame

	return vector.create(Frame.X, Frame.Y, Frame.Z) / StudsPerBlock
end

const function PlayDelayed(Event: string, Position: vector, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	const Delay = vector.magnitude(Position - CameraPosition()) / SoundSpeed

	task.delay(Delay, Sounds.Play, Event, Position, Volume, Pitch)
end

const function IsFarFromCamera(Position: vector): boolean
	const Offset = Position - CameraPosition()

	return vector.dot(Offset, Offset) >= FarDistanceSquared
end

const function Rgb(Color: number): vector
	return vector.create(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8)) / 255
end

const function RandomOf(List: { number }): number
	return List[NextInt(#List) + 1]
end

const function CreateSpark(Add: Adder, Position: vector, Motion: vector, Colors: { number }, FadeColors: { number }, Trail: boolean, Twinkle: boolean)
	const Created = Providers.Create({ Type = "firework" }, Position, Motion)

	if not Created then
		return
	end

	Created.Trail = Trail
	Created.Twinkle = Twinkle
	Created.Alpha = 0.99
	Created.Color = Rgb(RandomOf(Colors))

	if #FadeColors > 0 then
		Created.Fade = Rgb(RandomOf(FadeColors))
	end

	Add(Created)
end

const function Ball(Starter: Particle, Add: Adder, BaseSpeed: number, Steps: number, Colors: { number }, FadeColors: { number }, Trail: boolean, Twinkle: boolean)
	for YStep = -Steps, Steps do
		for XStep = -Steps, Steps do
			local ZStep = -Steps

			while ZStep <= Steps do
				const X = XStep + (NextFloat() - NextFloat()) * 0.5
				const Y = YStep + (NextFloat() - NextFloat()) * 0.5
				const Z = ZStep + (NextFloat() - NextFloat()) * 0.5
				const Length = math.sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z) / BaseSpeed + NextGaussian() * 0.05

				CreateSpark(Add, Starter.Position, vector.create(X, Y, Z) / Length, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)

				if YStep ~= -Steps and YStep ~= Steps and XStep ~= -Steps and XStep ~= Steps then
					ZStep += Steps * 2 - 1
				end

				ZStep += 1
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Shape(Starter: Particle, Add: Adder, BaseSpeed: number, Coordinates: { { number } }, Colors: { number }, FadeColors: { number }, Trail: boolean, Twinkle: boolean, Flat: boolean)
	const StartX = Coordinates[1][1]
	const StartY = Coordinates[1][2]

	CreateSpark(Add, Starter.Position, vector.create(StartX * BaseSpeed, StartY * BaseSpeed, 0), Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)

	const BaseAngle = NextFloat() * math.pi
	const AngleStep = if Flat then 0.034 else 0.34

	for Step = 0, 2 do
		const Angle = BaseAngle + Step * math.pi * AngleStep
		local FromX = StartX
		local FromY = StartY

		for Index = 2, #Coordinates do
			const ToX = Coordinates[Index][1]
			const ToY = Coordinates[Index][2]

			for SubStep = 0.25, 1, 0.25 do
				const Along = (FromX + (ToX - FromX) * SubStep) * BaseSpeed
				const Up = (FromY + (ToY - FromY) * SubStep) * BaseSpeed
				const Depth = Along * math.sin(Angle)
				const Across = Along * math.cos(Angle)

				for Flip = -1, 1, 2 do
					CreateSpark(Add, Starter.Position, vector.create(Across * Flip, Up, Depth * Flip), Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)
				end
			end

			FromX = ToX
			FromY = ToY
		end
	end
end

const function Burst(Starter: Particle, Add: Adder, Colors: { number }, FadeColors: { number }, Trail: boolean, Twinkle: boolean)
	const OffsetX = NextGaussian() * 0.05
	const OffsetZ = NextGaussian() * 0.05
	const Motion = Starter.Delta

	for _ = 1, 70 do
		const X = Motion.x * 0.5 + NextGaussian() * 0.15 + OffsetX
		const Z = Motion.z * 0.5 + NextGaussian() * 0.15 + OffsetZ
		const Y = Motion.y * 0.5 + NextFloat() * 0.5

		CreateSpark(Add, Starter.Position, vector.create(X, Y, Z), Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)
	end
end

const function Create(Position: vector, Motion: vector, Explosions: { Explosion }, PlaySound: boolean, Add: Adder)
	if #Explosions == 0 then
		local Index = 0

		while Index < NextInt(3) + 2 do
			const Created = Providers.Create({ Type = "poof" }, Position, vector.create(NextGaussian() * 0.05, 0.005, NextGaussian() * 0.05))

			if Created then
				Add(Created)
			end

			Index += 1
		end

		return
	end

	const Starter = Particle.Create("Starter", Position)

	Starter.Delta = Motion
	Starter.Explosions = Explosions
	Starter.PlaySound = PlaySound
	Starter.Lifetime = #Explosions * 2 - 1

	for _, Explosion in Explosions do
		if Explosion.has_twinkle == true then
			Starter.TwinkleDelay = true
			Starter.Lifetime += 15
			break
		end
	end

	Add(Starter)
end

const function Tick(Starter: Particle, Add: Adder)
	const Explosions = Starter.Explosions :: { Explosion }

	if Starter.Life == 0 and Starter.PlaySound then
		const Far = IsFarFromCamera(Starter.Position)
		local Large = #Explosions >= 3

		for _, Explosion in Explosions do
			if Explosion.shape == "large_ball" then
				Large = true
			end
		end

		const Event = if Large then (if Far then "entity.firework_rocket.large_blast_far" else "entity.firework_rocket.large_blast")
			else (if Far then "entity.firework_rocket.blast_far" else "entity.firework_rocket.blast")

		PlayDelayed(Event, Starter.Position, 20, 0.95 + NextFloat() * 0.1)
	end

	if Starter.Life % 2 == 0 and Starter.Life // 2 < #Explosions then
		const Explosion = Explosions[Starter.Life // 2 + 1]
		const Trail = Explosion.has_trail == true
		const Twinkle = Explosion.has_twinkle == true
		const Listed = (Explosion.colors or {}) :: { number }
		const Colors = if #Listed == 0 then { BlackFireworkColor } else Listed
		const FadeColors = (Explosion.fade_colors or {}) :: { number }
		const Kind = Explosion.shape

		if Kind == "small_ball" then
			Ball(Starter, Add, 0.25, 2, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)
		elseif Kind == "large_ball" then
			Ball(Starter, Add, 0.5, 4, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)
		elseif Kind == "star" then
			Shape(Starter, Add, 0.5, StarCoordinates, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle, false)
		elseif Kind == "creeper" then
			Shape(Starter, Add, 0.5, CreeperCoordinates, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle, true)
		elseif Kind == "burst" then
			Burst(Starter, Add, Colors, FadeColors, Trail, Twinkle)
		end

		const Flash = Providers.Create({ Type = "flash", Color = Rgb(Colors[1]), Alpha = bit32.extract(Colors[1], 24, 8) / 255 }, Starter.Position, vector.zero)

		if Flash then
			Add(Flash)
		end
	end

	Starter.Life += 1

	if Starter.Life > Starter.Lifetime then
		if Starter.TwinkleDelay and Starter.PlaySound then
			const Far = IsFarFromCamera(Starter.Position)

			PlayDelayed(if Far then "entity.firework_rocket.twinkle_far" else "entity.firework_rocket.twinkle", Starter.Position, 20, 0.9 + NextFloat() * 0.15)
		end

		Starter.Removed = true
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles/Particle"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Data = require("./Data")

const Collision = Minecraft.Collision

const MaximumCollisionVelocitySquared = 100 * 100
const BlockedThreshold = 1.0E-5

export type AtlasName = "particles" | "blocks" | "items"

export type Kind =
	"Crit"
	| "Sweep"
	| "Item"
	| "Terrain"
	| "Spell"
	| "Totem"
	| "Bubble"
	| "WaterDrop"
	| "Explode"
	| "Portal"
	| "Gust"
	| "GustSeed"
	| "Spark"
	| "Flash"
	| "Starter"
	| "Emitter"

export type Particle = {
	Kind: Kind,
	Position: vector,
	PositionO: vector,
	Delta: vector,
	Min: vector,
	Max: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	HasPhysics: boolean,
	StoppedByCollision: boolean,
	Removed: boolean,
	Age: number,
	Lifetime: number,
	Gravity: number,
	Friction: number,
	SpeedUpWhenYMotionIsBlocked: boolean,

	Renders: boolean,
	QuadSize: number,
	Color: vector,
	Alpha: number,
	Roll: number,
	RollO: number,
	Atlas: AtlasName,
	Sprite: string,
	Sprites: { string }?,
	U0: number,
	U1: number,
	V0: number,
	V1: number,
	FullBright: boolean,

	OriginalAlpha: number,
	Fade: vector?,
	Trail: boolean,
	Twinkle: boolean,
	Start: vector,
	Scale: number,
	Delay: number,
	Explosions: { { [string]: unknown } }?,
	PlaySound: boolean,
	TwinkleDelay: boolean,
	Life: number,
	EntityId: number,
	Options: Minecraft.ParticleOptions?,

}

const Generator = Random.new()

const function NextFloat(): number
	return Generator:NextNumber()
end

const function NextInt(Bound: number): number
	return Generator:NextInteger(0, Bound - 1)
end

const function NextGaussian(): number
	return math.sqrt(-2 * math.log(1 - Generator:NextNumber())) * math.cos(2 * math.pi * Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function SetBox(Particle: Particle)
	const Half = Particle.Width / 2
	const Position = Particle.Position

	Particle.Min = vector.create(Position.x - Half, Position.y, Position.z - Half)
	Particle.Max = vector.create(Position.x + Half, Position.y + Particle.Height, Position.z + Half)
end

const function SetSize(Particle: Particle, Width: number, Height: number)
	if Width == Particle.Width and Height == Particle.Height then
		return
	end

	const CenterX = (Particle.Min.x + Particle.Max.x) / 2
	const CenterZ = (Particle.Min.z + Particle.Max.z) / 2

	Particle.Width = Width
	Particle.Height = Height
	Particle.Min = vector.create(CenterX - Width / 2, Particle.Min.y, CenterZ - Width / 2)
	Particle.Max = vector.create(CenterX + Width / 2, Particle.Min.y + Height, CenterZ + Width / 2)
end

const function Create(Kind: Kind, Position: vector): Particle
	const Created: Particle = {
		Kind = Kind,
		Position = Position,
		PositionO = Position,
		Delta = vector.zero,
		Min = Position,
		Max = Position,
		Width = 0.2,
		Height = 0.2,
		OnGround = false,
		HasPhysics = true,
		StoppedByCollision = false,
		Removed = false,
		Age = 0,
		Lifetime = 4 / (NextFloat() * 0.9 + 0.1) // 1,
		Gravity = 0,
		Friction = 0.98,
		SpeedUpWhenYMotionIsBlocked = false,

		Renders = false,
		QuadSize = 0,
		Color = vector.one,
		Alpha = 1,
		Roll = 0,
		RollO = 0,
		Atlas = "particles",
		Sprite = "",
		Sprites = nil,
		U0 = 0,
		U1 = 1,
		V0 = 0,
		V1 = 1,
		FullBright = false,

		OriginalAlpha = 1,
		Fade = nil,
		Trail = false,
		Twinkle = false,
		Start = Position,
		Scale = 1,
		Delay = 0,
		Explosions = nil,
		PlaySound = false,
		TwinkleDelay = false,
		Life = 0,
		EntityId = 0,
		Options = nil,

	}

	SetBox(Created)

	return Created
end

const function CreateMoving(Kind: Kind, Position: vector, Direction: vector): Particle
	const Created = Create(Kind, Position)
	const Spread = vector.create(
		Direction.x + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.4,
		Direction.y + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.4,
		Direction.z + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.4
	)
	const Speed = (NextFloat() + NextFloat() + 1) * 0.15
	const Scaled = Spread / vector.magnitude(Spread) * Speed * 0.4

	Created.Delta = Scaled + vector.create(0, 0.1, 0)

	return Created
end

const function Quad(Particle: Particle, Atlas: AtlasName, Sprite: string): Particle
	Particle.Renders = true
	Particle.Atlas = Atlas
	Particle.Sprite = Sprite
	Particle.QuadSize = 0.1 * (NextFloat() * 0.5 + 0.5) * 2

	return Particle
end

const function SpriteSet(Type: string): { string }
	return Data.Sprites[Type]
end

const function Pick(Sprites: { string }): string
	return Sprites[NextInt(#Sprites) + 1]
end

const function SpriteFromAge(Particle: Particle)
	const Sprites = Particle.Sprites

	if Sprites and not Particle.Removed then
		Particle.Sprite = Sprites[math.clamp(Particle.Age * (#Sprites - 1) // Particle.Lifetime, 0, #Sprites - 1) + 1]
	end
end

const function Scale(Particle: Particle, Factor: number)
	Particle.QuadSize *= Factor
	SetSize(Particle, 0.2 * Factor, 0.2 * Factor)
end

const function SetPower(Particle: Particle, Power: number)
	const Delta = Particle.Delta

	Particle.Delta = vector.create(Delta.x * Power, (Delta.y - 0.1) * Power + 0.1, Delta.z * Power)
end

const function Move(Particle: Particle, Requested: vector)
	if Particle.StoppedByCollision then
		return
	end

	local Movement = Requested

	if Particle.HasPhysics and Movement ~= vector.zero and vector.dot(Movement, Movement) < MaximumCollisionVelocitySquared then
		const Min = Particle.Min
		const Max = Particle.Max

		Movement = Collision.CollideWithShapes(Movement, Min, Max, Collision.Gather(vector.min(Min, Min + Movement), vector.max(Max, Max + Movement)))
	end

	if Movement ~= vector.zero then
		Particle.Min += Movement
		Particle.Max += Movement
		Particle.Position = vector.create((Particle.Min.x + Particle.Max.x) / 2, Particle.Min.y, (Particle.Min.z + Particle.Max.z) / 2)
	end

	if math.abs(Requested.y) >= BlockedThreshold and math.abs(Movement.y) < BlockedThreshold then
		Particle.StoppedByCollision = true
	end

	Particle.OnGround = Requested.y ~= Movement.y and Requested.y < 0

	const Delta = Particle.Delta

	Particle.Delta = vector.create(if Requested.x ~= Movement.x then 0 else Delta.x, Delta.y, if Requested.z ~= Movement.z then 0 else Delta.z)
end

const function Tick(Particle: Particle)
	Particle.PositionO = Particle.Position

	if Particle.Age >= Particle.Lifetime then
		Particle.Age += 1
		Particle.Removed = true

		return
	end

	Particle.Age += 1
	Particle.Delta -= vector.create(0, 0.04 * Particle.Gravity, 0)

	const Before = Particle.Position.y

	Move(Particle, Particle.Delta)

	if Particle.SpeedUpWhenYMotionIsBlocked and Particle.Position.y == Before then
		Particle.Delta *= vector.create(1.1, 1, 1.1)
	end

	Particle.Delta *= Particle.Friction

	if Particle.OnGround then
		Particle.Delta *= vector.create(0.7, 1, 0.7)
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	CreateMoving = CreateMoving,
	Quad = Quad,
	SpriteSet = SpriteSet,
	Pick = Pick,
	SpriteFromAge = SpriteFromAge,
	SetSize = SetSize,
	Scale = Scale,
	SetPower = SetPower,
	Move = Move,
	Tick = Tick,
	NextFloat = NextFloat,
	NextInt = NextInt,
	NextGaussian = NextGaussian,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles/Providers"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const ItemModels = require("../ItemModels")
const Data = require("./Data")
const Particle = require("./Particle")

const Collision = Minecraft.Collision
const EntityPhysics = Minecraft.Entity
const NextFloat = Particle.NextFloat
const NextInt = Particle.NextInt
const NextGaussian = Particle.NextGaussian

const ScopingDistanceSquared = 9
const MissingItemSprite = "minecraft:missingno"
const PointExtent = vector.one * 1.0E-4

type Particle = Particle.Particle
type ParticleOptions = Minecraft.ParticleOptions

export type Spawner = (Options: ParticleOptions, Position: vector, Aux: vector) -> ()
export type Adder = (Created: Particle) -> ()

const RenderState = ItemModels.CreateRenderState()
const GroundContext: ItemModels.Context = { DisplayContext = "ground", Holder = nil, Seed = 0 }
const Picker = Random.new()
const Snowball = Minecraft.Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item("minecraft:snowball"), 1)

local ScopingEye: vector? = nil

const function SetScopingEye(Eye: vector?)
	ScopingEye = Eye
end

const function CloseToScopingPlayer(Created: Particle): boolean
	const Eye = ScopingEye

	if not Eye then
		return false
	end

	const Offset = Created.Position - Eye

	return vector.dot(Offset, Offset) <= ScopingDistanceSquared
end

const function QuarterRegion(Created: Particle)
	const UOffset = NextFloat() * 3
	const VOffset = NextFloat() * 3

	Created.U0 = (UOffset + 1) / 4
	Created.U1 = UOffset / 4
	Created.V0 = VOffset / 4
	Created.V1 = (VOffset + 1) / 4
end

const function Crit(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("Crit", Position, vector.zero), "particles", "")
	const Gray = NextFloat() * 0.3 + 0.6

	Created.Friction = 0.7
	Created.Gravity = 0.5
	Created.Delta = Created.Delta * 0.1 + Aux * 0.4
	Created.Color = vector.one * Gray
	Created.QuadSize *= 0.75
	Created.Lifetime = math.max(6 / (NextFloat() * 0.8 + 0.6) // 1, 1)
	Created.HasPhysics = false

	return Created
end

const function TickCrit(Created: Particle)
	Particle.Tick(Created)
	Created.Color *= vector.create(1, 0.96, 0.9)
end

const function ItemSprite(Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): { string }
	ItemModels.Resolve(RenderState, Stack, GroundContext)

	return ItemModels.ParticleSprite(RenderState, Picker) or { "items", MissingItemSprite }
end

const function BreakingItem(Position: vector, Sprite: { string }): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("Item", Position, vector.zero), Sprite[1] :: Particle.AtlasName, Sprite[2])

	Created.Gravity = 1
	Created.QuadSize /= 2
	QuarterRegion(Created)

	return Created
end

const function Terrain(Position: vector, Aux: vector, Block: string?, Tint: vector?): Particle?
	const Sprite = if Block then Data.Blocks[Block] else nil

	if not Sprite then
		return nil
	end

	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("Terrain", Position, Aux), "blocks", Sprite)

	Created.Gravity = 1
	Created.Color = (Tint or vector.one) * 0.6
	Created.QuadSize /= 2
	QuarterRegion(Created)

	return Created
end

const function Spell(Position: vector, Aux: vector, Type: string): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("Spell", Position, vector.create(0.5 - NextFloat(), Aux.y, 0.5 - NextFloat())), "particles", "")
	const Delta = Created.Delta

	Created.Friction = 0.96
	Created.Gravity = -0.1
	Created.SpeedUpWhenYMotionIsBlocked = true
	Created.Sprites = Particle.SpriteSet(Type)
	Created.Delta = if Aux.x == 0 and Aux.z == 0 then vector.create(Delta.x * 0.1, Delta.y * 0.2, Delta.z * 0.1) else vector.create(Delta.x, Delta.y * 0.2, Delta.z)
	Created.QuadSize *= 0.75
	Created.Lifetime = 8 / (NextFloat() * 0.8 + 0.2) // 1
	Created.HasPhysics = false
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	if CloseToScopingPlayer(Created) then
		Created.Alpha = 0
		Created.OriginalAlpha = 0
	end

	return Created
end

const function SetSpellAlpha(Created: Particle, Alpha: number)
	Created.Alpha = Alpha
	Created.OriginalAlpha = Alpha
end

const function TickSpell(Created: Particle)
	Particle.Tick(Created)
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	if CloseToScopingPlayer(Created) then
		Created.Alpha = 0
	else
		Created.Alpha += (Created.OriginalAlpha - Created.Alpha) * 0.05
	end
end

const function SimpleAnimated(Kind: Particle.Kind, Position: vector, Type: string, Gravity: number): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create(Kind, Position), "particles", "")

	Created.Friction = 0.91
	Created.Gravity = Gravity
	Created.Sprites = Particle.SpriteSet(Type)
	Created.FullBright = true

	return Created
end

const function TickSimpleAnimated(Created: Particle)
	Particle.Tick(Created)
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	if Created.Age > Created.Lifetime // 2 then
		Created.Alpha = 1 - (Created.Age - Created.Lifetime // 2) / Created.Lifetime

		const Fade = Created.Fade

		if Fade then
			Created.Color += (Fade - Created.Color) * 0.2
		end
	end
end

const function Totem(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = SimpleAnimated("Totem", Position, "totem_of_undying", 1.25)

	Created.Friction = 0.6
	Created.Delta = Aux
	Created.QuadSize *= 0.75
	Created.Lifetime = 60 + NextInt(12)
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	if NextInt(4) == 0 then
		Created.Color = vector.create(0.6 + NextFloat() * 0.2, 0.6 + NextFloat() * 0.3, NextFloat() * 0.2)
	else
		Created.Color = vector.create(0.1 + NextFloat() * 0.2, 0.4 + NextFloat() * 0.3, NextFloat() * 0.2)
	end

	return Created
end

const function Spark(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = SimpleAnimated("Spark", Position, "firework", 0.1)

	Created.Delta = Aux
	Created.QuadSize *= 0.75
	Created.Lifetime = 48 + NextInt(12)
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	return Created
end

const function TickSpark(Created: Particle, Add: Adder)
	TickSimpleAnimated(Created)

	if Created.Trail and Created.Age < Created.Lifetime // 2 and (Created.Age + Created.Lifetime) % 2 == 0 then
		const Trailing = Spark(Created.Position, vector.zero)

		Trailing.Alpha = 0.99
		Trailing.Color = Created.Color
		Trailing.Age = Trailing.Lifetime // 2
		Trailing.Twinkle = Created.Twinkle
		Add(Trailing)
	end
end

const function Bubble(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create("Bubble", Position), "particles", Particle.Pick(Particle.SpriteSet("bubble")))

	Particle.SetSize(Created, 0.02, 0.02)
	Created.QuadSize *= NextFloat() * 0.6 + 0.2
	Created.Delta = vector.create(
		Aux.x * 0.2 + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.02,
		Aux.y * 0.2 + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.02,
		Aux.z * 0.2 + (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.02
	)
	Created.Lifetime = 8 / (NextFloat() * 0.8 + 0.2) // 1

	return Created
end

const function TickBubble(Created: Particle)
	Created.PositionO = Created.Position

	if Created.Lifetime <= 0 then
		Created.Lifetime -= 1
		Created.Removed = true

		return
	end

	Created.Lifetime -= 1
	Created.Delta += vector.create(0, 0.002, 0)
	Particle.Move(Created, Created.Delta)
	Created.Delta *= 0.85

	if EntityPhysics.FluidAt(Created.Position) ~= "Water" then
		Created.Removed = true
	end
end

const function Splash(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("WaterDrop", Position, vector.zero), "particles", Particle.Pick(Particle.SpriteSet("splash")))
	const Delta = Created.Delta

	Created.Delta = vector.create(Delta.x * 0.3, NextFloat() * 0.2 + 0.1, Delta.z * 0.3)
	Particle.SetSize(Created, 0.01, 0.01)
	Created.Gravity = 0.04
	Created.Lifetime = 8 / (NextFloat() * 0.8 + 0.2) // 1

	if Aux.y == 0 and (Aux.x ~= 0 or Aux.z ~= 0) then
		Created.Delta = vector.create(Aux.x, 0.1, Aux.z)
	end

	return Created
end

const function TickWaterDrop(Created: Particle)
	Created.PositionO = Created.Position

	if Created.Lifetime <= 0 then
		Created.Lifetime -= 1
		Created.Removed = true

		return
	end

	Created.Lifetime -= 1
	Created.Delta -= vector.create(0, Created.Gravity, 0)
	Particle.Move(Created, Created.Delta)
	Created.Delta *= 0.98

	if Created.OnGround then
		if NextFloat() < 0.5 then
			Created.Removed = true
		end

		Created.Delta *= vector.create(0.7, 1, 0.7)
	end

	const Point = Created.Position

	if not Collision.NoCollision(Point - PointExtent, Point + PointExtent) or EntityPhysics.FluidAt(Point) ~= nil then
		Created.Removed = true
	end
end

const function Explode(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create("Explode", Position), "particles", "")
	const Gray = NextFloat() * 0.3 + 0.7

	Created.Sprites = Particle.SpriteSet("poof")
	Created.Gravity = -0.1
	Created.Friction = 0.9
	Created.Delta = Aux + vector.create((NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.05, (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.05, (NextFloat() * 2 - 1) * 0.05)
	Created.Color = vector.one * Gray
	Created.QuadSize = 0.1 * (NextFloat() * NextFloat() * 6 + 1)
	Created.Lifetime = 16 / (NextFloat() * 0.8 + 0.2) // 1 + 2
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	return Created
end

const function Portal(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create("Portal", Position), "particles", Particle.Pick(Particle.SpriteSet("portal")))
	const Brightness = NextFloat() * 0.6 + 0.4

	Created.Delta = Aux
	Created.Start = Position
	Created.QuadSize = 0.1 * (NextFloat() * 0.2 + 0.5)
	Created.Color = vector.create(Brightness * 0.9, Brightness * 0.3, Brightness)
	Created.Lifetime = NextFloat() * 10 // 1 + 40

	return Created
end

const function TickPortal(Created: Particle)
	Created.PositionO = Created.Position

	if Created.Age >= Created.Lifetime then
		Created.Age += 1
		Created.Removed = true

		return
	end

	Created.Age += 1

	const Progress = Created.Age / Created.Lifetime
	const Along = 1 - (-Progress + Progress * Progress * 2)

	Created.Position = Created.Start + Created.Delta * Along + vector.create(0, 1 - Progress, 0)
end

const function Gust(Position: vector, Small: boolean): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create("Gust", Position), "particles", "")

	Created.Sprites = Particle.SpriteSet(if Small then "small_gust" else "gust")
	Created.Lifetime = 12 + NextInt(4)
	Created.QuadSize = 1
	Particle.SetSize(Created, 1, 1)
	Created.FullBright = true
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	if Small then
		Particle.Scale(Created, 0.15)
	end

	return Created
end

const function TickAnimatedInPlace(Created: Particle)
	Created.PositionO = Created.Position

	if Created.Age >= Created.Lifetime then
		Created.Age += 1
		Created.Removed = true

		return
	end

	Created.Age += 1
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)
end

const function GustSeed(Position: vector, Scale: number, Lifetime: number, Delay: number): Particle
	const Created = Particle.CreateMoving("GustSeed", Position, vector.zero)

	Created.Scale = Scale
	Created.Lifetime = Lifetime
	Created.Delay = Delay

	return Created
end

const function TickGustSeed(Created: Particle, Spawn: Spawner)
	if Created.Age % (Created.Delay + 1) == 0 then
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			const Offset = vector.create(NextFloat() - NextFloat(), NextFloat() - NextFloat(), NextFloat() - NextFloat()) * Created.Scale

			Spawn({ Type = "gust" }, Created.Position + Offset, vector.create(Created.Age / Created.Lifetime, 0, 0))
		end
	end

	if Created.Age == Created.Lifetime then
		Created.Removed = true
	end

	Created.Age += 1
end

const function Flash(Position: vector, Options: ParticleOptions): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.Create("Flash", Position), "particles", Particle.Pick(Particle.SpriteSet("flash")))

	Created.Lifetime = 4
	Created.Color = Options.Color or vector.one
	Created.Alpha = Options.Alpha or 1

	return Created
end

const function Sweep(Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle
	const Created = Particle.Quad(Particle.CreateMoving("Sweep", Position, vector.zero), "particles", "")
	const Gray = NextFloat() * 0.6 + 0.4

	Created.Sprites = Particle.SpriteSet("sweep_attack")
	Created.Lifetime = 4
	Created.Color = vector.one * Gray
	Created.QuadSize = 1 - Aux.x * 0.5
	Created.FullBright = true
	Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)

	return Created
end

const function Create(Options: ParticleOptions, Position: vector, Aux: vector): Particle?
	const Type = Options.Type

	if Type == "crit" or Type == "enchanted_hit" or Type == "damage_indicator" then
		const Created = Crit(Position, if Type == "damage_indicator" then Aux + vector.create(0, 1, 0) else Aux)

		Created.Sprite = Particle.Pick(Particle.SpriteSet(Type))
		TickCrit(Created)

		if Type == "damage_indicator" then
			Created.Lifetime = 20
		elseif Type == "enchanted_hit" then
			Created.Color *= vector.create(0.3, 0.8, 1)
		end

		return Created
	elseif Type == "sweep_attack" then
		return Sweep(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "item" then
		const Created = BreakingItem(Position, ItemSprite(Options.Item or Minecraft.Items.Empty))

		Created.Delta = Created.Delta * 0.1 + Aux

		return Created
	elseif Type == "item_snowball" then
		return BreakingItem(Position, ItemSprite(Snowball))
	elseif Type == "block" then
		return Terrain(Position, Aux, Options.Block, Options.Color)
	elseif Type == "dust_pillar" then
		const Created = Terrain(Position, Aux, Options.Block, Options.Color)

		if Created then
			Created.Delta = vector.create(NextGaussian() / 30, Aux.y + NextGaussian() / 2, NextGaussian() / 30)
			Created.Lifetime = NextInt(20) + 20
		end

		return Created
	elseif Type == "effect" or Type == "instant_effect" then
		const Created = Spell(Position, Aux, Type)

		Created.Color = Options.Color or vector.one
		Particle.SetPower(Created, Options.Power or 1)

		return Created
	elseif Type == "entity_effect" then
		const Created = Spell(Position, Aux, Type)

		Created.Color = Options.Color or vector.one
		SetSpellAlpha(Created, Options.Alpha or 1)

		return Created
	elseif Type == "trial_omen" or Type == "raid_omen" then
		return Spell(Position, Aux, Type)
	elseif Type == "totem_of_undying" then
		return Totem(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "firework" then
		const Created = Spark(Position, Aux)

		Created.Alpha = 0.99

		return Created
	elseif Type == "flash" then
		return Flash(Position, Options)
	elseif Type == "bubble" then
		return Bubble(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "splash" then
		return Splash(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "poof" then
		return Explode(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "portal" then
		return Portal(Position, Aux)
	elseif Type == "gust" or Type == "small_gust" then
		return Gust(Position, Type == "small_gust")
	elseif Type == "gust_emitter_large" then
		return GustSeed(Position, 3, 7, 0)
	elseif Type == "gust_emitter_small" then
		return GustSeed(Position, 1, 3, 2)
	end

	return nil
end

const function Tick(Created: Particle, Spawn: Spawner, Add: Adder)
	const Kind = Created.Kind

	if Kind == "Crit" then
		TickCrit(Created)
	elseif Kind == "Spell" then
		TickSpell(Created)
	elseif Kind == "Totem" then
		TickSimpleAnimated(Created)
	elseif Kind == "Spark" then
		TickSpark(Created, Add)
	elseif Kind == "Bubble" then
		TickBubble(Created)
	elseif Kind == "WaterDrop" then
		TickWaterDrop(Created)
	elseif Kind == "Portal" then
		TickPortal(Created)
	elseif Kind == "Sweep" or Kind == "Gust" then
		TickAnimatedInPlace(Created)
	elseif Kind == "GustSeed" then
		TickGustSeed(Created, Spawn)
	elseif Kind == "Explode" then
		Particle.Tick(Created)
		Particle.SpriteFromAge(Created)
	else
		Particle.Tick(Created)
	end
end

const function QuadSize(Created: Particle, Partial: number): number
	const Kind = Created.Kind

	if Kind == "Crit" then
		return Created.QuadSize * math.clamp((Created.Age + Partial) / Created.Lifetime * 32, 0, 1)
	elseif Kind == "Portal" then
		const Shrink = 1 - (Created.Age + Partial) / Created.Lifetime

		return Created.QuadSize * (1 - Shrink * Shrink)
	elseif Kind == "Flash" then
		return 7.1 * math.sin((Created.Age + Partial - 1) * 0.25 * math.pi)
	end

	return Created.QuadSize
end

const function AlphaAt(Created: Particle, Partial: number): number
	if Created.Kind == "Flash" then
		return 0.6 - (Created.Age + Partial - 1) * 0.25 * 0.5
	end

	return Created.Alpha
end

const function Visible(Created: Particle): boolean
	return Created.Kind ~= "Spark" or not Created.Twinkle or Created.Age < Created.Lifetime // 3 or (Created.Age + Created.Lifetime) // 3 % 2 == 0
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Tick = Tick,
	QuadSize = QuadSize,
	AlphaAt = AlphaAt,
	Visible = Visible,
	SetScopingEye = SetScopingEye,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Minecraft/Particles/Billboards"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("../../../Shared/Minecraft")
const Textures = require("../Textures")

const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

type Element = {
	Gui: BillboardGui,
	Label: ImageLabel,
	Enabled: boolean,
	Offset: vector,
	Width: number,
	RectOffset: Vector2,
	RectSize: Vector2,
	Color: vector,
	Transparency: number,
	Rotation: number,
}

type Pool = {
	Content: Content,
	Elements: { Element },
	Used: number,
}

const Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
const Anchor = Instance.new("Attachment")
const Pools: { [string]: Pool } = {}

Folder.Name = "MinecraftParticles"
Folder.Parent = workspace
Anchor.Name = "ParticleOrigin"
Anchor.Parent = workspace.Terrain

const function PoolFor(AtlasName: Textures.AtlasName): Pool
	const Existing = Pools[AtlasName]

	if Existing then
		return Existing
	end

	const Created: Pool = { Content = Textures.AtlasContent(Textures.Atlas(AtlasName)), Elements = {}, Used = 0 }

	Pools[AtlasName] = Created

	return Created
end

const function CreateElement(Pool: Pool): Element
	const Gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	const Label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

	Gui.Adornee = Anchor
	Gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	Gui.LightInfluence = 0
	Gui.ClipsDescendants = false
	Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	Gui.MaxDistance = math.huge
	Gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	Gui.Enabled = false
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	Label.ImageContent = Pool.Content
	Label.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
	Label.Parent = Gui
	Gui.Parent = Folder

	return {
		Gui = Gui,
		Label = Label,
		Enabled = false,
		Offset = vector.zero,
		Width = 0,
		RectOffset = Vector2.zero,
		RectSize = Vector2.zero,
		Color = vector.one,
		Transparency = 0,
		Rotation = 0,
	}
end

const function Begin()
	for _, Pool in Pools do
		Pool.Used = 0
	end
end

const function Draw(AtlasName: Textures.AtlasName, SpriteId: string, U0: number, U1: number, V0: number, V1: number, Center: vector, HalfSize: number, Roll: number, Color: vector, Alpha: number)
	const Pool = PoolFor(AtlasName)
	const Atlas = Textures.Atlas(AtlasName)
	const Sprite = Textures.Sprite(Atlas, SpriteId)
	const Frame = Textures.Frame(Sprite)

	Pool.Used += 1

	local Element = Pool.Elements[Pool.Used]

	if not Element then
		Element = CreateElement(Pool)
		Pool.Elements[Pool.Used] = Element
	end

	const Gui = Element.Gui
	const Label = Element.Label
	const Offset = Center * StudsPerBlock
	const Width = HalfSize * 2 * StudsPerBlock
	const RectOffset = Vector2.new(Frame.X + math.min(U0, U1) * Sprite.Size.X, Frame.Y + math.min(V0, V1) * Sprite.Size.Y)
	const RectSize = Vector2.new(math.abs(U1 - U0) * Sprite.Size.X, math.abs(V1 - V0) * Sprite.Size.Y)
	const Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(Alpha, 0, 1)
	const Rotation = -math.deg(Roll)

	if not Element.Enabled then
		Element.Enabled = true
		Gui.Enabled = true
	end

	if Element.Offset ~= Offset then
		Element.Offset = Offset
		Gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Offset
	end

	if Element.Width ~= Width then
		Element.Width = Width
		Gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(Width, Width)
	end

	if Element.RectOffset ~= RectOffset then
		Element.RectOffset = RectOffset
		Label.ImageRectOffset = RectOffset
	end

	if Element.RectSize ~= RectSize then
		Element.RectSize = RectSize
		Label.ImageRectSize = RectSize
	end

	if Element.Color ~= Color then
		Element.Color = Color
		Label.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(math.min(Color.x, 1), math.min(Color.y, 1), math.min(Color.z, 1))
	end

	if Element.Transparency ~= Transparency then
		Element.Transparency = Transparency
		Label.ImageTransparency = Transparency
	end

	if Element.Rotation ~= Rotation then
		Element.Rotation = Rotation
		Label.Rotation = Rotation
	end
end

const function Finish()
	for _, Pool in Pools do
		for Index = Pool.Used + 1, #Pool.Elements do
			const Element = Pool.Elements[Index]

			if Element.Enabled then
				Element.Enabled = false
				Element.Gui.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
end

return {
	Begin = Begin,
	Draw = Draw,
	Finish = Finish,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Rendering/EditableBudget"] = function(require)

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const RetrySeconds = 1

local RefusedAt = -math.huge

const function Allowed(): boolean
	return os.clock() - RefusedAt >= RetrySeconds
end

const function Record(Created: EditableMesh?): EditableMesh?
	if not Created then
		RefusedAt = os.clock()
	end

	return Created
end

const function CreateMesh(): EditableMesh?
	if not Allowed() then
		return nil
	end

	return Record(AssetService:CreateEditableMesh())
end

const function CreateFixedMesh(Source: EditableMesh): EditableMesh?
	if not Allowed() then
		return nil
	end

	return Record(AssetService:CreateEditableMeshAsync(Content.fromObject(Source), { FixedSize = true }))
end

return {
	Allowed = Allowed,
	CreateMesh = CreateMesh,
	CreateFixedMesh = CreateFixedMesh,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Features/Rendering/Neon"] = function(require)

const NeonCurve = require("./NeonCurve")

const Samples = #NeonCurve - 1

const InverseCurve = buffer.create(256 * 4)

do
	local Saturation = #NeonCurve

	while Saturation > 1 and NeonCurve[Saturation - 1] == NeonCurve[#NeonCurve] do
		Saturation -= 1
	end

	for Target = 0, 255 do
		local Input = (Saturation - 1) / Samples

		if Target <= NeonCurve[1] then
			Input = 0
		elseif Target < NeonCurve[Saturation] then
			for Index = 1, Saturation - 1 do
				const Low = NeonCurve[Index]
				const High = NeonCurve[Index + 1]

				if Target <= High and High > Low then
					Input = (Index - 1 + (Target - Low) / (High - Low)) / Samples
					break
				end
			end
		end

		buffer.writef32(InverseCurve, Target * 4, Input)
	end
end

const function Invert(Target: number): number
	const Scaled = math.clamp(Target, 0, 1) * 255
	const Low, Fraction = math.modf(Scaled)
	const LowInput = buffer.readf32(InverseCurve, Low * 4)

	if Low >= 255 then
		return LowInput
	end

	return LowInput + (buffer.readf32(InverseCurve, (Low + 1) * 4) - LowInput) * Fraction
end

const function Correct(Color: vector): Color3
	return Color3.new(Invert(Color.x), Invert(Color.y), Invert(Color.z))
end

return Correct

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft"] = function(require)

const Units = require("@self/Units")

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Mth"] = function(require)

const SinScale = 10430.378350470453
const TableSize = 65536
const QuarterTurn = 16384
const ElasticFrequency = 1.3962634
const NormalizeEpsilon = 1.0E-5

const SinTable = buffer.create(TableSize * 4)
const FloatScratch = buffer.create(4)

for Index = 0, TableSize - 1 do
	buffer.writef32(SinTable, Index * 4, math.sin(Index / SinScale))
end

const function Float(Value: number): number
	buffer.writef32(FloatScratch, 0, Value)

	return buffer.readf32(FloatScratch, 0)
end

const function Equal(First: number, Second: number): boolean
	return math.abs(Second - First) < 9.999999747378752E-6
end

const function Sin(Value: number): number
	return buffer.readf32(SinTable, (math.modf(Value * SinScale) % TableSize) * 4)
end

const function Cos(Value: number): number
	return buffer.readf32(SinTable, (math.modf(Value * SinScale + QuarterTurn) % TableSize) * 4)
end

const function Clamp(Value: number, Minimum: number, Maximum: number): number
	return if Value < Minimum then Minimum else math.min(Value, Maximum)
end

const function Lerp(Alpha: number, From: number, To: number): number
	return From + Alpha * (To - From)
end

const function WrapDegrees(Angle: number): number
	local Normalized = math.fmod(Angle, 360)

	if Normalized >= 180 then
		Normalized -= 360
	end

	if Normalized < -180 then
		Normalized += 360
	end

	return Normalized
end

const function RotLerp(Alpha: number, From: number, To: number): number
	return From + Alpha * WrapDegrees(To - From)
end

const function RotLerpRad(Alpha: number, From: number, To: number): number
	local Difference = To - From

	while Difference < -math.pi do
		Difference += math.tau
	end

	while Difference >= math.pi do
		Difference -= math.tau
	end

	return From + Alpha * Difference
end

const function InverseLerp(Value: number, Start: number, Finish: number): number
	return (Value - Start) / (Finish - Start)
end

const function InQuad(Value: number): number
	return Value * Value
end

const function OutQuart(Value: number): number
	const Inverse = (1 - Value) * (1 - Value)

	return 1 - Inverse * Inverse
end

const function OutCubic(Value: number): number
	const Inverse = 1 - Value

	return 1 - Inverse * Inverse * Inverse
end

const function OutBack(Value: number): number
	const Shifted = Value - 1

	return 1 + 2.70158 * Shifted * Shifted * Shifted + 1.70158 * Shifted * Shifted
end

const function InOutSine(Value: number): number
	return -(Cos(math.pi * Value) - 1) / 2
end

const function InOutExpo(Value: number): number
	if Value < 0.5 then
		return if Value == 0 then 0 else 2 ^ (20 * Value - 10) / 2
	end

	return if Value == 1 then 1 else (2 - 2 ^ (-20 * Value + 10)) / 2
end

const function InOutBack(Value: number): number
	if Value < 0.5 then
		return 4 * Value * Value * (7.189819 * Value - 2.5949094) / 2
	end

	const Shifted = 2 * Value - 2

	return (Shifted * Shifted * (3.5949094 * Shifted + 2.5949094) + 2) / 2
end

const function InOutElastic(Value: number): number
	if Value == 0 or Value == 1 then
		return Value
	end

	const Wave = math.sin((20 * Value - 11.125) * ElasticFrequency)

	if Value < 0.5 then
		return -(2 ^ (20 * Value - 10) * Wave) / 2
	end

	return 2 ^ (-20 * Value + 10) * Wave / 2 + 1
end

const function InCirc(Value: number): number
	return 1 - math.sqrt(1 - Value * Value)
end

const function OutCirc(Value: number): number
	return math.sqrt(1 - (Value - 1) * (Value - 1))
end

const function Normalize(Vector: vector): vector
	const Length = vector.magnitude(Vector)

	return if Length < NormalizeEpsilon then vector.zero else Vector / Length
end

const function ShiftLeft(Value: number, Shift: number): number
	const Shifted = bit32.lshift(Value, Shift % 32)

	return if Shifted >= 0x80000000 then Shifted - 0x100000000 else Shifted
end

return {
	ShiftLeft = ShiftLeft,
	Normalize = Normalize,
	Float = Float,
	Equal = Equal,
	Sin = Sin,
	Cos = Cos,
	Clamp = Clamp,
	Lerp = Lerp,
	WrapDegrees = WrapDegrees,
	RotLerp = RotLerp,
	RotLerpRad = RotLerpRad,
	InverseLerp = InverseLerp,
	InQuad = InQuad,
	OutQuart = OutQuart,
	OutCubic = OutCubic,
	OutBack = OutBack,
	InOutSine = InOutSine,
	InOutExpo = InOutExpo,
	InOutBack = InOutBack,
	InOutElastic = InOutElastic,
	InCirc = InCirc,
	OutCirc = OutCirc,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Blocks"] = function(require)

export type Block = {
	Id: string,
	Friction: number,
	SpeedFactor: number,
	JumpFactor: number,
	Tinted: boolean,
}

const DefaultFriction = 0.6000000238418579
const IceFriction = 0.9800000190734863
const BlueIceFriction = 0.9890000224113464

const function Define(Id: string, Friction: number?): Block
	return { Id = Id, Friction = Friction or DefaultFriction, SpeedFactor = 1, JumpFactor = 1, Tinted = false }
end

const function DefineTinted(Id: string): Block
	const Defined = Define(Id)

	Defined.Tinted = true

	return Defined
end

const Stone = Define("minecraft:stone")

const ByMaterial: { [Enum.Material]: Block } = {
	[Enum.Material.Plastic] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_concrete"),
	[Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_concrete"),
	[Enum.Material.Neon] = Define("minecraft:sea_lantern"),
	[Enum.Material.Wood] = Define("minecraft:oak_log"),
	[Enum.Material.WoodPlanks] = Define("minecraft:oak_planks"),
	[Enum.Material.Marble] = Define("minecraft:calcite"),
	[Enum.Material.Slate] = Define("minecraft:deepslate"),
	[Enum.Material.Concrete] = Define("minecraft:gray_concrete"),
	[Enum.Material.Granite] = Define("minecraft:granite"),
	[Enum.Material.Brick] = Define("minecraft:bricks"),
	[Enum.Material.Pebble] = Define("minecraft:gravel"),
	[Enum.Material.Cobblestone] = Define("minecraft:cobblestone"),
	[Enum.Material.Rock] = Stone,
	[Enum.Material.Sandstone] = Define("minecraft:sandstone"),
	[Enum.Material.Basalt] = Define("minecraft:basalt"),
	[Enum.Material.CrackedLava] = Define("minecraft:magma_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Limestone] = Define("minecraft:diorite"),
	[Enum.Material.Pavement] = Define("minecraft:smooth_stone"),
	[Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal] = Define("minecraft:oxidized_copper"),
	[Enum.Material.DiamondPlate] = Define("minecraft:iron_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Foil] = Define("minecraft:iron_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Metal] = Define("minecraft:iron_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Grass] = Define("minecraft:grass_block"),
	[Enum.Material.LeafyGrass] = Define("minecraft:moss_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Sand] = Define("minecraft:sand"),
	[Enum.Material.Fabric] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_wool"),
	[Enum.Material.Snow] = Define("minecraft:snow_block"),
	[Enum.Material.Mud] = Define("minecraft:mud"),
	[Enum.Material.Ground] = Define("minecraft:dirt"),
	[Enum.Material.Asphalt] = Define("minecraft:blackstone"),
	[Enum.Material.Salt] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_concrete_powder"),
	[Enum.Material.Ice] = Define("minecraft:ice", IceFriction),
	[Enum.Material.Glacier] = Define("minecraft:blue_ice", BlueIceFriction),
	[Enum.Material.Glass] = DefineTinted("minecraft:glass"),
	[Enum.Material.ForceField] = DefineTinted("minecraft:glass"),
	[Enum.Material.Cardboard] = Define("minecraft:barrel"),
	[Enum.Material.Carpet] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_carpet"),
	[Enum.Material.CeramicTiles] = Define("minecraft:smooth_quartz"),
	[Enum.Material.ClayRoofTiles] = Define("minecraft:terracotta"),
	[Enum.Material.RoofShingles] = Define("minecraft:mud_bricks"),
	[Enum.Material.Leather] = Define("minecraft:brown_wool"),
	[Enum.Material.Plaster] = DefineTinted("minecraft:white_concrete"),
	[Enum.Material.Rubber] = Define("minecraft:black_concrete"),
}

const function ForMaterial(Material: Enum.Material): Block
	return ByMaterial[Material] or Stone
end

return ForMaterial

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Collision"] = function(require)

const CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

const Mth = require("./Mth")
const Units = require("./Units")

const StudsPerBlock = Units.StudsPerBlock
const Epsilon = 1.0E-7
const CellSize = 0.125
const CellKeyStride = 2 ^ 21
const QueryPadding = 1.0E-3
const AlignmentTolerance = 1.0E-5
const MinimumSurfaceUp = 0.05
const FloatTolerance = 2 ^ -20

export type FluidType = "Water" | "Lava"

type Shape = {
	Part: BasePart,
	CFrame: CFrame,
	Size: Vector3,
	IsBox: boolean,
	Min: vector,
	Max: vector,
	Columns: { [number]: vector | false },
	Gradients: { [number]: vector },
	Params: RaycastParams,
}

const Mins: { vector } = {}
const Maxs: { vector } = {}
const Parts: { BasePart } = {}
const Slopes: { vector } = {}
const StepHeights: { number } = {}
const Shapes: { [BasePart]: Shape } = {}
const FluidMins: { vector } = {}
const FluidMaxs: { vector } = {}
const FluidTypes: { FluidType } = {}
const FluidSlopes: { vector } = {}
const FluidTags: { FluidType } = { "Water", "Lava" }
const FluidTypeOf: { [BasePart]: FluidType } = {}
const FluidParts: { BasePart } = {}
const Excluded: { Instance } = {}
const Humanoids: { [Humanoid]: true } = {}
const QueryParams = OverlapParams.new()
const RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
const FluidParams = OverlapParams.new()

QueryParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
QueryParams.RespectCanCollide = true
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
RayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
FluidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
FluidParams.RespectCanCollide = false

local RefreshQueued = false

const function RefreshExclusions()
	RefreshQueued = false
	table.clear(Excluded)

	for Humanoid in Humanoids do
		const Model = Humanoid.Parent

		if Model and Model ~= workspace and Humanoid:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			table.insert(Excluded, Model)
		elseif not Humanoid:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			Humanoids[Humanoid] = nil
		end
	end

	table.clear(FluidTypeOf)
	table.clear(FluidParts)

	for _, Tag in FluidTags do
		for _, Tagged in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag) do
			if Tagged:IsA("BasePart") then
				FluidTypeOf[Tagged] = Tag
				table.insert(FluidParts, Tagged)
				table.insert(Excluded, Tagged)
			end
		end
	end

	QueryParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Excluded
	RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Excluded
	FluidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = FluidParts
end

const function QueueRefresh()
	if not RefreshQueued then
		RefreshQueued = true
		task.defer(RefreshExclusions)
	end
end

const function Track(Instance: Instance)
	if not Instance:IsA("Humanoid") then
		return
	end

	const Humanoid = Instance :: Humanoid

	if Humanoids[Humanoid] then
		QueueRefresh()

		return
	end

	Humanoids[Humanoid] = true
	Humanoid.AncestryChanged:Connect(QueueRefresh)
	QueueRefresh()
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(Track)

for _, Descendant in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	Track(Descendant)
end

for _, Tag in FluidTags do
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Tag):Connect(RefreshExclusions)
	CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(Tag):Connect(RefreshExclusions)
end

RefreshExclusions()

const function Component(Value: vector, Axis: number): number
	return if Axis == 1 then Value.x elseif Axis == 2 then Value.y else Value.z
end

const function WithComponent(Value: vector, Axis: number, Replacement: number): vector
	return if Axis == 1
		then vector.create(Replacement, Value.y, Value.z)
		elseif Axis == 2 then vector.create(Value.x, Replacement, Value.z)
		else vector.create(Value.x, Value.y, Replacement)
end

const function IsAxisAligned(Rotation: CFrame): boolean
	const Right = Rotation.XVector
	const Up = Rotation.YVector

	return math.abs(math.abs(Right.X) + math.abs(Right.Y) + math.abs(Right.Z) - 1) < AlignmentTolerance
		and math.abs(math.abs(Up.X) + math.abs(Up.Y) + math.abs(Up.Z) - 1) < AlignmentTolerance
end

const function BuildShape(Part: BasePart): Shape
	const Frame = Part.CFrame
	const Half = Part.Size * 0.5
	const Right = Frame.XVector
	const Up = Frame.YVector
	const Back = Frame.ZVector
	const Extent = vector.create(
		math.abs(Right.X) * Half.X + math.abs(Up.X) * Half.Y + math.abs(Back.X) * Half.Z,
		math.abs(Right.Y) * Half.X + math.abs(Up.Y) * Half.Y + math.abs(Back.Y) * Half.Z,
		math.abs(Right.Z) * Half.X + math.abs(Up.Z) * Half.Y + math.abs(Back.Z) * Half.Z
	)
	const Center = vector.create(Frame.X, Frame.Y, Frame.Z)
	const IsBoxPart = (Part:IsA("Part") and (Part :: Part).Shape == Enum.PartType.Block) or Part:IsA("TrussPart")
	const Params = RaycastParams.new()

	Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Part }

	return {
		Part = Part,
		CFrame = Frame,
		Size = Part.Size,
		IsBox = IsBoxPart and IsAxisAligned(Frame),
		Min = (Center - Extent) / StudsPerBlock,
		Max = (Center + Extent) / StudsPerBlock,
		Columns = {},
		Gradients = {},
		Params = Params,
	}
end

const function ShapeOf(Part: BasePart): Shape
	const Existing = Shapes[Part]

	if Existing and Existing.CFrame == Part.CFrame and Existing.Size == Part.Size then
		return Existing
	end

	if not Existing then
		Part.Destroying:Connect(function()
			Shapes[Part] = nil
		end)
	end

	const Built = BuildShape(Part)

	Shapes[Part] = Built

	return Built
end

const function Column(Shape: Shape, CellX: number, CellZ: number): vector | false
	const Key = CellX * CellKeyStride + CellZ
	const Cached = Shape.Columns[Key]

	if Cached ~= nil then
		return Cached
	end

	const X = (CellX + 0.5) * CellSize * StudsPerBlock
	const Z = (CellZ + 0.5) * CellSize * StudsPerBlock
	const Top = Shape.Max.y * StudsPerBlock + 0.5
	const Bottom = Shape.Min.y * StudsPerBlock - 0.5
	const Down = workspace:Raycast(vector.create(X, Top, Z), vector.create(0, Bottom - Top, 0), Shape.Params)
	local Result: vector | false = false

	if Down then
		const Up = workspace:Raycast(vector.create(X, Bottom, Z), vector.create(0, Top - Bottom, 0), Shape.Params)
		const Low = if Up then Up.Position.Y else Down.Position.Y
		const Normal = Down.Normal

		Result = vector.create(Low / StudsPerBlock, Down.Position.Y / StudsPerBlock, 0)
		Shape.Gradients[Key] = if Normal.Y > MinimumSurfaceUp then vector.create(-Normal.X / Normal.Y, 0, -Normal.Z / Normal.Y) else vector.zero
	end

	Shape.Columns[Key] = Result

	return Result
end

const function QueryBox(Min: vector, Max: vector, Params: OverlapParams): { BasePart }
	const Center = (Min + Max) * 0.5 * StudsPerBlock
	const Size = (Max - Min) * StudsPerBlock + vector.one * QueryPadding

	return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(Center), Size, Params)
end

const function AppendShape(Part: BasePart, Min: vector, Max: vector, Count: number, OutMins: { vector }, OutMaxs: { vector }, OutSlopes: { vector }): number
	const Shape = ShapeOf(Part)

	if Shape.IsBox then
		OutMins[Count + 1] = Shape.Min
		OutMaxs[Count + 1] = Shape.Max
		OutSlopes[Count + 1] = vector.zero

		return Count + 1
	end

	const FirstX = math.max(Min.x, Shape.Min.x) // CellSize
	const LastX = math.min(Max.x, Shape.Max.x) // CellSize
	const FirstZ = math.max(Min.z, Shape.Min.z) // CellSize
	const LastZ = math.min(Max.z, Shape.Max.z) // CellSize
	local Appended = Count

	for CellX = FirstX, LastX do
		for CellZ = FirstZ, LastZ do
			const Span = Column(Shape, CellX, CellZ)

			if Span then
				Appended += 1
				OutMins[Appended] = vector.create(CellX * CellSize, Span.x, CellZ * CellSize)
				OutMaxs[Appended] = vector.create((CellX + 1) * CellSize, Span.y, (CellZ + 1) * CellSize)
				OutSlopes[Appended] = Shape.Gradients[CellX * CellKeyStride + CellZ]
			end
		end
	end

	return Appended
end

const function Gather(Min: vector, Max: vector): number
	local Count = 0

	for _, Part in QueryBox(Min, Max, QueryParams) do
		if Part:IsA("Terrain") then
			continue
		end

		const Appended = AppendShape(Part, Min, Max, Count, Mins, Maxs, Slopes)

		for Index = Count + 1, Appended do
			Parts[Index] = Part
		end

		Count = Appended
	end

	return Count
end

const function GatherFluids(Min: vector, Max: vector): number
	if #FluidParts == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	local Count = 0

	for _, Part in QueryBox(Min, Max, FluidParams) do
		const Appended = AppendShape(Part, Min, Max, Count, FluidMins, FluidMaxs, FluidSlopes)

		for Index = Count + 1, Appended do
			FluidTypes[Index] = FluidTypeOf[Part]
		end

		Count = Appended
	end

	return Count
end

const function Tolerance(A: number, B: number): number
	return math.max(Epsilon, math.max(math.abs(A), math.abs(B)) * FloatTolerance)
end

const function Overlaps(MinA: number, MaxA: number, MinB: number, MaxB: number): boolean
	return MinA + Tolerance(MinA, MaxB) < MaxB and MaxA - Tolerance(MaxA, MinB) > MinB
end

const function CollideBox(Axis: number, Min: vector, Max: vector, ShapeMin: vector, ShapeMax: vector, Distance: number): number
	if math.abs(Distance) < Epsilon then
		return 0
	end

	for Other = 1, 3 do
		if Other ~= Axis and not Overlaps(Component(Min, Other), Component(Max, Other), Component(ShapeMin, Other), Component(ShapeMax, Other)) then
			return Distance
		end
	end

	if Distance > 0 then
		const Ahead = Component(ShapeMin, Axis)
		const Leading = Component(Max, Axis)
		const Margin = Tolerance(Leading, Ahead)

		if Leading - Margin < Ahead then
			const Allowed = Ahead - Leading

			if Allowed >= -Margin then
				return math.min(Distance, Allowed)
			end
		end
	else
		const Behind = Component(ShapeMax, Axis)
		const Trailing = Component(Min, Axis)
		const Margin = Tolerance(Trailing, Behind)

		if Trailing + Margin >= Behind then
			const Allowed = Behind - Trailing

			if Allowed <= Margin then
				return math.max(Distance, Allowed)
			end
		end
	end

	return Distance
end

const function CollideAxis(Axis: number, Min: vector, Max: vector, Distance: number, Count: number): number
	local Remaining = Distance

	for Index = 1, Count do
		if math.abs(Remaining) < Epsilon then
			return 0
		end

		Remaining = CollideBox(Axis, Min, Max, Mins[Index], Maxs[Index], Remaining)
	end

	return Remaining
end

const function CollideWithShapes(Movement: vector, Min: vector, Max: vector, Count: number): vector
	if Count == 0 then
		return Movement
	end

	local Resolved = vector.zero
	const ZBeforeX = math.abs(Movement.x) < math.abs(Movement.z)

	for Step = 1, 3 do
		const Axis = if Step == 1 then 2 elseif (Step == 2) == ZBeforeX then 3 else 1
		const Amount = Component(Movement, Axis)

		if Amount ~= 0 then
			Resolved = WithComponent(Resolved, Axis, CollideAxis(Axis, Min + Resolved, Max + Resolved, Amount, Count))
		end
	end

	return Resolved
end

const function CandidateStepHeights(MinY: number, MaxStepHeight: number, SkippedHeight: number, Count: number): number
	local Candidates = 0

	for Index = 1, Count do
		for Edge = 1, 2 do
			const Coordinate = if Edge == 1 then Mins[Index].y else Maxs[Index].y
			const Relative = Mth.Float(Coordinate - MinY)

			if Relative < 0 or Relative == SkippedHeight then
				continue
			end

			if Relative > MaxStepHeight then
				break
			end

			local Duplicate = false

			for Existing = 1, Candidates do
				if StepHeights[Existing] == Relative then
					Duplicate = true
					break
				end
			end

			if not Duplicate then
				Candidates += 1
				StepHeights[Candidates] = Relative
			end
		end
	end

	for Index = 2, Candidates do
		const Value = StepHeights[Index]
		local Position = Index - 1

		while Position >= 1 and StepHeights[Position] > Value do
			StepHeights[Position + 1] = StepHeights[Position]
			Position -= 1
		end

		StepHeights[Position + 1] = Value
	end

	return Candidates
end

const function NoCollision(Min: vector, Max: vector): boolean
	const Count = Gather(Min, Max)

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const ShapeMin = Mins[Index]
		const ShapeMax = Maxs[Index]

		if Overlaps(Min.x, Max.x, ShapeMin.x, ShapeMax.x) and Overlaps(Min.y, Max.y, ShapeMin.y, ShapeMax.y) and Overlaps(Min.z, Max.z, ShapeMin.z, ShapeMax.z) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function SupportingPart(Min: vector, Max: vector, Position: vector): BasePart?
	const Count = Gather(Min, Max)
	local Closest: BasePart? = nil
	local ClosestDistance = math.huge

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const ShapeMin = Mins[Index]
		const ShapeMax = Maxs[Index]

		if Min.x < ShapeMax.x and Max.x > ShapeMin.x and Min.y < ShapeMax.y and Max.y > ShapeMin.y and Min.z < ShapeMax.z and Max.z > ShapeMin.z then
			const Distance = vector.magnitude((ShapeMin + ShapeMax) * 0.5 - Position)

			if Distance < ClosestDistance then
				ClosestDistance = Distance
				Closest = Parts[Index]
			end
		end
	end

	return Closest
end

const function Raycast(Origin: vector, Direction: vector): vector?
	const Hit = workspace:Raycast(Origin * StudsPerBlock, Direction * StudsPerBlock, RayParams)

	return if Hit then vector.create(Hit.Position.X, Hit.Position.Y, Hit.Position.Z) / StudsPerBlock else nil
end

const function RaycastNormal(Origin: vector, Direction: vector): (vector?, vector)
	const Hit = workspace:Raycast(Origin * StudsPerBlock, Direction * StudsPerBlock, RayParams)

	if not Hit then
		return nil, vector.zero
	end

	return vector.create(Hit.Position.X, Hit.Position.Y, Hit.Position.Z) / StudsPerBlock, vector.create(Hit.Normal.X, Hit.Normal.Y, Hit.Normal.Z)
end

return {
	Raycast = Raycast,
	RaycastNormal = RaycastNormal,
	Mins = Mins,
	Maxs = Maxs,
	Slopes = Slopes,
	FluidMins = FluidMins,
	FluidMaxs = FluidMaxs,
	FluidTypes = FluidTypes,
	GatherFluids = GatherFluids,
	StepHeights = StepHeights,
	Gather = Gather,
	CollideAxis = CollideAxis,
	CollideWithShapes = CollideWithShapes,
	CandidateStepHeights = CandidateStepHeights,
	Tolerance = Tolerance,
	NoCollision = NoCollision,
	SupportingPart = SupportingPart,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Entity"] = function(require)

const Blocks = require("./Blocks")
const Collision = require("./Collision")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const MinimumMovement = 1.0E-7
const EdgeStep = 0.05
const SupportTolerance = 1.0E-6
const PointExtent = vector.one * 1.0E-4
const LegacyOnOffset = 0.2
const MoveDistScale = 0.6
const StepTolerance = Mth.Float(1.0E-5)
const FluidMargin = 0.001
const FluidJumpHeight = 0.4
const FallClipDistance = 8
const InflateTolerance = 1.0E-7

export type Pose = "Standing" | "Crouching" | "Swimming" | "FallFlying" | "SpinAttack" | "Sleeping" | "Dying"

export type Dimensions = {
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	EyeHeight: number,
}

export type FluidState = {
	FirstTick: boolean,
	WasTouchingWater: boolean,
	WasEyeInWater: boolean,
	WaterHeight: number,
	LavaHeight: number,
	EyeInWater: boolean,
	EyeInLava: boolean,
}

export type Entity = {
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Fluid: FluidState,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnGroundNoBlocks: boolean,
	HorizontalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollisionBelow: boolean,
	FallDistance: number,
	MaxUpStep: number,
	NoPhysics: boolean,
	SteppingCarefully: boolean,
	SupportingPart: BasePart?,
}

const function Dimensions(Width: number, Height: number, EyeHeight: number): Dimensions
	return { Width = Mth.Float(Width), Height = Mth.Float(Height), EyeHeight = Mth.Float(EyeHeight) }
end

const PlayerDimensions: { [Pose]: Dimensions } = {
	Standing = Dimensions(0.6, 1.8, 1.62),
	Crouching = Dimensions(0.6, 1.5, 1.27),
	Swimming = Dimensions(0.6, 0.6, 0.4),
	FallFlying = Dimensions(0.6, 0.6, 0.4),
	SpinAttack = Dimensions(0.6, 0.6, 0.4),
	Sleeping = Dimensions(0.2, 0.2, 0.2),
	Dying = Dimensions(0.2, 0.2, 1.62),
}

const function BoxAt(Position: vector, Width: number, Height: number): (vector, vector)
	const Half = Width / 2

	return vector.create(Position.x - Half, Position.y, Position.z - Half), vector.create(Position.x + Half, Position.y + Height, Position.z + Half)
end

const function Box(Entity: Entity): (vector, vector)
	return BoxAt(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height)
end

const function ExpandTowards(Min: vector, Max: vector, Delta: vector): (vector, vector)
	return vector.min(Min, Min + Delta), vector.max(Max, Max + Delta)
end

const function HorizontalLengthSquared(Value: vector): number
	return Value.x * Value.x + Value.z * Value.z
end

const function CanFallAtLeast(Entity: Entity, DeltaX: number, DeltaZ: number, MinimumHeight: number): boolean
	const Min, Max = Box(Entity)

	return Collision.NoCollision(
		vector.create(Min.x + MinimumMovement + DeltaX, Min.y - MinimumHeight - MinimumMovement, Min.z + MinimumMovement + DeltaZ),
		vector.create(Max.x - MinimumMovement + DeltaX, Min.y, Max.z - MinimumMovement + DeltaZ)
	)
end

const function IsAboveGround(Entity: Entity, MaxDownStep: number): boolean
	return Entity.OnGround or Entity.FallDistance < MaxDownStep and not CanFallAtLeast(Entity, 0, 0, MaxDownStep - Entity.FallDistance)
end

const function MaybeBackOffFromEdge(Entity: Entity, Delta: vector): vector
	const MaxDownStep = Entity.MaxUpStep

	if not Entity.SteppingCarefully or Delta.y > 0 or not IsAboveGround(Entity, MaxDownStep) then
		return Delta
	end

	local DeltaX = Delta.x
	local DeltaZ = Delta.z

	const StepX = math.sign(DeltaX) * EdgeStep
	const StepZ = math.sign(DeltaZ) * EdgeStep

	while DeltaX ~= 0 and CanFallAtLeast(Entity, DeltaX, 0, MaxDownStep) do
		if math.abs(DeltaX) <= EdgeStep then
			DeltaX = 0
			break
		end

		DeltaX -= StepX
	end

	while DeltaZ ~= 0 and CanFallAtLeast(Entity, 0, DeltaZ, MaxDownStep) do
		if math.abs(DeltaZ) <= EdgeStep then
			DeltaZ = 0
			break
		end

		DeltaZ -= StepZ
	end

	while DeltaX ~= 0 and DeltaZ ~= 0 and CanFallAtLeast(Entity, DeltaX, DeltaZ, MaxDownStep) do
		if math.abs(DeltaX) <= EdgeStep then
			DeltaX = 0
		else
			DeltaX -= StepX
		end

		if math.abs(DeltaZ) <= EdgeStep then
			DeltaZ = 0
		else
			DeltaZ -= StepZ
		end
	end

	return vector.create(DeltaX, Delta.y, DeltaZ)
end

const function Collide(Entity: Entity, Movement: vector): vector
	const Min, Max = Box(Entity)
	local Step = Movement

	if vector.magnitude(Movement) ~= 0 then
		const QueryMin, QueryMax = ExpandTowards(Min, Max, Movement)

		Step = Collision.CollideWithShapes(Movement, Min, Max, Collision.Gather(QueryMin, QueryMax))
	end

	const XCollision = Movement.x ~= Step.x
	const YCollision = Movement.y ~= Step.y
	const ZCollision = Movement.z ~= Step.z
	const OnGroundAfterCollision = YCollision and Movement.y < 0

	if Entity.MaxUpStep <= 0 or not (OnGroundAfterCollision or Entity.OnGround) or not (XCollision or ZCollision) then
		return Step
	end

	const GroundOffset = if OnGroundAfterCollision then vector.create(0, Step.y, 0) else vector.zero
	const GroundedMin = Min + GroundOffset
	const GroundedMax = Max + GroundOffset
	local StepUpMin, StepUpMax = ExpandTowards(GroundedMin, GroundedMax, vector.create(Movement.x, Entity.MaxUpStep, Movement.z))

	if not OnGroundAfterCollision then
		StepUpMin, StepUpMax = ExpandTowards(StepUpMin, StepUpMax, vector.create(0, -StepTolerance, 0))
	end

	const Count = Collision.Gather(StepUpMin, StepUpMax)
	const Candidates = Collision.CandidateStepHeights(GroundedMin.y, Mth.Float(Entity.MaxUpStep), Mth.Float(Step.y), Count)

	const GroundDistance = vector.create(0, Min.y - GroundedMin.y, 0)
	local Improving: vector? = nil

	for Index = 1, Candidates do
		const FromGround = Collision.CollideWithShapes(vector.create(Movement.x, Collision.StepHeights[Index], Movement.z), GroundedMin, GroundedMax, Count)

		if HorizontalLengthSquared(FromGround) > HorizontalLengthSquared(Step) then
			if FromGround.x == Movement.x and FromGround.z == Movement.z then
				return FromGround - GroundDistance
			end

			Improving = Improving or FromGround
		end
	end

	return if Improving then Improving - GroundDistance else Step
end

const function CheckSupportingBlock(Entity: Entity, Movement: vector?)
	if not Entity.OnGround then
		Entity.OnGroundNoBlocks = false
		Entity.SupportingPart = nil
		return
	end

	const Min, Max = Box(Entity)
	const TestMin = vector.create(Min.x, Min.y - math.max(SupportTolerance, Collision.Tolerance(Min.y, Min.y) * 2), Min.z)
	const TestMax = vector.create(Max.x, Min.y, Max.z)
	local Supporting = Collision.SupportingPart(TestMin, TestMax, Entity.Position)

	if Supporting or Entity.OnGroundNoBlocks then
		Entity.SupportingPart = Supporting
	elseif Movement then
		const Back = vector.create(-Movement.x, 0, -Movement.z)

		Supporting = Collision.SupportingPart(TestMin + Back, TestMax + Back, Entity.Position)
		Entity.SupportingPart = Supporting
	end

	Entity.OnGroundNoBlocks = Supporting == nil
end

const function SetOnGroundWithMovement(Entity: Entity, OnGround: boolean, HorizontalCollision: boolean, Movement: vector?)
	Entity.OnGround = OnGround
	Entity.HorizontalCollision = HorizontalCollision
	CheckSupportingBlock(Entity, Movement)
end

const function SupportingBlock(Entity: Entity): Blocks.Block?
	const Part = Entity.SupportingPart

	return if Part then Blocks(Part.Material) else nil
end

const function PartBlock(Part: BasePart?): (Blocks.Block?, vector?)
	if not Part then
		return nil, nil
	end

	const Block = Blocks(Part.Material)
	const Color = Part.Color

	return Block, if Block.Tinted then vector.create(Color.R, Color.G, Color.B) else nil
end

const function BlockAt(Point: vector): (Blocks.Block?, vector?)
	return PartBlock(Collision.SupportingPart(Point - PointExtent, Point + PointExtent, Point))
end

const function BlockInCell(Cell: vector): (Blocks.Block?, vector?)
	return PartBlock(Collision.SupportingPart(Cell, Cell + vector.one, Cell + vector.one * 0.5))
end

const function BlockOn(Position: vector, Width: number): (Blocks.Block?, vector?)
	const Half = Width / 2
	const Part = Collision.SupportingPart(vector.create(Position.x - Half, Position.y - math.max(SupportTolerance, Collision.Tolerance(Position.y, Position.y) * 2), Position.z - Half), vector.create(Position.x + Half, Position.y, Position.z + Half), Position)

	if Part then
		return PartBlock(Part)
	end

	return BlockAt(Position - vector.create(0, LegacyOnOffset, 0))
end

const function ClipScale(Scale: number, DeltaA: number, DeltaB: number, DeltaC: number, Point: number, MinB: number, MaxB: number, MinC: number, MaxC: number, FromA: number, FromB: number, FromC: number): number
	const Step = (Point - FromA) / DeltaA
	const B = FromB + Step * DeltaB
	const C = FromC + Step * DeltaC

	if 0 < Step and Step < Scale and MinB - MinimumMovement < B and B < MaxB + MinimumMovement and MinC - MinimumMovement < C and C < MaxC + MinimumMovement then
		return Step
	end

	return Scale
end

const function ClipBox(Min: vector, Max: vector, From: vector, To: vector): vector?
	const Delta = To - From
	local Scale = 1

	if Delta.x > MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.x, Delta.y, Delta.z, Min.x, Min.y, Max.y, Min.z, Max.z, From.x, From.y, From.z)
	elseif Delta.x < -MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.x, Delta.y, Delta.z, Max.x, Min.y, Max.y, Min.z, Max.z, From.x, From.y, From.z)
	end

	if Delta.y > MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.y, Delta.z, Delta.x, Min.y, Min.z, Max.z, Min.x, Max.x, From.y, From.z, From.x)
	elseif Delta.y < -MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.y, Delta.z, Delta.x, Max.y, Min.z, Max.z, Min.x, Max.x, From.y, From.z, From.x)
	end

	if Delta.z > MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.z, Delta.x, Delta.y, Min.z, Min.x, Max.x, Min.y, Max.y, From.z, From.x, From.y)
	elseif Delta.z < -MinimumMovement then
		Scale = ClipScale(Scale, Delta.z, Delta.x, Delta.y, Max.z, Min.x, Max.x, Min.y, Max.y, From.z, From.x, From.y)
	end

	return if Scale < 1 then From + Delta * Scale else nil
end

const function Contains(Min: vector, Max: vector, Point: vector): boolean
	return Point.x >= Min.x and Point.x < Max.x and Point.y >= Min.y and Point.y < Max.y and Point.z >= Min.z and Point.z < Max.z
end

const function DistanceToBoxSquared(Min: vector, Max: vector, Point: vector): number
	const Outside = vector.max(vector.max(Min - Point, Point - Max), vector.zero)

	return vector.dot(Outside, Outside)
end

const function CreateFluidState(): FluidState
	return {
		FirstTick = true,
		WasTouchingWater = false,
		WasEyeInWater = false,
		WaterHeight = 0,
		LavaHeight = 0,
		EyeInWater = false,
		EyeInLava = false,
	}
end

const function UpdateFluidInteraction(Entity: Entity): boolean
	const Fluid = Entity.Fluid
	const Position = Entity.Position
	const Min, Max = Box(Entity)
	const InnerMin = Min + vector.one * FluidMargin
	const InnerMax = Max - vector.one * FluidMargin
	const EyeY = Position.y + Entity.EyeHeight
	local Water = 0
	local Lava = 0
	local EyeInWater = false
	local EyeInLava = false
	local Touching = false

	for Index = 1, Collision.GatherFluids(InnerMin, InnerMax) do
		const FluidMin = Collision.FluidMins[Index]
		const FluidMax = Collision.FluidMaxs[Index]

		if FluidMax.y < InnerMin.y or FluidMin.y >= InnerMax.y or FluidMin.x >= InnerMax.x or FluidMax.x <= InnerMin.x or FluidMin.z >= InnerMax.z or FluidMax.z <= InnerMin.z then
			continue
		end

		const Height = FluidMax.y - Min.y
		const EyeInside = Position.x >= FluidMin.x and Position.x < FluidMax.x and Position.z >= FluidMin.z and Position.z < FluidMax.z and EyeY >= FluidMin.y and EyeY <= FluidMax.y

		Touching = true

		if Collision.FluidTypes[Index] == "Water" then
			Water = math.max(Water, Height)
			EyeInWater = EyeInWater or EyeInside
		else
			Lava = math.max(Lava, Height)
			EyeInLava = EyeInLava or EyeInside
		end
	end

	Fluid.WaterHeight = Water
	Fluid.LavaHeight = Lava
	Fluid.EyeInWater = EyeInWater
	Fluid.EyeInLava = EyeInLava

	if Water > 0 then
		Entity.FallDistance = 0
	end

	Fluid.WasTouchingWater = Water > 0

	return Touching
end

const function IsInWater(Entity: Entity): boolean
	return Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater
end

const function IsInLava(Entity: Entity): boolean
	return not Entity.Fluid.FirstTick and Entity.Fluid.LavaHeight > 0
end

const function IsInLiquid(Entity: Entity): boolean
	return IsInWater(Entity) or IsInLava(Entity)
end

const function IsUnderWater(Entity: Entity): boolean
	return Entity.Fluid.WasEyeInWater and Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater
end

const function FluidJumpThreshold(Entity: Entity): number
	return if Entity.EyeHeight < FluidJumpHeight then 0 else FluidJumpHeight
end

const function FluidAt(Point: vector): Collision.FluidType?
	for Index = 1, Collision.GatherFluids(Point, Point) do
		if Contains(Collision.FluidMins[Index], Collision.FluidMaxs[Index], Point) then
			return Collision.FluidTypes[Index]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function ContainsAnyFluid(Min: vector, Max: vector): boolean
	for Index = 1, Collision.GatherFluids(Min, Max) do
		const FluidMin = Collision.FluidMins[Index]
		const FluidMax = Collision.FluidMaxs[Index]

		if FluidMin.x < Max.x and FluidMax.x > Min.x and FluidMin.y < Max.y and FluidMax.y > Min.y and FluidMin.z < Max.z and FluidMax.z > Min.z then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function IsFree(Entity: Entity, Offset: vector): boolean
	const Min, Max = Box(Entity)

	return Collision.NoCollision(Min + Offset, Max + Offset) and not ContainsAnyFluid(Min + Offset, Max + Offset)
end

const function TouchedFluids(Entity: Entity, From: vector, To: vector): (boolean, boolean)
	const Half = vector.create(Entity.Width / 2, Entity.Height / 2, Entity.Width / 2)
	const Start = From + vector.create(0, Half.y, 0)
	const Finish = Start + (To - From)
	const Inflation = Half - vector.one * InflateTolerance
	local Water = false
	local Lava = false

	for Index = 1, Collision.GatherFluids(vector.min(Start, Finish) - Half, vector.max(Start, Finish) + Half) do
		const Min = Collision.FluidMins[Index] - Inflation
		const Max = Collision.FluidMaxs[Index] + Inflation

		if Contains(Min, Max, Finish) or Contains(Min, Max, Start) or ClipBox(Min, Max, Start, Finish) then
			if Collision.FluidTypes[Index] == "Water" then
				Water = true
			else
				Lava = true
			end
		end
	end

	return Water, Lava
end

const function ClipsWater(From: vector, To: vector): boolean
	for Index = 1, Collision.GatherFluids(vector.min(From, To), vector.max(From, To)) do
		const Min = Collision.FluidMins[Index]
		const Max = Collision.FluidMaxs[Index]

		if Collision.FluidTypes[Index] == "Water" and (Contains(Min, Max, From) or ClipBox(Min, Max, From, To)) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

export type StepState = {
	MoveDist: number,
	NextStep: number,
}

const function StepEmission(Position: vector, Width: number, Movement: vector, Step: StepState, OnGround: boolean, Crouching: boolean, Swimming: boolean, InWater: boolean): (Blocks.Block?, boolean)
	Step.MoveDist += math.sqrt(Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z) * MoveDistScale

	const Supporting = BlockOn(Position, Width)

	if Step.MoveDist <= Step.NextStep or not Supporting and not FluidAt(Position - vector.create(0, SupportTolerance, 0)) then
		return nil, false
	end

	if (OnGround or Crouching and Movement.y == 0) and not Swimming then
		Step.NextStep = Step.MoveDist // 1 + 1

		return BlockAt(Position - vector.create(0, LegacyOnOffset, 0)) or Supporting, false
	elseif InWater then
		Step.NextStep = Step.MoveDist // 1 + 1

		return nil, true
	end

	return nil, false
end

const function Move(Entity: Entity, Requested: vector, Living: boolean): vector
	if Entity.NoPhysics then
		Entity.Position += Requested
		Entity.HorizontalCollision = false
		Entity.VerticalCollision = false
		Entity.VerticalCollisionBelow = false
		return Requested
	end

	const Delta = MaybeBackOffFromEdge(Entity, Requested)
	const Movement = Collide(Entity, Delta)
	const MovementLength = vector.dot(Movement, Movement)

	if MovementLength > MinimumMovement or vector.dot(Delta, Delta) - MovementLength < MinimumMovement then
		if Entity.FallDistance ~= 0 and MovementLength >= 1 and ClipsWater(Entity.Position, Entity.Position + Mth.Normalize(Movement) * math.min(math.sqrt(MovementLength), FallClipDistance)) then
			Entity.FallDistance = 0
		end

		Entity.Position += Movement
	end

	const XCollision = not Mth.Equal(Delta.x, Movement.x)
	const ZCollision = not Mth.Equal(Delta.z, Movement.z)
	const MovedVertically = math.abs(Delta.y) > 0

	Entity.HorizontalCollision = XCollision or ZCollision
	Entity.VerticalCollision = Delta.y ~= Movement.y
	Entity.VerticalCollisionBelow = Entity.VerticalCollision and Delta.y < 0
	SetOnGroundWithMovement(Entity, Entity.VerticalCollisionBelow, Entity.HorizontalCollision, Movement)

	if Living and not Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater then
		UpdateFluidInteraction(Entity)
	end

	if not Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater and Movement.y < 0 then
		Entity.FallDistance -= Movement.y
	end

	if Entity.OnGround then
		Entity.FallDistance = 0
	end

	if MovedVertically and Entity.VerticalCollision or Entity.HorizontalCollision then
		const Current = Entity.DeltaMovement

		Entity.DeltaMovement = vector.create(if XCollision then 0 else Current.x, if Entity.VerticalCollision then 0 else Current.y, if ZCollision then 0 else Current.z)
	end

	const Block = SupportingBlock(Entity)
	const SpeedFactor = if Block then Block.SpeedFactor else 1

	Entity.DeltaMovement *= vector.create(SpeedFactor, 1, SpeedFactor)

	return Movement
end

return {
	PlayerDimensions = PlayerDimensions,
	ContainsAnyFluid = ContainsAnyFluid,
	CreateFluidState = CreateFluidState,
	UpdateFluidInteraction = UpdateFluidInteraction,
	IsInWater = IsInWater,
	IsInLava = IsInLava,
	IsInLiquid = IsInLiquid,
	IsUnderWater = IsUnderWater,
	FluidJumpThreshold = FluidJumpThreshold,
	FluidAt = FluidAt,
	IsFree = IsFree,
	TouchedFluids = TouchedFluids,
	BoxAt = BoxAt,
	ClipBox = ClipBox,
	Contains = Contains,
	DistanceToBoxSquared = DistanceToBoxSquared,
	Box = Box,
	Move = Move,
	SupportingBlock = SupportingBlock,
	BlockAt = BlockAt,
	BlockInCell = BlockInCell,
	BlockOn = BlockOn,
	StepEmission = StepEmission,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Protocol"] = function(require)

const Buffers = require("@self/Buffers")
const ItemStacks = require("@self/ItemStacks")
const Items = require("./Items")
const Inventory = require("./Inventory")

const DeltaSteps = 4096
const MaximumChangedSlots = 128
const ContinuationBit = 0x80

export type Stream = Buffers.Stream
export type Reader = Buffers.Reader
export type HashedStack = ItemStacks.HashedStack

export type CommandSuggestion = {
	Text: string,
	Tooltip: unknown?,
}

export type CommandInfo = {

	Usage: { unknown },
	UsageStart: number,
	Ranges: { { Start: number, End: number } },
	UnparsedStart: number,
	UnparsedLength: number,
	SuggestionStart: number,
	SuggestionEnd: number,
	Suggestions: { CommandSuggestion },
}

type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack
type EquipmentSlot = Inventory.EquipmentSlot

export type Skin = {

}

export type ParticleOptions = {
	Type: string,
	Item: ItemStack?,
	Block: string?,
	Color: vector?,
	Alpha: number?,
	Power: number?,
}

const Clientbound = {

const function EncodeCoordinate(Value: number): number
	return (Value * DeltaSteps + 0.5) // 1
end

const function DecodeCoordinate(Encoded: number): number
	return Encoded / DeltaSteps
end

const function PackDegrees(Angle: number): number
	return bit32.band((Angle * 256 / 360) // 1, 255)
end

const function UnpackDegrees(Packed: number): number
	return (if Packed >= 128 then Packed - 256 else Packed) * 360 / 256
end

const function WriteLogin(Stream: Stream, EntityId: number)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.Login)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, EntityId)
end

const function ReadLogin(Reader: Reader): number
	return Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
end

end

const function WriteRemoveEntities(Stream: Stream, EntityIds: { number }, Count: number)

	end

const function ReadRemoveEntities(Reader: Reader, EntityIds: { number }): number
