	for Index = 1, Count do
		EntityIds[Index] = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	end

	return Count
end

const function WriteMoveEntity(
	Stream: Stream,
	EntityId: number,
	StepCount: number,
	Deltas: { vector }?,
	Ticks: { number }?,
	YRot: number?,
	XRot: number?,
	OnGround: boolean
)
	const HasPosition = Deltas ~= nil
	const HasRotation = YRot ~= nil and XRot ~= nil

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if HasPosition and HasRotation then Clientbound.MoveEntityPosRot elseif HasPosition then Clientbound.MoveEntityPos else Clientbound.MoveEntityRot)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, EntityId)

	if Deltas then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, StepCount)

		for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
			if StepCount > 0 then
				Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, (Ticks :: { number })[Index])
			end

			Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, Deltas[Index].x)
			Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, Deltas[Index].y)
			Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, Deltas[Index].z)
		end
	end

	if YRot and XRot then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, PackDegrees(YRot))
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, PackDegrees(XRot))
	end

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if OnGround then 1 else 0)
end

const function ReadMoveEntity(Reader: Reader, PacketId: number, Deltas: { vector }, Ticks: { number }): (number, number, boolean, number, number, boolean)
	const EntityId = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	const HasPosition = PacketId ~= Clientbound.MoveEntityRot
	const HasRotation = PacketId ~= Clientbound.MoveEntityPos
	local StepCount = 0
	local YRot = 0
	local XRot = 0

	if HasPosition then
		StepCount = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)

		for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
			Ticks[Index] = if StepCount > 0 then Buffers.ReadU16(Reader) else 0

			const X = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)
			const Y = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)

			Deltas[Index] = vector.create(X, Y, Buffers.ReadI16(Reader))
		end
	end

	if HasRotation then
		YRot = UnpackDegrees(Buffers.ReadU8(Reader))
		XRot = UnpackDegrees(Buffers.ReadU8(Reader))
	end

	return EntityId, StepCount, HasRotation, YRot, XRot, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) == 1
end

const function WriteEntityPositionSync(Stream: Stream, EntityId: number, StepCount: number, Positions: { vector }, Ticks: { number }, YRot: number, XRot: number, OnGround: boolean)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.EntityPositionSync)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, EntityId)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, StepCount)

	for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
		if StepCount > 0 then
			Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Ticks[Index])
		end

		Buffers.WriteVector(Stream, Positions[Index])
	end

	Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, YRot)
	Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, XRot)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if OnGround then 1 else 0)
end

const function ReadEntityPositionSync(Reader: Reader, Positions: { vector }, Ticks: { number }): (number, number, number, number, boolean)
	const EntityId = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	const StepCount = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)

	for Index = 1, math.max(StepCount, 1) do
		Ticks[Index] = if StepCount > 0 then Buffers.ReadU16(Reader) else 0
		Positions[Index] = Buffers.ReadVector(Reader)
	end

	const YRot = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)
	const XRot = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)

	return EntityId, StepCount, YRot, XRot, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) == 1
end

const function WriteRotateHead(Stream: Stream, EntityId: number, YHeadRot: number)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.RotateHead)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, EntityId)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, PackDegrees(YHeadRot))
end

const function ReadRotateHead(Reader: Reader): (number, number)
	const EntityId = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)

	return EntityId, UnpackDegrees(Buffers.ReadU8(Reader))
end

const function PackColor(Color: vector, Alpha: number): number
	const function Channel(Value: number): number
		return math.clamp((Value * 255 + 0.5) // 1, 0, 255)
	end

	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(Channel(Alpha), 24), bit32.lshift(Channel(Color.x), 16), bit32.lshift(Channel(Color.y), 8), Channel(Color.z))
end

const function WriteParticleOptions(Stream: Stream, Options: ParticleOptions)
	local Flags = 0

	if Options.Item then
		Flags += ParticleOptionFlags.Item
	end

	if Options.Block then
		Flags += ParticleOptionFlags.Block
	end

	if Options.Color then
		Flags += ParticleOptionFlags.Color
	end

	if Options.Power then
		Flags += ParticleOptionFlags.Power
	end

	Buffers.WriteString(Stream, Options.Type)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Flags)

	if Options.Item then
		ItemStacks.WriteItemStack(Stream, Options.Item)
	end

	if Options.Block then
		Buffers.WriteString(Stream, Options.Block)
	end

	if Options.Color then
		Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, PackColor(Options.Color, Options.Alpha or 1))
	end

	if Options.Power then
		Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, Options.Power)
	end
end

const function ReadParticleOptions(Reader: Reader): ParticleOptions
	const Type = Buffers.ReadString(Reader)
	const Flags = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const Options: ParticleOptions = { Type = Type }

	if bit32.btest(Flags, ParticleOptionFlags.Item) then
		Options.Item = ItemStacks.ReadItemStack(Reader)
	end

	if bit32.btest(Flags, ParticleOptionFlags.Block) then
		Options.Block = Buffers.ReadString(Reader)
	end

	if bit32.btest(Flags, ParticleOptionFlags.Color) then
		const Packed = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)

		Options.Color = vector.create(bit32.extract(Packed, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Packed, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Packed, 0, 8)) / 255
		Options.Alpha = bit32.extract(Packed, 24, 8) / 255
	end

	if bit32.btest(Flags, ParticleOptionFlags.Power) then
		Options.Power = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)
	end

	return Options
end

const function WriteSetEntityData(Stream: Stream, EntityId: number, SharedFlags: number, Pose: number, Flags: number, Health: number, ArrowCount: number, AirSupply: number, EffectParticles: { ParticleOptions }, EffectAmbience: boolean)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.SetEntityData)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, EntityId)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, SharedFlags)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Pose)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Flags)
	Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, Health)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, math.min(ArrowCount, 255))
	Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, AirSupply)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, #EffectParticles)

	for _, Options in EffectParticles do
		WriteParticleOptions(Stream, Options)
	end

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if EffectAmbience then 1 else 0)
end

const function ReadSetEntityData(Reader: Reader, EffectParticles: { ParticleOptions }): (number, number, number, number, number, number, number, boolean)
	const EntityId = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	const SharedFlags = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const Pose = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const Flags = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const Health = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)
	const ArrowCount = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const AirSupply = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)

	table.clear(EffectParticles)

	for Index = 1, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) do
		EffectParticles[Index] = ReadParticleOptions(Reader)
	end

	return EntityId, SharedFlags, Pose, Flags, Health, ArrowCount, AirSupply, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) == 1
end

const function WriteMovePlayer(Stream: Stream, Position: vector?, YRot: number?, XRot: number?, OnGround: boolean, HorizontalCollision: boolean)
	local Flags = 0

	if Position then
		Flags += MoveFlags.Position
	end

	if YRot and XRot then
		Flags += MoveFlags.Rotation
	end

	if OnGround then
		Flags += MoveFlags.OnGround
	end

	if HorizontalCollision then
		Flags += MoveFlags.HorizontalCollision
	end

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Serverbound.MovePlayer)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Flags)

	if Position then
		Buffers.WriteVector(Stream, Position)
	end

	if YRot and XRot then
		Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, YRot)
		Buffers.WriteF32(Stream, XRot)
	end
end

const function ReadMovePlayer(Reader: Reader): (number, vector, number, number)
	const Flags = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	local Position = vector.zero
	local YRot = 0
	local XRot = 0

	if bit32.btest(Flags, MoveFlags.Position) then
		Position = Buffers.ReadVector(Reader)
	end

	if bit32.btest(Flags, MoveFlags.Rotation) then
		YRot = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)
		XRot = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)
	end

	return Flags, Position, YRot, XRot
end

const function WriteContainerClick(
	Stream: Stream,
	ContainerId: number,
	StateId: number,
	SlotIndex: number,
	Button: number,
	Input: number,
	ChangedSlots: { [number]: ItemStack },
	Carried: ItemStack
)
	local ChangedCount = 0

	for _ in ChangedSlots do
		ChangedCount += 1
	end

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Serverbound.ContainerClick)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, ContainerId)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, StateId)
	Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, SlotIndex)
	Buffers.WriteI8(Stream, Button)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Input)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, ChangedCount)

	for ChangedIndex, Stack in ChangedSlots do
		Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, ChangedIndex)
		ItemStacks.WriteHashedStack(Stream, Stack)
	end

	ItemStacks.WriteHashedStack(Stream, Carried)
end

const function ReadContainerClick(Reader: Reader): (number, number, number, number, number, { [number]: HashedStack }, HashedStack)
	const ContainerId = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const StateId = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const SlotIndex = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)
	const Button = Buffers.ReadI8(Reader)
	const Input = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)
	const ChangedCount = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const ChangedSlots: { [number]: HashedStack } = {}

	if ChangedCount > MaximumChangedSlots then
		error(`Container click changed {ChangedCount} slots, more than {MaximumChangedSlots}`)
	end

	for _ = 1, ChangedCount do
		const ChangedIndex = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)

		ChangedSlots[ChangedIndex] = ItemStacks.ReadHashedStack(Reader)
	end

	return ContainerId, StateId, SlotIndex, Button, Input, ChangedSlots, ItemStacks.ReadHashedStack(Reader)
end

const function WriteSetEquipment(Stream: Stream, EntityId: number, Slots: { EquipmentSlot }, Stacks: { ItemStack }, Count: number)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.SetEquipment)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, EntityId)

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const Ordinal = (table.find(EquipmentSlots, Slots[Index]) :: number) - 1

		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if Index < Count then bit32.bor(Ordinal, ContinuationBit) else Ordinal)
		ItemStacks.WriteItemStack(Stream, Stacks[Index])
	end
end

const function ReadSetEquipment(Reader: Reader, Slots: { EquipmentSlot }, Stacks: { ItemStack }): (number, number)
	const EntityId = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	local Count = 0
	local More = true

	while More do
		const Byte = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)

		Count += 1
		More = bit32.btest(Byte, ContinuationBit)
		Slots[Count] = EquipmentSlots[bit32.band(Byte, ContinuationBit - 1) + 1]
		Stacks[Count] = ItemStacks.ReadItemStack(Reader)
	end

	return EntityId, Count
end

const function PeekEntityId(Reader: Reader, PacketId: number): number?
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Id: number? = nil

	if PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPos or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityPosRot or PacketId == Clientbound.MoveEntityRot
		or PacketId == Clientbound.EntityPositionSync or PacketId == Clientbound.RotateHead or PacketId == Clientbound.SetEntityData then
		Id = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	elseif PacketId == Clientbound.SetEntityMotion or PacketId == Clientbound.EntityEvent or PacketId == Clientbound.SwingAnimation
		or PacketId == Clientbound.DamageEvent or PacketId == Clientbound.HurtAnimation or PacketId == Clientbound.TakeItemEntity
		or PacketId == Clientbound.SetItemEntityData then
		Id = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Start

	return Id
end

	const Y = Buffers.ReadF32(Reader)

	return vector.create(X, Y, Buffers.ReadF32(Reader))
end

const function WriteCommandSuggestions(Stream: Stream, Info: CommandInfo)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, Clientbound.CommandSuggestions)
	Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, Info.Id)
	Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Info.UsageStart)
	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, #Info.Usage)

	for _, Line in Info.Usage do
		ItemStacks.WriteValue(Stream, Line)
	end

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, #Info.Ranges)

	for _, Range in Info.Ranges do
		Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Range.Start)
		Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Range.End)
	end

	Buffers.WriteI16(Stream, Info.UnparsedStart)
	Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Info.UnparsedLength)
	Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Info.SuggestionStart)
	Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, Info.SuggestionEnd)
	Buffers.WriteU16(Stream, #Info.Suggestions)

	for _, Suggestion in Info.Suggestions do
		Buffers.WriteString(Stream, Suggestion.Text)
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, if Suggestion.Tooltip ~= nil then 1 else 0)

		if Suggestion.Tooltip ~= nil then
			ItemStacks.WriteValue(Stream, Suggestion.Tooltip)
		end
	end
end

const function ReadCommandSuggestions(Reader: Reader): CommandInfo
	const Id = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	const UsageStart = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader)
	const Usage: { unknown } = {}
	const Ranges: { { Start: number, End: number } } = {}
	const Suggestions: { CommandSuggestion } = {}

	for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) do
		table.insert(Usage, ItemStacks.ReadValue(Reader))
	end

	for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) do
		const Start = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader)

		table.insert(Ranges, { Start = Start, End = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader) })
	end

	const UnparsedStart = Buffers.ReadI16(Reader)
	const UnparsedLength = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader)
	const SuggestionStart = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader)
	const SuggestionEnd = Buffers.ReadU16(Reader)

	for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadU16(Reader) do
		const Text = Buffers.ReadString(Reader)
		const Tooltip = if Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) == 1 then ItemStacks.ReadValue(Reader) else nil

		table.insert(Suggestions, { Text = Text, Tooltip = Tooltip })
	end

	return {
		Id = Id,
		Usage = Usage,
		UsageStart = UsageStart,
		Ranges = Ranges,
		UnparsedStart = UnparsedStart,
		UnparsedLength = UnparsedLength,
		SuggestionStart = SuggestionStart,
		SuggestionEnd = SuggestionEnd,
		Suggestions = Suggestions,
	}
end
