_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Protocol/Buffers"] = function(require)

const InitialCapacity = 1024
const VarIntContinue = 128
const TwoTo31 = 2147483648
const TwoTo32 = 4294967296

export type Stream = {
	Buffer: buffer,
	Cursor: number,
}

export type Reader = {
	Buffer: buffer,
	Cursor: number,
}

const function CreateStream(): Stream
	return { Buffer = buffer.create(InitialCapacity), Cursor = 0 }
end

const function Reserve(Stream: Stream, Size: number)
	const Capacity = buffer.len(Stream.Buffer)

	if Stream.Cursor + Size <= Capacity then
		return
	end

	local NewCapacity = Capacity * 2

	while Stream.Cursor + Size > NewCapacity do
		NewCapacity *= 2
	end

	const Grown = buffer.create(NewCapacity)

	buffer.copy(Grown, 0, Stream.Buffer, 0, Stream.Cursor)
	Stream.Buffer = Grown
end

const function WriteU8(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 1)
	buffer.writeu8(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 1
end

const function WriteI8(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 1)
	buffer.writei8(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 1
end

const function WriteU16(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 2)
	buffer.writeu16(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 2
end

const function WriteI16(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 2)
	buffer.writei16(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 2
end

const function WriteU32(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 4)
	buffer.writeu32(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 4
end

const function WriteF32(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 4)
	buffer.writef32(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 4
end

const function WriteF64(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	Reserve(Stream, 8)
	buffer.writef64(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += 8
end

const function WriteVarInt(Stream: Stream, Value: number)
	local Remaining = Value % TwoTo32

	while Remaining >= VarIntContinue do
		WriteU8(Stream, Remaining % VarIntContinue + VarIntContinue)
		Remaining //= VarIntContinue
	end

	WriteU8(Stream, Remaining)
end

const function WriteVector(Stream: Stream, Value: vector)
	WriteF64(Stream, Value.x)
	WriteF64(Stream, Value.y)
	WriteF64(Stream, Value.z)
end

const function WriteString(Stream: Stream, Value: string)
	WriteVarInt(Stream, #Value)
	Reserve(Stream, #Value)
	buffer.writestring(Stream.Buffer, Stream.Cursor, Value)
	Stream.Cursor += #Value
end

const function Flush(Stream: Stream): buffer?
	if Stream.Cursor == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const Message = buffer.create(Stream.Cursor)

	buffer.copy(Message, 0, Stream.Buffer, 0, Stream.Cursor)
	Stream.Cursor = 0

	return Message
end

const function CreateReader(Message: buffer): Reader
	return { Buffer = Message, Cursor = 0 }
end

const function HasMore(Reader: Reader): boolean
	return Reader.Cursor < buffer.len(Reader.Buffer)
end

const function ReadU8(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readu8(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 1

	return Value
end

const function ReadI8(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readi8(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 1

	return Value
end

const function ReadU16(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readu16(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 2

	return Value
end

const function ReadI16(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readi16(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 2

	return Value
end

const function ReadU32(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readu32(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 4

	return Value
end

const function ReadF32(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readf32(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 4

	return Value
end

const function ReadF64(Reader: Reader): number
	const Value = buffer.readf64(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor)

	Reader.Cursor += 8

	return Value
end

const function ReadVarInt(Reader: Reader): number
	local Value = 0
	local Scale = 1

	for _ = 1, 5 do
		const Byte = ReadU8(Reader)

		Value += (Byte % VarIntContinue) * Scale

		if Byte < VarIntContinue then
			return if Value >= TwoTo31 then Value - TwoTo32 else Value
		end

		Scale *= VarIntContinue
	end

	error("VarInt too big")
end

const function ReadVector(Reader: Reader): vector
	const X = ReadF64(Reader)
	const Y = ReadF64(Reader)

	return vector.create(X, Y, ReadF64(Reader))
end

const function ReadString(Reader: Reader): string
	const Length = ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const Value = buffer.readstring(Reader.Buffer, Reader.Cursor, Length)

	Reader.Cursor += Length

	return Value
end

return {
	CreateStream = CreateStream,
	WriteU8 = WriteU8,
	WriteI8 = WriteI8,
	WriteU16 = WriteU16,
	WriteI16 = WriteI16,
	WriteU32 = WriteU32,
	WriteF32 = WriteF32,
	WriteF64 = WriteF64,
	WriteVarInt = WriteVarInt,
	WriteVector = WriteVector,
	WriteString = WriteString,
	Flush = Flush,
	CreateReader = CreateReader,
	HasMore = HasMore,
	ReadU8 = ReadU8,
	ReadI8 = ReadI8,
	ReadU16 = ReadU16,
	ReadI16 = ReadI16,
	ReadU32 = ReadU32,
	ReadF32 = ReadF32,
	ReadF64 = ReadF64,
	ReadVarInt = ReadVarInt,
	ReadVector = ReadVector,
	ReadString = ReadString,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Protocol/ItemStacks"] = function(require)

const Buffers = require("./Buffers")
const Items = require("../Items")
const Registry = require("../Registry")

type Stream = Buffers.Stream
type Reader = Buffers.Reader
type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack

export type HashedStack = {
	Item: Registry.Item?,
	Count: number,
	Added: { [string]: number },
	Removed: { [string]: true },
}

const ValueTags = {
	False = 0,
	True = 1,
	Integer = 2,
	Double = 3,
	String = 4,
	List = 5,
	Map = 6,
}

const Crc32cPolynomial = 0x82F63B78
const LargestVarInt = 2147483648

const Crc32cTable: { number } = {}
const HashStream = Buffers.CreateStream()

for Index = 0, 255 do
	local Crc = Index

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		Crc = if bit32.btest(Crc, 1) then bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(Crc, 1), Crc32cPolynomial) else bit32.rshift(Crc, 1)
	end

	Crc32cTable[Index + 1] = Crc
end

const function WriteValue(Stream: Stream, Value: unknown)
	if Value == false then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.False)
	elseif Value == true then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.True)
	elseif type(Value) == "number" then
		if Value == Value // 1 and math.abs(Value) < LargestVarInt then
			Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.Integer)
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Value)
		else
			Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.Double)
			Buffers.WriteF64(Stream, Value)
		end
	elseif type(Value) == "string" then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.String)
		Buffers.WriteString(Stream, Value)
	elseif type(Value) == "table" then
		const Table = Value :: { [unknown]: unknown }

		if #Table > 0 or next(Table) == nil then
			Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.List)
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, #Table)

			for _, Element in Table :: { unknown } do
				WriteValue(Stream, Element)
			end
		else
			const Keys: { string } = {}

			for Key in Table do
				table.insert(Keys, Key :: string)
			end

			table.sort(Keys)
			Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, ValueTags.Map)
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, #Keys)

			for _, Key in Keys do
				Buffers.WriteString(Stream, Key)
				WriteValue(Stream, Table[Key])
			end
		end
	else
		error(`Cannot encode a {type(Value)} component value`)
	end
end

const function ReadValue(Reader: Reader): unknown
	const Tag = Buffers.ReadU8(Reader)

	if Tag == ValueTags.False then
		return false
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.True then
		return true
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.Integer then
		return Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.Double then
		return Buffers.ReadF64(Reader)
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.String then
		return Buffers.ReadString(Reader)
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.List then
		const List: { unknown } = {}

		for Index = 1, Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader) do
			List[Index] = ReadValue(Reader)
		end

		return List
	elseif Tag == ValueTags.Map then
		const Map: { [string]: unknown } = {}

		for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader) do
			const Key = Buffers.ReadString(Reader)

			Map[Key] = ReadValue(Reader)
		end

		return Map
	end

	error(`Unknown component value tag {Tag}`)
end

const function HashValue(Value: unknown): number
	HashStream.Cursor = 0
	WriteValue(HashStream, Value)

	local Crc = 0xFFFFFFFF

	for Offset = 0, HashStream.Cursor - 1 do
		Crc = bit32.bxor(Crc32cTable[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(Crc, buffer.readu8(HashStream.Buffer, Offset)), 255) + 1], bit32.rshift(Crc, 8))
	end

	return bit32.bnot(Crc)
end

const function PatchCounts(Stack: ItemStack): (number, number)
	local Added = 0
	local Removed = 0

	for _, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value == Items.Removed then
			Removed += 1
		else
			Added += 1
		end
	end

	return Added, Removed
end

const function WriteItemStack(Stream: Stream, Stack: ItemStack)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, 0)

		return
	end

	const Added, Removed = PatchCounts(Stack)

	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Stack.Count)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Stack.Item.ProtocolId)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Added)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Removed)

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value ~= Items.Removed then
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Registry.ComponentTypeId(Type))
			WriteValue(Stream, Value)
		end
	end

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value == Items.Removed then
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Registry.ComponentTypeId(Type))
		end
	end
end

const function ReadItemStack(Reader: Reader): ItemStack
	const Count = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)

	if Count <= 0 then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	const Item = Registry.ItemByProtocolId(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))
	const Added = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const Removed = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)
	const Patch: Items.Patch = {}

	for _ = 1, Added do
		const Type = Registry.ComponentTypeName(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))

		Patch[Type] = ReadValue(Reader)
	end

	for _ = 1, Removed do
		Patch[Registry.ComponentTypeName(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))] = Items.Removed
	end

	return Items.FromPatch(Item, Count, Patch)
end

const function WriteHashedStack(Stream: Stream, Stack: ItemStack)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, 0)

		return
	end

	const Added, Removed = PatchCounts(Stack)

	Buffers.WriteU8(Stream, 1)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Stack.Item.ProtocolId)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Stack.Count)
	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Added)

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value ~= Items.Removed then
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Registry.ComponentTypeId(Type))
			Buffers.WriteU32(Stream, HashValue(Value))
		end
	end

	Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Removed)

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value == Items.Removed then
			Buffers.WriteVarInt(Stream, Registry.ComponentTypeId(Type))
		end
	end
end

const function ReadHashedStack(Reader: Reader): HashedStack
	const Added: { [string]: number } = {}
	const Removed: { [string]: true } = {}

	if Buffers.ReadU8(Reader) == 0 then
		return { Item = nil, Count = 0, Added = Added, Removed = Removed }
	end

	const Item = Registry.ItemByProtocolId(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))
	const Count = Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader)

	for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader) do
		const Type = Registry.ComponentTypeName(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))

		Added[Type] = Buffers.ReadU32(Reader)
	end

	for _ = 1, Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader) do
		Removed[Registry.ComponentTypeName(Buffers.ReadVarInt(Reader))] = true
	end

	return { Item = Item, Count = Count, Added = Added, Removed = Removed }
end

const function HashedStackMatches(Hashed: HashedStack, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	if not Hashed.Item then
		return Items.IsEmpty(Stack)
	end

	if Hashed.Count ~= Items.GetCount(Stack) or Hashed.Item ~= Stack.Item then
		return false
	end

	local Remaining = 0

	for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
		if Value == Items.Removed then
			if not Hashed.Removed[Type] then
				return false
			end
		elseif Hashed.Added[Type] ~= HashValue(Value) then
			return false
		end

		Remaining += 1
	end

	for _ in Hashed.Added do
		Remaining -= 1
	end

	for _ in Hashed.Removed do
		Remaining -= 1
	end

	return Remaining == 0
end

return {
	WriteValue = WriteValue,
	ReadValue = ReadValue,
	WriteItemStack = WriteItemStack,
	ReadItemStack = ReadItemStack,
	WriteHashedStack = WriteHashedStack,
	ReadHashedStack = ReadHashedStack,
	HashedStackMatches = HashedStackMatches,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Abilities"] = function(require)

const Protocol = require("./Protocol")

const Flags = Protocol.AbilityFlags

export type GameMode = "survival" | "creative" | "adventure" | "spectator"

export type Abilities = {
	Invulnerable: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	MayFly: boolean,
	Instabuild: boolean,
	FlyingSpeed: number,
	WalkingSpeed: number,
}

const DefaultFlyingSpeed = 0.05
const DefaultWalkingSpeed = 0.1

const function Create(): Abilities
	return {
		Invulnerable = false,
		Flying = false,
		MayFly = false,
		Instabuild = false,
		FlyingSpeed = DefaultFlyingSpeed,
		WalkingSpeed = DefaultWalkingSpeed,
	}
end

const function ApplyGameMode(Abilities: Abilities, GameMode: GameMode)
	if GameMode == "creative" then
		Abilities.MayFly = true
		Abilities.Instabuild = true
		Abilities.Invulnerable = true
	elseif GameMode == "spectator" then
		Abilities.MayFly = true
		Abilities.Instabuild = false
		Abilities.Invulnerable = true
		Abilities.Flying = true
	else
		Abilities.MayFly = false
		Abilities.Instabuild = false
		Abilities.Invulnerable = false
		Abilities.Flying = false
	end
end

const function ToFlags(Abilities: Abilities): number
	local Packed = 0

	if Abilities.Invulnerable then
		Packed += Flags.Invulnerable
	end

	if Abilities.Flying then
		Packed += Flags.Flying
	end

	if Abilities.MayFly then
		Packed += Flags.MayFly
	end

	if Abilities.Instabuild then
		Packed += Flags.Instabuild
	end

	return Packed
end

const function ApplyFlags(Abilities: Abilities, Packed: number)
	Abilities.Invulnerable = bit32.btest(Packed, Flags.Invulnerable)
	Abilities.Flying = bit32.btest(Packed, Flags.Flying)
	Abilities.MayFly = bit32.btest(Packed, Flags.MayFly)
	Abilities.Instabuild = bit32.btest(Packed, Flags.Instabuild)
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	ApplyGameMode = ApplyGameMode,
	ToFlags = ToFlags,
	ApplyFlags = ApplyFlags,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Argb"] = function(require)

const function Alpha(Color: number): number
	return bit32.extract(Color, 24, 8)
end

const function Red(Color: number): number
	return bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8)
end

const function Green(Color: number): number
	return bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8)
end

const function Blue(Color: number): number
	return bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8)
end

const function Color(AlphaValue: number, RedValue: number, GreenValue: number, BlueValue: number): number
	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(AlphaValue, 24), bit32.lshift(RedValue, 16), bit32.lshift(GreenValue, 8), BlueValue)
end

const function As8BitChannel(Value: number): number
	return (Value * 255) // 1
end

const function Opaque(ColorValue: number): number
	return bit32.bor(ColorValue, 0xFF000000)
end

const function White(AlphaValue: number): number
	return Color(AlphaValue, 255, 255, 255)
end

const function ScaleRgb(ColorValue: number, Scale: number): number
	return Color(
		Alpha(ColorValue),
		math.clamp(math.modf(Red(ColorValue) * Scale), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.modf(Green(ColorValue) * Scale), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.modf(Blue(ColorValue) * Scale), 0, 255)
	)
end

const function HsvToRgb(Hue: number, Saturation: number, Value: number): number
	const Sector = math.modf(Hue * 6) % 6
	const Fraction = Hue * 6 - Sector
	const P = Value * (1 - Saturation)
	const Q = Value * (1 - Fraction * Saturation)
	const T = Value * (1 - (1 - Fraction) * Saturation)
	local RedValue = Value
	local GreenValue = P
	local BlueValue = Q

	if Sector == 0 then
		RedValue, GreenValue, BlueValue = Value, T, P
	elseif Sector == 1 then
		RedValue, GreenValue, BlueValue = Q, Value, P
	elseif Sector == 2 then
		RedValue, GreenValue, BlueValue = P, Value, T
	elseif Sector == 3 then
		RedValue, GreenValue, BlueValue = P, Q, Value
	elseif Sector == 4 then
		RedValue, GreenValue, BlueValue = T, P, Value
	end

	return Color(0, math.clamp(math.modf(RedValue * 255), 0, 255), math.clamp(math.modf(GreenValue * 255), 0, 255), math.clamp(math.modf(BlueValue * 255), 0, 255))
end

return {
	Alpha = Alpha,
	Red = Red,
	Green = Green,
	Blue = Blue,
	Color = Color,
	As8BitChannel = As8BitChannel,
	Opaque = Opaque,
	White = White,
	ScaleRgb = ScaleRgb,
	HsvToRgb = HsvToRgb,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Attributes"] = function(require)

const Items = require("./Items")
const Effects = require("./Effects")
const Inventory = require("./Inventory")
const Registry = require("./Registry")

export type Modifier = {
	type: string,
	amount: number,
	id: string,
	operation: string,
	slot: string?,
}

const Applied: { [string]: Modifier } = {}
const EnchantmentModifiers: { Items.EnchantmentModifier } = {}
const EnchantmentApplied: { [string]: Modifier } = {}
const EffectApplied: { [string]: Modifier } = {}

const function Reused(Pool: { [string]: Modifier }, Id: string, Type: string): Modifier
	local Entry = Pool[Id]

	if not Entry then
		Entry = { type = Type, amount = 0, id = Id, operation = "add_value" }
		Pool[Id] = Entry
	end

	return Entry :: Modifier
end

const function CollectEquipment(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, Id: string)
	for _, Slot in Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Stack = Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot)
		const Modifiers = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:attribute_modifiers") :: { Modifier }?

		if Modifiers then
			for _, Modifier in Modifiers do
				if Modifier.type == Id and Items.Enchantments.GroupCovers(Modifier.slot or "any", Slot) then
					Applied[Modifier.id] = Modifier
				end
			end
		end

		for Index = 1, Items.Enchantments.Modifiers(Stack, Slot, false, EnchantmentModifiers) do
			const Enchanted = EnchantmentModifiers[Index]

			if Enchanted.Attribute == Id then
				const Target = Reused(EnchantmentApplied, Enchanted.Id, Id)

				Target.amount = Enchanted.Amount
				Target.operation = Enchanted.Operation
				Applied[Enchanted.Id] = Target
			end
		end
	end
end

const function CollectEffects(Active: Effects.Effects, Id: string)
	for EffectId, Effect in Active do
		const Definition = Registry.MobEffect(EffectId)

		if Definition then
			for _, Template in Definition.modifiers do
				if Template.attribute == Id then
					const Target = Reused(EffectApplied, Template.id, Id)

					Target.amount = Template.amount * (Effect.Amplifier + 1)
					Target.operation = Template.operation
					Applied[Template.id] = Target
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Calculate(Id: string): number
	const Attribute = Registry.Attribute(Id)
	local Added = Attribute.player or Attribute.default

	for _, Modifier in Applied do
		if Modifier.operation == "add_value" then
			Added += Modifier.amount
		end
	end

	local Result = Added

	for _, Modifier in Applied do
		if Modifier.operation == "add_multiplied_base" then
			Result += Added * Modifier.amount
		end
	end

	for _, Modifier in Applied do
		if Modifier.operation == "add_multiplied_total" then
			Result *= 1 + Modifier.amount
		end
	end

	return math.clamp(Result, Attribute.min, Attribute.max)
end

const function Value(Id: string, PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory?, Active: Effects.Effects?, Extra: { Modifier }?): number
	table.clear(Applied)

	if PlayerInventory then
		CollectEquipment(PlayerInventory, Id)
	end

	if Active then
		CollectEffects(Active, Id)
	end

	if Extra then
		for _, Modifier in Extra do
			if Modifier.type == Id then
				Applied[Modifier.id] = Modifier
			end
		end
	end

	return Calculate(Id)
end

return {
	Value = Value,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Damage"] = function(require)

const Items = require("./Items")
const Registry = require("./Registry")
const Entity = require("./Entity")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const MaximumArmor = 20
const ArmorProtectionDivider = 25
const BaseToughness = 2
const MinimumArmorRatio = 0.2
const DamageTypeRegistry = "minecraft:damage_type"

const PlayerHurtSounds: { [string]: string } = {
	hurt = "entity.player.hurt",
	thorns = "entity.player.hurt",
	drowning = "entity.player.hurt_drown",
	burning = "entity.player.hurt_on_fire",
	poking = "entity.player.hurt_sweet_berry_bush",
	freezing = "entity.player.hurt_freeze",
}

export type Difficulty = "peaceful" | "easy" | "normal" | "hard"

export type Subject = {
	Id: number,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Entity.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	GameMode: string?,
	FoodLevel: number?,
}

export type Source = {
	Type: string,
	Causing: Subject?,
	Direct: Subject?,
	Position: vector?,
	Weapon: Items.ItemStack?,
}

export type DamageType = {
	message_id: string,
	exhaustion: number,
	scaling: string,
	effects: string?,
	death_message_type: string?,
}

const function Type(Id: string): DamageType
	const Found = Registry.DatapackEntry(DamageTypeRegistry, Id)

	if not Found then
		error(`Unknown damage type {Id}`)
	end

	return Found :: DamageType
end

const function PlayerHurtSound(TypeId: string): string
	return PlayerHurtSounds[Type(TypeId).effects or "hurt"]
end

const function Create(TypeId: string, Direct: Subject?, Causing: Subject?, Position: vector?, Weapon: Items.ItemStack?): Source
	Type(TypeId)

	return { Type = TypeId, Direct = Direct, Causing = Causing, Position = Position, Weapon = Weapon }
end

const function Is(Source: Source, Tag: string): boolean
	return Registry.HasTag(DamageTypeRegistry, Tag, Source.Type)
end

const function ItemCanBeHurtBy(Stack: Items.ItemStack, Source: Source): boolean
	const Resistant = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:damage_resistant") :: { types: string }?

	return Resistant == nil or not Registry.HolderSetContains(DamageTypeRegistry, Resistant.types, Source.Type)
end

const function IsDirect(Source: Source): boolean
	return Source.Causing == Source.Direct
end

const function SourcePosition(Source: Source): vector?
	if Source.Position then
		return Source.Position
	end

	return if Source.Direct then Source.Direct.Position else nil
end

const function FoodExhaustion(Source: Source): number
	return Mth.Float(Type(Source.Type).exhaustion)
end

const function ScalesWithDifficulty(Source: Source): boolean
	const Scaling = Type(Source.Type).scaling

	if Scaling == "always" then
		return true
	elseif Scaling == "when_caused_by_living_non_player" then
		const Causing = Source.Causing

		return Causing ~= nil and Causing.IsLiving and Causing.EntityType ~= "minecraft:player"
	end

	return false
end

const function ScaleForPlayer(Amount: number, Difficulty: Difficulty): number
	if Difficulty == "peaceful" then
		return 0
	elseif Difficulty == "easy" then
		return math.min(Mth.Float(Amount / 2 + 1), Amount)
	elseif Difficulty == "hard" then
		return Mth.Float(Amount * 3 / 2)
	end

	return Amount
end

const function ArmorFraction(Damage: number, Armor: number, Toughness: number): number
	const ToughnessFactor = Mth.Float(BaseToughness + Toughness / 4)
	const RealArmor = Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float(Armor - Damage / ToughnessFactor), Mth.Float(Armor * MinimumArmorRatio), MaximumArmor)

	return Mth.Float(RealArmor / ArmorProtectionDivider)
end

const function AfterMagicAbsorb(Damage: number, MagicArmor: number): number
	const RealArmor = Mth.Clamp(MagicArmor, 0, MaximumArmor)

	return Mth.Float(Damage * Mth.Float(1 - RealArmor / ArmorProtectionDivider))
end

return {
	Type = Type,
	PlayerHurtSound = PlayerHurtSound,
	Create = Create,
	Is = Is,
	IsDirect = IsDirect,
	ItemCanBeHurtBy = ItemCanBeHurtBy,
	SourcePosition = SourcePosition,
	FoodExhaustion = FoodExhaustion,
	ScalesWithDifficulty = ScalesWithDifficulty,
	ScaleForPlayer = ScaleForPlayer,
	ArmorFraction = ArmorFraction,
	AfterMagicAbsorb = AfterMagicAbsorb,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Effects"] = function(require)

const Registry = require("./Registry")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const InfiniteDuration = -1
const MaximumAmplifier = 255
const UpdateCutOff = 32147

export type Instance = {
	Id: string,
	Duration: number,
	Amplifier: number,
	Ambient: boolean,
	Visible: boolean,
	ShowIcon: boolean,
	Hidden: Instance?,
	BlendFactor: number,
	BlendFactorPrevious: number,
}

export type Effects = { [string]: Instance }

type Codec = {
	id: string,
	amplifier: number?,
	duration: number?,
	ambient: boolean?,
	show_particles: boolean?,
	show_icon: boolean?,
	hidden_effect: Codec?,
}

type Blend = { In: number, Out: number, OutAdvance: number }

const Blends: { [string]: Blend } = {
	["minecraft:darkness"] = { In = 22, Out = 22, OutAdvance = 22 },
	["minecraft:nausea"] = { In = 150, Out = 20, OutAdvance = 60 },
}

const NoBlend: Blend = { In = 0, Out = 0, OutAdvance = 0 }

const function Create(Id: string, Duration: number, Amplifier: number, Ambient: boolean?, Visible: boolean?, ShowIcon: boolean?): Instance
	const IsVisible = Visible ~= false

	return {
		Id = Id,
		Duration = Duration,
		Amplifier = math.clamp(Amplifier, 0, MaximumAmplifier),
		Ambient = Ambient == true,
		Visible = IsVisible,
		ShowIcon = if ShowIcon == nil then IsVisible else ShowIcon,
		Hidden = nil,
		BlendFactor = 0,
		BlendFactorPrevious = 0,
	}
end

const function Copy(Source: Instance): Instance
	return {
		Id = Source.Id,
		Duration = Source.Duration,
		Amplifier = Source.Amplifier,
		Ambient = Source.Ambient,
		Visible = Source.Visible,
		ShowIcon = Source.ShowIcon,
		Hidden = Source.Hidden,
		BlendFactor = Source.BlendFactor,
		BlendFactorPrevious = Source.BlendFactorPrevious,
	}
end

const function FromCodec(Value: unknown): Instance
	const Fields = Value :: Codec
	const Created = Create(Fields.id, Fields.duration or 0, Fields.amplifier or 0, Fields.ambient, Fields.show_particles, Fields.show_icon)

	if Fields.hidden_effect then
		const HiddenFields = table.clone(Fields.hidden_effect)

		HiddenFields.id = Fields.id
		Created.Hidden = FromCodec(HiddenFields)
	end

	return Created
end

const function IsInfinite(Effect: Instance): boolean
	return Effect.Duration == InfiniteDuration
end

const function EndsWithin(Effect: Instance, Ticks: number): boolean
	return not IsInfinite(Effect) and Effect.Duration <= Ticks
end

const function IsShorterThan(Effect: Instance, Other: Instance): boolean
	return not IsInfinite(Effect) and (Effect.Duration < Other.Duration or IsInfinite(Other))
end

const function SetDetailsFrom(Effect: Instance, Source: Instance)
	Effect.Duration = Source.Duration
	Effect.Amplifier = Source.Amplifier
	Effect.Ambient = Source.Ambient
	Effect.Visible = Source.Visible
	Effect.ShowIcon = Source.ShowIcon
end

const function Update(Effect: Instance, TakeOver: Instance): boolean
	local Changed = false

	if TakeOver.Amplifier > Effect.Amplifier then
		if IsShorterThan(TakeOver, Effect) then
			const PreviousHidden = Effect.Hidden
			const Hidden = Copy(Effect)

			Hidden.Hidden = PreviousHidden
			Effect.Hidden = Hidden
		end

		Effect.Amplifier = TakeOver.Amplifier
		Effect.Duration = TakeOver.Duration
		Changed = true
	elseif IsShorterThan(Effect, TakeOver) then
		if TakeOver.Amplifier == Effect.Amplifier then
			Effect.Duration = TakeOver.Duration
			Changed = true
		elseif not Effect.Hidden then
			Effect.Hidden = Copy(TakeOver)
		else
			Update(Effect.Hidden :: Instance, TakeOver)
		end
	end

	if not TakeOver.Ambient and Effect.Ambient or Changed then
		Effect.Ambient = TakeOver.Ambient
		Changed = true
	end

	if TakeOver.Visible ~= Effect.Visible then
		Effect.Visible = TakeOver.Visible
		Changed = true
	end

	if TakeOver.ShowIcon ~= Effect.ShowIcon then
		Effect.ShowIcon = TakeOver.ShowIcon
		Changed = true
	end

	return Changed
end

const function ScaledDuration(Effect: Instance, Scale: number): Instance
	const Scaled = Copy(Effect)

	if not IsInfinite(Scaled) and Scaled.Duration ~= 0 then
		Scaled.Duration = math.max((Scaled.Duration * Scale) // 1, 1)
	end

	return Scaled
end

const function HasRemainingDuration(Effect: Instance): boolean
	return IsInfinite(Effect) or Effect.Duration > 0
end

const function TickDownDuration(Effect: Instance)
	if Effect.Hidden then
		TickDownDuration(Effect.Hidden)
	end

	if not IsInfinite(Effect) and Effect.Duration ~= 0 then
		Effect.Duration -= 1
	end
end

const function DowngradeToHidden(Effect: Instance): boolean
	const Hidden = Effect.Hidden

	if Effect.Duration == 0 and Hidden then
		SetDetailsFrom(Effect, Hidden)
		Effect.Hidden = Hidden.Hidden

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function ShouldApplyTick(Id: string, TickCount: number, Amplifier: number): boolean
	local Interval = 0

	if Id == "minecraft:poison" then
		Interval = bit32.rshift(25, Amplifier)
	elseif Id == "minecraft:wither" then
		Interval = bit32.rshift(40, Amplifier)
	elseif Id == "minecraft:regeneration" then
		Interval = bit32.rshift(50, Amplifier)
	elseif Id == "minecraft:hunger" or Id == "minecraft:absorption" or Id == "minecraft:bad_omen" then
		return true
	elseif Id == "minecraft:raid_omen" then
		return TickCount == 1
	else
		const Effect = Registry.MobEffect(Id)

		return Effect ~= nil and Effect.instantaneous and TickCount >= 1
	end

	return if Interval > 0 then TickCount % Interval == 0 else true
end

const function BlendOf(Id: string): Blend
	return Blends[Id] or NoBlend
end

const function TickBlend(Effect: Instance)
	const Blend = BlendOf(Effect.Id)
	const Present = not EndsWithin(Effect, Blend.OutAdvance)
	const Target = if Present then 1 else 0

	Effect.BlendFactorPrevious = Effect.BlendFactor

	if Effect.BlendFactor ~= Target then
		const Duration = if Present then Blend.In else Blend.Out

		if Duration == 0 then
			Effect.BlendFactor = Target
		else
			const Step = Mth.Float(1 / Duration)

			Effect.BlendFactor = Mth.Float(Effect.BlendFactor + Mth.Clamp(Target - Effect.BlendFactor, -Step, Step))
		end
	end
end

const function TickClient(Effect: Instance)
	if HasRemainingDuration(Effect) then
		TickDownDuration(Effect)
		DowngradeToHidden(Effect)
	end

	TickBlend(Effect)
end

const function SkipBlending(Effect: Instance)
	Effect.BlendFactor = if EndsWithin(Effect, BlendOf(Effect.Id).OutAdvance) then 0 else 1
	Effect.BlendFactorPrevious = Effect.BlendFactor
end

const function BlendFactor(Effect: Instance, Partial: number): number
	return Mth.Lerp(Partial, Effect.BlendFactorPrevious, Effect.BlendFactor)
end

const function Amplifier(Effects: Effects, Id: string): number?
	const Effect = Effects[Id]

	return if Effect then Effect.Amplifier else nil
end

const function Color(Effect: Instance): number
	const Definition = Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)

	return if Definition then Definition.color else 0
end

const function Compare(A: Instance, B: Instance): number
	if (A.Duration <= UpdateCutOff or B.Duration <= UpdateCutOff) and (not A.Ambient or not B.Ambient) then
		if A.Ambient ~= B.Ambient then
			return if A.Ambient then 1 else -1
		elseif IsInfinite(A) ~= IsInfinite(B) then
			return if IsInfinite(A) then 1 else -1
		elseif A.Duration ~= B.Duration then
			return if A.Duration < B.Duration then -1 else 1
		end
	elseif A.Ambient ~= B.Ambient then
		return if A.Ambient then 1 else -1
	end

	const ColorA = Color(A)
	const ColorB = Color(B)

	return if ColorA < ColorB then -1 elseif ColorA > ColorB then 1 else 0
end

const function Precedes(A: Instance, B: Instance): boolean
	return Compare(A, B) < 0
end

return {
	InfiniteDuration = InfiniteDuration,
	Precedes = Precedes,
	Create = Create,
	Copy = Copy,
	FromCodec = FromCodec,
	IsInfinite = IsInfinite,
	EndsWithin = EndsWithin,
	Update = Update,
	ScaledDuration = ScaledDuration,
	HasRemainingDuration = HasRemainingDuration,
	TickDownDuration = TickDownDuration,
	DowngradeToHidden = DowngradeToHidden,
	ShouldApplyTick = ShouldApplyTick,
	TickClient = TickClient,
	SkipBlending = SkipBlending,
	BlendFactor = BlendFactor,
	Amplifier = Amplifier,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/EnchantmentEffects"] = function(require)

const Damage = require("./Damage")
const Inventory = require("./Inventory")
const Items = require("./Items")
const Registry = require("./Registry")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const TicksPerSecond = 20

type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack
type Subject = Damage.Subject

export type Context = {
	Level: number,
	Tool: ItemStack?,
	This: Subject?,
	Source: Damage.Source?,
	Active: boolean,
	Random: Random,
}

export type Collected = {
	Effect: { [string]: unknown },
	Level: number,
	Affected: string,
	Stack: ItemStack,
}

type Conditional = { effect: unknown, requirements: unknown? }
type Targeted = { effect: unknown, requirements: unknown?, enchanted: string, affected: string? }
type Bounds = { min: number?, max: number? }

const Scratch: Context = { Level = 1, Tool = nil, This = nil, Source = nil, Active = false, Random = Random.new() }

const function Definition(Id: string): { [string]: unknown }?
	return Registry.Enchantment(Id)
end

const function EffectsOf(Id: string, Component: string): unknown?
	const Found = Definition(Id)
	const Effects = Found and Found.effects :: { [string]: unknown }?

	return if Effects then Effects[Component] else nil
end

const function SlotCovers(Id: string, Slot: string): boolean
	const Found = Definition(Id)

	if not Found then
		return false
	end

	for _, Group in Found.slots :: { string } do
		if Items.Enchantments.GroupCovers(Group, Slot) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function InBounds(Value: number, Range: unknown?): boolean
	if Range == nil then
		return true
	elseif type(Range) == "number" then
		return Value == Range
	end

	const Limits = Range :: Bounds

	return (Limits.min == nil or Value >= Limits.min) and (Limits.max == nil or Value <= Limits.max)
end

const function InSquaredBounds(Squared: number, Range: unknown?): boolean
	if Range == nil then
		return true
	elseif type(Range) == "number" then
		return Squared == Range * Range
	end

	const Limits = Range :: Bounds

	return (Limits.min == nil or Squared >= Limits.min * Limits.min) and (Limits.max == nil or Squared <= Limits.max * Limits.max)
end

const function FlagsMatch(Entity: Subject, Flags: { [string]: boolean }): boolean
	for Name, Expected in Flags do
		local Actual = false

		if Name == "is_on_ground" then
			Actual = Entity.OnGround
		elseif Name == "is_on_fire" then
			Actual = Entity.OnFire
		elseif Name == "is_sneaking" then
			Actual = Entity.Crouching
		elseif Name == "is_sprinting" then
			Actual = Entity.Sprinting
		elseif Name == "is_flying" then
			Actual = Entity.IsLiving and (Entity.FallFlying or Entity.Flying)
		elseif Name == "is_fall_flying" then
			if not Entity.IsLiving then
				continue
			end

			Actual = Entity.FallFlying
		elseif Name == "is_baby" then
			if not Entity.IsLiving then
				continue
			end
		elseif Name == "is_swimming" then
			Actual = Entity.Swimming
		elseif Name == "is_in_water" then
			Actual = Entity.Fluid.WasTouchingWater
		else
			error(`Unsupported entity flag {Name}`)
		end

		if Actual ~= Expected then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function MovementMatches(Entity: Subject, Movement: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	const Velocity = Entity.KnownMovement * TicksPerSecond

	return InBounds(Velocity.x, Movement.x)
		and InBounds(Velocity.y, Movement.y)
		and InBounds(Velocity.z, Movement.z)
		and InSquaredBounds(vector.dot(Velocity, Velocity), Movement.speed)
		and InSquaredBounds(Velocity.x * Velocity.x + Velocity.z * Velocity.z, Movement.horizontal_speed)
		and InBounds(math.abs(Velocity.y), Movement.vertical_speed)
		and InBounds(Entity.FallDistance, Movement.fall_distance)
end

const function PlayerMatches(Entity: Subject, Player: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	if not Entity.GameMode then
		return false
	end

	const GameModes = Player.gamemode :: { string }?

	if GameModes and not table.find(GameModes, Entity.GameMode) then
		return false
	end

	const Food = Player.food :: { level: unknown? }?

	return not (Food and not InBounds(Entity.FoodLevel or 0, Food.level))
end

const function EntityMatches(Entity: Subject?, Predicate: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	if not Entity then
		return false
	end

	for Key, Value in Predicate do
		if Key == "minecraft:entity_type" then
			if not Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:entity_type", Value, Entity.EntityType) then
				return false
			end
		elseif Key == "minecraft:flags" then
			if not FlagsMatch(Entity, Value :: { [string]: boolean }) then
				return false
			end
		elseif Key == "minecraft:movement" then
			if not MovementMatches(Entity, Value :: { [string]: unknown }) then
				return false
			end
		elseif Key == "minecraft:periodic_tick" then
			if Entity.TickCount % (Value :: number) ~= 0 then
				return false
			end
		elseif Key == "minecraft:type_specific/player" then
			if not PlayerMatches(Entity, Value :: { [string]: unknown }) then
				return false
			end
		elseif Key == "minecraft:vehicle" or Key == "minecraft:location" or Key == "minecraft:movement_affected_by" then
			return false
		else
			error(`Unsupported entity predicate {Key}`)
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function SourceMatches(Source: Damage.Source?, Predicate: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	if not Source then
		return false
	end

	const Tags = Predicate.tags :: { { id: string, expected: boolean } }?

	if Tags then
		for _, Tag in Tags do
			if Damage.Is(Source, string.sub(Tag.id, 2)) ~= Tag.expected then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	if Predicate.is_direct ~= nil and Damage.IsDirect(Source) ~= Predicate.is_direct then
		return false
	end

	if Predicate.direct_entity and not EntityMatches(Source.Direct, Predicate.direct_entity :: { [string]: unknown }) then
		return false
	end

	return not (Predicate.source_entity and not EntityMatches(Source.Causing, Predicate.source_entity :: { [string]: unknown }))
end

const function NumberValue(Provider: unknown, Context: Context): number
	if type(Provider) == "number" then
		return Provider
	end

	const Fields = Provider :: { [string]: unknown }

	if Fields.type == "minecraft:enchantment_level" then
		return Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.amount, Context.Level)
	elseif Fields.type == "minecraft:constant" then
		return Fields.value :: number
	elseif Fields.type == "minecraft:uniform" then
		const Minimum = NumberValue(Fields.min, Context)

		return Minimum + Context.Random:NextNumber() * (NumberValue(Fields.max, Context) - Minimum)
	end

	error(`Unsupported number provider {Fields.type}`)
end

const function Matches(Condition: unknown?, Context: Context): boolean
	if Condition == nil then
		return true
	end

	const Fields = Condition :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Type = Fields.type

	if Type == "minecraft:all_of" then
		for _, Term in Fields.terms :: { unknown } do
			if not Matches(Term, Context) then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	elseif Type == "minecraft:any_of" then
		for _, Term in Fields.terms :: { unknown } do
			if Matches(Term, Context) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	elseif Type == "minecraft:inverted" then
		return not Matches(Fields.term, Context)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:random_chance" then
		return Context.Random:NextNumber() < NumberValue(Fields.chance, Context)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:match_tool" then
		const Predicate = Fields.predicate :: { items: unknown? }
		const Tool = Context.Tool

		return Tool ~= nil and (Predicate.items == nil or Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:item", Predicate.items, Items.ItemOf(Tool).Id))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:damage_source_properties" then
		return SourceMatches(Context.Source, Fields.predicate :: { [string]: unknown })
	elseif Type == "minecraft:entity_properties" then
		const Which = Fields.entity
		const Source = Context.Source
		local Entity: Subject? = Context.This

		if Which == "attacker" then
			Entity = if Source then Source.Causing else nil
		elseif Which == "direct_attacker" then
			Entity = if Source then Source.Direct else nil
		end

		return EntityMatches(Entity, (Fields.predicate or {}) :: { [string]: unknown })
	elseif Type == "minecraft:enchantment_active_check" then
		return Context.Active == Fields.active
	elseif Type == "minecraft:weather_check" then
		return Fields.raining ~= true and Fields.thundering ~= true
	elseif Type == "minecraft:location_check" then
		return false
	end

	error(`Unsupported loot condition {Type}`)
end

const function NextGaussian(Generator: Random): number
	return math.sqrt(-2 * math.log(1 - Generator:NextNumber())) * math.cos(math.tau * Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function Process(Effect: unknown, Level: number, Value: number, Generator: Random): number
	const Fields = Effect :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Type = Fields.type

	if Type == "minecraft:add" then
		return Mth.Float(Value + Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.value, Level))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:multiply" then
		return Mth.Float(Value * Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.factor, Level))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:set" then
		return Mth.Float(Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.value, Level))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:exponential" then
		return Mth.Float(Value * Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.base, Level) ^ Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.exponent, Level))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:all_of" then
		local Result = Value

		for _, Inner in Fields.effects :: { unknown } do
			Result = Process(Inner, Level, Result, Generator)
		end

		return Result
	elseif Type == "minecraft:remove_binomial" then
		const Chance = Mth.Float(Items.Enchantments.LevelValue(Fields.chance, Level))
		local Dropped = 0

		if Value > 128 and Value * Chance >= 20 and Value * (1 - Chance) >= 20 then
			const Mean = (Value * Chance) // 1
			const Deviation = math.sqrt(Value * Chance * (1 - Chance))

			Dropped = math.clamp(math.round(Mean + NextGaussian(Generator) * Deviation), 0, Value // 1)
		else
			for _ = 1, math.ceil(Value) do
				if Generator:NextNumber() < Chance then
					Dropped += 1
				end
			end
		end

		return Value - Dropped
	end

	error(`Unsupported value effect {Type}`)
end

const function Enchantments(Stack: ItemStack): { [string]: number }?
	return Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:enchantments") :: { [string]: number }?
end

const function ApplyConditional(Id: string, Component: string, Level: number, Value: number, Context: Context): number
	const Effects = EffectsOf(Id, Component) :: { Conditional }?
	local Result = Value

	if Effects then
		Context.Level = Level

		for _, Entry in Effects do
			if Matches(Entry.requirements, Context) then
				Result = Process(Entry.effect, Level, Result, Context.Random)
			end
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function Prepare(Tool: ItemStack?, This: Subject?, Source: Damage.Source?, Generator: Random): Context
	Scratch.Tool = Tool
	Scratch.This = This
	Scratch.Source = Source
	Scratch.Active = false
	Scratch.Random = Generator

	return Scratch
end

const function ItemValue(Component: string, Stack: ItemStack, Tool: ItemStack, Value: number, Generator: Random): number
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)
	local Result = Value

	if Levels then
		const Context = Prepare(Tool, nil, nil, Generator)

		for Id, Level in Levels do
			Result = ApplyConditional(Id, Component, Level, Result, Context)
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function EntityValue(Component: string, Stack: ItemStack, Entity: Subject, Value: number, Generator: Random): number
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)
	local Result = Value

	if Levels then
		const Context = Prepare(nil, Entity, nil, Generator)

		for Id, Level in Levels do
			Result = ApplyConditional(Id, Component, Level, Result, Context)
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function DamageValue(Component: string, Stack: ItemStack, Victim: Subject, Source: Damage.Source, Value: number, Generator: Random): number
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)
	local Result = Value

	if Levels then
		const Context = Prepare(nil, Victim, Source, Generator)

		for Id, Level in Levels do
			Result = ApplyConditional(Id, Component, Level, Result, Context)
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function UnfilteredValue(Component: string, Stack: ItemStack, Value: number, Generator: Random): number
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)
	local Result = Value

	if Levels then
		for Id, Level in Levels do
			const Effect = EffectsOf(Id, Component)

			if Effect then
				Result = Process(Effect, Level, Result, Generator)
			end
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function DamageProtection(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, Victim: Subject, Source: Damage.Source, Generator: Random): number
	local Result = 0

	for _, Slot in Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Levels = Enchantments(Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot))

		if Levels then
			const Context = Prepare(nil, Victim, Source, Generator)

			for Id, Level in Levels do
				if SlotCovers(Id, Slot) then
					Result = ApplyConditional(Id, "minecraft:damage_protection", Level, Result, Context)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function IsImmuneToDamage(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, Victim: Subject, Source: Damage.Source, Generator: Random): boolean
	for _, Slot in Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Levels = Enchantments(Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot))

		if Levels then
			const Context = Prepare(nil, Victim, Source, Generator)

			for Id, Level in Levels do
				const Effects = EffectsOf(Id, "minecraft:damage_immunity") :: { Conditional }?

				if Effects and SlotCovers(Id, Slot) then
					Context.Level = Level

					for _, Entry in Effects do
						if Matches(Entry.requirements, Context) then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function CollectPostAttack(Stack: ItemStack, Slot: string?, Enchanted: string, Victim: Subject, Source: Damage.Source, Generator: Random, Out: { Collected })
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)

	if not Levels then
		return
	end

	const Context = Prepare(nil, Victim, Source, Generator)

	for Id, Level in Levels do
		const Effects = EffectsOf(Id, "minecraft:post_attack") :: { Targeted }?

		if Effects and (Slot == nil or SlotCovers(Id, Slot)) then
			Context.Level = Level

			for _, Entry in Effects do
				if Entry.enchanted == Enchanted and Matches(Entry.requirements, Context) then
					table.insert(Out, { Effect = Entry.effect :: { [string]: unknown }, Level = Level, Affected = Entry.affected or Entry.enchanted, Stack = Stack })
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function CollectEntityEffects(Component: string, Stack: ItemStack, Slot: string?, Entity: Subject, Generator: Random, Out: { Collected })
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)

	if not Levels then
		return
	end

	const Context = Prepare(nil, Entity, nil, Generator)

	for Id, Level in Levels do
		const Effects = EffectsOf(Id, Component) :: { Conditional }?

		if Effects and (Slot == nil or SlotCovers(Id, Slot)) then
			Context.Level = Level

			for _, Entry in Effects do
				if Matches(Entry.requirements, Context) then
					table.insert(Out, { Effect = Entry.effect :: { [string]: unknown }, Level = Level, Affected = "this", Stack = Stack })
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Has(Stack: ItemStack, Component: string): boolean
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)

	if Levels then
		for Id in Levels do
			if EffectsOf(Id, Component) ~= nil then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function PickHighestLevel(Stack: ItemStack, Component: string): unknown?
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)
	local Picked: { unknown }? = nil
	local PickedLevel = 0

	if Levels then
		for Id, Level in Levels do
			const Effect = EffectsOf(Id, Component) :: { unknown }?

			if Effect and Level > PickedLevel then
				Picked = Effect
				PickedLevel = Level
			end
		end
	end

	return if Picked then Picked[math.min(PickedLevel, #Picked)] else nil
end

const function HasInSlot(Stack: ItemStack, Component: string, Slot: string): boolean
	const Levels = Enchantments(Stack)

	if Levels then
		for Id in Levels do
			if EffectsOf(Id, Component) ~= nil and SlotCovers(Id, Slot) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	HasInSlot = HasInSlot,
	PickHighestLevel = PickHighestLevel,
	Matches = Matches,
	ItemValue = ItemValue,
	EntityValue = EntityValue,
	DamageValue = DamageValue,
	UnfilteredValue = UnfilteredValue,
	DamageProtection = DamageProtection,
	IsImmuneToDamage = IsImmuneToDamage,
	CollectPostAttack = CollectPostAttack,
	CollectEntityEffects = CollectEntityEffects,
	Has = Has,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Food"] = function(require)

const Mth = require("./Mth")

const MaximumFood = 20
const StartSaturation = 5
const ExhaustionDrop = 4
const MaximumExhaustion = 40
const HealLevel = 18
const HealthTicks = 80
const SaturatedHealthTicks = 10
const HealExhaustion = 6
const SaturatedHealCap = 6

export type Food = {
	FoodLevel: number,
	Saturation: number,
	Exhaustion: number,
	TickTimer: number,
}

const function Create(): Food
	return { FoodLevel = MaximumFood, Saturation = StartSaturation, Exhaustion = 0, TickTimer = 0 }
end

const function Add(Food: Food, Nutrition: number, Saturation: number)
	Food.FoodLevel = math.clamp(Nutrition + Food.FoodLevel, 0, MaximumFood)
	Food.Saturation = Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float(Saturation + Food.Saturation), 0, Food.FoodLevel)
end

const function Eat(Food: Food, Nutrition: number, SaturationModifier: number)
	Add(Food, Nutrition, Mth.Float(Nutrition * SaturationModifier * 2))
end

const function AddExhaustion(Food: Food, Amount: number)
	Food.Exhaustion = math.min(Mth.Float(Food.Exhaustion + Amount), MaximumExhaustion)
end

const function Tick(Food: Food, Difficulty: string, Hurt: boolean, Health: number): (number, boolean)
	if Food.Exhaustion > ExhaustionDrop then
		Food.Exhaustion = Mth.Float(Food.Exhaustion - ExhaustionDrop)

		if Food.Saturation > 0 then
			Food.Saturation = math.max(Mth.Float(Food.Saturation - 1), 0)
		elseif Difficulty ~= "peaceful" then
			Food.FoodLevel = math.max(Food.FoodLevel - 1, 0)
		end
	end

	if Food.Saturation > 0 and Hurt and Food.FoodLevel >= MaximumFood then
		Food.TickTimer += 1

		if Food.TickTimer >= SaturatedHealthTicks then
			const Spent = math.min(Food.Saturation, SaturatedHealCap)

			AddExhaustion(Food, Spent)
			Food.TickTimer = 0

			return Mth.Float(Spent / SaturatedHealCap), false
		end
	elseif Food.FoodLevel >= HealLevel and Hurt then
		Food.TickTimer += 1

		if Food.TickTimer >= HealthTicks then
			AddExhaustion(Food, HealExhaustion)
			Food.TickTimer = 0

			return 1, false
		end
	elseif Food.FoodLevel <= 0 then
		Food.TickTimer += 1

		if Food.TickTimer >= HealthTicks then
			Food.TickTimer = 0

			return 0, Health > 10 or Difficulty == "hard" or Health > 1 and Difficulty == "normal"
		end
	else
		Food.TickTimer = 0
	end

	return 0, false
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Add = Add,
	Eat = Eat,
	AddExhaustion = AddExhaustion,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/ItemBehaviors"] = function(require)

const Attributes = require("./Attributes")
const EnchantmentEffects = require("./EnchantmentEffects")
const Effects = require("./Effects")
const Inventory = require("./Inventory")
const Items = require("./Items")
const Registry = require("./Registry")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const LongUseDuration = 72000
const BundleUseDuration = 200
const SpyglassUseDuration = 1200
const CrossbowChargeSeconds = 1.25
const DefaultConsumeSeconds = 1.6
const ConsumeEffectsDelay = 0.21875
const Namespace = "minecraft:"
const DefaultSwingDuration = 6
const DefaultUseSpeed = Mth.Float(0.2)
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

const Generator = Random.new()

const CreativeReach: { Attributes.Modifier } = {
	{ type = "minecraft:entity_interaction_range", id = "minecraft:creative_mode_entity_range", amount = 2, operation = "add_value" },
	{ type = "minecraft:block_interaction_range", id = "minecraft:creative_mode_block_range", amount = 0.5, operation = "add_value" },
}

const Sprinting: { Attributes.Modifier } = {
	{ type = "minecraft:movement_speed", id = "minecraft:sprinting", amount = Mth.Float(0.3), operation = "add_multiplied_total" },
}

type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack

export type Outcome = "Pass" | "Fail" | "Consume" | "Success"

export type Action =
	"None"
	| "StartUsing"
	| "ShootCrossbow"
	| "Throw"
	| "ConsumeInstantly"
	| "SwapEquipment"
	| "StartKinetic"
	| "PlayInstrument"
	| "BoostFirework"
	| "ConsumeKnowledgeBook"
	| "LaunchFirework"

export type UseAnimation = "none" | "eat" | "drink" | "block" | "bow" | "trident" | "crossbow" | "spyglass" | "toot_horn" | "brush" | "bundle" | "spear"

export type User = {
	Inventory: Inventory.Inventory,
	Creative: boolean,
	InfiniteMaterials: boolean,
	Invulnerable: boolean,
	FoodLevel: number,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	InWater: boolean,
}

export type Swing = {
	type: string?,
	duration: number?,
}

export type Cooldowns = {
	TickCount: number,
	Groups: { [string]: { Start: number, End: number } },
}

const ThrownClasses = { "SnowballItem", "EggItem", "EnderpearlItem", "ExperienceBottleItem", "ThrowablePotionItem", "WindChargeItem" }
const PassingClasses = {
	"BoatItem",
	"BottleItem",
	"BucketItem",
	"EmptyMapItem",
	"FishingRodItem",
	"FoodOnAStickItem",
	"PlaceOnWaterBlockItem",
	"SpawnEggItem",
	"WritableBookItem",
	"WrittenBookItem",
}

const function IsAny(Item: Registry.Item, Classes: { string }): boolean
	for _, Class in Classes do
		if Registry.IsInstance(Item, Class) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function Consumable(Stack: ItemStack): { [string]: unknown }?
	return Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:consumable") :: { [string]: unknown }?
end

const function ConsumeTicks(Fields: { [string]: unknown }): number
	return (math.modf(Mth.Float((Fields.consume_seconds :: number? or DefaultConsumeSeconds) * TicksPerSecond)))
end

const function SoundEventOf(Value: unknown): string?
	const Id = if type(Value) == "table" then (Value :: { sound_id: unknown }).sound_id else Value

	if type(Id) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end

	return if string.sub(Id, 1, #Namespace) == Namespace then string.sub(Id, #Namespace + 1) else Id
end

const function ShouldEmitConsumeEffects(Stack: ItemStack, Remaining: number): boolean
	const Fields = Consumable(Stack)

	if not Fields then
		return false
	end

	const Ticks = ConsumeTicks(Fields)

	return Ticks - Remaining > (Ticks * ConsumeEffectsDelay) // 1 and Remaining % 4 == 0
end

const function ConsumeSound(Stack: ItemStack, Generator: Random): (string, number, number, boolean)
	const Fields = Consumable(Stack) :: { [string]: unknown }
	const EatVolume = if Generator:NextInteger(0, 1) == 0 then 0.5 else 1
	const EatPitch = 1 + 0.2 * (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber())
	const DrinkPitch = 0.9 + Generator:NextNumber() * 0.1
	const Drink = Fields.animation == "drink"

	return SoundEventOf(Fields.sound) or "entity.generic.eat", if Drink then 0.5 else EatVolume, if Drink then DrinkPitch else EatPitch, Fields.has_consume_particles ~= false
end

const function Instrument(Stack: ItemStack): { [string]: unknown }?
	const Value = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:instrument")

	if type(Value) == "string" then
		return Registry.DatapackEntry("minecraft:instrument", Value)
	end

	return Value :: { [string]: unknown }?
end

const function TridentSpinStrength(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return EnchantmentEffects.UnfilteredValue("minecraft:trident_spin_attack_strength", Stack, 0, Generator)
end

const function RiptidePush(XRot: number, YRot: number, Strength: number): vector
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Pitch = Mth.Float(XRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const X = Mth.Float(-Mth.Sin(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch))
	const Y = Mth.Float(-Mth.Sin(Pitch))
	const Z = Mth.Float(Mth.Cos(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch))
	const Scale = Mth.Float(Strength / Mth.Float(math.sqrt(Mth.Float(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z))))

	return vector.create(Mth.Float(X * Scale), Mth.Float(Y * Scale), Mth.Float(Z * Scale))
end

const function IsChargedCrossbow(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	if not Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Stack), "CrossbowItem") then
		return false
	end

	const Projectiles = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:charged_projectiles") :: { unknown }?

	return Projectiles ~= nil and #Projectiles > 0
end

const function NextDamageWillBreak(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Items.IsDamageableItem(Stack) and Items.DamageValue(Stack) >= Items.MaxDamage(Stack) - 1
end

const function CanGlideUsing(Stack: ItemStack, Slot: Inventory.EquipmentSlot): boolean
	if not Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:glider") then
		return false
	end

	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: string }?

	return Equippable ~= nil and Equippable.slot == Slot and not NextDamageWillBreak(Stack)
end

const function CanGlide(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, OnGround: boolean, Flying: boolean, Levitating: boolean): boolean
	if OnGround or Flying or Levitating then
		return false
	end

	for _, Slot in Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		if CanGlideUsing(Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot), Slot) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function IsArrow(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Registry.HasTag("minecraft:item", "minecraft:arrows", Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id)
end

const function IsHeldProjectile(Weapon: ItemStack, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return false
	end

	return IsArrow(Stack) or Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Weapon), "CrossbowItem") and Items.Is(Stack, "minecraft:firework_rocket")
end

const function FindProjectile(Weapon: ItemStack, User: User): (ItemStack, number?)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Weapon)

	if not Registry.IsInstance(Item, "ProjectileWeaponItem") then
		return Items.Empty, nil
	end

	const PlayerInventory = User.Inventory
	const OffHand = Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "offhand")

	if IsHeldProjectile(Weapon, OffHand) then
		return OffHand, nil
	end

	const MainHand = Inventory.GetSelectedItem(PlayerInventory)

	if IsHeldProjectile(Weapon, MainHand) then
		return MainHand, PlayerInventory.Selected
	end

	for Slot = 0, Inventory.Size - 1 do
		const Stack = Inventory.GetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot)

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and IsArrow(Stack) then
			return Stack, Slot
		end
	end

	return if User.InfiniteMaterials then Items.Create(Registry.Item("minecraft:arrow"), 1) else Items.Empty, nil
end

const function CanEat(User: User, CanAlwaysEat: boolean): boolean
	return User.Invulnerable or CanAlwaysEat or User.FoodLevel < 20
end

const function CanConsume(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): boolean
	const Food = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:food") :: { can_always_eat: boolean? }?

	return Food == nil or CanEat(User, Food.can_always_eat == true)
end

const function CanSwapEquipment(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): boolean
	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: Inventory.EquipmentSlot, allowed_entities: unknown? }
	const Allowed = Equippable.allowed_entities

	if Allowed ~= nil and not Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:entity_type", Allowed, "minecraft:player") then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function SwapOutcome(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): Outcome
	if not CanSwapEquipment(Stack, User) then
		return "Pass"
	end

	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: Inventory.EquipmentSlot }
	const Equipped = Inventory.GetEquipment(User.Inventory, Equippable.slot)
	const Locked = EnchantmentEffects.Has(Equipped, "minecraft:prevent_armor_change") and not User.Creative

	if Locked or Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Stack, Equipped) then
		return "Fail"
	end

	return "Success"
end

const function BaseUse(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): (Outcome, Action)
	const Consumed = Consumable(Stack)

	if Consumed then
		if not CanConsume(Stack, User) then
			return "Fail", "None"
		end

		return "Consume", if ConsumeTicks(Consumed) > 0 then "StartUsing" else "ConsumeInstantly"
	end

	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { swappable: boolean? }?

	if Equippable and Equippable.swappable ~= false then
		const Outcome = SwapOutcome(Stack, User)

		return Outcome, if Outcome == "Success" then "SwapEquipment" else "None"
	elseif Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") then
		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	elseif Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") then
		return "Consume", "StartKinetic"
	end

	return "Pass", "None"
end

const function Use(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): (Outcome, Action)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BowItem") then
		if not User.InfiniteMaterials and Items.IsEmpty((FindProjectile(Stack, User))) then
			return "Fail", "None"
		end

		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CrossbowItem") then
		if IsChargedCrossbow(Stack) then
			return "Consume", "ShootCrossbow"
		elseif not Items.IsEmpty((FindProjectile(Stack, User))) then
			return "Consume", "StartUsing"
		end

		return "Fail", "None"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "TridentItem") then
		if NextDamageWillBreak(Stack) or TridentSpinStrength(Stack) > 0 and not User.InWater then
			return "Fail", "None"
		end

		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SpyglassItem") then
		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BundleItem") then
		return "Success", "StartUsing"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "InstrumentItem") then
		if not Instrument(Stack) then
			return "Fail", "None"
		end

		return "Consume", "PlayInstrument"
	elseif IsAny(Item, ThrownClasses) then
		return "Success", "Throw"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "FireworkRocketItem") then
		if not User.FallFlying then
			return "Pass", "None"
		end

		return "Success", "BoostFirework"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "EnderEyeItem") then
		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "KnowledgeBookItem") then
		return if Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:recipes") == nil then "Fail" else "Success", "ConsumeKnowledgeBook"
	elseif IsAny(Item, PassingClasses) then
		return "Pass", "None"
	end

	return BaseUse(Stack, User)
end

const function UseOn(Stack: ItemStack, User: User): (Outcome, Action)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "FireworkRocketItem") then
		if User.FallFlying then
			return "Pass", "None"
		end

		return "Success", "LaunchFirework"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BrushItem") then
		return "Consume", "StartUsing"
	end

	return "Pass", "None"
end

const function UseAnimation(Stack: ItemStack): UseAnimation
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BowItem") then
		return "bow"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CrossbowItem") then
		return "crossbow"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "TridentItem") then
		return "trident"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SpyglassItem") then
		return "spyglass"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "InstrumentItem") then
		return "toot_horn"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BrushItem") then
		return "brush"
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BundleItem") then
		return "bundle"
	end

	const Consumed = Consumable(Stack)

	if Consumed then
		return (Consumed.animation :: UseAnimation?) or "eat"
	elseif Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") then
		return "block"
	elseif Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") then
		return "spear"
	end

	return "none"
end

const function UseDuration(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BowItem") or Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CrossbowItem") or Registry.IsInstance(Item, "TridentItem") then
		return LongUseDuration
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SpyglassItem") then
		return SpyglassUseDuration
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BundleItem") then
		return BundleUseDuration
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BrushItem") then
		return 200
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "InstrumentItem") then
		const Found = Instrument(Stack)

		return if Found then (Mth.Float((Found.use_duration :: number) * TicksPerSecond)) // 1 else 0
	end

	const Consumed = Consumable(Stack)

	if Consumed then
		return ConsumeTicks(Consumed)
	end

	return if Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") or Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") then LongUseDuration else 0
end

const function UseOnRelease(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Stack), "CrossbowItem")
end

const function ChargeDuration(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Seconds = math.max(0, EnchantmentEffects.UnfilteredValue("minecraft:crossbow_charge_time", Stack, CrossbowChargeSeconds, Generator))

	return Mth.Float(Seconds * TicksPerSecond) // 1
end

const function BowPower(TimeHeld: number): number
	local Power = Mth.Float(TimeHeld / 20)

	Power = Mth.Float((Power * Power + Power * 2) / 3)

	return math.min(Power, 1)
end

const function CrossbowPower(TimeHeld: number, Stack: ItemStack): number
	return math.min(Mth.Float(TimeHeld / ChargeDuration(Stack)), 1)
end

const function ConsumableOf(Stack: ItemStack): { [string]: unknown }?
	return Consumable(Stack)
end

const function UseSpeedMultiplier(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Effects = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:use_effects") :: { speed_multiplier: number? }?

	return if Effects then Mth.Float(Effects.speed_multiplier or DefaultUseSpeed) else DefaultUseSpeed
end

const function CanSprintWhileUsing(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	const Effects = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:use_effects") :: { can_sprint: boolean? }?

	return Effects ~= nil and Effects.can_sprint == true
end

const function BlockDelayTicks(Stack: ItemStack): number?
	const Blocks = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") :: { block_delay_seconds: number? }?

	return if Blocks then math.round(Mth.Float((Blocks.block_delay_seconds or 0) * TicksPerSecond)) else nil
end

const function AttackAnimation(Stack: ItemStack): (string, number)
	const Swing = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:attack_animation") :: Swing?

	return if Swing then Swing.type or "whack" else "whack", if Swing then Swing.duration or DefaultSwingDuration else DefaultSwingDuration
end

const function InteractAnimation(Stack: ItemStack): (string, number)
	const Swing = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:interact_animation") :: Swing?

	return if Swing then Swing.type or "whack" else "whack", if Swing then Swing.duration or DefaultSwingDuration else DefaultSwingDuration
end

const function AttackRange(Stack: ItemStack, Creative: boolean, InteractionRange: number): (number, number, number)
	const Range = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:attack_range") :: { [string]: number }?

	if not Range then
		return 0, InteractionRange, 0
	end

	if Creative then
		return Mth.Float(Range.min_creative_reach or 0), Mth.Float(Range.max_creative_reach or 5), Mth.Float(Range.hitbox_margin or 0.3)
	end

	return Mth.Float(Range.min_reach or 0), Mth.Float(Range.max_reach or 3), Mth.Float(Range.hitbox_margin or 0.3)
end

const function InteractionRange(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, Active: Effects.Effects, Creative: boolean, Id: string): number
	return Attributes.Value(Id, PlayerInventory, Active, if Creative then CreativeReach else nil)
end

const function MovementSpeed(PlayerInventory: Inventory.Inventory, Active: Effects.Effects, IsSprinting: boolean): number
	return Mth.Float(Attributes.Value("minecraft:movement_speed", PlayerInventory, Active, if IsSprinting then Sprinting else nil))
end

const function CooldownGroup(Stack: ItemStack): string
	const Cooldown = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:use_cooldown") :: { cooldown_group: string? }?

	return if Cooldown and Cooldown.cooldown_group then Cooldown.cooldown_group else Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id
end

const function UseCooldownTicks(Stack: ItemStack): number?
	const Cooldown = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:use_cooldown") :: { seconds: number }?

	return if Cooldown then math.modf(Mth.Float(Cooldown.seconds * TicksPerSecond)) else nil
end

const function CreateCooldowns(): Cooldowns
	return { TickCount = 0, Groups = {} }
end

const function CooldownPercent(Cooldowns: Cooldowns, Stack: ItemStack, Partial: number): number
	const Entry = Cooldowns.Groups[CooldownGroup(Stack)]

	if not Entry then
		return 0
	end

	return Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float((Entry.End - (Cooldowns.TickCount + Partial)) / (Entry.End - Entry.Start)), 0, 1)
end

const function IsOnCooldown(Cooldowns: Cooldowns, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return CooldownPercent(Cooldowns, Stack, 0) > 0
end

const function AddCooldown(Cooldowns: Cooldowns, Group: string, Ticks: number)
	Cooldowns.Groups[Group] = { Start = Cooldowns.TickCount, End = Cooldowns.TickCount + Ticks }
end

const function TickCooldowns(Cooldowns: Cooldowns)
	Cooldowns.TickCount += 1

	for Group, Entry in Cooldowns.Groups do
		if Entry.End <= Cooldowns.TickCount then
			Cooldowns.Groups[Group] = nil
		end
	end
end

return {
	CanGlideUsing = CanGlideUsing,
	CanGlide = CanGlide,
	Use = Use,
	UseOn = UseOn,
	UseAnimation = UseAnimation,
	UseDuration = UseDuration,
	UseOnRelease = UseOnRelease,
	FindProjectile = FindProjectile,
	ConsumableOf = ConsumableOf,
	SoundEventOf = SoundEventOf,
	ShouldEmitConsumeEffects = ShouldEmitConsumeEffects,
	ConsumeSound = ConsumeSound,
	Instrument = Instrument,
	TridentSpinStrength = TridentSpinStrength,
	RiptidePush = RiptidePush,
	IsChargedCrossbow = IsChargedCrossbow,
	NextDamageWillBreak = NextDamageWillBreak,
	ChargeDuration = ChargeDuration,
	BowPower = BowPower,
	CrossbowPower = CrossbowPower,
	UseSpeedMultiplier = UseSpeedMultiplier,
	CanSprintWhileUsing = CanSprintWhileUsing,
	BlockDelayTicks = BlockDelayTicks,
	AttackAnimation = AttackAnimation,
	InteractAnimation = InteractAnimation,
	AttackRange = AttackRange,
	InteractionRange = InteractionRange,
	MovementSpeed = MovementSpeed,
	CooldownGroup = CooldownGroup,
	UseCooldownTicks = UseCooldownTicks,
	CreateCooldowns = CreateCooldowns,
	CooldownPercent = CooldownPercent,
	IsOnCooldown = IsOnCooldown,
	AddCooldown = AddCooldown,
	TickCooldowns = TickCooldowns,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/JavaRandom"] = function(require)

const TwoTo24 = 16777216
const TwoTo31 = 2147483648
const TwoTo32 = 4294967296
const TwoTo48 = 281474976710656
const MultiplierHigh = 1502
const MultiplierLow = 15525485
const Increment = 11
const FloatBits = 24

export type JavaRandom = {
	High: number,
	Low: number,
}

const function SetSeed(Random: JavaRandom, Seed: number)
	const Wrapped = Seed % TwoTo48

	Random.High = bit32.bxor(Wrapped // TwoTo24, MultiplierHigh)
	Random.Low = bit32.bxor(Wrapped % TwoTo24, MultiplierLow)
end

const function SetSeedInt(Random: JavaRandom, Product: number)
	const Wrapped = (Product + TwoTo31) % TwoTo32 - TwoTo31

	SetSeed(Random, Wrapped)
end

const function Create(Seed: number): JavaRandom
	const Random = { High = 0, Low = 0 }

	SetSeed(Random, Seed)

	return Random
end

const function Next(Random: JavaRandom, Bits: number): number
	const LowProduct = Random.Low * MultiplierLow + Increment
	const Carry = LowProduct // TwoTo24
	const HighProduct = Random.High * MultiplierLow + Random.Low * MultiplierHigh + Carry

	Random.Low = LowProduct % TwoTo24
	Random.High = HighProduct % TwoTo24

	const Value = (Random.High * TwoTo24 + Random.Low) // 2 ^ (48 - Bits)

	return if Value >= TwoTo31 then Value - TwoTo32 else Value
end

const function NextInt(Random: JavaRandom, Bound: number): number
	if bit32.band(Bound, Bound - 1) == 0 then
		return (Bound * Next(Random, 31)) // TwoTo31
	end

	while true do
		const Sample = Next(Random, 31)
		const Modulo = Sample % Bound

		if Sample - Modulo + (Bound - 1) < TwoTo31 then
			return Modulo
		end
	end
end

const function NextFloat(Random: JavaRandom): number
	return Next(Random, FloatBits) / TwoTo24
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	SetSeed = SetSeed,
	SetSeedInt = SetSeedInt,
	NextInt = NextInt,
	NextFloat = NextFloat,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Projectile"] = function(require)

const Items = require("./Items")
const Mth = require("./Mth")

const Spread = 0.0172275
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const HandAngleDegrees = 80
const RocketItem = "minecraft:firework_rocket"

export type Type =
	"Arrow"
	| "SpectralArrow"
	| "Trident"
	| "Snowball"
	| "Egg"
	| "EnderPearl"
	| "SplashPotion"
	| "LingeringPotion"
	| "ExperienceBottle"
	| "WindCharge"
	| "FireworkRocket"

type Properties = {
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Gravity: number,
	Drag: number,
	WaterInertia: number,
	EyeHeight: number,
	EntityType: string,
}

const ArrowDrag = Mth.Float(0.99)
const ArrowWaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.6)
const TridentWaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.99)
const ThrownWaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.8)
const ArrowEyeHeight = Mth.Float(0.13)
const SmallEyeHeight = Mth.Float(Mth.Float(0.25) * Mth.Float(0.85))

const Properties: { [Type]: Properties } = {
	Arrow = { Width = 0.5, Height = 0.5, Gravity = 0.05, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ArrowWaterInertia, EyeHeight = ArrowEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:arrow" },
	SpectralArrow = { Width = 0.5, Height = 0.5, Gravity = 0.05, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ArrowWaterInertia, EyeHeight = ArrowEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:spectral_arrow" },
	Trident = { Width = 0.5, Height = 0.5, Gravity = 0.05, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = TridentWaterInertia, EyeHeight = ArrowEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:trident" },
	Snowball = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.03, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:snowball" },
	Egg = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.03, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:egg" },
	EnderPearl = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.03, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:ender_pearl" },
	SplashPotion = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.05, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:splash_potion" },
	LingeringPotion = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.05, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:lingering_potion" },
	ExperienceBottle = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0.07, Drag = ArrowDrag, WaterInertia = ThrownWaterInertia, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:experience_bottle" },
	WindCharge = { Width = 0.3125, Height = 0.3125, Gravity = 0, Drag = 1, WaterInertia = 1, EyeHeight = 0, EntityType = "minecraft:wind_charge" },
	FireworkRocket = { Width = 0.25, Height = 0.25, Gravity = 0, Drag = 1, WaterInertia = 1, EyeHeight = SmallEyeHeight, EntityType = "minecraft:firework_rocket" },
}

const function Triangle(Generator: Random, Center: number, Width: number): number
	return Center + Width * (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function FacingOf(Motion: vector): (number, number)
	const Horizontal = math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x + Motion.z * Motion.z)

	return Mth.Float(math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.x, Motion.z))), Mth.Float(math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.y, Horizontal)))
end

const function LerpRotation(Previous: number, Target: number): number
	local From = Previous

	while Target - From < -180 do
		From -= 360
	end

	while Target - From >= 180 do
		From += 360
	end

	return Mth.Lerp(Mth.Float(0.2), From, Target)
end

const function Shoot(Direction: vector, Power: number, Uncertainty: number, Generator: Random): vector
	const Shake = Spread * Uncertainty
	const Shaken = Mth.Normalize(Direction) + vector.create(Triangle(Generator, 0, Shake), Triangle(Generator, 0, Shake), Triangle(Generator, 0, Shake))

	return Shaken * Power
end

const function ViewDirection(XRot: number, YRot: number, YOffset: number): vector
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Pitch = Mth.Float(XRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Lift = Mth.Float((XRot + YOffset) * DegreesToRadians)

	return vector.create(-Mth.Sin(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch), -Mth.Sin(Lift), Mth.Cos(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch))
end

const function RocketHandAngle(MainHand: Items.ItemStack, OffHand: Items.ItemStack, YRot: number): vector
	const OnlyOffHand = Items.Is(OffHand, RocketItem) and not Items.Is(MainHand, RocketItem)

	return ViewDirection(0, YRot + (if OnlyOffHand then -HandAngleDegrees else HandAngleDegrees), 0) * 0.5
end

const function ShootFromRotation(XRot: number, YRot: number, YOffset: number, Power: number, Uncertainty: number, Generator: Random, ShooterMovement: vector, ShooterOnGround: boolean): vector
	const Motion = Shoot(ViewDirection(XRot, YRot, YOffset), Power, Uncertainty, Generator)

	return Motion + vector.create(ShooterMovement.x, if ShooterOnGround then 0 else ShooterMovement.y, ShooterMovement.z)
end

const function Of(Type: Type): Properties
	return Properties[Type]
end

return {
	Of = Of,
	Triangle = Triangle,
	FacingOf = FacingOf,
	LerpRotation = LerpRotation,
	Shoot = Shoot,
	ViewDirection = ViewDirection,
	ShootFromRotation = ShootFromRotation,
	RocketHandAngle = RocketHandAngle,
}

end
