_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Inventory/Menu"] = function(require)

const Items = require("../Items")
const Registry = require("../Registry")
const PlayerInventory = require("./PlayerInventory")

type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack
type Inventory = PlayerInventory.Inventory
type EquipmentSlot = PlayerInventory.EquipmentSlot

export type SlotKind = "Plain" | "Armor" | "Offhand" | "Crafting" | "Result" | "Creative" | "Trash"

export type MenuKind = "Inventory" | "ItemPicker"

export type Slot = {
	Index: number,
	Kind: SlotKind,
	ContainerSlot: number,
	EquipmentSlot: EquipmentSlot?,
	NoItemIcon: string?,
	X: number,
	Y: number,
}

export type Menu = {
	Kind: MenuKind,
	ContainerId: number,
	Inventory: Inventory,
	Slots: { Slot },
	Crafting: { ItemStack },
	Result: ItemStack,
	Creative: { ItemStack },
	Carried: ItemStack,
	CarriedMenu: Menu?,
	StateId: number,
	QuickcraftType: number,
	QuickcraftStatus: number,
	QuickcraftSlots: { Slot },
}

export type Drop = {
	Stack: ItemStack,
	Predicted: boolean,
}

export type Sound = {
	Event: string,
	Volume: number,
	Pitch: number,
	PitchSpread: number,
}

export type Owner = {
	Inventory: Inventory,
	Menu: Menu,
	InfiniteMaterials: boolean,
	Creative: boolean,
	Drops: { Drop },
	Sounds: { Sound },
}

const Inputs = {
	Pickup = 0,
	QuickMove = 1,
	Swap = 2,
	Clone = 3,
	Throw = 4,
	QuickCraft = 5,
	PickupAll = 6,
}

const Primary = 0
const Secondary = 1
const SlotClickedOutside = -999
const InventoryContainerId = 0
const OffhandInventorySlot = 40
const ContainerMaxStackSize = 99
const StateIdMask = 32767
const CraftingGridSize = 2
const SlotSize = 18
const PlayerEntityType = "minecraft:player"
const PreventArmorChange = "minecraft:prevent_armor_change"

const QuickcraftTypes = {
	Charitable = 0,
	Greedy = 1,
	Clone = 2,
}

const QuickcraftHeaders = {
	Start = 0,
	Continue = 1,
	End = 2,
}

const ArmorIndices: { [EquipmentSlot]: number } = {
	feet = 0,
	legs = 1,
	chest = 2,
	head = 3,
}

const ArmorSlotOrder: { EquipmentSlot } = { "head", "chest", "legs", "feet" }

const EmptyArmorIcons: { [EquipmentSlot]: string } = {
	head = "minecraft:container/slot/helmet",
	chest = "minecraft:container/slot/chestplate",
	legs = "minecraft:container/slot/leggings",
	feet = "minecraft:container/slot/boots",
}

const EmptyOffhandIcon = "minecraft:container/slot/shield"
const CreativeRows = 5
const CreativeColumns = 9
const CreativeLock = "minecraft:creative_slot_lock"

const MenuSlots = {
	Result = 0,
	CraftStart = 1,
	CraftEnd = 5,
	ArmorStart = 5,
	ArmorEnd = 9,
	InventoryStart = 9,
	InventoryEnd = 36,
	HotbarStart = 36,
	HotbarEnd = 45,
	Offhand = 45,
}

const function AddSlot(Slots: { Slot }, Kind: SlotKind, ContainerSlot: number, X: number, Y: number, EquipmentSlot: EquipmentSlot?, NoItemIcon: string?)
	table.insert(Slots, {
		Index = #Slots,
		Kind = Kind,
		ContainerSlot = ContainerSlot,
		EquipmentSlot = EquipmentSlot,
		NoItemIcon = NoItemIcon,
		X = X,
		Y = Y,
	})
end

const function CreateInventoryMenu(Inventory: Inventory): Menu
	const Slots: { Slot } = {}

	AddSlot(Slots, "Result", 0, 154, 28)

	for Y = 0, CraftingGridSize - 1 do
		for X = 0, CraftingGridSize - 1 do
			AddSlot(Slots, "Crafting", X + Y * CraftingGridSize, 98 + X * SlotSize, 18 + Y * SlotSize)
		end
	end

	for Index, EquipmentSlot in ArmorSlotOrder do
		AddSlot(Slots, "Armor", 40 - Index, 8, 8 + (Index - 1) * SlotSize, EquipmentSlot, EmptyArmorIcons[EquipmentSlot])
	end

	for Y = 0, 2 do
		for X = 0, 8 do
			AddSlot(Slots, "Plain", X + (Y + 1) * 9, 8 + X * SlotSize, 84 + Y * SlotSize)
		end
	end

	for X = 0, 8 do
		AddSlot(Slots, "Plain", X, 8 + X * SlotSize, 142)
	end

	AddSlot(Slots, "Offhand", OffhandInventorySlot, 77, 62, nil, EmptyOffhandIcon)

	const Crafting: { ItemStack } = {}

	for Index = 1, CraftingGridSize * CraftingGridSize do
		Crafting[Index] = Items.Empty
	end

	const Created: Menu = {
		Kind = "Inventory",
		ContainerId = InventoryContainerId,
		Inventory = Inventory,
		Slots = Slots,
		Crafting = Crafting,
		Result = Items.Empty,
		Creative = {},
		Carried = Items.Empty,
		CarriedMenu = nil,
		StateId = 0,
		QuickcraftType = -1,
		QuickcraftStatus = 0,
		QuickcraftSlots = {},
	}

	Created.CarriedMenu = Created

	return Created
end

const function PickerSlots(Slots: { Slot })
	table.clear(Slots)

	for Y = 0, CreativeRows - 1 do
		for X = 0, CreativeColumns - 1 do
			AddSlot(Slots, "Creative", Y * CreativeColumns + X, 9 + X * SlotSize, 18 + Y * SlotSize)
		end
	end

	for X = 0, PlayerInventory.SelectionSize - 1 do
		AddSlot(Slots, "Plain", X, 9 + X * SlotSize, 112)
	end
end

const function CreateItemPickerMenu(InventoryMenu: Menu): Menu
	const Slots: { Slot } = {}
	const Creative: { ItemStack } = {}

	PickerSlots(Slots)

	for Index = 1, CreativeRows * CreativeColumns do
		Creative[Index] = Items.Empty
	end

	return {
		Kind = "ItemPicker",
		ContainerId = InventoryContainerId,
		Inventory = InventoryMenu.Inventory,
		Slots = Slots,
		Crafting = InventoryMenu.Crafting,
		Result = Items.Empty,
		Creative = Creative,
		Carried = Items.Empty,
		CarriedMenu = InventoryMenu,
		StateId = 0,
		QuickcraftType = -1,
		QuickcraftStatus = 0,
		QuickcraftSlots = {},
	}
end

const function ShowPickerItems(Picker: Menu)
	PickerSlots(Picker.Slots)
end

const function ShowPickerInventory(Picker: Menu, InventoryMenu: Menu)
	table.clear(Picker.Slots)

	for Index, Target in InventoryMenu.Slots do
		const SlotIndex = Index - 1
		local X = 0
		local Y = 0

		if SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.ArmorStart and SlotIndex < MenuSlots.ArmorEnd then
			const Position = SlotIndex - MenuSlots.ArmorStart

			X = 54 + (Position // 2) * 54
			Y = 6 + (Position % 2) * 27
		elseif SlotIndex < MenuSlots.ArmorStart then
			X = -2000
			Y = -2000
		elseif SlotIndex == MenuSlots.Offhand then
			X = 35
			Y = 20
		else
			const Position = SlotIndex - MenuSlots.InventoryStart

			X = 9 + (Position % 9) * SlotSize
			Y = if SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.HotbarStart then 112 else 54 + (Position // 9) * SlotSize
		end

		AddSlot(Picker.Slots, Target.Kind, Target.ContainerSlot, X, Y, Target.EquipmentSlot, Target.NoItemIcon)
	end

	AddSlot(Picker.Slots, "Trash", 0, 173, 112)
end

const function CarriedOf(Menu: Menu): Menu
	return Menu.CarriedMenu :: Menu
end

const function IsCreativeContainer(Slot: Slot): boolean
	return Slot.Kind == "Creative" or Slot.Kind == "Trash"
end

const function ContainerOf(Slot: Slot): string
	return if IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then "Creative" elseif Slot.Kind == "Crafting" or Slot.Kind == "Result" then Slot.Kind else "Inventory"
end

const function UsesInventory(Slot: Slot): boolean
	return Slot.Kind ~= "Crafting" and Slot.Kind ~= "Result" and not IsCreativeContainer(Slot)
end

const function GetItem(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot): ItemStack
	if Slot.Kind == "Crafting" then
		return Menu.Crafting[Slot.ContainerSlot + 1]
	elseif Slot.Kind == "Result" then
		return Menu.Result
	elseif IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then
		return Menu.Creative[Slot.ContainerSlot + 1]
	end

	return PlayerInventory.GetItem(Menu.Inventory, Slot.ContainerSlot)
end

const function HasItem(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot): boolean
	return not Items.IsEmpty(GetItem(Menu, Slot))
end

const function SetChanged(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot)
	if UsesInventory(Slot) then
		PlayerInventory.SetChanged(Menu.Inventory)
	end
end

const function Set(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack)
	if Slot.Kind == "Crafting" then
		Menu.Crafting[Slot.ContainerSlot + 1] = Stack
	elseif Slot.Kind == "Result" then
		Menu.Result = Stack
	elseif IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then
		Menu.Creative[Slot.ContainerSlot + 1] = Stack
	else
		PlayerInventory.SetItem(Menu.Inventory, Slot.ContainerSlot, Stack)
	end

	SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
end

const function SlotMaxStackSize(Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack): number
	return math.min(if Slot.Kind == "Armor" then 1 else ContainerMaxStackSize, Items.MaxStackSize(Stack))
end

const function CanBeEquippedByPlayer(Equippable: { [string]: unknown }): boolean
	const AllowedEntities = Equippable.allowed_entities

	return AllowedEntities == nil or Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:entity_type", AllowedEntities, PlayerEntityType)
end

const function EquipmentSlotForItem(Stack: ItemStack): EquipmentSlot
	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: EquipmentSlot }?

	return if Equippable then Equippable.slot else "mainhand"
end

const function IsEquippableInSlot(Stack: ItemStack, EquipmentSlot: EquipmentSlot): boolean
	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { [string]: unknown }?

	if not Equippable then
		return EquipmentSlot == "mainhand"
	end

	return EquipmentSlot == Equippable.slot and CanBeEquippedByPlayer(Equippable)
end

const function MayPlace(Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	if Slot.Kind == "Result" then
		return false
	elseif Slot.Kind == "Armor" then
		return IsEquippableInSlot(Stack, Slot.EquipmentSlot :: EquipmentSlot)
	end

	return true
end

const function MayPickup(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Slot: Slot): boolean
	if Slot.Kind == "Creative" then
		const Stack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

		return Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or not Items.Has(Stack, CreativeLock)
	elseif Slot.Kind == "Armor" then
		const Stack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

		return Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Owner.Creative or not Items.HasEnchantmentEffect(Stack, PreventArmorChange)
	end

	return true
end

const function AllowModification(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Slot: Slot): boolean
	return MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Slot) and MayPlace(Slot, GetItem(Menu, Slot))
end

const function Remove(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot, Amount: number): ItemStack
	if Slot.Kind == "Result" then
		const Taken = Menu.Result

		Menu.Result = Items.Empty

		return Taken
	elseif Slot.Kind == "Crafting" or IsCreativeContainer(Slot) then
		const Stack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

		return if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and Amount > 0 then Items.Split(Stack, Amount) else Items.Empty
	end

	return PlayerInventory.RemoveItem(Menu.Inventory, Slot.ContainerSlot, Amount)
end

const function TryRemove(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Slot: Slot, Amount: number, MaxAmount: number): ItemStack?
	if not MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Slot) then
		return nil
	end

	if not AllowModification(Menu, Owner, Slot) and MaxAmount < Items.GetCount(GetItem(Menu, Slot)) then
		return nil
	end

	const Result = Remove(Menu, Slot, math.min(Amount, MaxAmount))

	if Items.IsEmpty(Result) then
		return nil
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(GetItem(Menu, Slot)) then
		Set(Menu, Slot, Items.Empty)
	end

	return Result
end

const function SafeTake(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Slot: Slot, Amount: number, MaxAmount: number): ItemStack
	const Taken = TryRemove(Menu, Owner, Slot, Amount, MaxAmount)

	if not Taken then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	SetChanged(Menu, Slot)

	return Taken
end

const function SafeInsert(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack, Amount: number): ItemStack
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or not MayPlace(Slot, Stack) then
		return Stack
	end

	const SlotStack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)
	const Transferable = math.min(math.min(Amount, Items.GetCount(Stack)), SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Stack) - Items.GetCount(SlotStack))

	if Transferable <= 0 then
		return Stack
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack) then
		Set(Menu, Slot, Items.Split(Stack, Transferable))
	elseif Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(SlotStack, Stack) then
		Items.Shrink(Stack, Transferable)
		Items.Grow(SlotStack, Transferable)
		Set(Menu, Slot, SlotStack)
	end

	return Stack
end

const function Drop(Owner: Owner, Stack: ItemStack)
	if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		table.insert(Owner.Drops, { Stack = Stack, Predicted = true })
	end
end

const function MoveItemStackTo(Menu: Menu, Stack: ItemStack, StartSlot: number, EndSlot: number, Backwards: boolean): boolean
	local AnythingChanged = false
	local Destination = if Backwards then EndSlot - 1 else StartSlot

	if Items.IsStackable(Stack) then
		while not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and (if Backwards then Destination >= StartSlot else Destination < EndSlot) do
			const Slot = Menu.Slots[Destination + 1]
			const Target = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

			if not Items.IsEmpty(Target) and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Stack, Target) then
				const Total = Items.GetCount(Target) + Items.GetCount(Stack)
				const MaxStackSize = SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Target)

				if Total <= MaxStackSize then
					Items.SetCount(Stack, 0)
					Items.SetCount(Target, Total)
					SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
					AnythingChanged = true
				elseif Items.GetCount(Target) < MaxStackSize then
					Items.Shrink(Stack, MaxStackSize - Items.GetCount(Target))
					Items.SetCount(Target, MaxStackSize)
					SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
					AnythingChanged = true
				end
			end

			Destination += if Backwards then -1 else 1
		end
	end

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Destination = if Backwards then EndSlot - 1 else StartSlot

		while if Backwards then Destination >= StartSlot else Destination < EndSlot do
			const Slot = Menu.Slots[Destination + 1]

			if Items.IsEmpty(GetItem(Menu, Slot)) and MayPlace(Slot, Stack) then
				Set(Menu, Slot, Items.Split(Stack, math.min(Items.GetCount(Stack), SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Stack))))
				SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
				AnythingChanged = true

				break
			end

			Destination += if Backwards then -1 else 1
		end
	end

	return AnythingChanged
end

const function QuickMoveStack(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number): ItemStack
	const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]

	if Menu.Kind == "ItemPicker" then
		if SlotIndex >= #Menu.Slots - PlayerInventory.SelectionSize and HasItem(Menu, Slot) then
			Set(Menu, Slot, Items.Empty)
		end

		return Items.Empty
	end

	if not HasItem(Menu, Slot) then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	const Stack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)
	const Clicked = Items.Copy(Stack)
	const EquipmentSlot = EquipmentSlotForItem(Clicked)
	const ArmorIndex = ArmorIndices[EquipmentSlot]
	local Moved = false

	if SlotIndex == MenuSlots.Result then
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.InventoryStart, MenuSlots.HotbarEnd, true)
	elseif SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.CraftStart and SlotIndex < MenuSlots.ArmorEnd then
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.InventoryStart, MenuSlots.HotbarEnd, false)
	elseif ArmorIndex and not HasItem(Menu, Menu.Slots[MenuSlots.ArmorEnd - ArmorIndex]) then
		const Position = MenuSlots.ArmorEnd - 1 - ArmorIndex

		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, Position, Position + 1, false)
	elseif EquipmentSlot == "offhand" and not HasItem(Menu, Menu.Slots[MenuSlots.Offhand + 1]) then
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.Offhand, MenuSlots.Offhand + 1, false)
	elseif SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.InventoryStart and SlotIndex < MenuSlots.InventoryEnd then
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.HotbarStart, MenuSlots.HotbarEnd, false)
	elseif SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.HotbarStart and SlotIndex < MenuSlots.HotbarEnd then
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.InventoryStart, MenuSlots.InventoryEnd, false)
	else
		Moved = MoveItemStackTo(Menu, Stack, MenuSlots.InventoryStart, MenuSlots.HotbarEnd, false)
	end

	if not Moved then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Set(Menu, Slot, Items.Empty)
	else
		SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
	end

	if Items.GetCount(Stack) == Items.GetCount(Clicked) then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	SetChanged(Menu, Slot)

	if SlotIndex == MenuSlots.Result then
		Drop(Owner, Stack)
	end

	return Clicked
end

const function CanItemQuickReplace(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot, Stack: ItemStack, IgnoreSize: boolean): boolean
	const SlotStack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

	if not Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack) and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Stack, SlotStack) then
		return Items.GetCount(SlotStack) + (if IgnoreSize then 0 else Items.GetCount(Stack)) <= Items.MaxStackSize(Stack)
	end

	return Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack)
end

const function QuickCraftPlaceCount(SlotCount: number, Type: number, Stack: ItemStack): number
	if Type == QuickcraftTypes.Charitable then
		return Items.GetCount(Stack) // SlotCount
	elseif Type == QuickcraftTypes.Greedy then
		return 1
	elseif Type == QuickcraftTypes.Clone then
		return Items.MaxStackSize(Stack)
	end

	return Items.GetCount(Stack)
end

const function QuickcraftMask(Header: number, Type: number): number
	return bit32.bor(bit32.band(Header, 3), bit32.lshift(bit32.band(Type, 3), 2))
end

const function CanTakeItemForPickAll(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot): boolean
	return if Menu.Kind == "ItemPicker" then not IsCreativeContainer(Slot) else Slot.Kind ~= "Result"
end

const function CanDragTo(Menu: Menu, Slot: Slot): boolean
	return Menu.Kind ~= "ItemPicker" or not IsCreativeContainer(Slot)
end

const function IsValidQuickcraftType(Type: number, Owner: Owner): boolean
	return Type == QuickcraftTypes.Charitable or Type == QuickcraftTypes.Greedy or (Type == QuickcraftTypes.Clone and Owner.InfiniteMaterials)
end

const function ResetQuickCraft(Menu: Menu)
	Menu.QuickcraftStatus = 0
	table.clear(Menu.QuickcraftSlots)
end

const function PlayBundleSound(Owner: Owner, Event: string)
	if Event == "item.bundle.insert_fail" then
		table.insert(Owner.Sounds, { Event = Event, Volume = 1, Pitch = 1, PitchSpread = 0 })
	else
		table.insert(Owner.Sounds, { Event = Event, Volume = 0.8, Pitch = 0.8, PitchSpread = 0.4 })
	end
end

const function BundleStackedOnOther(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Bundle: ItemStack, Slot: Slot, Action: number): boolean
	const Contents = Items.Bundle.Open(Bundle)

	if not Contents then
		return false
	end

	const Other = GetItem(Menu, Slot)

	if Action == Primary and not Items.IsEmpty(Other) then
		const Valid, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator = Items.Bundle.Weight(Other)
		local Inserted = 0

		if Valid and Items.Bundle.CanItemBeInBundle(Other) then
			const MaxAmount = Items.Bundle.MaxAmountToAdd(Contents, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator)

			Inserted = Items.Bundle.TryInsert(Contents, SafeTake(Menu, Owner, Slot, Items.GetCount(Other), MaxAmount))
		end

		PlayBundleSound(Owner, if Inserted > 0 then "item.bundle.insert" else "item.bundle.insert_fail")
		Items.Bundle.Close(Bundle, Contents)

		return true
	elseif Action == Secondary and Items.IsEmpty(Other) then
		const Removed = Items.Bundle.RemoveOne(Contents)

		if Removed then
			const Remainder = SafeInsert(Menu, Slot, Removed, Items.GetCount(Removed))

			if Items.GetCount(Remainder) > 0 then
				Items.Bundle.TryInsert(Contents, Remainder)
			else
				PlayBundleSound(Owner, "item.bundle.remove_one")
			end
		end

		Items.Bundle.Close(Bundle, Contents)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function BundleOtherStackedOnMe(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Bundle: ItemStack, Other: ItemStack, Slot: Slot, Action: number): boolean
	if Action == Primary and Items.IsEmpty(Other) then
		Items.Bundle.ToggleSelectedItemOf(Bundle, Items.NoSelectedItem)

		return false
	end

	const Contents = Items.Bundle.Open(Bundle)

	if not Contents then
		return false
	end

	if Action == Primary and not Items.IsEmpty(Other) then
		const Inserted = if AllowModification(Menu, Owner, Slot) then Items.Bundle.TryInsert(Contents, Other) else 0

		PlayBundleSound(Owner, if Inserted > 0 then "item.bundle.insert" else "item.bundle.insert_fail")
		Items.Bundle.Close(Bundle, Contents)

		return true
	elseif Action == Secondary and Items.IsEmpty(Other) then
		if AllowModification(Menu, Owner, Slot) then
			const Removed = Items.Bundle.RemoveOne(Contents)

			if Removed then
				PlayBundleSound(Owner, "item.bundle.remove_one")
				CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Removed
			end
		end

		Items.Bundle.Close(Bundle, Contents)

		return true
	end

	Items.Bundle.ToggleSelectedItemOf(Bundle, Items.NoSelectedItem)

	return false
end

const function TryItemClickBehaviourOverride(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, Action: number, Slot: Slot, Clicked: ItemStack, Carried: ItemStack): boolean
	if Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Carried), "BundleItem") and BundleStackedOnOther(Menu, Owner, Carried, Slot, Action) then
		return true
	end

	return Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Clicked), "BundleItem") and BundleOtherStackedOnMe(Menu, Owner, Clicked, Carried, Slot, Action)
end

const function ClickQuickCraft(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Button: number): number?
	const ExpectedStatus = Menu.QuickcraftStatus

	Menu.QuickcraftStatus = bit32.band(Button, 3)

	if (ExpectedStatus ~= QuickcraftHeaders.Continue or Menu.QuickcraftStatus ~= QuickcraftHeaders.End) and ExpectedStatus ~= Menu.QuickcraftStatus then
		ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
	elseif Items.IsEmpty(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried) then
		ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
	elseif Menu.QuickcraftStatus == QuickcraftHeaders.Start then
		Menu.QuickcraftType = bit32.band(bit32.rshift(Button, 2), 3)

		if IsValidQuickcraftType(Menu.QuickcraftType, Owner) then
			Menu.QuickcraftStatus = QuickcraftHeaders.Continue
			table.clear(Menu.QuickcraftSlots)
		else
			ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
		end
	elseif Menu.QuickcraftStatus == QuickcraftHeaders.Continue then
		const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]
		const Carried = CarriedOf(Menu).Carried

		if
			Slot
			and CanItemQuickReplace(Menu, Slot, Carried, true)
			and MayPlace(Slot, Carried)
			and (Menu.QuickcraftType == QuickcraftTypes.Clone or Items.GetCount(Carried) > #Menu.QuickcraftSlots)
			and CanDragTo(Menu, Slot)
			and not table.find(Menu.QuickcraftSlots, Slot)
		then
			table.insert(Menu.QuickcraftSlots, Slot)
		end
	elseif Menu.QuickcraftStatus == QuickcraftHeaders.End then
		if #Menu.QuickcraftSlots == 1 then
			const Single = Menu.QuickcraftSlots[1].Index

			ResetQuickCraft(Menu)

			return Single
		end

		if #Menu.QuickcraftSlots > 0 then
			const Source = Items.Copy(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried)

			if Items.IsEmpty(Source) then
				ResetQuickCraft(Menu)

				return nil
			end

			local Remaining = Items.GetCount(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried)

			for _, Slot in Menu.QuickcraftSlots do
				const Carried = CarriedOf(Menu).Carried

				if
					CanItemQuickReplace(Menu, Slot, Carried, true)
					and MayPlace(Slot, Carried)
					and (Menu.QuickcraftType == QuickcraftTypes.Clone or Items.GetCount(Carried) >= #Menu.QuickcraftSlots)
					and CanDragTo(Menu, Slot)
				then
					const Carry = if HasItem(Menu, Slot) then Items.GetCount(GetItem(Menu, Slot)) else 0
					const MaxSize = math.min(Items.MaxStackSize(Source), SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Source))
					const NewCount = math.min(QuickCraftPlaceCount(#Menu.QuickcraftSlots, Menu.QuickcraftType, Source) + Carry, MaxSize)

					Remaining -= NewCount - Carry
					Set(Menu, Slot, Items.CopyWithCount(Source, NewCount))
				end
			end

			Items.SetCount(Source, Remaining)
			CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Source
		end

		ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
	else
		ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
	end

	return nil
end

const function ClickPickup(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Action: number)
	if SlotIndex < 0 then
		return
	end

	const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]
	const ClickedStack = GetItem(Menu, Slot)
	const Carried = CarriedOf(Menu).Carried

	if not TryItemClickBehaviourOverride(Menu, Owner, Action, Slot, ClickedStack, Carried) then
		if Items.IsEmpty(ClickedStack) then
			if not Items.IsEmpty(Carried) then
				CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = SafeInsert(Menu, Slot, Carried, if Action == Primary then Items.GetCount(Carried) else 1)
			end
		elseif MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Slot) then
			if Items.IsEmpty(Carried) then
				const Amount = if Action == Primary then Items.GetCount(ClickedStack) else (Items.GetCount(ClickedStack) + 1) // 2
				const Taken = TryRemove(Menu, Owner, Slot, Amount, math.huge)

				if Taken then
					CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Taken
					SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
				end
			elseif MayPlace(Slot, Carried) then
				if Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(ClickedStack, Carried) then
					CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = SafeInsert(Menu, Slot, Carried, if Action == Primary then Items.GetCount(Carried) else 1)
				elseif Items.GetCount(Carried) <= SlotMaxStackSize(Slot, Carried) then
					CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = ClickedStack
					Set(Menu, Slot, Carried)
				end
			elseif Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(ClickedStack, Carried) then
				const Taken = TryRemove(Menu, Owner, Slot, Items.GetCount(ClickedStack), Items.MaxStackSize(Carried) - Items.GetCount(Carried))

				if Taken then
					Items.Grow(Carried, Items.GetCount(Taken))
					SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	SetChanged(Menu, Slot)
end

const function ClickSwap(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Button: number)
	const Inventory = Menu.Inventory
	const Source = PlayerInventory.GetItem(Inventory, Button)
	const Target = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]
	const TargetStack = GetItem(Menu, Target)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Source) and Items.IsEmpty(TargetStack) then
		return
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(Source) then
		if MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Target) then
			PlayerInventory.SetItem(Inventory, Button, TargetStack)
			Set(Menu, Target, Items.Empty)
			SetChanged(Menu, Target)
		end
	elseif Items.IsEmpty(TargetStack) then
		if MayPlace(Target, Source) then
			const MaxStackSize = SlotMaxStackSize(Target, Source)

			if Items.GetCount(Source) > MaxStackSize then
				Set(Menu, Target, Items.Split(Source, MaxStackSize))
			else
				PlayerInventory.SetItem(Inventory, Button, Items.Empty)
				Set(Menu, Target, Source)
			end
		end
	elseif MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Target) and MayPlace(Target, Source) then
		const MaxStackSize = SlotMaxStackSize(Target, Source)

		if Items.GetCount(Source) > MaxStackSize then
			Set(Menu, Target, Items.Split(Source, MaxStackSize))
			SetChanged(Menu, Target)

			if not PlayerInventory.Add(Inventory, TargetStack, Owner.InfiniteMaterials) then
				Drop(Owner, TargetStack)
			end
		else
			PlayerInventory.SetItem(Inventory, Button, TargetStack)
			Set(Menu, Target, Source)
			SetChanged(Menu, Target)
		end
	end
end

const function ClickThrow(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Button: number)
	const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]
	const Amount = if Button == 0 then 1 else Items.GetCount(GetItem(Menu, Slot))
	local Thrown = SafeTake(Menu, Owner, Slot, Amount, math.huge)

	Drop(Owner, Thrown)

	if Button == 1 then
		while not Items.IsEmpty(Thrown) and Items.IsSameItem(GetItem(Menu, Slot), Thrown) do
			Thrown = SafeTake(Menu, Owner, Slot, Amount, math.huge)
			Drop(Owner, Thrown)
		end
	end
end

const function ClickPickupAll(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Button: number)
	const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]
	const Carried = CarriedOf(Menu).Carried

	if Items.IsEmpty(Carried) or (HasItem(Menu, Slot) and MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Slot)) then
		return
	end

	const Start = if Button == 0 then 0 else #Menu.Slots - 1
	const Step = if Button == 0 then 1 else -1

	for Pass = 0, 1 do
		local Index = Start

		while Index >= 0 and Index < #Menu.Slots and Items.GetCount(Carried) < Items.MaxStackSize(Carried) do
			const Target = Menu.Slots[Index + 1]

			if HasItem(Menu, Target) and CanItemQuickReplace(Menu, Target, Carried, true) and MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Target) and CanTakeItemForPickAll(Menu, Target) then
				const TargetStack = GetItem(Menu, Target)

				if Pass ~= 0 or Items.GetCount(TargetStack) ~= Items.MaxStackSize(TargetStack) then
					const Taken = SafeTake(Menu, Owner, Target, Items.GetCount(TargetStack), Items.MaxStackSize(Carried) - Items.GetCount(Carried))

					Items.Grow(Carried, Items.GetCount(Taken))
				end
			end

			Index += Step
		end
	end
end

const function Clicked(Menu: Menu, Owner: Owner, SlotIndex: number, Button: number, Input: number)
	if Input == Inputs.QuickCraft then
		const Single = ClickQuickCraft(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex, Button)

		if Single then
			Clicked(Menu, Owner, Single, Menu.QuickcraftType, Inputs.Pickup)
		end
	elseif Menu.QuickcraftStatus ~= 0 then
		ResetQuickCraft(Menu)
	elseif (Input == Inputs.Pickup or Input == Inputs.QuickMove) and (Button == Primary or Button == Secondary) then
		if SlotIndex == SlotClickedOutside then
			if not Items.IsEmpty(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried) then
				if Button == Primary then
					Drop(Owner, CarriedOf(Menu).Carried)
					CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Items.Empty
				else
					Drop(Owner, Items.Split(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried, 1))
				end
			end
		elseif Input == Inputs.QuickMove then
			if SlotIndex < 0 then
				return
			end

			const Slot = Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1]

			if not MayPickup(Menu, Owner, Slot) then
				return
			end

			local Moved = QuickMoveStack(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex)

			while not Items.IsEmpty(Moved) and Items.IsSameItem(GetItem(Menu, Slot), Moved) do
				Moved = QuickMoveStack(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex)
			end
		else
			ClickPickup(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex, Button)
		end
	elseif Input == Inputs.Swap and SlotIndex >= 0 and ((Button >= 0 and Button < PlayerInventory.SelectionSize) or Button == OffhandInventorySlot) then
		ClickSwap(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex, Button)
	elseif Input == Inputs.Clone and Owner.InfiniteMaterials and Items.IsEmpty(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried) and SlotIndex >= 0 then
		const Stack = GetItem(Menu, Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1])

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
			CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, Items.MaxStackSize(Stack))
		end
	elseif Input == Inputs.Throw and Items.IsEmpty(CarriedOf(Menu).Carried) and SlotIndex >= 0 then
		ClickThrow(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex, Button)
	elseif Input == Inputs.PickupAll and SlotIndex >= 0 then
		ClickPickupAll(Menu, Owner, SlotIndex, Button)
	end
end

const function IsValidSlotIndex(Menu: Menu, SlotIndex: number): boolean
	return SlotIndex == -1 or SlotIndex == SlotClickedOutside or SlotIndex < #Menu.Slots
end

const function SlotItem(Menu: Menu, SlotIndex: number): ItemStack
	return GetItem(Menu, Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1])
end

const function SetItem(Menu: Menu, SlotIndex: number, StateId: number, Stack: ItemStack)
	Set(Menu, Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1], Stack)
	Menu.StateId = StateId
end

const function SetByPlayer(Menu: Menu, SlotIndex: number, Stack: ItemStack)
	Set(Menu, Menu.Slots[SlotIndex + 1], Stack)
end

const function InitializeContents(Menu: Menu, StateId: number, Stacks: { ItemStack }, Carried: ItemStack)
	for Index, Stack in Stacks do
		Set(Menu, Menu.Slots[Index], Stack)
	end

	CarriedOf(Menu).Carried = Carried
	Menu.StateId = StateId
end

const function IncrementStateId(Menu: Menu): number
	Menu.StateId = bit32.band(Menu.StateId + 1, StateIdMask)

	return Menu.StateId
end

const function SetSelectedBundleItemIndex(Menu: Menu, SlotIndex: number, SelectedItem: number)
	if SlotIndex >= 0 and SlotIndex < #Menu.Slots then
		Items.Bundle.ToggleSelectedItemOf(SlotItem(Menu, SlotIndex), SelectedItem)
	end
end

const function IsHotbarSlot(SlotIndex: number): boolean
	return (SlotIndex >= MenuSlots.HotbarStart and SlotIndex < MenuSlots.HotbarEnd) or SlotIndex == MenuSlots.Offhand
end

return {
	Inputs = Inputs,
	SlotClickedOutside = SlotClickedOutside,
	QuickcraftTypes = QuickcraftTypes,
	QuickcraftHeaders = QuickcraftHeaders,
	MenuSlots = MenuSlots,
	CreateInventoryMenu = CreateInventoryMenu,
	Clicked = Clicked,
	QuickcraftMask = QuickcraftMask,
	IsValidSlotIndex = IsValidSlotIndex,
	IsHotbarSlot = IsHotbarSlot,
	SlotItem = SlotItem,
	SetItem = SetItem,
	SetByPlayer = SetByPlayer,
	InitializeContents = InitializeContents,
	IncrementStateId = IncrementStateId,
	SetSelectedBundleItemIndex = SetSelectedBundleItemIndex,
	CreateItemPickerMenu = CreateItemPickerMenu,
	ShowPickerItems = ShowPickerItems,
	ShowPickerInventory = ShowPickerInventory,
	CarriedOf = CarriedOf,
	IsCreativeContainer = IsCreativeContainer,
	ContainerOf = ContainerOf,
	HasItem = HasItem,
	MayPlace = MayPlace,
	MayPickup = MayPickup,
	SlotMaxStackSize = SlotMaxStackSize,
	CanItemQuickReplace = CanItemQuickReplace,
	QuickCraftPlaceCount = QuickCraftPlaceCount,
	CanTakeItemForPickAll = CanTakeItemForPickAll,
	CanDragTo = CanDragTo,
	GetItem = GetItem,
	Set = Set,
	Remove = Remove,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Inventory/PlayerInventory"] = function(require)

const Items = require("../Items")

type ItemStack = Items.ItemStack

export type EquipmentSlot = "mainhand" | "offhand" | "feet" | "legs" | "chest" | "head" | "body" | "saddle"

export type Inventory = {
	Items: { ItemStack },
	Equipment: { [EquipmentSlot]: ItemStack },
	Selected: number,
	TimesChanged: number,
}

const Size = 36
const ContainerSize = 43
const SelectionSize = 9
const ContainerMaxStackSize = 99
const PopTimeDuration = 5
const NotFound = -1

const EquipmentSlots: { EquipmentSlot } = { "mainhand", "offhand", "feet", "legs", "chest", "head", "body", "saddle" }

const EquipmentBySlot: { [number]: EquipmentSlot } = {
	[36] = "feet",
	[37] = "legs",
	[38] = "chest",
	[39] = "head",
	[40] = "offhand",
	[41] = "body",
	[42] = "saddle",
}

const function Create(): Inventory
	const Main: { ItemStack } = {}

	for Index = 1, Size do
		Main[Index] = Items.Empty
	end

	return {
		Items = Main,
		Equipment = {
			offhand = Items.Empty,
			feet = Items.Empty,
			legs = Items.Empty,
			chest = Items.Empty,
			head = Items.Empty,
			body = Items.Empty,
			saddle = Items.Empty,
		},
		Selected = 0,
		TimesChanged = 0,
	}
end

const function IsHotbarSlot(Slot: number): boolean
	return Slot >= 0 and Slot < SelectionSize
end

const function GetItem(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: number): ItemStack
	if Slot < Size then
		return Inventory.Items[Slot + 1]
	end

	const Equipment = EquipmentBySlot[Slot]

	return if Equipment then Inventory.Equipment[Equipment] else Items.Empty
end

const function SetItem(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: number, Stack: ItemStack)
	if Slot < Size then
		Inventory.Items[Slot + 1] = Stack
	end

	const Equipment = EquipmentBySlot[Slot]

	if Equipment then
		Inventory.Equipment[Equipment] = Stack
	end
end

const function RemoveItem(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: number, Count: number): ItemStack
	const Stack = GetItem(Inventory, Slot)

	if (Slot < Size or EquipmentBySlot[Slot]) and not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and (Slot >= Size or Count > 0) then
		return Items.Split(Stack, Count)
	end

	return Items.Empty
end

const function GetSelectedItem(Inventory: Inventory): ItemStack
	return Inventory.Items[Inventory.Selected + 1]
end

const function RemoveFromSelected(Inventory: Inventory, All: boolean): ItemStack
	const Selected = GetSelectedItem(Inventory)

	return if Items.IsEmpty(Selected) then Items.Empty else RemoveItem(Inventory, Inventory.Selected, if All then Items.GetCount(Selected) else 1)
end

const function SetSelectedSlot(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: number)
	if not IsHotbarSlot(Slot) then
		error("Invalid selected slot")
	end

	Inventory.Selected = Slot
end

const function GetEquipment(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: EquipmentSlot): ItemStack
	return if Slot == "mainhand" then GetSelectedItem(Inventory) else Inventory.Equipment[Slot]
end

const function SetEquipment(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: EquipmentSlot, Stack: ItemStack): ItemStack
	const Previous = GetEquipment(Inventory, Slot)

	if Slot == "mainhand" then
		Inventory.Items[Inventory.Selected + 1] = Stack
	else
		Inventory.Equipment[Slot] = Stack
	end

	return Previous
end

const function SetChanged(Inventory: Inventory)
	Inventory.TimesChanged += 1
end

const function MaxStackSize(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return math.min(ContainerMaxStackSize, Items.MaxStackSize(Stack))
end

const function HasRemainingSpaceForItem(SlotStack: ItemStack, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return not Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack) and Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(SlotStack, Stack) and Items.IsStackable(SlotStack) and Items.GetCount(SlotStack) < MaxStackSize(SlotStack)
end

const function GetFreeSlot(Inventory: Inventory): number
	for Index = 1, Size do
		if Items.IsEmpty(Inventory.Items[Index]) then
			return Index - 1
		end
	end

	return NotFound
end

const function GetSlotWithRemainingSpace(Inventory: Inventory, Stack: ItemStack): number
	if HasRemainingSpaceForItem(GetItem(Inventory, Inventory.Selected), Stack) then
		return Inventory.Selected
	end

	if HasRemainingSpaceForItem(GetItem(Inventory, 40), Stack) then
		return 40
	end

	for Index = 1, Size do
		if HasRemainingSpaceForItem(Inventory.Items[Index], Stack) then
			return Index - 1
		end
	end

	return NotFound
end

const function AddResourceTo(Inventory: Inventory, Slot: number, Stack: ItemStack): number
	local Count = Items.GetCount(Stack)
	local SlotStack = GetItem(Inventory, Slot)

	if Items.IsEmpty(SlotStack) then
		SlotStack = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, 0)
		SetItem(Inventory, Slot, SlotStack)
	end

	const ToAdd = math.min(Count, MaxStackSize(SlotStack) - Items.GetCount(SlotStack))

	if ToAdd == 0 then
		return Count
	end

	Count -= ToAdd
	Items.Grow(SlotStack, ToAdd)
	SlotStack.PopTime = PopTimeDuration

	return Count
end

const function AddResource(Inventory: Inventory, Stack: ItemStack): number
	local Slot = GetSlotWithRemainingSpace(Inventory, Stack)

	if Slot == NotFound then
		Slot = GetFreeSlot(Inventory)
	end

	return if Slot == NotFound then Items.GetCount(Stack) else AddResourceTo(Inventory, Slot, Stack)
end

const function Add(Inventory: Inventory, Stack: ItemStack, InfiniteMaterials: boolean, Slot: number?): boolean
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return false
	end

	if Items.IsDamaged(Stack) then
		const Target = Slot or GetFreeSlot(Inventory)

		if Target >= 0 then
			const Added = Items.CopyAndClear(Stack)

			Inventory.Items[Target + 1] = Added
			Added.PopTime = PopTimeDuration

			return true
		elseif InfiniteMaterials then
			Items.SetCount(Stack, 0)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	local LastSize = 0

	repeat
		LastSize = Items.GetCount(Stack)
		Items.SetCount(Stack, if Slot then AddResourceTo(Inventory, Slot, Stack) else AddResource(Inventory, Stack))
	until Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Items.GetCount(Stack) >= LastSize

	if Items.GetCount(Stack) == LastSize and InfiniteMaterials then
		Items.SetCount(Stack, 0)

		return true
	end

	return Items.GetCount(Stack) < LastSize
end

const function TickStack(Stack: ItemStack)
	if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) and Stack.PopTime > 0 then
		Stack.PopTime -= 1
	end
end

const function Tick(Inventory: Inventory)
	for _, Stack in Inventory.Items do
		TickStack(Stack)
	end
end

const function TickEquipment(Inventory: Inventory)
	for _, Stack in Inventory.Equipment do
		TickStack(Stack)
	end
end

return {
	EquipmentSlots = EquipmentSlots,
	Size = Size,
	ContainerSize = ContainerSize,
	SelectionSize = SelectionSize,
	PopTimeDuration = PopTimeDuration,
	TickEquipment = TickEquipment,
	RemoveFromSelected = RemoveFromSelected,
	NotFound = NotFound,
	Create = Create,
	IsHotbarSlot = IsHotbarSlot,
	GetItem = GetItem,
	SetItem = SetItem,
	RemoveItem = RemoveItem,
	GetSelectedItem = GetSelectedItem,
	SetSelectedSlot = SetSelectedSlot,
	GetEquipment = GetEquipment,
	SetEquipment = SetEquipment,
	SetChanged = SetChanged,
	MaxStackSize = MaxStackSize,
	GetFreeSlot = GetFreeSlot,
	GetSlotWithRemainingSpace = GetSlotWithRemainingSpace,
	Add = Add,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

const ItemStack = require("@self/ItemStack")
const Bundle = require("@self/Bundle")

export type ItemStack = ItemStack.ItemStack
export type Patch = ItemStack.Patch
export type BundleContents = Bundle.Contents

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Items/Bar"] = function(require)

const Argb = require("../Argb")
const Registry = require("../Registry")
const Bundle = require("./Bundle")
const ItemStack = require("./ItemStack")

type ItemStack = ItemStack.ItemStack

const BarSegments = 13

const function IsBundle(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Registry.IsInstance(ItemStack.ItemOf(Stack), "BundleItem")
end

const function IsVisible(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return if IsBundle(Stack) then Bundle.IsBarVisible(Stack) else ItemStack.IsDamaged(Stack)
end

const function Width(Stack: ItemStack): number
	if IsBundle(Stack) then
		return Bundle.BarWidth(Stack)
	end

	return math.clamp(math.round(BarSegments - ItemStack.DamageValue(Stack) * BarSegments / ItemStack.MaxDamage(Stack)), 0, BarSegments)
end

const function Color(Stack: ItemStack): number
	if IsBundle(Stack) then
		return Bundle.BarColor(Stack)
	end

	const Maximum = ItemStack.MaxDamage(Stack)

	return Argb.HsvToRgb(math.max(0, (Maximum - ItemStack.DamageValue(Stack)) / Maximum) / 3, 1, 1)
end

return {
	IsVisible = IsVisible,
	Width = Width,
	Color = Color,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Items/Bundle"] = function(require)

const Argb = require("../Argb")
const Registry = require("../Registry")
const ItemStack = require("./ItemStack")

type ItemStack = ItemStack.ItemStack

export type Contents = {
	Items: { ItemStack },
	WeightNumerator: number,
	WeightDenominator: number,
	SelectedItem: number,
}

const ContentsType = "minecraft:bundle_contents"
const RemovedContentsType = "!minecraft:bundle_contents"
const BeesType = "minecraft:bees"
const RemovedBeesType = "!minecraft:bees"
const MaxStackSizeType = "minecraft:max_stack_size"
const RemovedMaxStackSizeType = "!minecraft:max_stack_size"
const BarSegments = 12
const FullBarColor = Argb.Color(255, Argb.As8BitChannel(1), Argb.As8BitChannel(0.33), Argb.As8BitChannel(0.33))
const BarColorValue = Argb.Color(255, Argb.As8BitChannel(0.44), Argb.As8BitChannel(0.53), Argb.As8BitChannel(1))
const EmptyContents: { unknown } = {}
const MaximumInt = 2147483647
const NestedBundleDenominator = 16
const MaxShownItems = 12
const ColumnCount = 4

const function GreatestCommonDivisor(A: number, B: number): number
	A = math.abs(A)
	B = math.abs(B)

	while B ~= 0 do
		A, B = B, A % B
	end

	return A
end

const function Reduce(Numerator: number, Denominator: number): (number, number)
	const Divisor = math.max(GreatestCommonDivisor(Numerator, Denominator), 1)

	return Numerator // Divisor, Denominator // Divisor
end

const function Add(LeftNumerator: number, LeftDenominator: number, RightNumerator: number, RightDenominator: number): (number, number)
	return Reduce(LeftNumerator * RightDenominator + RightNumerator * LeftDenominator, LeftDenominator * RightDenominator)
end

const function FitsInt(Numerator: number, Denominator: number): boolean
	return math.abs(Numerator) <= MaximumInt and Denominator <= MaximumInt
end

const function TemplateComponent(Template: unknown, Type: string, RemovedKey: string): unknown?
	if type(Template) == "string" then
		return Registry.Item(Template).Components[Type]
	end

	const Fields = Template :: { id: string, components: { [string]: unknown }? }
	const Components = Fields.components

	if Components then
		if Components[RemovedKey] ~= nil then
			return nil
		elseif Components[Type] ~= nil then
			return Components[Type]
		end
	end

	return Registry.Item(Fields.id).Components[Type]
end

const function SingleWeight(ContentsNumerator: number, ContentsDenominator: number, Bees: { unknown }?, MaxStackSize: number, IsBundle: boolean): (boolean, number, number)
	if IsBundle then
		const Numerator, Denominator = Add(ContentsNumerator, ContentsDenominator, 1, NestedBundleDenominator)

		return FitsInt(Numerator, Denominator), Numerator, Denominator
	elseif Bees and #Bees > 0 then
		return true, 1, 1
	end

	return true, Reduce(1, MaxStackSize)
end

const function ContentsWeight(Templates: { unknown }): (boolean, number, number)
	local Numerator = 0
	local Denominator = 1

	for _, Template in Templates do
		const Nested = TemplateComponent(Template, ContentsType, RemovedContentsType) :: { unknown }?
		local NestedValid = true
		local NestedNumerator = 0
		local NestedDenominator = 1

		if Nested then
			NestedValid, NestedNumerator, NestedDenominator = ContentsWeight(Nested)
		end

		const Bees = TemplateComponent(Template, BeesType, RemovedBeesType) :: { unknown }?
		const MaxStackSize = (TemplateComponent(Template, MaxStackSizeType, RemovedMaxStackSizeType) or 1) :: number
		const Valid, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator = SingleWeight(NestedNumerator, NestedDenominator, Bees, MaxStackSize, Nested ~= nil)
		const Count = if type(Template) == "table" then (Template :: { count: number? }).count or 1 else 1

		if not NestedValid or not Valid then
			return false, 0, 1
		end

		Numerator, Denominator = Add(Numerator, Denominator, ItemNumerator * Count, ItemDenominator)

		if not FitsInt(Numerator, Denominator) then
			return false, 0, 1
		end
	end

	return true, Numerator, Denominator
end

const function Weight(Stack: ItemStack): (boolean, number, number)
	const Templates = ItemStack.Get(Stack, ContentsType) :: { unknown }?
	local ContentsValid = true
	local ContentsNumerator = 0
	local ContentsDenominator = 1

	if Templates then
		ContentsValid, ContentsNumerator, ContentsDenominator = ContentsWeight(Templates)
	end

	const Valid, Numerator, Denominator = SingleWeight(ContentsNumerator, ContentsDenominator, ItemStack.Get(Stack, BeesType) :: { unknown }?, ItemStack.MaxStackSize(Stack), Templates ~= nil)

	return ContentsValid and Valid, Numerator, Denominator
end

const function Fullness(Stack: ItemStack): (number, number)
	const Templates = (ItemStack.Get(Stack, ContentsType) or EmptyContents) :: { unknown }
	const Valid, Numerator, Denominator = ContentsWeight(Templates)

	if not Valid then
		return 1, 1
	end

	return Numerator, Denominator
end

const function IsBarVisible(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Fullness(Stack) > 0
end

const function BarWidth(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Numerator, Denominator = Fullness(Stack)

	return math.min(1 + Numerator * BarSegments // Denominator, BarSegments + 1)
end

const function BarColor(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Numerator, Denominator = Fullness(Stack)

	return if Numerator >= Denominator then FullBarColor else BarColorValue
end

const function NumberOfItemsToShow(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Templates = (ItemStack.Get(Stack, ContentsType) or EmptyContents) :: { unknown }
	const Count = #Templates
	const Available = if Count > MaxShownItems then MaxShownItems - 1 else MaxShownItems
	const OnLastRow = Count % ColumnCount
	const EmptyOnLastRow = if OnLastRow == 0 then 0 else ColumnCount - OnLastRow

	return math.min(Count, Available - EmptyOnLastRow)
end

const function SelectedItemIndex(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return if ItemStack.Has(Stack, ContentsType) then Stack.SelectedBundleItem else ItemStack.NoSelectedItem
end

const function CanItemBeInBundle(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return not ItemStack.IsEmpty(Stack) and Stack.Item.CanFitInsideContainerItems
end

const function IsOutsideBounds(Contents: Contents, Index: number): boolean
	return Index < 0 or Index >= #Contents.Items
end

const function Open(Stack: ItemStack): Contents?
	const Templates = ItemStack.Get(Stack, ContentsType) :: { unknown }?

	if not Templates then
		return nil
	end

	const Valid, Numerator, Denominator = ContentsWeight(Templates)
	const Items: { ItemStack } = {}

	if not Valid then
		return { Items = Items, WeightNumerator = 0, WeightDenominator = 1, SelectedItem = ItemStack.NoSelectedItem }
	end

	for Index, Template in Templates do
		Items[Index] = ItemStack.FromTemplate(Template)
	end

	return { Items = Items, WeightNumerator = Numerator, WeightDenominator = Denominator, SelectedItem = Stack.SelectedBundleItem }
end

const function Close(Stack: ItemStack, Contents: Contents)
	const Templates: { unknown } = {}

	for Index, Item in Contents.Items do
		Templates[Index] = ItemStack.ToTemplate(Item)
	end

	ItemStack.Set(Stack, ContentsType, Templates)
	Stack.SelectedBundleItem = Contents.SelectedItem
end

const function MaxAmountToAdd(Contents: Contents, ItemNumerator: number, ItemDenominator: number): number
	const RemainingNumerator = Contents.WeightDenominator - Contents.WeightNumerator

	return math.max((RemainingNumerator * ItemDenominator) // (Contents.WeightDenominator * ItemNumerator), 0)
end

const function FindStackIndex(Contents: Contents, Stack: ItemStack): number?
	if not ItemStack.IsStackable(Stack) then
		return nil
	end

	for Index, Item in Contents.Items do
		if ItemStack.IsSameItemSameComponents(Item, Stack) then
			return Index
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function TryInsert(Contents: Contents, Stack: ItemStack): number
	if not CanItemBeInBundle(Stack) then
		return 0
	end

	const Valid, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator = Weight(Stack)

	if not Valid then
		return 0
	end

	const Amount = math.min(ItemStack.GetCount(Stack), MaxAmountToAdd(Contents, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator))

	if Amount == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	const Numerator, Denominator = Add(Contents.WeightNumerator, Contents.WeightDenominator, ItemNumerator * Amount, ItemDenominator)
	const Existing = FindStackIndex(Contents, Stack)

	Contents.WeightNumerator = Numerator
	Contents.WeightDenominator = Denominator

	if Existing then
		const Merged = table.remove(Contents.Items, Existing) :: ItemStack

		ItemStack.Shrink(Stack, Amount)
		table.insert(Contents.Items, 1, ItemStack.CopyWithCount(Merged, Merged.Count + Amount))
	else
		table.insert(Contents.Items, 1, ItemStack.Split(Stack, Amount))
	end

	return Amount
end

const function ToggleSelectedItem(Contents: Contents, Index: number)
	Contents.SelectedItem = if Contents.SelectedItem ~= Index and not IsOutsideBounds(Contents, Index) then Index else ItemStack.NoSelectedItem
end

const function RemoveOne(Contents: Contents): ItemStack?
	if #Contents.Items == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const RemoveIndex = if IsOutsideBounds(Contents, Contents.SelectedItem) then 0 else Contents.SelectedItem
	const Stack = ItemStack.Copy(table.remove(Contents.Items, RemoveIndex + 1) :: ItemStack)
	const Valid, ItemNumerator, ItemDenominator = Weight(Stack)

	if not Valid then
		error("Removed a bundle item whose weight is invalid")
	end

	const Numerator, Denominator = Add(Contents.WeightNumerator, Contents.WeightDenominator, -ItemNumerator * Stack.Count, ItemDenominator)

	Contents.WeightNumerator = Numerator
	Contents.WeightDenominator = Denominator
	ToggleSelectedItem(Contents, ItemStack.NoSelectedItem)

	return Stack
end

const function ToggleSelectedItemOf(Stack: ItemStack, Index: number)
	const Contents = Open(Stack)

	if Contents then
		ToggleSelectedItem(Contents, Index)
		Close(Stack, Contents)
	end
end

return {
	Weight = Weight,
	ContentsWeight = ContentsWeight,
	NumberOfItemsToShow = NumberOfItemsToShow,
	SelectedItemIndex = SelectedItemIndex,
	IsBarVisible = IsBarVisible,
	BarWidth = BarWidth,
	BarColor = BarColor,
	CanItemBeInBundle = CanItemBeInBundle,
	Open = Open,
	Close = Close,
	MaxAmountToAdd = MaxAmountToAdd,
	TryInsert = TryInsert,
	RemoveOne = RemoveOne,
	ToggleSelectedItemOf = ToggleSelectedItemOf,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Items/Enchantments"] = function(require)

const Registry = require("../Registry")
const ItemStack = require("./ItemStack")

type ItemStack = ItemStack.ItemStack

export type Modifier = {
	Attribute: string,
	Id: string,
	Amount: number,
	Operation: string,
}

const HandSlots: { [string]: true } = { mainhand = true, offhand = true }
const ArmorSlots: { [string]: true } = { feet = true, legs = true, chest = true, head = true, body = true }

const function LevelValue(Value: unknown, Level: number): number
	if type(Value) == "number" then
		return Value
	end

	const Fields = Value :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Type = Fields.type

	if Type == "minecraft:linear" then
		return (Fields.base :: number) + (Fields.per_level_above_first :: number) * (Level - 1)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:clamped" then
		return math.clamp(LevelValue(Fields.value, Level), Fields.min :: number, Fields.max :: number)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:fraction" then
		const Denominator = LevelValue(Fields.denominator, Level)

		return if Denominator == 0 then 0 else LevelValue(Fields.numerator, Level) / Denominator
	elseif Type == "minecraft:levels_squared" then
		return Level * Level + (Fields.added :: number)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:exponent" then
		return LevelValue(Fields.base, Level) ^ LevelValue(Fields.power, Level)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:lookup" then
		const Values = Fields.values :: { number }

		return if Level <= #Values then Values[Level] else LevelValue(Fields.fallback, Level)
	end

	error(`Unsupported level based value {Type}`)
end

const function GroupCovers(Group: string, Slot: string): boolean
	if Group == "any" then
		return true
	elseif Group == "hand" then
		return HandSlots[Slot] == true
	elseif Group == "armor" then
		return ArmorSlots[Slot] == true
	end

	return Group == Slot
end

const function SlotMatches(Groups: { string }, Slot: string, IsGroup: boolean): boolean
	for _, Group in Groups do
		if if IsGroup then Group == Slot else GroupCovers(Group, Slot) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function Modifiers(Stack: ItemStack, Slot: string, IsGroup: boolean, Output: { Modifier }): number
	const Enchantments = ItemStack.Get(Stack, "minecraft:enchantments") :: { [string]: number }?
	local Count = 0

	if not Enchantments then
		return 0
	end

	for Id, Level in Enchantments do
		const Definition = Registry.Enchantment(Id)
		const Effects = Definition and Definition.effects :: { [string]: unknown }?
		const Attributes = Effects and Effects["minecraft:attributes"] :: { { attribute: string, id: string, amount: unknown, operation: string } }?

		if Attributes and SlotMatches(Definition.slots :: { string }, Slot, IsGroup) then
			for _, Effect in Attributes do
				Count += 1

				local Entry = Output[Count]

				if not Entry then
					Entry = { Attribute = "", Id = "", Amount = 0, Operation = "" }
					Output[Count] = Entry
				end

				const Target = Entry :: Modifier

				Target.Attribute = Effect.attribute
				Target.Id = `{Effect.id}/{Slot}`
				Target.Amount = LevelValue(Effect.amount, Level)
				Target.Operation = Effect.operation
			end
		end
	end

	return Count
end

return {
	LevelValue = LevelValue,
	GroupCovers = GroupCovers,
	Modifiers = Modifiers,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Items/ItemStack"] = function(require)

const Registry = require("../Registry")
const PotionContents = require("./PotionContents")

export type Patch = { [string]: unknown }

export type ItemStack = {
	Item: Registry.Item,
	Count: number,
	PopTime: number,
	Patch: Patch,
	SelectedBundleItem: number,
}

const Removed = { Removed = true }
const RemovedPrefix = "!"
const NoSelectedItem = -1

const RarityColors: { [string]: string } = { common = "white", uncommon = "yellow", rare = "aqua", epic = "light_purple" }

const Empty: ItemStack = {
	Item = Registry.Air,
	Count = 0,
	PopTime = 0,
	Patch = {},
	SelectedBundleItem = NoSelectedItem,
}

const function Equal(A: unknown, B: unknown): boolean
	if A == B then
		return true
	end

	if type(A) ~= "table" or type(B) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	local Remaining = 0

	for Key, Value in A :: { [unknown]: unknown } do
		if not Equal(Value, (B :: { [unknown]: unknown })[Key]) then
			return false
		end

		Remaining += 1
	end

	for _ in B :: { [unknown]: unknown } do
		Remaining -= 1
	end

	return Remaining == 0
end

const function IsEmpty(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Stack == Empty or Stack.Item == Registry.Air or Stack.Count <= 0
end

const function ItemOf(Stack: ItemStack): Registry.Item
	return if IsEmpty(Stack) then Registry.Air else Stack.Item
end

const function Is(Stack: ItemStack, Id: string): boolean
	return ItemOf(Stack).Id == Id
end

const function Get(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string): unknown?
	if IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return nil
	end

	const Patched = Stack.Patch[Type]

	if Patched == nil then
		return Stack.Item.Components[Type]
	end

	return if Patched == Removed then nil else Patched
end

const function Has(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string): boolean
	return Get(Stack, Type) ~= nil
end

const function Set(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string, Value: unknown?)
	const Default = Stack.Item.Components[Type]

	if Equal(Value, Default) then
		Stack.Patch[Type] = nil
	else
		Stack.Patch[Type] = if Value == nil then Removed else Value
	end
end

const function Remove(Stack: ItemStack, Type: string)
	Stack.Patch[Type] = if Stack.Item.Components[Type] ~= nil then Removed else nil
end

const function Create(Item: Registry.Item, Count: number): ItemStack
	return {
		Item = Item,
		Count = Count,
		PopTime = 0,
		Patch = {},
		SelectedBundleItem = NoSelectedItem,
	}
end

const function FromPatch(Item: Registry.Item, Count: number, Patch: Patch): ItemStack
	const Stack = Create(Item, Count)

	for Type, Value in Patch do
		if Value == Removed then
			Remove(Stack, Type)
		else
			Set(Stack, Type, Value)
		end
	end

	return Stack
end

const function Copy(Stack: ItemStack): ItemStack
	if IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return Empty
	end

	return {
		Item = Stack.Item,
		Count = Stack.Count,
		PopTime = Stack.PopTime,
		Patch = table.clone(Stack.Patch),
		SelectedBundleItem = Stack.SelectedBundleItem,
	}
end

const function CopyWithCount(Stack: ItemStack, Count: number): ItemStack
	if IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return Empty
	end

	const Copied = Copy(Stack)

	Copied.Count = Count

	return Copied
end

const function GetCount(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return if IsEmpty(Stack) then 0 else Stack.Count
end

const function SetCount(Stack: ItemStack, Count: number)
	Stack.Count = Count
end

const function Grow(Stack: ItemStack, Amount: number)
	SetCount(Stack, GetCount(Stack) + Amount)
end

const function Shrink(Stack: ItemStack, Amount: number)
	Grow(Stack, -Amount)
end

const function Split(Stack: ItemStack, Amount: number): ItemStack
	const Taken = math.min(Amount, GetCount(Stack))
	const Result = CopyWithCount(Stack, Taken)

	Shrink(Stack, Taken)

	return Result
end

const function CopyAndClear(Stack: ItemStack): ItemStack
	if IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return Empty
	end

	const Result = Copy(Stack)

	SetCount(Stack, 0)

	return Result
end

const function MaxStackSize(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return (Get(Stack, "minecraft:max_stack_size") or 1) :: number
end

const function MaxDamage(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return (Get(Stack, "minecraft:max_damage") or 0) :: number
end

const function DamageValue(Stack: ItemStack): number
	return math.clamp((Get(Stack, "minecraft:damage") or 0) :: number, 0, MaxDamage(Stack))
end

const function SetDamageValue(Stack: ItemStack, Value: number)
	Set(Stack, "minecraft:damage", math.clamp(Value, 0, MaxDamage(Stack)))
end

const function IsDamageableItem(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return Has(Stack, "minecraft:max_damage") and not Has(Stack, "minecraft:unbreakable") and Has(Stack, "minecraft:damage")
end

const function IsDamaged(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return IsDamageableItem(Stack) and DamageValue(Stack) > 0
end

const function IsStackable(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	return MaxStackSize(Stack) > 1 and (not IsDamageableItem(Stack) or not IsDamaged(Stack))
end

const function IsEnchanted(Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	const Enchantments = Get(Stack, "minecraft:enchantments")

	return Enchantments ~= nil and next(Enchantments :: { [string]: number }) ~= nil
end

const function HasEnchantmentEffect(Stack: ItemStack, EffectType: string): boolean
	const Enchantments = Get(Stack, "minecraft:enchantments") :: { [string]: number }?

	if not Enchantments then
		return false
	end

	for Id in Enchantments do
		const Definition = Registry.Enchantment(Id)
		const Effects = Definition and Definition.effects :: { [string]: unknown }?

		if Effects and Effects[EffectType] ~= nil then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function PatchesEqual(A: Patch, B: Patch): boolean
	local Remaining = 0

	for Type, Value in A do
		const Other = B[Type]

		if Other == nil or (Value == Removed) ~= (Other == Removed) or not Equal(Value, Other) then
			return false
		end

		Remaining += 1
	end

	for _ in B do
		Remaining -= 1
	end

	return Remaining == 0
end

const function IsSameItem(A: ItemStack, B: ItemStack): boolean
	return ItemOf(A) == ItemOf(B)
end

const function IsSameItemSameComponents(A: ItemStack, B: ItemStack): boolean
	if ItemOf(A) ~= ItemOf(B) then
		return false
	end

	return (IsEmpty(A) and IsEmpty(B)) or PatchesEqual(A.Patch, B.Patch)
end

const function Matches(A: ItemStack, B: ItemStack): boolean
	return A == B or (GetCount(A) == GetCount(B) and IsSameItemSameComponents(A, B))
end

const function ComponentsMatchIgnoring(A: ItemStack, B: ItemStack, Patch: Patch, Ignored: { [string]: boolean }): boolean
	for Type in Patch do
		const Left = Get(A, Type)
		const Right = Get(B, Type)

		if (Left == nil) ~= (Right == nil) or (Left ~= nil and not Ignored[Type] and not Equal(Left, Right)) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function MatchesIgnoringComponents(A: ItemStack, B: ItemStack, Ignored: { [string]: boolean }): boolean
	if A == B then
		return true
	end

	if GetCount(A) ~= GetCount(B) or ItemOf(A) ~= ItemOf(B) then
		return false
	end

	if IsEmpty(A) and IsEmpty(B) then
		return true
	end

	return ComponentsMatchIgnoring(A, B, A.Patch, Ignored) and ComponentsMatchIgnoring(A, B, B.Patch, Ignored)
end

const function FromTemplate(Template: unknown): ItemStack
	if type(Template) == "string" then
		return Create(Registry.Item(Template), 1)
	end

	const Fields = Template :: { id: string, count: number?, components: Patch? }
	const Stack = Create(Registry.Item(Fields.id), Fields.count or 1)

	if Fields.components then
		for Key, Value in Fields.components do
			if string.sub(Key, 1, 1) == RemovedPrefix then
				Remove(Stack, string.sub(Key, 2))
			else
				Set(Stack, Key, Value)
			end
		end
	end

	return Stack
end

const function ToTemplate(Stack: ItemStack): { [string]: unknown }
	const Template: { [string]: unknown } = { id = Stack.Item.Id }

	if Stack.Count ~= 1 then
		Template.count = Stack.Count
	end

	if next(Stack.Patch) ~= nil then
		const Components: Patch = {}

		for Type, Value in Stack.Patch do
			if Value == Removed then
				Components[`{RemovedPrefix}{Type}`] = {}
			else
				Components[Type] = Value
			end
		end

		Template.components = Components
	end

	return Template
end

const function GetCustomName(Stack: ItemStack): unknown?
	const CustomName = Get(Stack, "minecraft:custom_name")

	if CustomName ~= nil then
		return CustomName
	end

	const Book = Get(Stack, "minecraft:written_book_content") :: { title: unknown }?
	const Title = Book and Book.title
	const Raw = if type(Title) == "table" then (Title :: { raw: string }).raw else Title :: string?

	if Raw and string.find(Raw, "%S") then
		return Raw
	end

	return nil
end

const function GetItemName(Stack: ItemStack): unknown
	const Item = ItemOf(Stack)

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CompassItem") and Has(Stack, "minecraft:lodestone_tracker") then
		return { translate = "item.minecraft.lodestone_compass" }
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "PlayerHeadItem") then
		const Profile = Get(Stack, "minecraft:profile")
		const Name = if type(Profile) == "table" then (Profile :: { name: string? }).name else Profile :: string?

		if Name then
			return { translate = `{Item.DescriptionId}.named`, with = { Name } }
		end
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "PotionItem") or Registry.IsInstance(Item, "TippedArrowItem") then
		const Contents = Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

		if Contents ~= nil then
			return { translate = `{Item.DescriptionId}.effect.{PotionContents.NameSuffix(Contents)}` }
		end
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "ShieldItem") then
		const BaseColor = Get(Stack, "minecraft:base_color") :: string?

		if BaseColor then
			return { translate = `{Item.DescriptionId}.{BaseColor}` }
		end
	end

	return if IsEmpty(Stack) then Item.Components["minecraft:item_name"] or "" else Get(Stack, "minecraft:item_name") or ""
end

const function GetHoverName(Stack: ItemStack): unknown
	const CustomName = GetCustomName(Stack)

	return if CustomName ~= nil then CustomName else GetItemName(Stack)
end

const function Rarity(Stack: ItemStack): string
	const Base = (Get(Stack, "minecraft:rarity") or "common") :: string

	if not IsEnchanted(Stack) then
		return Base
	elseif Base == "common" or Base == "uncommon" then
		return "rare"
	elseif Base == "rare" then
		return "epic"
	end

	return Base
end

const function GetDisplayName(Stack: ItemStack): unknown
	const Name = { text = "", extra = { GetHoverName(Stack) }, italic = if Has(Stack, "minecraft:custom_name") then true else nil }

	return { translate = "chat.square_brackets", with = { Name }, color = if IsEmpty(Stack) then nil else RarityColors[Rarity(Stack)] }
end

return {
	Empty = Empty,
	Removed = Removed,
	NoSelectedItem = NoSelectedItem,
	Equal = Equal,
	Create = Create,
	FromPatch = FromPatch,
	FromTemplate = FromTemplate,
	ToTemplate = ToTemplate,
	IsEmpty = IsEmpty,
	ItemOf = ItemOf,
	Is = Is,
	Get = Get,
	Has = Has,
	Set = Set,
	Remove = Remove,
	Copy = Copy,
	CopyWithCount = CopyWithCount,
	CopyAndClear = CopyAndClear,
	GetCount = GetCount,
	SetCount = SetCount,
	Grow = Grow,
	Shrink = Shrink,
	Split = Split,
	MaxStackSize = MaxStackSize,
	MaxDamage = MaxDamage,
	DamageValue = DamageValue,
	SetDamageValue = SetDamageValue,
	IsDamageableItem = IsDamageableItem,
	IsDamaged = IsDamaged,
	IsStackable = IsStackable,
	IsEnchanted = IsEnchanted,
	HasEnchantmentEffect = HasEnchantmentEffect,
	IsSameItem = IsSameItem,
	IsSameItemSameComponents = IsSameItemSameComponents,
	Matches = Matches,
	MatchesIgnoringComponents = MatchesIgnoringComponents,
	GetCustomName = GetCustomName,
	GetHoverName = GetHoverName,
	GetDisplayName = GetDisplayName,
	Rarity = Rarity,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Items/PotionContents"] = function(require)

const Argb = require("../Argb")
const Effects = require("../Effects")
const Registry = require("../Registry")

type Fields = {
	potion: string?,
	custom_color: number?,
	custom_effects: { { id: string, amplifier: number?, show_particles: boolean? } }?,
	custom_name: string?,
}

const NoName = "empty"

local RedSum = 0
local GreenSum = 0
local BlueSum = 0
local Weight = 0

const function FieldsOf(Contents: unknown): Fields?
	return if type(Contents) == "table" then Contents :: Fields else nil
end

const function PotionOf(Contents: unknown): Registry.Potion?
	const Fields = FieldsOf(Contents)
	const Id = if Fields then Fields.potion else Contents :: string

	return if Id then Registry.Potion(Id) else nil
end

const function NameSuffix(Contents: unknown): string
	const Fields = FieldsOf(Contents)

	if Fields and Fields.custom_name then
		return Fields.custom_name
	end

	const Potion = PotionOf(Contents)

	return if Potion then Potion.name else NoName
end

const function AddEffect(Id: string, Amplifier: number, Visible: boolean)
	const Effect = Registry.MobEffect(Id)

	if Visible and Effect then
		RedSum += (Amplifier + 1) * Argb.Red(Effect.color)
		GreenSum += (Amplifier + 1) * Argb.Green(Effect.color)
		BlueSum += (Amplifier + 1) * Argb.Blue(Effect.color)
		Weight += Amplifier + 1
	end
end

const function Color(Contents: unknown, Default: number): number
	const Fields = FieldsOf(Contents)

	if Fields and Fields.custom_color then
		return Fields.custom_color
	end

	const Potion = PotionOf(Contents)

	RedSum = 0
	GreenSum = 0
	BlueSum = 0
	Weight = 0

	if Potion then
		for _, Effect in Potion.effects do
			AddEffect(Effect.id, Effect.amplifier, Effect.visible)
		end
	end

	if Fields and Fields.custom_effects then
		for _, Effect in Fields.custom_effects do
			AddEffect(Effect.id, Effect.amplifier or 0, Effect.show_particles ~= false)
		end
	end

	if Weight == 0 then
		return Default
	end

	return Argb.Color(255, RedSum // Weight, GreenSum // Weight, BlueSum // Weight)
end

const function AllEffects(Contents: unknown, DurationScale: number): { Effects.Instance }
	const Fields = FieldsOf(Contents)
	const Potion = PotionOf(Contents)
	const Result: { Effects.Instance } = {}

	if Potion then
		for _, Effect in Potion.effects do
			const Created = Effects.Create(Effect.id, Effect.duration, Effect.amplifier, Effect.ambient, Effect.visible, Effect.showIcon)

			table.insert(Result, Effects.ScaledDuration(Created, DurationScale))
		end
	end

	if Fields and Fields.custom_effects then
		for _, Effect in Fields.custom_effects do
			table.insert(Result, Effects.ScaledDuration(Effects.FromCodec(Effect), DurationScale))
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function HasInstantEffects(Contents: unknown): boolean
	const Potion = PotionOf(Contents)

	if Potion then
		for _, Effect in Potion.effects do
			const Definition = Registry.MobEffect(Effect.id)

			if Definition and Definition.instantaneous then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	HasInstantEffects = HasInstantEffects,
	AllEffects = AllEffects,
	NameSuffix = NameSuffix,
	Color = Color,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Registry"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Data = require("@self/Data")

export type Item = {
	Id: string,
	ProtocolId: number,
	Class: string,
	DescriptionId: string,
	CanFitInsideContainerItems: boolean,
	HoverText: { unknown }?,
	Components: { [string]: unknown },
}

export type PotionEffect = {
	id: string,
	duration: number,
	amplifier: number,
	ambient: boolean,
	visible: boolean,
	showIcon: boolean,
}

export type Potion = {
	name: string,
	effects: { PotionEffect },
}

export type Attribute = {
	default: number,
	min: number,
	max: number,
	descriptionId: string,
	sentiment: "positive" | "neutral" | "negative",
	player: number?,
}

export type EffectModifier = {
	attribute: string,
	id: string,
	amount: number,
	operation: "add_value" | "add_multiplied_base" | "add_multiplied_total",
}

export type MobEffect = {
	color: number,
	category: "beneficial" | "harmful" | "neutral",
	descriptionId: string,
	instantaneous: boolean,
	modifiers: { EffectModifier },
}

type Payload = {
	ComponentTypes: { string },
	EntityTypes: { string },
	Values: { unknown },
	Items: { { Id: string, Class: string, DescriptionId: string, CanFitInsideContainerItems: boolean, HoverText: { unknown }?, Components: { number } } },
	BlockDescriptions: { [string]: string },
	Superclasses: { [string]: string },
	Potions: { [string]: Potion },
	MobEffects: { [string]: MobEffect },
	Attributes: { [string]: Attribute },
	Enchantments: { [string]: { [string]: unknown } },
	Tags: { [string]: { [string]: { string } } },
	DatapackRegistries: { [string]: { [string]: { [string]: unknown } } },
}

const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
const Payload = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: Payload
const Items: { Item } = {}
const ItemsById: { [string]: Item } = {}
const ComponentTypeIds: { [string]: number } = {}
const EntityTypes: { [string]: true } = {}
const Tags: { [string]: { [string]: { [string]: true } } } = {}
const TagsOfElement: { [string]: { [string]: { string } } } = {}

for _, Name in Payload.EntityTypes do
	EntityTypes[Name] = true
end

for Index, Name in Payload.ComponentTypes do
	ComponentTypeIds[Name] = Index - 1
end

for Index, Source in Payload.Items do
	const Components: { [string]: unknown } = {}

	for Pair = 1, #Source.Components, 2 do
		Components[Payload.ComponentTypes[Source.Components[Pair] + 1]] = Payload.Values[Source.Components[Pair + 1] + 1]
	end

	const Created = {
		Id = Source.Id,
		ProtocolId = Index - 1,
		Class = Source.Class,
		DescriptionId = Source.DescriptionId,
		CanFitInsideContainerItems = Source.CanFitInsideContainerItems,
		HoverText = Source.HoverText,
		Components = Components,
	}

	Items[Index] = Created
	ItemsById[Source.Id] = Created
end

for RegistryName, RegistryTags in Payload.Tags do
	const Sets: { [string]: { [string]: true } } = {}
	const ElementTags: { [string]: { string } } = {}

	for Tag, Members in RegistryTags do
		const Set: { [string]: true } = {}

		for _, Member in Members do
			const MemberTags = ElementTags[Member] or {}

			Set[Member] = true
			table.insert(MemberTags, Tag)
			ElementTags[Member] = MemberTags
		end

		Sets[Tag] = Set
	end

	Tags[RegistryName] = Sets
	TagsOfElement[RegistryName] = ElementTags
end

const function FindItem(Id: string): Item?
	return ItemsById[Id]
end

const function Item(Id: string): Item
	const Found = ItemsById[Id]

	if not Found then
		error(`Unknown item {Id}`)
	end

	return Found
end

const function ItemByProtocolId(ProtocolId: number): Item
	const Found = Items[ProtocolId + 1]

	if not Found then
		error(`Unknown item protocol id {ProtocolId}`)
	end

	return Found
end

const function ComponentTypeId(Name: string): number
	const Id = ComponentTypeIds[Name]

	if not Id then
		error(`Unknown data component type {Name}`)
	end

	return Id
end

const function ComponentTypeName(Id: number): string
	const Name = Payload.ComponentTypes[Id + 1]

	if not Name then
		error(`Unknown data component type id {Id}`)
	end

	return Name
end

const function ComponentTypeNames(): { string }
	return Payload.ComponentTypes
end

const function EntityTypeNames(): { string }
	return Payload.EntityTypes
end

const function MobEffectNames(): { string }
	const Names: { string } = {}

	for Id in Payload.MobEffects do
		table.insert(Names, Id)
	end

	table.sort(Names)

	return Names
end

const function IsComponentType(Name: string): boolean
	return ComponentTypeIds[Name] ~= nil
end

const function IsEntityType(Id: string): boolean
	return EntityTypes[Id] == true
end

const function IsInstance(Item: Item, Class: string): boolean
	local Current = Item.Class

	while Current ~= Class do
		const Superclass = Payload.Superclasses[Current]

		if not Superclass then
			return Class == "Item"
		end

		Current = Superclass
	end

	return true
end

const function Enchantment(Id: string): { [string]: unknown }?
	return Payload.Enchantments[Id]
end

const function Potion(Id: string): Potion?
	return Payload.Potions[Id]
end

const function MobEffect(Id: string): MobEffect?
	return Payload.MobEffects[Id]
end

const function Attribute(Id: string): Attribute
	const Found = Payload.Attributes[Id]

	if not Found then
		error(`Unknown attribute {Id}`)
	end

	return Found
end

const function BlockDescriptionId(Id: string): string
	const Found = Payload.BlockDescriptions[Id]

	if not Found then
		error(`Unknown block ${Id}`)
	end

	return Found
end

const function TagMembers(RegistryName: string, Tag: string): { string }
	return Payload.Tags[RegistryName][Tag] or {}
end

const function HasTag(RegistryName: string, Tag: string, Id: string): boolean
	const Members = Tags[RegistryName][Tag]

	return Members ~= nil and Members[Id] == true
end

const function IsTag(RegistryName: string, Tag: string): boolean
	const Sets = Tags[RegistryName]

	return Sets ~= nil and Sets[Tag] ~= nil
end

const function TagNames(RegistryName: string): { string }
	const Names: { string } = {}

	for Tag in Payload.Tags[RegistryName] do
		table.insert(Names, Tag)
	end

	table.sort(Names)

	return Names
end

const function TagsOf(RegistryName: string, Id: string): { string }
	return TagsOfElement[RegistryName][Id] or {}
end

const function DatapackEntry(RegistryName: string, Id: string): { [string]: unknown }?
	return Payload.DatapackRegistries[RegistryName][Id]
end

const function HolderSetContains(RegistryName: string, HolderSet: unknown, Id: string): boolean
	if type(HolderSet) == "string" then
		if string.sub(HolderSet, 1, 1) ~= "#" then
			return HolderSet == Id
		end

		return HasTag(RegistryName, string.sub(HolderSet, 2), Id)
	end

	return table.find(HolderSet :: { string }, Id) ~= nil
end

return {
	Air = Item("minecraft:air"),
	Items = Items,
	FindItem = FindItem,
	Item = Item,
	ItemByProtocolId = ItemByProtocolId,
	ComponentTypeId = ComponentTypeId,
	ComponentTypeName = ComponentTypeName,
	IsComponentType = IsComponentType,
	ComponentTypeNames = ComponentTypeNames,
	EntityTypeNames = EntityTypeNames,
	MobEffectNames = MobEffectNames,
	IsEntityType = IsEntityType,
	IsInstance = IsInstance,
	Enchantment = Enchantment,
	Potion = Potion,
	MobEffect = MobEffect,
	Attribute = Attribute,
	BlockDescriptionId = BlockDescriptionId,
	TagMembers = TagMembers,
	HasTag = HasTag,
	IsTag = IsTag,
	TagNames = TagNames,
	TagsOf = TagsOf,
	DatapackEntry = DatapackEntry,
	HolderSetContains = HolderSetContains,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Registry/Data"] = function(require)

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Language"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
const HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

const Data = require("@self/Data")

const NullArgument = "null"

const Decoded = EncodingService:DecompressBuffer(EncodingService:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(Data)), Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
const Strings = HttpService:JSONDecode(buffer.tostring(Decoded)) :: { [string]: string }

const function Translate(Key: string): string?
	return Strings[Key]
end

const function ArgumentText(Argument: unknown): string
	if type(Argument) == "number" then
		return if Argument == Argument // 1 then string.format("%d", Argument) else tostring(Argument)
	end

	return tostring(Argument)
end

const function DecomposeTemplate(Template: string): { string | number }?
	const Parts: { string | number } = {}
	local NextArgument = 1
	local Current = 1

	while true do
		const Start, Finish, Position, Kind = string.find(Template, "%%(%d*%$?)([A-Za-z%%]?)", Current)

		if not Start then
			break
		end

		if Start > Current then
			const Prefix = string.sub(Template, Current, Start - 1)

			if string.find(Prefix, "%", 1, true) then
				return nil
			end

			table.insert(Parts, Prefix)
		end

		const Explicit = string.match(Position, "^(%d+)%$$")

		if Position ~= "" and not Explicit then
			return nil
		end

		if Kind == "%" and Finish - Start == 1 then
			table.insert(Parts, "%")
		elseif Kind == "s" then
			if Explicit then
				table.insert(Parts, tonumber(Explicit) :: number)
			else
				table.insert(Parts, NextArgument)
				NextArgument += 1
			end
		else
			return nil
		end

		Current = Finish + 1
	end

	if Current <= #Template then
		const Tail = string.sub(Template, Current)

		if string.find(Tail, "%", 1, true) then
			return nil
		end

		table.insert(Parts, Tail)
	end

	return Parts
end

const function AppendPlain(Out: { string }, Value: unknown)
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		table.insert(Out, Value)

		return
	end

	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	const List = Value :: { unknown }

	if #List > 0 then
		for _, Child in List do
			AppendPlain(Out, Child)
		end

		return
	end

	const Component = Value :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Key = Component.translate

	if type(Component.text) == "string" then
		table.insert(Out, Component.text :: string)
	elseif type(Key) == "string" then
		const Template = Strings[Key] or (if type(Component.fallback) == "string" then Component.fallback :: string else Key)
		const Arguments = (Component.with or {}) :: { unknown }
		const Parts = DecomposeTemplate(Template)
		local Valid = Parts ~= nil

		if Parts then
			for _, Part in Parts do
				if type(Part) == "number" and Arguments[Part] == nil and Part > #Arguments then
					Valid = false
				end
			end
		end

		if Valid and Parts then
			for _, Part in Parts do
				if type(Part) == "string" then
					table.insert(Out, Part)
				else
					const Argument = Arguments[Part]

					if type(Argument) == "table" then
						AppendPlain(Out, Argument)
					else
						table.insert(Out, if Argument == nil then NullArgument else ArgumentText(Argument))
					end
				end
			end
		else
			table.insert(Out, Template)
		end
	end

	if type(Component.extra) == "table" then
		for _, Child in Component.extra :: { unknown } do
			AppendPlain(Out, Child)
		end
	end
end

const function PlainText(Component: unknown): string
	const Out: { string } = {}

	AppendPlain(Out, Component)

	return table.concat(Out)
end

return {
	Translate = Translate,
	ArgumentText = ArgumentText,
	DecomposeTemplate = DecomposeTemplate,
	PlainText = PlainText,
}

end
