_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Uuid"] = function(require)

const EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")

const MaximumLength = 36
const LongDigits = 16
const FieldDigits = { 8, 4, 4, 4, 12 }

const function Offline(Name: string): buffer
	const Digest = EncodingService:ComputeBufferHash(buffer.fromstring(`OfflinePlayer:{Name}`), Enum.HashAlgorithm.Md5)

	buffer.writeu8(Digest, 6, bit32.bor(bit32.band(buffer.readu8(Digest, 6), 0x0f), 0x30))
	buffer.writeu8(Digest, 8, bit32.bor(bit32.band(buffer.readu8(Digest, 8), 0x3f), 0x80))

	return Digest
end

const function Before(Left: buffer, Right: buffer): boolean
	for Half = 0, 8, 8 do
		for Index = Half, Half + 7 do
			local A = buffer.readu8(Left, Index)
			local B = buffer.readu8(Right, Index)

			if Index == Half then
				A = (A + 128) % 256
				B = (B + 128) % 256
			end

			if A ~= B then
				return A < B
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function FromString(Text: string): buffer?
	const Length = utf8.len(Text)

	if not Length or Length > MaximumLength then
		return nil
	end

	const Fields = string.split(Text, "-")

	if #Fields ~= #FieldDigits then
		return nil
	end

	const Hex: { string } = {}

	for Index, Field in Fields do
		const Digits = string.match(Field, "^%+?(%x+)$")

		if not Digits then
			return nil
		end

		const Significant = string.match(Digits, "^0*(.-)$") :: string

		if #Significant > LongDigits or (#Significant == LongDigits and (tonumber(string.sub(Significant, 1, 1), 16) :: number) >= 8) then
			return nil
		end

		const Width = FieldDigits[Index]
		const Padded = `{string.rep("0", Width)}{Significant}`

		table.insert(Hex, string.sub(Padded, -Width))
	end

	const Joined = table.concat(Hex)
	const Result = buffer.create(16)

	for Index = 0, 15 do
		buffer.writeu8(Result, Index, tonumber(string.sub(Joined, Index * 2 + 1, Index * 2 + 2), 16) :: number)
	end

	return Result
end

const function ToString(Uuid: buffer): string
	const Hex: { string } = {}

	for Index = 0, 15 do
		table.insert(Hex, string.format("%02x", buffer.readu8(Uuid, Index)))

		if Index == 3 or Index == 5 or Index == 7 or Index == 9 then
			table.insert(Hex, "-")
		end
	end

	return table.concat(Hex)
end

const function ToIntArray(Uuid: buffer): { number }
	const Result: { number } = {}

	for Offset = 0, 12, 4 do
		const Word = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(Uuid, Offset))

		table.insert(Result, if Word >= 0x80000000 then Word - 0x100000000 else Word)
	end

	return Result
end

return {
	Offline = Offline,
	Before = Before,
	FromString = FromString,
	ToString = ToString,
	ToIntArray = ToIntArray,
}

end

_MODULES["ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft/Advancements"] = function(require)

export type AdvancementType = "task" | "goal" | "challenge"

export type Advancement = {
	Title: string,
	Description: string,
	Type: AdvancementType,
	Icon: string,
}

const Definitions: { [string]: Advancement } = {
	["roblox:this_aint_right"] = {
		Title = "Powering Imagination",
		Description = "Hit a Roblox character",
		Type = "challenge",
		Icon = "noob_head",
	},
}

const function Get(Id: string): Advancement?
	return Definitions[Id]
end

const function ChatColor(Type: AdvancementType): string
	return if Type == "challenge" then "dark_purple" else "green"
end

const function Name(Advancement: Advancement): { [string]: unknown }
	const Color = ChatColor(Advancement.Type)
	const Tooltip = { text = Advancement.Title, color = Color, extra = { "\n", Advancement.Description } }

	return {
		translate = "chat.square_brackets",
		with = { { text = Advancement.Title, hover_event = { action = "show_text", value = Tooltip } } },
		color = Color,
	}
end

return {
	Get = Get,
	Name = Name,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft"] = function(require)

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Commands = require("@self/Commands")
const Connection = require("@self/Connection")
const Containers = require("@self/Containers")
const Entities = require("@self/Entities")
const ItemEntities = require("@self/ItemEntities")
const Orbs = require("@self/Orbs")
const Players = require("@self/Players")
const Projectiles = require("@self/Projectiles")
const Tracking = require("@self/Tracking")

const TickSeconds = 0.05
const MaximumTicksPerStep = 10

local Elapsed = 0

const function Step(DeltaTime: number)
	Elapsed += DeltaTime

	local Ticks = Elapsed // TickSeconds

	Elapsed -= Ticks * TickSeconds
	Ticks = math.min(Ticks, MaximumTicksPerStep)

	for _ = 1, Ticks do
		Entities.Tick()
		Players.Tick()
		Projectiles.Tick()
		Orbs.Tick()
		ItemEntities.Tick()
		Containers.Tick()
		Tracking.Tick()
		Connection.FlushAll()
	end
end

const function Receive(Player: Player, PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	if not Commands.Receive(Player, PacketId, Reader) then
		Players.Receive(Player, PacketId, Reader)
	end
end

const function Start()
	Connection.Start(Receive)
	Entities.Start()
	Players.Start()
	Commands.Start()
	local conn = RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(Step)
	_G.__MINECRAFT_SERVER_CONN = conn
end

return Start

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Players"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Damage = require("../Damage")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Containers = require("./Containers")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const ItemUse = require("./ItemUse")
const Living = require("./Living")
const Melee = require("./Melee")
const Settings = require("./Settings")
const Tracking = require("./Tracking")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Serverbound = Protocol.Serverbound
const EntityPhysics = Minecraft.Entity
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const SpawnSearchTop = 320
const SpawnSearchDepth = 640
const TeleportResendTicks = 20
const PoseDeflation = 1.0E-7
const GroundRange = 1
const SpectateReach = 3
const FaceTolerance = 1.0E-3

type ServerPlayer = Entities.ServerPlayer

const ServerPlayers: { [Player]: ServerPlayer } = {}
const HitboxOwners: { [Instance]: ServerPlayer } = {}
const FocusContainer = Instance.new("Folder")
const HitboxContainer = Instance.new("Folder")

FocusContainer.Name = "MinecraftFocus"
FocusContainer.Parent = workspace
HitboxContainer.Name = "MinecraftHitboxes"
HitboxContainer.Parent = workspace

local JoinOrder = 0

const function FreeJoinSkin(): Minecraft.Skin?
	for _, Skin in Settings.JoinSkins do
		local Taken = false

		for _, Existing in ServerPlayers do
			if Existing.Skin == Skin then
				Taken = true
			end
		end

		if not Taken then
			return Skin
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function GameModeId(GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode): number
	return (table.find(Protocol.GameModes, GameMode) :: number) - 1
end

const function Broadcast(Write: "Add" | "Remove" | "GameMode", Player: ServerPlayer)
	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Viewer)

		if Write == "Add" then
			Protocol.WritePlayerInfoAdd(Stream, Player.Id, Player.Name, GameModeId(Player.GameMode), Player.Skin)
		elseif Write == "Remove" then
			Protocol.WritePlayerInfoRemove(Stream, Player.Id)
		else
			Protocol.WritePlayerInfoGameMode(Stream, Player.Id, GameModeId(Player.GameMode))
		end
	end
end

const function SetCamera(Player: ServerPlayer, Camera: Entities.Entity?)
	const Old = Player.Camera or Player
	const New = Camera or Player

	Player.Camera = if New == Player then nil else New

	if Old ~= New then
		Entities.Teleport(Player, New.Position, Player.YRot, Player.XRot)
		Protocol.WriteSetCamera(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), New.Id)
	end
end

const function IsInRangeOfGround(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	const Collision = Minecraft.Collision
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Player)

	if not Collision.NoCollision(Min, Max) then
		return false
	end

	const Count = Collision.Gather(Min - vector.create(0, GroundRange, 0), vector.create(Max.x, Min.y, Max.z))

	return -Collision.CollideAxis(2, Min, Max, -GroundRange, Count) < GroundRange
end

const function UpdateEffectVisibility(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Invisible, Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Player.Effects["minecraft:invisibility"] ~= nil)
end

const function SetGameMode(Player: ServerPlayer, GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode): boolean
	if Player.GameMode == GameMode then
		return false
	end

	const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player)
	const Abilities = Player.Abilities

	Player.GameMode = GameMode
	Minecraft.Abilities.ApplyGameMode(Abilities, GameMode)

	if Abilities.Flying and GameMode ~= "spectator" and IsInRangeOfGround(Player) then
		Abilities.Flying = false
	end

	Player.Flying = Abilities.Flying
	Protocol.WritePlayerAbilities(Stream, Minecraft.Abilities.ToFlags(Abilities), Abilities.FlyingSpeed, Abilities.WalkingSpeed)
	Broadcast("GameMode", Player)

	if GameMode == "creative" then
		Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
		Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
	end

	Protocol.WriteGameMode(Stream, GameMode)

	if GameMode == "spectator" then
		ItemUse.Stop(Player)
	else
		SetCamera(Player, nil)
	end

	Protocol.WritePlayerAbilities(Stream, Minecraft.Abilities.ToFlags(Abilities), Abilities.FlyingSpeed, Abilities.WalkingSpeed)
	Containers.SetGameMode(Player.Player, GameMode, Abilities)
	UpdateEffectVisibility(Player)

	return true
end

const function ToggleCreative(Player: Player): boolean?
	const Target = ServerPlayers[Player]

	if not Target or Target.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const NextMode: Minecraft.GameMode = if Target.GameMode == "creative" then "survival" else "creative"
	SetGameMode(Target, NextMode)

	return NextMode == "creative"
end

const function Spectate(Player: ServerPlayer, TargetId: number?)
	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" or not TargetId then
		return
	end

	const Target = Entities.Get(TargetId)

	if not Target or not Target.IsLiving or not Entities.IsAlive(Target) or Target.GameMode == "spectator" then
		return
	end

	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Target)
	const Eye = Player.Position + vector.create(0, Player.EyeHeight, 0)
	const Reach = Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:entity_interaction_range", Player.Inventory, Player.Effects) + SpectateReach

	if EntityPhysics.DistanceToBoxSquared(Min, Max, Eye) < Reach * Reach then
		SetCamera(Player, Target)
	end
end

const function TeleportToEntity(Player: ServerPlayer, TargetId: number)
	const Target = Entities.Get(TargetId)

	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" or not Target then
		return
	end

	SetCamera(Player, nil)
	Entities.Teleport(Player, Target.Position, Target.YRot, Target.XRot)
end

const function FollowCamera(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Camera = Player.Camera

	if not Camera then
		return
	end

	if not Entities.IsAlive(Camera) or bit32.btest(Player.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Shift) then
		SetCamera(Player, nil)

		return
	end

	Player.Position = Camera.Position
	Player.YRot = Camera.YRot
	Player.XRot = Camera.XRot
end

const function SpawnPosition(): vector
	if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character then
		local root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart
		if root then
			return vector.create(root.Position.X, root.Position.Y, root.Position.Z) / Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
		end
	end
	const Hit = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(vector.create(0, SpawnSearchTop, 0), vector.create(0, -SpawnSearchDepth, 0))
	return Hit or vector.zero
end

const function EntityOf(Instance: Instance?): Entities.Entity?
	if not Instance then
		return nil
	end

	if Instance:IsA("Player") then
		const Playing = ServerPlayers[Instance]

		if Playing then
			return Playing
		end

		const Character = Instance.Character

		if not Character then
			return nil
		end

		const Id = Character:GetAttribute(Entities.IdAttribute)

		return if type(Id) == "number" then Entities.Get(Id) else nil
	end

	const Id = Instance:GetAttribute(Entities.IdAttribute)

	return if type(Id) == "number" then Entities.Get(Id) else nil
end

const function CreateHitbox(Player: Player): Model
	const Model = Instance.new("Model")
	const Part = Instance.new("Part")

	Model.Name = Player.Name
	Part.Name = "Hitbox"
	Part.Anchored = true
	Part.CanCollide = false
	Part.CanQuery = true
	Part.CanTouch = true
	Part.Transparency = 1
	Part.Size = vector.one
	Part.Parent = Model
	Model.PrimaryPart = Part
	Model.Parent = HitboxContainer

	return Model
end

const function HurtHitbox(Model: Instance, Hit: Damage.Hit): boolean
	const Playing = HitboxOwners[Model]

	if not Playing then
		return false
	end

	const Attacker = EntityOf(Hit.Attacker)
	const Type = if Minecraft.Registry.DatapackEntry("minecraft:damage_type", Hit.Type) then Hit.Type else "minecraft:generic"

	return Living.Hurt(Playing, Minecraft.Damage.Create(Type, Attacker, Attacker), Hit.Amount)
end

const function PushHitbox(Model: Instance, Push: vector, Attacker: Instance?)
	const Playing = HitboxOwners[Model]

	if Playing then
		Living.Knockback(Playing, vector.magnitude(vector.create(Push.x, 0, Push.z)), -Push.x, -Push.z)
	end
end

const HitboxReceiver: Damage.Receiver = { Hurt = HurtHitbox, Knockback = PushHitbox }

const function RegisterHitbox(Playing: ServerPlayer)
	HitboxOwners[Playing.Hitbox] = Playing
	Damage.Register(Playing.Hitbox, HitboxReceiver)
end

	Focus.CanQuery = false

const function Assign(Player: Player)
	JoinOrder += 1

	const IsMinecraft = Settings.IsMinecraftPlayer(Player, JoinOrder)

	Player:SetAttribute(Minecraft.PlayerAttribute, IsMinecraft)

	for _, Existing in ServerPlayers do
		Protocol.WritePlayerInfoAdd(Connection.StreamFor(Player), Existing.Id, Existing.Name, GameModeId(Existing.GameMode), Existing.Skin)
	end

	Tracking.PairExisting(Player)

	if IsMinecraft then
		Join(Player)
	end
end

const function Leave(Player: Player)
	const Leaving = ServerPlayers[Player]

	if not Leaving then
		return
	end

	ServerPlayers[Player] = nil
	Broadcast("Remove", Leaving)
	Entities.Remove(Leaving)
	Containers.Leave(Player)
	Damage.Unregister(Leaving.Hitbox)
	HitboxOwners[Leaving.Hitbox] = nil
	Leaving.Hitbox:Destroy()
	Leaving.Focus:Destroy()
end

const function IsFinite(Value: number): boolean
	return Value == Value and math.abs(Value) ~= math.huge
end

const function HandleMove(Player: ServerPlayer, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	const Flags, Position, YRot, XRot = Protocol.ReadMovePlayer(Reader)
	const HasPosition = bit32.btest(Flags, Protocol.MoveFlags.Position)
	const HasRotation = bit32.btest(Flags, Protocol.MoveFlags.Rotation)

	if not (IsFinite(Position.x) and IsFinite(Position.y) and IsFinite(Position.z) and IsFinite(YRot) and IsFinite(XRot)) then
		return
	end

	if HasRotation then
		Player.YRot = Minecraft.Mth.WrapDegrees(YRot)
		Player.XRot = Minecraft.Mth.WrapDegrees(XRot)
		Player.YHeadRot = Player.YRot
	end

	if Player.AwaitingTeleport ~= 0 then
		return
	end

	const From = Player.Position
	const WasOnGround = Player.OnGround

	if HasPosition then
		Player.Position = Position

		if Position ~= From then
			table.insert(Player.Movements, From)
			table.insert(Player.Movements, Position)
		end
	end

	Player.OnGround = bit32.btest(Flags, Protocol.MoveFlags.OnGround)
	Player.HorizontalCollision = bit32.btest(Flags, Protocol.MoveFlags.HorizontalCollision)
	Living.HandleMove(Player, From, WasOnGround)
end

const function Respawn(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.Health > 0 then
		return
	end

	const Spawn = SpawnPosition()

	Containers.DropMenuContents(Player.Player)
	Living.Reset(Player)
	Protocol.WriteRespawn(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player))
	Protocol.WriteGameMode(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Player.GameMode)
	Protocol.WritePlayerAbilities(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Minecraft.Abilities.ToFlags(Player.Abilities), Player.Abilities.FlyingSpeed, Player.Abilities.WalkingSpeed)
	Entities.Teleport(Player, Spawn, 0, 0)
end

const function HandleAction(Player: ServerPlayer, Action: number)
	if Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.SwapItemWithOffhand then
		if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			Containers.SwapHands(Player.Player)
			ItemUse.Stop(Player)
		end
	elseif Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.ReleaseUseItem then
		ItemUse.Release(Player)
	elseif Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.Stab then
		Melee.Stab(Player)
	elseif Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.DropItem or Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.DropAllItems then
		if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			Containers.DropFromSelected(Player.Player, Action == Protocol.PlayerActions.DropAllItems)

			if Player.UsingItem and Items.IsEmpty(Player.UseItem) then
				ItemUse.Stop(Player)
			end

			Living.ResetAttackStrength(Player)
		end
	end
end

const function Receive(Player: Player, PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	const ServerPlayer = ServerPlayers[Player]

	if not ServerPlayer then
		error("Packet from a player who is not a Minecraft player")
	end

	if PacketId == Serverbound.AcceptTeleportation then
		if Protocol.ReadAcceptTeleportation(Reader) == ServerPlayer.AwaitingTeleport then
			ServerPlayer.Position = ServerPlayer.TeleportPosition
			ServerPlayer.AwaitingTeleport = 0
		end
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.MovePlayer then
		HandleMove(ServerPlayer, Reader)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.PlayerInput then
		Entities.SetSharedFlag(ServerPlayer, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Shift, bit32.btest(Protocol.ReadPlayerInput(Reader), Protocol.InputFlags.Shift))
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.PlayerAbilities then
		ServerPlayer.Abilities.Flying = Protocol.ReadServerboundAbilities(Reader) and ServerPlayer.Abilities.MayFly
		ServerPlayer.Flying = ServerPlayer.Abilities.Flying
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.PlayerCommand then
		const Action = Protocol.ReadPlayerCommand(Reader)

		if Action == Protocol.PlayerCommands.StartSprinting then
			Entities.SetSharedFlag(ServerPlayer, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting, true)
			ServerPlayer.Sprinting = true
		elseif Action == Protocol.PlayerCommands.StopSprinting then
			Entities.SetSharedFlag(ServerPlayer, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting, false)
			ServerPlayer.Sprinting = false
		elseif Action == Protocol.PlayerCommands.StartFallFlying then
			Living.StartFallFlying(ServerPlayer)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.PlayerAction then
		HandleAction(ServerPlayer, Protocol.ReadPlayerAction(Reader))
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.Attack then
		Melee.Attack(ServerPlayer, Protocol.ReadAttack(Reader))
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.Punch then
		Melee.Punch(ServerPlayer)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.UseItem then
		const OffHand, YRot, XRot = Protocol.ReadUseItem(Reader)

		ItemUse.UseItem(ServerPlayer, OffHand, if IsFinite(YRot) then YRot else ServerPlayer.YRot, if IsFinite(XRot) then XRot else ServerPlayer.XRot)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.UseItemOn then
		const OffHand, Location, Face = Protocol.ReadUseItemOn(Reader)

		if IsFinite(Location.x) and IsFinite(Location.y) and IsFinite(Location.z) and math.abs(vector.magnitude(Face) - 1) < FaceTolerance then
			ItemUse.UseItemOn(ServerPlayer, OffHand, Location, Face)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.SpectatorAction then
		Spectate(ServerPlayer, Protocol.ReadSpectatorAction(Reader))
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.TeleportToEntity then
		TeleportToEntity(ServerPlayer, Protocol.ReadTeleportToEntity(Reader))
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.ClientCommand then
		if Protocol.ReadClientCommand(Reader) == Protocol.ClientCommands.PerformRespawn then
			Respawn(ServerPlayer)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.SetCarriedItem then
		const Slot = Protocol.ReadSetCarriedItem(Reader)

		if Minecraft.Inventory.IsHotbarSlot(Slot) then
			if Slot ~= ServerPlayer.Inventory.Selected and not ServerPlayer.UsingOffHand then
				ItemUse.Stop(ServerPlayer)
			end

			Minecraft.Inventory.SetSelectedSlot(ServerPlayer.Inventory, Slot)
		end
	elseif not Containers.Receive(Player, PacketId, Reader) then
		error(`Unknown serverbound packet {PacketId}`)
	end
end

const function CanFit(Player: ServerPlayer, Pose: Minecraft.Pose): boolean
	const Dimensions = EntityPhysics.PlayerDimensions[Pose]
	const Min, Max = EntityPhysics.BoxAt(Player.Position, Dimensions.Width, Dimensions.Height)
	const Deflation = vector.one * PoseDeflation

	return Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min + Deflation, Max - Deflation)
end

const function UpdatePose(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.Health <= 0 or Player.Dead then
		Player.Pose = "Dying"
	elseif CanFit(Player, "Swimming") then
		const Shift = bit32.btest(Player.SharedFlags, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Shift)
		const Desired: Minecraft.Pose = if Player.Swimming
			then "Swimming"
			elseif Player.FallFlying then "FallFlying"
			elseif Player.SpinAttack then "SpinAttack"
			elseif Shift and not Player.Abilities.Flying then "Crouching"
			else "Standing"

		Player.Pose = if CanFit(Player, Desired) then Desired elseif CanFit(Player, "Crouching") then "Crouching" else "Swimming"
	end

	const Dimensions = EntityPhysics.PlayerDimensions[Player.Pose]

	Player.Width = Dimensions.Width
	Player.Height = Dimensions.Height
	Player.EyeHeight = Dimensions.EyeHeight
	Player.Crouching = Player.Pose == "Crouching"
end

const function PlaceHitbox(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Part = Player.Hitbox.PrimaryPart :: Part
	const Size = vector.create(Player.Width, Player.Height, Player.Width) * StudsPerBlock

	if Part.Size ~= Size then
		Part.Size = Size
	end

	Part.CFrame = CFrame.new((Player.Position + vector.create(0, Player.Height / 2, 0)) * StudsPerBlock)
end

const function Tick()
	for _, Player in ServerPlayers do
		if Player.AwaitingTeleport ~= 0 then
			Player.TeleportTicks += 1

			if Player.TeleportTicks >= TeleportResendTicks then
				Entities.Teleport(Player, Player.TeleportPosition, Player.YRot, Player.XRot)
			end
		end

		Living.Tick(Player)
		Melee.TickAutoSpinAttack(Player)
		ItemUse.Tick(Player)
		Living.PostTick(Player)
		FollowCamera(Player)
		UpdatePose(Player)
		Player.Focus.CFrame = CFrame.new(Player.Position * StudsPerBlock)
		PlaceHitbox(Player)
	end
end

const function Start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Assign)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(Leave)

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Assign(Player)
	end
end

return {
	Start = Start,
	Receive = Receive,
	Tick = Tick,
	SetGameMode = SetGameMode,
	ToggleCreative = ToggleCreative,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Connection"] = function(require)
    local Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
    local Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
    local Streams = {}
    local Discarded = Protocol.CreateStream()

    local function StreamFor(Player)
        local Existing = Streams[Player]
        if Existing then return Existing end
        local Created = Protocol.CreateStream()
        Streams[Player] = Created
        return Created
    end

    local function Start(Handler)
        _ServerReceiveHandler = Handler
        while #_ClientToServerQueue > 0 do
            local msg = table.remove(_ClientToServerQueue, 1)
            _ProcessClientToServer(msg)
        end
    end

    local function FlushAll()
        local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        for Player, Stream in pairs(Streams) do
            local Message = Protocol.Flush(Stream)
            if Message and (Player == lp or not lp) then
                _DeliverServerToClient(Message)
            end
        end
        Protocol.Flush(Discarded)
    end

    return {
        StreamFor = StreamFor,
        Start = Start,
        FlushAll = FlushAll,
    }
end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Tracking"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const ItemEntities = require("./ItemEntities")
const ItemUse = require("./ItemUse")
const Orbs = require("./Orbs")
const Projectiles = require("./Projectiles")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items

const ForcedPositionInterval = 60
const TeleportDelayLimit = 400
const PositionChangeThreshold = 7.6293945E-6
const MotionChangeThreshold = 1.0E-7
const DeltaLimit = 32767
const BodyLingerTicks = 20
const NeverInterval = math.huge

type Entity = Entities.Entity

type ServerEntity = {
	TickCount: number,
	Interval: number,
	TeleportDelay: number,
	Base: vector,
	LastSentYRot: number,
	LastSentXRot: number,
	LastSentYHeadRot: number,
	LastSentFlags: number,
	LastSentPose: string,
	LastSentLiving: number,
	LastSentHealth: number,
	LastSentArrows: number,
	LastSentAir: number,
	LastSentRadius: number,
	LastSentWaiting: boolean,
	LastSentMotion: vector,
	WasOnGround: boolean,
	StepPositions: { vector },
	StepTicks: { number },
	StepCount: number,
	TicksSinceLastStep: number,
	LastEquipment: { [Minecraft.EquipmentSlot]: Minecraft.ItemStack },
}

const Tracked: { [Entity]: ServerEntity } = {}
const Deltas: { vector } = {}
const RemovedIds: { number } = {}
const ChangedSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = {}
const ChangedStacks: { Minecraft.ItemStack } = {}
const ProjectileTypes = Protocol.ProjectileTypes

const function SignedByte(Packed: number): number
	return if Packed >= 128 then Packed - 256 else Packed
end

const function OwnerOf(Entity: Entity): Player?
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	return if Player then Player.Player else nil
end

const function IsTrackable(Entity: Entity): boolean
	if Entity.Removed or Entity.Kind == "Humanoid" then
		return false
	end

	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	return not (Player and Player.Dead and Player.DeathTime >= BodyLingerTicks)
end

const function UpdateIntervalOf(Entity: Entity): number
	const Kind = Entity.Kind

	if Kind == "Player" then
		return 2
	elseif Kind == "Arrow" or Kind == "Trident" or Kind == "ExperienceOrb" or Kind == "Item" then
		return 20
	elseif Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		return NeverInterval
	end

	return 10
end

const function ProjectileFlags(Projectile: Projectiles.Projectile): number
	local Flags = 0

	if Projectile.Critical then
		Flags += Protocol.ProjectileFlags.Critical
	end

	if Projectile.InGround then
		Flags += Protocol.ProjectileFlags.InGround
	end

	if Projectile.NoPhysics then
		Flags += Protocol.ProjectileFlags.NoPhysics
	end

	if Projectile.ShotAtAngle then
		Flags += Protocol.ProjectileFlags.ShotAtAngle
	end

	const GlintOverride = Items.Get(Projectile.Stack, "minecraft:enchantment_glint_override")

	if GlintOverride == true or GlintOverride == nil and Items.IsEnchanted(Projectile.Stack) then
		Flags += Protocol.ProjectileFlags.Foil
	end

	return Flags
end

const function WritePlayerData(Stream: Minecraft.Stream, Player: Entities.ServerPlayer)
	Protocol.WriteSetEntityData(Stream, Player.Id, Player.SharedFlags, Minecraft.Poses[Player.Pose], ItemUse.LivingFlags(Player), Player.Health, Player.ArrowCount, Player.AirSupply, Player.EffectParticles, Player.EffectAmbience)
end

const function Pair(Entity: Entity, Viewer: Player)
	const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Viewer)
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		local Count = 0

		Protocol.WriteAddEntity(Stream, Player.Id, Player.Name, Player.Position, Player.YRot, Player.XRot, Player.YHeadRot)
		WritePlayerData(Stream, Player)

		for _, Slot in Protocol.EquipmentSlots do
			const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)

			if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
				Count += 1
				ChangedSlots[Count] = Slot
				ChangedStacks[Count] = Items.Copy(Stack)
			end
		end

		if Count > 0 then
			Protocol.WriteSetEquipment(Stream, Player.Id, ChangedSlots, ChangedStacks, Count)
		end

		table.clear(ChangedSlots)
		table.clear(ChangedStacks)
	elseif Entity.Kind == "ExperienceOrb" then
		Protocol.WriteAddExperienceOrb(Stream, Entity.Id, Entity.Position, (Entity :: Orbs.Orb).Value)
	elseif Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		const Cloud = Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud

		Protocol.WriteAddAreaEffectCloud(Stream, Cloud.Id, Cloud.Position, Cloud.Radius, Cloud.Color)
		Protocol.WriteSetCloudData(Stream, Cloud.Id, Cloud.Radius, Cloud.Waiting)
	elseif Entity.Kind == "Item" then
		const Item = Entity :: ItemEntities.ItemEntity

		Protocol.WriteAddItemEntity(Stream, Item.Id, Item.Position, Item.DeltaMovement, Items.Copy(Item.Stack))
	else
		const Projectile = Entity :: Projectiles.Projectile
		const Owner = Projectile.Owner

		Protocol.WriteAddProjectile(
			Stream,
			Projectile.Id,
			ProjectileTypes[Projectile.Type],
			Projectile.Position,
			Projectile.DeltaMovement,
			Projectile.YRot,
			Projectile.XRot,
			if Owner then Owner.Id else 0,
			Projectile.Stack,
			Projectile.Data
		)
		Protocol.WriteSetProjectileData(Stream, Projectile.Id, ProjectileFlags(Projectile), Projectile.Data)
	end
end

const function Broadcast(Entity: Entity, Count: number, SwappedHands: boolean)
	const Owner = OwnerOf(Entity)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer == Owner then
			continue
		end

		const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Viewer)

		if SwappedHands then
			Protocol.WriteEntityEvent(Stream, Entity.Id, Protocol.EntityEvents.SwapHands)
		end

		if Count > 0 then
			Protocol.WriteSetEquipment(Stream, Entity.Id, ChangedSlots, ChangedStacks, Count)
		end
	end
end

const function DetectEquipmentUpdates(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer, State: ServerEntity)
	const Last = State.LastEquipment
	local Count = 0
	local MainHand: Minecraft.ItemStack? = nil
	local OffHand: Minecraft.ItemStack? = nil

	for _, Slot in Protocol.EquipmentSlots do
		const Current = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)

		if not Items.Matches(Current, Last[Slot]) then
			if Slot == "mainhand" then
				MainHand = Current
			elseif Slot == "offhand" then
				OffHand = Current
			else
				Count += 1
				ChangedSlots[Count] = Slot
				ChangedStacks[Count] = Current
			end
		end
	end

	local SwappedHands = false

	if MainHand and OffHand and Items.Matches(MainHand, Last.offhand) and Items.Matches(OffHand, Last.mainhand) then
		SwappedHands = true
		Last.mainhand = Items.Copy(MainHand)
		Last.offhand = Items.Copy(OffHand)
	else
		if OffHand then
			table.insert(ChangedSlots, 1, "offhand")
			table.insert(ChangedStacks, 1, OffHand)
			Count += 1
		end

		if MainHand then
			table.insert(ChangedSlots, 1, "mainhand")
			table.insert(ChangedStacks, 1, MainHand)
			Count += 1
		end
	end

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const Copy = Items.Copy(ChangedStacks[Index])

		ChangedStacks[Index] = Copy
		Last[ChangedSlots[Index]] = Copy
	end

	if Count > 0 or SwappedHands then
		Broadcast(Player, Count, SwappedHands)
	end

	table.clear(ChangedSlots)
	table.clear(ChangedStacks)
end

const function Track(Entity: Entity)
	const Equipment: { [Minecraft.EquipmentSlot]: Minecraft.ItemStack } = {}
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	for _, Slot in Protocol.EquipmentSlots do
		Equipment[Slot] = if Player then Items.Copy(Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)) else Items.Empty
	end

	Tracked[Entity] = {
		TickCount = 0,
		Interval = UpdateIntervalOf(Entity),
		TeleportDelay = 0,
		Base = Entity.Position,
		LastSentYRot = Protocol.PackDegrees(Entity.YRot),
		LastSentXRot = Protocol.PackDegrees(Entity.XRot),
		LastSentYHeadRot = Protocol.PackDegrees(if Player then Player.YHeadRot else Entity.YRot),
		LastSentFlags = if Player then Player.SharedFlags else 0,
		LastSentPose = if Player then Player.Pose else "Standing",
		LastSentLiving = if Player then ItemUse.LivingFlags(Player) else 0,
		LastSentHealth = if Player then Player.Health else 0,
		LastSentArrows = if Player then Player.ArrowCount else 0,
		LastSentAir = if Player then Player.AirSupply else 0,
		LastSentRadius = if Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then (Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud).Radius else 0,
		LastSentWaiting = if Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then (Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud).Waiting else false,
		LastSentMotion = Entity.DeltaMovement,
		WasOnGround = Entity.OnGround,
		StepPositions = {},
		StepTicks = {},
		StepCount = 0,
		TicksSinceLastStep = -1,
		LastEquipment = Equipment,
	}

	const Owner = OwnerOf(Entity)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer ~= Owner then
			Pair(Entity, Viewer)
		end
	end
end

const function Untrack(Entity: Entity)
	Tracked[Entity] = nil
	RemovedIds[1] = Entity.Id

	const Owner = OwnerOf(Entity)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer ~= Owner then
			Protocol.WriteRemoveEntities(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), RemovedIds, 1)
		end
	end
end

const function PairExisting(Viewer: Player)
	for Entity in Tracked do
		if OwnerOf(Entity) ~= Viewer then
			Pair(Entity, Viewer)
		end
	end
end

const function EncodeSteps(State: ServerEntity): boolean
	local Base = State.Base

	for Index = 1, math.max(State.StepCount, 1) do
		const Position = State.StepPositions[Index]
		const Delta = vector.create(
			Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Position.x) - Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Base.x),
			Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Position.y) - Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Base.y),
			Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Position.z) - Protocol.EncodeCoordinate(Base.z)
		)

		if math.abs(Delta.x) > DeltaLimit or math.abs(Delta.y) > DeltaLimit or math.abs(Delta.z) > DeltaLimit then
			return false
		end

		Deltas[Index] = Delta
		Base = Position
	end

	return true
end

const function DataDirty(Entity: Entity, State: ServerEntity): boolean
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		return Player.DataForced
			or Player.SharedFlags ~= State.LastSentFlags
			or Player.Pose ~= State.LastSentPose
			or ItemUse.LivingFlags(Player) ~= State.LastSentLiving
			or Player.Health ~= State.LastSentHealth
			or Player.ArrowCount ~= State.LastSentArrows
			or Player.AirSupply ~= State.LastSentAir
	elseif Entity.Kind == "Item" then
		return (Entity :: ItemEntities.ItemEntity).DataDirty
	elseif Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		const Cloud = Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud

		return Cloud.Radius ~= State.LastSentRadius or Cloud.Waiting ~= State.LastSentWaiting
	elseif Entity.Kind ~= "ExperienceOrb" and Entity.Kind ~= "AreaEffectCloud" then
		return (Entity :: Projectiles.Projectile).DataDirty
	end

	return false
end

const function WriteData(Entity: Entity, Stream: Minecraft.Stream)
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		WritePlayerData(Stream, Player)
	elseif Entity.Kind == "Item" then
		const Item = Entity :: ItemEntities.ItemEntity

		Protocol.WriteSetItemEntityData(Stream, Item.Id, Items.Copy(Item.Stack))
	elseif Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		const Cloud = Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud

		Protocol.WriteSetCloudData(Stream, Cloud.Id, Cloud.Radius, Cloud.Waiting)
	elseif Entity.Kind ~= "ExperienceOrb" and Entity.Kind ~= "AreaEffectCloud" then
		const Projectile = Entity :: Projectiles.Projectile

		Protocol.WriteSetProjectileData(Stream, Projectile.Id, ProjectileFlags(Projectile), Projectile.Data)
	end
end

const function MarkDataSent(Entity: Entity, State: ServerEntity)
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		Player.DataForced = false
		State.LastSentFlags = Player.SharedFlags
		State.LastSentPose = Player.Pose
		State.LastSentLiving = ItemUse.LivingFlags(Player)
		State.LastSentHealth = Player.Health
		State.LastSentArrows = Player.ArrowCount
		State.LastSentAir = Player.AirSupply
	elseif Entity.Kind == "Item" then
		(Entity :: ItemEntities.ItemEntity).DataDirty = false
	elseif Entity.Kind == "AreaEffectCloud" then
		State.LastSentRadius = (Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud).Radius
		State.LastSentWaiting = (Entity :: Projectiles.Cloud).Waiting
	elseif Entity.Kind ~= "ExperienceOrb" and Entity.Kind ~= "AreaEffectCloud" then
		(Entity :: Projectiles.Projectile).DataDirty = false
	end
end

const function SendChanges(Entity: Entity, State: ServerEntity)
	const Position = Entity.Position
	const Owner = OwnerOf(Entity)
	const Dirty = DataDirty(Entity, State)
	const Projectile = if Entity.Kind ~= "Player" and Entity.Kind ~= "ExperienceOrb" and Entity.Kind ~= "AreaEffectCloud" and Entity.Kind ~= "Item" then Entity :: Projectiles.Projectile else nil
	const Item = if Entity.Kind == "Item" then Entity :: ItemEntities.ItemEntity else nil
	const NeedsSync = Projectile ~= nil and Projectile.NeedsSync or Item ~= nil and Item.NeedsSync

	State.TicksSinceLastStep += 1

	if State.TickCount % State.Interval == 0 or Dirty or NeedsSync then
		const YRotPacked = Protocol.PackDegrees(Entity.YRot)
		const XRotPacked = Protocol.PackDegrees(Entity.XRot)
		const ShouldSendRotation = math.abs(SignedByte(YRotPacked) - SignedByte(State.LastSentYRot)) >= 1 or math.abs(SignedByte(XRotPacked) - SignedByte(State.LastSentXRot)) >= 1
		const IsArrow = Entity.Kind == "Arrow" or Entity.Kind == "Trident"

		State.TeleportDelay += 1

		if State.TicksSinceLastStep > 0 then
			State.StepCount += 1
			State.StepPositions[State.StepCount] = Position
			State.StepTicks[State.StepCount] = State.TicksSinceLastStep
			State.TicksSinceLastStep = 0
		elseif State.StepCount == 0 then
			State.StepPositions[1] = Position
		end

		const PositionChanged = vector.dot(Position - State.Base, Position - State.Base) >= PositionChangeThreshold
		const ShouldSendPosition = IsArrow or PositionChanged or State.TickCount % ForcedPositionInterval == 0
		const SendRotation = IsArrow or ShouldSendRotation
		local Kind: "Sync" | "Move" | "Rotate" | "None" = "None"

		if State.TeleportDelay > TeleportDelayLimit or State.WasOnGround ~= Entity.OnGround then
			State.WasOnGround = Entity.OnGround
			State.TeleportDelay = 0
			Kind = "Sync"
		elseif ShouldSendPosition then
			Kind = if EncodeSteps(State) then "Move" else "Sync"
		elseif SendRotation then
			Kind = "Rotate"
		end

		local SendMotion = false

		if Entity.Kind ~= "AreaEffectCloud" and (Entity.Kind ~= "Player" or Entity.FallFlying) then
			const Motion = if Entity.Kind == "Player" then Entity.KnownMovement else Entity.DeltaMovement
			const Difference = vector.dot(Motion - State.LastSentMotion, Motion - State.LastSentMotion)

			if Difference > MotionChangeThreshold or Difference > 0 and vector.dot(Motion, Motion) == 0 then
				State.LastSentMotion = Motion
				SendMotion = true
			end
		end

		for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
			const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Viewer)

			if Viewer == Owner then
				if Dirty then
					WriteData(Entity, Stream)
				end

				continue
			end

			if SendMotion then
				Protocol.WriteSetEntityMotion(Stream, Entity.Id, State.LastSentMotion)
			end

			if Kind == "Sync" then
				Protocol.WriteEntityPositionSync(Stream, Entity.Id, State.StepCount, State.StepPositions, State.StepTicks, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot, Entity.OnGround)
			elseif Kind == "Move" then
				Protocol.WriteMoveEntity(Stream, Entity.Id, State.StepCount, Deltas, State.StepTicks, if SendRotation then Entity.YRot else nil, if SendRotation then Entity.XRot else nil, Entity.OnGround)
			elseif Kind == "Rotate" then
				Protocol.WriteMoveEntity(Stream, Entity.Id, 0, nil, nil, Entity.YRot, Entity.XRot, Entity.OnGround)
			end

			if Dirty then
				WriteData(Entity, Stream)
			end
		end

		State.StepCount = 0

		if Kind == "Sync" or Kind == "Move" then
			State.Base = Position
		end

		if Kind == "Sync" or Kind == "Rotate" or Kind == "Move" and SendRotation then
			State.LastSentYRot = YRotPacked
			State.LastSentXRot = XRotPacked
		end

		MarkDataSent(Entity, State)

		if Projectile then
			Projectile.NeedsSync = false
		end

		if Item then
			Item.NeedsSync = false
		end

		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player then
			const YHeadRotPacked = Protocol.PackDegrees(Player.YHeadRot)

			if math.abs(SignedByte(YHeadRotPacked) - SignedByte(State.LastSentYHeadRot)) >= 1 then
				for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
					if Viewer ~= Owner then
						Protocol.WriteRotateHead(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Player.Id, Player.YHeadRot)
					end
				end

				State.LastSentYHeadRot = YHeadRotPacked
			end
		end
	end

	State.TickCount += 1

	if Entity.HurtMarked then
		Entity.HurtMarked = false

		for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
			Protocol.WriteSetEntityMotion(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Entity.Id, Entity.DeltaMovement)
		end
	end
end

const function Tick()
	for Entity in Tracked do
		if not IsTrackable(Entity) then
			Untrack(Entity)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		if not Tracked[Entity] and IsTrackable(Entity) then
			Track(Entity)
		end
	end

	for Entity, State in Tracked do
		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player then
			DetectEquipmentUpdates(Player, State)
		end

		SendChanges(Entity, State)
	end
end

return {
	PairExisting = PairExisting,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Containers"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const ItemEntities = require("./ItemEntities")
const Living = require("./Living")
const Settings = require("./Settings")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Serverbound = Protocol.Serverbound
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Inventory = Minecraft.Inventory
const Menu = Inventory.Menu

const LastContainerInput = Menu.Inputs.PickupAll
const FirstCreativeSlot = 1
const LastCreativeSlot = 45
const DropSpamStep = 20
const DropSpamThreshold = 1480

type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

type RemoteSlot = {
	Stack: ItemStack?,
	Hash: Minecraft.HashedStack?,
}

type Container = {
	Player: Player,
	ServerPlayer: Entities.ServerPlayer,
	Owner: Minecraft.Owner,
	RemoteSlots: { RemoteSlot },
	RemoteCarried: RemoteSlot,
	SuppressRemoteUpdates: boolean,
	DropSpam: number,
}

const Containers: { [Player]: Container } = {}
const EquipSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = { "head", "chest", "legs", "feet", "offhand" }
const EquipmentBefore: { [Minecraft.EquipmentSlot]: ItemStack } = {}

const function Force(Remote: RemoteSlot, Stack: ItemStack)
	Remote.Stack = Items.Copy(Stack)
	Remote.Hash = nil
end

const function ReceiveHash(Remote: RemoteSlot, Hash: Minecraft.HashedStack)
	Remote.Stack = nil
	Remote.Hash = Hash
end

const function RemoteMatches(Remote: RemoteSlot, Stack: ItemStack): boolean
	if Remote.Stack then
		return Items.Matches(Remote.Stack, Stack)
	elseif Remote.Hash and Protocol.HashedStackMatches(Remote.Hash, Stack) then
		Remote.Stack = Items.Copy(Stack)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function SendAllDataToRemote(Container: Container)
	const ContainerMenu = Container.Owner.Menu
	const Stacks: { ItemStack } = {}

	for Index = 1, #ContainerMenu.Slots do
		const Stack = Menu.SlotItem(ContainerMenu, Index - 1)

		Stacks[Index] = Items.Copy(Stack)
		Force(Container.RemoteSlots[Index], Stack)
	end

	Force(Container.RemoteCarried, ContainerMenu.Carried)
	Protocol.WriteContainerSetContent(Connection.StreamFor(Container.Player), ContainerMenu.ContainerId, Menu.IncrementStateId(ContainerMenu), Stacks, Items.Copy(ContainerMenu.Carried))
end

const function BroadcastChanges(Container: Container)
	if Container.SuppressRemoteUpdates then
		return
	end

	const ContainerMenu = Container.Owner.Menu
	const Stream = Connection.StreamFor(Container.Player)

	for Index = 1, #ContainerMenu.Slots do
		const Stack = Menu.SlotItem(ContainerMenu, Index - 1)
		const Remote = Container.RemoteSlots[Index]

		if not RemoteMatches(Remote, Stack) then
			Force(Remote, Stack)
			Protocol.WriteContainerSetSlot(Stream, ContainerMenu.ContainerId, Menu.IncrementStateId(ContainerMenu), Index - 1, Items.Copy(Stack))
		end
	end

	if not RemoteMatches(Container.RemoteCarried, ContainerMenu.Carried) then
		Force(Container.RemoteCarried, ContainerMenu.Carried)
		Protocol.WriteSetCursorItem(Stream, Items.Copy(ContainerMenu.Carried))
	end
end

const function FlushDrops(Container: Container)
	const Drops = Container.Owner.Drops
	const Played = Container.Owner.Sounds
	const Player = Container.ServerPlayer

	for _, Entry in Drops do
		ItemEntities.Drop(Player, Entry.Stack, Entry.Predicted)
	end

	for _, Sound in Played do
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, Sound.Event, Sound.Volume, Sound.Pitch + Player.Random:NextNumber() * Sound.PitchSpread)
	end

	table.clear(Drops)
	table.clear(Played)
end

const function SnapshotEquipment(Container: Container)
	for _, Slot in EquipSlots do
		EquipmentBefore[Slot] = Items.Copy(Inventory.GetEquipment(Container.Owner.Inventory, Slot))
	end
end

const function EquipChanged(Container: Container)
	for _, Slot in EquipSlots do
		Living.OnEquipItem(Container.ServerPlayer, Slot, EquipmentBefore[Slot], Inventory.GetEquipment(Container.Owner.Inventory, Slot))
	end
end

const function DropFromSelected(Player: Player, All: boolean)
	const Container = Containers[Player]
	const PlayerInventory = Container.Owner.Inventory
	const Removed = Inventory.RemoveFromSelected(PlayerInventory, All)

	Force(Container.RemoteSlots[Menu.MenuSlots.HotbarStart + PlayerInventory.Selected + 1], Inventory.GetSelectedItem(PlayerInventory))
	ItemEntities.Drop(Container.ServerPlayer, Removed, true)
end

const function PlaceItemBackInInventory(Container: Container, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Owner = Container.Owner
	const PlayerInventory = Owner.Inventory

	while not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) do
		local Slot = Inventory.GetSlotWithRemainingSpace(PlayerInventory, Stack)

		if Slot == Inventory.NotFound then
			Slot = Inventory.GetFreeSlot(PlayerInventory)
		end

		if Slot == Inventory.NotFound then
			table.insert(Owner.Drops, { Stack = Stack, Predicted = false })

			break
		end

		const SpaceFor = Items.MaxStackSize(Stack) - Items.GetCount(Inventory.GetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot))

		if Inventory.Add(PlayerInventory, Items.Split(Stack, SpaceFor), Owner.InfiniteMaterials, Slot) then
			Protocol.WriteSetPlayerInventory(Connection.StreamFor(Container.Player), Slot, Items.Copy(Inventory.GetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot)))
		end
	end
end

const function CloseContainer(Container: Container)
	const ContainerMenu = Container.Owner.Menu

	if not Items.IsEmpty(ContainerMenu.Carried) then
		PlaceItemBackInInventory(Container, ContainerMenu.Carried)
		ContainerMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	end

	ContainerMenu.Result = Items.Empty

	for Index, Stack in ContainerMenu.Crafting do
		ContainerMenu.Crafting[Index] = Items.Empty
		PlaceItemBackInInventory(Container, Stack)
	end

	FlushDrops(Container)
end

const function DropMenuContents(Player: Player)
	const Container = Containers[Player]
	const ContainerMenu = Container.Owner.Menu

	if not Items.IsEmpty(ContainerMenu.Carried) then
		ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Container.ServerPlayer, ContainerMenu.Carried, false)
		ContainerMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	end

	ContainerMenu.Result = Items.Empty

	for Index, Stack in ContainerMenu.Crafting do
		if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
			ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Container.ServerPlayer, Stack, false)
			ContainerMenu.Crafting[Index] = Items.Empty
		end
	end

	SendAllDataToRemote(Container)
end

const function HandleContainerClick(Container: Container, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	const ContainerId, StateId, SlotIndex, Button, Input, ChangedSlots, Carried = Protocol.ReadContainerClick(Reader)
	const ContainerMenu = Container.Owner.Menu

	if ContainerMenu.ContainerId ~= ContainerId then
		return
	end

	if Container.ServerPlayer.GameMode == "spectator" or Container.ServerPlayer.Health <= 0 then
		SendAllDataToRemote(Container)

		return
	end

	if not Menu.IsValidSlotIndex(ContainerMenu, SlotIndex) then
		return
	end

	const FullResyncNeeded = StateId ~= ContainerMenu.StateId

	Container.SuppressRemoteUpdates = true
	SnapshotEquipment(Container)
	Menu.Clicked(ContainerMenu, Container.Owner, SlotIndex, Button, if Input > LastContainerInput then Menu.Inputs.Pickup else Input)
	EquipChanged(Container)

	for ChangedIndex, Hash in ChangedSlots do
		const Remote = Container.RemoteSlots[ChangedIndex + 1]

		if Remote then
			ReceiveHash(Remote, Hash)
		end
	end

	ReceiveHash(Container.RemoteCarried, Carried)
	Container.SuppressRemoteUpdates = false

	if FullResyncNeeded then
		SendAllDataToRemote(Container)
	else
		BroadcastChanges(Container)
	end

	FlushDrops(Container)
end

const function HandleSetCreativeModeSlot(Container: Container, Reader: Minecraft.Reader)
	const SlotIndex, Stack = Protocol.ReadSetCreativeModeSlot(Reader)
	const Owner = Container.Owner

	if not Owner.InfiniteMaterials then
		return
	end

	const ValidData = Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Items.GetCount(Stack) <= Items.MaxStackSize(Stack)

	if SlotIndex >= FirstCreativeSlot and SlotIndex <= LastCreativeSlot and ValidData then
		SnapshotEquipment(Container)
		Menu.SetByPlayer(Owner.Menu, SlotIndex, Stack)
		EquipChanged(Container)
		Force(Container.RemoteSlots[SlotIndex + 1], Stack)
		BroadcastChanges(Container)
	elseif SlotIndex < 0 and ValidData and Container.DropSpam < DropSpamThreshold then
		Container.DropSpam += DropSpamStep
		table.insert(Owner.Drops, { Stack = Stack, Predicted = true })
		FlushDrops(Container)
	end
end

const function ClearOrCountStack(Stack: ItemStack, Matches: (ItemStack) -> boolean, Amount: number, CountingOnly: boolean): number
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or not Matches(Stack) then
		return 0
	elseif CountingOnly then
		return Items.GetCount(Stack)
	end

	const Removed = if Amount < 0 then Items.GetCount(Stack) else math.min(Amount, Items.GetCount(Stack))

	Items.Shrink(Stack, Removed)

	return Removed
end

const function ClearOrCountMatching(Player: Player, Matches: (ItemStack) -> boolean, CountingOnly: boolean, Amount: number): number
	const Owner = Containers[Player].Owner
	const ContainerMenu = Owner.Menu
	local Count = 0

	for Slot = 0, Inventory.ContainerSize - 1 do
		const Stack = Inventory.GetItem(Owner.Inventory, Slot)
		const Removed = ClearOrCountStack(Stack, Matches, Amount - Count, CountingOnly)

		if Removed > 0 and not CountingOnly and Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
			Inventory.SetItem(Owner.Inventory, Slot, Items.Empty)
		end

		Count += Removed
	end

	for Index, Stack in ContainerMenu.Crafting do
		const Removed = ClearOrCountStack(Stack, Matches, Amount - Count, CountingOnly)

		if Removed > 0 and not CountingOnly and Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
			ContainerMenu.Crafting[Index] = Items.Empty
		end

		Count += Removed
	end

	Count += ClearOrCountStack(ContainerMenu.Carried, Matches, Amount - Count, CountingOnly)

	if not CountingOnly and Items.IsEmpty(ContainerMenu.Carried) then
		ContainerMenu.Carried = Items.Empty
	end

	return Count
end

const function SetGameMode(Player: Player, GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode, Abilities: Minecraft.Abilities)
	const Owner = Containers[Player].Owner

	Owner.InfiniteMaterials = Abilities.Instabuild
	Owner.Creative = GameMode == "creative"
end

const function SwapHands(Player: Player)
	const PlayerInventory = Containers[Player].Owner.Inventory
	const Offhand = Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "offhand")

	Inventory.SetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "offhand", Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "mainhand"))
	Inventory.SetEquipment(PlayerInventory, "mainhand", Offhand)
end

const function Join(Joined: Entities.ServerPlayer)
	const Player = Joined.Player
	const PlayerInventory = Joined.Inventory

	for _, Entry in Settings.StartingEquipment do
		const Stack = Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item(Entry.Id), 1)

		for Type, Value in Entry.Components do
			Items.Set(Stack, Type, Value)
		end

		Inventory.SetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Entry.Slot, Stack)
	end

	for _, Entry in Settings.StartingItems do
		const Stack = Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item(Entry.Id), Entry.Count)

		for Type, Value in Entry.Components or {} do
			Items.Set(Stack, Type, Value)
		end

		Inventory.Add(PlayerInventory, Stack, false)
	end

	const ContainerMenu = Menu.CreateInventoryMenu(PlayerInventory)
	const RemoteSlots: { RemoteSlot } = {}

	for Index = 1, #ContainerMenu.Slots do
		RemoteSlots[Index] = {}
	end

	const Created: Container = {
		Player = Player,
		ServerPlayer = Joined,
		Owner = {
			Inventory = PlayerInventory,
			Menu = ContainerMenu,
			InfiniteMaterials = false,
			Creative = false,
			Drops = {},
			Sounds = {},
		},
		RemoteSlots = RemoteSlots,
		RemoteCarried = {},
		SuppressRemoteUpdates = false,
		DropSpam = 0,
	}

	Containers[Player] = Created
	SetGameMode(Player, Joined.GameMode, Joined.Abilities)
	Protocol.WriteSetHeldSlot(Connection.StreamFor(Player), PlayerInventory.Selected)
	SendAllDataToRemote(Created)
end

const function Leave(Player: Player)
	Containers[Player] = nil
end

const function Receive(Player: Player, PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	const Container = Containers[Player]

	if PacketId == Serverbound.ContainerClick then
		HandleContainerClick(Container, Reader)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.ContainerClose then
		Protocol.ReadContainerClose(Reader)
		CloseContainer(Container)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.SetCreativeModeSlot then
		HandleSetCreativeModeSlot(Container, Reader)
	elseif PacketId == Serverbound.SelectBundleItem then
		const SlotIndex, SelectedItem = Protocol.ReadSelectBundleItem(Reader)

		Menu.SetSelectedBundleItemIndex(Container.Owner.Menu, SlotIndex, SelectedItem)
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function Tick()
	for _, Container in Containers do
		if Container.DropSpam > 0 then
			Container.DropSpam -= 1
		end

		BroadcastChanges(Container)
		Inventory.Tick(Container.Owner.Inventory)
		Inventory.TickEquipment(Container.Owner.Inventory)
	end
end

return {
	DropFromSelected = DropFromSelected,
	ClearOrCountMatching = ClearOrCountMatching,
	SwapHands = SwapHands,
	DropMenuContents = DropMenuContents,
	Join = Join,
	SetGameMode = SetGameMode,
	Leave = Leave,
	Receive = Receive,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/EnchantmentActions"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const Explosions = require("./Explosions")
const Living = require("./Living")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const LevelValue = Items.Enchantments.LevelValue

const ImpulseGraceTicks = 10
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180
const Namespace = "minecraft:"

type Entity = Entities.Entity

export type ItemInUse = {
	Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack,
	Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot?,
	Owner: Entities.ServerPlayer?,
}

const Collected: { Minecraft.CollectedEnchantment } = {}

const function RandomBetween(Generator: Random, Minimum: number, Maximum: number): number
	return Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber() * (Maximum - Minimum) + Minimum)
end

const function LookRotate(Entity: Entity, Direction: vector): vector
	const Pitch = Entity.XRot * DegreesToRadians
	const Yaw = -Entity.YRot * DegreesToRadians
	const Y = Direction.y * math.cos(Pitch) - Direction.z * math.sin(Pitch)
	const Z = Direction.y * math.sin(Pitch) + Direction.z * math.cos(Pitch)

	return vector.create(Direction.x * math.cos(Yaw) + Z * math.sin(Yaw), Y, -Direction.x * math.sin(Yaw) + Z * math.cos(Yaw))
end

const function RandomEffect(HolderSet: unknown, Generator: Random): string?
	if type(HolderSet) == "string" then
		if string.sub(HolderSet, 1, 1) == "#" then
			return nil
		end

		return HolderSet
	end

	const List = HolderSet :: { string }

	return if #List > 0 then List[Generator:NextInteger(1, #List)] else nil
end

const function SampleFloat(Provider: unknown, Generator: Random): number
	if type(Provider) == "number" then
		return Provider
	end

	const Fields = Provider :: { [string]: unknown }

	if Fields.type == "minecraft:constant" then
		return Fields.value :: number
	elseif Fields.type == "minecraft:uniform" then
		const Minimum = Fields.min_inclusive :: number

		return Minimum + Generator:NextNumber() * ((Fields.max_exclusive :: number) - Minimum)
	end

	error(`Unsupported float provider {Fields.type}`)
end

const function ParticleOf(Value: unknown): Minecraft.ParticleOptions
	const Id = (Value :: { type: string }).type

	return { Type = if string.sub(Id, 1, #Namespace) == Namespace then string.sub(Id, #Namespace + 1) else Id }
end

const function Apply(Effect: { [string]: unknown }, Level: number, Item: ItemInUse, Target: Entity, Position: vector)
	const Type = Effect.type
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Target)
	const Generator = if Player then Player.Random else Random.new()

	if Type == "minecraft:all_of" then
		for _, Inner in Effect.effects :: { { [string]: unknown } } do
			Apply(Inner, Level, Item, Target, Position)
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:apply_mob_effect" then
		const Id = RandomEffect(Effect.to_apply, Generator)

		if Player and Id then
			const Ticks = math.round(RandomBetween(Generator, LevelValue(Effect.min_duration, Level), LevelValue(Effect.max_duration, Level)) * 20)
			const Amplifier = math.max(0, math.round(RandomBetween(Generator, LevelValue(Effect.min_amplifier, Level), LevelValue(Effect.max_amplifier, Level))))

			Living.AddEffect(Player, Minecraft.Effects.Create(Id, Ticks, Amplifier))
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:damage_entity" then
		const Amount = RandomBetween(Generator, LevelValue(Effect.min_damage, Level), LevelValue(Effect.max_damage, Level))

		Living.HurtEntity(Target, Minecraft.Damage.Create(Effect.damage_type :: string, Item.Owner, Item.Owner), Amount)
	elseif Type == "minecraft:ignite" then
		Living.Ignite(Target, LevelValue(Effect.duration, Level))
	elseif Type == "minecraft:apply_impulse" then
		const Direction = Effect.direction :: { number }
		const Scale = Effect.coordinate_scale :: { number }
		const Magnitude = LevelValue(Effect.magnitude, Level)
		const Rotated = LookRotate(Target, vector.create(Direction[1], Direction[2], Direction[3]))

		Entities.Push(Target, Rotated * vector.create(Scale[1], Scale[2], Scale[3]) * Magnitude)

		if Player then
			Player.ImpulseGraceTime = math.max(Player.ImpulseGraceTime, ImpulseGraceTicks)
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:apply_exhaustion" then
		if Player then
			Living.CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, LevelValue(Effect.amount, Level))
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:change_item_damage" then
		const Owner = Item.Owner

		if Owner and Items.Has(Item.Stack, "minecraft:max_damage") and Items.Has(Item.Stack, "minecraft:damage") then
			Living.HurtAndBreak(Owner, Item.Stack, math.modf(LevelValue(Effect.amount, Level)), Item.Slot)
		end
	elseif Type == "minecraft:explode" then
		const Offset = (Effect.offset or { 0, 0, 0 }) :: { number }
		const Center = Position + vector.create(Offset[1], Offset[2], Offset[3])
		const Multiplier = if Effect.knockback_multiplier then LevelValue(Effect.knockback_multiplier, Level) else 1

		Explosions.Explode(if Effect.attribute_to_user then Target else nil, Center, math.max(LevelValue(Effect.radius, Level), 0), Multiplier, false, ParticleOf(Effect.small_particle), ParticleOf(Effect.large_particle), Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Effect.sound) or "")
	elseif Type == "minecraft:play_sound" then
		const Listed = Effect.sound
		const Events = (if type(Listed) == "table" and (Listed :: { unknown })[1] ~= nil then Listed else { Listed }) :: { unknown }
		const Event = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Events[math.clamp(Level, 1, #Events)])

		if Event then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Position, Event, SampleFloat(Effect.volume, Generator), SampleFloat(Effect.pitch, Generator))
		end
	end
end

const function ApplyCollected(Source: Minecraft.DamageSource, Victim: Entity, Owner: Entities.ServerPlayer?, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot)
	for _, Entry in Collected do
		local Target: Entity? = Victim

		if Entry.Affected == "attacker" then
			Target = Source.Causing :: Entity?
		elseif Entry.Affected == "damaging_entity" then
			Target = Source.Direct :: Entity?
		end

		if Target then
			Apply(Entry.Effect, Entry.Level, { Stack = Entry.Stack, Slot = Slot, Owner = Owner }, Target, Target.Position)
		end
	end

	table.clear(Collected)
end

const function PostAttack(Victim: Entity, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack?)
	const VictimPlayer = Entities.AsPlayer(Victim)
	const Generator = if VictimPlayer then VictimPlayer.Random else Random.new()

	if VictimPlayer then
		for _, Slot in Minecraft.Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
			table.clear(Collected)
			Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.CollectPostAttack(Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(VictimPlayer.Inventory, Slot), Slot, "victim", Victim, Source, Generator, Collected)
			ApplyCollected(Source, Victim, VictimPlayer, Slot)
		end
	end

	const Attacker = Source.Causing :: Entity?

	if Weapon and Attacker and Attacker.IsLiving then
		table.clear(Collected)
		Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.CollectPostAttack(Weapon, "mainhand", "attacker", Victim, Source, Generator, Collected)
		ApplyCollected(Source, Victim, Entities.AsPlayer(Attacker), "mainhand")
	end
end

const function RunEntityEffects(Component: string, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot?, Target: Entity, Owner: Entities.ServerPlayer?)
	table.clear(Collected)
	Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.CollectEntityEffects(Component, Stack, Slot, Target, if Owner then Owner.Random else Random.new(), Collected)

	for _, Entry in Collected do
		Apply(Entry.Effect, Entry.Level, { Stack = Stack, Slot = Slot, Owner = Owner }, Target, Target.Position)
	end

	table.clear(Collected)
end

const function PostPiercing(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer)
	RunEntityEffects("minecraft:post_piercing_attack", Minecraft.Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory), "mainhand", Player, Player)
end

const function ProjectileSpawned(Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Projectile: Entity, Owner: Entities.ServerPlayer?)
	RunEntityEffects("minecraft:projectile_spawned", Weapon, nil, Projectile, Owner)
end

return {
	PostAttack = PostAttack,
	PostPiercing = PostPiercing,
	ProjectileSpawned = ProjectileSpawned,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Entities"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")

const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const IdAttribute = "MinecraftEntityId"
const HumanoidType = "roblox:humanoid"

export type Kind = "Player" | "Humanoid" | "Arrow" | "Trident" | "Thrown" | "WindCharge" | "Firework" | "ExperienceOrb" | "AreaEffectCloud" | "Item"

export type Entity = {
	Id: number,
	Kind: Kind,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	Removed: boolean,
	HurtMarked: boolean,
	GameMode: string?,
	FoodLevel: number?,
	PierceLevel: number?,
	KnockbackFromPosition: boolean?,
	RemainingFireTicks: number,
}

export type Swing = {
	OffHand: boolean,
	Type: string,
	Duration: number,
	Ticks: number,
	Active: boolean,
}

export type ServerPlayer = {
	Id: number,
	Kind: Kind,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	Removed: boolean,
	HurtMarked: boolean,

	Player: Player,
	Name: string,
	Skin: Minecraft.Skin?,
	YHeadRot: number,
	HorizontalCollision: boolean,
	SharedFlags: number,
	Pose: Minecraft.Pose,
	GameMode: Minecraft.GameMode,
	FoodLevel: number,
	Abilities: Minecraft.Abilities,
	Inventory: Minecraft.Inventory,
	AwaitingTeleport: number,
	TeleportPosition: vector,
	TeleportTicks: number,
	NextTeleportId: number,
	Focus: Part,
	Hitbox: Model,

	Health: number,
	Absorption: number,
	Food: Minecraft.Food,
	Effects: Minecraft.Effects,
	EffectsDirty: boolean,
	HurtTime: number,
	DamageCooldownTime: number,
	LastHurt: number,
	DeathTime: number,
	Dead: boolean,
	RemainingFireTicks: number,
	CombatEntries: { { Source: Minecraft.DamageSource, Damage: number, FallDistance: number } },
	LastDamageTime: number,
	InCombat: boolean,
	TakingDamage: boolean,
	LastHurtByPlayer: ServerPlayer?,
	LastHurtByPlayerMemory: number,
	LastHurtByMob: Entity?,
	LastHurtByMobTime: number,
	ExperienceLevel: number,
	ExperienceProgress: number,
	TotalExperience: number,
	Score: number,
	LastLevelUpTime: number,
	TakeXpDelay: number,
	ArrowCount: number,
	RemoveArrowTime: number,
	FallFlyTicks: number,
	DataForced: boolean,
	EffectParticles: { Minecraft.ParticleOptions },
	EffectAmbience: boolean,
	SpawnExtraParticlesOnFall: boolean,
	CrossbowStartSoundPlayed: boolean,
	CrossbowMidSoundPlayed: boolean,
	MoveDist: number,
	NextStep: number,
	ImpulseImpactPosition: vector?,
	ImpulseGraceTime: number,
	AirSupply: number,
	AutoSpinAttackTicks: number,
	AutoSpinAttackDamage: number,
	AutoSpinAttackItem: Minecraft.ItemStack?,
	Movements: { vector },
	Camera: Entity?,

	AttackStrengthTicker: number,
	ItemSwapTicker: number,
	LastItemInMainHand: Minecraft.ItemStack,
	Swing: Swing,
	Cooldowns: Minecraft.Cooldowns,
	UseItem: Minecraft.ItemStack,
	UseItemRemaining: number,
	UsingItem: boolean,
	UsingOffHand: boolean,
	SpinAttack: boolean,
	RecentKineticEnemies: { [Entity]: number }?,
	LastSentHealth: number,
	LastSentAbsorption: number,
	Advancements: { [string]: true },
	LastSentFood: number,
	LastSentSaturation: number,
	LastSentExperience: number,
	Random: Random,
}

export type HumanoidEntity = {
	Id: number,
	Kind: Kind,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	Removed: boolean,
	HurtMarked: boolean,

	GameMode: string?,
	FoodLevel: number?,
	RemainingFireTicks: number,

	Model: Model,
	Humanoid: Humanoid,
}

const All: { [number]: Entity } = {}
const HumanoidsByModel: { [Model]: HumanoidEntity } = {}

local NextEntityId = 1

const function NextId(): number
	const Id = NextEntityId

	NextEntityId += 1

	return Id
end

const function Add(Entity: Entity)
	All[Entity.Id] = Entity
end

const function Remove(Entity: Entity)
	Entity.Removed = true
	All[Entity.Id] = nil
end

const function Get(Id: number): Entity?
	return All[Id]
end

const function Box(Entity: Entity): (vector, vector)
	return Minecraft.Entity.BoxAt(Entity.Position, Entity.Width, Entity.Height)
end

const function Intersects(MinA: vector, MaxA: vector, MinB: vector, MaxB: vector): boolean
	return MinA.x < MaxB.x and MaxA.x > MinB.x and MinA.y < MaxB.y and MaxA.y > MinB.y and MinA.z < MaxB.z and MaxA.z > MinB.z
end

const function InBox(Min: vector, Max: vector, Except: Entity?, Out: { Entity }): number
	local Count = 0

	for _, Entity in All do
		if Entity ~= Except and not Entity.Removed then
			const EntityMin, EntityMax = Box(Entity)

			if Intersects(Min, Max, EntityMin, EntityMax) then
				Count += 1
				Out[Count] = Entity
			end
		end
	end

	for Index = Count + 1, #Out do
		Out[Index] = nil
	end

	return Count
end

const function AsPlayer(Entity: Entity): ServerPlayer?
	return if Entity.Kind == "Player" then Entity :: ServerPlayer else nil
end

const function AsHumanoid(Entity: Entity): HumanoidEntity?
	return if Entity.Kind == "Humanoid" then Entity :: HumanoidEntity else nil
end

const function IsAlive(Entity: Entity): boolean
	if Entity.Removed then
		return false
	end

	const Player = AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		return Player.Health > 0 and not Player.Dead
	end

	const Humanoid = AsHumanoid(Entity)

	return Humanoid == nil or Humanoid.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

const function DisplayName(Entity: Entity?): unknown?
	if not Entity then
		return nil
	end

	const Player = AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		return { text = Player.Name }
	end

	const Humanoid = AsHumanoid(Entity)

	if Humanoid then
		return { text = Humanoid.Model.Name }
	end

	return { translate = `entity.minecraft.{string.sub(Entity.EntityType, 11)}` }
end

const function SetSharedFlag(Player: ServerPlayer, Flag: number, Enabled: boolean)
	const Flags = if Enabled then bit32.bor(Player.SharedFlags, Flag) else bit32.band(Player.SharedFlags, bit32.bnot(Flag))

	if Flags ~= Player.SharedFlags then
		Player.SharedFlags = Flags
		Player.DataForced = true
	end

	if Flag == Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying then
		Player.FallFlying = Enabled
	end
end

const function ForceData(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.DataForced = true
end

const function Swing(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Type: string, Duration: number, ToSelf: boolean)
	const State = Player.Swing
	local Modified = Duration
	const Haste = Player.Effects["minecraft:haste"]
	const Conduit = Player.Effects["minecraft:conduit_power"]
	const Fatigue = Player.Effects["minecraft:mining_fatigue"]

	if Haste or Conduit then
		const HasteLevel = if Haste then Haste.Amplifier else 0
		const ConduitLevel = if Conduit then Conduit.Amplifier else 0

		Modified -= 1 + math.max(HasteLevel, ConduitLevel)
	elseif Fatigue then
		Modified += (1 + Fatigue.Amplifier) * 2
	end

	if State.Active and State.Ticks <= State.Duration // 2 and State.Ticks > 0 then
		return
	end

	State.Active = true
	State.OffHand = OffHand
	State.Type = Type
	State.Duration = Modified
	State.Ticks = 0

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer ~= Player.Player or ToSelf then
			Minecraft.Protocol.WriteSwingAnimation(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Player.Id, OffHand, Type, Modified)
		end
	end
end

const function Push(Entity: Entity, Motion: vector)
	const Humanoid = AsHumanoid(Entity)

	if Humanoid then
		const Root = Humanoid.Humanoid.RootPart

		if Root then
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Motion * (StudsPerBlock * TicksPerSecond)
		end

		return
	end

	Entity.DeltaMovement += Motion
	Entity.HurtMarked = true
end

const function Teleport(Player: ServerPlayer, Position: vector, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	Player.NextTeleportId += 1
	Player.AwaitingTeleport = Player.NextTeleportId
	Player.TeleportPosition = Position
	Player.TeleportTicks = 0
	Player.Position = Position
	Player.YRot = YRot
	Player.XRot = XRot
	Player.YHeadRot = YRot
	Minecraft.Protocol.WritePlayerPosition(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Player.AwaitingTeleport, Position, YRot, XRot)
end

const function UpdateHumanoid(Entity: HumanoidEntity)
	const Model = Entity.Model
	const BoxFrame, Size = Model:GetBoundingBox()
	const Right = BoxFrame.RightVector * (Size.X / 2)
	const Up = BoxFrame.UpVector * (Size.Y / 2)
	const Look = BoxFrame.LookVector * (Size.Z / 2)
	const Corner = vector.create(
		math.abs(Right.X) + math.abs(Up.X) + math.abs(Look.X),
		math.abs(Right.Y) + math.abs(Up.Y) + math.abs(Look.Y),
		math.abs(Right.Z) + math.abs(Up.Z) + math.abs(Look.Z)
	)
	const Center = vector.create(BoxFrame.X, BoxFrame.Y, BoxFrame.Z)
	const Min = (Center - Corner) / StudsPerBlock
	const Max = (Center + Corner) / StudsPerBlock
	const Previous = Entity.Position
	const Root = Entity.Humanoid.RootPart

	Entity.Position = vector.create((Min.x + Max.x) / 2, Min.y, (Min.z + Max.z) / 2)
	Entity.Width = math.max(Max.x - Min.x, Max.z - Min.z)
	Entity.Height = Max.y - Min.y
	Entity.KnownMovement = Entity.Position - Previous
	Entity.DeltaMovement = if Root then Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity / (StudsPerBlock * TicksPerSecond) else vector.zero
	Entity.OnGround = Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

	if Root then
		const Facing = Root.CFrame.LookVector

		Entity.YRot = math.deg(math.atan2(-Facing.X, Facing.Z))
	end

	Entity.TickCount += 1
end

const function Track(Humanoid: Humanoid)
	const Model = Humanoid.Parent

	if not Model or not Model:IsA("Model") or HumanoidsByModel[Model] then
		return
	end

	const Entity: HumanoidEntity = {
		Id = NextId(),
		Kind = "Humanoid",
		EntityType = HumanoidType,
		IsLiving = true,
		Position = vector.zero,
		DeltaMovement = vector.zero,
		KnownMovement = vector.zero,
		Width = 0,
		Height = 0,
		YRot = 0,
		XRot = 0,
		OnGround = false,
		OnFire = false,
		Crouching = false,
		Sprinting = false,
		Flying = false,
		FallFlying = false,
		EyeHeight = 0,
		Swimming = false,
		Fluid = Minecraft.Entity.CreateFluidState(),
		FallDistance = 0,
		TickCount = 0,
		Removed = false,
		HurtMarked = false,
		GameMode = nil,
		FoodLevel = nil,
		RemainingFireTicks = 0,
		Model = Model,
		Humanoid = Humanoid,
	}

	HumanoidsByModel[Model] = Entity
	UpdateHumanoid(Entity)
	Entity.KnownMovement = vector.zero
	Model:SetAttribute(IdAttribute, Entity.Id)
	Add(Entity)
end

const function Untrack(Model: Model)
	const Entity = HumanoidsByModel[Model]

	if Entity then
		HumanoidsByModel[Model] = nil
		Remove(Entity)
	end
end

const function Tick()
	for Model, Entity in HumanoidsByModel do
		if not Model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or Entity.Humanoid.Parent ~= Model then
			Untrack(Model)
		else
			UpdateHumanoid(Entity)
		end
	end

end

const function Start()
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Descendant: Instance)
		if Descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
			task.defer(Track, Descendant)
		end
	end)

	for _, Descendant in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if Descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
			Track(Descendant)
		end
	end
end

return {
	IdAttribute = IdAttribute,
	HumanoidType = HumanoidType,
	All = All,
	NextId = NextId,
	Add = Add,
	Remove = Remove,
	Get = Get,
	Box = Box,
	Intersects = Intersects,
	InBox = InBox,
	AsPlayer = AsPlayer,
	AsHumanoid = AsHumanoid,
	IsAlive = IsAlive,
	DisplayName = DisplayName,
	Push = Push,
	Swing = Swing,
	SetSharedFlag = SetSharedFlag,
	ForceData = ForceData,
	Teleport = Teleport,
	Tick = Tick,
	Start = Start,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Experience"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const MaximumInt = 2147483647
const MaximumReward = 100
const RewardPerLevel = 7

const OrbValues = { 2477, 1237, 617, 307, 149, 73, 37, 17, 7, 3 }

type ServerPlayer = Entities.ServerPlayer

const function NeededForNextLevel(Level: number): number
	if Level >= 30 then
		return 112 + (Level - 30) * 9
	elseif Level >= 15 then
		return 37 + (Level - 15) * 5
	end

	return 7 + Level * 2
end

const function GiveLevels(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	if Amount == 0 then
		return
	end

	Player.LastSentExperience = -1
	Player.ExperienceLevel = math.clamp(Player.ExperienceLevel + Amount, -MaximumInt - 1, MaximumInt)

	if Player.ExperienceLevel < 0 then
		Player.ExperienceLevel = 0
		Player.ExperienceProgress = 0
		Player.TotalExperience = 0
	end

	if Amount > 0 and Player.ExperienceLevel % 5 == 0 and Player.LastLevelUpTime < Player.TickCount - 100 then
		const Volume = if Player.ExperienceLevel > 30 then 1 else Player.ExperienceLevel / 30

		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "entity.player.levelup", Volume * 0.75, 1)
		Player.LastLevelUpTime = Player.TickCount
	end
end

const function GivePoints(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	Player.Score += Amount
	Player.ExperienceProgress += Amount / NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)
	Player.TotalExperience = math.clamp(Player.TotalExperience + Amount, 0, MaximumInt)

	while Player.ExperienceProgress < 0 do
		const Remaining = Player.ExperienceProgress * NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)

		if Player.ExperienceLevel > 0 then
			GiveLevels(Player, -1)
			Player.ExperienceProgress = 1 + Remaining / NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)
		else
			GiveLevels(Player, -1)
			Player.ExperienceProgress = 0
		end
	end

	while Player.ExperienceProgress >= 1 do
		Player.ExperienceProgress = (Player.ExperienceProgress - 1) * NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)
		GiveLevels(Player, 1)
		Player.ExperienceProgress /= NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)
	end
end

const function SetPoints(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number): boolean
	const Needed = NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)

	if Amount >= Needed then
		return false
	end

	const Progress = math.clamp(Mth.Float(Amount / Needed), 0, Mth.Float((Needed - 1) / Needed))

	if Progress ~= Player.ExperienceProgress then
		Player.ExperienceProgress = Progress
		Player.LastSentExperience = -1
	end

	return true
end

const function SetLevels(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	if Amount ~= Player.ExperienceLevel then
		Player.ExperienceLevel = Amount
		Player.LastSentExperience = -1
	end
end

const function PointsInLevel(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	return (Player.ExperienceProgress * NeededForNextLevel(Player.ExperienceLevel)) // 1
end

const function DeathReward(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	return if Player.GameMode == "spectator" then 0 else math.min(Player.ExperienceLevel * RewardPerLevel, MaximumReward)
end

const function OrbValue(MaximumValue: number): number
	for _, Value in OrbValues do
		if MaximumValue >= Value then
			return Value
		end
	end

	return 1
end

return {
	GiveLevels = GiveLevels,
	GivePoints = GivePoints,
	SetPoints = SetPoints,
	SetLevels = SetLevels,
	PointsInLevel = PointsInLevel,
	DeathReward = DeathReward,
	OrbValue = OrbValue,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Explosions"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")

const ImpulseGraceTicks = 40
const SmallRadius = 2

type Entity = Entities.Entity

const Nearby: { Entity } = {}
const HitPlayers: { [Player]: vector } = {}

const function SeenPercent(Center: vector, Entity: Entity): number
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Entity)
	const StepX = 1 / ((Max.x - Min.x) * 2 + 1)
	const StepY = 1 / ((Max.y - Min.y) * 2 + 1)
	const StepZ = 1 / ((Max.z - Min.z) * 2 + 1)
	const OffsetX = (1 - (1 / StepX) // 1 * StepX) / 2
	const OffsetZ = (1 - (1 / StepZ) // 1 * StepZ) / 2
	local Hits = 0
	local Count = 0
	local X = 0

	while X <= 1 do
		local Y = 0

		while Y <= 1 do
			local Z = 0

			while Z <= 1 do
				const From = vector.create(Min.x + (Max.x - Min.x) * X + OffsetX, Min.y + (Max.y - Min.y) * Y, Min.z + (Max.z - Min.z) * Z + OffsetZ)

				if not Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(From, Center - From) then
					Hits += 1
				end

				Count += 1
				Z += StepZ
			end

			Y += StepY
		end

		X += StepX
	end

	return Minecraft.Mth.Float(Hits / Count)
end

const function KnockbackResistance(Entity: Entity): number
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	return if Player then Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:explosion_knockback_resistance", Player.Inventory, Player.Effects) else 0
end

const function SendEffects(Center: vector, Radius: number, SmallParticle: Minecraft.ParticleOptions, LargeParticle: Minecraft.ParticleOptions, Sound: string)
	const Particle = if Radius < SmallRadius then SmallParticle else LargeParticle

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Minecraft.Protocol.WriteExplode(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Center, Particle, Sound, HitPlayers[Viewer] or vector.zero)
	end

	table.clear(HitPlayers)
end

const function Explode(Source: Entity?, Center: vector, Radius: number, KnockbackMultiplier: number, FromWindCharge: boolean, SmallParticle: Minecraft.ParticleOptions, LargeParticle: Minecraft.ParticleOptions, Sound: string)
	if Radius < 1.0E-5 then
		SendEffects(Center, Radius, SmallParticle, LargeParticle, Sound)

		return
	end

	const DoubleRadius = Radius * 2
	const Reach = vector.one * (DoubleRadius + 1)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(vector.floor(Center - Reach), vector.floor(Center + Reach), Source, Nearby) do
