		const Entity = Nearby[Index]
		const Distance = vector.magnitude(Entity.Position - Center) / DoubleRadius

		if Distance > 1 or Entity.Kind == "Item" then
			continue
		end

		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)
		const Multiplier = if Player and Player.Abilities.Flying then 0 else KnockbackMultiplier
		const Exposure = if Multiplier == 0 then 0 else SeenPercent(Center, Entity)
		const EyeHeight = if Player then Minecraft.Entity.PlayerDimensions[Player.Pose].EyeHeight else Entity.Height * 0.85
		const Direction = Minecraft.Mth.Normalize(Entity.Position + vector.create(0, EyeHeight, 0) - Center)
		const Power = (1 - Distance) * Exposure * Multiplier * (1 - KnockbackResistance(Entity))

		const Knockback = Direction * Power

		if Player then
			Player.DeltaMovement += Knockback

			if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" and not (Player.GameMode == "creative" and Player.Abilities.Flying) then
				HitPlayers[Player.Player] = Knockback
			end
		else
			Entities.Push(Entity, Knockback)
		end

		if Player then
			if FromWindCharge then
				Player.ImpulseGraceTime = math.max(Player.ImpulseGraceTime, ImpulseGraceTicks)
				Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = Player.Position
			else
				Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
			end
		end
	end

	SendEffects(Center, Radius, SmallParticle, LargeParticle, Sound)
end

return {
	Explode = Explode,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/ItemEntities"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const StudsPerBlock = Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

const ItemSize = 0.25
const Gravity = 0.04
const AirDrag = Mth.Float(0.98)
const DefaultFriction = Mth.Float(0.6)
const BounceFactor = -0.5
const RestingSpeedSquared = Mth.Float(1.0E-5)
const MovingMergeRate = 2
const RestingMergeRate = 40
const MergeReach = 0.5
const MergeLimit = 64
const Lifetime = 6000
const SyncThreshold = 0.01
const DropPickupDelay = 40
const HandDrop = 0.3
const ThrowPower = Mth.Float(0.3)
const ScatterPower = Mth.Float(0.02)
const RandomPower = Mth.Float(0.5)
const SwingDuration = 6
const PushBase = Mth.Float(0.1)
const PushRange = Mth.Float(0.2)
const PushDamping = 0.75
const Deflation = 1.0E-7
const ItemEyeHeight = Mth.Float(0.2125)
const FluidDepth = Mth.Float(0.1)
const WaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.99)
const LavaInertia = Mth.Float(0.95)
const FluidRise = Mth.Float(5.0E-4)
const FluidRiseLimit = Mth.Float(0.06)
const ItemHealth = 5
const NeverPickUp = 32767
const FireDamageInterval = 20
const LavaIgniteTicks = 300
const LavaDamage = 4
const LavaFallScale = 0.5
const SpillSpread = 0.2
const SpillLift = 0.2
const DefaultPickupDelay = 10
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

export type ItemEntity = {
	Id: number,
	Kind: Entities.Kind,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	Removed: boolean,
	HurtMarked: boolean,
	RemainingFireTicks: number,

	OnGroundNoBlocks: boolean,
	HorizontalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollisionBelow: boolean,
	MaxUpStep: number,
	NoPhysics: boolean,
	SteppingCarefully: boolean,
	SupportingPart: BasePart?,

	Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack,
	Health: number,
	Age: number,
	PickupDelay: number,
	Target: Player?,
	NeedsSync: boolean,
	DataDirty: boolean,
}

const ItemEntities: { [ItemEntity]: true } = {}
const Generator = Random.new()
const Spawned: { ItemEntity } = {}
const Nearby: { Entities.Entity } = {}

const function Float(): number
	return Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function Spawn(Position: vector, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Motion: vector, PickupDelay: number): ItemEntity
	const Created: ItemEntity = {
		Id = Entities.NextId(),
		Kind = "Item",
		EntityType = "minecraft:item",
		IsLiving = false,
		Position = Position,
		DeltaMovement = Motion,
		KnownMovement = vector.zero,
		Width = ItemSize,
		Height = ItemSize,
		YRot = Float() * 360,
		XRot = 0,
		OnGround = false,
		OnFire = false,
		Crouching = false,
		Sprinting = false,
		Flying = false,
		FallFlying = false,
		EyeHeight = ItemEyeHeight,
		Swimming = false,
		Fluid = Minecraft.Entity.CreateFluidState(),
		FallDistance = 0,
		TickCount = 0,
		Removed = false,
		HurtMarked = false,
		RemainingFireTicks = 0,
		OnGroundNoBlocks = false,
		HorizontalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollisionBelow = false,
		MaxUpStep = 0,
		NoPhysics = false,
		SteppingCarefully = false,
		SupportingPart = nil,
		Stack = Stack,
		Health = ItemHealth,
		Age = 0,
		PickupDelay = PickupDelay,
		Target = nil,
		NeedsSync = false,
		DataDirty = false,
	}

	table.insert(Spawned, Created)
	Entities.Add(Created)

	return Created
end

const function FreshMotion(): vector
	return vector.create(Generator:NextNumber() * SpillSpread - SpillSpread / 2, SpillLift, Generator:NextNumber() * SpillSpread - SpillSpread / 2)
end

const function SpawnAtLocation(Position: vector, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, YOffset: number)
	if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Spawn(Position + vector.create(0, YOffset, 0), Stack, FreshMotion(), DefaultPickupDelay)
	end
end

const function CreateDrop(Dropper: Entities.ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Randomly: boolean): ItemEntity?
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return nil
	end

	const EyeHeight = Minecraft.Entity.PlayerDimensions[Dropper.Pose].EyeHeight
	const Position = Dropper.Position + vector.create(0, EyeHeight - HandDrop, 0)
	local Motion: vector

	if Randomly then
		const Power = Float() * RandomPower
		const Direction = Float() * Mth.Float(math.pi * 2)

		Motion = vector.create(-Mth.Sin(Direction) * Power, Mth.Float(0.2), Mth.Cos(Direction) * Power)
	else
		const SinX = Mth.Sin(Dropper.XRot * DegreesToRadians)
		const CosX = Mth.Cos(Dropper.XRot * DegreesToRadians)
		const SinY = Mth.Sin(Dropper.YRot * DegreesToRadians)
		const CosY = Mth.Cos(Dropper.YRot * DegreesToRadians)
		const Direction = Float() * Mth.Float(math.pi * 2)
		const Scatter = ScatterPower * Float()

		Motion = vector.create(
			-SinY * CosX * ThrowPower + math.cos(Direction) * Scatter,
			-SinX * ThrowPower + Mth.Float(0.1) + (Float() - Float()) * Mth.Float(0.1),
			CosY * CosX * ThrowPower + math.sin(Direction) * Scatter
		)
	end

	return Spawn(Position, Stack, Motion, DropPickupDelay)
end

const function AllowOnly(Item: ItemEntity, Player: Player)
	Item.PickupDelay = 0
	Item.Target = Player
end

const function MakeFake(Item: ItemEntity)
	Item.PickupDelay = NeverPickUp
	Item.Age = Lifetime - 1
end

const function Drop(Dropper: Entities.ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Predicted: boolean)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	Entities.Swing(Dropper, false, "whack", SwingDuration, not Predicted)
	CreateDrop(Dropper, Stack, false)
end

const function Discard(Item: ItemEntity)
	ItemEntities[Item] = nil
	Entities.Remove(Item)
end

const function Spill(Item: ItemEntity, Spilled: Minecraft.ItemStack)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Spilled) then
		return
	end

	Spawn(Item.Position, Spilled, FreshMotion(), 0)
end

const function OnDestroyed(Item: ItemEntity)
	const Stack = Item.Stack
	const Registered = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Registered, "BundleItem") then
		const Contents = Items.Bundle.Open(Stack)

		if Contents then
			const Spilled = Contents.Items

			Contents.Items = {}
			Items.Bundle.Close(Stack, Contents)

			for _, Copy in Spilled do
				Spill(Item, Copy)
			end
		end
	elseif Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Registered, "BlockItem") then
		const Container = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:container") :: { { item: unknown } }?

		if Container then
			Items.Set(Stack, "minecraft:container", {})

			for _, Entry in Container do
				Spill(Item, Items.FromTemplate(Entry.item))
			end
		end
	end
end

const function CanBeHurtBy(Item: ItemEntity, Type: string): boolean
	return Minecraft.Damage.ItemCanBeHurtBy(Item.Stack, Minecraft.Damage.Create(Type))
end

const function Hurt(Item: ItemEntity, Type: string, Amount: number)
	if Item.Removed or not CanBeHurtBy(Item, Type) then
		return
	end

	Item.HurtMarked = true
	Item.Health = math.modf(Item.Health - Amount)

	if Item.Health <= 0 then
		OnDestroyed(Item)
		Discard(Item)
	end
end

const function ApplyFluidEffects(Item: ItemEntity, From: vector)
	const Water, Lava = Minecraft.Entity.TouchedFluids(Item, From, Item.Position)
	const PreviousFireTicks = Item.RemainingFireTicks
	const FireImmune = not CanBeHurtBy(Item, "minecraft:in_fire")

	if Lava and not FireImmune then
		if Item.RemainingFireTicks < LavaIgniteTicks then
			Item.RemainingFireTicks = LavaIgniteTicks
		end

		Hurt(Item, "minecraft:lava", LavaDamage)
	end

	if Water then
		Item.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Item.RemainingFireTicks)
	end

	if (FireImmune or Item.RemainingFireTicks <= 0) and Item.RemainingFireTicks <= PreviousFireTicks then
		Item.RemainingFireTicks = -1
	end
end

const function BaseTick(Item: ItemEntity)
	Item.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Item.Fluid.EyeInWater
	Minecraft.Entity.UpdateFluidInteraction(Item)

	if Item.RemainingFireTicks > 0 then
		if not CanBeHurtBy(Item, "minecraft:in_fire") then
			Item.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Item.RemainingFireTicks)
		else
			if Item.RemainingFireTicks % FireDamageInterval == 0 and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Item) then
				Hurt(Item, "minecraft:on_fire", 1)
			end

			Item.RemainingFireTicks -= 1
		end
	end

	if Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Item) then
		Item.FallDistance *= LavaFallScale
	end

	Item.OnFire = Item.RemainingFireTicks > 0
	Item.Fluid.FirstTick = false
end

const function IsMergeable(Item: ItemEntity): boolean
	return not Item.Removed and Item.PickupDelay ~= NeverPickUp and Item.Age < Lifetime and Items.GetCount(Item.Stack) < Items.MaxStackSize(Item.Stack)
end

const function MergeInto(Target: ItemEntity, Source: ItemEntity)
	const TargetStack = Target.Stack
	const SourceStack = Source.Stack
	const Delta = math.min(math.min(Items.MaxStackSize(TargetStack), MergeLimit) - Items.GetCount(TargetStack), Items.GetCount(SourceStack))

	Target.Stack = Items.CopyWithCount(TargetStack, Items.GetCount(TargetStack) + Delta)
	Target.DataDirty = true
	Items.Shrink(SourceStack, Delta)
	Source.DataDirty = true
	Target.PickupDelay = math.max(Target.PickupDelay, Source.PickupDelay)
	Target.Age = math.min(Target.Age, Source.Age)

	if Items.IsEmpty(SourceStack) then
		Discard(Source)
	end
end

const function TryToMerge(Item: ItemEntity, Other: ItemEntity)
	const Stack = Item.Stack
	const OtherStack = Other.Stack

	if Item.Target ~= Other.Target or Items.GetCount(OtherStack) + Items.GetCount(Stack) > Items.MaxStackSize(OtherStack) or not Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Stack, OtherStack) then
		return
	end

	if Items.GetCount(OtherStack) < Items.GetCount(Stack) then
		MergeInto(Item, Other)
	else
		MergeInto(Other, Item)
	end
end

const function MergeWithNeighbours(Item: ItemEntity)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Item)
	const Grow = vector.create(MergeReach, 0, MergeReach)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, Item, Nearby) do
		const Entity = Nearby[Index]

		if Entity.Kind == "Item" and IsMergeable(Entity :: ItemEntity) then
			TryToMerge(Item, Entity :: ItemEntity)

			if Item.Removed then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

const function MoveTowardsClosestSpace(Item: ItemEntity, Min: vector, Max: vector)
	const Collision = Minecraft.Collision
	const Count = Collision.Gather(Min, Max)
	local North, South, West, East, Up = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

	for Index = 1, Count do
		const ShapeMin = Collision.Mins[Index]
		const ShapeMax = Collision.Maxs[Index]

		if Min.x < ShapeMax.x and Max.x > ShapeMin.x and Min.y < ShapeMax.y and Max.y > ShapeMin.y and Min.z < ShapeMax.z and Max.z > ShapeMin.z then
			North = math.max(North, Max.z - ShapeMin.z)
			South = math.max(South, ShapeMax.z - Min.z)
			West = math.max(West, Max.x - ShapeMin.x)
			East = math.max(East, ShapeMax.x - Min.x)
			Up = math.max(Up, ShapeMax.y - Min.y)
		end
	end

	const Speed = Float() * PushRange + PushBase
	const Damped = Item.DeltaMovement * PushDamping
	const Closest = math.min(North, South, West, East, Up)

	if Closest == North then
		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Damped.x, Damped.y, -Speed)
	elseif Closest == South then
		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Damped.x, Damped.y, Speed)
	elseif Closest == West then
		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(-Speed, Damped.y, Damped.z)
	elseif Closest == East then
		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Speed, Damped.y, Damped.z)
	else
		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Damped.x, Speed, Damped.z)
	end
end

const function TickItem(Item: ItemEntity)
	if Items.IsEmpty(Item.Stack) then
		Discard(Item)

		return
	end

	Item.TickCount += 1
	BaseTick(Item)

	if Item.Removed then
		return
	end

	if Item.PickupDelay > 0 and Item.PickupDelay ~= NeverPickUp then
		Item.PickupDelay -= 1
	end

	const Previous = Item.Position
	const OldMovement = Item.DeltaMovement
	const Fluid = Item.Fluid

	if Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Item) and Fluid.WaterHeight > FluidDepth then
		const Movement = Item.DeltaMovement

		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x * WaterInertia, Movement.y + (if Movement.y < FluidRiseLimit then FluidRise else 0), Movement.z * WaterInertia)
	elseif Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Item) and Fluid.LavaHeight > FluidDepth then
		const Movement = Item.DeltaMovement

		Item.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x * LavaInertia, Movement.y + (if Movement.y < FluidRiseLimit then FluidRise else 0), Movement.z * LavaInertia)
	else
		Item.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Gravity, 0)
	end

	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Item)
	const Deflate = vector.one * Deflation

	Item.NoPhysics = not Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min + Deflate, Max - Deflate)

	if Item.NoPhysics then
		MoveTowardsClosestSpace(Item, Min, Max)
	end

	const Movement = Item.DeltaMovement

	if not (Item.OnGround and Movement.x * Movement.x + Movement.z * Movement.z <= RestingSpeedSquared and (Item.TickCount + Item.Id) % 4 ~= 0) then
		Minecraft.Entity.Move(Item, Item.DeltaMovement, false)

		local Friction = AirDrag

		if Item.OnGround then
			const Block = Minecraft.Entity.SupportingBlock(Item)

			Friction = Mth.Float(AirDrag * (if Block then Block.Friction else DefaultFriction))
		end

		Item.DeltaMovement *= vector.create(Friction, AirDrag, Friction)

		if Item.OnGround and Item.DeltaMovement.y < 0 then
			Item.DeltaMovement *= vector.create(1, BounceFactor, 1)
		end
	end

	ApplyFluidEffects(Item, Previous)

	if Item.Removed then
		return
	end

	Item.KnownMovement = Item.Position - Previous

	const Moved = Previous.x // 1 ~= Item.Position.x // 1 or Previous.y // 1 ~= Item.Position.y // 1 or Previous.z // 1 ~= Item.Position.z // 1

	if Item.TickCount % (if Moved then MovingMergeRate else RestingMergeRate) == 0 and IsMergeable(Item) then
		MergeWithNeighbours(Item)
	end

	if Item.Removed then
		return
	end

	Item.Age += 1

	if Minecraft.Entity.UpdateFluidInteraction(Item) then
		Item.NeedsSync = true
	end

	const Change = Item.DeltaMovement - OldMovement

	if vector.dot(Change, Change) > SyncThreshold then
		Item.NeedsSync = true
	end

	if Item.Age >= Lifetime or Item.Position.y < workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight / StudsPerBlock then
		Discard(Item)
	end
end

const function Touch(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer, Item: ItemEntity)
	const Stack = Item.Stack
	const Count = Items.GetCount(Stack)

	if Item.PickupDelay ~= 0 or (Item.Target ~= nil and Item.Target ~= Player.Player) or not Minecraft.Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, Stack, Player.Abilities.Instabuild) then
		return
	end

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteTakeItemEntity(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Item.Id, Player.Id, Count - Items.GetCount(Stack))
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		Discard(Item)
	end
end

const function TouchNearby(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Player)
	const Grow = vector.create(1, 0.5, 1)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, Player, Nearby) do
		const Entity = Nearby[Index]

		if Entity.Kind == "Item" and not Entity.Removed then
			Touch(Player, Entity :: ItemEntity)
		end
	end
end

const function Tick()
	for _, Created in Spawned do
		ItemEntities[Created] = true
	end

	table.clear(Spawned)

	for Item in ItemEntities do
		if Item.Removed then
			ItemEntities[Item] = nil
		else
			TickItem(Item)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player and Player.Health > 0 and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			TouchNearby(Player)
		end
	end
end

return {
	CreateDrop = CreateDrop,
	SpawnAtLocation = SpawnAtLocation,
	AllowOnly = AllowOnly,
	MakeFake = MakeFake,
	Drop = Drop,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/ItemUse"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const ItemEntities = require("./ItemEntities")
const Living = require("./Living")
const Melee = require("./Melee")
const Projectiles = require("./Projectiles")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Behaviors = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors
const Inventory = Minecraft.Inventory
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

const ArrowPower = Mth.Float(3.15)
const RocketPower = Mth.Float(1.6)
const BowPowerScale = 3
const MinimumBowPower = 0.1
const TridentThrowThreshold = 10
const RiptideTicks = 20
const RiptideDamage = 8
const BundleFirstDropDelay = 10
const OminousDuration = 120000
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const RocketPlacementOffset = 0.15
const CrossbowStartSound = 0.2
const CrossbowMidSound = 0.5
const BrushStroke = 10
const BrushSoundTick = 5
const BrushHitInset = 1.0E-3
const InstrumentRangeScale = 16
const UseOnReachTolerance = 1

const DefaultChargingSounds = {
	start = "minecraft:item.crossbow.loading_start",
	mid = "minecraft:item.crossbow.loading_middle",
	["end"] = "minecraft:item.crossbow.loading_end",
}

const ThrowSounds: { [string]: string } = {
	SnowballItem = "entity.snowball.throw",
	EggItem = "entity.egg.throw",
	EnderpearlItem = "entity.ender_pearl.throw",
	ExperienceBottleItem = "entity.experience_bottle.throw",
	SplashPotionItem = "entity.splash_potion.throw",
	LingeringPotionItem = "entity.lingering_potion.throw",
	WindChargeItem = "entity.wind_charge.throw",
}

type ServerPlayer = Entities.ServerPlayer
type ItemStack = Minecraft.ItemStack

const User: Minecraft.ItemUser = {
	Inventory = Inventory.Create(),
	Creative = false,
	InfiniteMaterials = false,
	Invulnerable = false,
	FoodLevel = 20,
	FallFlying = false,
	InWater = false,
}

const Stabbed: { Entities.Entity } = {}

const function HandSlot(OffHand: boolean): Minecraft.EquipmentSlot
	return if OffHand then "offhand" else "mainhand"
end

const function PrepareUser(Player: ServerPlayer): Minecraft.ItemUser
	User.Inventory = Player.Inventory
	User.Creative = Player.GameMode == "creative"
	User.InfiniteMaterials = Player.Abilities.Instabuild
	User.Invulnerable = Player.Abilities.Invulnerable
	User.FoodLevel = Player.Food.FoodLevel
	User.FallFlying = Player.FallFlying
	User.InWater = Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Player)

	return User
end

const function AddCooldown(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Ticks: number)
	const Group = Behaviors.CooldownGroup(Stack)

	Behaviors.AddCooldown(Player.Cooldowns, Group, Ticks)
	Protocol.WriteCooldown(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Group, Ticks)
end

const function Consume(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Amount: number)
	if not Player.Abilities.Instabuild then
		Items.Shrink(Stack, Amount)
	end
end

const function SetInHand(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Stack: ItemStack)
	Inventory.SetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(OffHand), if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then Items.Empty else Stack)
end

const function AfterUseSideEffects(Player: ServerPlayer, Result: ItemStack, Before: ItemStack): ItemStack
	const Remainder = Items.Get(Before, "minecraft:use_remainder") :: { id: string }?
	const CooldownTicks = Behaviors.UseCooldownTicks(Before)
	local Final = Result

	if Remainder and not Player.Abilities.Instabuild and Items.GetCount(Result) < Items.GetCount(Before) then
		const Created = Items.FromTemplate(Remainder)

		if Items.IsEmpty(Result) then
			Final = Created
		elseif not Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, Created, false) then
			ItemEntities.Drop(Player, Created, true)
		end
	end

	if CooldownTicks then
		AddCooldown(Player, Before, CooldownTicks)
	end

	return Final
end

const StopUsing = Living.StopUsingItem

const function StartUsing(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean)
	const Stack = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(OffHand))

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Player.UsingItem then
		return
	end

	Player.UseItem = Stack
	Player.UseItemRemaining = Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack)
	Player.UsingItem = true
	Player.UsingOffHand = OffHand

	if Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") then
		Player.RecentKineticEnemies = {}
	end
end

const function ApplyPotion(Player: ServerPlayer, Contents: unknown, Scale: number)
	for _, Effect in Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Contents, Scale) do
		const Definition = Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)

		if Definition and Definition.instantaneous then
			Living.ApplyInstantaneous(Player, Effect.Id, Effect.Amplifier, 1, Player, Player)
		else
			Living.AddEffect(Player, Effect)
		end
	end
end

const function ConsumeSound(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Event, Volume, Pitch = Behaviors.ConsumeSound(Stack, Player.Random)

	Sounds.EntitySound(Player, Event, Volume, Pitch)
end

const function OnConsume(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack): ItemStack
	const Consumable = Behaviors.ConsumableOf(Stack) :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Food = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:food") :: { nutrition: number, saturation: number }?
	const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")
	const Stew = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:suspicious_stew_effects") :: { { id: string, duration: number? } }?
	const Ominous = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:ominous_bottle_amplifier") :: number?

	ConsumeSound(Player, Stack)

	if Food then
		const Random = Player.Random

		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Consumable.sound) or "entity.generic.eat", 1, 1 + 0.4 * (Random:NextNumber() - Random:NextNumber()))
		Minecraft.Food.Add(Player.Food, Food.nutrition, Mth.Float(Food.saturation))
		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "entity.player.burp", 0.5, 0.9 + Random:NextNumber() * 0.1)
	end

	if Contents ~= nil then
		ApplyPotion(Player, Contents, (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_duration_scale") :: number?) or 1)
	end

	if Stew then
		for _, Entry in Stew do
			Living.AddEffect(Player, Minecraft.Effects.Create(Entry.id, Entry.duration or 160, 0))
		end
	end

	if Ominous then
		Living.AddEffect(Player, Minecraft.Effects.Create("minecraft:bad_omen", OminousDuration, Ominous, false, false, true))
	end

	Living.ApplyConsumeEffects(Player, (Consumable.on_consume_effects or {}) :: { { [string]: unknown } })
	Consume(Player, Stack, 1)

	return Stack
end

const function UseAmmo(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: ItemStack, Ammo: ItemStack, ForceInfinite: boolean): ItemStack
	const AmmoToUse = if not ForceInfinite and not Player.Abilities.Instabuild then Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.ItemValue("minecraft:ammo_use", Weapon, Ammo, 1, Player.Random) // 1 else 0

	if AmmoToUse > Items.GetCount(Ammo) then
		return Items.Empty
	end

	if AmmoToUse == 0 then
		const Copy = Items.CopyWithCount(Ammo, 1)

		Items.Set(Copy, "minecraft:intangible_projectile", {})

		return Copy
	end

	const Used = Items.Split(Ammo, AmmoToUse)

	if Items.IsEmpty(Ammo) then
		for Slot = 0, Inventory.Size - 1 do
			if Inventory.GetItem(Player.Inventory, Slot) == Ammo then
				Inventory.SetItem(Player.Inventory, Slot, Items.Empty)
			end
		end

		if Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, "offhand") == Ammo then
			Inventory.SetEquipment(Player.Inventory, "offhand", Items.Empty)
		end
	end

	return Used
end

const function Draw(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: ItemStack, Ammo: ItemStack): { ItemStack }
	const Drawn: { ItemStack } = {}

	if Items.IsEmpty(Ammo) then
		return Drawn
	end

	const Count = math.max(0, Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.EntityValue("minecraft:projectile_count", Weapon, Player, 1, Player.Random) // 1)
	const AmmoCopy = Items.Copy(Ammo)

	for Index = 0, Count - 1 do
		const Used = UseAmmo(Player, Weapon, if Index == 0 then Ammo else AmmoCopy, Index > 0)

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Used) then
			table.insert(Drawn, Used)
		end
	end

	return Drawn
end

const function CrossbowShotPitch(Random: Random, Index: number): number
	if Index == 0 then
		return 1
	end

	return 1 / (Random:NextNumber() * 0.5 + 1.8) + (if Index % 2 == 1 then 0.63 else 0.43)
end

const function Shoot(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Weapon: ItemStack, Shots: { ItemStack }, Power: number, Uncertainty: number, Critical: boolean, FromCrossbow: boolean)
	const MaximumAngle = math.max(0, Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.EntityValue("minecraft:projectile_spread", Weapon, Player, 0, Player.Random))
	const Step = if #Shots == 1 then 0 else Mth.Float(2 * MaximumAngle / (#Shots - 1))
	const Offset = Mth.Float((#Shots - 1) % 2 * Step / 2)
	local Direction = 1

	for Index, Shot in Shots do
		if Items.IsEmpty(Shot) then
			continue
		end

		const Angle = Mth.Float(Offset + Direction * (Index // 2) * Step)

		Direction = -Direction

		if FromCrossbow then
			Projectiles.ShootFromCrossbow(Player, Weapon, Shot, Power, Uncertainty, Angle)
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "item.crossbow.shoot", 1, CrossbowShotPitch(Player.Random, Index - 1))
		else
			Projectiles.ShootArrow(Player, Weapon, Shot, Power, Uncertainty, Critical, Angle)
		end

		Living.HurtAndBreak(Player, Weapon, if Items.Is(Shot, "minecraft:firework_rocket") then 3 else 1, HandSlot(OffHand))

		if Items.IsEmpty(Weapon) then
			break
		end
	end
end

const function ShootCrossbow(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Crossbow: ItemStack)
	const Charged = (Items.Get(Crossbow, "minecraft:charged_projectiles") :: { unknown }?) or {}
	local Power = ArrowPower
	const Shots: { ItemStack } = {}

	for _, Template in Charged do
		const Shot = Items.FromTemplate(Template)

		if Items.Is(Shot, "minecraft:firework_rocket") then
			Power = RocketPower
		end

		table.insert(Shots, Shot)
	end

	Items.Set(Crossbow, "minecraft:charged_projectiles", {})

	if #Shots > 0 then
		Shoot(Player, OffHand, Crossbow, Shots, Power, 1, true, true)
	end
end

const function LoadCrossbow(Player: ServerPlayer, Crossbow: ItemStack): boolean
	const Ammo = Behaviors.FindProjectile(Crossbow, PrepareUser(Player))
	const Drawn = Draw(Player, Crossbow, Ammo)

	if #Drawn > 0 then
		const Templates: { unknown } = {}

		for _, Stack in Drawn do
			table.insert(Templates, Items.ToTemplate(Stack))
		end

		Items.Set(Crossbow, "minecraft:charged_projectiles", Templates)
	end

	return #Drawn > 0
end

const function SwapEquipment(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack): ItemStack
	const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot }
	const Slot = Equippable.slot
	const Equipped = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)
	const Creative = Player.GameMode == "creative"

	const Previous = Items.Copy(Equipped)

	if Items.GetCount(Stack) <= 1 then
		const ToHand = if Items.IsEmpty(Equipped) then Stack else Items.CopyAndClear(Equipped)
		const ToEquipment = if Creative then Items.Copy(Stack) else Items.CopyAndClear(Stack)

		Inventory.SetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot, ToEquipment)
		Living.OnEquipItem(Player, Slot, Previous, ToEquipment)

		return ToHand
	end

	const ToInventory = Items.CopyAndClear(Equipped)
	const ToEquipment = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, 1)

	Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
	Inventory.SetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot, ToEquipment)
	Living.OnEquipItem(Player, Slot, Previous, ToEquipment)

	if not Items.IsEmpty(ToInventory) and not Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, ToInventory, false) then
		ItemEntities.Drop(Player, ToInventory, true)
	end

	return Stack
end

const function ThrowItem(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	for Class, Event in ThrowSounds do
		if Registry.IsInstance(Item, Class) then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Event, 0.5, 0.4 / (Player.Random:NextNumber() * 0.4 + 0.8))
		end
	end

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SnowballItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "Snowball", Stack, 0, 1.5)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "EggItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "Egg", Stack, 0, 1.5)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "EnderpearlItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "EnderPearl", Stack, 0, 1.5)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "ExperienceBottleItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "ExperienceBottle", Stack, -20, 0.7)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SplashPotionItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "SplashPotion", Stack, -20, 0.5)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "LingeringPotionItem") then
		Projectiles.Throw(Player, "LingeringPotion", Stack, -20, 0.5)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "WindChargeItem") then
		Projectiles.ShootWindCharge(Player, Stack)
	end

	Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
end

const function PlayInstrument(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Instrument = Behaviors.Instrument(Stack) :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Durability = (Instrument.durability_damage :: number?) or 0
	const Seconds = Mth.Float(Instrument.use_duration :: number)

	StartUsing(Player, OffHand)

	const Sound = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Instrument.sound_event)

	if Sound then
		Sounds.PlayFromEntity(Player.Player, Player, Sound, Mth.Float((Instrument.range :: number) / InstrumentRangeScale), 1)
	end

	if Durability > 0 then
		Living.HurtAndBreak(Player, Stack, Durability, HandSlot(OffHand))
	end

	if Seconds > 0 then
		AddCooldown(Player, Stack, Mth.Float(Seconds * TicksPerSecond) // 1)
	end
end

const function Perform(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Stack: ItemStack, Action: Minecraft.UseAction): ItemStack
	if Action == "StartUsing" or Action == "StartKinetic" then
		StartUsing(Player, OffHand)

		const Kinetic = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") :: { sound: unknown? }?
		const KineticSound = if Action == "StartKinetic" and Kinetic then Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Kinetic.sound) else nil

		if KineticSound then
			Sounds.EntitySound(Player, KineticSound, 1, 1)
		elseif Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Stack), "SpyglassItem") then
			Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "item.spyglass.use", 1, 1)
		end
	elseif Action == "ShootCrossbow" then
		ShootCrossbow(Player, OffHand, Stack)
	elseif Action == "Throw" then
		ThrowItem(Player, Stack)
	elseif Action == "ConsumeInstantly" then
		return OnConsume(Player, Stack)
	elseif Action == "SwapEquipment" then
		return SwapEquipment(Player, Stack)
	elseif Action == "PlayInstrument" then
		PlayInstrument(Player, OffHand, Stack)
	elseif Action == "BoostFirework" then
		Projectiles.AttachFirework(Player, Stack)
		Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
	elseif Action == "ConsumeKnowledgeBook" then
		Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
	end

	return Stack
end

const function UseItem(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, YRot: number, XRot: number)
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Living.IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		return
	end

	const Stack = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(OffHand))

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		return
	end

	Player.YRot = Mth.WrapDegrees(YRot)
	Player.XRot = Mth.WrapDegrees(XRot)
	Player.YHeadRot = Player.YRot

	if Behaviors.IsOnCooldown(Player.Cooldowns, Stack) then
		return
	end

	const Before = Items.Copy(Stack)
	const Instant = Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) <= 0
	const Outcome, Action = Behaviors.Use(Stack, PrepareUser(Player))

	if Outcome == "Pass" then
		return
	end

	local Result = if Outcome == "Fail" then Stack else Perform(Player, OffHand, Stack, Action)

	if Instant and Outcome ~= "Fail" then
		Result = AfterUseSideEffects(Player, Result, Before)
	end

	if Result ~= Stack or Items.IsEmpty(Result) then
		SetInHand(Player, OffHand, Result)
	end

	if Outcome == "Success" then
		Melee.Swing(Player, OffHand, Before, false, false)
	end
end

const function KineticConditionPasses(Condition: unknown?, Used: number, AttackerSpeed: number, Relative: number): boolean
	if Condition == nil then
		return false
	end

	const Fields = Condition :: { max_duration_ticks: number, min_speed: number?, min_relative_speed: number? }

	return Used <= Fields.max_duration_ticks and AttackerSpeed >= Mth.Float(Fields.min_speed or 0) and Relative >= Mth.Float(Fields.min_relative_speed or 0)
end

const function DamageWithKinetic(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Remaining: number)
	const Kinetic = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") :: { [string]: unknown }
	const Delay = (Kinetic.delay_ticks :: number?) or 0
	local Used = Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Remaining

	if Used < Delay then
		return
	end

	Used -= Delay

	const Look = Melee.LookVector(Player.XRot, Player.YRot)
	const AttackerSpeed = vector.dot(Look, Player.KnownMovement * TicksPerSecond)
	const Attribute = Registry.Attribute("minecraft:attack_damage")
	const BaseDamage = Mth.Float(Attribute.player or Attribute.default)
	const Cooldown = (Kinetic.contact_cooldown_ticks :: number?) or 10
	const Multiplier = Mth.Float((Kinetic.damage_multiplier :: number?) or 1)
	const Recent = Player.RecentKineticEnemies
	local Affected = false

	for Index = 1, Melee.HitEntitiesAlong(Player, Stack, Stabbed) do
		const Target = Stabbed[Index]
		const Last = if Recent then Recent[Target] else nil

		if Last and Player.TickCount - Last < Cooldown then
			continue
		end

		if Recent then
			Recent[Target] = Player.TickCount
		end

		const TargetSpeed = vector.dot(Look, Target.KnownMovement * TicksPerSecond)
		const Relative = math.max(0, AttackerSpeed - TargetSpeed)
		const Damages = KineticConditionPasses(Kinetic.damage_conditions, Used, AttackerSpeed, Relative)
		const Knocks = KineticConditionPasses(Kinetic.knockback_conditions, Used, AttackerSpeed, Relative)
		const Dismounts = KineticConditionPasses(Kinetic.dismount_conditions, Used, AttackerSpeed, Relative)

		if Damages or Knocks or Dismounts then
			const Damage = BaseDamage + (Relative * Multiplier) // 1

			Affected = Melee.StabAttack(Player, HandSlot(Player.UsingOffHand), Target, Damage, Damages, Knocks) or Affected
		end
	end

	if Affected then
		Living.BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.KineticHit)
	end
end

const function DropFromBundle(Player: ServerPlayer, Bundle: ItemStack)
	const Contents = Items.Bundle.Open(Bundle)

	if not Contents then
		return
	end

	const Removed = Items.Bundle.RemoveOne(Contents)

	Items.Bundle.Close(Bundle, Contents)

	if Removed then
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "item.bundle.remove_one", 0.8, 0.8 + Player.Random:NextNumber() * 0.4)
		ItemEntities.Drop(Player, Removed, true)
		Sounds.Play(nil, vector.floor(Player.Position) + vector.one * 0.5, "item.bundle.drop_contents", 0.8, 0.8 + Player.Random:NextNumber() * 0.4)
	end
end

const function TickCrossbowSounds(Player: ServerPlayer, Crossbow: ItemStack, Progress: number)
	const Charging = (Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.PickHighestLevel(Crossbow, "minecraft:crossbow_charging_sounds") or DefaultChargingSounds) :: { [string]: unknown }

	if Progress < CrossbowStartSound then
		Player.CrossbowStartSoundPlayed = false
		Player.CrossbowMidSoundPlayed = false
	end

	if Progress >= CrossbowStartSound and not Player.CrossbowStartSoundPlayed then
		const Start = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Charging.start)

		Player.CrossbowStartSoundPlayed = true

		if Start then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Start, 0.5, 1)
		end
	end

	if Progress >= CrossbowMidSound and not Player.CrossbowMidSoundPlayed then
		const Mid = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Charging.mid)

		Player.CrossbowMidSoundPlayed = true

		if Mid then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Mid, 0.5, 1)
		end
	end

	if Progress >= 1 and not Behaviors.IsChargedCrossbow(Crossbow) and LoadCrossbow(Player, Crossbow) then
		const End = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Charging["end"])

		if End then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, End, 1, 1 / (Player.Random:NextNumber() * 0.5 + 1) + 0.2)
		end
	end
end

const function TickBrush(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Remaining: number)
	const Range = Behaviors.InteractionRange(Player.Inventory, Player.Effects, Player.GameMode == "creative", "minecraft:block_interaction_range")
	const Hit, Normal = Minecraft.Collision.RaycastNormal(Melee.EyePosition(Player), Melee.LookVector(Player.XRot, Player.YRot) * Range)

	if Remaining < 0 or not Hit then
		StopUsing(Player)

		return
	end

	if (Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Remaining + 1) % BrushStroke == BrushSoundTick then
		Sounds.Play(Player.Player, vector.floor(Hit - Normal * BrushHitInset) + vector.one * 0.5, "item.brush.brushing.generic", 1, 1)
	end
end

const function OnUseTick(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Remaining: number)
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)

	if Behaviors.ShouldEmitConsumeEffects(Stack, Remaining) then
		ConsumeSound(Player, Stack)
	end

	if Items.Has(Stack, "minecraft:kinetic_weapon") then
		DamageWithKinetic(Player, Stack, Remaining)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CrossbowItem") then
		TickCrossbowSounds(Player, Stack, (Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Remaining) / Behaviors.ChargeDuration(Stack))
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BrushItem") then
		TickBrush(Player, Stack, Remaining)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BundleItem") then
		const Duration = Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack)

		if Remaining == Duration or Remaining < Duration - BundleFirstDropDelay and Remaining % 2 == 0 then
			DropFromBundle(Player, Stack)
		end
	end
end

const function UseItemOn(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Location: vector, Face: vector)
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Living.IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		return
	end

	const Range = Behaviors.InteractionRange(Player.Inventory, Player.Effects, Player.GameMode == "creative", "minecraft:block_interaction_range")

	if vector.magnitude(Location - Melee.EyePosition(Player)) >= Range + UseOnReachTolerance then
		return
	end

	const Stack = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(OffHand))

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) or Behaviors.IsOnCooldown(Player.Cooldowns, Stack) then
		return
	end

	const Outcome, Action = Behaviors.UseOn(Stack, PrepareUser(Player))

	if Outcome == "Pass" then
		return
	end

	if Action == "LaunchFirework" then
		Projectiles.LaunchFirework(Player, Stack, Location + Face * RocketPlacementOffset)
		Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
	elseif Action == "StartUsing" then
		StartUsing(Player, OffHand)
	end

	if Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
		SetInHand(Player, OffHand, Items.Empty)
	end

	if Outcome == "Success" then
		Melee.Swing(Player, OffHand, Stack, false, false)
	end
end

const function ReleaseUsing(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Remaining: number): boolean
	const Item = Items.ItemOf(Stack)
	const TimeHeld = Behaviors.UseDuration(Stack) - Remaining

	if Registry.IsInstance(Item, "BowItem") then
		const Ammo = Behaviors.FindProjectile(Stack, PrepareUser(Player))

		if Items.IsEmpty(Ammo) then
			return false
		end

		const Power = Behaviors.BowPower(TimeHeld)

		if Power < MinimumBowPower then
			return false
		end

		const Drawn = Draw(Player, Stack, Ammo)

		if #Drawn > 0 then
			Shoot(Player, Player.UsingOffHand, Stack, Drawn, Power * BowPowerScale, 1, Power == 1, false)
		end

		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "entity.arrow.shoot", 1, 1 / (Player.Random:NextNumber() * 0.4 + 1.2) + Power * 0.5)

		return true
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "CrossbowItem") then
		return Behaviors.CrossbowPower(TimeHeld, Stack) >= 1 and Behaviors.IsChargedCrossbow(Stack)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "TridentItem") then
		const Strength = Behaviors.TridentSpinStrength(Stack)

		if TimeHeld < TridentThrowThreshold or Strength > 0 and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInWater(Player) or Behaviors.NextDamageWillBreak(Stack) then
			return false
		end

		const Sound = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.PickHighestLevel(Stack, "minecraft:trident_sound")) or "item.trident.throw"

		Living.HurtWithoutBreaking(Player, Stack, 1)

		if Strength == 0 then
			const Thrown = Items.CopyWithCount(Stack, 1)

			Consume(Player, Stack, 1)
			Sounds.PlayFromEntity(nil, Projectiles.ThrowTrident(Player, Thrown), Sound, 1, 1)

			return true
		end

		Player.DeltaMovement += Behaviors.RiptidePush(Player.XRot, Player.YRot, Strength)
		Living.StartAutoSpinAttack(Player, RiptideTicks, RiptideDamage, Stack)
		Sounds.PlayFromEntity(nil, Player, Sound, 1, 1)

		return true
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Item, "SpyglassItem") then
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "item.spyglass.stop_using", 1, 1)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function Release(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const InHand = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(Player.UsingOffHand))
	const UseItem = Player.UseItem

	if not Items.IsEmpty(UseItem) and Items.IsSameItem(InHand, UseItem) then
		Player.UseItem = InHand

		const Before = Items.Copy(InHand)

		if ReleaseUsing(Player, InHand, Player.UseItemRemaining) then
			const Result = AfterUseSideEffects(Player, InHand, Before)

			if Result ~= InHand then
				SetInHand(Player, Player.UsingOffHand, Result)
			end
		end

		if Behaviors.UseOnRelease(InHand) and Player.UsingItem then
			OnUseTick(Player, InHand, Player.UseItemRemaining)
			Player.UseItemRemaining -= 1
		end
	end

	StopUsing(Player)
end

const function Complete(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const OffHand = Player.UsingOffHand
	const InHand = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(OffHand))
	const UseItem = Player.UseItem

	if UseItem ~= InHand then
		Release(Player)

		return
	end

	Protocol.WriteEntityEvent(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Player.Id, Protocol.EntityEvents.UseItemComplete)

	const Before = Items.Copy(UseItem)
	local Result = UseItem

	if Behaviors.ConsumableOf(UseItem) then
		Result = OnConsume(Player, UseItem)
	elseif Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(UseItem), "SpyglassItem") then
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "item.spyglass.stop_using", 1, 1)
	end

	Result = AfterUseSideEffects(Player, Result, Before)

	if Result ~= UseItem or Items.IsEmpty(Result) then
		SetInHand(Player, OffHand, Result)
	end

	StopUsing(Player)
end

const function Tick(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if not Player.UsingItem then
		return
	end

	const InHand = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, HandSlot(Player.UsingOffHand))

	if not Items.IsSameItem(InHand, Player.UseItem) then
		StopUsing(Player)

		return
	end

	Player.UseItem = InHand
	OnUseTick(Player, InHand, Player.UseItemRemaining)

	if not Player.UsingItem then
		return
	end

	Player.UseItemRemaining -= 1

	if Player.UseItemRemaining == 0 and not Behaviors.UseOnRelease(InHand) then
		Complete(Player)
	end
end

const function LivingFlags(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	local Flags = 0

	if Player.UsingItem then
		Flags += Protocol.LivingFlags.UsingItem

		if Player.UsingOffHand then
			Flags += Protocol.LivingFlags.OffHand
		end
	end

	if Player.SpinAttack then
		Flags += Protocol.LivingFlags.SpinAttack
	end

	return Flags
end

return {
	UseItem = UseItem,
	UseItemOn = UseItemOn,
	Release = Release,
	Stop = StopUsing,
	Tick = Tick,
	LivingFlags = LivingFlags,
}

end

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const ResistancePerLevel = 5
const ResistanceDivider = 25
const SprintJumpExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.2)
const JumpExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.05)
const SprintExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.1)
const AttackExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.1)
const HungerExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.005)
const ArrowRemovalBase = 30
const TeleportAttempts = 16
const HorizontalRestThreshold = 9.0E-6
const GlideFallSpeed = -0.5
const GlideFallDistanceCap = 1
const GlideDamageStep = 10
const VerticalRestThreshold = 0.003
const WindChargedRadiusBase = 3
const WindChargedRadiusRange = 2
const WindChargedKnockback = 1.22
const MaxAirSupply = 300
const AirRefill = 4
const DrownThreshold = -20
const DrownDamage = 2
const LavaIgniteSeconds = 15
const LavaDamage = 4
const FireImmuneTicks = 20
const LavaFallScale = 0.5
const TurtleHelmetTicks = 200
const MovementExhaustion = Mth.Float(0.01)
const LandedSpeed = Mth.Float(1.0E-5)
const BigFallDamage = 4
const FallParticleBase = 0.2
const FallParticleScale = 15
const FallParticleLimit = 2.5
const FallParticleCount = 150
const FallParticleSpeed = 0.15
const SmashFallParticlesPerBlock = 50
const SmashFallParticleLimit = 200
const SmashFallSpread = vector.one * 0.3
const AmbientEffectAlpha = 38 / 255
const LegacyOnOffset = vector.create(0, 0.2, 0)
const OnOffset = vector.create(0, 1.0E-5, 0)
const SplashVolumeScale = 0.2
const SwimVolumeScale = 0.35
const HighSpeedSplash = 0.25

const BreakEvents: { [string]: number } = {
	mainhand = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakMainHand,
	offhand = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakOffHand,
	head = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakHead,
	chest = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakChest,
	legs = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakLegs,
	feet = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakFeet,
	body = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakBody,
	saddle = Protocol.EntityEvents.BreakSaddle,
}

const ArmorSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = { "feet", "legs", "chest", "head" }
const HeadSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = { "head" }
const HandSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = { "mainhand", "offhand" }
const GliderSlots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot } = {}

type ServerPlayer = Entities.ServerPlayer
type Entity = Entities.Entity
type Source = Minecraft.DamageSource

const Generator = Random.new()
const EffectIds: { string } = {}

const function Stream(Player: ServerPlayer): Minecraft.Stream
	return Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player)
end

const function StopUsingItem(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.UsingItem = false
	Player.UseItem = Items.Empty
	Player.UseItemRemaining = 0
	Player.RecentKineticEnemies = nil
end

const function BroadcastEntityEvent(Entity: Entity, Event: number)
	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteEntityEvent(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Entity.Id, Event)
	end
end

const function TrianglePitch(Mode: number, Deviation: number): number
	return Mode + Deviation * (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber())
end

const function ExtinguishSound(Entity: Entity)
	Sounds.Play(nil, Entity.Position, "entity.generic.extinguish_fire", 0.7, TrianglePitch(1.6, 0.4))
end

const function OnEquipItem(Player: ServerPlayer, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot, Old: Minecraft.ItemStack, New: Minecraft.ItemStack)
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Items.IsSameItemSameComponents(Old, New) then
		return
	end

	const Equippable = Items.Get(New, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: string, equip_sound: unknown? }?

	if Equippable and Equippable.slot == Slot then
		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Equippable.equip_sound) or "item.armor.equip_generic", 1, 1)
	end
end

const function EffectParticleOptions(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): Minecraft.ParticleOptions
	if Effect.Id == "minecraft:trial_omen" or Effect.Id == "minecraft:raid_omen" then
		return { Type = string.sub(Effect.Id, #"minecraft:" + 1) }
	end

	const Color = (Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id) :: Minecraft.MobEffect).color

	return {
		Type = "entity_effect",
		Color = vector.create(bit32.extract(Color, 16, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 8, 8), bit32.extract(Color, 0, 8)) / 255,
		Alpha = if Effect.Ambient then AmbientEffectAlpha else 1,
	}
end

const function UpdateEffectParticles(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Visible: { Minecraft.ParticleOptions } = {}
	local Ambient = true

	for _, Effect in Player.Effects do
		if Effect.Visible then
			table.insert(Visible, EffectParticleOptions(Effect))
			Ambient = Ambient and Effect.Ambient
		end
	end

	Player.EffectParticles = Visible

	if next(Player.Effects) ~= nil then
		Player.EffectAmbience = Ambient
	end

	Player.DataForced = true
end

const function BroadcastDamageEvent(Entity: Entity, Source: Source)
	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteDamageEvent(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Entity.Id, Source.Type)
	end
end

const function AttributeValue(Player: ServerPlayer, Id: string): number
	return Attributes.Value(Id, Player.Inventory, Player.Effects)
end

const function MaxHealth(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	return Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:max_health"))
end

const function SetHealth(Player: ServerPlayer, Health: number)
	Player.Health = Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float(Health), 0, MaxHealth(Player))
end

const function SetAbsorption(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	Player.Absorption = Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float(Amount), 0, Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:max_absorption")))
end

const function Heal(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	if Player.Health > 0 then
		SetHealth(Player, Player.Health + Amount)
	end
end

const function IsDeadOrDying(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	return Player.Health <= 0 or Player.Dead
end

const function CauseFoodExhaustion(Player: ServerPlayer, Amount: number)
	if not Player.Abilities.Invulnerable then
		Minecraft.Food.AddExhaustion(Player.Food, Amount)
	end
end

const function RefreshAttributes(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.Health > MaxHealth(Player) then
		SetHealth(Player, MaxHealth(Player))
	end

	SetAbsorption(Player, Player.Absorption)
end

const function EffectFlags(Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, Blend: boolean): number
	local Flags = 0

	if Effect.Ambient then
		Flags += Protocol.EffectFlags.Ambient
	end

	if Effect.Visible then
		Flags += Protocol.EffectFlags.Visible
	end

	if Effect.ShowIcon then
		Flags += Protocol.EffectFlags.ShowIcon
	end

	if Blend then
		Flags += Protocol.EffectFlags.Blend
	end

	return Flags
end

const function SendEffect(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, Blend: boolean)
	Protocol.WriteUpdateMobEffect(Stream(Player), Player.Id, Effect.Id, Effect.Amplifier, Effect.Duration, EffectFlags(Effect, Blend))
end

const function OnEffectUpdated(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance, Refresh: boolean)
	Player.EffectsDirty = true

	if Refresh then
		RefreshAttributes(Player)
	end

	SendEffect(Player, Effect, false)
end

const function OnEffectRemoved(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance)
	Player.EffectsDirty = true
	RefreshAttributes(Player)
	Protocol.WriteRemoveMobEffect(Stream(Player), Player.Id, Effect.Id)
end

const function OnEffectStarted(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance)
	if Effect.Id == "minecraft:absorption" then
		SetAbsorption(Player, math.max(Player.Absorption, 4 * (1 + Effect.Amplifier)))
	end
end

const function AddEffect(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): boolean
	const Existing = Player.Effects[Effect.Id]
	local Changed = false

	if not Existing then
		Player.Effects[Effect.Id] = Effect
		Player.EffectsDirty = true
		RefreshAttributes(Player)
		SendEffect(Player, Effect, true)
		Changed = true
	elseif Effects.Update(Existing, Effect) then
		OnEffectUpdated(Player, Existing, true)
		Changed = true
	end

	OnEffectStarted(Player, Effect)

	return Changed
end

const function RemoveEffect(Player: ServerPlayer, Id: string): boolean
	const Effect = Player.Effects[Id]

	if not Effect then
		return false
	end

	Player.Effects[Id] = nil
	OnEffectRemoved(Player, Effect)

	return true
end

const function RemoveAllEffects(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	if next(Player.Effects) == nil then
		return false
	end

	for Id in Player.Effects do
		RemoveEffect(Player, Id)
	end

	return true
end

const function Ignite(Entity: Entity, Seconds: number)
	const Ticks = Mth.Float(Seconds * 20) // 1

	if Entity.Kind ~= "Humanoid" and Entity.RemainingFireTicks < Ticks then
		Entity.RemainingFireTicks = Ticks
	end
end

const function SubjectOf(Entity: Entity?): Instance?
	if not Entity then
		return nil
	end

	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		return Player.Player
	end

	const Humanoid = Entities.AsHumanoid(Entity)

	return if Humanoid then Humanoid.Model else nil
end

const function BreakEquipment(Player: ServerPlayer, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot)
	BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, BreakEvents[Slot])
end

const function HurtAndBreak(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Amount: number, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot?)
	if not Items.IsDamageableItem(Stack) or Player.Abilities.Instabuild then
		return
	end

	const Change = if Amount > 0 then Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.ItemValue("minecraft:item_damage", Stack, Stack, Amount, Player.Random) // 1 else Amount

	if Change == 0 then
		return
	end

	Items.SetDamageValue(Stack, Items.DamageValue(Stack) + Change)

	if Items.DamageValue(Stack) >= Items.MaxDamage(Stack) then
		Items.Shrink(Stack, 1)

		if Slot then
			BreakEquipment(Player, Slot)
		end
	end
end

const function HurtWithoutBreaking(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Amount: number)
	if not Items.IsDamageableItem(Stack) or Player.Abilities.Instabuild then
		return
	end

	const Change = Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.ItemValue("minecraft:item_damage", Stack, Stack, Amount, Player.Random) // 1

	if Change ~= 0 then
		Items.SetDamageValue(Stack, math.min(Items.DamageValue(Stack) + Change, Items.MaxDamage(Stack) - 1))
	end
end

const function HurtEquipment(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number, Slots: { Minecraft.EquipmentSlot })
	if Amount <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Durability = math.modf(math.max(1, Amount / 4))

	for _, Slot in Slots do
		const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)
		const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: string, damage_on_hurt: boolean? }?

		if Equippable and Equippable.damage_on_hurt ~= false and Items.IsDamageableItem(Stack) and DamageRules.ItemCanBeHurtBy(Stack, Source) then
			HurtAndBreak(Player, Stack, Durability, Slot)
		end
	end
end

const function IsInvulnerableTo(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source): boolean
	if Player.Removed then
		return true
	end

	return Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.IsImmuneToDamage(Player.Inventory, Player, Source, Player.Random)
end

const function ViewVector(YRot: number): vector
	const Angle = Mth.Float(-YRot * (math.pi / 180))

	return vector.create(Mth.Sin(Angle), 0, Mth.Cos(Angle))
end

const function ItemBlockingWith(Player: ServerPlayer): Minecraft.ItemStack?
	if not Player.UsingItem then
		return nil
	end

	const Delay = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.BlockDelayTicks(Player.UseItem)

	if Delay and Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.UseDuration(Player.UseItem) - Player.UseItemRemaining >= Delay then
		return Player.UseItem
	end

	return nil
end

const function BlockedDamage(Blocks: { [string]: unknown }, Source: Source, Damage: number, Angle: number): number
	const Reductions = (Blocks.damage_reductions or { { horizontal_blocking_angle = 90, base = 0, factor = 1 } }) :: { { [string]: unknown } }
	local Blocked = 0

	for _, Reduction in Reductions do
		const Limit = math.rad(Mth.Float((Reduction.horizontal_blocking_angle :: number?) or 90))

		if Angle <= Limit and (Reduction.type == nil or Minecraft.Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:damage_type", Reduction.type, Source.Type)) then
			Blocked += Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float((Reduction.base :: number) + (Reduction.factor :: number) * Damage), 0, Damage)
		end
	end

	return Mth.Clamp(Blocked, 0, Damage)
end

const function DisableBlocking(Player: ServerPlayer, Blocks: { [string]: unknown }, Seconds: number, Blocking: Minecraft.ItemStack)
	const Scaled = Mth.Float(Seconds * Mth.Float((Blocks.disable_cooldown_scale :: number?) or 1))
	const Ticks = if Scaled > 0 then math.round(Scaled * 20) else 0

	if Ticks > 0 then
		const Group = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CooldownGroup(Blocking)
		const DisableSound = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Blocks.disable_sound)

		Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.AddCooldown(Player.Cooldowns, Group, Ticks)
		Protocol.WriteCooldown(Stream(Player), Group, Ticks)
		StopUsingItem(Player)

		if DisableSound then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, DisableSound, 0.8, 0.8 + Generator:NextNumber() * 0.4)
		end
	end
end

const function Knockback(Entity: Entity, Power: number, DirectionX: number, DirectionZ: number)
	local X = DirectionX
	local Z = DirectionZ

	while X * X + Z * Z < MinimumKnockbackDirection do
		X = (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber()) * 0.01
		Z = (Generator:NextNumber() - Generator:NextNumber()) * 0.01
	end

	const Humanoid = Entities.AsHumanoid(Entity)

	if Humanoid then
		if Power > 0 then
			const Direction = Mth.Normalize(vector.create(X, 0, Z))

			DamageContract.Knockback(Humanoid.Model, -Direction * Power)
		end

		return
	end

	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if not Player then
		return
	end

	const Resisted = Power * (1 - AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:knockback_resistance"))

	if Resisted <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Push = Mth.Normalize(vector.create(X, 0, Z)) * Resisted
	const Old = Player.DeltaMovement

	Player.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Old.x / 2 - Push.x, if Player.OnGround then math.min(MaximumKnockbackLift, Old.y / 2 + Resisted) else Old.y, Old.z / 2 - Push.z)
	Player.HurtMarked = true
end

const function ApplyItemBlocking(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Damage: number): number
	if Damage <= 0 then
		return 0
	end

	const Blocking = ItemBlockingWith(Player)
	const Blocks = if Blocking then Items.Get(Blocking, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") :: { [string]: unknown }? else nil

	if not Blocking or not Blocks then
		return 0
	end

	if Blocks.bypassed_by and Minecraft.Registry.HolderSetContains("minecraft:damage_type", Blocks.bypassed_by, Source.Type) then
		return 0
	end

	const Direct = Source.Direct :: Entity?

	if Direct and (Direct.PierceLevel or 0) > 0 then
		return 0
	end

	const SourcePosition = DamageRules.SourcePosition(Source)
	local Angle = math.pi

	if SourcePosition then
		const Toward = SourcePosition - Player.Position
		const Flat = Mth.Normalize(vector.create(Toward.x, 0, Toward.z))

		Angle = math.acos(math.clamp(vector.dot(Flat, ViewVector(Player.YHeadRot)), -1, 1))
	end

	const Blocked = BlockedDamage(Blocks, Source, Damage, Angle)
	const ItemDamage = (Blocks.item_damage or { threshold = 1, base = 0, factor = 1 }) :: { threshold: number, base: number, factor: number }
	const Durability = if Blocked < ItemDamage.threshold then 0 else Mth.Float(ItemDamage.base + ItemDamage.factor * Blocked) // 1

	if Durability > 0 then
		HurtAndBreak(Player, Blocking, Durability, if Player.UsingOffHand then "offhand" else "mainhand")
	end

	if Blocked > 0 and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:is_projectile") and Direct and Direct.IsLiving then
		if Blocked < Damage then
			Knockback(Player, 0.5, Player.Position.x - Direct.Position.x, Player.Position.z - Direct.Position.z)
		end

		const Attacker = Entities.AsPlayer(Direct)

		if Attacker then
			const Weapon = Minecraft.Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Attacker.Inventory)
			const WeaponData = Items.Get(Weapon, "minecraft:weapon") :: { disable_blocking_for_seconds: number? }?
			const Active = if Attacker.UsingItem then Attacker.UseItem else Weapon
			const Seconds = if WeaponData and Active == Weapon then Mth.Float(WeaponData.disable_blocking_for_seconds or 0) else 0

			if Seconds > 0 then
				DisableBlocking(Player, Blocks, Seconds, Blocking)
			end
		end
	end

	return Blocked
end

const function DamageAfterArmor(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number): number
	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_armor") then
		return Amount
	end

	HurtEquipment(Player, Source, Amount, ArmorSlots)

	const Armor = AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:armor") // 1
	const Toughness = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:armor_toughness"))
	local Fraction = DamageRules.ArmorFraction(Amount, Armor, Toughness)

	if Source.Weapon then
		Fraction = Mth.Clamp(Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:armor_effectiveness", Source.Weapon, Player, Source, Fraction, Player.Random), 0, 1)
	end

	return Mth.Float(Amount * Mth.Float(1 - Fraction))
end

const function DamageAfterMagic(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number): number
	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_effects") then
		return Amount
	end

	local Result = Amount
	const Resistance = Player.Effects["minecraft:resistance"]

	if Resistance and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_resistance") then
		const Absorb = ResistanceDivider - (Resistance.Amplifier + 1) * ResistancePerLevel

		Result = math.max(Mth.Float(Mth.Float(Result * Absorb) / ResistanceDivider), 0)
	end

	if Result <= 0 then
		return 0
	elseif DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_enchantments") then
		return Result
	end

	const Protection = Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageProtection(Player.Inventory, Player, Source, Player.Random)

	return if Protection > 0 then DamageRules.AfterMagicAbsorb(Result, Protection) else Result
end

const function RecheckCombat(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Reset = if Player.InCombat then CombatResetTicks else DamageResetTicks

	if Player.TakingDamage and (IsDeadOrDying(Player) or Player.TickCount - Player.LastDamageTime > Reset) then
		Player.TakingDamage = false
		Player.InCombat = false
		table.clear(Player.CombatEntries)
	end
end

const function RecordDamage(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number)
	RecheckCombat(Player)
	table.insert(Player.CombatEntries, { Source = Source, Damage = Amount, FallDistance = Player.FallDistance })
	Player.LastDamageTime = Player.TickCount
	Player.TakingDamage = true

	if not Player.InCombat and Player.Health > 0 and Source.Causing and Source.Causing.IsLiving then
		Player.InCombat = true
	end
end

const function ActuallyHurt(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number)
	if IsInvulnerableTo(Player, Source) then
		return
	end

	local Remaining = DamageAfterMagic(Player, Source, DamageAfterArmor(Player, Source, Amount))
	const Before = Remaining

	Remaining = math.max(Mth.Float(Remaining - Player.Absorption), 0)
	SetAbsorption(Player, Player.Absorption - (Before - Remaining))

	if Remaining ~= 0 then
		CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, DamageRules.FoodExhaustion(Source))
		RecordDamage(Player, Source, Remaining)
		SetHealth(Player, Player.Health - Remaining)
	end
end

const function KillCredit(Player: ServerPlayer): Entity?
	return Player.LastHurtByPlayer or Player.LastHurtByMob
end

const function HeldCustomItem(Entity: Entity?): Minecraft.ItemStack?
	const Player = if Entity then Entities.AsPlayer(Entity) else nil

	if not Player then
		return nil
	end

	const Held = Minecraft.Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)

	return if not Items.IsEmpty(Held) and Items.Has(Held, "minecraft:custom_name") then Held else nil
end

const function LocalizedDeathMessage(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source): unknown
	const Key = `death.attack.{DamageRules.Type(Source.Type).message_id}`
	const Name = Entities.DisplayName(Player)
	const Causing = Source.Causing :: Entity?
	const Direct = Source.Direct :: Entity?

	if not Causing and not Direct then
		const Credit = KillCredit(Player)

		return if Credit then { translate = `{Key}.player`, with = { Name, Entities.DisplayName(Credit) } } else { translate = Key, with = { Name } }
	end

	const Killer = Entities.DisplayName(Causing or Direct)
	const Held = HeldCustomItem(Causing)

	return if Held then { translate = `{Key}.item`, with = { Name, Killer, Items.GetDisplayName(Held) } } else { translate = Key, with = { Name, Killer } }
end

const function MostSignificantFall(Player: ServerPlayer): { Source: Source, Damage: number, FallDistance: number }?
	local Result: { Source: Source, Damage: number, FallDistance: number }? = nil
	local BestFall = 0

	for Index, Entry in Player.CombatEntries do
		const IsFakeFall = DamageRules.Is(Entry.Source, "minecraft:always_most_significant_fall")
		const FallDistance = if IsFakeFall then MaximumFloat else Entry.FallDistance

		if (DamageRules.Is(Entry.Source, "minecraft:is_fall") or IsFakeFall) and FallDistance > 0 and (Result == nil or FallDistance > BestFall) then
			Result = if Index > 1 then Player.CombatEntries[Index - 1] else Entry
			BestFall = FallDistance
		end
	end

	return if BestFall > 5 then Result else nil
end

const function FallMessage(Player: ServerPlayer, KnockOff: { Source: Source, Damage: number, FallDistance: number }, Killing: Entity?): unknown
	const Name = Entities.DisplayName(Player)
	const Source = KnockOff.Source

	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:is_fall") or DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:always_most_significant_fall") then
		return { translate = "death.fell.accident.generic", with = { Name } }
	end

	const KillerName = Entities.DisplayName(Killing)
	const Attacker = Source.Causing :: Entity?
	const AttackerName = Entities.DisplayName(Attacker)

	if Attacker and Attacker ~= Killing then
		const Held = HeldCustomItem(Attacker)

		return if Held then { translate = "death.fell.assist.item", with = { Name, AttackerName, Items.GetDisplayName(Held) } } else { translate = "death.fell.assist", with = { Name, AttackerName } }
	elseif Killing then
		const Held = HeldCustomItem(Killing)

		return if Held then { translate = "death.fell.finish.item", with = { Name, KillerName, Items.GetDisplayName(Held) } } else { translate = "death.fell.finish", with = { Name, KillerName } }
	end

	return { translate = "death.fell.killer", with = { Name } }
end

const function DeathMessage(Player: ServerPlayer): unknown
	const Entries = Player.CombatEntries

	if #Entries == 0 then
		return { translate = "death.attack.generic", with = { Entities.DisplayName(Player) } }
	end

	const Killing = Entries[#Entries].Source
	const KnockOff = MostSignificantFall(Player)
	const Type = DamageRules.Type(Killing.Type).death_message_type

	if Type == "fall_variants" and KnockOff then
		return FallMessage(Player, KnockOff, Killing.Causing :: Entity?)
	elseif Type == "intentional_game_design" then
		const Key = `death.attack.{DamageRules.Type(Killing.Type).message_id}`
		const Link = { translate = "chat.square_brackets", with = { { translate = `{Key}.link` } } }

		return { translate = `{Key}.message`, with = { Entities.DisplayName(Player), Link } }
	end

	return LocalizedDeathMessage(Player, Killing)
end

const function DropAll(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const PlayerInventory = Player.Inventory

	for Slot = 0, Minecraft.Inventory.Size - 1 do
		const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot)

		if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
			if not Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.Has(Stack, "minecraft:prevent_equipment_drop") then
				ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Player, Stack, true)
			end

			Minecraft.Inventory.SetItem(PlayerInventory, Slot, Items.Empty)
		end
	end

	for _, Slot in Minecraft.Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		if Slot ~= "mainhand" then
			const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot)

			if not Items.IsEmpty(Stack) then
				if not Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.Has(Stack, "minecraft:prevent_equipment_drop") then
					ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Player, Stack, true)
				end

				Minecraft.Inventory.SetEquipment(PlayerInventory, Slot, Items.Empty)
			end
		end
	end
end

const function Die(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source)
	if Player.Removed or Player.Dead then
		return
	end

	StopUsingItem(Player)

	const Message = DeathMessage(Player)

	Protocol.WritePlayerCombatKill(Stream(Player), Message, Player.Score)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteSystemChat(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Message)
	end

	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		DropAll(Player)
		Orbs.Award(Player.Position, Experience.DeathReward(Player))
	end

	Player.Dead = true
	BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.Death)
	Player.Pose = "Dying"
	Player.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Player.RemainingFireTicks)
end

const function RandomTeleport(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: vector): boolean
	const Cell = vector.floor(Target)
	const Floor = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight / Minecraft.StudsPerBlock
	local Drop = 0

	while Cell.y - Drop > Floor do
		const Below = Cell - vector.create(0, Drop + 1, 0)

		if not Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Below, Below + vector.one) then
			break
		end

		Drop += 1
	end

	if Cell.y - Drop <= Floor then
		return false
	end

	const Landing = Target - vector.create(0, Drop, 0)
	const Dimensions = Minecraft.Entity.PlayerDimensions[Player.Pose]
	const Min, Max = Minecraft.Entity.BoxAt(Landing, Dimensions.Width, Dimensions.Height)

	if not Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min, Max) or EntityPhysics.ContainsAnyFluid(Min, Max) then
		return false
	end

	Entities.Teleport(Player, Landing, Player.YRot, Player.XRot)
	BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.ChorusTeleport)
	Player.FallDistance = 0
	Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
	Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0

	return true
end

const function ApplyConsumeEffects(Player: ServerPlayer, Effects: { { [string]: unknown } })
	for _, Effect in Effects do
		const Type = Effect.type

		if Type == "minecraft:apply_effects" then
			if Player.Random:NextNumber() < Mth.Float((Effect.probability :: number?) or 1) then
				for _, Codec in Effect.effects :: { unknown } do
					AddEffect(Player, Minecraft.Effects.FromCodec(Codec))
				end
			end
		elseif Type == "minecraft:remove_effects" then
			const Removed = Effect.effects

			if type(Removed) == "string" and string.sub(Removed, 1, 1) ~= "#" then
				RemoveEffect(Player, Removed)
			elseif type(Removed) == "table" then
				for _, Id in Removed :: { string } do
					RemoveEffect(Player, Id)
				end
			end
		elseif Type == "minecraft:clear_all_effects" then
			RemoveAllEffects(Player)
		elseif Type == "minecraft:teleport_randomly" then
			const Diameter = Mth.Float((Effect.diameter :: number?) or 16)

			for _ = 1, TeleportAttempts do
				const Target = Player.Position + vector.create(Player.Random:NextNumber() - 0.5, Player.Random:NextNumber() - 0.5, Player.Random:NextNumber() - 0.5) * Diameter

				if RandomTeleport(Player, Target) then
					Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "item.chorus_fruit.teleport", 1, 1)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function CheckTotem(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source): boolean
	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_invulnerability") then
		return false
	end

	for _, Slot in HandSlots do
		const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)
		const Protection = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:death_protection") :: { death_effects: { { [string]: unknown } }? }?

		if Protection then
			Items.Shrink(Stack, 1)
			SetHealth(Player, 1)
			ApplyConsumeEffects(Player, Protection.death_effects or {})
			BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.TotemOfUndying)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function IndicateDamage(Player: ServerPlayer, DirectionX: number, DirectionZ: number)
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(math.deg(math.atan2(DirectionZ, DirectionX)) - Player.YRot)

	Protocol.WriteHurtAnimation(Stream(Player), Player.Id, Yaw)
end

const function DefaultKnockbackDirection(Entity: Entity, Source: Source): (number, number)
	const Direct = Source.Direct :: Entity?

	if Direct and Direct.Kind ~= "Player" and Direct.Kind ~= "Humanoid" and not Direct.KnockbackFromPosition then
		return -Direct.DeltaMovement.x, -Direct.DeltaMovement.z
	end

	const Position = DamageRules.SourcePosition(Source)

	if Position then
		return Position.x - Entity.Position.x, Position.z - Entity.Position.z
	end

	return 0, 0
end

const function ResolveResponsible(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source)
	const Causing = Source.Causing :: Entity?

	if Causing and Causing.IsLiving and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:no_anger") then
		Player.LastHurtByMob = Causing
		Player.LastHurtByMobTime = Player.TickCount
	end

	const Attacker = if Causing then Entities.AsPlayer(Causing) else nil

	if Attacker then
		Player.LastHurtByPlayer = Attacker
		Player.LastHurtByPlayerMemory = PlayerMemoryTicks
	end
end

const function SecondaryHurtSound(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source)
	if Source.Type == "minecraft:thorns" then
		Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "enchant.thorns.hit", 1, 1)
	end
end

const function Hurt(Player: ServerPlayer, Source: Source, Amount: number): boolean
	if IsInvulnerableTo(Player, Source) then
		return false
	end

	if Player.Abilities.Invulnerable and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_invulnerability") then
		return false
	end

	if IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		return false
	end

	local Damage = Amount

	if DamageRules.ScalesWithDifficulty(Source) then
		Damage = DamageRules.ScaleForPlayer(Damage, Settings.Difficulty)
	end

	if Damage == 0 then
		return false
	end

	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:is_fire") and Player.Effects["minecraft:fire_resistance"] then
		return false
	end

	Damage = math.max(Damage, 0)

	const InUse = Player.UseItem
	const Blocked = ApplyItemBlocking(Player, Source, Damage)

	Damage = Mth.Float(Damage - Blocked)

	const WasBlocked = Blocked > 0

	if DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:damages_helmet") and not Items.IsEmpty(Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, "head")) then
		HurtEquipment(Player, Source, Damage, HeadSlots)
		Damage = Mth.Float(Damage * HelmetDamageScale)
	end

	if Damage ~= Damage or math.abs(Damage) == math.huge then
		Damage = MaximumFloat
	end

	local TookFullDamage = true

	if Player.DamageCooldownTime > HalfInvulnerability and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_cooldown") then
		if Damage <= Player.LastHurt then
			return false
		end

		ActuallyHurt(Player, Source, Damage - Player.LastHurt)
		Player.LastHurt = Damage
		TookFullDamage = false
	else
		Player.LastHurt = Damage
		Player.DamageCooldownTime = InvulnerabilityTicks
		ActuallyHurt(Player, Source, Damage)
		Player.HurtTime = HurtDuration
	end

	ResolveResponsible(Player, Source)

	if TookFullDamage then
		const Blocks = Items.Get(InUse, "minecraft:blocks_attacks") :: { block_sound: unknown? }?

		if WasBlocked and Blocks then
			const BlockSound = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.SoundEventOf(Blocks.block_sound)

			if BlockSound then
				Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, BlockSound, 1, 0.8 + Generator:NextNumber() * 0.4)
			end
		else
			BroadcastDamageEvent(Player, Source)
		end

		if not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:no_impact") and (not WasBlocked or Damage > 0) then
			Player.HurtMarked = true
		end

		if not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:no_knockback") and not (WasBlocked and Damage <= 0) then
			const DirectionX, DirectionZ = DefaultKnockbackDirection(Player, Source)

			Knockback(Player, DefaultKnockback, DirectionX, DirectionZ)

			if not WasBlocked then
				IndicateDamage(Player, DirectionX, DirectionZ)
			end
		end
	end

	if IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		if not CheckTotem(Player, Source) then
			if TookFullDamage then
				Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "entity.player.death", 1, 1)
				SecondaryHurtSound(Player, Source)
			end

			Die(Player, Source)
		end
	elseif TookFullDamage then
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, DamageRules.PlayerHurtSound(Source.Type), 1, 1)
		SecondaryHurtSound(Player, Source)
	end

	return not WasBlocked or Damage > 0
end

const function HurtEntity(Entity: Entity, Source: Source, Amount: number): boolean
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player then
		return Hurt(Player, Source, Amount)
	end

	const Humanoid = Entities.AsHumanoid(Entity)

	if not Humanoid then
		return false
	end

	const Dealt = DamageContract.Deal(Humanoid.Model, {
		Amount = Amount,
		Type = Source.Type,
		Attacker = SubjectOf(Source.Causing :: Entity?),
		BypassesInvulnerability = DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:bypasses_invulnerability"),
	})

	if Dealt and not DamageRules.Is(Source, "minecraft:no_knockback") then
		const DirectionX, DirectionZ = DefaultKnockbackDirection(Humanoid, Source)

		Knockback(Humanoid, DefaultKnockback, DirectionX, DirectionZ)
	end

	const Attacker = Entities.AsPlayer(Source.Causing :: Entity?)

	if Dealt and Attacker then
		Advancements.Award(Attacker, "roblox:this_aint_right")
	end

	return Dealt
end

const function Kill(Entity: Entity)
	if Entity.IsLiving then
		HurtEntity(Entity, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:generic_kill"), MaximumFloat)
	else
		Entities.Remove(Entity)
	end
end

const function EffectTick(Player: ServerPlayer, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): boolean
	const Id = Effect.Id
	const Amplifier = Effect.Amplifier

	if Id == "minecraft:absorption" then
		return Player.Absorption > 0
	elseif Id == "minecraft:instant_health" then
		Heal(Player, math.max(Mth.ShiftLeft(4, Amplifier), 0))
	elseif Id == "minecraft:instant_damage" then
		Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:magic"), Mth.ShiftLeft(6, Amplifier))
	elseif Id == "minecraft:hunger" then
		CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Mth.Float(HungerExhaustion * (Amplifier + 1)))
	elseif Id == "minecraft:poison" then
		if Player.Health > 1 then
			Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:magic"), 1)
		end
	elseif Id == "minecraft:regeneration" then
		if Player.Health < MaxHealth(Player) then
			Heal(Player, 1)
		end
	elseif Id == "minecraft:saturation" then
		Minecraft.Food.Eat(Player.Food, Amplifier + 1, 1)
	elseif Id == "minecraft:wither" then
		Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:wither"), 1)
	end

	return true
end

const function ApplyInstantaneous(Player: ServerPlayer, Id: string, Amplifier: number, Scale: number, Source: Entity?, Owner: Entity?)
	if Id == "minecraft:instant_health" then
		Heal(Player, (Scale * Mth.ShiftLeft(4, Amplifier) + 0.5) // 1)
	elseif Id == "minecraft:instant_damage" then
		const Amount = (Scale * Mth.ShiftLeft(6, Amplifier) + 0.5) // 1

		Hurt(Player, if Source then DamageRules.Create("minecraft:indirect_magic", Source, Owner) else DamageRules.Create("minecraft:magic"), Amount)
	else
		EffectTick(Player, Effects.Create(Id, 1, Amplifier))
	end
end

const function TickEffects(Player: ServerPlayer)
	table.clear(EffectIds)

	for Id in Player.Effects do
		table.insert(EffectIds, Id)
	end

	for _, Id in EffectIds do
		const Effect = Player.Effects[Id]

		if not Effect then
			continue
		end

		local Alive = Effects.HasRemainingDuration(Effect)

		if Alive then
			const TickCount = if Effects.IsInfinite(Effect) then Player.TickCount else Effect.Duration

			if Effects.ShouldApplyTick(Id, TickCount, Effect.Amplifier) and not EffectTick(Player, Effect) then
				Alive = false
			else
				Effects.TickDownDuration(Effect)

				if Effects.DowngradeToHidden(Effect) then
					OnEffectUpdated(Player, Effect, true)
				end

				Alive = Effects.HasRemainingDuration(Effect)
			end
		end

		if Player.Effects[Id] ~= Effect then
			continue
		end

		if not Alive then
			Player.Effects[Id] = nil
			OnEffectRemoved(Player, Effect)
		elseif Effect.Duration % EffectRefreshInterval == 0 then
			OnEffectUpdated(Player, Effect, false)
		end
	end
end

const function UpdateSwimming(Player: ServerPlayer)
	local Swimming = false

	if not Player.Abilities.Flying then
		Swimming = if Player.Swimming
			then Player.Sprinting and EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player)
			else Player.Sprinting and EntityPhysics.IsUnderWater(Player) and EntityPhysics.FluidAt(Player.Position) == "Water"
	end

	Player.Swimming = Swimming
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Swimming, Swimming)
end

const function IsEquipped(Player: ServerPlayer, Id: string): boolean
	for _, Slot in Minecraft.Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)
		const Equippable = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:equippable") :: { slot: string }?
