		if Items.Is(Stack, Id) and Equippable and Equippable.slot == Slot then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function DecreaseAirSupply(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	const OxygenBonus = AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:oxygen_bonus")

	return if OxygenBonus > 0 and Player.Random:NextNumber() >= 1 / (OxygenBonus + 1) then Player.AirSupply else Player.AirSupply - 1
end

const function TickAirSupply(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Effects = Player.Effects

	if not Player.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		if Player.AirSupply < MaxAirSupply then
			Player.AirSupply = math.min(Player.AirSupply + AirRefill, MaxAirSupply)
		end

		return
	end

	const WaterBreathing = Effects["minecraft:water_breathing"] ~= nil or Effects["minecraft:conduit_power"] ~= nil
	const Nautilus = Effects["minecraft:breath_of_the_nautilus"] ~= nil

	if not WaterBreathing and not Nautilus and not Player.Abilities.Invulnerable then
		Player.AirSupply = DecreaseAirSupply(Player)

		if Player.AirSupply <= DrownThreshold then
			Player.AirSupply = 0
			BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.Drown)
			Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:drown"), DrownDamage)
		end
	elseif Player.AirSupply < MaxAirSupply and (not Nautilus or WaterBreathing) then
		Player.AirSupply = math.min(Player.AirSupply + AirRefill, MaxAirSupply)
	end
end

const function ApplyFluidEffects(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Movements = Player.Movements
	local Water = false
	local Lava = false

	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" then
		table.clear(Movements)

		return
	end

	if #Movements == 0 then
		Water, Lava = EntityPhysics.TouchedFluids(Player, Player.Position, Player.Position)
	end

	for Index = 1, #Movements, 2 do
		const ThroughWater, ThroughLava = EntityPhysics.TouchedFluids(Player, Movements[Index], Movements[Index + 1])

		Water = Water or ThroughWater
		Lava = Lava or ThroughLava
	end

	table.clear(Movements)

	const PreviousFireTicks = Player.RemainingFireTicks

	if Lava then
		Ignite(Player, LavaIgniteSeconds)

		if Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:lava"), LavaDamage) then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "entity.generic.burn", 0.4, 2 + Generator:NextNumber() * 0.4)
		end
	end

	if Water then
		Player.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Player.RemainingFireTicks)
	end

	if PreviousFireTicks > 0 and Player.RemainingFireTicks <= 0 then
		ExtinguishSound(Player)
	end

	if Player.RemainingFireTicks <= 0 and Player.RemainingFireTicks <= PreviousFireTicks then
		Player.RemainingFireTicks = -FireImmuneTicks
	end
end

const function IsInWall(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" then
		return false
	end

	const Dimensions = Minecraft.Entity.PlayerDimensions[Player.Pose]
	const Half = Dimensions.Width * 0.8 / 2
	const Eye = Player.Position + vector.create(0, Dimensions.EyeHeight, 0)

	return not Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Eye - vector.create(Half, 5.0E-7, Half), Eye + vector.create(Half, 5.0E-7, Half))
end

const function CanGlide(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	return Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CanGlide(Player.Inventory, Player.OnGround, Player.Abilities.Flying, Player.Effects["minecraft:levitation"] ~= nil)
end

const function StartFallFlying(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if not Player.FallFlying and CanGlide(Player) and not EntityPhysics.IsInLiquid(Player) then
		Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying, true)

		return
	end

	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying, false)
	Entities.ForceData(Player)
end

const function StartAutoSpinAttack(Player: ServerPlayer, Ticks: number, Damage: number, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack)
	Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks = Ticks
	Player.AutoSpinAttackDamage = Damage
	Player.AutoSpinAttackItem = Stack
	Player.SpinAttack = true
end

const function UpdateFallFlying(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.KnownMovement.y > GlideFallSpeed and Player.FallDistance > GlideFallDistanceCap then
		Player.FallDistance = GlideFallDistanceCap
	end

	if not CanGlide(Player) then
		Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.FallFlying, false)

		return
	end

	const CheckTicks = Player.FallFlyTicks + 1

	if CheckTicks % GlideDamageStep ~= 0 or (CheckTicks // GlideDamageStep) % 2 ~= 0 then
		return
	end

	table.clear(GliderSlots)

	for _, Slot in Minecraft.Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		if Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CanGlideUsing(Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot), Slot) then
			table.insert(GliderSlots, Slot)
		end
	end

	const Slot = GliderSlots[Player.Random:NextInteger(1, #GliderSlots)]

	HurtAndBreak(Player, Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot), 1, Slot)
end

const function Tick(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.TickCount += 1

	if Player.FallFlying then
		UpdateFallFlying(Player)
	end

	if Player.TakeXpDelay > 0 then
		Player.TakeXpDelay -= 1
	end

	if Player.Swing.Active then
		Player.Swing.Ticks += 1

		if Player.Swing.Ticks > Player.Swing.Duration then
			Player.Swing.Active = false
		end
	end

	Player.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Player.Fluid.EyeInWater

	const WasTouchingWater = Player.Fluid.WasTouchingWater
	const FirstTick = Player.Fluid.FirstTick

	EntityPhysics.UpdateFluidInteraction(Player)
	UpdateSwimming(Player)

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player) and not WasTouchingWater and not FirstTick and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		const Motion = Player.KnownMovement
		const Speed = math.min(1, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x * 0.2 + Motion.y * Motion.y + Motion.z * Motion.z * 0.2) * SplashVolumeScale)

		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, if Speed < HighSpeedSplash then "entity.player.splash" else "entity.player.splash.high_speed", Speed, TrianglePitch(1, 0.4))
	end

	if Player.RemainingFireTicks > 0 then
		if Player.RemainingFireTicks % FireDamageInterval == 0 and not EntityPhysics.IsInLava(Player) then
			Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:on_fire"), 1)
		end

		Player.RemainingFireTicks -= 1
	end

	if EntityPhysics.IsInLava(Player) then
		Player.FallDistance *= LavaFallScale
	end

	Player.OnFire = Player.RemainingFireTicks > 0
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.OnFire, Player.OnFire)
	Player.Fluid.FirstTick = false

	if not IsDeadOrDying(Player) and IsInWall(Player) then
		Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:in_wall"), 1)
	end

	if not IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		TickAirSupply(Player)
	end

	if Player.HurtTime > 0 then
		Player.HurtTime -= 1
	end

	if Player.DamageCooldownTime > 0 then
		Player.DamageCooldownTime -= 1
	end

	if IsDeadOrDying(Player) and not Player.Removed then
		Player.DeathTime += 1

		if Player.DeathTime == DeathTicks then
			BroadcastEntityEvent(Player, Protocol.EntityEvents.Poof)

			if Player.Effects["minecraft:wind_charged"] then
				const Strength = WindChargedRadiusBase + Player.Random:NextNumber() * WindChargedRadiusRange

				Explosions.Explode(Player, Player.Position + vector.create(0, Player.Height / 2, 0), Strength, WindChargedKnockback, false, { Type = "gust_emitter_small" }, { Type = "gust_emitter_large" }, "entity.breeze.wind_burst")
			end
		end
	end

	if Player.LastHurtByPlayerMemory > 0 then
		Player.LastHurtByPlayerMemory -= 1
	else
		Player.LastHurtByPlayer = nil
	end

	const Mob = Player.LastHurtByMob

	if Mob and (not Entities.IsAlive(Mob) or Player.TickCount - Player.LastHurtByMobTime > MobMemoryTicks) then
		Player.LastHurtByMob = nil
	end

	TickEffects(Player)
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Invisible, Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Player.Effects["minecraft:invisibility"] ~= nil)
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Glowing, Player.Effects["minecraft:glowing"] ~= nil)

	if Player.ArrowCount > 0 then
		if Player.RemoveArrowTime <= 0 then
			Player.RemoveArrowTime = 20 * (ArrowRemovalBase - Player.ArrowCount)
		end

		Player.RemoveArrowTime -= 1

		if Player.RemoveArrowTime <= 0 then
			Player.ArrowCount -= 1
		end
	end

	if Player.TickCount % 20 == 0 then
		RecheckCombat(Player)
	end

	if Player.ImpulseGraceTime > 0 then
		Player.ImpulseGraceTime -= 1
	end

	if Player.Abilities.Flying then
		Player.FallDistance = 0
	end

	ApplyFluidEffects(Player)

	const Motion = Player.DeltaMovement
	const Horizontal = Motion.x * Motion.x + Motion.z * Motion.z < HorizontalRestThreshold

	Player.DeltaMovement = vector.create(if Horizontal then 0 else Motion.x, if math.abs(Motion.y) < VerticalRestThreshold then 0 else Motion.y, if Horizontal then 0 else Motion.z)
	Player.FallFlyTicks = if Player.FallFlying then Player.FallFlyTicks + 1 else 0
end

const function ResetAttackStrength(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.AttackStrengthTicker = 0
	Player.ItemSwapTicker = 0
end

const function PostTick(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const MainHand = Minecraft.Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)

	Player.AttackStrengthTicker += 1
	Player.ItemSwapTicker += 1

	if not Items.Matches(Player.LastItemInMainHand, MainHand) then
		if not Items.IsSameItem(Player.LastItemInMainHand, MainHand) then
			ResetAttackStrength(Player)
		end

		Player.LastItemInMainHand = Items.Copy(MainHand)
	end

	if not Player.Fluid.EyeInWater and IsEquipped(Player, "minecraft:turtle_helmet") then
		AddEffect(Player, Effects.Create("minecraft:water_breathing", TurtleHelmetTicks, 0, false, false, true))
	end

	Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.TickCooldowns(Player.Cooldowns)

	if not IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		const Hurting = Player.Health > 0 and Player.Health < MaxHealth(Player)
		const Healed, Starving = Minecraft.Food.Tick(Player.Food, Settings.Difficulty, Hurting, Player.Health)

		if Healed > 0 then
			Heal(Player, Healed)
		end

		if Starving then
			Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:starve"), 1)
		end
	end

	Player.FoodLevel = Player.Food.FoodLevel

	const Food = Player.Food
	const SaturationZero = Food.Saturation == 0

	if Player.EffectsDirty then
		UpdateEffectParticles(Player)
	end

	if
		Player.Health ~= Player.LastSentHealth
		or Food.FoodLevel ~= Player.LastSentFood
		or SaturationZero ~= (Player.LastSentSaturation == 0)
		or Player.Absorption ~= Player.LastSentAbsorption
		or Player.EffectsDirty
	then
		Protocol.WriteSetHealth(Stream(Player), Player.Health, Food.FoodLevel, Food.Saturation, Player.Absorption)
		Player.LastSentHealth = Player.Health
		Player.LastSentAbsorption = Player.Absorption
		Player.LastSentFood = Food.FoodLevel
		Player.LastSentSaturation = Food.Saturation
		Player.EffectsDirty = false
	end

	if Player.TotalExperience ~= Player.LastSentExperience then
		Protocol.WriteSetExperience(Stream(Player), Player.ExperienceProgress, Player.ExperienceLevel, Player.TotalExperience)
		Player.LastSentExperience = Player.TotalExperience
	end
end

const function CauseFallDamage(Player: ServerPlayer, FallDistance: number)
	if Player.Abilities.MayFly then
		return
	end

	local Effective = FallDistance
	const Impact = Player.ImpulseImpactPosition

	if Impact then
		Effective = math.min(FallDistance, Impact.y - Player.Position.y)

		if Effective <= 0 or Player.ImpulseGraceTime == 0 then
			Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
			Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
		end
	end

	const SafeFall = AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:safe_fall_distance")
	const Multiplier = AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:fall_damage_multiplier")
	const Amount = ((Effective + 1.0E-6 - SafeFall) * Multiplier) // 1

	if Amount > 0 then
		Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
		Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, if Amount > BigFallDamage then "entity.player.big_fall" else "entity.player.small_fall", 1, 1)

		const Landed = EntityPhysics.BlockAt(Player.Position - LegacyOnOffset)

		if Landed then
			const Sound = Minecraft.BlockSounds[Landed.Id]

			Sounds.EntitySound(Player, Sound.Fall, Sound.Volume * 0.5, Sound.Pitch * 0.75)
		end

		Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:fall"), Amount)
	end
end

const function FallParticles(Player: ServerPlayer)
	local Landed, Tint = EntityPhysics.BlockAt(Player.Position - LegacyOnOffset)

	if not Landed then
		Landed, Tint = EntityPhysics.BlockOn(Player.Position, Player.Width)
	end

	if not Landed then
		return
	end

	const Options: Minecraft.ParticleOptions = { Type = "block", Block = Landed.Id, Color = Tint }

	if Player.SpawnExtraParticlesOnFall then
		const Cell = vector.floor(Player.Position - OnOffset)
		const Count = math.clamp(SmashFallParticlesPerBlock * Player.FallDistance, 0, SmashFallParticleLimit) // 1

		Particles.Send(Options, Cell + vector.create(0.5, 1, 0.5), Count, SmashFallSpread, FallParticleSpeed)
		Player.SpawnExtraParticlesOnFall = false
	end

	const Power = math.max(0, (Player.FallDistance + 1.0E-6 - AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:safe_fall_distance")) // 1)

	if Power > 0 then
		const Count = FallParticleCount * math.min(FallParticleBase + Power / FallParticleScale, FallParticleLimit) // 1

		Particles.Send(Options, Player.Position, Count, vector.zero, FallParticleSpeed)
	end
end

const function StepSounds(Player: ServerPlayer, Delta: vector)
	if Player.Abilities.Flying or Player.OnGround and Player.Crouching then
		return
	end

	const Stepped, Swim = EntityPhysics.StepEmission(Player.Position, Player.Width, Delta, Player, Player.OnGround, Player.Crouching, Player.Swimming, EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player))

	if Stepped then
		const Sound = Minecraft.BlockSounds[Stepped.Id]

		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, Sound.Step, Sound.Volume * 0.15, Sound.Pitch)
	elseif Swim then
		const Motion = Player.KnownMovement
		const Speed = math.min(1, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x * 0.2 + Motion.y * Motion.y + Motion.z * Motion.z * 0.2) * SwimVolumeScale)

		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, "entity.player.swim", Speed, TrianglePitch(1, 0.4))
	end
end

const function HandleMove(Player: ServerPlayer, From: vector, WasOnGround: boolean)
	const Delta = Player.Position - From
	const MovedUpwards = Delta.y > 0
	const Motion = Player.DeltaMovement

	if Player.FallFlying and Player.HorizontalCollision then
		const Previous = Player.KnownMovement
		const Lost = math.sqrt(Previous.x * Previous.x + Previous.z * Previous.z) - math.sqrt(Delta.x * Delta.x + Delta.z * Delta.z)
		const Damage = Lost * 10 - 3

		if Damage > 0 then
			Sounds.EntitySound(Player, if Damage // 1 > BigFallDamage then "entity.player.big_fall" else "entity.player.small_fall", 1, 1)
			Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:fly_into_wall"), Damage)
		end
	end

	Player.KnownMovement = Delta
	Player.DeltaMovement = vector.create(if Player.HorizontalCollision then 0 else Motion.x, if Player.OnGround then 0 else Motion.y, if Player.HorizontalCollision then 0 else Motion.z)

	if WasOnGround and not Player.OnGround and MovedUpwards then
		CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, if Player.Sprinting then SprintJumpExhaustion else JumpExhaustion)
	end

	if not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player) then
		EntityPhysics.UpdateFluidInteraction(Player)
	end

	if not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player) and Delta.y < 0 then
		Player.FallDistance -= Delta.y
	end

	if Player.OnGround then
		if Player.FallDistance > 0 then
			FallParticles(Player)
			CauseFallDamage(Player, Player.FallDistance)
		end

		Player.FallDistance = 0
	end

	if MovedUpwards then
		Player.FallDistance = 0
	end

	const LandedInLiquid = Player.DeltaMovement.y < LandedSpeed and EntityPhysics.IsInLiquid(Player)

	if (Player.OnGround or LandedInLiquid or Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Player.FallFlying or Player.SpinAttack) and Player.ImpulseGraceTime == 0 then
		Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
	end

	if Delta == vector.zero then
		return
	end

	if Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
		StepSounds(Player, Delta)
	end

	const Moved = math.round(Mth.Float(math.sqrt(vector.dot(Delta, Delta))) * 100)
	const MovedAcross = math.round(Mth.Float(math.sqrt(Delta.x * Delta.x + Delta.z * Delta.z)) * 100)

	if Player.Swimming or Player.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		if Moved > 0 then
			CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Mth.Float(MovementExhaustion * Moved * 0.01))
		end
	elseif EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player) then
		if MovedAcross > 0 then
			CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Mth.Float(MovementExhaustion * MovedAcross * 0.01))
		end
	elseif Player.OnGround and MovedAcross > 0 and Player.Sprinting then
		CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Mth.Float(SprintExhaustion * MovedAcross * 0.01))
	end
end

const function Reset(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.Effects = {}
	Player.Food = Minecraft.Food.Create()
	Player.FoodLevel = Player.Food.FoodLevel
	Player.Health = MaxHealth(Player)
	Player.Absorption = 0
	Player.HurtTime = 0
	Player.DamageCooldownTime = 0
	Player.LastHurt = 0
	Player.DeathTime = 0
	Player.Dead = false
	Player.RemainingFireTicks = 0
	Player.OnFire = false
	Player.AirSupply = MaxAirSupply
	Player.Swimming = false
	Player.Fluid = EntityPhysics.CreateFluidState()
	Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
	Player.AutoSpinAttackDamage = 0
	Player.AutoSpinAttackItem = nil
	Player.Camera = nil
	table.clear(Player.Movements)
	table.clear(Player.CombatEntries)
	Player.InCombat = false
	Player.TakingDamage = false
	Player.LastHurtByPlayer = nil
	Player.LastHurtByMob = nil
	Player.ExperienceLevel = 0
	Player.ExperienceProgress = 0
	Player.TotalExperience = 0
	Player.Score = 0
	Player.ArrowCount = 0
	Player.FallDistance = 0
	Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
	Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
	Player.AttackStrengthTicker = 0
	Player.ItemSwapTicker = 0
	Player.Cooldowns = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors.CreateCooldowns()
	StopUsingItem(Player)
	Player.SpinAttack = false
	Player.Pose = "Standing"
	Player.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
	Player.LastSentHealth = -1
	Player.LastSentAbsorption = -1
	Player.LastSentExperience = -1
	Player.EffectParticles = {}
	Player.EffectAmbience = false
	Player.SpawnExtraParticlesOnFall = false
	Player.DataForced = true
end

return {
	StopUsingItem = StopUsingItem,
	SetHealth = SetHealth,
	IsDeadOrDying = IsDeadOrDying,
	CauseFoodExhaustion = CauseFoodExhaustion,
	AttackExhaustion = AttackExhaustion,
	AddEffect = AddEffect,
	RemoveEffect = RemoveEffect,
	RemoveAllEffects = RemoveAllEffects,
	ApplyInstantaneous = ApplyInstantaneous,
	ApplyConsumeEffects = ApplyConsumeEffects,
	Ignite = Ignite,
	BroadcastEntityEvent = BroadcastEntityEvent,
	HurtAndBreak = HurtAndBreak,
	HurtWithoutBreaking = HurtWithoutBreaking,
	Knockback = Knockback,
	Hurt = Hurt,
	HurtEntity = HurtEntity,
	Kill = Kill,
	ResetAttackStrength = ResetAttackStrength,
	StartFallFlying = StartFallFlying,
	StartAutoSpinAttack = StartAutoSpinAttack,
	Tick = Tick,
	PostTick = PostTick,
	HandleMove = HandleMove,
	Reset = Reset,
	OnEquipItem = OnEquipItem,
	ExtinguishSound = ExtinguishSound,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Melee"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const EnchantmentActions = require("./EnchantmentActions")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const Living = require("./Living")
const Particles = require("./Particles")
const Sounds = require("./Sounds")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Behaviors = Minecraft.ItemBehaviors
const Inventory = Minecraft.Inventory
const EntityPhysics = Minecraft.Entity

const AttackRangeSlack = 3
const MinimumChargeTolerance = 5
const FullStrengthThreshold = Mth.Float(0.9)
const CriticalMultiplier = Mth.Float(1.5)
const SprintKnockback = Mth.Float(0.5)
const SweepKnockback = Mth.Float(0.4)
const StabKnockback = Mth.Float(0.4)
const AttackerSlowdown = vector.create(0.6, 1, 0.6)
const SweepReach = vector.create(1, 0.25, 1)
const SweepDistanceSquared = 9
const SmashThreshold = 1.5
const SmashHeavyThreshold = 5
const SmashRadius = 3.5
const SmashPower = Mth.Float(0.7)
const SmashLift = Mth.Float(0.7)
const SmashMotion = Mth.Float(0.01)
const SmashParticleCount = 750
const SmashGroundOffset = vector.create(0, 1.0E-5, 0)
const DegreesToRadians = math.pi / 180

type ServerPlayer = Entities.ServerPlayer
type Entity = Entities.Entity

const Nearby: { Entity } = {}
const Stabbed: { Entity } = {}
const Touching: { Entity } = {}

const function EyePosition(Player: ServerPlayer): vector
	return Player.Position + vector.create(0, EntityPhysics.PlayerDimensions[Player.Pose].EyeHeight, 0)
end

const function LookVector(XRot: number, YRot: number): vector
	const Pitch = Mth.Float(XRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(-YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const PitchCosine = Mth.Cos(Pitch)

	return vector.create(Mth.Sin(Yaw) * PitchCosine, -Mth.Sin(Pitch), Mth.Cos(Yaw) * PitchCosine)
end

const function AttributeValue(Player: ServerPlayer, Id: string): number
	return Minecraft.Attributes.Value(Id, Player.Inventory, Player.Effects)
end

const function AttackStrengthDelay(Player: ServerPlayer): number
	return Mth.Float(1 / AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:attack_speed") * 20)
end

const function AttackStrengthScale(Player: ServerPlayer, Partial: number): number
	return Mth.Clamp(Mth.Float((Player.AttackStrengthTicker + Partial) / AttackStrengthDelay(Player)), 0, 1)
end

const function CannotAttackWithItem(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Tolerance: number): boolean
	const Required = Mth.Float((Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:minimum_attack_charge") :: number?) or 0)
	const Optimistic = Mth.Float((Player.AttackStrengthTicker + Tolerance) / AttackStrengthDelay(Player))

	return Required > 0 and Optimistic < Required
end

const function Reach(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): (number, number, number)
	const Creative = Player.GameMode == "creative"
	const Range = Behaviors.InteractionRange(Player.Inventory, Player.Effects, Creative, "minecraft:entity_interaction_range")

	return Behaviors.AttackRange(Stack, Creative, Range)
end

const function IsInAttackRange(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity, Buffer: number): boolean
	const Minimum, Maximum, Margin = Reach(Player, Stack)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Target)
	const Distance = math.sqrt(EntityPhysics.DistanceToBoxSquared(Min, Max, EyePosition(Player)))

	return Distance >= Minimum - Margin - Buffer and Distance <= Maximum + Margin + Buffer
end

const function CanSmashAttack(Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	return Player.FallDistance > SmashThreshold and not Player.FallFlying
end

const function DamageSourceFor(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack): Minecraft.DamageSource
	const Type = Items.Get(Weapon, "minecraft:damage_type") :: string?

	if Type then
		return Minecraft.Damage.Create(Type, Player, Player, nil, Weapon)
	elseif Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Weapon), "MaceItem") and CanSmashAttack(Player) then
		return Minecraft.Damage.Create("minecraft:mace_smash", Player, Player, nil, Weapon)
	end

	return Minecraft.Damage.Create("minecraft:player_attack", Player, Player, nil, Weapon)
end

const function EnchantedDamage(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity, Damage: number, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource): number
	return Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:damage", Weapon, Target, Source, Damage, Player.Random)
end

const function Knockback(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource): number
	const Base = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:attack_knockback"))

	return Mth.Float(Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:knockback", Weapon, Target, Source, Base, Player.Random) / 2)
end

const function MaceBonus(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource): number
	if not Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Weapon), "MaceItem") or not CanSmashAttack(Player) then
		return 0
	end

	const Fall = Player.FallDistance
	local Damage = 22 + Fall - 8

	if Fall <= 3 then
		Damage = 4 * Fall
	elseif Fall <= 8 then
		Damage = 12 + 2 * (Fall - 3)
	end

	return Mth.Float(Damage + Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:smash_damage_per_fallen_block", Weapon, Target, Source, 0, Player.Random) * Fall)
end

const function StopSprinting(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Player.Sprinting = false
	Entities.SetSharedFlag(Player, Minecraft.SharedFlags.Sprinting, false)
end

const function PlayServerSideSound(Player: ServerPlayer, Event: string)
	Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, Event, 1, 1)
end

const function CauseExtraKnockback(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity, Amount: number)
	if Amount <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Yaw = Mth.Float(Player.YRot * DegreesToRadians)

	if Target.IsLiving then
		Living.Knockback(Target, Amount, Mth.Sin(Yaw), -Mth.Cos(Yaw))
	else
		Entities.Push(Target, vector.create(-Mth.Sin(Yaw) * Amount, 0.1, Mth.Cos(Yaw) * Amount))
	end

	Player.DeltaMovement *= AttackerSlowdown
	StopSprinting(Player)
end

const function SmashKnockback(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Target)

	Particles.LevelEvent(nil, Protocol.LevelEvents.SmashAttack, Target.Position - SmashGroundOffset, SmashParticleCount)

	const Grow = vector.one * SmashRadius

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, nil, Nearby) do
		const Other = Nearby[Index]
		const OtherPlayer = Entities.AsPlayer(Other)
		const Direction = Other.Position - Target.Position

		if Other == Player or Other == Target or not Other.IsLiving or vector.dot(Direction, Direction) > SmashRadius * SmashRadius then
			continue
		end

		if OtherPlayer and (OtherPlayer.GameMode == "spectator" or OtherPlayer.GameMode == "creative" and OtherPlayer.Abilities.Flying) then
			continue
		end

		const Resistance = if OtherPlayer then AttributeValue(OtherPlayer, "minecraft:knockback_resistance") else 0
		const Power = (SmashRadius - vector.magnitude(Direction)) * SmashPower * (if Player.FallDistance > SmashHeavyThreshold then 2 else 1) * (1 - Resistance)

		if Power > 0 then
			const Push = Mth.Normalize(Direction) * Power

			Entities.Push(Other, vector.create(Push.x, SmashLift, Push.z))
		end
	end
end

const function HurtEnemy(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity): boolean
	if Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Weapon), "MaceItem") and CanSmashAttack(Player) then
		Player.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Player.DeltaMovement.x, SmashMotion, Player.DeltaMovement.z)
		const Impact = Player.ImpulseImpactPosition

		Player.ImpulseGraceTime = math.max(Player.ImpulseGraceTime, 40)
		Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = if Impact and Impact.y <= Player.Position.y then Impact else Player.Position
		Player.HurtMarked = true

		if Target.OnGround then
			Player.SpawnExtraParticlesOnFall = true
			PlayServerSideSound(Player, if Player.FallDistance > SmashHeavyThreshold then "item.mace.smash_ground_heavy" else "item.mace.smash_ground")
		else
			PlayServerSideSound(Player, "item.mace.smash_air")
		end

		SmashKnockback(Player, Target)
	end

	return Items.Has(Weapon, "minecraft:weapon")
end

const function PostHurtEnemy(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack)
	if Minecraft.Registry.IsInstance(Items.ItemOf(Weapon), "MaceItem") and CanSmashAttack(Player) then
		Player.FallDistance = 0
	end

	const WeaponData = Items.Get(Weapon, "minecraft:weapon") :: { item_damage_per_attack: number? }?

	if WeaponData then
		Living.HurtAndBreak(Player, Weapon, WeaponData.item_damage_per_attack or 1, "mainhand")
	end
end

const function ItemAttackInteraction(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource, ApplyToTarget: boolean)
	local HurtEnemyResult = false

	if Target.IsLiving then
		HurtEnemyResult = HurtEnemy(Player, Weapon, Target)
	end

	if ApplyToTarget then
		EnchantmentActions.PostAttack(Target, Source, Weapon)
	end

	if not Items.IsEmpty(Weapon) and Target.IsLiving and HurtEnemyResult then
		PostHurtEnemy(Player, Weapon)
	end
end

const function CanCriticalAttack(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity): boolean
	return Player.FallDistance > 0
		and not Player.OnGround
		and not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Player)
		and not Player.Effects["minecraft:blindness"]
		and Target.IsLiving
		and not Player.Sprinting
end

const function IsSweepAttack(Player: ServerPlayer, FullStrength: boolean, Critical: boolean, KnockbackAttack: boolean): boolean
	if not FullStrength or Critical or KnockbackAttack or not Player.OnGround then
		return false
	end

	const Known = Player.KnownMovement
	const MaximumSpeed = Behaviors.MovementSpeed(Player.Inventory, Player.Effects, Player.Sprinting) * 2.5

	return Known.x * Known.x + Known.z * Known.z < MaximumSpeed * MaximumSpeed
		and Minecraft.Registry.HasTag("minecraft:item", "minecraft:swords", Items.ItemOf(Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)).Id)
end

const function DoSweepAttack(Player: ServerPlayer, Weapon: Minecraft.ItemStack, Target: Entity, BaseDamage: number, Source: Minecraft.DamageSource, Scale: number)
	PlayServerSideSound(Player, "entity.player.attack.sweep")

	const SweepDamage = Mth.Float(1 + AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:sweeping_damage_ratio") * BaseDamage)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Target)
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(Player.YRot * DegreesToRadians)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - SweepReach, Max + SweepReach, nil, Nearby) do
		const Other = Nearby[Index]
		const Offset = Other.Position - Player.Position

		if Other == Player or Other == Target or not Other.IsLiving or vector.dot(Offset, Offset) >= SweepDistanceSquared then
			continue
		end

		const Damage = Mth.Float(EnchantedDamage(Player, Weapon, Other, SweepDamage, Source) * Scale)

		if Living.HurtEntity(Other, Source, Damage) then
			Living.Knockback(Other, SweepKnockback, Mth.Sin(Yaw), -Mth.Cos(Yaw))
			EnchantmentActions.PostAttack(Other, Source, Weapon)
		end
	end

	const Direction = vector.create(-Mth.Sin(Yaw), 0, Mth.Cos(Yaw))

	Particles.Send({ Type = "sweep_attack" }, Player.Position + Direction + vector.create(0, Player.Height * 0.5, 0), 0, Direction, 0)
end

const function AttackVisualEffects(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity, Critical: boolean, Sweep: boolean, FullStrength: boolean, Stab: boolean, MagicBoost: number)
	if Critical then
		PlayServerSideSound(Player, "entity.player.attack.crit")
		Particles.Animate(Target.Id, Protocol.AnimateActions.CriticalHit)
	end

	if not Critical and not Sweep and not Stab then
		PlayServerSideSound(Player, if FullStrength then "entity.player.attack.strong" else "entity.player.attack.weak")
	end

	if MagicBoost > 0 then
		Particles.Animate(Target.Id, Protocol.AnimateActions.MagicCriticalHit)
	end
end

const function AttackTarget(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity)
	if not Target.IsLiving or not Entities.IsAlive(Target) then
		return
	end

	local BaseDamage = if Player.SpinAttack then Player.AutoSpinAttackDamage else Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:attack_damage"))
	const Weapon = if Player.SpinAttack and Player.AutoSpinAttackItem then Player.AutoSpinAttackItem else Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)
	const Source = DamageSourceFor(Player, Weapon)
	const Scale = AttackStrengthScale(Player, 0.5)
	const MagicBoost = Mth.Float(Scale * (EnchantedDamage(Player, Weapon, Target, BaseDamage, Source) - BaseDamage))

	BaseDamage = Mth.Float(BaseDamage * Mth.Float(0.2 + Scale * Scale * 0.8))
	Player.AttackStrengthTicker = 0

	if BaseDamage > 0 or MagicBoost > 0 then
		const FullStrength = Scale > FullStrengthThreshold
		const KnockbackAttack = Player.Sprinting and FullStrength

		if KnockbackAttack then
			PlayServerSideSound(Player, "entity.player.attack.knockback")
		end

		BaseDamage = Mth.Float(BaseDamage + MaceBonus(Player, Weapon, Target, Source))

		const Critical = FullStrength and CanCriticalAttack(Player, Target)

		if Critical then
			BaseDamage = Mth.Float(BaseDamage * CriticalMultiplier)
		end

		const Total = Mth.Float(BaseDamage + MagicBoost)
		const Sweep = IsSweepAttack(Player, FullStrength, Critical, KnockbackAttack)

		if Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, Total) then
			CauseExtraKnockback(Player, Target, Knockback(Player, Weapon, Target, Source) + (if KnockbackAttack then SprintKnockback else 0))

			if Sweep then
				DoSweepAttack(Player, Weapon, Target, BaseDamage, Source, Scale)
			end

			AttackVisualEffects(Player, Target, Critical, Sweep, FullStrength, false, MagicBoost)
			ItemAttackInteraction(Player, Target, Weapon, Source, true)
			Living.CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Living.AttackExhaustion)
		else
			PlayServerSideSound(Player, "entity.player.attack.nodamage")
		end
	end

	EnchantmentActions.PostPiercing(Player)
end

const function StabAttack(Player: ServerPlayer, Slot: Minecraft.EquipmentSlot, Target: Entity, BaseDamage: number, DealsDamage: boolean, DealsKnockback: boolean): boolean
	if not Target.IsLiving or not Entities.IsAlive(Target) then
		return false
	end

	const Weapon = Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)
	const Source = DamageSourceFor(Player, Weapon)
	local Damage = BaseDamage
	local MagicBoost = Mth.Float(EnchantedDamage(Player, Weapon, Target, Damage, Source) - Damage)
	const UsedSlot = if Player.UsingOffHand then "offhand" else "mainhand"

	if not Player.UsingItem or UsedSlot ~= Slot then
		const Scale = AttackStrengthScale(Player, 0.5)

		MagicBoost = Mth.Float(MagicBoost * Scale)
		Damage = Mth.Float(Damage * Mth.Float(0.2 + Scale * Scale * 0.8))
	end

	const Total = if DealsDamage then Mth.Float(Damage + MagicBoost) else 0
	const Hurt = DealsDamage and Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, Total)

	if DealsKnockback then
		CauseExtraKnockback(Player, Target, StabKnockback)
		CauseExtraKnockback(Player, Target, Knockback(Player, Weapon, Target, Source))
	end

	if not Hurt and not DealsKnockback then
		return false
	end

	AttackVisualEffects(Player, Target, false, false, DealsDamage, true, MagicBoost)
	ItemAttackInteraction(Player, Target, Weapon, Source, Hurt)
	Living.CauseFoodExhaustion(Player, Living.AttackExhaustion)

	return true
end

const function CanBeStabbed(Player: ServerPlayer, Target: Entity): boolean
	const TargetPlayer = Entities.AsPlayer(Target)

	return Target ~= Player and Target.IsLiving and Entities.IsAlive(Target) and not (TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.GameMode == "spectator")
end

const function HitEntitiesAlong(Player: ServerPlayer, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, Out: { Entity }): number
	const Minimum, Maximum, Margin = Reach(Player, Stack)
	const Look = LookVector(Player.XRot, Player.YHeadRot)
	const Eye = EyePosition(Player)
	const From = Eye + Look * Minimum
	local To = Eye + Look * (Maximum + math.max(0, vector.dot(Player.KnownMovement, Look)))
	const Blocked = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Eye, To - Eye)

	if Blocked then
		To = Blocked

		if vector.dot(Blocked - Eye, Blocked - Eye) < vector.dot(From - Eye, From - Eye) then
			return 0
		end
	end

	const Half = vector.one * (Margin / 2)
	const SearchMin = vector.min(From - Half, To - Half) - vector.one
	const SearchMax = vector.max(From + Half, To + Half) + vector.one
	local Count = 0

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(SearchMin, SearchMax, Player, Nearby) do
		const Target = Nearby[Index]

		if not CanBeStabbed(Player, Target) then
			continue
		end

		const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Target)
		local Hit = EntityPhysics.Contains(Min, Max, From) or EntityPhysics.ClipBox(Min, Max, From, To) ~= nil

		if not Hit and Margin > 0 then
			const Grow = vector.one * Margin
			const Outside = EntityPhysics.ClipBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, From, To)

			if Outside then
				local Toward = (Min + Max) / 2
				const Wall = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Outside, Toward - Outside)

				if Wall then
					Toward = Wall
				end

				Hit = EntityPhysics.ClipBox(Min, Max, Outside, Toward) ~= nil
			end
		end

		if Hit then
			Count += 1
			Out[Count] = Target
		end
	end

	for Index = Count + 1, #Out do
		Out[Index] = nil
	end

	return Count
end

const function Swing(Player: ServerPlayer, OffHand: boolean, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack, ToSelf: boolean, Attack: boolean)
	local Type, Duration = Behaviors.InteractAnimation(Stack)

	if Attack then
		Type, Duration = Behaviors.AttackAnimation(Stack)
	end

	Entities.Swing(Player, OffHand, Type, Duration, ToSelf)
end

const function Attack(Player: ServerPlayer, TargetId: number)
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Living.IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		return
	end

	const Target = Entities.Get(TargetId)
	const Weapon = Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)

	if not Target or Target == Player or not IsInAttackRange(Player, Weapon, Target, AttackRangeSlack) then
		return
	end

	if Items.Has(Weapon, "minecraft:piercing_weapon") or not Target.IsLiving then
		return
	end

	if not CannotAttackWithItem(Player, Weapon, MinimumChargeTolerance) then
		AttackTarget(Player, Target)
	end
end

const function TickAutoSpinAttack(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks <= 0 then
		return
	end

	Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks -= 1

	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Player)
	local Touched = false

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min, Max, Player, Touching) do
		const Entity = Touching[Index]

		if Entity.GameMode == "spectator" then
			continue
		end

		Touched = true

		if Entity.IsLiving then
			AttackTarget(Player, Entity)
			Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
			Player.DeltaMovement *= -0.2

			break
		end
	end

	if not Touched and Player.HorizontalCollision then
		Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks = 0
	end

	if Player.AutoSpinAttackTicks <= 0 then
		Player.SpinAttack = false
		Player.AutoSpinAttackDamage = 0
		Player.AutoSpinAttackItem = nil
	end
end

const function Punch(Player: ServerPlayer)
	Swing(Player, false, Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory), false, true)
	Living.ResetAttackStrength(Player)
end

const function Stab(Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Player.GameMode == "spectator" or Living.IsDeadOrDying(Player) then
		return
	end

	const Weapon = Inventory.GetSelectedItem(Player.Inventory)

	if CannotAttackWithItem(Player, Weapon, MinimumChargeTolerance) then
		return
	end

	const Piercing = Items.Get(Weapon, "minecraft:piercing_weapon") :: { deals_knockback: boolean?, sound: unknown?, hit_sound: unknown? }?

	if not Piercing then
		return
	end

	const Damage = Mth.Float(AttributeValue(Player, "minecraft:attack_damage"))

	local HitSomething = false

	for Index = 1, HitEntitiesAlong(Player, Weapon, Stabbed) do
		HitSomething = StabAttack(Player, "mainhand", Stabbed[Index], Damage, true, Piercing.deals_knockback ~= false) or HitSomething
	end

	Player.AttackStrengthTicker = 0
	EnchantmentActions.PostPiercing(Player)

	const HitSound = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Piercing.hit_sound)
	const Sound = Behaviors.SoundEventOf(Piercing.sound)

	if HitSomething and HitSound then
		PlayServerSideSound(Player, HitSound)
	end

	if Sound then
		Sounds.EntitySound(Player, Sound, 1, 1)
	end

	Swing(Player, false, Weapon, false, true)
	Living.ResetAttackStrength(Player)
end

return {
	LookVector = LookVector,
	EyePosition = EyePosition,
	HitEntitiesAlong = HitEntitiesAlong,
	StabAttack = StabAttack,
	Swing = Swing,
	Attack = Attack,
	TickAutoSpinAttack = TickAutoSpinAttack,
	Punch = Punch,
	Stab = Stab,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Orbs"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")
const Experience = require("./Experience")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol
const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const Lifetime = 6000
const ScanPeriod = 20
const FollowDistance = 8
const MergeGroups = 40
const MergeDistance = 0.5
const Gravity = 0.03
const AirDrag = Mth.Float(0.98)
const OrbSize = 0.5
const PickupDelay = 2
const RepairComponent = "minecraft:repair_with_xp"
const OrbEyeHeight = Mth.Float(OrbSize * Mth.Float(0.85))
const WaterInertia = Mth.Float(0.99)
const FluidRise = Mth.Float(5.0E-4)
const FluidRiseLimit = Mth.Float(0.06)
const LavaHop = Mth.Float(0.2)
const OrbHealth = 5
const FireDamageInterval = 20
const LavaIgniteTicks = 300
const LavaDamage = 4
const LavaFallScale = 0.5

export type Orb = {
	Id: number,
	Kind: Entities.Kind,
	EntityType: string,
	IsLiving: boolean,
	Position: vector,
	DeltaMovement: vector,
	KnownMovement: vector,
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	YRot: number,
	XRot: number,
	OnGround: boolean,
	OnFire: boolean,
	Crouching: boolean,
	Sprinting: boolean,
	Flying: boolean,
	FallFlying: boolean,
	EyeHeight: number,
	Swimming: boolean,
	Fluid: Minecraft.FluidState,
	FallDistance: number,
	TickCount: number,
	Removed: boolean,
	HurtMarked: boolean,
	RemainingFireTicks: number,

	OnGroundNoBlocks: boolean,
	HorizontalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollision: boolean,
	VerticalCollisionBelow: boolean,
	MaxUpStep: number,
	NoPhysics: boolean,
	SteppingCarefully: boolean,
	SupportingPart: BasePart?,

	Value: number,
	Count: number,
	Age: number,
	Health: number,
	Following: Entities.ServerPlayer?,
}

const Orbs: { [Orb]: true } = {}
const Generator = Random.new()
const Nearby: { Entities.Entity } = {}
const Candidates: { Orb } = {}
const RepairCandidates: { Minecraft.ItemStack } = {}

const function NoCollision(Orb: Orb, Offset: vector): boolean
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Orb)

	return Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Min + Offset, Max + Offset)
end

const function Spawn(Position: vector, Rough: vector, Value: number)
	local Motion = vector.create((Generator:NextNumber() * 0.2 - 0.1) * 2, Generator:NextNumber() * 0.2 * 2, (Generator:NextNumber() * 0.2 - 0.1) * 2)
	local Start = Position

	if vector.dot(Rough, Rough) > 0 then
		if vector.dot(Rough, Motion) < 0 then
			Motion = -Motion
		end

		Start += Mth.Normalize(Rough) * (OrbSize * 0.5)
	end

	const Created: Orb = {
		Id = Entities.NextId(),
		Kind = "ExperienceOrb",
		EntityType = "minecraft:experience_orb",
		IsLiving = false,
		Position = Start,
		DeltaMovement = Motion,
		KnownMovement = vector.zero,
		Width = OrbSize,
		Height = OrbSize,
		YRot = Generator:NextNumber() * 360,
		XRot = 0,
		OnGround = false,
		OnFire = false,
		Crouching = false,
		Sprinting = false,
		Flying = false,
		FallFlying = false,
		EyeHeight = OrbEyeHeight,
		Swimming = false,
		Fluid = Minecraft.Entity.CreateFluidState(),
		FallDistance = 0,
		TickCount = 0,
		Removed = false,
		HurtMarked = false,
		RemainingFireTicks = 0,
		OnGroundNoBlocks = false,
		HorizontalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollisionBelow = false,
		MaxUpStep = 0,
		NoPhysics = false,
		SteppingCarefully = false,
		SupportingPart = nil,
		Value = Value,
		Count = 1,
		Age = 0,
		Health = OrbHealth,
		Following = nil,
	}

	Orbs[Created] = true
	Entities.Add(Created)
end

const function CanMerge(Orb: Orb, Id: number, Value: number): boolean
	return not Orb.Removed and (Orb.Id - Id) % MergeGroups == 0 and Orb.Value == Value
end

const function TryMergeToExisting(Position: vector, Value: number): boolean
	const Id = Generator:NextInteger(0, MergeGroups - 1)
	const Half = vector.one * 0.5

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Position - Half, Position + Half, nil, Nearby) do
		const Entity = Nearby[Index]

		if Entity.Kind == "ExperienceOrb" and CanMerge(Entity :: Orb, Id, Value) then
			const Found = Entity :: Orb

			Found.Count += 1
			Found.Age = 0

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

const function Award(Position: vector, Amount: number, Rough: vector?)
	local Remaining = Amount

	while Remaining > 0 do
		const Value = Experience.OrbValue(Remaining)

		Remaining -= Value

		if not TryMergeToExisting(Position, Value) then
			Spawn(Position, Rough or vector.zero, Value)
		end
	end
end

const function Discard(Orb: Orb)
	Orbs[Orb] = nil
	Entities.Remove(Orb)
end

const function ScanForMerges(Orb: Orb)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Orb)
	const Grow = vector.one * MergeDistance

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, Orb, Nearby) do
		const Entity = Nearby[Index]

		if Entity.Kind == "ExperienceOrb" and CanMerge(Entity :: Orb, Orb.Id, Orb.Value) then
			const Other = Entity :: Orb

			Orb.Count += Other.Count
			Orb.Age = math.min(Orb.Age, Other.Age)
			Discard(Other)
		end
	end
end

const function NearestPlayer(Orb: Orb): Entities.ServerPlayer?
	local Nearest: Entities.ServerPlayer? = nil
	local NearestDistance = FollowDistance * FollowDistance

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			const Distance = vector.dot(Player.Position - Orb.Position, Player.Position - Orb.Position)

			if Distance < NearestDistance then
				Nearest = Player
				NearestDistance = Distance
			end
		end
	end

	return Nearest
end

const function FollowNearbyPlayer(Orb: Orb)
	const Following = Orb.Following

	if not Following or Following.Removed or Following.GameMode == "spectator" or vector.dot(Following.Position - Orb.Position, Following.Position - Orb.Position) > 64 then
		const Nearest = NearestPlayer(Orb)

		Orb.Following = if Nearest and Entities.IsAlive(Nearest) then Nearest else nil
	end

	const Target = Orb.Following

	if Target then
		const EyeHeight = Minecraft.Entity.PlayerDimensions[Target.Pose].EyeHeight
		const Delta = Target.Position + vector.create(0, EyeHeight / 2, 0) - Orb.Position
		const Power = 1 - vector.magnitude(Delta) / FollowDistance

		Orb.DeltaMovement += Mth.Normalize(Delta) * (Power * Power * 0.1)
	end
end

const function Hurt(Orb: Orb, Amount: number)
	if Orb.Removed then
		return
	end

	Orb.HurtMarked = true
	Orb.Health = math.modf(Orb.Health - Amount)

	if Orb.Health <= 0 then
		Discard(Orb)
	end
end

const function BaseTick(Orb: Orb)
	Orb.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Orb.Fluid.EyeInWater
	Minecraft.Entity.UpdateFluidInteraction(Orb)

	if Orb.RemainingFireTicks > 0 then
		if Orb.RemainingFireTicks % FireDamageInterval == 0 and not Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Orb) then
			Hurt(Orb, 1)
		end

		Orb.RemainingFireTicks -= 1
	end

	if Minecraft.Entity.IsInLava(Orb) then
		Orb.FallDistance *= LavaFallScale
	end

	Orb.OnFire = Orb.RemainingFireTicks > 0
	Orb.Fluid.FirstTick = false
end

const function ApplyFluidEffects(Orb: Orb, From: vector)
	const Water, Lava = Minecraft.Entity.TouchedFluids(Orb, From, Orb.Position)
	const PreviousFireTicks = Orb.RemainingFireTicks

	if Lava then
		if Orb.RemainingFireTicks < LavaIgniteTicks then
			Orb.RemainingFireTicks = LavaIgniteTicks
		end

		Hurt(Orb, LavaDamage)
	end

	if Water then
		Orb.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Orb.RemainingFireTicks)
	end

	if Orb.RemainingFireTicks <= 0 and Orb.RemainingFireTicks <= PreviousFireTicks then
		Orb.RemainingFireTicks = -1
	end
end

const function TickOrb(Orb: Orb)
	Orb.TickCount += 1
	BaseTick(Orb)

	if Orb.Removed then
		return
	end

	const Colliding = not NoCollision(Orb, vector.zero)

	if Orb.Fluid.EyeInWater then
		const Movement = Orb.DeltaMovement

		Orb.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Movement.x * WaterInertia, math.min(Movement.y + FluidRise, FluidRiseLimit), Movement.z * WaterInertia)
	elseif not Colliding then
		Orb.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Gravity, 0)
	end

	if Minecraft.Entity.FluidAt(Orb.Position) == "Lava" then
		Orb.DeltaMovement = vector.create((Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) - Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber())) * LavaHop, LavaHop, (Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber()) - Mth.Float(Generator:NextNumber())) * LavaHop)
	end

	if Orb.TickCount % ScanPeriod == 1 then
		ScanForMerges(Orb)
	end

	FollowNearbyPlayer(Orb)

	const Previous = Orb.Position
	const FallSpeed = Orb.DeltaMovement.y

	Minecraft.Entity.Move(Orb, Orb.DeltaMovement, false)
	ApplyFluidEffects(Orb, Previous)

	if Orb.Removed then
		return
	end

	Orb.KnownMovement = Orb.Position - Previous

	local Friction = AirDrag

	if Orb.OnGround then
		const Block = Minecraft.Entity.SupportingBlock(Orb)

		Friction = Mth.Float(Friction * (if Block then Block.Friction else Mth.Float(0.6)))
	end

	Orb.DeltaMovement *= Friction

	if Orb.VerticalCollisionBelow and FallSpeed < -Gravity then
		Orb.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Orb.DeltaMovement.x, -FallSpeed * 0.4, Orb.DeltaMovement.z)
	end

	Orb.Age += 1

	if Orb.Age >= Lifetime then
		Discard(Orb)
	end
end

const function RepairPlayerItems(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer, Amount: number): number
	table.clear(RepairCandidates)

	for _, Slot in Minecraft.Inventory.EquipmentSlots do
		const Stack = Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Player.Inventory, Slot)

		if Items.IsDamaged(Stack) and Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.HasInSlot(Stack, RepairComponent, Slot) then
			table.insert(RepairCandidates, Stack)
		end
	end

	if #RepairCandidates == 0 then
		return Amount
	end

	const Stack = RepairCandidates[Generator:NextInteger(1, #RepairCandidates)]
	const Repairable = math.max(0, Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.ItemValue(RepairComponent, Stack, Stack, Amount, Generator) // 1)
	const Repair = math.min(Repairable, Items.DamageValue(Stack))

	Items.SetDamageValue(Stack, Items.DamageValue(Stack) - Repair)

	if Repair > 0 then
		const Remaining = Amount - Repair * Amount // Repairable

		if Remaining > 0 then
			return RepairPlayerItems(Player, Remaining)
		end
	end

	return 0
end

const function Touch(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer, Orb: Orb)
	if Player.TakeXpDelay ~= 0 then
		return
	end

	Player.TakeXpDelay = PickupDelay
	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteTakeItemEntity(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Orb.Id, Player.Id, 1)
	end

	const Remaining = RepairPlayerItems(Player, Orb.Value)

	if Remaining > 0 then
		Experience.GivePoints(Player, Remaining)
	end

	Orb.Count -= 1

	if Orb.Count == 0 then
		Discard(Orb)
	end
end

const function TouchNearby(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Player)
	const Grow = vector.create(1, 0.5, 1)

	table.clear(Candidates)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, Player, Nearby) do
		if Nearby[Index].Kind == "ExperienceOrb" then
			table.insert(Candidates, Nearby[Index] :: Orb)
		end
	end

	if #Candidates > 0 then
		Touch(Player, Candidates[Generator:NextInteger(1, #Candidates)])
	end
end

const function Tick()
	for Orb in Orbs do
		if Orb.Removed then
			Orbs[Orb] = nil
		else
			TickOrb(Orb)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player and Entities.IsAlive(Player) and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			TouchNearby(Player)
		end
	end
end

return {
	Award = Award,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

		Height = Properties.Height,

		OnFire = false,
		Crouching = false,
		Sprinting = false,

		FallFlying = false,
		EyeHeight = Properties.EyeHeight,
		Swimming = false,
		Fluid = Minecraft.Entity.CreateFluidState(),
		FallDistance = 0,
		TickCount = 0,
		Removed = false,
		HurtMarked = false,
		RemainingFireTicks = 0,
		PierceLevel = 0,
		KnockbackFromPosition = Type == "SplashPotion" or Type == "LingeringPotion" or Type == "FireworkRocket",
		OnGroundNoBlocks = false,
		HorizontalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollision = false,
		VerticalCollisionBelow = false,
		MaxUpStep = 0,
		NoPhysics = false,

		LeftOwner = false,

const function Discard(Projectile: Projectile)
	Projectiles[Projectile] = nil
	Entities.Remove(Projectile)
end

const function Face(Projectile: Projectile, Motion: vector)
	Projectile.DeltaMovement = Motion
	Projectile.YRot, Projectile.XRot = Flight.FacingOf(Motion)
end

const function SpawnProjectile(Projectile: Projectile, Pickup: ItemStack)
	Projectiles[Projectile] = true
	Entities.Add(Projectile)

	const Owner = if Projectile.Owner then Entities.AsPlayer(Projectile.Owner) else nil

	EnchantmentActions.ProjectileSpawned(Pickup, Projectile, Owner)

	const Weapon = Projectile.Weapon

	if Projectile.Kind == "Arrow" and Weapon and not Items.IsEmpty(Weapon) and Items.ItemOf(Pickup) ~= Items.ItemOf(Weapon) then
		EnchantmentActions.ProjectileSpawned(Weapon, Projectile, Owner)
	end
end

const function ArrowColor(Stack: ItemStack): number
	const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

	return if Contents == nil then -1 else bit32.band(Items.PotionContents.Color(Contents, -1), 0xFFFFFF)
end

const function CreateArrow(Owner: ServerPlayer, Ammo: ItemStack, Weapon: ItemStack?, Critical: boolean): Projectile
	const Type: Minecraft.ProjectileType = if Items.Is(Ammo, "minecraft:spectral_arrow") then "SpectralArrow" else "Arrow"
	const Pickup = Items.Copy(Ammo)
	const Intangible = Items.Has(Pickup, "minecraft:intangible_projectile")

	Items.Remove(Pickup, "minecraft:intangible_projectile")

	const Arrow = Create(Type, Owner, EyePosition(Owner) - vector.create(0, ArrowSpawnDrop, 0), Pickup, Weapon)

	Arrow.Stack = Pickup
	Arrow.Critical = Critical
	Arrow.Data = if Type == "Arrow" then ArrowColor(Pickup) else -1

	if Intangible then
		Arrow.Pickup = "CreativeOnly"
	end

	if Weapon then
		Arrow.PierceLevel = math.max(0, Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.ItemValue("minecraft:projectile_piercing", Weapon, Pickup, 0, Owner.Random) // 1)
	end

	return Arrow
end

const function ShooterMovement(Owner: Entity): (vector, boolean)
	return Owner.KnownMovement, Owner.OnGround
end

const function ShootArrow(Owner: ServerPlayer, Weapon: ItemStack, Ammo: ItemStack, Power: number, Uncertainty: number, Critical: boolean, Angle: number)
	const Arrow = CreateArrow(Owner, Ammo, Weapon, Critical)
	const Movement, OnGround = ShooterMovement(Owner)

	Face(Arrow, Flight.ShootFromRotation(Owner.XRot, Owner.YRot + Angle, 0, Power, Uncertainty, Owner.Random, Movement, OnGround))
	SpawnProjectile(Arrow, Ammo)
end

const function CrossbowShotVector(Owner: ServerPlayer, Angle: number): vector
	const View = Flight.ViewDirection(Owner.XRot, Owner.YRot, 0)
	const Pitch = Mth.Float((Owner.XRot - 90) * DegreesToRadians)
	const Yaw = Mth.Float(-Owner.YRot * DegreesToRadians)
	const Up = vector.create(Mth.Sin(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch), -Mth.Sin(Pitch), Mth.Cos(Yaw) * Mth.Cos(Pitch))
	const Radians = Angle * DegreesToRadians

	return View * math.cos(Radians) + vector.cross(Up, View) * math.sin(Radians) + Up * vector.dot(Up, View) * (1 - math.cos(Radians))
end

const function ShootFromCrossbow(Owner: ServerPlayer, Weapon: ItemStack, Ammo: ItemStack, Power: number, Uncertainty: number, Angle: number)
	const Direction = CrossbowShotVector(Owner, Angle)
	local Shot: Projectile

	if Items.Is(Ammo, "minecraft:firework_rocket") then
		Shot = Create("FireworkRocket", Owner, EyePosition(Owner) - vector.create(0, RocketSpawnDrop, 0), Ammo, nil)
		Shot.ShotAtAngle = true

		const Fireworks = Items.Get(Ammo, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { flight_duration: number? }?
		const Flights = 1 + (if Fireworks then Fireworks.flight_duration or 0 else 0)

		Shot.Lifetime = 10 * Flights + Shot.Random:NextInteger(0, 5) + Shot.Random:NextInteger(0, 6)
	else
		Shot = CreateArrow(Owner, Ammo, Weapon, true)
		Shot.HitSound = "item.crossbow.hit"
	end

	Face(Shot, Flight.Shoot(Direction, Power, Uncertainty, Owner.Random))
	SpawnProjectile(Shot, Ammo)
end

const function ThrowTrident(Owner: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack): Projectile
	const Trident = Create("Trident", Owner, EyePosition(Owner) - vector.create(0, ArrowSpawnDrop, 0), Stack, nil)
	const Movement, OnGround = ShooterMovement(Owner)

	Trident.Weapon = Trident.Stack
	Trident.Loyalty = math.clamp(Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.EntityValue("minecraft:trident_return_acceleration", Stack, Trident, 0, Owner.Random) // 1, 0, 127)
	Trident.Data = Trident.Loyalty

	if Owner.Abilities.Instabuild then
		Trident.Pickup = "CreativeOnly"
	end

	Face(Trident, Flight.ShootFromRotation(Owner.XRot, Owner.YRot, 0, 2.5, 1, Owner.Random, Movement, OnGround))
	SpawnProjectile(Trident, Stack)

	return Trident
end

const function Throw(Owner: ServerPlayer, Type: Minecraft.ProjectileType, Stack: ItemStack, YOffset: number, Power: number)
	const Thrown = Create(Type, Owner, EyePosition(Owner) - vector.create(0, ArrowSpawnDrop, 0), Stack, nil)
	const Movement, OnGround = ShooterMovement(Owner)

	Face(Thrown, Flight.ShootFromRotation(Owner.XRot, Owner.YRot, YOffset, Power, 1, Owner.Random, Movement, OnGround))
	SpawnProjectile(Thrown, Stack)
end

const function ShootWindCharge(Owner: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Eye = EyePosition(Owner)
	const Charge = Create("WindCharge", Owner, vector.create(Owner.Position.x, Eye.y, Owner.Position.z), Stack, nil)

const function AttachFirework(Owner: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Rocket = Create("FireworkRocket", Owner, Owner.Position, Stack, nil)
	const Fireworks = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { flight_duration: number? }?
	const Flights = 1 + (if Fireworks then Fireworks.flight_duration or 0 else 0)

	Rocket.Attached = Owner
	Rocket.Data = Owner.Id
	Rocket.Lifetime = 10 * Flights + Rocket.Random:NextInteger(0, 5) + Rocket.Random:NextInteger(0, 6)
	Rocket.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Flight.Triangle(Rocket.Random, 0, 0.002297), 0.05, Flight.Triangle(Rocket.Random, 0, 0.002297))
	SpawnProjectile(Rocket, Stack)
end

const function LaunchFirework(Owner: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack, Position: vector)
	const Rocket = Create("FireworkRocket", Owner, Position, Stack, nil)
	const Fireworks = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { flight_duration: number? }?
	const Flights = 1 + (if Fireworks then Fireworks.flight_duration or 0 else 0)

	Rocket.Lifetime = 10 * Flights + Rocket.Random:NextInteger(0, 5) + Rocket.Random:NextInteger(0, 6)
	Rocket.DeltaMovement = vector.create(Flight.Triangle(Rocket.Random, 0, 0.002297), 0.05, Flight.Triangle(Rocket.Random, 0, 0.002297))
	SpawnProjectile(Rocket, Stack)
end

const function Margin(Projectile: Projectile): number
	return math.max(0, math.min(0.3, (Projectile.TickCount - 2) / 20))
end

const function CanHitEntity(Projectile: Projectile, Entity: Entity): boolean
	if Entity == Projectile or not Entity.IsLiving or not Entities.IsAlive(Entity) then
		return false
	end

	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Player and Player.GameMode == "spectator" then
		return false
	end

	if Projectile.PiercingIgnore[Entity.Id] then
		return false
	end

	return Projectile.Owner == nil or Projectile.LeftOwner or Entity ~= Projectile.Owner
end

const function CheckLeftOwner(Projectile: Projectile)
	const Owner = Projectile.Owner

	if Projectile.LeftOwner or not Owner then
		Projectile.LeftOwner = true

		return
	end

	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Projectile)
	const Delta = Projectile.DeltaMovement
	const SearchMin = vector.min(Min, Min + Delta) - vector.one
	const SearchMax = vector.max(Max, Max + Delta) + vector.one
	const OwnerMin, OwnerMax = Entities.Box(Owner)

	Projectile.LeftOwner = not Entities.Intersects(SearchMin, SearchMax, OwnerMin, OwnerMax)
end

const function CollectHits(Projectile: Projectile, From: vector, To: vector, Grow: number): number
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Projectile)
	const Delta = Projectile.DeltaMovement
	const SearchMin = vector.min(Min, Min + Delta) - vector.one
	const SearchMax = vector.max(Max, Max + Delta) + vector.one
	local Count = 0

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(SearchMin, SearchMax, Projectile, Nearby) do
		const Target = Nearby[Index]

		if CanHitEntity(Projectile, Target) then
			const TargetMin, TargetMax = Entities.Box(Target)
			const Inflate = vector.one * Grow
			const Point = EntityPhysics.ClipBox(TargetMin - Inflate, TargetMax + Inflate, From, To)

			if Point then
				Count += 1
				HitList[Count] = Target
				HitPoints[Count] = Point
			end
		end
	end

	for Index = Count + 1, #HitList do
		HitList[Index] = nil
		HitPoints[Index] = nil
	end

	return Count
end

const function NearestHit(Projectile: Projectile, From: vector, To: vector): (Entity?, vector?)
	local Nearest: Entity? = nil
	local NearestPoint: vector? = nil
	local NearestDistance = math.huge
	const Grow = Margin(Projectile)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Projectile)
	const Delta = Projectile.DeltaMovement

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(vector.min(Min, Min + Delta) - vector.one, vector.max(Max, Max + Delta) + vector.one, Projectile, Nearby) do
		const Target = Nearby[Index]

		if CanHitEntity(Projectile, Target) then
			const TargetMin, TargetMax = Entities.Box(Target)
			const Inflate = vector.one * Grow
			const Point = EntityPhysics.ClipBox(TargetMin - Inflate, TargetMax + Inflate, From, To)

			if Point then
				const Distance = vector.dot(Point - From, Point - From)

				if Distance < NearestDistance then
					Nearest = Target
					NearestPoint = Point
					NearestDistance = Distance
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return Nearest, NearestPoint
end

const function CompareHits(Left: number, Right: number): boolean
	const LeftOffset = HitList[Left].Position - SortOrigin
	const RightOffset = HitList[Right].Position - SortOrigin

	return vector.dot(LeftOffset, LeftOffset) < vector.dot(RightOffset, RightOffset)
end

const function Deflect(Projectile: Projectile, Power: vector)
	const Rotation = 170 + Projectile.Random:NextNumber() * 20

	Projectile.DeltaMovement *= -Power * 0.5
	Projectile.YRot += Rotation
	Projectile.NeedsSync = true
end

const function OwnerOrSelf(Projectile: Projectile): Entity
	return Projectile.Owner or Projectile
end

const function ApplyPotionEffects(Target: ServerPlayer, Stack: ItemStack)
	const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

	if Contents == nil then
		return
	end

	const Scale = (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_duration_scale") :: number?) or 1

	for _, Effect in Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Contents, Scale) do
		Living.AddEffect(Target, Effect)
	end
end

const function HitPitch(Projectile: Projectile): number
	return 1.2 / (Projectile.Random:NextNumber() * 0.2 + 0.9)
end

const function ArrowHitEntity(Arrow: Projectile, Target: Entity)
	const Speed = Mth.Float(vector.magnitude(Arrow.DeltaMovement))
	const Owner = Arrow.Owner
	const Source = DamageRules.Create("minecraft:arrow", Arrow, OwnerOrSelf(Arrow), nil, Arrow.Weapon)
	local ArrowDamage = Arrow.BaseDamage
	const Generator = Arrow.Random

	if Arrow.Weapon then
		ArrowDamage = Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:damage", Arrow.Weapon, Target, Source, ArrowDamage, Generator)
	end

	local Damage = math.ceil(math.clamp(Speed * ArrowDamage, 0, 2147483647))
	const PierceLevel = Arrow.PierceLevel or 0

	if PierceLevel > 0 then
		local Ignored = 0

		for _ in Arrow.PiercingIgnore do
			Ignored += 1
		end

		if Ignored >= PierceLevel + 1 then
			Discard(Arrow)

			return
		end

		Arrow.PiercingIgnore[Target.Id] = true
	end

	if Arrow.Critical then
		Damage = math.min(Generator:NextInteger(0, Damage // 2 + 1) + Damage, 2147483647)
	end

	const PreviousFire = Target.RemainingFireTicks

	if Arrow.RemainingFireTicks > 0 then
		Living.Ignite(Target, 5)
	end

	if Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, Damage) then
		const Victim = Entities.AsPlayer(Target)

		if Victim and PierceLevel <= 0 then
			Victim.ArrowCount += 1
		end

		if Target.IsLiving then
			if Arrow.Weapon and Arrow.Kind == "Arrow" then
				const Knockback = Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:knockback", Arrow.Weapon, Target, Source, 0, Generator)

				if Knockback > 0 then
					const Resistance = if Victim then math.max(0, 1 - Minecraft.Attributes.Value("minecraft:knockback_resistance", Victim.Inventory, Victim.Effects)) else 1
					const Flat = vector.create(Arrow.DeltaMovement.x, 0, Arrow.DeltaMovement.z)

					if vector.dot(Flat, Flat) > 0 then
						const Push = Mth.Normalize(Flat) * (Knockback * 0.6 * Resistance)

						Entities.Push(Target, vector.create(Push.x, 0.1, Push.z))
					end
				end
			end

			EnchantmentActions.PostAttack(Target, Source, Arrow.Weapon)

			if Victim then
				if Arrow.Type == "SpectralArrow" then
					Living.AddEffect(Victim, Minecraft.Effects.Create("minecraft:glowing", 200, 0))
				elseif Arrow.Type == "Arrow" then
					ApplyPotionEffects(Victim, Arrow.Stack)
				end
			end

			const Shooter = if Owner then Entities.AsPlayer(Owner) else nil

			if Victim and Shooter and Victim ~= Shooter then
				Protocol.WriteGameEvent(Connection.StreamFor(Shooter.Player), Protocol.GameEvents.ArrowHitPlayer, 0)
			end
		end

		Sounds.Play(nil, Arrow.Position, Arrow.HitSound, 1, HitPitch(Arrow))

		if PierceLevel <= 0 then
			Discard(Arrow)
		end
	else
		Target.RemainingFireTicks = PreviousFire
		Deflect(Arrow, vector.one * 0.2)

		if vector.dot(Arrow.DeltaMovement, Arrow.DeltaMovement) < 1.0E-7 then
			if Arrow.Pickup == "Allowed" then
				ItemEntities.SpawnAtLocation(Arrow.Position, Items.Copy(Arrow.Stack), DropOffset)
			end

			Discard(Arrow)
		end
	end

	if Owner then
		Arrow.NeedsSync = true
	end
end

const function TridentHitEntity(Trident: Projectile, Target: Entity)
	const Source = DamageRules.Create("minecraft:trident", Trident, OwnerOrSelf(Trident), nil, Trident.Weapon)
	const Damage = Minecraft.EnchantmentEffects.DamageValue("minecraft:damage", Trident.Stack, Target, Source, TridentDamage, Trident.Random)

	Trident.DealtDamage = true

	const Hurt = Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, Damage)

	if Hurt then
		EnchantmentActions.PostAttack(Target, Source, Trident.Stack)
	end

	Sounds.Play(nil, Trident.Position, "item.trident.hit", 1, 1)
	Deflect(Trident, vector.create(0.02, 0.2, 0.02))
end

const function ArrowHitBlock(Arrow: Projectile)
	const Motion = Arrow.DeltaMovement

	Arrow.Position -= vector.create(math.sign(Motion.x), math.sign(Motion.y), math.sign(Motion.z)) * 0.05
	Arrow.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
	Sounds.Play(nil, Arrow.Position, if Arrow.Kind == "Trident" then "item.trident.hit_ground" else Arrow.HitSound, 1, HitPitch(Arrow))
	Arrow.HitSound = "entity.arrow.hit"
	Arrow.InGround = true
	Arrow.ShakeTime = ShakeTicks
	Arrow.Critical = false
	Arrow.PierceLevel = 0
	table.clear(Arrow.PiercingIgnore)
	Arrow.DataDirty = true
end

const function IsInsidePart(Position: vector): boolean
	return not Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Position - vector.one * 1.0E-7, Position + vector.one * 1.0E-7)
end

const function ShouldFall(Arrow: Projectile): boolean
	return Arrow.InGround and Minecraft.Collision.NoCollision(Arrow.Position - vector.one * 0.06, Arrow.Position + vector.one * 0.06)
end

const function ApplyFluidEffects(Projectile: Projectile, From: vector)
	const Water, Lava = EntityPhysics.TouchedFluids(Projectile, From, Projectile.Position)
	const PreviousFireTicks = Projectile.RemainingFireTicks

	if Lava then
		Living.Ignite(Projectile, LavaIgniteSeconds)
		Projectile.HurtMarked = true
	end

	if Water then
		Projectile.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Projectile.RemainingFireTicks)
	end

	if Projectile.RemainingFireTicks <= 0 and Projectile.RemainingFireTicks <= PreviousFireTicks then
		Projectile.RemainingFireTicks = -1
	end
end

const function BaseTick(Projectile: Projectile)
	Projectile.Fluid.WasEyeInWater = Projectile.Fluid.EyeInWater
	EntityPhysics.UpdateFluidInteraction(Projectile)

	if Projectile.RemainingFireTicks > 0 then
		Projectile.RemainingFireTicks -= 1
	end

	Projectile.Fluid.FirstTick = false
end

const function TickArrow(Arrow: Projectile)
	const Physics = not Arrow.NoPhysics

	if Physics and not Arrow.InGround and IsInsidePart(Arrow.Position) then
		Arrow.DeltaMovement = vector.zero
		Arrow.InGround = true
		Arrow.DataDirty = true
	end

	if Arrow.ShakeTime > 0 then
		Arrow.ShakeTime -= 1
	end

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Arrow) then
		Arrow.RemainingFireTicks = math.min(0, Arrow.RemainingFireTicks)
	end

	if Arrow.InGround and Physics then
		if ShouldFall(Arrow) then
			Arrow.InGround = false
			Arrow.DeltaMovement *= vector.create(Arrow.Random:NextNumber() * 0.2, Arrow.Random:NextNumber() * 0.2, Arrow.Random:NextNumber() * 0.2)
			Arrow.Life = 0
			Arrow.DataDirty = true
		elseif not (Arrow.Kind == "Trident" and Arrow.Pickup == "Allowed" and Arrow.Loyalty > 0) then
			Arrow.Life += 1

			if Arrow.Life >= ArrowLifetime then
				Discard(Arrow)

				return
			end
		end

		Arrow.InGroundTime += 1

		if Arrow.Type == "Arrow" and Arrow.Data ~= -1 and Arrow.InGroundTime >= TippedDecayTicks then
			Living.BroadcastEntityEvent(Arrow, Protocol.EntityEvents.TippedArrowParticles)
			Arrow.Stack = Items.Create(Minecraft.Registry.Item("minecraft:arrow"), 1)
			Arrow.Data = -1
			Arrow.DataDirty = true
		end

		ApplyFluidEffects(Arrow, Arrow.Position)

		return
	end

	Arrow.InGroundTime = 0

	const Motion = Arrow.DeltaMovement
	const Origin = Arrow.Position
	const TargetYRot = if Physics then math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.x, Motion.z)) else math.deg(math.atan2(-Motion.x, -Motion.z))
	const TargetXRot = math.deg(math.atan2(Motion.y, math.sqrt(Motion.x * Motion.x + Motion.z * Motion.z)))

	Arrow.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Arrow.XRot, Mth.Float(TargetXRot))
	Arrow.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Arrow.YRot, Mth.Float(TargetYRot))

	if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Arrow) then
		Arrow.DeltaMovement *= Flight.Of(Arrow.Type).WaterInertia
	end

	CheckLeftOwner(Arrow)

	if Physics then
		const Blocked = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Origin, Motion)
		const Stop = Blocked or Origin + Motion

		while not Arrow.Removed do
			const Start = Arrow.Position
			local Count = 0

			if not (Arrow.Kind == "Trident" and Arrow.DealtDamage) then
				Count = if Arrow.Kind == "Trident" then 0 else CollectHits(Arrow, Start, Stop, Margin(Arrow))

				if Arrow.Kind == "Trident" then
					const Single, Point = NearestHit(Arrow, Start, Stop)

					if Single and Point then
						Count = 1
						HitList[1] = Single
						HitPoints[1] = Point
					end
				end
			end

			if Count == 0 then
				Arrow.Position = Stop

				if Blocked then
					ArrowHitBlock(Arrow)
					Arrow.NeedsSync = true
				end

				break
			end

			table.clear(SortedHits)

			for Index = 1, Count do
				SortedHits[Index] = Index
			end

			SortOrigin = Start
			table.sort(SortedHits, CompareHits)

			Arrow.Position = HitPoints[SortedHits[1]]

			local Deflected = false

			for _, Index in SortedHits do
				const Before = Arrow.DeltaMovement

				if Arrow.Kind == "Trident" then
					TridentHitEntity(Arrow, HitList[Index])
				else
					ArrowHitEntity(Arrow, HitList[Index])
				end

				if Arrow.Removed or Arrow.DeltaMovement ~= Before then
					Deflected = not Arrow.Removed
					break
				end
			end

			Arrow.NeedsSync = true

			if (Arrow.PierceLevel or 0) > 0 and not Deflected and not Arrow.Removed then
				continue
			end

			break
		end
	else
		Arrow.Position = Origin + Motion
	end

	if Arrow.Removed then
		return
	end

	ApplyFluidEffects(Arrow, Origin)

	if not EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Arrow) then
		Arrow.DeltaMovement *= Flight.Of(Arrow.Type).Drag
	end

	if Physics and not Arrow.InGround then
		Arrow.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Flight.Of(Arrow.Type).Gravity, 0)
	end

	BaseTick(Arrow)
end

const function TickTrident(Trident: Projectile)
	if Trident.InGroundTime > 4 then
		Trident.DealtDamage = true
	end

	const Owner = Trident.Owner

	if Trident.Loyalty > 0 and (Trident.DealtDamage or Trident.NoPhysics) and Owner then
		const OwnerPlayer = Entities.AsPlayer(Owner)

		if not Entities.IsAlive(Owner) or OwnerPlayer and OwnerPlayer.GameMode == "spectator" then
			if Trident.Pickup == "Allowed" then
				ItemEntities.SpawnAtLocation(Trident.Position, Items.Copy(Trident.Stack), DropOffset)
			end

			Discard(Trident)

			return
		end

		Trident.NoPhysics = true
		Trident.InGround = false
		Trident.DataDirty = true

		const Toward = EyePosition(Owner) - Trident.Position

		if Trident.ReturnTicks == 0 then
			Sounds.Play(nil, Trident.Position, "item.trident.return", 10, 1)
		end

		Trident.ReturnTicks += 1

		Trident.Position += vector.create(0, Toward.y * ReturnRiseScale * Trident.Loyalty, 0)
		Trident.DeltaMovement = Trident.DeltaMovement * 0.95 + Mth.Normalize(Toward) * (ReturnAcceleration * Trident.Loyalty)
	end

	TickArrow(Trident)
end

const function SplashEffects(Potion: Projectile, HitPoint: vector)
	const Contents = Items.Get(Potion.Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

	if Contents == nil then
		return
	end

	const Scale = (Items.Get(Potion.Stack, "minecraft:potion_duration_scale") :: number?) or 1
	const Effects = Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Contents, 1)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Potion)
	const Offset = HitPoint - Potion.Position
	const PotionMin = Min + Offset
	const PotionMax = Max + Offset
	const Grow = Margin(Potion)
	const Source = Potion.Owner

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(PotionMin - SplashGrow, PotionMax + SplashGrow, nil, Nearby) do
		const Target = Entities.AsPlayer(Nearby[Index])

		if not Target or not Entities.IsAlive(Target) then
			continue
		end

		const TargetMin, TargetMax = Entities.Box(Target)
		const Inflate = vector.one * Grow
		const Gap = vector.max(vector.max(PotionMin - (TargetMax + Inflate), (TargetMin - Inflate) - PotionMax), vector.zero)
		const Distance = vector.dot(Gap, Gap)

		if Distance < SplashRangeSquared then
			const Strength = 1 - math.sqrt(Distance) / SplashRange

			for _, Effect in Effects do
				const Definition = Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)

				if Definition and Definition.instantaneous then
					Living.ApplyInstantaneous(Target, Effect.Id, Effect.Amplifier, Strength, Potion, Source)
				else
					const Duration = if Effect.Duration == -1 or Effect.Duration == 0 then Effect.Duration else (Strength * Effect.Duration * Scale + 0.5) // 1
					const Scaled = Minecraft.Effects.Create(Effect.Id, Duration, Effect.Amplifier, Effect.Ambient, Effect.Visible)

					if not Minecraft.Effects.EndsWithin(Scaled, 20) then
						Living.AddEffect(Target, Scaled)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

const function SpawnCloud(Potion: Projectile, Position: vector)
	const Contents = Items.Get(Potion.Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")
	const Created: Cloud = {
		Id = Entities.NextId(),
		Kind = "AreaEffectCloud",
		EntityType = "minecraft:area_effect_cloud",
		IsLiving = false,
		Position = Position,
		DeltaMovement = vector.zero,
		KnownMovement = vector.zero,
		Width = CloudRadius * 2,
		Height = CloudHeight,
		YRot = 0,
		XRot = 0,
		OnGround = false,
		OnFire = false,
		Crouching = false,
		Sprinting = false,
		Flying = false,
		FallFlying = false,
		EyeHeight = CloudEyeHeight,
		Swimming = false,
		Fluid = Minecraft.Entity.CreateFluidState(),
		FallDistance = 0,
		TickCount = 0,
		Removed = false,
		HurtMarked = false,
		RemainingFireTicks = 0,
		Owner = Potion.Owner,
		Contents = Contents,
		DurationScale = (Items.Get(Potion.Stack, "minecraft:potion_duration_scale") :: number?) or 1,
		Radius = CloudRadius,
		RadiusPerTick = Mth.Float(-CloudRadius / CloudDuration),
		RadiusOnUse = CloudRadiusOnUse,
		Duration = CloudDuration,
		WaitTime = CloudWait,
		Waiting = false,
		Color = if Contents == nil then 0xFFFFFF else bit32.band(Items.PotionContents.Color(Contents, -1), 0xFFFFFF),
		Victims = {},
	}

	Clouds[Created] = true
	Entities.Add(Created)
end

const function PotionHit(Potion: Projectile, HitPoint: vector, HitEntity: Entity?)
	const Contents = Items.Get(Potion.Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

	if Contents ~= nil then
		const PotionId = if type(Contents) == "string" then Contents else (Contents :: { potion: string? }).potion

		if PotionId and Minecraft.Registry.HasTag("minecraft:potion", "minecraft:extinguishes_entities", PotionId) then
			const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Potion)

			for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - SplashGrow, Max + SplashGrow, nil, Nearby) do
				const Target = Nearby[Index]

				if Target.IsLiving and Target.RemainingFireTicks > 0 and vector.dot(Target.Position - Potion.Position, Target.Position - Potion.Position) < SplashRangeSquared then
					Living.ExtinguishSound(Target)
					Target.RemainingFireTicks = 0
				end
			end
		end

		if #Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Contents, 1) > 0 then
			if Potion.Type == "SplashPotion" then
				SplashEffects(Potion, HitPoint)
			else
				SpawnCloud(Potion, if HitEntity then HitEntity.Position else Potion.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	const Instant = Contents ~= nil and Items.PotionContents.HasInstantEffects(Contents)
	const Color = if Contents == nil then PotionDefaultColor else Items.PotionContents.Color(Contents, PotionDefaultColor)

	Particles.LevelEvent(nil, if Instant then Protocol.LevelEvents.InstantPotionSplash else Protocol.LevelEvents.PotionSplash, Potion.Position, Color)
	Particles.LevelEvent(nil, if Instant then Protocol.LevelEvents.InstantSplashPotionSound else Protocol.LevelEvents.SplashPotionSound, Potion.Position, 0)
	Discard(Potion)
end

const function TeleportOwner(Pearl: Projectile)
	const Owner = Pearl.Owner
	const Player = if Owner then Entities.AsPlayer(Owner) else nil

	if Player and Entities.IsAlive(Player) then
		Entities.Teleport(Player, Pearl.PositionO, Player.YRot, Player.XRot)
		Player.FallDistance = 0
		Player.ImpulseImpactPosition = nil
		Player.ImpulseGraceTime = 0
		Living.Hurt(Player, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:ender_pearl"), 5)
		Sounds.Play(nil, Pearl.PositionO, "entity.player.teleport", 1, 1)
	end

	Discard(Pearl)
end

const function ThrownHit(Thrown: Projectile, HitPoint: vector, Normal: vector, Target: Entity?)
	const Type = Thrown.Type

	if Target and (Type == "Snowball" or Type == "Egg" or Type == "EnderPearl") then
		Living.HurtEntity(Target, DamageRules.Create("minecraft:thrown", Thrown, Thrown.Owner), 0)
	end

	if Type == "Snowball" or Type == "Egg" then
		Living.BroadcastEntityEvent(Thrown, Protocol.EntityEvents.ThrownHit)
		Discard(Thrown)
	elseif Type == "EnderPearl" then
		TeleportOwner(Thrown)
	elseif Type == "SplashPotion" or Type == "LingeringPotion" then
		PotionHit(Thrown, HitPoint, Target)
	elseif Type == "ExperienceBottle" then
		const Count = 3 + Thrown.Random:NextInteger(0, 4) + Thrown.Random:NextInteger(0, 4)

		Orbs.Award(HitPoint, Count, if Target then -Thrown.DeltaMovement else Normal)
		Particles.LevelEvent(nil, Protocol.LevelEvents.PotionSplash, Thrown.Position, ExperienceBottleColor)
		Particles.LevelEvent(nil, Protocol.LevelEvents.SplashPotionSound, Thrown.Position, 0)
		Discard(Thrown)
	end
end

const function TickThrown(Thrown: Projectile)
	Thrown.DeltaMovement -= vector.create(0, Flight.Of(Thrown.Type).Gravity, 0)
	Thrown.DeltaMovement *= if EntityPhysics.IsInWater(Thrown) then Flight.Of(Thrown.Type).WaterInertia else Flight.Of(Thrown.Type).Drag

	const From = Thrown.Position
	const To = From + Thrown.DeltaMovement
	const Blocked, Normal = Minecraft.Collision.RaycastNormal(From, Thrown.DeltaMovement)
	const Target, Point = NearestHit(Thrown, From, Blocked or To)
	const HitPoint = Point or Blocked

	Thrown.PositionO = From
	Thrown.Position = HitPoint or To

	const Motion = Thrown.DeltaMovement
	const YRot, XRot = Flight.FacingOf(Motion)

	Thrown.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Thrown.XRot, XRot)
	Thrown.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Thrown.YRot, YRot)
	ApplyFluidEffects(Thrown, From)
	CheckLeftOwner(Thrown)
	BaseTick(Thrown)

	if HitPoint then
		ThrownHit(Thrown, HitPoint, Normal, Target)
	end
end

const function WindChargeBurst(Charge: Projectile, Center: vector)
	Explosions.Explode(Charge, Center, WindChargeRadius, WindChargeKnockback, true, { Type = "gust_emitter_small" }, { Type = "gust_emitter_large" }, "entity.wind_charge.wind_burst")
end

const function TickWindCharge(Charge: Projectile)
	if Charge.Position.y // 1 > WorldTopY + WindChargeCeiling then
		WindChargeBurst(Charge, Charge.Position)
		Discard(Charge)

		return
	end

	const From = Charge.Position
	const To = From + Charge.DeltaMovement
	const Blocked, Normal = Minecraft.Collision.RaycastNormal(From + vector.create(0, -WindChargeBoxDrop + Charge.Height / 2, 0), Charge.DeltaMovement)
	const Target, Point = NearestHit(Charge, From, if Blocked then Blocked + vector.create(0, WindChargeBoxDrop - Charge.Height / 2, 0) else To)

	Charge.Position = Point or (if Blocked then Blocked + vector.create(0, WindChargeBoxDrop - Charge.Height / 2, 0) else To)
	CheckLeftOwner(Charge)

	if Target then
		const Owner = Charge.Owner
		const Source = DamageRules.Create("minecraft:wind_charge", Charge, if Owner and Owner.IsLiving then Owner else nil)

		if Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, 1) then
			EnchantmentActions.PostAttack(Target, Source, nil)
		end

		WindChargeBurst(Charge, Charge.Position)
		Discard(Charge)
	elseif Blocked then
		WindChargeBurst(Charge, Blocked + Normal * 0.25)
		Discard(Charge)
	end
end

const function RocketExplode(Rocket: Projectile)
	const Fireworks = Items.Get(Rocket.Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { explosions: { unknown }? }?
	const Explosions = if Fireworks and Fireworks.explosions then #Fireworks.explosions else 0

	Living.BroadcastEntityEvent(Rocket, 17)

	if Explosions > 0 then
