		const Damage = RocketBaseDamage + Explosions * 2
		const Source = DamageRules.Create("minecraft:fireworks", Rocket, Rocket.Owner)

		if Rocket.Attached then
			Living.Hurt(Rocket.Attached, Source, Damage)
		end

		const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Rocket)
		const Grow = vector.one * RocketRadius

		for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, nil, Nearby) do
			const Target = Nearby[Index]
			const Distance = vector.magnitude(Target.Position - Rocket.Position)

			if Target == Rocket.Attached or not Target.IsLiving or Distance > RocketRadius then
				continue
			end

			local Visible = false

			for Step = 0, 1 do
				const Point = Target.Position + vector.create(0, Target.Height * 0.5 * Step, 0)

				if not Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Rocket.Position, Point - Rocket.Position) then
					Visible = true

					break
				end
			end

			if Visible then
				Living.HurtEntity(Target, Source, Mth.Float(Damage * math.sqrt((RocketRadius - Distance) / RocketRadius)))
			end
		end
	end

	Discard(Rocket)
end

const function TickRocket(Rocket: Projectile)
	CheckLeftOwner(Rocket)

	local Target: Entity? = nil
	local Point: vector? = nil
	local Blocked: vector? = nil
	const Attached = Rocket.Attached

	if Attached then
		local HandAngle = vector.zero

		if Attached.FallFlying then
			const Look = Flight.ViewDirection(Attached.XRot, Attached.YRot, 0)
			const Motion = Attached.DeltaMovement

			Attached.DeltaMovement = Motion + Look * RocketBoostPull + (Look * RocketBoost - Motion) * 0.5
			HandAngle = Flight.RocketHandAngle(Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Attached.Inventory, "mainhand"), Minecraft.Inventory.GetEquipment(Attached.Inventory, "offhand"), Attached.YRot)
		end

		Rocket.Position = Attached.Position + HandAngle
		Rocket.DeltaMovement = Attached.DeltaMovement
		Target, Point = NearestHit(Rocket, Rocket.Position, Rocket.Position + Rocket.DeltaMovement)
	else
		if not Rocket.ShotAtAngle then
			const Acceleration = if Rocket.HorizontalCollision then 1 else 1.15

			Rocket.DeltaMovement = Rocket.DeltaMovement * vector.create(Acceleration, 1, Acceleration) + vector.create(0, 0.04, 0)
		end

		const Motion = Rocket.DeltaMovement

		Blocked = Minecraft.Collision.Raycast(Rocket.Position, Motion)
		Target, Point = NearestHit(Rocket, Rocket.Position, Blocked or Rocket.Position + Motion)
		EntityPhysics.Move(Rocket, Motion, false)
		Rocket.DeltaMovement = Motion
	end

	if Target then
		RocketExplode(Rocket)

		return
	elseif Blocked and not Point then
		const Fireworks = Items.Get(Rocket.Stack, "minecraft:fireworks") :: { explosions: { unknown }? }?

		if Fireworks and Fireworks.explosions and #Fireworks.explosions > 0 then
			RocketExplode(Rocket)

			return
		end
	end

	const YRot, XRot = Flight.FacingOf(Rocket.DeltaMovement)

	Rocket.XRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Rocket.XRot, XRot)
	Rocket.YRot = Flight.LerpRotation(Rocket.YRot, YRot)

	if Rocket.Life == 0 then
		Sounds.Play(nil, Rocket.Position, "entity.firework_rocket.launch", 3, 1)
	end

	Rocket.Life += 1

	if Rocket.Life > Rocket.Lifetime then
		RocketExplode(Rocket)
	end
end

const function TickCloud(Cloud: Cloud)
	Cloud.TickCount += 1

	if Cloud.Duration ~= -1 and Cloud.TickCount - Cloud.WaitTime >= Cloud.Duration then
		Clouds[Cloud] = nil
		Entities.Remove(Cloud)

		return
	end

	const ShouldWait = Cloud.TickCount < Cloud.WaitTime

	Cloud.Waiting = ShouldWait

	if ShouldWait then
		return
	end

	local Radius = Cloud.Radius

	if Cloud.RadiusPerTick ~= 0 then
		Radius = Mth.Float(Radius + Cloud.RadiusPerTick)

		if Radius < CloudMinimumRadius then
			Clouds[Cloud] = nil
			Entities.Remove(Cloud)

			return
		end

		Cloud.Radius = Radius
		Cloud.Width = Radius * 2
	end

	if Cloud.TickCount % 5 ~= 0 then
		return
	end

	for Victim, Until in Cloud.Victims do
		if Cloud.TickCount >= Until then
			Cloud.Victims[Victim] = nil
		end
	end

	if Cloud.Contents == nil then
		table.clear(Cloud.Victims)

		return
	end

	const Effects = Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Cloud.Contents, Cloud.DurationScale)

	if #Effects == 0 then
		table.clear(Cloud.Victims)

		return
	end

	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Cloud)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min, Max, nil, Nearby) do
		const Target = Entities.AsPlayer(Nearby[Index])

		if not Target or Cloud.Victims[Target] or not Entities.IsAlive(Target) then
			continue
		end

		const Offset = Target.Position - Cloud.Position

		if Offset.x * Offset.x + Offset.z * Offset.z > Radius * Radius then
			continue
		end

		Cloud.Victims[Target] = Cloud.TickCount + CloudReapplicationDelay

		for _, Effect in Effects do
			const Definition = Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Effect.Id)

			if Definition and Definition.instantaneous then
				Living.ApplyInstantaneous(Target, Effect.Id, Effect.Amplifier, 0.5, Cloud, Cloud.Owner)
			else
				Living.AddEffect(Target, Minecraft.Effects.Copy(Effect))
			end
		end

		if Cloud.RadiusOnUse ~= 0 then
			Radius = Mth.Float(Radius + Cloud.RadiusOnUse)

			if Radius < CloudMinimumRadius then
				Clouds[Cloud] = nil
				Entities.Remove(Cloud)

				return
			end

			Cloud.Radius = Radius
			Cloud.Width = Radius * 2
		end
	end
end

const function TryPickup(Arrow: Projectile, Player: ServerPlayer): boolean
	if Arrow.Pickup == "Allowed" then
		return Minecraft.Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, Items.Copy(Arrow.Stack), Player.Abilities.Instabuild)
	elseif Arrow.Pickup == "CreativeOnly" then
		return Player.Abilities.Instabuild
	end

	return false
end

const function Touch(Arrow: Projectile, Player: ServerPlayer)
	if Arrow.Kind == "Trident" and Arrow.Owner ~= nil and Arrow.Owner ~= Player then
		return
	end

	if not (Arrow.InGround or Arrow.NoPhysics) or Arrow.ShakeTime > 0 then
		return
	end

	local Taken = TryPickup(Arrow, Player)

	if not Taken and Arrow.Kind == "Trident" and Arrow.NoPhysics and Arrow.Owner == Player then
		Taken = Minecraft.Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, Items.Copy(Arrow.Stack), Player.Abilities.Instabuild)
	end

	if Taken then
		for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
			Protocol.WriteTakeItemEntity(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Arrow.Id, Player.Id, 1)
		end
		Discard(Arrow)
	end
end

const function TouchNearby(Player: ServerPlayer)
	const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Player)
	const Grow = vector.create(1, 0.5, 1)

	for Index = 1, Entities.InBox(Min - Grow, Max + Grow, Player, Nearby) do
		const Entity = Nearby[Index]

		if Entity.Kind == "Arrow" or Entity.Kind == "Trident" then
			Touch(Entity :: Projectile, Player)
		end
	end
end

const function Tick()
	const VoidY = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight / Minecraft.StudsPerBlock

	for Projectile in Projectiles do
		if Projectile.Removed then
			Projectiles[Projectile] = nil

			continue
		end

		if Projectile.Position.y < VoidY then
			Discard(Projectile)

			continue
		end

		if Projectile.Owner and Projectile.Owner.Removed then
			Projectile.Owner = nil
		end

		const Previous = Projectile.Position

		Projectile.TickCount += 1

		if Projectile.Type == "Trident" then
			TickTrident(Projectile)
		elseif Projectile.Kind == "Arrow" then
			TickArrow(Projectile)
		elseif Projectile.Kind == "WindCharge" then
			TickWindCharge(Projectile)
		elseif Projectile.Kind == "Firework" then
			TickRocket(Projectile)
		else
			const Owner = Projectile.Owner

			if Projectile.Type == "EnderPearl" and Owner and not Entities.IsAlive(Owner) then
				Discard(Projectile)
			else
				TickThrown(Projectile)
			end
		end

		Projectile.KnownMovement = Projectile.Position - Previous
		Projectile.OnFire = Projectile.RemainingFireTicks > 0
	end

	for Cloud in Clouds do
		if Cloud.Removed then
			Clouds[Cloud] = nil
		else
			TickCloud(Cloud)
		end
	end

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Player and Entities.IsAlive(Player) and Player.GameMode ~= "spectator" then
			TouchNearby(Player)
		end
	end
end

return {
	ShootArrow = ShootArrow,
	ShootFromCrossbow = ShootFromCrossbow,
	ThrowTrident = ThrowTrident,
	Throw = Throw,
	ShootWindCharge = ShootWindCharge,
	AttachFirework = AttachFirework,
	LaunchFirework = LaunchFirework,
	Tick = Tick,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Clear = require("@self/Clear")
const Completion = require("@self/Completion")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Dispatcher = require("@self/Dispatcher")
const Effect = require("@self/Effect")
const Experience = require("@self/Experience")
const GameMode = require("@self/GameMode")
const Give = require("@self/Give")
const Kill = require("@self/Kill")
const Reader = require("@self/Reader")
const Source = require("@self/Source")

const Modules = {
	GameMode = GameMode,
	Give = Give,
	Clear = Clear,
	Effect = Effect,
	Kill = Kill,
	Experience = Experience,
}

const MaximumLength = 256
const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const Root = Dispatcher.Root()

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context)
	Modules[Context.Owner].Execute(Context, Context.Command :: string)
end

const function Perform(Sender: Source.Source, Text: string)
	const Line = if string.sub(Text, 1, 1) == "/" then string.sub(Text, 2) else Text
	const Context = Dispatcher.Finish(Dispatcher.Parse(Root, Line, Sender), Sender)

	if not Context then
		return
	end

	const Ok, Problem = pcall(Execute, Context)

	if Ok then
		return
	elseif Reader.IsException(Problem) then
		Source.SendFailure(Sender, (Problem :: Reader.Exception).Message)
	else
		warn(`Command exception: /{Line}: {Problem}`)
		Source.SendFailure(Sender, { translate = "command.failed" })
	end
end

const function Receive(Player: Player, PacketId: number, Reader: Minecraft.Reader): boolean
	if PacketId == Protocol.Serverbound.ChatCommand then
		const Command = Protocol.ReadChatCommand(Reader)
		const Sender = Source.Create(Player)

		if Sender and (utf8.len(Command) or math.huge) <= MaximumLength then
			Perform(Sender, Command)
		end
	elseif PacketId == Protocol.Serverbound.CommandSuggestion then
		const Id, Line, Cursor, SelectedEntity = Protocol.ReadCommandSuggestion(Reader)
		const Length = utf8.len(Line) or math.huge
		const Sender = Source.Create(Player)

		if Sender and Length <= MaximumLength and Cursor <= Length then
			Protocol.WriteCommandSuggestions(Connection.StreamFor(Player), Completion.Compute(Root, Sender, Id, Line, Cursor, SelectedEntity))
		end
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

const function Start()
	for _, Module in Modules do
		Module.Register(Root)
	end
end

return {
	Start = Start,
	Receive = Receive,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Clear"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Containers = require("../Containers")
const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const ItemArguments = require("./ItemArguments")
const Reader = require("./Reader")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const Tracker = require("./Tracker")

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Item = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("item", Dispatcher.ItemPredicate()), "Item")
	const Targets = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("targets", Dispatcher.Entity(false, true)), "Targets")

	Dispatcher.Then(Item, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("maxCount", Dispatcher.Integer(0)), "MaxCount"))
	Dispatcher.Then(Targets, Item)
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("clear"), "Self"), Targets), "Clear")
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Arguments = Context.Arguments
	const Players = if Command == "Self" then { Source.Entity } else Selectors.GetPlayers(Arguments.targets :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
	const Test = if Command == "Item" or Command == "MaxCount" then Arguments.item :: ItemArguments.Test else ItemArguments.Any
	const MaxCount = if Command == "MaxCount" then Arguments.maxCount :: number else -1
	const CountingOnly = MaxCount == 0
	const Results = Tracker.Create()

	for _, Player in Players do
		Tracker.Track(Results, Player, Containers.ClearOrCountMatching(Player.Player, function(Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): boolean
			return ItemArguments.Matches(Test, Stack)
		end, CountingOnly, MaxCount))
	end

	if Results.Total == 0 then
		Reader.Fail(Tracker.Message(Results, false, "clear.failed.single", "clear.failed.multiple", { 0 }, 1))
	end

	if CountingOnly then
		return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, nil, "commands.clear.test.single", "commands.clear.test.multiple", { Results.Total, 0 }, 2)
	end

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, nil, "commands.clear.success.single", "commands.clear.success.multiple", { Results.Total, 0 }, 2)
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Dispatcher"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Identifier = require("./Identifier")
const ItemArguments = require("./ItemArguments")
const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")
const Suggestions = require("./Suggestions")

const Space = ReaderModule.Space
const MinimumInt = -2147483648
const MaximumInt = 2147483647
const ContextLength = 10
const MobEffectRegistry = "minecraft:mob_effect"

type Reader = ReaderModule.Reader
type Exception = ReaderModule.Exception
type Source = SourceModule.Source

export type ArgumentType = {
	Kind: "Integer" | "Bool" | "Entity" | "GameMode" | "Item" | "ItemPredicate" | "MobEffect",
	Minimum: number,
	Maximum: number,
	Single: boolean,
	PlayersOnly: boolean,
}

export type Node = {
	Kind: "Root" | "Literal" | "Argument",
	Name: string,
	Type: ArgumentType?,
	Literals: { [string]: Node },
	Arguments: { Node },
	Children: { Node },
	Command: string?,
	Owner: string,
	Redirect: Node?,
	Restricted: boolean,
}

export type ParsedNode = {
	Node: Node,
	Start: number,
	End: number,
}

export type ArgumentRange = {
	Name: string,
	Start: number,
	End: number,
}

export type Context = {
	Source: Source,
	Root: Node,
	Arguments: { [string]: unknown },
	Nodes: { ParsedNode },
	Ranges: { ArgumentRange },
	RangeStart: number,
	RangeEnd: number,
	Command: string?,
	Owner: string,
	Child: Context?,
}

export type ParseResult = {
	Context: Context,
	Reader: Reader,
	Exceptions: { Exception },
}

const function CreateNode(Kind: "Root" | "Literal" | "Argument", Name: string, Type: ArgumentType?): Node
	return {
		Kind = Kind,
		Name = Name,
		Type = Type,
		Literals = {},
		Arguments = {},
		Children = {},
		Command = nil,
		Owner = "",
		Redirect = nil,
		Restricted = false,
	}
end

const function CreateType(Kind: "Integer" | "Bool" | "Entity" | "GameMode" | "Item" | "ItemPredicate" | "MobEffect"): ArgumentType
	return { Kind = Kind, Minimum = MinimumInt, Maximum = MaximumInt, Single = false, PlayersOnly = false }
end

const function Root(): Node
	return CreateNode("Root", "")
end

const function Literal(Name: string): Node
	return CreateNode("Literal", Name)
end

const function Argument(Name: string, Type: ArgumentType): Node
	return CreateNode("Argument", Name, Type)
end

const function Then(Parent: Node, Child: Node): Node
	if Child.Kind == "Literal" then
		Parent.Literals[Child.Name] = Child
	else
		table.insert(Parent.Arguments, Child)
	end

	table.insert(Parent.Children, Child)

	return Parent
end

const function Executes(Node: Node, Command: string): Node
	Node.Command = Command

	return Node
end

const function Redirect(Node: Node, Target: Node): Node
	Node.Redirect = Target

	return Node
end

const function SetOwner(Node: Node, Owner: string)
	Node.Owner = Owner

	for _, Child in Node.Literals do
		SetOwner(Child, Owner)
	end

	for _, Child in Node.Arguments do
		SetOwner(Child, Owner)
	end
end

const function Register(Parent: Node, Command: Node, Owner: string): Node
	Command.Restricted = true
	SetOwner(Command, Owner)
	Then(Parent, Command)

	return Command
end

const function Integer(Minimum: number?, Maximum: number?): ArgumentType
	const Type = CreateType("Integer")

	Type.Minimum = Minimum or MinimumInt
	Type.Maximum = Maximum or MaximumInt

	return Type
end

const function Bool(): ArgumentType
	return CreateType("Bool")
end

const function EntityArgument(Single: boolean, PlayersOnly: boolean): ArgumentType
	const Type = CreateType("Entity")

	Type.Single = Single
	Type.PlayersOnly = PlayersOnly

	return Type
end

const function GameMode(): ArgumentType
	return CreateType("GameMode")
end

const function Item(): ArgumentType
	return CreateType("Item")
end

const function ItemPredicate(): ArgumentType
	return CreateType("ItemPredicate")
end

const function MobEffect(): ArgumentType
	return CreateType("MobEffect")
end

const function ParseArgument(Type: ArgumentType, Reader: Reader, Source: Source): unknown
	const Kind = Type.Kind

	if Kind == "Integer" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Value = ReaderModule.ReadInt(Reader)

		if Value < Type.Minimum then
			Reader.Cursor = Start
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.integer.low", with = { Type.Minimum, Value } }, Reader)
		elseif Value > Type.Maximum then
			Reader.Cursor = Start
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.integer.big", with = { Type.Maximum, Value } }, Reader)
		end

		return Value
	elseif Kind == "Bool" then
		return ReaderModule.ReadBoolean(Reader)
	elseif Kind == "Entity" then
		return Selectors.ParseArgument(Reader, Type.Single, Type.PlayersOnly, Source.Permitted)
	elseif Kind == "GameMode" then
		const Name = ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)

		if not table.find(Minecraft.Protocol.GameModes, Name) then
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.gamemode.invalid", with = { Name } }, Reader)
		end

		return Name
	elseif Kind == "Item" then
		return ItemArguments.ParseItem(Reader)
	elseif Kind == "ItemPredicate" then
		return ItemArguments.ParsePredicate(Reader)
	end

	const Id = Identifier.Read(Reader)

	if not Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Id) then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.resource.not_found", with = { Id, MobEffectRegistry } }, Reader)
	end

	return Id
end

const function ParseLiteral(Node: Node, Reader: Reader)
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Length = utf8.len(Node.Name) :: number

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader, Length) and ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Start + Length) == Node.Name then
		Reader.Cursor = Start + Length

		if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) or ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Space then
			return
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start
	end

	ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.literal.incorrect", with = { Node.Name } }, Reader)
end

const function ParseChild(Child: Node, Reader: Reader, Context: Context)
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	if Child.Kind == "Literal" then
		ParseLiteral(Child, Reader)
	else
		Context.Arguments[Child.Name] = ParseArgument(Child.Type :: ArgumentType, Reader, Context.Source)
		table.insert(Context.Ranges, { Name = Child.Name, Start = Start, End = Reader.Cursor })
	end

	table.insert(Context.Nodes, { Node = Child, Start = Start, End = Reader.Cursor })
	Context.RangeStart = math.min(Context.RangeStart, Start)
	Context.RangeEnd = math.max(Context.RangeEnd, Reader.Cursor)
end

const function RelevantNodes(Node: Node, Reader: Reader): { Node }
	if next(Node.Literals) == nil then
		return Node.Arguments
	end

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Finish = Start

	while Finish < Reader.Length and Reader.Codepoints[Finish + 1] ~= Space do
		Finish += 1
	end

	const Found = Node.Literals[ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Finish)]

	return if Found then { Found } else Node.Arguments
end

const function CopyContext(Context: Context): Context
	return {
		Source = Context.Source,
		Root = Context.Root,
		Arguments = table.clone(Context.Arguments),
		Nodes = table.clone(Context.Nodes),
		Ranges = table.clone(Context.Ranges),
		RangeStart = Context.RangeStart,
		RangeEnd = Context.RangeEnd,
		Command = Context.Command,
		Owner = Context.Owner,
		Child = Context.Child,
	}
end

const function NewContext(Source: Source, Root: Node, Start: number): Context
	return {
		Source = Source,
		Root = Root,
		Arguments = {},
		Nodes = {},
		Ranges = {},
		RangeStart = Start,
		RangeEnd = Start,
		Command = nil,
		Owner = "",
		Child = nil,
	}
end

const function Rank(Result: ParseResult): number
	return (if ReaderModule.CanRead(Result.Reader) then 2 else 0) + (if #Result.Exceptions > 0 then 1 else 0)
end

const function ParseNodes(Node: Node, OriginalReader: Reader, ContextSoFar: Context): ParseResult
	const Source = ContextSoFar.Source
	const Exceptions: { Exception } = {}
	local Best: ParseResult? = nil

	for _, Child in RelevantNodes(Node, OriginalReader) do
		if Child.Restricted and not Source.Permitted then
			continue
		end

		const Context = CopyContext(ContextSoFar)
		const Reader = ReaderModule.Copy(OriginalReader)
		const Ok, Problem = pcall(ParseChild, Child, Reader, Context)
		local Raised: Exception? = nil

		if not Ok then
			Raised = if ReaderModule.IsException(Problem) then Problem :: Exception else ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = "command.exception", with = { tostring(Problem) } }, Reader)
		elseif ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= Space then
			Raised = ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = "command.expected.separator" }, Reader)
		end

		if Raised then
			table.insert(Exceptions, Raised)

			continue
		end

		Context.Command = Child.Command
		Context.Owner = Child.Owner

		local Result: ParseResult

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader, if Child.Redirect then 1 else 2) then
			ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)

			const Target = Child.Redirect

			if Target then
				const Redirected = ParseNodes(Target, Reader, NewContext(Source, Target, Reader.Cursor))

				Context.Child = Redirected.Context

				return { Context = Context, Reader = Redirected.Reader, Exceptions = Redirected.Exceptions }
			end

			Result = ParseNodes(Child, Reader, Context)
		else
			Result = { Context = Context, Reader = Reader, Exceptions = {} }
		end

		if not Best or Rank(Result) < Rank(Best) then
			Best = Result
		end
	end

	return Best or { Context = ContextSoFar, Reader = OriginalReader, Exceptions = Exceptions }
end

const function Parse(Root: Node, Line: string, Source: Source, Start: number?): ParseResult
	const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Line)

	Reader.Cursor = Start or 0

	return ParseNodes(Root, Reader, NewContext(Source, Root, Reader.Cursor))
end

const function LastChild(Context: Context): Context
	local Current = Context

	while Current.Child do
		Current = Current.Child
	end

	return Current
end

const function FindSuggestionContext(Context: Context, Cursor: number): (Node, number)
	if Context.RangeStart > Cursor then
		error("Can't find node before cursor")
	end

	if Context.RangeEnd < Cursor then
		if Context.Child then
			return FindSuggestionContext(Context.Child, Cursor)
		elseif #Context.Nodes > 0 then
			const Last = Context.Nodes[#Context.Nodes]

			return Last.Node, Last.End + 1
		end

		return Context.Root, Context.RangeStart
	end

	local Previous = Context.Root

	for _, Parsed in Context.Nodes do
		if Parsed.Start <= Cursor and Cursor <= Parsed.End then
			return Previous, Parsed.Start
		end

		Previous = Parsed.Node
	end

	return Previous, Context.RangeStart
end

const function CanUse(Node: Node, Source: Source): boolean
	return not Node.Restricted or Source.Permitted
end

const function ListSuggestions(Node: Node, Builder: Suggestions.Builder, Source: Source, Selected: string?): Suggestions.Suggestions
	if Node.Kind == "Literal" then
		if string.sub(string.lower(Node.Name), 1, #Builder.RemainingLowerCase) == Builder.RemainingLowerCase then
			Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, Node.Name)
		end

		return Suggestions.Build(Builder)
	end

	const Type = Node.Type :: ArgumentType
	const Kind = Type.Kind

	if Kind == "Bool" then
		for _, Value in { "true", "false" } do
			if string.sub(Value, 1, #Builder.RemainingLowerCase) == Builder.RemainingLowerCase then
				Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, Value)
			end
		end
	elseif Kind == "Entity" then
		return Selectors.Suggest(Builder, Source, Type.PlayersOnly, Selected)
	elseif Kind == "GameMode" then
		Suggestions.SuggestMatching(Builder, Minecraft.Protocol.GameModes)
	elseif Kind == "Item" then
		return ItemArguments.SuggestItem(Builder)
	elseif Kind == "ItemPredicate" then
		return ItemArguments.SuggestPredicate(Builder)
	elseif Kind == "MobEffect" then
		Suggestions.SuggestResource(Builder, Minecraft.Registry.MobEffectNames())
	end

	return Suggestions.Build(Builder)
end

const function CompletionSuggestions(Result: ParseResult, Line: string, Cursor: number, Selected: string?): Suggestions.Suggestions
	const Source = Result.Context.Source
	const Parent, StartPosition = FindSuggestionContext(Result.Context, Cursor)
	const Truncated = Suggestions.Substring(Line, 0, Cursor)
	const All: { Suggestions.Suggestions } = {}

	for _, Child in Parent.Children do
		if CanUse(Child, Source) then
			const Ok, Found = pcall(ListSuggestions, Child, Suggestions.Create(Truncated, math.min(StartPosition, Cursor)), Source, Selected)

			if Ok then
				table.insert(All, Found :: Suggestions.Suggestions)
			end
		end
	end

	return Suggestions.Merge(Line, All)
end

const function UsageText(Node: Node): string
	return if Node.Kind == "Argument" then `<{Node.Name}>` else Node.Name
end

const function NodeUsage(Node: Node, Source: Source, Optional: boolean, Deep: boolean): string?
	if not CanUse(Node, Source) then
		return nil
	end

	const Self = if Optional then `[{UsageText(Node)}]` else UsageText(Node)
	const ChildOptional = Node.Command ~= nil

	if Deep then
		return Self
	elseif Node.Redirect then
		return `{Self} -> {UsageText(Node.Redirect)}`
	end

	const Usable: { Node } = {}

	for _, Child in Node.Children do
		if CanUse(Child, Source) then
			table.insert(Usable, Child)
		end
	end

	if #Usable == 1 then
		const Usage = NodeUsage(Usable[1], Source, ChildOptional, ChildOptional)

		if Usage then
			return `{Self} {Usage}`
		end
	elseif #Usable > 1 then
		const Names: { string } = {}

		for _, Child in Usable do
			table.insert(Names, UsageText(Child))
		end

		return if ChildOptional then `{Self} [{table.concat(Names, "|")}]` else `{Self} ({table.concat(Names, "|")})`
	end

	return Self
end

const function SmartUsage(Node: Node, Source: Source): { { Node: Node, Usage: string } }
	const Result: { { Node: Node, Usage: string } } = {}
	const Optional = Node.Command ~= nil

	for _, Child in Node.Children do
		const Usage = NodeUsage(Child, Source, Optional, false)

		if Usage then
			table.insert(Result, { Node = Child, Usage = Usage })
		end
	end

	return Result
end

const function Report(Source: Source, Exception: Exception)
	SourceModule.SendFailure(Source, Exception.Message)

	const Input = Exception.Input

	if not Input or Exception.Cursor < 0 then
		return
	end

	const Line = ReaderModule.Create(Input)
	const Cursor = math.min(Line.Length, Exception.Cursor)
	const Parts: { unknown } = {}

	if Cursor > ContextLength then
		table.insert(Parts, "...")
	end

	table.insert(Parts, ReaderModule.Substring(Line, math.max(0, Cursor - ContextLength), Cursor))

	if Cursor < Line.Length then
		table.insert(Parts, { text = ReaderModule.Substring(Line, Cursor, Line.Length), color = "red", underlined = true })
	end

	table.insert(Parts, { translate = "command.context.here", color = "red", italic = true })
	SourceModule.SendFailure(Source, { text = "", color = "gray", extra = Parts })
end

const function Finish(Result: ParseResult, Source: Source): Context?
	local Problem: Exception? = nil

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Result.Reader) then
		if #Result.Exceptions == 1 then
			Problem = Result.Exceptions[1]
		else
			const Empty = Result.Context.RangeStart == Result.Context.RangeEnd

			Problem = ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = if Empty then "command.unknown.command" else "command.unknown.argument" }, Result.Reader)
		end
	else
		local Current = Result.Context

		while Current.Child do
			Current = Current.Child
		end

		if Current.Command then
			return Current
		end

		Problem = ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = "command.unknown.command" }, Result.Reader)
	end

	Report(Source, Problem :: Exception)

	return nil
end

return {
	ContextLength = ContextLength,
	Root = Root,
	Literal = Literal,
	Argument = Argument,
	Then = Then,
	Executes = Executes,
	Redirect = Redirect,
	Register = Register,
	Integer = Integer,
	Bool = Bool,
	Entity = EntityArgument,
	GameMode = GameMode,
	Item = Item,
	ItemPredicate = ItemPredicate,
	MobEffect = MobEffect,
	Parse = Parse,
	LastChild = LastChild,
	FindSuggestionContext = FindSuggestionContext,
	CompletionSuggestions = CompletionSuggestions,
	SmartUsage = SmartUsage,
	Finish = Finish,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Effect"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Living = require("../Living")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const Tracker = require("./Tracker")

const DefaultSeconds = 30
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const MaximumSeconds = 1000000
const MaximumAmplifier = 255

const function GiveBranch(Parent: Dispatcher.Node, Prefix: string)
	const Amplifier = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("amplifier", Dispatcher.Integer(0, MaximumAmplifier)), `{Prefix}Amplifier`)

	Dispatcher.Then(Amplifier, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("hideParticles", Dispatcher.Bool()), `{Prefix}Particles`))
	Dispatcher.Then(Parent, Amplifier)
end

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Seconds = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("seconds", Dispatcher.Integer(1, MaximumSeconds)), "Seconds")
	const Infinite = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("infinite"), "Infinite")
	const GiveEffect = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("effect", Dispatcher.MobEffect()), "Give")
	const ClearTargets = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("targets", Dispatcher.Entity(false, false)), "ClearTargets")
	const Clear = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("clear"), "ClearSelf")

	GiveBranch(Seconds, "Seconds")
	GiveBranch(Infinite, "Infinite")
	Dispatcher.Then(GiveEffect, Seconds)
	Dispatcher.Then(GiveEffect, Infinite)
	Dispatcher.Then(ClearTargets, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("effect", Dispatcher.MobEffect()), "ClearEffect"))
	Dispatcher.Then(Clear, ClearTargets)

	const Command = Dispatcher.Literal("effect")

	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Clear)
	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Literal("give"), Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Argument("targets", Dispatcher.Entity(false, false)), GiveEffect)))
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Command, "Effect")
end

const function Truncate(Value: number): number
	return if Value >= 0 then Value // 1 else -(-Value // 1)
end

const function GiveEffect(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Arguments = Context.Arguments
	const Id = Arguments.effect :: string
	const Effect = Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Id) :: Minecraft.MobEffect
	const Infinite = string.sub(Command, 1, 8) == "Infinite"
	const HasSeconds = string.sub(Command, 1, 7) == "Seconds"
	const Amplifier = if Command == "SecondsAmplifier" or Command == "SecondsParticles" or Command == "InfiniteAmplifier" or Command == "InfiniteParticles" then Arguments.amplifier :: number else 0
	const Particles = if Command == "SecondsParticles" or Command == "InfiniteParticles" then not (Arguments.hideParticles :: boolean) else true
	const Results = Tracker.Create()
	local Duration: number

	if Infinite then
		Duration = Minecraft.Effects.InfiniteDuration
	elseif HasSeconds then
		const Seconds = Arguments.seconds :: number

		Duration = if Effect.instantaneous then Seconds else Seconds * TicksPerSecond
	else
		Duration = if Effect.instantaneous then 1 else DefaultSeconds * TicksPerSecond
	end

	for _, Entity in Selectors.GetEntities(Arguments.targets :: Selectors.Selector, Source) do
		if not Entity.IsLiving then
			continue
		end

		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)
		const Changed = Player ~= nil and Living.AddEffect(Player, Minecraft.Effects.Create(Id, Duration, Amplifier, false, Particles))

		Tracker.Track(Results, Entity, if Changed then 1 else 0)
	end

	const Name = { translate = Effect.descriptionId }

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, "commands.effect.give.failed", "commands.effect.give.success.single", "commands.effect.give.success.multiple", { Name, 0, Truncate(Duration / TicksPerSecond) }, 2)
end

const function ClearEffects(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Arguments = Context.Arguments
	const Targets = if Command == "ClearSelf" then { Source.Entity :: Entities.Entity } else Selectors.GetEntities(Arguments.targets :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
	const Id = if Command == "ClearEffect" then Arguments.effect :: string else nil
	const Results = Tracker.Create()

	for _, Entity in Targets do
		if not Entity.IsLiving then
			continue
		end

		const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)
		local Changed = false

		if Player then
			Changed = if Id then Living.RemoveEffect(Player, Id) else Living.RemoveAllEffects(Player)
		end

		Tracker.Track(Results, Entity, if Changed then 1 else 0)
	end

	if Id then
		const Name = { translate = (Minecraft.Registry.MobEffect(Id) :: Minecraft.MobEffect).descriptionId }

		return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, "commands.effect.clear.specific.failed", "commands.effect.clear.specific.success.single", "commands.effect.clear.specific.success.multiple", { Name, 0 }, 2)
	end

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, "commands.effect.clear.everything.failed", "commands.effect.clear.everything.success.single", "commands.effect.clear.everything.success.multiple", { 0 }, 1)
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	if string.sub(Command, 1, 5) == "Clear" then
		return ClearEffects(Context, Command)
	end

	return GiveEffect(Context, Command)
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Experience"] = function(require)

const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const ExperienceRules = require("../Experience")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")
const Tracker = require("./Tracker")

const function Amounts(Action: string, Minimum: number?): Dispatcher.Node
	const Amount = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("amount", Dispatcher.Integer(Minimum)), `{Action}Points`)

	Dispatcher.Then(Amount, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("points"), `{Action}Points`))
	Dispatcher.Then(Amount, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("levels"), `{Action}Levels`))

	return Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Literal(string.lower(Action)), Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Argument("target", Dispatcher.Entity(false, true)), Amount))
end

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Query = Dispatcher.Argument("target", Dispatcher.Entity(true, true))
	const Command = Dispatcher.Literal("experience")

	Dispatcher.Then(Query, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("points"), "QueryPoints"))
	Dispatcher.Then(Query, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("levels"), "QueryLevels"))
	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Amounts("Add", nil))
	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Amounts("Set", 0))
	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Literal("query"), Query))
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Command, "Experience")
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Dispatcher.Redirect(Dispatcher.Literal("xp"), Command), "Experience")
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Arguments = Context.Arguments
	const Levels = string.sub(Command, -6) == "Levels"
	const Name = if Levels then "levels" else "points"

	if string.sub(Command, 1, 5) == "Query" then
		const Player = Selectors.GetPlayer(Arguments.target :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
		const Result = if Levels then Player.ExperienceLevel else ExperienceRules.PointsInLevel(Player)

		SourceModule.SendSuccess(Source, { translate = `commands.experience.query.{Name}`, with = { Entities.DisplayName(Player), Result } }, false)

		return Result
	end

	const Amount = Arguments.amount :: number
	const Adding = string.sub(Command, 1, 3) == "Add"
	const Results = Tracker.Create()

	for _, Player in Selectors.GetPlayers(Arguments.target :: Selectors.Selector, Source) do
		if Adding then
			if Levels then
				ExperienceRules.GiveLevels(Player, Amount)
			else
				ExperienceRules.GivePoints(Player, Amount)
			end

			Tracker.Track(Results, Player, 1)
		elseif Levels then
			ExperienceRules.SetLevels(Player, Amount)
			Tracker.Track(Results, Player, 1)
		else
			Tracker.Track(Results, Player, if ExperienceRules.SetPoints(Player, Amount) then 1 else 0)
		end
	end

	if Adding then
		return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, nil, `commands.experience.add.{Name}.success.single`, `commands.experience.add.{Name}.success.multiple`, { Amount, 0 }, 2)
	end

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, "commands.experience.set.points.invalid", `commands.experience.set.{Name}.success.single`, `commands.experience.set.{Name}.success.multiple`, { Amount, 0 }, 2)
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/GameMode"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const Players = require("../Players")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Mode = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("gamemode", Dispatcher.GameMode()), "Self")

	Dispatcher.Then(Mode, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("target", Dispatcher.Entity(false, true)), "Targets"))
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Literal("gamemode"), Mode), "GameMode")
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const GameMode = Context.Arguments.gamemode :: Minecraft.GameMode
	const Targets = if Command == "Self" then { Source.Entity } else Selectors.GetPlayers(Context.Arguments.target :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
	const Mode = { translate = `gameMode.{GameMode}` }
	local Count = 0

	for _, Player in Targets do
		if not Players.SetGameMode(Player, GameMode) then
			continue
		end

		if Source.Entity == Player then
			SourceModule.SendSuccess(Source, { translate = "commands.gamemode.success.self", with = { Mode } }, true)
		else
			SourceModule.SendSystemMessage(Player.Player, { translate = "gameMode.changed", with = { Mode } })
			SourceModule.SendSuccess(Source, { translate = "commands.gamemode.success.other", with = { Entities.DisplayName(Player), Mode } }, true)
		end

		Count += 1
	end

	return Count
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Give"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const ItemArguments = require("./ItemArguments")
const ItemEntities = require("../ItemEntities")
const Reader = require("./Reader")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const Sounds = require("../Sounds")
const Tracker = require("./Tracker")

const Items = Minecraft.Items

const MaximumStacks = 100

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Item = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("item", Dispatcher.Item()), "Default")

	Dispatcher.Then(Item, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("count", Dispatcher.Integer(1)), "Count"))
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Literal("give"), Dispatcher.Then(Dispatcher.Argument("targets", Dispatcher.Entity(false, true)), Item)), "Give")
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Input = Context.Arguments.item :: ItemArguments.ItemInput
	const Players = Selectors.GetPlayers(Context.Arguments.targets :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
	const Count = if Command == "Count" then Context.Arguments.count :: number else 1
	const Prototype = ItemArguments.CreateStack(Input, 1)
	const MaxStackSize = Items.MaxStackSize(Prototype)
	const MaxAllowed = MaxStackSize * MaximumStacks
	const Results = Tracker.Create()

	if Count > MaxAllowed then
		Reader.Fail({ translate = "commands.give.failed.toomanyitems", with = { MaxAllowed, Items.GetDisplayName(Prototype) } })
	end

	for _, Player in Players do
		local Remaining = Count

		while Remaining > 0 do
			const Size = math.min(MaxStackSize, Remaining)
			const Given = Items.CopyWithCount(Prototype, Size)

			Remaining -= Size

			if Minecraft.Inventory.Add(Player.Inventory, Given, Player.Abilities.Instabuild) and Items.IsEmpty(Given) then
				const Fake = ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Player, Items.Copy(Prototype), false)

				if Fake then
					ItemEntities.MakeFake(Fake)
				end

				Sounds.Play(nil, Player.Position, "entity.item.pickup", 0.2, ((Player.Random:NextNumber() - Player.Random:NextNumber()) * 0.7 + 1) * 2)
			else
				const Drop = ItemEntities.CreateDrop(Player, Given, false)

				if Drop then
					ItemEntities.AllowOnly(Drop, Player.Player)
				end
			end
		end

		Tracker.Track(Results, Player, 1)
	end

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, nil, "commands.give.success.single", "commands.give.success.multiple", { Count, Items.GetDisplayName(Prototype), 0 }, 3)
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Identifier"] = function(require)

const Reader = require("./Reader")

const DefaultNamespace = "minecraft"

const function IsAllowed(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Reader.IsDigit(Codepoint)
		or (Codepoint >= 97 and Codepoint <= 122)
		or Codepoint == 95
		or Codepoint == 58
		or Codepoint == 47
		or Codepoint == 46
		or Codepoint == 45
end

const function Parse(Raw: string): string?
	const Separator = string.find(Raw, ":", 1, true)
	const Namespace = if Separator and Separator > 1 then string.sub(Raw, 1, Separator - 1) else DefaultNamespace
	const Path = if Separator then string.sub(Raw, Separator + 1) else Raw

	if not string.match(Namespace, "^[a-z0-9_.%-]*$") or not string.match(Path, "^[a-z0-9/._%-]*$") then
		return nil
	end

	return `{Namespace}:{Path}`
end

const function ReadRaw(Source: Reader.Reader): string
	const Start = Source.Cursor

	while Reader.CanRead(Source) and IsAllowed(Reader.Peek(Source)) do
		Reader.Skip(Source)
	end

	return Reader.Substring(Source, Start, Source.Cursor)
end

const function Read(Source: Reader.Reader): string
	const Start = Source.Cursor
	const Parsed = Parse(ReadRaw(Source))

	if not Parsed then
		Source.Cursor = Start
		Reader.Fail({ translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, Source)
	end

	return Parsed :: string
end

const function ReadNonEmpty(Source: Reader.Reader): string
	const Start = Source.Cursor
	const Raw = ReadRaw(Source)

	if Raw == "" then
		Reader.Fail({ translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, Source)
	end

	const Parsed = Parse(Raw)

	if not Parsed then
		Source.Cursor = Start
		Reader.Fail({ translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, Source)
	end

	return Parsed :: string
end

return {
	Parse = Parse,
	Read = Read,
	ReadNonEmpty = ReadNonEmpty,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/ItemArguments"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Identifier = require("./Identifier")
const Packrat = require("./Packrat")
const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")
const Snbt = require("./Snbt")
const Suggestions = require("./Suggestions")

const Items = Minecraft.Items
const Registry = Minecraft.Registry

const OpenBracket = 91
const CloseBracket = 93
const Comma = 44
const Equals = 61
const Exclamation = 33
const CountId = "minecraft:count"
const ItemRegistry = "minecraft:item"
const EnchantmentRegistry = "minecraft:enchantment"
const MinimumEnchantmentLevel = 1
const MaximumEnchantmentLevel = 255
const PotionRegistry = "minecraft:potion"

const TransientComponents: { [string]: true } = {
	["minecraft:creative_slot_lock"] = true,
	["minecraft:additional_trade_cost"] = true,
	["minecraft:map_post_processing"] = true,
}

const PredicateTypes: { [string]: boolean } = {
	["minecraft:damage"] = true,
	["minecraft:enchantments"] = true,
	["minecraft:stored_enchantments"] = true,
	["minecraft:potion_contents"] = true,
	["minecraft:custom_data"] = true,
	["minecraft:container"] = false,
	["minecraft:bundle_contents"] = false,
	["minecraft:firework_explosion"] = false,
	["minecraft:fireworks"] = false,
	["minecraft:writable_book_content"] = false,
	["minecraft:written_book_content"] = false,
	["minecraft:attribute_modifiers"] = false,
	["minecraft:trim"] = false,
	["minecraft:jukebox_playable"] = false,
	["minecraft:villager/variant"] = false,
}

type Reader = ReaderModule.Reader
type State = Packrat.State

type Bounds = {
	Min: number?,
	Max: number?,
}

type InstancePredicate = {
	Amplifier: Bounds,
	Duration: Bounds,
	Ambient: boolean?,
	Visible: boolean?,
}

type EffectsPredicate = { [string]: InstancePredicate }

type EffectCollection = {
	Contains: { EffectsPredicate }?,
	Counts: { { Test: EffectsPredicate, Count: Bounds } }?,
	Size: Bounds?,
}

type EnchantmentPredicate = {
	Enchantments: { string }?,
	Levels: Bounds?,
}

type TestKind = "Always" | "Item" | "Tag" | "Not" | "AnyOf" | "AllOf" | "Present" | "Equals" | "Count" | "Damage" | "Enchantments" | "Potions" | "CustomData"

export type Test = {
	Kind: TestKind,
	Id: string,
	Value: unknown,
	Children: { Test },
	Bounds: Bounds,
	DamageBounds: Bounds,
	Enchantments: { EnchantmentPredicate },
	Potions: { string }?,
	Effects: EffectCollection?,
}

type ItemSuggestion = "Item" | "StartComponents" | "Nothing" | "AssignmentOrRemoval" | "Component" | "Assignment" | "NextOrEnd"

type Tracker = {
	Kind: ItemSuggestion,
}

type LookupKind = "Component" | "CountComponent" | "Predicate" | "CountPredicate" | "Existence"

type Lookup = {
	Kind: LookupKind,
	Id: string,
}

export type ItemInput = {
	Item: Minecraft.Item,
	Patch: Minecraft.ItemPatch,
}

const AnyBounds: Bounds = {}
const ItemIds: { string } = {}
const ComponentIds: { string } = {}
const ComponentLookupIds: { string } = { CountId }
const PredicateLookupIds: { string } = { CountId }

for _, Item in Registry.Items do
	table.insert(ItemIds, Item.Id)
end

for _, Name in Registry.ComponentTypeNames() do
	if not TransientComponents[Name] then
		table.insert(ComponentIds, Name)
		table.insert(ComponentLookupIds, Name)
	end
end

for Name in PredicateTypes do
	table.insert(PredicateLookupIds, Name)
end

const ItemSupplier: Packrat.Supplier = { Values = ItemIds, Resource = true }
const TagSupplier: Packrat.Supplier = { Values = Registry.TagNames(ItemRegistry), Resource = true }
const ComponentSupplier: Packrat.Supplier = { Values = ComponentLookupIds, Resource = true }
const PredicateSupplier: Packrat.Supplier = { Values = PredicateLookupIds, Resource = true }

const function NewTest(Kind: TestKind, Id: string?): Test
	return {
		Kind = Kind,
		Id = Id or "",
		Value = nil,
		Children = {},
		Bounds = AnyBounds,
		DamageBounds = AnyBounds,
		Enchantments = {},
		Potions = nil,
		Effects = nil,
	}
end

const Any = NewTest("Always")

const function Describe(Value: unknown): string
	return if type(Value) == "string" then `"{Value}"` else tostring(Value)
end

const function Truncate(Value: number): number
	return if Value >= 0 then Value // 1 else -(-Value // 1)
end

const function DecodeInt(Value: unknown): (number?, string?)
	if type(Value) == "number" then
		return Truncate(Value), nil
	end

	return nil, `Not a number: {Describe(Value)}`
end

const function DecodeInts(Value: unknown): (Bounds?, string?)
	if type(Value) == "number" then
		const Exact = Truncate(Value)

		return { Min = Exact, Max = Exact }, nil
	elseif type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `Not a number or a map: {Describe(Value)}`
	end

	const Fields = Value :: { min: unknown?, max: unknown? }
	local Min: number? = nil
	local Max: number? = nil

	if Fields.min ~= nil then
		const Decoded, Problem = DecodeInt(Fields.min)

		if not Decoded then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		Min = Decoded
	end

	if Fields.max ~= nil then
		const Decoded, Problem = DecodeInt(Fields.max)

		if not Decoded then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		Max = Decoded
	end

	if Min and Max and Min > Max then
		return nil, `Swapped bounds in range: {Min} is higher than {Max}`
	end

	return { Min = Min, Max = Max }, nil
end

const function DecodeOptionalInts(Fields: { [string]: unknown }, Name: string): (Bounds?, string?)
	if Fields[Name] == nil then
		return AnyBounds, nil
	end

	return DecodeInts(Fields[Name])
end

const function DecodeHolder(Text: unknown, RegistryName: string, Exists: (string) -> boolean): (string?, string?)
	const Id = if type(Text) == "string" then Identifier.Parse(Text) else nil

	if not Id then
		return nil, `Not a valid resource location: {Describe(Text)}`
	elseif not Exists(Id) then
		return nil, `Unknown element in {RegistryName}: {Id}`
	end

	return Id, nil
end

const function DecodeHolderSet(Value: unknown, RegistryName: string, Exists: (string) -> boolean): ({ string }?, string?)
	if type(Value) == "string" and string.sub(Value, 1, 1) == "#" then
		const Tag = Identifier.Parse(string.sub(Value, 2))

		if not Tag or not Registry.IsTag(RegistryName, Tag) then
			return nil, `Missing tag: {Value} in {RegistryName}`
		end

		return Registry.TagMembers(RegistryName, Tag), nil
	elseif type(Value) == "string" then
		const Id, Problem = DecodeHolder(Value, RegistryName, Exists)

		return if Id then { Id } else nil, Problem
	elseif type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `Not a holder set: {Describe(Value)}`
	end

	const Members: { string } = {}

	for _, Element in Value :: { unknown } do
		const Id, Problem = DecodeHolder(Element, RegistryName, Exists)

		if not Id then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		table.insert(Members, Id)
	end

	return Members, nil
end

const function EnchantmentExists(Id: string): boolean
	return Registry.Enchantment(Id) ~= nil
end

const function PotionExists(Id: string): boolean
	return Registry.Potion(Id) ~= nil
end

const function EffectExists(Id: string): boolean
	return Registry.MobEffect(Id) ~= nil
end

const function DecodeMap(Value: unknown): ({ [string]: unknown }?, string?)
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `Not a map: {Describe(Value)}`
	end

	return Value :: { [string]: unknown }, nil
end

const function DecodeList(Value: unknown): ({ unknown }?, string?)
	if type(Value) ~= "table" or (#(Value :: { unknown }) == 0 and next(Value :: { [unknown]: unknown }) ~= nil) then
		return nil, `Not a list: {Describe(Value)}`
	end

	return Value :: { unknown }, nil
end

const function DecodeEnchantments(Test: Test, Value: unknown): string?
	const List, Problem = DecodeList(Value)

	if not List then
		return Problem
	end

	for _, Element in List do
		const Fields, MapProblem = DecodeMap(Element)

		if not Fields then
			return MapProblem
		end

		const Predicate: EnchantmentPredicate = { Enchantments = nil, Levels = nil }

		if Fields.enchantments ~= nil then
			const Set, SetProblem = DecodeHolderSet(Fields.enchantments, EnchantmentRegistry, EnchantmentExists)

			if not Set then
				return SetProblem
			end

			Predicate.Enchantments = Set
		end

		if Fields.levels ~= nil then
			const Levels, LevelsProblem = DecodeInts(Fields.levels)

			if not Levels then
				return LevelsProblem
			end

			Predicate.Levels = Levels
		end

		table.insert(Test.Enchantments, Predicate)
	end

	return nil
end

const function DecodeEnchantmentLevels(Value: unknown): ({ [string]: number }?, string?)
	const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

	if not Fields then
		return nil, Problem
	end

	const Levels: { [string]: number } = {}

	for Key, Level in Fields do
		const Id, KeyProblem = DecodeHolder(Key, EnchantmentRegistry, EnchantmentExists)

		if not Id then
			return nil, KeyProblem
		end

		const Decoded, LevelProblem = DecodeInt(Level)

		if not Decoded then
			return nil, LevelProblem
		elseif Decoded < MinimumEnchantmentLevel or Decoded > MaximumEnchantmentLevel then
			return nil, `Value {Decoded} outside of range [{MinimumEnchantmentLevel}:{MaximumEnchantmentLevel}]`
		end

		Levels[Id] = Decoded
	end

	return Levels, nil
end

const function DecodeComponentValue(Type: string, Value: unknown): (unknown, string?)
	if Type == "minecraft:enchantments" or Type == "minecraft:stored_enchantments" then
		return DecodeEnchantmentLevels(Value)
	end

	return Value, nil
end

const function ReadComponentType(Reader: Reader): string
	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.component.expected" }, Reader)
	end

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = Identifier.Read(Reader)

	if not Registry.IsComponentType(Id) or TransientComponents[Id] then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.component.unknown", with = { Id } }, Reader)
	end

	return Id
end

const function ReadComponents(Reader: Reader, Patch: Minecraft.ItemPatch, Tracker: Tracker)
	const Visited: { [string]: true } = {}

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, OpenBracket)
	Tracker.Kind = "AssignmentOrRemoval"

	while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBracket do
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		const Removing = ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Exclamation

		if Removing then
			ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
			Tracker.Kind = "Component"
		end

		const Type = ReadComponentType(Reader)

		if Visited[Type] then
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.component.repeated", with = { Type } })
		end

		Visited[Type] = true

		if Removing then
			Patch[Type] = Items.Removed
			Tracker.Kind = "Nothing"
		else
			Tracker.Kind = "Assignment"
			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
			ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, Equals)
			Tracker.Kind = "Nothing"
			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

			const ValueStart = Reader.Cursor
			const Decoded, Problem = DecodeComponentValue(Type, Snbt.Parse(Reader))

			if Problem then
				Reader.Cursor = ValueStart
				ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.component.malformed", with = { Type, Problem } }, Reader)
			end

			Patch[Type] = Decoded
		end

		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Tracker.Kind = "NextOrEnd"

		if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) or ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= Comma then
			break
		end

		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Tracker.Kind = "AssignmentOrRemoval"

		if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.component.expected" }, Reader)
		end
	end

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, CloseBracket)
	Tracker.Kind = "Nothing"
end

const function ParseItemParts(Reader: Reader, Tracker: Tracker): ItemInput
	Tracker.Kind = "Item"

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = Identifier.Read(Reader)
	const Item = Registry.FindItem(Id)

	if not Item then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.item.id.invalid", with = { Id } }, Reader)
	end

	const Patch: Minecraft.ItemPatch = {}

	Tracker.Kind = "StartComponents"

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == OpenBracket then
		Tracker.Kind = "Nothing"
		ReadComponents(Reader, Patch, Tracker)
	end

	return { Item = Item :: Minecraft.Item, Patch = Patch }
end

const function ParseItem(Reader: Reader): ItemInput
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Ok, Result = pcall(ParseItemParts, Reader, { Kind = "Nothing" } :: Tracker)

	if not Ok then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		error(Result, 0)
	end

	return Result :: ItemInput
end

const function CreateStack(Input: ItemInput, Count: number): Minecraft.ItemStack
	const Stack = Items.FromPatch(Input.Item, Count, Input.Patch)
	const MaxStackSize = Items.MaxStackSize(Stack)

	if Count > MaxStackSize then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "arguments.item.overstacked", with = { Input.Item.Id, MaxStackSize } })
	end

	return Stack
end

const function DecodeEffectsPredicate(Value: unknown): (EffectsPredicate?, string?)
	const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

	if not Fields then
		return nil, Problem
	end

	const Predicate: EffectsPredicate = {}

	for Key, Entry in Fields do
		const Id, IdProblem = DecodeHolder(Key, "minecraft:mob_effect", EffectExists)

		if not Id then
			return nil, IdProblem
		end

		const EntryFields, EntryProblem = DecodeMap(Entry)

		if not EntryFields then
			return nil, EntryProblem
		end

		const Amplifier, AmplifierProblem = DecodeOptionalInts(EntryFields, "amplifier")
		const Duration, DurationProblem = DecodeOptionalInts(EntryFields, "duration")

		if not Amplifier or not Duration then
			return nil, AmplifierProblem or DurationProblem
		end

		const Ambient = EntryFields.ambient
		const Visible = EntryFields.visible

		if (Ambient ~= nil and type(Ambient) ~= "boolean") or (Visible ~= nil and type(Visible) ~= "boolean") then
			return nil, `Not a boolean: {Describe(if type(Ambient) ~= "boolean" then Ambient else Visible)}`
		end

		Predicate[Id] = { Amplifier = Amplifier, Duration = Duration, Ambient = Ambient :: boolean?, Visible = Visible :: boolean? }
	end

	return Predicate, nil
end

const function DecodeEffectCollection(Value: unknown): (EffectCollection?, string?)
	const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

	if not Fields then
		return nil, Problem
	end

	const Collection: EffectCollection = { Contains = nil, Counts = nil, Size = nil }

	if Fields.contains ~= nil then
		const List, ListProblem = DecodeList(Fields.contains)

		if not List then
			return nil, ListProblem
		end

		const Contains: { EffectsPredicate } = {}

		for _, Element in List do
			const Predicate, PredicateProblem = DecodeEffectsPredicate(Element)

			if not Predicate then
				return nil, PredicateProblem
			end

			table.insert(Contains, Predicate)
		end

		Collection.Contains = Contains
	end

	if Fields.count ~= nil then
		const List, ListProblem = DecodeList(Fields.count)

		if not List then
			return nil, ListProblem
		end

		const Counts: { { Test: EffectsPredicate, Count: Bounds } } = {}

		for _, Element in List do
			const EntryFields, EntryProblem = DecodeMap(Element)

			if not EntryFields then
				return nil, EntryProblem
			elseif EntryFields.test == nil then
				return nil, "No key test in MapLike"
			elseif EntryFields.count == nil then
				return nil, "No key count in MapLike"
			end

			const Predicate, PredicateProblem = DecodeEffectsPredicate(EntryFields.test)
			const Count, CountProblem = DecodeInts(EntryFields.count)

			if not Predicate or not Count then
				return nil, PredicateProblem or CountProblem
			end

			table.insert(Counts, { Test = Predicate, Count = Count })
		end

		Collection.Counts = Counts
	end

	if Fields.size ~= nil then
		const Size, SizeProblem = DecodeInts(Fields.size)

		if not Size then
			return nil, SizeProblem
		end

		Collection.Size = Size
	end

	return Collection, nil
end

const function DecodeCustomData(Value: unknown): (unknown, string?)
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Value)
		const Ok, Result = pcall(Snbt.Parse, Reader)

		if not Ok then
			if not ReaderModule.IsException(Result) then
				error(Result, 0)
			end

			return nil, Minecraft.Language.PlainText((Result :: ReaderModule.Exception).Message)
		end

		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
			return nil, Minecraft.Language.PlainText({ translate = "argument.nbt.trailing" })
		elseif type(Result) ~= "table" then
			return nil, `Expected compound tag, got {Describe(Result)}`
		end

		return Result, nil
	elseif type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `Not a map: {Describe(Value)}`
	end

	return Value, nil
end

const function DecodePredicate(Id: string, Value: unknown): (Test?, string?)
	if Id == "minecraft:damage" then
		const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

		if not Fields then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		const Test = NewTest("Damage")
		const Durability, DurabilityProblem = DecodeOptionalInts(Fields, "durability")
		const Damage, DamageProblem = DecodeOptionalInts(Fields, "damage")

		if not Durability or not Damage then
			return nil, DurabilityProblem or DamageProblem
		end

		Test.Bounds = Durability
		Test.DamageBounds = Damage

		return Test, nil
	elseif Id == "minecraft:enchantments" or Id == "minecraft:stored_enchantments" then
		const Test = NewTest("Enchantments", Id)
		const Problem = DecodeEnchantments(Test, Value)

		return if Problem then nil else Test, Problem
	elseif Id == "minecraft:potion_contents" then
		const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

		if not Fields then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		const Test = NewTest("Potions")

		if Fields.potions ~= nil then
			const Set, SetProblem = DecodeHolderSet(Fields.potions, PotionRegistry, PotionExists)

			if not Set then
				return nil, SetProblem
			end

			Test.Potions = Set
		end

		if Fields.effects ~= nil then
			const Collection, CollectionProblem = DecodeEffectCollection(Fields.effects)

			if not Collection then
				return nil, CollectionProblem
			end

			Test.Effects = Collection
		end

		return Test, nil
	elseif Id == "minecraft:custom_data" then
		const Compound, Problem = DecodeCustomData(Value)

		if Problem then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		const Test = NewTest("CustomData")

		Test.Value = Compound

		return Test, nil
	end

	return nil, `The {Id} predicate is not supported in this port`
end

const function IdRule(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Ok, Result = pcall(Identifier.ReadNonEmpty, Reader)

	if not Ok then
		if not ReaderModule.IsException(Result) then
			error(Result, 0)
		end

		return nil
	end

	return Result :: string
end

const function LookupFailure(State: State, Mark: number, Key: string, Id: string, Supplier: Packrat.Supplier)
	Packrat.StoreException(State, Mark, ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = Key, with = { Id } }, State.Reader), Supplier)
end

const function ElementType(State: State): Test?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = IdRule(State)

	if not Id then
		Packrat.Store(State, Mark, { translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, ItemSupplier)

		return nil
	elseif not Registry.FindItem(Id) then
		LookupFailure(State, Mark, "argument.item.id.invalid", Id, ItemSupplier)

		return nil
	end

	return NewTest("Item", Id)
end

const function TagType(State: State): Test?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = IdRule(State)

	if not Id then
		Packrat.Store(State, Mark, { translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, TagSupplier)

		return nil
	elseif not Registry.IsTag(ItemRegistry, Id) then
		LookupFailure(State, Mark, "arguments.item.tag.unknown", Id, TagSupplier)

		return nil
	end

	return NewTest("Tag", Id)
end

const function TypeRule(State: State): (boolean, Test?)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Element = ElementType(State)

	if Element then
		return true, Element
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "#") then
		const Tag = TagType(State)

		if Tag then
			return true, Tag
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return false, nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "*") then
		return true, nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return false, nil
end

const function ComponentType(State: State): Lookup?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = IdRule(State)

	if not Id then
		Packrat.Store(State, Mark, { translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, ComponentSupplier)

		return nil
	elseif Id == CountId then
		return { Kind = "CountComponent", Id = Id }
	elseif not Registry.IsComponentType(Id) or TransientComponents[Id] then
		LookupFailure(State, Mark, "arguments.item.component.unknown", Id, ComponentSupplier)

		return nil
	end

	return { Kind = "Component", Id = Id }
end

const function PredicateType(State: State): Lookup?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Id = IdRule(State)

	if not Id then
		Packrat.Store(State, Mark, { translate = "argument.id.invalid" }, PredicateSupplier)

		return nil
	elseif Id == CountId then
		return { Kind = "CountPredicate", Id = Id }
	elseif PredicateTypes[Id] ~= nil then
		return { Kind = "Predicate", Id = Id }
	elseif Registry.IsComponentType(Id) then
		return { Kind = "Existence", Id = Id }
	end

	LookupFailure(State, Mark, "arguments.item.predicate.unknown", Id, PredicateSupplier)

	return nil
end

const function TagValue(State: State): (boolean, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Ok, Result = pcall(Snbt.Parse, Reader)

	if not Ok then
		if not ReaderModule.IsException(Result) then
			error(Result, 0)
		end

		Packrat.StoreException(State, Mark, Result :: ReaderModule.Exception)
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return false, nil
	end

	return true, Result
end

const function BuildTest(Lookup: Lookup, HasValue: boolean, Value: unknown): (Test?, unknown)
	const Kind = Lookup.Kind
	const IsPredicate = Kind == "Predicate" or Kind == "CountPredicate" or Kind == "Existence"
	const MalformedKey = if IsPredicate then "arguments.item.predicate.malformed" else "arguments.item.component.malformed"

	if not HasValue then
		return if Kind == "CountComponent" then NewTest("Always") else NewTest("Present", Lookup.Id), nil
	elseif Kind == "Component" then
		const Decoded, Problem = DecodeComponentValue(Lookup.Id, Value)

		if Problem then
			return nil, { translate = MalformedKey, with = { Lookup.Id, Problem } }
		end

		const Test = NewTest("Equals", Lookup.Id)

		Test.Value = Decoded

		return Test, nil
	elseif Kind == "CountComponent" or Kind == "CountPredicate" then
		const Count, Problem = DecodeInts(Value)

		if not Count then
			return nil, { translate = MalformedKey, with = { Lookup.Id, Problem } }
		end

		const Test = NewTest("Count")

		Test.Bounds = Count

		return Test, nil
	elseif Kind == "Existence" then
		const Fields, Problem = DecodeMap(Value)

		if not Fields then
			return nil, { translate = MalformedKey, with = { Lookup.Id, Problem } }
		end

		return NewTest("Present", Lookup.Id), nil
	end

	const Test, Problem = DecodePredicate(Lookup.Id, Value)

	if not Test then
		return nil, { translate = MalformedKey, with = { Lookup.Id, Problem } }
	end

	return Test, nil
end

const function TestRule(State: State): Test?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	local Found: Lookup? = nil
	local HasValue = false
	local Value: unknown = nil

	const Component = ComponentType(State)

	if Component and Packrat.Character(State, "=") then
		const Ok, Parsed = TagValue(State)

		if not Ok then
			Reader.Cursor = Mark

			return nil
		end

		Found, HasValue, Value = Component, true, Parsed
	end

	if not Found then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		const Predicate = PredicateType(State)

		if Predicate and Packrat.Character(State, "~") then
			const Ok, Parsed = TagValue(State)

			if not Ok then
				Reader.Cursor = Mark

				return nil
			end

			Found, HasValue, Value = Predicate, true, Parsed
		end
	end

	if not Found then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark
		Found = ComponentType(State)
	end

	if not Found then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return nil
	end

	const Test, Malformed = BuildTest(Found, HasValue, Value)

	if not Test then
		Packrat.StoreException(State, Reader.Cursor, ReaderModule.NewException(Malformed, Reader))
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return nil
	end

	return Test
end

const function TermRule(State: State): Test?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Test = TestRule(State)

	if Test then
		return Test
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "!") then
		const Negated = TestRule(State)

		if Negated then
			const Not = NewTest("Not")

			table.insert(Not.Children, Negated)

			return Not
		end
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return nil
end

const function AlternativesRule(State: State, Into: { Test }): boolean
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const Term = TermRule(State)

	if not Term then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return false
	end

	table.insert(Into, Term)

	const Rest = Reader.Cursor
	const Count = #Into

	if Packrat.Character(State, "|") and AlternativesRule(State, Into) then
		return true
	end

	for Index = #Into, Count + 1, -1 do
		Into[Index] = nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Rest

	return true
end

const function ConditionsRule(State: State, Into: { Test }): boolean
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	const AnyOf = NewTest("AnyOf")

	if not AlternativesRule(State, AnyOf.Children) then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return false
	end

	table.insert(Into, AnyOf)

	const Rest = Reader.Cursor
	const Count = #Into

	if Packrat.Character(State, ",") and ConditionsRule(State, Into) then
		return true
	end

	for Index = #Into, Count + 1, -1 do
		Into[Index] = nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Rest

	return true
end

const function TopRule(State: State): Test?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const All = NewTest("AllOf")
	const Ok, Type = TypeRule(State)

	if Ok and Packrat.Character(State, "[") then
		if Type then
			table.insert(All.Children, Type)
		end

		const Conditions = Reader.Cursor

		if not ConditionsRule(State, All.Children) then
			Reader.Cursor = Conditions
		end

		if Packrat.Character(State, "]") then
			return All
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Start

	const Matched, Alone = TypeRule(State)

	if not Matched then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil
	end

	if Alone then
		table.insert(All.Children, Alone)
	end

	return All
end

const function ParsePredicate(Reader: Reader): Test
	const State = Packrat.Create(Reader)
	const Test = TopRule(State)

	if not Test then
		Packrat.Fail(State)
	end

	return Test :: Test
end

const function SuggestPredicate(Builder: Suggestions.Builder): Suggestions.Suggestions
	const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Builder.Input)

	Reader.Cursor = Builder.Start

	const State = Packrat.Create(Reader)

	if TopRule(State) then
		Packrat.Finish(State, Reader.Cursor)
	end

	return Packrat.Suggest(State, Builder)
end

const function SuggestComponents(Builder: Suggestions.Builder, Suffix: string)
	for _, Id in ComponentIds do
		if Suggestions.ResourceMatches(Builder.RemainingLowerCase, Id) then
			Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, `{Id}{Suffix}`)
		end
	end
end

const function SuggestItem(Builder: Suggestions.Builder): Suggestions.Suggestions
	const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Builder.Input)
	const Tracker: Tracker = { Kind = "Nothing" }

	Reader.Cursor = Builder.Start
	pcall(ParseItemParts, Reader, Tracker)

	const Offset = Suggestions.CreateOffset(Builder, Reader.Cursor)
	const Kind = Tracker.Kind
	const Empty = Offset.Remaining == ""

	if Kind == "Item" then
		Suggestions.SuggestResource(Offset, ItemIds)
	elseif Kind == "StartComponents" and Empty then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "[")
	elseif Kind == "AssignmentOrRemoval" then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "!")
		SuggestComponents(Offset, "=")
	elseif Kind == "Component" then
		SuggestComponents(Offset, "")
	elseif Kind == "Assignment" and Empty then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "=")
	elseif Kind == "NextOrEnd" and Empty then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, ",")
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "]")
	end

	return Suggestions.Build(Offset)
end

const function InBounds(Range: Bounds, Value: number): boolean
	return (Range.Min == nil or Range.Min <= Value) and (Range.Max == nil or Range.Max >= Value)
end

const function MatchesInstance(Predicate: InstancePredicate, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): boolean
	return InBounds(Predicate.Amplifier, Effect.Amplifier)
		and InBounds(Predicate.Duration, Effect.Duration)
		and (Predicate.Ambient == nil or Predicate.Ambient == Effect.Ambient)
		and (Predicate.Visible == nil or Predicate.Visible == Effect.Visible)
end

const function MatchesEffect(Predicate: EffectsPredicate, Effect: Minecraft.EffectInstance): boolean
	const Instance = Predicate[Effect.Id]

	return Instance ~= nil and MatchesInstance(Instance, Effect)
end

const function MatchesCollection(Collection: EffectCollection, Effects: { Minecraft.EffectInstance }): boolean
	if Collection.Contains and #Collection.Contains > 0 then
		const Remaining = table.clone(Collection.Contains)

		for _, Effect in Effects do
			for Index = #Remaining, 1, -1 do
				if MatchesEffect(Remaining[Index], Effect) then
					table.remove(Remaining, Index)
				end
			end

			if #Remaining == 0 then
				break
			end
		end

		if #Remaining > 0 then
			return false
		end
	end

	if Collection.Counts then
		for _, Entry in Collection.Counts do
			local Count = 0

			for _, Effect in Effects do
				if MatchesEffect(Entry.Test, Effect) then
					Count += 1
				end
			end

			if not InBounds(Entry.Count, Count) then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return Collection.Size == nil or InBounds(Collection.Size, #Effects)
end

const function MatchesEnchantment(Predicate: EnchantmentPredicate, Applied: { [string]: number }): boolean
	if Predicate.Enchantments then
		for _, Id in Predicate.Enchantments do
			const Level = Applied[Id] or 0

			if Level ~= 0 and (Predicate.Levels == nil or InBounds(Predicate.Levels, Level)) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	elseif Predicate.Levels then
		for _, Level in Applied do
			if InBounds(Predicate.Levels, Level) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	return next(Applied) ~= nil
end

const function CompareNbt(Expected: unknown, Actual: unknown): boolean
	if Expected == Actual or Expected == nil then
		return true
	elseif Actual == nil or type(Expected) ~= type(Actual) then
		return false
	elseif type(Expected) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	const ExpectedTable = Expected :: { [unknown]: unknown }
	const ActualTable = Actual :: { [unknown]: unknown }

	if #(ExpectedTable :: { unknown }) > 0 then
		if #(ActualTable :: { unknown }) == 0 and next(ActualTable) ~= nil then
			return false
		end

		for _, Element in ExpectedTable :: { unknown } do
			local Found = false

			for _, Other in ActualTable :: { unknown } do
				if CompareNbt(Element, Other) then
					Found = true

					break
				end
			end

			if not Found then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	local Size = 0

	for Key, Value in ExpectedTable do
		if not CompareNbt(Value, ActualTable[Key]) then
			return false
		end

		Size += 1
	end

	for _ in ActualTable do
		Size -= 1
	end

	return Size <= 0
end

const function Matches(Test: Test, Stack: Minecraft.ItemStack): boolean
	const Kind = Test.Kind

	if Kind == "Always" then
		return true
	elseif Kind == "Item" then
		return Items.Is(Stack, Test.Id)
	elseif Kind == "Tag" then
		return Registry.HasTag(ItemRegistry, Test.Id, Items.ItemOf(Stack).Id)
	elseif Kind == "Not" then
		return not Matches(Test.Children[1], Stack)
	elseif Kind == "AnyOf" then
		for _, Child in Test.Children do
			if Matches(Child, Stack) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	elseif Kind == "AllOf" then
		for _, Child in Test.Children do
			if not Matches(Child, Stack) then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	elseif Kind == "Present" then
		return Items.Has(Stack, Test.Id)
	elseif Kind == "Equals" then
		return Items.Equal(Test.Value, Items.Get(Stack, Test.Id))
	elseif Kind == "Count" then
		return InBounds(Test.Bounds, Items.GetCount(Stack))
	elseif Kind == "Damage" then
		const Damage = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:damage") :: number?

		if Damage == nil then
			return false
		end

		const MaxDamage = (Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:max_damage") or 0) :: number

		return InBounds(Test.Bounds, MaxDamage - Damage) and InBounds(Test.DamageBounds, Damage)
	elseif Kind == "Enchantments" then
		const Applied = Items.Get(Stack, Test.Id) :: { [string]: number }?

		if Applied == nil then
			return false
		end

		for _, Predicate in Test.Enchantments do
			if not MatchesEnchantment(Predicate, Applied) then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	elseif Kind == "Potions" then
		const Contents = Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:potion_contents")

		if Contents == nil then
			return false
		end

		if Test.Potions then
			const Potion = if type(Contents) == "string" then Contents else (Contents :: { potion: string? }).potion

			if not Potion or not table.find(Test.Potions, Potion) then
				return false
			end
		end

		return Test.Effects == nil or MatchesCollection(Test.Effects, Items.PotionContents.AllEffects(Contents, 1))
	end

	return CompareNbt(Test.Value, Items.Get(Stack, "minecraft:custom_data") or {})
end

return {
	Any = Any,
	ParseItem = ParseItem,
	CreateStack = CreateStack,
	ParsePredicate = ParsePredicate,
	SuggestItem = SuggestItem,
	SuggestPredicate = SuggestPredicate,
	Matches = Matches,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Kill"] = function(require)

const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Living = require("../Living")
const Selectors = require("./Selectors")
const Tracker = require("./Tracker")

const function Register(Root: Dispatcher.Node)
	const Command = Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Literal("kill"), "Self")

	Dispatcher.Then(Command, Dispatcher.Executes(Dispatcher.Argument("targets", Dispatcher.Entity(false, false)), "Targets"))
	Dispatcher.Register(Root, Command, "Kill")
end

const function Execute(Context: Dispatcher.Context, Command: string): number
	const Source = Context.Source
	const Victims = if Command == "Self" then { Source.Entity :: Entities.Entity } else Selectors.GetEntities(Context.Arguments.targets :: Selectors.Selector, Source)
	const Results = Tracker.Create()

	for _, Entity in Victims do
		Living.Kill(Entity)
		Tracker.Track(Results, Entity, 1)
	end

	return Tracker.Feedback(Results, Source, true, nil, "commands.kill.success.single", "commands.kill.success.multiple", { 0 }, 1)
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Execute = Execute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Packrat"] = function(require)

const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")
const Suggestions = require("./Suggestions")

type Reader = ReaderModule.Reader

export type Supplier = {
	Values: { string },
	Resource: boolean,
}

type Entry = {
	Message: unknown,
	Cursor: number,
	Exception: ReaderModule.Exception?,
	Supplier: Supplier?,
}

export type State = {
	Reader: Reader,
	LastCursor: number,
	Errors: { Entry },
}

const function Create(Reader: Reader): State
	return { Reader = Reader, LastCursor = -1, Errors = {} }
end

const function Keep(State: State, Cursor: number, Entry: Entry)
	if Cursor > State.LastCursor then
		State.LastCursor = Cursor
		table.clear(State.Errors)
	end

	if Cursor == State.LastCursor then
		table.insert(State.Errors, Entry)
	end
end

const function Finish(State: State, Cursor: number)
	if Cursor > State.LastCursor then
		State.LastCursor = Cursor
		table.clear(State.Errors)
	end
end

const function Store(State: State, Cursor: number, Message: unknown, Supplier: Supplier?)
	Keep(State, Cursor, { Message = Message, Cursor = Cursor, Exception = nil, Supplier = Supplier })
end

const function StoreException(State: State, Cursor: number, Exception: ReaderModule.Exception, Supplier: Supplier?)
	Keep(State, Cursor, { Message = Exception.Message, Cursor = Cursor, Exception = Exception, Supplier = Supplier })
end
