const function Character(State: State, First: string, Second: string?): boolean
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Cursor = Reader.Cursor

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		const Codepoint = ReaderModule.Read(Reader)

		if Codepoint == string.byte(First) or (Second ~= nil and Codepoint == string.byte(Second)) then
			return true
		end
	end

	Store(State, Cursor, { translate = "argument.literal.incorrect", with = { if Second then `{First}|{Second}` else First } }, { Values = if Second then { First, Second } else { First }, Resource = false })

	return false
end

const function Fail(State: State): never
	const First = State.Errors[1]

	if not First then
		error("Failed to parse")
	end

	if First.Exception then
		error(First.Exception, 0)
	end

	const Context = ReaderModule.Copy(State.Reader)

	Context.Cursor = First.Cursor

	return ReaderModule.Fail(First.Message, Context)
end

const function Suggest(State: State, Builder: Suggestions.Builder): Suggestions.Suggestions
	if #State.Errors == 0 then
		return Suggestions.Build(Builder)
	end

	const Offset = Suggestions.CreateOffset(Builder, State.LastCursor)

	for _, Entry in State.Errors do
		const Supplier = Entry.Supplier

		if Supplier and Supplier.Resource then
			Suggestions.SuggestResource(Offset, Supplier.Values)
		elseif Supplier then
			Suggestions.SuggestMatching(Offset, Supplier.Values)
		end
	end

	return Suggestions.Build(Offset)
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Suggest = Suggest,
	Finish = Finish,
	Store = Store,
	StoreException = StoreException,
	Character = Character,
	Fail = Fail,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Reader"] = function(require)

const Space = 32
const Escape = 92
const DoubleQuote = 34
const SingleQuote = 39
const Minus = 45
const Period = 46
const MaximumInt = 2147483647

export type Reader = {
	Codepoints: { number },
	Length: number,
	Cursor: number,
}

export type Exception = {
	Message: unknown,
	Input: string?,
	Cursor: number,
}

const function Create(Text: string): Reader
	const Codepoints: { number } = {}

	for _, Codepoint in utf8.codes(Text) do
		table.insert(Codepoints, Codepoint)
	end

	return { Codepoints = Codepoints, Length = #Codepoints, Cursor = 0 }
end

const function Copy(Source: Reader): Reader
	return { Codepoints = Source.Codepoints, Length = Source.Length, Cursor = Source.Cursor }
end

const function Substring(Reader: Reader, From: number, To: number): string
	if To <= From then
		return ""
	end

	return utf8.char(table.unpack(Reader.Codepoints, From + 1, To))
end

const function Text(Reader: Reader): string
	return Substring(Reader, 0, Reader.Length)
end

const function NewException(Message: unknown, Context: Reader?): Exception
	return {
		Message = Message,
		Input = if Context then Text(Context) else nil,
		Cursor = if Context then Context.Cursor else -1,
	}
end

const function Fail(Message: unknown, Context: Reader?): never
	error(NewException(Message, Context), 0)
end

const function IsException(Value: unknown): boolean
	return type(Value) == "table" and (Value :: { Message: unknown? }).Message ~= nil
end

const function CanRead(Reader: Reader, Length: number?): boolean
	return Reader.Cursor + (Length or 1) <= Reader.Length
end

const function Peek(Reader: Reader, Offset: number?): number
	return Reader.Codepoints[Reader.Cursor + (Offset or 0) + 1] or -1
end

const function Read(Reader: Reader): number
	Reader.Cursor += 1

	return Reader.Codepoints[Reader.Cursor]
end

const function Skip(Reader: Reader)
	Reader.Cursor += 1
end

const function IsWhitespace(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Codepoint == Space
		or (Codepoint >= 9 and Codepoint <= 13)
		or (Codepoint >= 0x1C and Codepoint <= 0x1F)
		or Codepoint == 0x1680
		or (Codepoint >= 0x2000 and Codepoint <= 0x2006)
		or (Codepoint >= 0x2008 and Codepoint <= 0x200A)
		or Codepoint == 0x2028
		or Codepoint == 0x2029
		or Codepoint == 0x205F
		or Codepoint == 0x3000
end

const function IsDigit(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Codepoint >= 48 and Codepoint <= 57
end

const function IsAllowedNumber(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return IsDigit(Codepoint) or Codepoint == Period or Codepoint == Minus
end

const function IsAllowedInUnquotedString(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return IsDigit(Codepoint)
		or (Codepoint >= 65 and Codepoint <= 90)
		or (Codepoint >= 97 and Codepoint <= 122)
		or Codepoint == 95
		or Codepoint == Minus
		or Codepoint == Period
		or Codepoint == 43
end

const function IsQuotedStringStart(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Codepoint == DoubleQuote or Codepoint == SingleQuote
end

const function SkipWhitespace(Reader: Reader)
	while CanRead(Reader) and IsWhitespace(Peek(Reader)) do
		Skip(Reader)
	end
end

const function ParseInt(Text: string): number?
	if not string.match(Text, "^%-?%d+$") then
		return nil
	end

	const Value = tonumber(Text) :: number

	return if Value >= -MaximumInt - 1 and Value <= MaximumInt then Value else nil
end

const function ParseDouble(Text: string): number?
	if not string.match(Text, "^%-?%d*%.?%d*$") or not string.find(Text, "%d") then
		return nil
	end

	return tonumber(Text)
end

const function ReadNumberText(Reader: Reader): (number, string)
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	while CanRead(Reader) and IsAllowedNumber(Peek(Reader)) do
		Skip(Reader)
	end

	return Start, Substring(Reader, Start, Reader.Cursor)
end

const function ReadInt(Reader: Reader): number
	const Start, Number = ReadNumberText(Reader)

	if Number == "" then
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.int.expected" }, Reader)
	end

	const Value = ParseInt(Number)

	if not Value then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.int.invalid", with = { Number } }, Reader)
	end

	return Value :: number
end

const function ReadDouble(Reader: Reader): number
	const Start, Number = ReadNumberText(Reader)

	if Number == "" then
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.double.expected" }, Reader)
	end

	const Value = ParseDouble(Number)

	if not Value then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.double.invalid", with = { Number } }, Reader)
	end

	return Value :: number
end

const function ReadUnquotedString(Reader: Reader): string
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	while CanRead(Reader) and IsAllowedInUnquotedString(Peek(Reader)) do
		Skip(Reader)
	end

	return Substring(Reader, Start, Reader.Cursor)
end

const function ReadStringUntil(Reader: Reader, Terminator: number): string
	const Result: { number } = {}
	local Escaped = false

	while CanRead(Reader) do
		const Codepoint = Read(Reader)

		if Escaped then
			if Codepoint == Terminator or Codepoint == Escape then
				table.insert(Result, Codepoint)
				Escaped = false
			else
				Reader.Cursor -= 1
				Fail({ translate = "parsing.quote.escape", with = { utf8.char(Codepoint) } }, Reader)
			end
		elseif Codepoint == Escape then
			Escaped = true
		elseif Codepoint == Terminator then
			return if #Result > 0 then utf8.char(table.unpack(Result)) else ""
		else
			table.insert(Result, Codepoint)
		end
	end

	return Fail({ translate = "parsing.quote.expected.end" }, Reader)
end

const function ReadString(Reader: Reader): string
	if not CanRead(Reader) then
		return ""
	end

	const Next = Peek(Reader)

	if IsQuotedStringStart(Next) then
		Skip(Reader)

		return ReadStringUntil(Reader, Next)
	end

	return ReadUnquotedString(Reader)
end

const function ReadBoolean(Reader: Reader): boolean
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Value = ReadString(Reader)

	if Value == "" then
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.bool.expected" }, Reader)
	end

	if Value == "true" then
		return true
	elseif Value == "false" then
		return false
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Start

	return Fail({ translate = "parsing.bool.invalid", with = { Value } }, Reader)
end

const function Expect(Reader: Reader, Codepoint: number)
	if not CanRead(Reader) or Peek(Reader) ~= Codepoint then
		Fail({ translate = "parsing.expected", with = { utf8.char(Codepoint) } }, Reader)
	end

	Skip(Reader)
end

return {
	Space = Space,
	Create = Create,
	Copy = Copy,
	Substring = Substring,
	Text = Text,
	NewException = NewException,
	Fail = Fail,
	IsException = IsException,
	CanRead = CanRead,
	Peek = Peek,
	Read = Read,
	Skip = Skip,
	IsDigit = IsDigit,
	SkipWhitespace = SkipWhitespace,
	ParseInt = ParseInt,
	ParseDouble = ParseDouble,
	ReadInt = ReadInt,
	ReadDouble = ReadDouble,
	ReadUnquotedString = ReadUnquotedString,
	ReadString = ReadString,
	ReadBoolean = ReadBoolean,
	Expect = Expect,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Selectors"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Identifier = require("./Identifier")
const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")
const Suggestions = require("./Suggestions")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth
const Uuid = Minecraft.Uuid

const At = 64
const OpenBracket = 91
const CloseBracket = 93
const OpenBrace = 123
const CloseBrace = 125
const Comma = 44
const Equals = 61
const Exclamation = 33
const Hash = 35
const Period = 46
const Minus = 45
const MaximumNameLength = 16
const Unlimited = math.huge
const PlayerType = "minecraft:player"
const EntityTypeRegistry = "minecraft:entity_type"
const DefaultMaximumRotation = 359

type Reader = ReaderModule.Reader
type Source = SourceModule.Source
type Entity = Entities.Entity

type Bounds = {
	Min: number?,
	Max: number?,
}

type Order = "Arbitrary" | "Nearest" | "Furthest" | "Random"

type SuggestionKind = "NameOrSelector" | "Name" | "Selector" | "OpenOptions" | "OptionsKeyOrClose" | "OptionsKey" | "OptionsNextOrClose" | "Nothing" | "GameMode" | "Type"

type PredicateKind = "Alive" | "Name" | "GameMode" | "Team" | "Type" | "TypeTag" | "Tag" | "Never" | "Level" | "XRotation" | "YRotation"

type Predicate = {
	Kind: PredicateKind,
	Inverted: boolean,
	Text: string,
	Bounds: Bounds,
}

type OptionState = {
	Limitation: "None" | "Single" | "Multiple",
	Tags: { [string]: true },
}

type Parser = {
	Reader: Reader,
	AllowSelectors: boolean,
	MaxResults: number,
	IncludesEntities: boolean,
	Distance: Bounds?,
	Level: Bounds?,
	X: number?,
	Y: number?,
	Z: number?,
	DeltaX: number?,
	DeltaY: number?,
	DeltaZ: number?,
	RotX: Bounds?,
	RotY: Bounds?,
	Predicates: { Predicate },
	Order: Order,
	CurrentEntity: boolean,
	PlayerName: string?,
	EntityUuid: buffer?,
	NameOption: OptionState,
	GameModeOption: OptionState,
	TeamOption: OptionState,
	TypeOption: OptionState,
	Limited: boolean,
	Sorted: boolean,
	Scored: boolean,
	Advanced: boolean,
	Type: string?,
	UsesSelector: boolean,
	Suggestions: SuggestionKind,
	StartPosition: number,
}

export type Selector = {
	MaxResults: number,
	IncludesEntities: boolean,
	Predicates: { Predicate },
	Distance: Bounds?,
	X: number?,
	Y: number?,
	Z: number?,
	BoxMin: vector?,
	BoxMax: vector?,
	Order: Order,
	CurrentEntity: boolean,
	PlayerName: string?,
	EntityUuid: buffer?,
	Type: string?,
	UsesSelector: boolean,
}

const OptionNames = { "name", "distance", "level", "x", "y", "z", "dx", "dy", "dz", "x_rotation", "y_rotation", "limit", "sort", "gamemode", "team", "type", "tag", "nbt", "scores", "advancements", "predicate" }
const SelectorSuggestions = {
	{ Text = "@p", Key = "argument.entity.selector.nearestPlayer" },
	{ Text = "@a", Key = "argument.entity.selector.allPlayers" },
	{ Text = "@r", Key = "argument.entity.selector.randomPlayer" },
	{ Text = "@s", Key = "argument.entity.selector.self" },
	{ Text = "@e", Key = "argument.entity.selector.allEntities" },
	{ Text = "@n", Key = "argument.entity.selector.nearestEntity" },
}

const NoBounds: Bounds = {}
const Generator = Random.new()

const function OptionStateCreate(): OptionState
	return { Limitation = "None", Tags = {} }
end

const function CanParseElement(State: OptionState, Inverted: boolean): boolean
	return if Inverted then State.Limitation ~= "Single" else State.Limitation == "None"
end

const function CanParseAny(State: OptionState): boolean
	return State.Limitation ~= "Single"
end

const function MarkParsedElement(State: OptionState, Inverted: boolean)
	State.Limitation = if Inverted then "Multiple" else "Single"
end

const function AddPredicate(Parser: Parser, Kind: PredicateKind, Inverted: boolean, Text: string?, Range: Bounds?)
	table.insert(Parser.Predicates, { Kind = Kind, Inverted = Inverted, Text = Text or "", Bounds = Range or NoBounds })
end

const function Rollback(Reader: Reader, Start: number, Key: string, Argument: string?): never
	Reader.Cursor = Start

	return ReaderModule.Fail(if Argument then { translate = Key, with = { Argument } } else { translate = Key }, Reader)
end

const function IsBoundCharacter(Reader: Reader): boolean
	const Codepoint = ReaderModule.Peek(Reader)

	if ReaderModule.IsDigit(Codepoint) or Codepoint == Minus then
		return true
	elseif Codepoint ~= Period then
		return false
	end

	return not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader, 2) or ReaderModule.Peek(Reader, 1) ~= Period
end

const function ReadBound(Reader: Reader, Kind: "Int" | "Double" | "Float"): number?
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and IsBoundCharacter(Reader) do
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
	end

	const Number = ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Reader.Cursor)

	if Number == "" then
		return nil
	end

	const Value = if Kind == "Int" then ReaderModule.ParseInt(Number) else ReaderModule.ParseDouble(Number)

	if not Value then
		const Key = if Kind == "Int" then "parsing.int.invalid" elseif Kind == "Double" then "parsing.double.invalid" else "parsing.float.invalid"

		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = Key, with = { Number } }, Reader)
	end

	return if Kind == "Float" then Mth.Float(Value :: number) else Value
end

const function ReadBoundsParts(Reader: Reader, Kind: "Int" | "Double" | "Float"): Bounds
	const Min = ReadBound(Reader, Kind)
	local Max = Min

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader, 2) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Period and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader, 1) == Period then
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		Max = ReadBound(Reader, Kind)
	end

	if Min == nil and Max == nil then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.range.empty" }, Reader)
	end

	return { Min = Min, Max = Max }
end

const function ReadBounds(Reader: Reader, Kind: "Int" | "Double" | "Float"): Bounds
	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.range.empty" }, Reader)
	end

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Ok, Result = pcall(ReadBoundsParts, Reader, Kind)

	if not Ok then
		if ReaderModule.IsException(Result) then
			const Raised = Result :: ReaderModule.Exception

			Reader.Cursor = Start
			Raised.Cursor = Start
		end

		error(Result, 0)
	end

	const Range = Result :: Bounds

	if Kind ~= "Float" and Range.Min and Range.Max and Range.Min > Range.Max then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.range.swapped" }, Reader)
	end

	return Range
end

const function InvertValue(Reader: Reader): boolean
	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Exclamation then
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function IsTag(Reader: Reader): boolean
	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Hash then
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function IsEntityType(Id: string): boolean
	return Minecraft.Registry.IsEntityType(Id) or Id == Entities.HumanoidType
end

const function CanUseOption(Parser: Parser, Key: string): boolean?
	if Key == "name" then
		return CanParseAny(Parser.NameOption)
	elseif Key == "distance" then
		return Parser.Distance == nil
	elseif Key == "level" then
		return Parser.Level == nil
	elseif Key == "x" then
		return Parser.X == nil
	elseif Key == "y" then
		return Parser.Y == nil
	elseif Key == "z" then
		return Parser.Z == nil
	elseif Key == "dx" then
		return Parser.DeltaX == nil
	elseif Key == "dy" then
		return Parser.DeltaY == nil
	elseif Key == "dz" then
		return Parser.DeltaZ == nil
	elseif Key == "x_rotation" then
		return Parser.RotX == nil
	elseif Key == "y_rotation" then
		return Parser.RotY == nil
	elseif Key == "limit" then
		return not Parser.CurrentEntity and not Parser.Limited
	elseif Key == "sort" then
		return not Parser.CurrentEntity and not Parser.Sorted
	elseif Key == "gamemode" then
		return CanParseAny(Parser.GameModeOption)
	elseif Key == "team" then
		return CanParseAny(Parser.TeamOption)
	elseif Key == "type" then
		return CanParseAny(Parser.TypeOption)
	elseif Key == "tag" or Key == "nbt" or Key == "predicate" then
		return true
	elseif Key == "scores" then
		return not Parser.Scored
	elseif Key == "advancements" then
		return not Parser.Advanced
	end

	return nil
end

const function ParseTypeOption(Parser: Parser)
	const Reader = Parser.Reader
	const State = Parser.TypeOption

	Parser.Suggestions = "Type"
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Inverted = InvertValue(Reader)

	if IsTag(Reader) then
		if not CanParseAny(State) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "type")
		end

		const Tag = Identifier.Read(Reader)

		if State.Tags[Tag] then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "type")
		end

		AddPredicate(Parser, "TypeTag", Inverted, Tag)
		State.Limitation = "Multiple"
		State.Tags[Tag] = true

		return
	end

	if not CanParseElement(State, Inverted) then
		Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "type")
	end

	const Type = Identifier.Read(Reader)

	if not IsEntityType(Type) then
		Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.type.invalid", Type)
	end

	if Type == PlayerType and not Inverted then
		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
	end

	AddPredicate(Parser, "Type", Inverted, Type)

	if not Inverted then
		Parser.Type = Type
	end

	MarkParsedElement(State, Inverted)
end

const function SkipScores(Reader: Reader): boolean
	local Any = false

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, OpenBrace)
	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBrace do
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, Equals)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		ReadBounds(Reader, "Int")
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Any = true

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Comma then
			ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		end
	end

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, CloseBrace)

	return Any
end

const function SkipAdvancements(Reader: Reader): boolean
	local Any = false

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, OpenBrace)
	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBrace do
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Identifier.Read(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, Equals)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == OpenBrace then
			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
			ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, OpenBrace)
			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

			while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBrace do
				ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
				ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)
				ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
				ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, Equals)
				ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
				ReaderModule.ReadBoolean(Reader)
				ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

				if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Comma then
					ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
				end
			end

			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
			ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, CloseBrace)
			ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		else
			ReaderModule.ReadBoolean(Reader)
		end

		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Any = true

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == Comma then
			ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		end
	end

	ReaderModule.Expect(Reader, CloseBrace)

	return Any
end

const function ParseOption(Parser: Parser, Key: string)
	const Reader = Parser.Reader

	if Key == "name" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Inverted = InvertValue(Reader)
		const Name = ReaderModule.ReadString(Reader)

		if not CanParseElement(Parser.NameOption, Inverted) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "name")
		end

		MarkParsedElement(Parser.NameOption, Inverted)
		AddPredicate(Parser, "Name", Inverted, Name)
	elseif Key == "distance" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Range = ReadBounds(Reader, "Double")

		if (Range.Min and Range.Min < 0) or (Range.Max and Range.Max < 0) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.distance.negative")
		end

		Parser.Distance = Range
	elseif Key == "level" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Range = ReadBounds(Reader, "Int")

		if (Range.Min and Range.Min < 0) or (Range.Max and Range.Max < 0) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.level.negative")
		end

		Parser.Level = Range
		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
	elseif Key == "x" then
		Parser.X = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "y" then
		Parser.Y = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "z" then
		Parser.Z = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "dx" then
		Parser.DeltaX = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "dy" then
		Parser.DeltaY = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "dz" then
		Parser.DeltaZ = ReaderModule.ReadDouble(Reader)
	elseif Key == "x_rotation" then
		Parser.RotX = ReadBounds(Reader, "Float")
	elseif Key == "y_rotation" then
		Parser.RotY = ReadBounds(Reader, "Float")
	elseif Key == "limit" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Count = ReaderModule.ReadInt(Reader)

		if Count < 1 then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.limit.toosmall")
		end

		Parser.MaxResults = Count
		Parser.Limited = true
	elseif Key == "sort" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Name = ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)

		if Name == "nearest" then
			Parser.Order = "Nearest"
		elseif Name == "furthest" then
			Parser.Order = "Furthest"
		elseif Name == "random" then
			Parser.Order = "Random"
		elseif Name == "arbitrary" then
			Parser.Order = "Arbitrary"
		else
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.sort.irreversible", Name)
		end

		Parser.Sorted = true
	elseif Key == "gamemode" then
		Parser.Suggestions = "GameMode"

		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Inverted = InvertValue(Reader)

		if not CanParseElement(Parser.GameModeOption, Inverted) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "gamemode")
		end

		const Name = ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)

		if not table.find(Minecraft.Protocol.GameModes, Name) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.mode.invalid", Name)
		end

		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		AddPredicate(Parser, "GameMode", Inverted, Name)
		MarkParsedElement(Parser.GameModeOption, Inverted)
	elseif Key == "team" then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Inverted = InvertValue(Reader)
		const Name = ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)

		if not CanParseElement(Parser.TeamOption, Inverted) then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", "team")
		end

		AddPredicate(Parser, "Team", Inverted, Name)
		MarkParsedElement(Parser.TeamOption, Inverted)
	elseif Key == "type" then
		ParseTypeOption(Parser)
	elseif Key == "tag" then
		const Inverted = InvertValue(Reader)

		AddPredicate(Parser, "Tag", Inverted, ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader))
	elseif Key == "nbt" then
		ReaderModule.Fail("The nbt selector option is not supported: entities are not saved as NBT", Reader)
	elseif Key == "scores" then
		if SkipScores(Reader) then
			AddPredicate(Parser, "Never", false)
		end

		Parser.Scored = true
	elseif Key == "advancements" then
		if SkipAdvancements(Reader) then
			AddPredicate(Parser, "Never", false)
			Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		end

		Parser.Advanced = true
	elseif Key == "predicate" then
		InvertValue(Reader)
		Identifier.Read(Reader)
		AddPredicate(Parser, "Never", false)
	end
end

const function ParseOptions(Parser: Parser)
	const Reader = Parser.Reader

	Parser.Suggestions = "OptionsKey"
	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	while ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBracket do
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		const Key = ReaderModule.ReadString(Reader)
		const Usable = CanUseOption(Parser, Key)

		if Usable == nil then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.unknown", Key)
		elseif not Usable then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.inapplicable", Key)
		end

		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

		if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) or ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= Equals then
			Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.options.valueless", Key)
		end

		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Parser.Suggestions = "Nothing"
		ParseOption(Parser, Key)
		ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)
		Parser.Suggestions = "OptionsNextOrClose"

		if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
			if ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= Comma then
				if ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= CloseBracket then
					ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.options.unterminated" }, Reader)
				end

				break
			end

			ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
			Parser.Suggestions = "OptionsKey"
		end
	end

	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.options.unterminated" }, Reader)
	end

	ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
	Parser.Suggestions = "Nothing"
end

const function ParseSelector(Parser: Parser)
	const Reader = Parser.Reader

	Parser.UsesSelector = true
	Parser.Suggestions = "Selector"

	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.selector.missing" }, Reader)
	end

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Type = utf8.char(ReaderModule.Read(Reader))
	local Alive = false

	if Type == "a" then
		Parser.MaxResults = Unlimited
		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		Parser.Order = "Arbitrary"
		Parser.Type = PlayerType
	elseif Type == "e" then
		Parser.MaxResults = Unlimited
		Parser.IncludesEntities = true
		Parser.Order = "Arbitrary"
		Alive = true
	elseif Type == "n" then
		Parser.MaxResults = 1
		Parser.IncludesEntities = true
		Parser.Order = "Nearest"
		Alive = true
	elseif Type == "p" then
		Parser.MaxResults = 1
		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		Parser.Order = "Nearest"
		Parser.Type = PlayerType
	elseif Type == "r" then
		Parser.MaxResults = 1
		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		Parser.Order = "Random"
		Parser.Type = PlayerType
	elseif Type == "s" then
		Parser.MaxResults = 1
		Parser.IncludesEntities = true
		Parser.CurrentEntity = true
	else
		Rollback(Reader, Start, "argument.entity.selector.unknown", `@{Type}`)
	end

	if Alive then
		AddPredicate(Parser, "Alive", false)
	end

	Parser.Suggestions = "OpenOptions"

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == OpenBracket then
		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		Parser.Suggestions = "OptionsKeyOrClose"
		ParseOptions(Parser)
	end
end

const function ParseNameOrUuid(Parser: Parser)
	const Reader = Parser.Reader

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) then
		Parser.Suggestions = "Name"
	end

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Name = ReaderModule.ReadString(Reader)
	const Parsed = Uuid.FromString(Name)

	if Parsed then
		Parser.EntityUuid = Parsed
		Parser.IncludesEntities = true
	else
		if Name == "" or (utf8.len(Name) or 0) > MaximumNameLength then
			Reader.Cursor = Start
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.invalid" }, Reader)
		end

		Parser.IncludesEntities = false
		Parser.PlayerName = Name
	end

	Parser.MaxResults = 1
end

const function WrappedBounds(Range: Bounds): Bounds
	return { Min = Mth.WrapDegrees(Range.Min or 0), Max = Mth.WrapDegrees(Range.Max or DefaultMaximumRotation) }
end

const function NewParser(Reader: Reader, AllowSelectors: boolean): Parser
	return {
		Reader = Reader,
		AllowSelectors = AllowSelectors,
		MaxResults = 0,
		IncludesEntities = false,
		Distance = nil,
		Level = nil,
		X = nil,
		Y = nil,
		Z = nil,
		DeltaX = nil,
		DeltaY = nil,
		DeltaZ = nil,
		RotX = nil,
		RotY = nil,
		Predicates = {},
		Order = "Arbitrary",
		CurrentEntity = false,
		PlayerName = nil,
		EntityUuid = nil,
		NameOption = OptionStateCreate(),
		GameModeOption = OptionStateCreate(),
		TeamOption = OptionStateCreate(),
		TypeOption = OptionStateCreate(),
		Limited = false,
		Sorted = false,
		Scored = false,
		Advanced = false,
		Type = nil,
		UsesSelector = false,
		Suggestions = "NameOrSelector",
		StartPosition = Reader.Cursor,
	}
end

const function ParseWith(Parser: Parser): Selector
	const Reader = Parser.Reader
	const AllowSelectors = Parser.AllowSelectors

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) and ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) == At then
		if not AllowSelectors then
			ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.selector.not_allowed" }, Reader)
		end

		ReaderModule.Skip(Reader)
		ParseSelector(Parser)
	else
		ParseNameOrUuid(Parser)
	end

	if Parser.RotX then
		AddPredicate(Parser, "XRotation", false, nil, WrappedBounds(Parser.RotX))
	end

	if Parser.RotY then
		AddPredicate(Parser, "YRotation", false, nil, WrappedBounds(Parser.RotY))
	end

	if Parser.Level then
		AddPredicate(Parser, "Level", false, nil, Parser.Level)
	end

	local BoxMin: vector? = nil
	local BoxMax: vector? = nil

	if Parser.DeltaX == nil and Parser.DeltaY == nil and Parser.DeltaZ == nil then
		const Range = Parser.Distance

		if Range and Range.Max then
			BoxMin = -vector.one * Range.Max
			BoxMax = vector.one * (Range.Max + 1)
		end
	else
		const Delta = vector.create(Parser.DeltaX or 0, Parser.DeltaY or 0, Parser.DeltaZ or 0)

		BoxMin = vector.min(Delta, vector.zero)
		BoxMax = vector.max(Delta, vector.zero) + vector.one
	end

	return {
		MaxResults = Parser.MaxResults,
		IncludesEntities = Parser.IncludesEntities,
		Predicates = Parser.Predicates,
		Distance = Parser.Distance,
		X = Parser.X,
		Y = Parser.Y,
		Z = Parser.Z,
		BoxMin = BoxMin,
		BoxMax = BoxMax,
		Order = Parser.Order,
		CurrentEntity = Parser.CurrentEntity,
		PlayerName = Parser.PlayerName,
		EntityUuid = Parser.EntityUuid,
		Type = Parser.Type,
		UsesSelector = Parser.UsesSelector,
	}
end

const function ParseArgument(Reader: Reader, Single: boolean, PlayersOnly: boolean, AllowSelectors: boolean): Selector
	const Selector = ParseWith(NewParser(Reader, AllowSelectors))

	if Selector.MaxResults > 1 and Single then
		Reader.Cursor = 0
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = if PlayersOnly then "argument.player.toomany" else "argument.entity.toomany" }, Reader)
	elseif Selector.IncludesEntities and PlayersOnly and not Selector.CurrentEntity then
		Reader.Cursor = 0
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.player.entities" }, Reader)
	end

	return Selector
end

const function InBounds(Range: Bounds, Value: number): boolean
	return (Range.Min == nil or Range.Min <= Value) and (Range.Max == nil or Range.Max >= Value)
end

const function InRotation(Range: Bounds, Rotation: number): boolean
	const Min = Range.Min :: number
	const Max = Range.Max :: number
	const Wrapped = Mth.WrapDegrees(Rotation)

	return if Min > Max then Wrapped >= Min or Wrapped <= Max else Wrapped >= Min and Wrapped <= Max
end

const function PlainName(Entity: Entity): string
	return Minecraft.Language.PlainText(Entities.DisplayName(Entity))
end

const function Test(Predicate: Predicate, Entity: Entity): boolean
	const Kind = Predicate.Kind
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	if Kind == "Alive" then
		return Entities.IsAlive(Entity)
	elseif Kind == "Name" then
		return (PlainName(Entity) == Predicate.Text) ~= Predicate.Inverted
	elseif Kind == "GameMode" then
		return Player ~= nil and ((Player.GameMode == Predicate.Text) ~= Predicate.Inverted)
	elseif Kind == "Team" then
		return (Predicate.Text == "") ~= Predicate.Inverted
	elseif Kind == "Type" then
		return (Entity.EntityType == Predicate.Text) ~= Predicate.Inverted
	elseif Kind == "TypeTag" then
		return Minecraft.Registry.HasTag(EntityTypeRegistry, Predicate.Text, Entity.EntityType) ~= Predicate.Inverted
	elseif Kind == "Tag" then
		return (Predicate.Text == "") ~= Predicate.Inverted
	elseif Kind == "Level" then
		return Player ~= nil and InBounds(Predicate.Bounds, Player.ExperienceLevel)
	elseif Kind == "XRotation" then
		return InRotation(Predicate.Bounds, Entity.XRot)
	elseif Kind == "YRotation" then
		return InRotation(Predicate.Bounds, Entity.YRot)
	end

	return false
end

const function Matches(Selector: Selector, Entity: Entity, Position: vector): boolean
	for _, Predicate in Selector.Predicates do
		if not Test(Predicate, Entity) then
			return false
		end
	end

	if Selector.BoxMin and Selector.BoxMax then
		const Min, Max = Entities.Box(Entity)

		if not Entities.Intersects(Selector.BoxMin + Position, Selector.BoxMax + Position, Min, Max) then
			return false
		end
	end

	const Range = Selector.Distance

	if Range then
		const Offset = Entity.Position - Position
		const DistanceSquared = vector.dot(Offset, Offset)

		if (Range.Min and Range.Min * Range.Min > DistanceSquared) or (Range.Max and Range.Max * Range.Max < DistanceSquared) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

const function CheckPermissions(Selector: Selector, Source: Source)
	if Selector.UsesSelector and not Source.Permitted then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.selector.not_allowed" })
	end
end

const function Candidates(PlayersOnly: boolean): { Entity }
	const Result: { Entity } = {}

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		if not PlayersOnly or Entity.Kind == "Player" then
			table.insert(Result, Entity)
		end
	end

	table.sort(Result, function(First: Entity, Second: Entity): boolean
		return First.Id < Second.Id
	end)

	return Result
end

const function PlayerNamed(Name: string): Entity?
	const Lower = string.lower(Name)

	for _, Entity in Candidates(true) do
		if string.lower((Entity :: Entities.ServerPlayer).Name) == Lower then
			return Entity
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function PlayerWithUuid(Id: buffer): Entity?
	for _, Entity in Candidates(true) do
		if buffer.tostring(Uuid.Offline((Entity :: Entities.ServerPlayer).Name)) == buffer.tostring(Id) then
			return Entity
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function SortAndLimit(Selector: Selector, Position: vector, Result: { Entity }): { Entity }
	if #Result > 1 then
		if Selector.Order == "Random" then
			for Index = #Result, 2, -1 do
				const Other = Generator:NextInteger(1, Index)

				Result[Index], Result[Other] = Result[Other], Result[Index]
			end
		elseif Selector.Order ~= "Arbitrary" then
			const Furthest = Selector.Order == "Furthest"
			const Distances: { [Entity]: number } = {}
			const Indices: { [Entity]: number } = {}

			for Index, Entity in Result do
				const Offset = Entity.Position - Position

				Distances[Entity] = vector.dot(Offset, Offset)
				Indices[Entity] = Index
			end

			table.sort(Result, function(First: Entity, Second: Entity): boolean
				if Distances[First] ~= Distances[Second] then
					return if Furthest then Distances[First] > Distances[Second] else Distances[First] < Distances[Second]
				end

				return Indices[First] < Indices[Second]
			end)
		end
	end

	for Index = #Result, Selector.MaxResults + 1, -1 do
		Result[Index] = nil
	end

	return Result
end

const function Collect(Selector: Selector, Source: Source, PlayersOnly: boolean): { Entity }
	const Origin = Source.Position
	const Position = vector.create(Selector.X or Origin.x, Selector.Y or Origin.y, Selector.Z or Origin.z)

	if Selector.CurrentEntity then
		const Entity = Source.Entity :: Entities.Entity

		if Entity and (not PlayersOnly or Entity.Kind == "Player") and Matches(Selector, Entity, Position) then
			return { Entity }
		end

		return {}
	end

	const Limit = if Selector.Order == "Arbitrary" then Selector.MaxResults else Unlimited
	const Result: { Entity } = {}

	for _, Entity in Candidates(PlayersOnly) do
		if (PlayersOnly or Selector.Type == nil or Entity.EntityType == Selector.Type) and Matches(Selector, Entity, Position) then
			table.insert(Result, Entity)

			if #Result >= Limit then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return SortAndLimit(Selector, Position, Result)
end

const function FindPlayers(Selector: Selector, Source: Source): { Entities.ServerPlayer }
	CheckPermissions(Selector, Source)

	local Found: { Entity } = {}

	if Selector.PlayerName then
		const Player = PlayerNamed(Selector.PlayerName)

		Found = if Player then { Player } else {}
	elseif Selector.EntityUuid then
		const Player = PlayerWithUuid(Selector.EntityUuid)

		Found = if Player then { Player } else {}
	else
		Found = Collect(Selector, Source, true)
	end

	return (Found :: unknown) :: { Entities.ServerPlayer }
end

const function FindEntities(Selector: Selector, Source: Source): { Entity }
	CheckPermissions(Selector, Source)

	if not Selector.IncludesEntities then
		return (FindPlayers(Selector, Source) :: unknown) :: { Entity }
	elseif Selector.EntityUuid then
		const Player = PlayerWithUuid(Selector.EntityUuid)

		return if Player then { Player } else {}
	end

	return Collect(Selector, Source, false)
end

const function GetEntities(Selector: Selector, Source: Source): { Entity }
	const Found = FindEntities(Selector, Source)

	if #Found == 0 then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.notfound.entity" })
	end

	return Found
end

const function GetPlayers(Selector: Selector, Source: Source): { Entities.ServerPlayer }
	const Found = FindPlayers(Selector, Source)

	if #Found == 0 then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.notfound.player" })
	end

	return Found
end

const function GetPlayer(Selector: Selector, Source: Source): Entities.ServerPlayer
	const Found = FindPlayers(Selector, Source)

	if #Found ~= 1 then
		ReaderModule.Fail({ translate = "argument.entity.notfound.player" })
	end

	return Found[1]
end

const function OnlinePlayerNames(): { string }
	const Names: { string } = {}

	for _, Entity in Candidates(true) do
		table.insert(Names, (Entity :: Entities.ServerPlayer).Name)
	end

	return Names
end

const function SuggestNames(Builder: Suggestions.Builder, PlayersOnly: boolean, Selected: string?)
	const Names = OnlinePlayerNames()

	if not PlayersOnly and Selected then
		table.insert(Names, Selected)
	end

	Suggestions.SuggestMatching(Builder, Names)
end

const function SuggestSelectors(Builder: Suggestions.Builder)
	for _, Entry in SelectorSuggestions do
		Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, Entry.Text, { translate = Entry.Key })
	end
end

const function SuggestOptionNames(Parser: Parser, Builder: Suggestions.Builder)
	for _, Key in OptionNames do
		if CanUseOption(Parser, Key) and string.sub(Key, 1, #Builder.RemainingLowerCase) == Builder.RemainingLowerCase then
			Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, `{Key}=`, { translate = `argument.entity.options.{Key}.description` })
		end
	end
end

const function SuggestGameModes(State: OptionState, Builder: Suggestions.Builder)
	local Prefix = Builder.RemainingLowerCase
	local AddNormal = State.Limitation == "None"
	local AddInverted = State.Limitation ~= "Single"

	if Prefix ~= "" then
		if string.sub(Prefix, 1, 1) == "!" then
			AddNormal = false
			Prefix = string.sub(Prefix, 2)
		else
			AddInverted = false
		end
	end

	for _, Name in Minecraft.Protocol.GameModes do
		if string.sub(Name, 1, #Prefix) == Prefix then
			if AddInverted then
				Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, `!{Name}`)
			end

			if AddNormal then
				Suggestions.Suggest(Builder, Name)
			end
		end
	end
end

const function SuggestTypes(State: OptionState, Builder: Suggestions.Builder)
	const Types = table.clone(Minecraft.Registry.EntityTypeNames())

	table.insert(Types, Entities.HumanoidType)

	if State.Limitation ~= "Single" then
		Suggestions.SuggestResource(Builder, Types, "!")
	end

	if State.Limitation == "None" then
		Suggestions.SuggestResource(Builder, Types)
	end

	if State.Limitation ~= "Single" then
		const Allowed: { string } = {}

		for _, Tag in Minecraft.Registry.TagNames(EntityTypeRegistry) do
			if not State.Tags[Tag] then
				table.insert(Allowed, Tag)
			end
		end

		if #Allowed > 0 then
			Suggestions.SuggestResource(Builder, Allowed, "#")
			Suggestions.SuggestResource(Builder, Allowed, "!#")
		end
	end
end

const function Suggest(Builder: Suggestions.Builder, Source: Source, PlayersOnly: boolean, Selected: string?): Suggestions.Suggestions
	const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Builder.Input)

	Reader.Cursor = Builder.Start

	const Parser = NewParser(Reader, Source.Permitted)

	pcall(ParseWith, Parser)

	const Offset = Suggestions.CreateOffset(Builder, Reader.Cursor)
	const Kind = Parser.Suggestions

	if Kind == "NameOrSelector" then
		SuggestNames(Offset, PlayersOnly, Selected)

		if Parser.AllowSelectors then
			SuggestSelectors(Offset)
		end
	elseif Kind == "Name" then
		const Names = Suggestions.CreateOffset(Offset, Parser.StartPosition)

		SuggestNames(Names, PlayersOnly, Selected)
		Suggestions.Add(Offset, Names)
	elseif Kind == "Selector" then
		const Selectors = Suggestions.CreateOffset(Offset, Offset.Start - 1)

		SuggestSelectors(Selectors)
		Suggestions.Add(Offset, Selectors)
	elseif Kind == "OpenOptions" then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "[")
	elseif Kind == "OptionsKeyOrClose" then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "]")
		SuggestOptionNames(Parser, Offset)
	elseif Kind == "OptionsKey" then
		SuggestOptionNames(Parser, Offset)
	elseif Kind == "OptionsNextOrClose" then
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, ",")
		Suggestions.Suggest(Offset, "]")
	elseif Kind == "GameMode" then
		SuggestGameModes(Parser.GameModeOption, Offset)
	elseif Kind == "Type" then
		SuggestTypes(Parser.TypeOption, Offset)
	end

	return Suggestions.Build(Offset)
end

return {
	Suggest = Suggest,
	ParseArgument = ParseArgument,
	GetEntities = GetEntities,
	GetPlayers = GetPlayers,
	GetPlayer = GetPlayer,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Snbt"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Packrat = require("./Packrat")
const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")

const Mth = Minecraft.Mth

const Underscore = 95
const Backslash = 92
const DoubleQuote = 34
const SingleQuote = 39

const Limits = {
	[2] = {
		Int = string.rep("1", 31),
		IntNegative = `1{string.rep("0", 31)}`,
		Long = string.rep("1", 63),
		LongNegative = `1{string.rep("0", 63)}`,
		UnsignedLong = string.rep("1", 64),
	},
	[10] = {
		Int = "2147483647",
		IntNegative = "2147483648",
		Long = "9223372036854775807",
		LongNegative = "9223372036854775808",
		UnsignedLong = "18446744073709551615",
	},
	[16] = {
		Int = "7fffffff",
		IntNegative = "80000000",
		Long = "7fffffffffffffff",
		LongNegative = "8000000000000000",
		UnsignedLong = "ffffffffffffffff",
	},
}

const Radixes = { Binary = 2, Decimal = 10, Hex = 16 }
const NumeralErrors = { Binary = "snbt.parser.expected_binary_numeral", Decimal = "snbt.parser.expected_decimal_numeral", Hex = "snbt.parser.expected_hex_numeral" }
const SimpleEscapes = { b = "\b", s = " ", t = "\t", n = "\n", f = "\f", r = "\r", ["\\"] = "\\", ["'"] = "'", ['"'] = '"' }
const SimpleEscapeOrder = { "b", "s", "t", "n", "f", "r", "\\", "'", '"' }
const HexEscapes = { { Letter = "x", Size = 2 }, { Letter = "u", Size = 4 }, { Letter = "U", Size = 8 } }
const ArrayTypes = {
	Byte = { Byte = true },
	Int = { Int = true, Byte = true, Short = true },
	Long = { Long = true, Byte = true, Short = true, Int = true },
}
const TypeLetters = { { Lower = "b", Upper = "B", Type = "Byte" }, { Lower = "s", Upper = "S", Type = "Short" }, { Lower = "i", Upper = "I", Type = "Int" }, { Lower = "l", Upper = "L", Type = "Long" } }
const ArrayPrefixes = { { Letter = "B", Type = "Byte" }, { Letter = "L", Type = "Long" }, { Letter = "I", Type = "Int" } }

type Reader = ReaderModule.Reader
type State = Packrat.State

type Parser = (State: State) -> (boolean, unknown)

type IntegerType = "Byte" | "Short" | "Int" | "Long"

type IntegerLiteral = {
	Sign: string,
	Base: "Binary" | "Decimal" | "Hex",
	Digits: string,
	Signed: string?,
	Type: IntegerType?,
}

const function Error(Key: string, Argument: string?): unknown
	return if Argument then { translate = Key, with = { Argument } } else { translate = Key }
end

const function CanStartNumber(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return ReaderModule.IsDigit(Codepoint) or Codepoint == 43 or Codepoint == 45 or Codepoint == 46
end

const function LooksAt(State: State, Kind: "Number" | "Quote" | "Map" | "List"): boolean
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Codepoint = ReaderModule.Peek(Reader)

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Kind == "Number" then
		return CanStartNumber(Codepoint)
	elseif Kind == "Quote" then
		return Codepoint == DoubleQuote or Codepoint == SingleQuote
	elseif Kind == "Map" then
		return Codepoint == string.byte("{")
	end

	return Codepoint == string.byte("[")
end

const function IsHexDigit(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return ReaderModule.IsDigit(Codepoint) or (Codepoint >= 65 and Codepoint <= 70) or (Codepoint >= 97 and Codepoint <= 102)
end

const function IsNumeral(Codepoint: number, Base: string): boolean
	if Codepoint == Underscore then
		return true
	elseif Base == "Binary" then
		return Codepoint == 48 or Codepoint == 49
	elseif Base == "Decimal" then
		return ReaderModule.IsDigit(Codepoint)
	end

	return IsHexDigit(Codepoint)
end

const function Numeral(State: State, Base: "Binary" | "Decimal" | "Hex"): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Position = Start

	while Position < Reader.Length and IsNumeral(Reader.Codepoints[Position + 1], Base) do
		Position += 1
	end

	if Position == Start then
		Packrat.Store(State, Start, Error(NumeralErrors[Base]))

		return nil
	end

	if Reader.Codepoints[Start + 1] == Underscore or Reader.Codepoints[Position] == Underscore then
		Packrat.Store(State, Start, Error("snbt.parser.underscore_not_allowed"))

		return nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Position

	return ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Position)
end

const function Sign(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor

	if Packrat.Character(State, "+") then
		return "+"
	end

	State.Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "-") then
		return "-"
	end

	State.Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return nil
end

const function OptionalSign(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor
	const Found = Sign(State)

	if not Found then
		State.Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	return Found
end

const function TypeLetter(State: State): IntegerType?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor

	for _, Letter in TypeLetters do
		if Packrat.Character(State, Letter.Lower, Letter.Upper) then
			return Letter.Type :: IntegerType
		end

		State.Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	return nil
end

const function IntegerSuffix(State: State): (string?, IntegerType?)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor

	if Packrat.Character(State, "u", "U") then
		const Type = TypeLetter(State)

		if Type then
			return "Unsigned", Type
		end
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "s", "S") then
		const Type = TypeLetter(State)

		if Type then
			return "Signed", Type
		end
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return nil, TypeLetter(State)
end

const function IntegerLiteralRule(State: State): IntegerLiteral?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const SignValue = OptionalSign(State)
	const AlternativeMark = Reader.Cursor
	local Base: "Binary" | "Decimal" | "Hex" = "Decimal"
	local Digits: string? = nil

	if Packrat.Character(State, "0") then
		const InnerMark = Reader.Cursor
		local InnerCut = false

		if Packrat.Character(State, "x", "X") then
			InnerCut = true
			Digits = Numeral(State, "Hex")
			Base = "Hex"
		end

		if not Digits and not InnerCut then
			Reader.Cursor = InnerMark

			if Packrat.Character(State, "b", "B") then
				Digits = Numeral(State, "Binary")
				Base = "Binary"
			end
		end

		if not Digits and not InnerCut then
			Reader.Cursor = InnerMark

			if Numeral(State, "Decimal") then
				InnerCut = true
				Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.leading_zero_not_allowed"))
			end
		end

		if not Digits and not InnerCut then
			Reader.Cursor = InnerMark
			Digits = "0"
			Base = "Decimal"
		end

		if not Digits then
			Reader.Cursor = Start

			return nil
		end
	else
		Reader.Cursor = AlternativeMark
		Digits = Numeral(State, "Decimal")
		Base = "Decimal"

		if not Digits then
			Reader.Cursor = Start

			return nil
		end
	end

	const SuffixMark = Reader.Cursor
	const Signed, Type = IntegerSuffix(State)

	if not Type then
		Reader.Cursor = SuffixMark
	end

	return { Sign = SignValue or "+", Base = Base, Digits = Digits :: string, Signed = Signed, Type = Type }
end

const function Exceeds(Digits: string, Limit: string): boolean
	const Significant = string.lower(string.match(Digits, "^0*(.-)$") :: string)

	if #Significant ~= #Limit then
		return #Significant > #Limit
	end

	return Significant > Limit
end

const function InputMessage(Text: string, Radix: number): string
	return if Radix == 10 then `For input string: "{Text}"` else `For input string: "{Text}" under radix {Radix}`
end

const function ParseJavaInteger(Text: string, Radix: number, Long: boolean): (number?, string?)
	const Negative = string.sub(Text, 1, 1) == "-"
	const Digits = if Negative then string.sub(Text, 2) else Text
	const Limit = Limits[Radix]
	const Bound = if Long then (if Negative then Limit.LongNegative else Limit.Long) else (if Negative then Limit.IntNegative else Limit.Int)

	if Exceeds(Digits, Bound) then
		return nil, InputMessage(Text, Radix)
	end

	const Magnitude = tonumber(Digits, Radix) :: number

	return if Negative then -Magnitude else Magnitude, nil
end

const function ParseSigned(Text: string, Radix: number, Type: IntegerType): (number?, string?)
	if Type == "Long" then
		return ParseJavaInteger(Text, Radix, true)
	end

	const Value, Problem = ParseJavaInteger(Text, Radix, false)

	if not Value or Type == "Int" then
		return Value, Problem
	end

	const Bits = if Type == "Byte" then 8 else 16
	const Half = 2 ^ (Bits - 1)

	if Value < -Half or Value >= Half then
		return nil, `Value out of range. Value:"{Text}" Radix:{Radix}`
	end

	return Value, nil
end

const function ParseUnsigned(Text: string, Radix: number, Type: IntegerType): (number?, string?)
	if Type == "Byte" or Type == "Short" then
		const Value, Problem = ParseJavaInteger(Text, Radix, false)

		if not Value then
			return nil, Problem
		end

		const Bits = if Type == "Byte" then 8 else 16

		if Value < 0 or Value >= 2 ^ Bits then
			return nil, `out of range: {Value}`
		end

		return if Value >= 2 ^ (Bits - 1) then Value - 2 ^ Bits else Value, nil
	elseif Type == "Int" then
		if #Text <= 5 or (Radix == 10 and #Text <= 9) then
			return ParseJavaInteger(Text, Radix, false)
		end

		const Value, Problem = ParseJavaInteger(Text, Radix, true)

		if not Value then
			return nil, Problem
		elseif Value >= 2 ^ 32 then
			return nil, `String value {Text} exceeds range of unsigned int.`
		end

		return if Value >= 2 ^ 31 then Value - 2 ^ 32 else Value, nil
	end

	if Exceeds(Text, Limits[Radix].UnsignedLong) then
		return nil, `String value {Text} exceeds range of unsigned long.`
	end

	const Value = tonumber(Text, Radix) :: number

	return if Value >= 2 ^ 63 then Value - 2 ^ 64 else Value, nil
end

const function CreateInteger(State: State, Literal: IntegerLiteral, Type: IntegerType): number?
	const Prefix = Literal.Signed or (if Literal.Base == "Decimal" then "Signed" else "Unsigned")
	const IsSigned = Prefix == "Signed"

	if not IsSigned and Literal.Sign == "-" then
		Packrat.Store(State, State.Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.expected_non_negative_number"))

		return nil
	end

	const Digits = string.gsub(Literal.Digits, "_", "")
	const Text = if Literal.Sign == "-" then `-{Digits}` else Digits
	const Radix = Radixes[Literal.Base]
	local Value: number? = nil
	local Problem: string? = nil

	if IsSigned then
		Value, Problem = ParseSigned(Text, Radix, Type)
	else
		Value, Problem = ParseUnsigned(Text, Radix, Type)
	end

	if not Value then
		Packrat.Store(State, State.Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.number_parse_failure", Problem))

		return nil
	end

	return Value
end

const function FloatTypeSuffix(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor

	if Packrat.Character(State, "f", "F") then
		return "Float"
	end

	State.Reader.Cursor = Mark

	if Packrat.Character(State, "d", "D") then
		return "Double"
	end

	State.Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return nil
end

const function OptionalNumeral(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor
	const Found = Numeral(State, "Decimal")

	if not Found then
		State.Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	return Found
end

const function ExponentPart(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor

	if not Packrat.Character(State, "e", "E") then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return nil
	end

	const SignValue = OptionalSign(State)
	const Digits = Numeral(State, "Decimal")

	if not Digits then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark

		return nil
	end

	return `e{if SignValue == "-" then "-" else ""}{string.gsub(Digits, "_", "")}`
end

const function OptionalExponent(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor
	const Found = ExponentPart(State)

	if not Found then
		State.Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	return Found
end

const function FloatLiteral(State: State): (boolean, number)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const SignValue = OptionalSign(State)
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	local Whole: string? = nil
	local Fraction: string? = nil
	local Exponent: string? = nil
	local Suffix: string? = nil
	local Matched = false

	Whole = Numeral(State, "Decimal")

	if Whole and Packrat.Character(State, ".") then
		Matched = true
		Fraction = OptionalNumeral(State)
		Exponent = OptionalExponent(State)
		Suffix = FloatTypeSuffix(State)
	end

	if not Matched then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark
		Whole = nil

		if Packrat.Character(State, ".") then
			Fraction = Numeral(State, "Decimal")

			if not Fraction then
				Reader.Cursor = Start

				return false, 0
			end

			Matched = true
			Exponent = OptionalExponent(State)
			Suffix = FloatTypeSuffix(State)
		end
	end

	if not Matched then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark
		Whole = Numeral(State, "Decimal")
		Exponent = if Whole then ExponentPart(State) else nil

		if Whole and Exponent then
			Matched = true
			Suffix = FloatTypeSuffix(State)
		end
	end

	if not Matched then
		Reader.Cursor = Mark
		Whole = Numeral(State, "Decimal")
		Exponent = if Whole then OptionalExponent(State) else nil
		Suffix = if Whole then FloatTypeSuffix(State) else nil
		Matched = Suffix ~= nil
	end

	if not Matched then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, 0
	end

	const Contents = `{if SignValue == "-" then "-" else ""}{if Whole then string.gsub(Whole, "_", "") else ""}{if Fraction then `.{string.gsub(Fraction, "_", "")}` else ""}{Exponent or ""}`
	const Parsed = tonumber(Contents) :: number
	const Value = if Suffix == "Float" then Mth.Float(Parsed) else Parsed

	if not math.isfinite(Value) then
		Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.infinity_not_allowed"))
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, 0
	end

	return true, Value
end

const function HexLiteral(State: State, Size: number): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Position = Start

	while Position < Reader.Length and IsHexDigit(Reader.Codepoints[Position + 1]) and Position - Start < Size do
		Position += 1
	end

	if Position - Start < Size then
		Packrat.Store(State, Start, Error("snbt.parser.expected_hex_escape", tostring(Size)))

		return nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Position

	return ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Position)
end

const function IsUnicodeNameCharacter(Codepoint: number): boolean
	return Codepoint == 45 or Codepoint == 32 or ReaderModule.IsDigit(Codepoint) or (Codepoint >= 65 and Codepoint <= 90) or (Codepoint >= 97 and Codepoint <= 122)
end

const function EscapeSequence(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Mark = Reader.Cursor

	for _, Letter in SimpleEscapeOrder do
		if Packrat.Character(State, Letter) then
			return SimpleEscapes[Letter]
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	for _, Escape in HexEscapes do
		if Packrat.Character(State, Escape.Letter) then
			const Hex = HexLiteral(State, Escape.Size)

			if Hex then
				local Codepoint = tonumber(Hex, 16) :: number

				if Codepoint >= 2 ^ 31 then
					Codepoint -= 2 ^ 32
				end

				if Codepoint < 0 or Codepoint > 0x10FFFF then
					Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_codepoint", string.format("U+%08X", Codepoint % 2 ^ 32)))
					Reader.Cursor = Mark

					return nil
				end

				return utf8.char(Codepoint)
			end
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	if Packrat.Character(State, "N") and Packrat.Character(State, "{") then
		const Start = Reader.Cursor
		local Position = Start

		while Position < Reader.Length and IsUnicodeNameCharacter(Reader.Codepoints[Position + 1]) do
			Position += 1
		end

		if Position == Start then
			Packrat.Store(State, Start, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_character_name"))
		else
			Reader.Cursor = Position

			if Packrat.Character(State, "}") then
				Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_character_name"))
			end
		end
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Mark

	return nil
end

const function PlainChunk(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Position = Start

	while Position < Reader.Length do
		const Codepoint = Reader.Codepoints[Position + 1]

		if Codepoint == DoubleQuote or Codepoint == SingleQuote or Codepoint == Backslash then
			break
		end

		Position += 1
	end

	if Position == Start then
		Packrat.Store(State, Start, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_string_contents"))

		return nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Position

	return ReaderModule.Substring(Reader, Start, Position)
end

const function StringContents(State: State, OtherQuote: string): string
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Chunks: { string } = {}

	while true do
		const Mark = Reader.Cursor
		local Chunk = PlainChunk(State)

		if not Chunk then
			Reader.Cursor = Mark

			if Packrat.Character(State, "\\") then
				Chunk = EscapeSequence(State)
			end
		end

		if not Chunk then
			Reader.Cursor = Mark

			if Packrat.Character(State, OtherQuote) then
				Chunk = OtherQuote
			end
		end

		if not Chunk then
			Reader.Cursor = Mark

			break
		end

		table.insert(Chunks, Chunk)
	end

	return table.concat(Chunks)
end

const function QuotedString(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	if Packrat.Character(State, '"') then
		const Contents = StringContents(State, "'")

		if Packrat.Character(State, '"') then
			return Contents
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Start

	if Packrat.Character(State, "'") then
		const Contents = StringContents(State, '"')

		if Packrat.Character(State, "'") then
			return Contents
		end
	end

	Reader.Cursor = Start

	return nil
end

const function UnquotedString(State: State): string?
	const Reader = State.Reader

	ReaderModule.SkipWhitespace(Reader)

	const Cursor = Reader.Cursor
	const Value = ReaderModule.ReadUnquotedString(Reader)

	if Value == "" then
		Packrat.Store(State, Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.expected_unquoted_string"))

		return nil
	end

	return Value
end

const function RepeatedLiterals(State: State, Parse: Parser): { unknown }
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Elements: { unknown } = {}

	while true do
		const MarkBeforeSeparator = Reader.Cursor

		if #Elements > 0 and not Packrat.Character(State, ",") then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkBeforeSeparator

			break
		end

		const MarkAfterSeparator = Reader.Cursor
		const Ok, Value = Parse(State)

		if not Ok then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkAfterSeparator

			break
		end

		table.insert(Elements, Value)
	end

	return Elements
end

const function ToBoolean(Value: unknown): boolean?
	if type(Value) == "boolean" then
		return Value
	elseif type(Value) == "number" then
		return (Value // 1) % 256 ~= 0
	end

	return nil
end

const function UnquotedOrBuiltin(State: State, Parse: Parser): (boolean, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Contents = UnquotedString(State)

	if not Contents then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	const ArgumentsMark = Reader.Cursor
	local Arguments: { unknown }? = nil

	if Packrat.Character(State, "(") then
		const Parsed = RepeatedLiterals(State, Parse)

		if Packrat.Character(State, ")") then
			Arguments = Parsed
		end
	end

	if not Arguments then
		Reader.Cursor = ArgumentsMark
	end

	if CanStartNumber(string.byte(Contents) :: number) then
		Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_unquoted_start"))
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	if Arguments then
		if Contents == "bool" and #Arguments == 1 then
			const Converted = ToBoolean(Arguments[1])

			if Converted ~= nil then
				return true, Converted
			end

			Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.expected_number_or_boolean"))
		elseif Contents == "uuid" and #Arguments == 1 then
			const Parsed = if type(Arguments[1]) == "string" then Minecraft.Uuid.FromString(Arguments[1] :: string) else nil

			if Parsed then
				return true, Minecraft.Uuid.ToIntArray(Parsed)
			end

			Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.expected_string_uuid"))
		else
			Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.no_such_operation", `{Contents}/{#Arguments}`))
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	const Lower = string.lower(Contents)

	if Lower == "true" then
		return true, true
	elseif Lower == "false" then
		return true, false
	end

	return true, Contents
end

const function MapEntry(State: State, Parse: Parser): (string?, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	local Key = QuotedString(State)

	if not Key then
		Reader.Cursor = Start
		Key = UnquotedString(State)
	end

	if not Key or not Packrat.Character(State, ":") then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil, nil
	end

	const Ok, Value = Parse(State)

	if not Ok then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil, nil
	end

	if Key == "" then
		Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.empty_key"))
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return nil, nil
	end

	return Key, Value
end

const function MapLiteral(State: State, Parse: Parser): (boolean, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor
	const Map: { [string]: unknown } = {}

	if not Packrat.Character(State, "{") then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	local First = true

	while true do
		const MarkBeforeSeparator = Reader.Cursor

		if not First and not Packrat.Character(State, ",") then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkBeforeSeparator

			break
		end

		const MarkAfterSeparator = Reader.Cursor
		const Key, Value = MapEntry(State, Parse)

		if not Key then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkAfterSeparator

			break
		end

		Map[Key] = Value
		First = false
	end

	if not Packrat.Character(State, "}") then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	return true, Map
end

const function ArrayPrefix(State: State): string?
	const Mark = State.Reader.Cursor

	for _, Prefix in ArrayPrefixes do
		if Packrat.Character(State, Prefix.Letter) then
			return Prefix.Type
		end

		State.Reader.Cursor = Mark
	end

	return nil
end

const function IntegerEntries(State: State): { IntegerLiteral }
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Entries: { IntegerLiteral } = {}

	while true do
		const MarkBeforeSeparator = Reader.Cursor

		if #Entries > 0 and not Packrat.Character(State, ",") then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkBeforeSeparator

			break
		end

		const MarkAfterSeparator = Reader.Cursor
		const Entry = IntegerLiteralRule(State)

		if not Entry then
			Reader.Cursor = MarkAfterSeparator

			break
		end

		table.insert(Entries, Entry)
	end

	return Entries
end

const function ListLiteral(State: State, Parse: Parser): (boolean, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	if not Packrat.Character(State, "[") then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	const Mark = Reader.Cursor
	local ArrayType = ArrayPrefix(State)
	local Entries: { IntegerLiteral } = {}
	local Elements: { unknown } = {}

	if ArrayType and Packrat.Character(State, ";") then
		Entries = IntegerEntries(State)
	else
		ArrayType = nil
		Reader.Cursor = Mark
		Elements = RepeatedLiterals(State, Parse)
	end

	if not Packrat.Character(State, "]") then
		Reader.Cursor = Start

		return false, nil
	end

	if not ArrayType then
		return true, Elements
	end

	const Allowed = ArrayTypes[ArrayType]
	const Values: { number } = {}

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		const Type = Entry.Type or ArrayType :: IntegerType

		if not Allowed[Type] then
			Packrat.Store(State, Reader.Cursor, Error("snbt.parser.invalid_array_element_type"))
			Reader.Cursor = Start

			return false, nil
		end

		const Value = CreateInteger(State, Entry, Type)

		if not Value then
			Reader.Cursor = Start

			return false, nil
		end

		table.insert(Values, Value)
	end

	return true, Values
end

const function Literal(State: State): (boolean, unknown)
	const Reader = State.Reader
	const Start = Reader.Cursor

	if LooksAt(State, "Number") then
		const IsFloat, Float = FloatLiteral(State)

		if IsFloat then
			return true, Float
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start

		const Integer = IntegerLiteralRule(State)

		if Integer then
			const Value = CreateInteger(State, Integer, Integer.Type or "Int")

			if Value then
				return true, Value
			end

			Reader.Cursor = Start

			return false, nil
		end

		Reader.Cursor = Start
	end

	if LooksAt(State, "Quote") then
		const Quoted = QuotedString(State)

		return Quoted ~= nil, Quoted
	elseif LooksAt(State, "Map") then
		return MapLiteral(State, Literal)
	elseif LooksAt(State, "List") then
		return ListLiteral(State, Literal)
	end

	return UnquotedOrBuiltin(State, Literal)
end

const function Parse(Reader: Reader): unknown
	const State = Packrat.Create(Reader)
	const Ok, Value = Literal(State)

	if Ok then
		return Value
	end

	return Packrat.Fail(State)
end

return {
	Parse = Parse,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Source"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("../Connection")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Settings = require("../Settings")

export type Source = {
	Player: Player,
	Entity: Entities.ServerPlayer,
	Position: vector,
	DisplayName: unknown,
	Permitted: boolean,
}

const function PlayerOf(Player: Player): Entities.ServerPlayer?
	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const ServerPlayer = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if ServerPlayer and ServerPlayer.Player == Player then
			return ServerPlayer
		end
	end

	return nil
end

const function Create(Player: Player): Source?
	const Entity = PlayerOf(Player)

	if not Entity then
		return nil
	end

	return {
		Player = Player,
		Entity = Entity,
		Position = Entity.Position,
		DisplayName = { text = Player.Name },
		Permitted = Settings.CanUseCommands(Player),
	}
end

const function SendSystemMessage(Player: Player, Message: unknown)
	Minecraft.Protocol.WriteSystemChat(Connection.StreamFor(Player), Message)
end

const function SendSuccess(Source: Source, Message: unknown, Broadcast: boolean)
	SendSystemMessage(Source.Player, Message)

	if not Broadcast then
		return
	end

	const Notice = { translate = "chat.type.admin", with = { Source.DisplayName, Message }, color = "gray", italic = true }

	for _, Entity in Entities.All do
		const Other = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

		if Other and Other ~= Source.Entity and Settings.CanUseCommands(Other.Player) then
			SendSystemMessage(Other.Player, Notice)
		end
	end

	print(Minecraft.Language.PlainText(Notice))
end

const function SendFailure(Source: Source, Message: unknown)
	SendSystemMessage(Source.Player, { text = "", extra = { Message }, color = "red" })
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	SendSystemMessage = SendSystemMessage,
	SendSuccess = SendSuccess,
	SendFailure = SendFailure,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Suggestions"] = function(require)

export type Suggestion = {
	Start: number,
	End: number,
	Text: string,
	Tooltip: unknown?,
}

export type Builder = {
	Input: string,
	InputLowerCase: string,
	Start: number,
	Remaining: string,
	RemainingLowerCase: string,
	Result: { Suggestion },
}

export type Suggestions = {
	Start: number,
	End: number,
	List: { Suggestion },
}

const function Codepoints(Text: string): number
	return utf8.len(Text) or #Text
end

const function Substring(Text: string, From: number, To: number?): string
	const Start = utf8.offset(Text, From + 1) or #Text + 1
	const Finish = if To then (utf8.offset(Text, To + 1) or #Text + 1) - 1 else #Text

	return string.sub(Text, Start, Finish)
end

const function Create(Input: string, Start: number): Builder
	const Remaining = Substring(Input, Start)

	return {
		Input = Input,
		InputLowerCase = string.lower(Input),
		Start = Start,
		Remaining = Remaining,
		RemainingLowerCase = string.lower(Remaining),
		Result = {},
	}
end

const function CreateOffset(Builder: Builder, Start: number): Builder
	return Create(Builder.Input, Start)
end

const function Suggest(Builder: Builder, Text: string, Tooltip: unknown?)
	if Text == Builder.Remaining then
		return
	end

	table.insert(Builder.Result, { Start = Builder.Start, End = Codepoints(Builder.Input), Text = Text, Tooltip = Tooltip })
end

const function Add(Builder: Builder, Other: Builder)
	for _, Entry in Other.Result do
		table.insert(Builder.Result, Entry)
	end
end

const function Collect(Input: string, Entries: { Suggestion }): Suggestions
	if #Entries == 0 then
		return { Start = 0, End = 0, List = {} }
	end

	local Start = math.huge
	local End = -math.huge

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		Start = math.min(Start, Entry.Start)
		End = math.max(End, Entry.End)
	end

	const Seen: { [string]: true } = {}
	const List: { Suggestion } = {}

	for _, Entry in Entries do
		const Text = if Entry.Start == Start and Entry.End == End then Entry.Text else `{Substring(Input, Start, Entry.Start)}{Entry.Text}{Substring(Input, Entry.End, End)}`

		if not Seen[Text] then
			Seen[Text] = true
			table.insert(List, { Start = Start, End = End, Text = Text, Tooltip = Entry.Tooltip })
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(First: Suggestion, Second: Suggestion): boolean
		const Left = string.lower(First.Text)
		const Right = string.lower(Second.Text)

		return if Left ~= Right then Left < Right else First.Text < Second.Text
	end)

	return { Start = Start, End = End, List = List }
end

const function Build(Builder: Builder): Suggestions
	return Collect(Builder.Input, Builder.Result)
end

const function Merge(Input: string, All: { Suggestions }): Suggestions
	const Entries: { Suggestion } = {}

	for _, Each in All do
		for _, Entry in Each.List do
			table.insert(Entries, Entry)
		end
	end

	return Collect(Input, Entries)
end

const function MatchesSubString(Pattern: string, Input: string): boolean
	local Index = 1

	while string.sub(Input, Index, Index + #Pattern - 1) ~= Pattern do
		const Splitter = string.find(Input, "[%._/]", Index)

		if not Splitter then
			return false
		end

		Index = Splitter + 1
	end

	return true
end

const function SuggestMatching(Builder: Builder, Values: { string })
	for _, Value in Values do
		if MatchesSubString(Builder.RemainingLowerCase, string.lower(Value)) then
			Suggest(Builder, Value)
		end
	end
end

const function ResourceMatches(Contents: string, Id: string): boolean
	if string.find(Contents, ":", 1, true) then
		return MatchesSubString(Contents, Id)
	end

	const Namespace, Path = string.match(Id, "^([^:]*):(.*)$")

	return MatchesSubString(Contents, Namespace or "") or MatchesSubString(Contents, Path or Id)
end

const function SuggestResource(Builder: Builder, Ids: { string }, Prefix: string?, Tooltips: { [string]: unknown }?)
	local Contents = Builder.RemainingLowerCase
	const Required = Prefix or ""

	if Required ~= "" then
		if Contents == "" then
			for _, Id in Ids do
				Suggest(Builder, `{Required}{Id}`, if Tooltips then Tooltips[Id] else nil)
			end

			return
		end

		local Common = 0

		while Common < #Contents and Common < #Required and string.sub(Contents, Common + 1, Common + 1) == string.sub(Required, Common + 1, Common + 1) do
			Common += 1
		end

		if Common == 0 then
			return
		end

		Contents = string.sub(Contents, Common + 1)
	end

	for _, Id in Ids do
		if ResourceMatches(Contents, Id) then
			Suggest(Builder, `{Required}{Id}`, if Tooltips then Tooltips[Id] else nil)
		end
	end
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	CreateOffset = CreateOffset,
	Suggest = Suggest,
	Add = Add,
	Build = Build,
	Merge = Merge,
	Substring = Substring,
	SuggestMatching = SuggestMatching,
	SuggestResource = SuggestResource,
	ResourceMatches = ResourceMatches,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Tracker"] = function(require)

const Entities = require("../Entities")
const Reader = require("./Reader")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")

export type Tracker = {
	Total: number,
	Count: number,
	Only: Entities.Entity?,
	NonZeroCount: number,
	OnlyNonZero: Entities.Entity?,
}

const function Create(): Tracker
	return { Total = 0, Count = 0, Only = nil, NonZeroCount = 0, OnlyNonZero = nil }
end

const function Track(Tracker: Tracker, Element: Entities.Entity, Value: number)
	Tracker.Total += Value
	Tracker.Count += 1
	Tracker.Only = if Tracker.Count == 1 then Element else nil

	if Value ~= 0 then
		Tracker.NonZeroCount += 1
		Tracker.OnlyNonZero = if Tracker.NonZeroCount == 1 then Element else nil
	end
end

const function Message(Tracker: Tracker, NonZero: boolean, SingleKey: string, MultipleKey: string, Arguments: { unknown }, TargetIndex: number): unknown
	const Only = if NonZero then Tracker.OnlyNonZero else Tracker.Only
	const Filled = table.clone(Arguments)

	Filled[TargetIndex] = if Only then Entities.DisplayName(Only) else (if NonZero then Tracker.NonZeroCount else Tracker.Count)

	return { translate = if Only then SingleKey else MultipleKey, with = Filled }
end

const function Feedback(Tracker: Tracker, Source: SourceModule.Source, NonZero: boolean, ZeroError: string?, SingleKey: string, MultipleKey: string, Arguments: { unknown }, TargetIndex: number): number
	if ZeroError and (if NonZero then Tracker.NonZeroCount else Tracker.Count) == 0 then
		Reader.Fail({ translate = ZeroError })
	end

	SourceModule.SendSuccess(Source, Message(Tracker, NonZero, SingleKey, MultipleKey, Arguments, TargetIndex), true)

	return Tracker.Total
end

return {
	Create = Create,
	Track = Track,
	Message = Message,
	Feedback = Feedback,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Commands/Completion"] = function(require)

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Dispatcher = require("./Dispatcher")
const Entities = require("../Entities")
const ReaderModule = require("./Reader")
const SourceModule = require("./Source")

const Slash = 47
const ContextLength = Dispatcher.ContextLength

type Exception = ReaderModule.Exception

const function Context(Exception: Exception): string?
	const Input = Exception.Input

	if not Input or Exception.Cursor < 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const Line = ReaderModule.Create(Input)
	const Cursor = math.min(Line.Length, Exception.Cursor)
	const Prefix = if Cursor > ContextLength then "..." else ""

	return `{Prefix}{ReaderModule.Substring(Line, math.max(0, Cursor - ContextLength), Cursor)}<--[HERE]`
end

const function Message(Exception: Exception): unknown
	const Where = Context(Exception)

	return if Where then { translate = "command.context.parse_error", with = { Exception.Message, Exception.Cursor, Where } } else Exception.Message
end

const function IsLiteralError(Exception: Exception): boolean
	const Message = Exception.Message

	return type(Message) == "table" and (Message :: { translate: string? }).translate == "argument.literal.incorrect"
end

const function ParseException(Result: Dispatcher.ParseResult): Exception?
	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Result.Reader) then
		return nil
	elseif #Result.Exceptions == 1 then
		return Result.Exceptions[1]
	end

	const Empty = Result.Context.RangeStart == Result.Context.RangeEnd

	return ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = if Empty then "command.unknown.command" else "command.unknown.argument" }, Result.Reader)
end

const function SelectedUuid(EntityId: number?): string?
	const Entity = if EntityId then Entities.Get(EntityId) else nil
	const Player = if Entity then Entities.AsPlayer(Entity) else nil

	return if Player then Minecraft.Uuid.ToString(Minecraft.Uuid.Offline(Player.Name)) else nil
end

const function Compute(Root: Dispatcher.Node, Source: SourceModule.Source, Id: number, Line: string, Cursor: number, SelectedEntity: number?): Minecraft.CommandInfo
	const Info: Minecraft.CommandInfo = {
		Id = Id,
		Usage = {},
		UsageStart = 0,
		Ranges = {},
		UnparsedStart = -1,
		UnparsedLength = 0,
		SuggestionStart = 0,
		SuggestionEnd = 0,
		Suggestions = {},
	}

	const Reader = ReaderModule.Create(Line)

	if not ReaderModule.CanRead(Reader) or ReaderModule.Peek(Reader) ~= Slash then
		return Info
	end

	const Result = Dispatcher.Parse(Root, Line, Source, 1)

	for _, Range in Dispatcher.LastChild(Result.Context).Ranges do
		table.insert(Info.Ranges, { Start = Range.Start, End = Range.End })
	end

	if ReaderModule.CanRead(Result.Reader) then
		Info.UnparsedStart = Result.Reader.Cursor
		Info.UnparsedLength = Result.Reader.Length - Result.Reader.Cursor
	end

	if Cursor < 1 then
		return Info
	end

	const Found = Dispatcher.CompletionSuggestions(Result, Line, Cursor, SelectedUuid(SelectedEntity))
	local Trailing = false

	Info.SuggestionStart = Found.Start
	Info.SuggestionEnd = Found.End

	for _, Suggestion in Found.List do
		table.insert(Info.Suggestions, { Text = Suggestion.Text, Tooltip = Suggestion.Tooltip })
	end

	if Cursor == Reader.Length then
		if #Found.List == 0 and #Result.Exceptions > 0 then
			local Literals = 0

			for _, Exception in Result.Exceptions do
				if IsLiteralError(Exception) then
					Literals += 1
				else
					table.insert(Info.Usage, Message(Exception))
				end
			end

			if Literals > 0 then
				table.insert(Info.Usage, Message(ReaderModule.NewException({ translate = "command.unknown.argument" }, Result.Reader)))
			end
		elseif ReaderModule.CanRead(Result.Reader) then
			Trailing = true
		end
	end

	const Parent, Start = Dispatcher.FindSuggestionContext(Result.Context, Cursor)

	if #Info.Usage == 0 then
		const Entries: { unknown } = {}

		for _, Entry in Dispatcher.SmartUsage(Parent, Source) do
			if Entry.Node.Kind ~= "Literal" then
				table.insert(Entries, { text = Entry.Usage, color = "gray" })
			end
		end

		if #Entries == 0 and Trailing then
			const Problem = ParseException(Result)

			if Problem then
				table.insert(Info.Usage, Message(Problem))
			end
		end

		for _, Entry in Entries do
			table.insert(Info.Usage, Entry)
		end
	end

	Info.UsageStart = Start

	return Info
end

return {
	Compute = Compute,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Sounds"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
