const Entities = require("./Entities")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const SeedRange = 2 ^ 32 - 1

const Generator = Random.new()

const function Play(Except: Player?, Position: vector, Event: string, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	const Seed = Generator:NextInteger(0, SeedRange)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer ~= Except then
			Protocol.WriteSound(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Event, Position, Volume, Pitch, Seed)
		end
	end
end

const function PlayFromEntity(Except: Player?, Entity: Entities.Entity, Event: string, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	const Seed = Generator:NextInteger(0, SeedRange)

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Viewer ~= Except then
			Protocol.WriteSoundEntity(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Event, Entity.Id, Volume, Pitch, Seed)
		end
	end
end

const function EntitySound(Entity: Entities.Entity, Event: string, Volume: number, Pitch: number)
	const Player = Entities.AsPlayer(Entity)

	Play(if Player then Player.Player else nil, Entity.Position, Event, Volume, Pitch)
end

return {
	Play = Play,
	PlayFromEntity = PlayFromEntity,
	EntitySound = EntitySound,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Advancements"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")
const Connection = require("./Connection")
const Entities = require("./Entities")

const Protocol = Minecraft.Protocol

const function Award(Player: Entities.ServerPlayer, Id: string)
	const Advancement = Minecraft.Advancements.Get(Id)

	if not Advancement or Player.Advancements[Id] then
		return
	end

	Player.Advancements[Id] = true
	Protocol.WriteAwardAdvancement(Connection.StreamFor(Player.Player), Id)

	const Announcement = {
		translate = `chat.type.advancement.{Advancement.Type}`,
		with = { Entities.DisplayName(Player), Minecraft.Advancements.Name(Advancement) },
	}

	for _, Viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Protocol.WriteSystemChat(Connection.StreamFor(Viewer), Announcement)
	end
end

return {
	Award = Award,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/Damage"] = function(require)

const StudsPerMeter = 1 / 0.28
const TicksPerSecond = 20
const MaximumLift = 0.4

export type Hit = {
	Amount: number,
	Type: string,
	Attacker: Instance?,
	BypassesInvulnerability: boolean?,
}

export type Receiver = {
	Hurt: (Model: Instance, Hit: Hit) -> boolean,
	Knockback: (Model: Instance, Push: vector, Attacker: Instance?) -> (),
}

const Receivers: { [Instance]: Receiver } = {}

const function Register(Model: Instance, Receiver: Receiver)
	Receivers[Model] = Receiver
end

const function Unregister(Model: Instance)
	Receivers[Model] = nil
end

const function ResolveReceiver(Target: Instance): (Receiver?, Instance?, Humanoid?)
	local Current: Instance? = Target

	while Current and Current ~= workspace do
		const Registered = Receivers[Current]

		if Registered then
			return Registered, Current, nil
		end

		const Humanoid = Current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if Humanoid then
			return nil, nil, Humanoid
		end

		Current = Current.Parent
	end

	return nil, nil, nil
end

const function HurtHumanoid(Humanoid: Humanoid, Hit: Hit): boolean
	if Humanoid.Health <= 0 or Hit.Amount <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	if Hit.BypassesInvulnerability then
		Humanoid.Health = math.max(Humanoid.Health - Hit.Amount, 0)
	else
		Humanoid:TakeDamage(Hit.Amount)
	end

	return true
end

const function PushHumanoid(Humanoid: Humanoid, Push: vector)
	const Root = Humanoid.RootPart

	if not Root or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	const Scale = StudsPerMeter * TicksPerSecond
	const Old = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity / Scale
	const Power = math.sqrt(Push.x * Push.x + Push.z * Push.z)
	const Grounded = Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	const Vertical = if Grounded then math.min(MaximumLift, Old.Y / 2 + Power) else Old.Y

	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.create(Old.X / 2 + Push.x, Vertical, Old.Z / 2 + Push.z) * Scale
end

const function Deal(Target: Instance, Hit: Hit): boolean
	const Registered, Model, Humanoid = ResolveReceiver(Target)

	if Registered and Model then
		return Registered.Hurt(Model, Hit)
	elseif Humanoid then
		return HurtHumanoid(Humanoid, Hit)
	end

	return false
end

const function Knockback(Target: Instance, Push: vector, Attacker: Instance?)
	const Registered, Model, Humanoid = ResolveReceiver(Target)

	if Registered and Model then
		Registered.Knockback(Model, Push, Attacker)
	elseif Humanoid then
		PushHumanoid(Humanoid, Push)
	end
end

const function IsTarget(Target: Instance): boolean
	const Registered, Model, Humanoid = ResolveReceiver(Target)

	return Registered ~= nil and Model ~= nil or Humanoid ~= nil
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	Unregister = Unregister,
	Deal = Deal,
	Knockback = Knockback,
	IsTarget = IsTarget,
}

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Features/RobloxCharacters"] = function(require)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Minecraft = require("@game/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Minecraft")

const function Spawn(Player: Player)
	if Player.Parent == Players and Player:GetAttribute(Minecraft.PlayerAttribute) == false then
		Player:LoadCharacterAsync()
	end
end

const function WatchCharacter(Player: Player, Character: Model)
	const Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			task.delay(Players.RespawnTime, Spawn, Player)
		end)
	end
end

const function Watch(Player: Player)
	Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
		WatchCharacter(Player, Character)
	end)

	if Player:GetAttribute(Minecraft.PlayerAttribute) ~= nil then
		Spawn(Player)
	else
		Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Minecraft.PlayerAttribute):Once(function()
			Spawn(Player)
		end)
	end
end

const function Start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Watch)

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Watch(Player)
	end
end

return Start

end

_MODULES["ServerScriptService/Server"] = function(require)

const StartMinecraft = require("./Features/Minecraft")
const StartRobloxCharacters = require("./Features/RobloxCharacters")

StartMinecraft()
StartRobloxCharacters()

end

_G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP = function()
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("Minecraft")
    end)
    if _G.__MINECRAFT_SERVER_CONN then
        pcall(function()
            _G.__MINECRAFT_SERVER_CONN:Disconnect()
        end)
        _G.__MINECRAFT_SERVER_CONN = nil
    end
    pcall(function()
        local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("MinecraftFocus")
        if f then f:Destroy() end
        local h = workspace:FindFirstChild("MinecraftHitboxes")
        if h then h:Destroy() end
        local av = workspace:FindFirstChild("MinecraftAvatars")
        if av then av:Destroy() end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()

    if _G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP then
        _G.__MINECRAFT_CLEANUP()
    end

    print("[Minecraft Luau] Inicializando Minecraft Java Edition (Clientsided)...")

    local function _protectRobloxCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 3) or char.PrimaryPart
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.RequiresNeck = false
                pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false) end)
            end
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.Transparency = 1
                    part.CastShadow = false
                    if part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or part == root then
                        part.Anchored = true
                    end
                elseif part:IsA("Decal") then
                    part.Transparency = 1
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        _protectRobloxCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(_protectRobloxCharacter)

    local okClient, errClient = xpcall(function()
        local ClientMinecraft = _virtualRequire("ReplicatedStorage/Client", "./Features/Minecraft")
        ClientMinecraft()
    end, debug.traceback)

    if not okClient then
        warn("[Minecraft Luau ERRO NO CLIENTE]: " .. tostring(errClient))
        return
    end

    local okServer, errServer = xpcall(function()
        local ServerMinecraft = _virtualRequire("ServerScriptService/Server", "./Features/Minecraft")
        ServerMinecraft()
    end, debug.traceback)

    if not okServer then
        warn("[Minecraft Luau ERRO NO SERVIDOR]: " .. tostring(errServer))
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        local ServerConn = _virtualRequire("ServerScriptService/Features/Minecraft/Connection", "./Connection")
        if ServerConn and ServerConn.FlushAll then
            ServerConn.FlushAll()
        end
    end)

    print("[Minecraft Luau] Pronto! Carregado e ativo de primeira tentativa.")
end)
